  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — DataWeave 2.0 function lookup table; Lossy fields — Mule's reactive-scheduler semantics; per-Mule-version DSL deltas (3.x vs 4.x).
  - **Cutover phase**: User re-auth via passkey; per-API DNS cut-over with 30-day dual-routing window; client_id/client_secret rotation with overlap.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 14-day shadow on 10% of API traffic + per-field lineage comparison; delta detection — per-API response-body diff + latency-distribution comparison; cut-over gate — body-diff < 0.1% + p99 latency ≤ 1.2x source; sunset — subscription termination with 90-day log retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Starter (limited cores + 25 APIs) → **Bronze**; Gold → **Silver**; Platinum → **Gold**; Titanium (multi-region + premier support + AI features) → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `data-pipeline` + `apigw` are canonical; `mulesoft` and `anypoint` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-007 - Slack
- Vendor name and category: Slack Technologies / Salesforce ecosystem / team-messaging + workflow platform + Slack federation + Slack Apps marketplace + Huddles + Canvas + Slack AI.
- Coverage tier: A (already covered by `messenger` + `community` + `plugin-app-store`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free → **Bronze**; Pro → **Silver**; Business+ → **Gold** (Slack + SAML SSO + retention controls); Enterprise Grid + Slack AI → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `messenger` (1:1 DM + group DM + channel + thread); `community` (open-membership channel + multi-tenant federation analog of Slack Connect); `plugin-app-store` (Slack-app-class extension model under ADR-0249); `workflow-engine` (Slack Workflow Builder analog); `meetings` (Huddles → audio/video session); `wiki` (Canvas → document surface).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Slack Web API + Events API + SCIM):
  - `Team`/`Workspace` (id like `T01234567`, name, domain, email_domain, enterprise_id when in Grid).
  - `Enterprise` (id `E0...`, Grid org with multiple Teams).
  - `User` (id `U0...`, name, real_name, profile{email, image, status_text, status_emoji}, is_admin, is_owner, is_bot, is_guest, is_restricted, is_ultra_restricted, tz, locale).
  - `Channel` (id `C0...` public / `G0...` private group / `D0...` IM, name, is_private, is_archived, is_general, is_shared, is_org_shared, is_ext_shared, creator, purpose, topic, members[]).
  - `Conversation` (unified abstraction in newer API replacing channel/group/im).
  - `Message` (ts, user, text, blocks[], attachments[], thread_ts, reply_count, reactions[{name, count, users[]}], files[]).
  - `File` (id `F0...`, name, mimetype, filetype, size, url_private, url_private_download, permalink, channels[], groups[], ims[], is_external).
  - `Reaction` (name=emoji_code, users[], count).
  - `Workflow` (Workflow Builder workflow id, steps[{type in {form, message, send_message, send_dm, function_app, branch}}]).
  - `App` (Slack App with manifest.yaml: bot_user, oauth.scopes.bot/user, features.slash_commands, features.event_subscriptions, features.app_home).
  - `SlackConnect` channel + invitation (cross-org channel membership).
  - `Huddle` (audio/video session, per-channel; not persisted in Web API).
  - `Canvas` (Slack Canvas: rich-text doc surface, channel-canvas vs standalone canvas).
  - `List` (Slack Lists: structured-data tables inside channels).
  - `UserGroup` (id `S0...`, handle, users[], description).
  - `Pin`, `Star`, `Bookmark` (per-channel-anchored content).
  - `Reminder` (user-bound timed message).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Web API: `POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage`, `GET conversations.list`, `GET conversations.history`, `POST conversations.create`, `POST conversations.invite`, `POST files.upload`, `POST reactions.add`, `GET users.list`, `GET search.messages`.
  - Events API: HTTP webhook to bot's URL with events `message`, `app_mention`, `reaction_added`, `channel_created`, `team_join`, `file_shared`, `app_home_opened`, `workflow_step_execute`.
  - Real Time Messaging (RTM) WebSocket (legacy, deprecated in favor of Socket Mode).
  - Socket Mode WebSocket: `wss://wss-primary.slack.com/socket-mode/...`.
  - SCIM API for user provisioning (Grid Enterprise).
  - Discovery API (Enterprise Grid; eDiscovery export of all org content).
  - Slack Audit Logs API (`https://api.slack.com/audit/v1/`).
  - Block Kit JSON UI framework for interactive surfaces.
  - OAuth 2.0 for app install with granular scopes.
  - Granular bot tokens (`xoxb-`), user tokens (`xoxp-`), app tokens (`xapp-`).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Sidebar" with sections (Custom Sections, Starred, Channels, DMs, Apps, Drafts & sent).
  - "Channel header" with members/pinned/files/canvas tabs.
  - "Threads view" + "Mentions & reactions" + "Drafts & sent" + "Saved items".
  - "Huddle" floating audio bar + screen-share + Multi-person reactions.
  - "Canvas" doc-style surface attached to a channel.
  - "Lists" Trello-style structured data inside channels.
  - "Workflow Builder" no-code automation designer.
  - "Slack AI" message summary + channel recap + topic search.
  - "Slack Connect" external-org-member badge + DM with another company.
  - "Apps directory" (Slack App Marketplace).
  - "Slash commands" + "Shortcuts menu" + "Bookmarks" channel-anchored.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<member-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"MessagePost", Oyatie::Action::"MessageEditOwn",
      Oyatie::Action::"MessageDeleteOwn", Oyatie::Action::"ReactionAdd",
      Oyatie::Action::"ThreadReply", Oyatie::Action::"UserMention",
      Oyatie::Action::"GroupMention", Oyatie::Action::"HereMention",
      Oyatie::Action::"EveryoneMention", Oyatie::Action::"MessagePin",
      Oyatie::Action::"BookmarkAdd", Oyatie::Action::"CrossChannelShare",
      Oyatie::Action::"UserInvite", Oyatie::Action::"UserKick",
      Oyatie::Action::"ChannelArchive", Oyatie::Action::"ChannelRename",
      Oyatie::Action::"AppInstall", Oyatie::Action::"AppShortcutRun",
      Oyatie::Action::"WorkflowRun", Oyatie::Action::"HuddleStart"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::MessengerChannel::"<channel-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (resource.is_phi_channel ? principal.has_baa_clearance : true) &&
    (resource.is_cross_tenant ? Oyatie::CrossTenant::federation_active(resource.federation_id) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"EveryoneMention" ? principal.has_role("ChannelManager") : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Team`/`Workspace` → `Oyatie::Tenant::workspace_partition`.
  - `Channel` (`C`/`G`) → `Oyatie::Messenger::channel` (with `visibility` enum: public/private/cross-tenant/dm); preserves `is_shared` + `is_ext_shared` + `is_org_shared` flags.
  - `Message.ts` (epoch+microsecond) → `Oyatie::Message::id` (preserve `ts` as `legacy_slack_ts` for cross-ref).
  - `Message.blocks` (Block Kit) → `Oyatie::Message::content_blocks` (per-block type translation).
  - `Message.thread_ts` → `Oyatie::Message::thread_anchor_id`.
  - `Reaction` → `Oyatie::Reaction::record` (emoji-code mapped via `oya-shared-emoji-sticker-reaction-system` registry).
  - `File` → `Oyatie::FileAttachment::record` (with `drive` projection if persistent; per-MIME-type policy class).
  - `User` → `Oyatie::User::record` (per-Workspace/per-Enterprise mapping).
  - `UserGroup` → `Oyatie::UserGroup::record`.
  - `App` → `Oyatie::PluginApp::installed_app` (per ADR-0249 marketplace entry).
  - `Workflow` (Workflow Builder) → `Oyatie::Workflow::definition` with per-step typed translation.
  - `Canvas` → `Oyatie::Canvas::document` (with channel-anchor or standalone).
  - `List` → `Oyatie::List::table` (rows + columns + per-cell type).
  - `Huddle` event → `Oyatie::Meeting::session` (audio/video + screen-share state).
  - Slack channel + invitation → `Oyatie::CrossTenantFederation::grant` per ADR-0313.

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: Slack Enterprise Grid Export (full data export for Plus/Grid plans) OR Standard zip export per workspace; for non-Plus tenants, use `conversations.history` API with pagination + rate-limiting (~50 req/min per workspace).
  2. **Land**: JSON exports + file binaries ingested by `oya-cloud-data-pipeline`; per-channel partition.
  3. **Project**: per-message JSON → `Oyatie::Message`; Block Kit → Oyatie content blocks; thread structure preserved.
  4. **User identity mapping**: Slack `U0...` → Oyatie principal-id; per-user passkey enrollment with `email` as bridge; bots tracked as `Oyatie::ServicePrincipal`.
  5. **Channel membership backfill**: per-channel-member projected to Cedar group membership.
  6. **App catalog migration**: per-Slack-App manifest.yaml → `oya-shared-plugin-app-store` listing; bot tokens rotated.
  7. **Slack federation handoff**: each Slack channel mapped to `Oyatie::CrossTenantFederation::grant` per ADR-0313 sovereign-child boundary.
  8. **Workflow Builder migration**: per-Workflow JSON → Oyatie workflow definition; un-translatable function-apps surface in `slack-workflow-gap.md`.
  9. **Canvas migration**: per-Canvas content (rich-text JSON) → Oyatie canvas.
  10. **Cutover**: per-channel cut-over with member-notification; Slack channel set to read-only; new posts route to Oyatie.
  11. **Sunset**: Slack subscription termination + 90-day retention.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Mention-storm** (@everyone in 50k-member channel): rate-limit + per-channel-mention-policy + abuse-defence integration.
  - **Cross-tenant federation trust-break** (sovereign child leaves federation): per ADR-0313 grant revocation; cross-tenant channel becomes read-only then archived.
  - **App supply-chain compromise**: per-app sigstore + meta-trust-root per ADR-0293 + ADR-0247.
  - **Thread explosion** (10k+ replies in single thread): per-thread pagination + archive-policy.
  - **File-attachment policy violation** (PHI in non-PHI-tagged channel): write-time DLP scan + Cedar `forbid` on the post.
  - **Huddle recording consent mismatch**: per-participant consent check at huddle-start; non-consent triggers audio-mute for that participant only.
  - **Discovery API rate-limit** for full-content extract on Grid: ~1M messages/hour throttle; mitigation — multi-week extract window for large orgs.
  - **Channel ID re-use after archive+create**: Slack reuses some IDs; per-channel idempotent ingestion.
  - **Slack file-URL TTL**: `url_private` requires Slack OAuth token; mitigation — re-download all files during extract with token + persist to `oya-shared-drive`.
  - **Slack AI summary state**: AI-generated channel summaries are not exportable; lost at sunset (acknowledged loss).
  - **Bot token revocation race**: bot uninstall mid-cutover; mitigation — dual-token window with read-only fallback.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Slack Enterprise Grid Export + Web API + Discovery API + SCIM; format — JSON + file binaries; duration — ~24-72 hours for 10k-user org with 5 years of history; bandwidth — saturates Slack rate-limits.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Block Kit JSON → Oyatie content blocks (1:1 for most blocks; `image` blocks require file re-upload); Lossy fields — Huddle recordings (only available 14 days post-call); Slack AI summaries (regenerated post-cutover).
  - **Cutover phase**: User re-auth via passkey + SCIM provisioning; channel membership via Cedar; per-Slack-App OAuth rotation with dual-token window; DNS/SSO cut-over with 30-day rollback.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with dual-receive; delta detection — per-channel message-count + reaction-count + thread-count reconciliation; cut-over gate — |delta| ≤ 0.1% per channel; sunset — Slack subscription termination + 90-day retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Free → **Bronze**; Pro → **Silver**; Business+ → **Gold**; Enterprise Grid + Slack AI → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `messenger` + `meetings` + `wiki` are canonical; `slack` is benchmark alias.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-008 - Heroku
- Vendor name and category: Heroku / Salesforce ecosystem / Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) — build + deploy + run + add-on marketplace + Heroku (Salesforce sync) + Heroku Postgres + Heroku Redis + Heroku Kafka + Heroku Pipelines + Review Apps.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across cloud-iac + foundry + cloud-k8s + developer-sdk). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Eco/Basic → **Bronze**; Standard → **Silver**; Performance → **Gold**; Private Spaces + Shield → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `cloud-iac` (per-tenant IaC + per-environment manifest); `foundry` (build + deploy pipeline + per-app GitOps); `cloud-k8s` (runtime substrate; per-app namespace + per-app pod + Cloud Hypervisor isolation per ADR-0254); `developer-sdk` (per-app developer surface + CLI); `marketplace` (Heroku Add-ons → plugin-app-store entitlement per ADR-0314).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Heroku Platform API v3):
  - `App` (id, name, web_url, git_url, region{name, country, locale}, stack{name, state}, space{id, name}, maintenance, frozen, owner{id, email}, organization{id, name}, team{id, name}, internal_routing, acm).
  - `Release` (id, version (auto-increment integer), description, slug{id}, current, output_stream_url, status in {pending/succeeded/failed}, user{id, email}, created_at).
  - `Slug` (id, blob{method, url}, buildpack_provided_description, checksum, commit, commit_description, process_types{web, worker, ...}, size, stack).
  - `Build` (id, app{id}, buildpacks[{url}], source_blob{checksum, url, version}, status in {pending/succeeded/failed}, output_stream_url, slug{id}, user{id}).
  - `ConfigVar` (key/value pairs; `KEY=VALUE` env injected at dyno-boot).
  - `Dyno` (id, name, command, type in {web, worker, run}, size in {Eco/Basic/Standard-1X/Standard-2X/Performance-M/Performance-L/Performance-L-RAM/Performance-XL/Performance-2XL}, state, app{id}, release{id, version}, attach_url).
  - `Formation` (id, app, type, quantity, size, command).
  - `Addon` (id, name, app{id, name}, addon_service{id, name, human_name}, plan{id, name}, config_vars[], state in {provisioning/provisioned/deprovisioning/deprovisioned}).
  - `Pipeline` (id, name, owner) + `PipelineCoupling` (app + stage in {test/review/development/staging/production}).
  - `ReviewApp` (per-PR ephemeral env) + `ReviewAppConfig` (parent_app, deploy_target).
  - `Domain` (id, app, hostname, cname, kind in {custom/heroku}, acm_status, sni_endpoint).
  - `LogSession` (Logplex log stream URL).
  - `OAuth Authorization` + `OAuth Token` + `OAuth Client`.
  - `Buildpack` (URL or `heroku/<lang>` shortcut; nodejs/ruby/python/go/jvm/php/clojure/scala/.net/static).
  - `Stack` (heroku-22, heroku-24, container).
  - `Space` (Private Space — per-tenant VPC).
  - `Team` + `OrganizationApp` + `Collaborator`.

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST API v3: `GET https://api.heroku.com/apps/{app}`, `POST .../apps`, `POST .../apps/{app}/builds`, `GET .../apps/{app}/releases`, `POST .../apps/{app}/dynos`, `PATCH .../apps/{app}/config-vars`.
  - Accept header: `application/vnd.heroku+json; version=3`.
  - OAuth 2.0 + API key authentication.
  - Git push deploy: `git push heroku main` (Heroku's git endpoint accepts push + triggers build).
  - GitHub integration: webhook-driven build on PR/push.
  - Heroku CLI (`heroku apps:info`, `heroku releases`, `heroku ps:scale`, `heroku addons:create`).
  - Heroku (Salesforce bi-directional sync): bespoke REST API.
  - Logplex log-streaming protocol (Syslog over HTTPS).
  - Webhooks: `app/created`, `app/updated`, `app/destroyed`, `release/created`, `dyno/created`, `dyno/restart`, `addon/created`.
  - Container Registry (`registry.heroku.com`): Docker push for container-stack apps.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Heroku Dashboard" with app overview (Activity tab = release graph; Resources tab = formation + addon list; Deploy tab = git/GitHub integration; Settings tab = config + buildpacks + domains).
  - "Pipelines view" with multi-stage promotion graph (test → review → development → staging → production).
  - "Review Apps" per-PR auto-spawned ephemeral env with comments on PR.
  - "Metrics dashboard" with response-time + throughput + dyno-load tiles.
  - "Heroku Elements Marketplace" (add-on catalog).
  - "Heroku Dashboard" (Salesforce sync mapping editor).
  - "Heroku CLI" with `heroku run bash`, `heroku logs --tail`, `heroku ps`, `heroku releases:rollback`.
  - "Heroku Button" one-click deploy from GitHub README.
  - "Procfile" declares process types in repo root.
  - "app.json" manifest for review apps + addon manifest.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<dev-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"AppCreate", Oyatie::Action::"AppDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"AppRollback", Oyatie::Action::"EnvVarSet",
      Oyatie::Action::"LogsView", Oyatie::Action::"FormationScale",
      Oyatie::Action::"AppRestart", Oyatie::Action::"AppDestroy",
      Oyatie::Action::"PromoteToProduction", Oyatie::Action::"AddonAttach",
      Oyatie::Action::"AddonDetach", Oyatie::Action::"OwnershipTransfer",
      Oyatie::Action::"AppFork", Oyatie::Action::"OneOffDynoRun",
      Oyatie::Action::"DomainAdd", Oyatie::Action::"SSLEnable"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::App::"<app-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PromoteToProduction" ? principal.has_role("ReleaseManager") : true) &&
    (resource.is_pci_in_scope ? context.cell.is_pci_certified : true) &&
    (resource.handles_phi ? principal.has_baa_clearance : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `App` → `Oyatie::App::definition` (preserves `name` as alias; `region` → cell binding).
  - `Release.version` → `Oyatie::Release::version` (i64, monotonic per app).
  - `Slug` → `Oyatie::ContainerImage::reference` (translated to OCI image in `oya-cloud-registry`).
  - `Build` → `Oyatie::Build::record` (with buildpack-chain + source-blob-checksum).
  - `ConfigVar` → `Oyatie::Secret::env_binding` (Heroku Config Vars → OpenBao secret refs; legacy KEY preserved with `legacy_heroku_config_var` flag).
  - `Dyno` → `Oyatie::Pod::instance` (Kubernetes pod under Cloud Hypervisor per ADR-0254).
  - `Formation` → `Oyatie::Deployment::replica_set` (process-type × size × count).
  - `Addon` → `Oyatie::MarketplaceEntitlement::installation` per ADR-0249 + ADR-0314.
  - `Pipeline` + `PipelineCoupling` → `Oyatie::ReleaseTrain::stage_graph`.
  - `ReviewApp` → `Oyatie::EphemeralEnvironment::pr_spawned`.
  - `Domain` → `Oyatie::IngressDomain::record` (with ACM cert binding).
  - `Space` (Private Space) → `Oyatie::PrivateCell::vpc_isolation`.
  - `Team` + `Collaborator` → Cedar group memberships.

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: per-app `heroku apps:info`, `heroku releases`, `heroku addons`, `heroku config`, `heroku pipelines:info` via CLI + API; slug-download per release (last 50 retained); git mirror to `oya-shared-developer-sdk`.
  2. **Land**: per-app definition + per-release slug + per-config-var + per-addon catalog ingested.
  3. **Project**: per-Procfile process-type → Oyatie deployment manifest; per-buildpack → Oyatie build pipeline step (per-language buildpack registry).
  4. **Secret migration**: per-Config-Var copied to OpenBao with per-tenant + per-env scope; original Heroku Config Vars left intact during parallel-run.
  5. **Add-on migration**: per-addon class — Heroku Postgres → `oya-cloud-data-postgres` managed instance; Heroku Redis → `oya-cloud-data-redis`; Heroku Kafka → `oya-shared-messaging-kafka`; Heroku → `oya-cloud-data-pipeline` Salesforce-sync pipeline; Other add-ons → `oya-shared-plugin-app-store` re-registration.
  6. **Pipeline migration**: per-Heroku Pipeline graph → `oya-shared-foundry` promotion graph; per-Review-App config → ephemeral-environment manifest.
  7. **GitOps re-registration**: each app's repo connected to `oya-shared-foundry` Git GitOps controller; webhook re-bound.
  8. **Parallel-run**: shadow-instance on `oya-cloud-k8s` for each app + per-tenant 14-day shadow window.
  9. **Cutover**: per-app DNS swap (`heroku-app.herokuapp.com` → Oyatie ingress); CNAME map + 301 redirects from custom domains.
  10. **Sunset**: per-app deletion in Heroku after 90-day retention + final release archive to `oya-governance-evidence-store`.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Build failure**: per-build retry budget (3 attempts with exponential backoff) + per-build artifact archive + runbook `heroku-build-failure.md`.
  - **Deploy rollback cascade**: per-release atomic rollback + compensating action; rollback emits audit-event.
  - **Secret leak via env-var**: per-env-var OpenBao reference + per-app secret-scan (regex for AWS keys, GitHub tokens, etc.) + Cedar audit on access.
  - **Add-on failure**: per-addon SLA + per-addon failover; per-addon SLA tier mapped to Oyatie cell.
  - **Cross-region deploy skew**: per-region deploy version monitoring; alert on >2 versions skew.
  - **Dyno eviction loss-of-state**: per-dyno stateless-enforce + ephemeral-fs warning at build-time (Heroku Dyno filesystem is ephemeral; restart purges).
  - **Heroku mapping drift**: Salesforce schema changes break Heroku-mapping; migration validator checks per-mapping vs current Salesforce metadata.
  - **Buildpack incompatibility**: custom buildpacks (community + private) may not have Oyatie equivalent; per-buildpack inventory + replacement-mapping.
  - **Dyno tier sleep** (Eco dynos sleep after 30 min idle): per-app wake-on-request preserved or upgraded to non-sleeping tier.
  - **Private Space VPC peering**: per-Space network-config (firewall rules, VPN, peerings) requires per-Space migration.
  - **Heroku Postgres follower replication lag**: pre-cutover lag check; failover requires acknowledgment that follower data may lag primary by <60s.
  - **Heroku Redis persistence mode**: per-Redis-tier configuration (RDB snapshot only vs AOF) — Oyatie default to AOF + RDB.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Heroku CLI + Platform API v3 + per-addon export tools; format — JSON + slug binaries + Postgres pg_dump + Redis BGSAVE; duration — ~2 hours per 100 apps + per-DB-size; bandwidth — ~50 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Heroku Procfile process types → Oyatie deployment manifest; Lossy fields — Heroku metric history beyond 30 days; per-addon proprietary metrics.
  - **Cutover phase**: User re-auth via passkey; per-app DNS swap with 30-day rollback; per-addon failover with dual-active window; ACM cert re-issuance.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 14-day shadow with traffic-mirror at ingress; delta detection — per-app response-body diff sampling + latency comparison; cut-over gate — body-diff < 0.1% + p99 latency ≤ 1.2x source; sunset — Heroku app deletion + 90-day retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Eco/Basic → **Bronze**; Standard → **Silver**; Performance → **Gold**; Private Spaces + Shield → **Platinum** (HIPAA + PCI compliant Private Space).

- Naming justification: `cloud-iac` + `foundry` + `cloud-k8s` + `developer-sdk` are canonical; `heroku` is benchmark alias.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-009 - Salesforce Commerce Cloud
- Vendor name and category: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware lineage; B2C Commerce + B2B Commerce + Order Management OMS + Headless Commerce) / Salesforce ecosystem / multi-tenant SaaS commerce platform.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across marketplace + crm + ontology + payments + cloud-cdn + intelligence). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Starter Storefront → **Bronze**; Growth → **Silver**; Plus → **Gold**; B2C+B2B+OMS+Einstein → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `marketplace` (catalog + cart + checkout + order); `crm` (customer-360 binding); `payments` (multi-PSP gateway); `cloud-cdn` (storefront edge + image-transformation); `intelligence` (Einstein Commerce predictive sort + recommendations + Einstein Search); `data-pipeline` (catalog/inventory feed ingest); `apigw` (Open Commerce API + Shopper API + B2C SCAPI exposure).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (B2C Commerce + SCAPI):
  - `Catalog` (id, online, default, online_flag, image, master_catalog_flag, owner).
  - `Category` (id, online, page_title, name, image, slot_configs[], parent, sub_categories[], assigned_products[]).
  - `Product` (id, name, online, brand, manufacturer_sku, ean, upc, page_title, type{master, variant, set, bundle, option}, primary_category, image_groups[], custom_attributes[]).
  - `Variant` (variant_id, product, variation_attribute_values, orderable, available, stock_level).
  - `PriceBook` (id, currency, online_flag, parent_pricebook, start_date, end_date, price_book_prices[]).
  - `Promotion` (id, name, type{product/order/shipping}, exclusivity{none/class/global}, rank, qualifiers, callout_msg, coupons[], campaigns[]).
  - `Campaign` + `Coupon` + `CouponCode`.
  - `Cart`/`Basket` (basket_id, customer_info, billing_address, shipments[], product_items[], shipping_items[], adjusted_merchandize_total, currency, taxation, channel_type).
  - `Order` (order_no, status{created/new/open/completed/cancelled/failed}, shipping_status, payment_status, confirmation_status, export_status, channel_type, customer_info, product_items[], payment_instruments[], shipments[]).
  - `Shipment` (id, shipping_method, shipping_address, shipping_total, gift, tracking_number).
  - `PaymentInstrument` (method_id, masked_number, last_modified, c_payment_processor_response, c_psp_token).
  - `Customer` (id, login, email, encryption_scheme, hashed_password, primary_address, addresses[], payment_instruments[], wishlists[], custom_attributes[]).
  - `Inventory` + `InventoryList` (atomic stock levels with reservation tokens).
  - `Content Asset` (CMS content; HTML body + folder structure).
  - `Page` (Page Designer: layout + components + slot bindings).
  - `Search Index` (per-Locale Solr-derived index of products).
  - `Einstein Recommendation Set` (predictive sorting + complete-the-set + viewed-also-viewed).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API): `GET https://{shortcode}.api.commercecloud.salesforce.com/checkout/shopper-baskets/v1/organizations/{orgId}/baskets/{basketId}`.
  - OCAPI (legacy Open Commerce API): Shop API `/s/-/dw/shop/v23_2/` + Data API `/s/-/dw/data/v23_2/` + Meta API.
  - Shopper API + Customer API + Order API + Catalog API + Pricing API + Promotion API.
  - Business Manager (BM) GUI admin endpoint.
  - SFRA (Storefront Reference Architecture) JS+ISML cartridges deployed to per-instance code-pool.
  - Page Designer JSON page-model.
  - Commerce Cloud Open Commerce Hooks (per-cartridge JavaScript hooks).
  - WebDAV file API for cartridge upload.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Business Manager" admin shell with catalog/inventory/order/promotion/customer/search-config consoles.
  - "Page Designer" drag-drop landing-page editor.
  - "Search & Merch Console" with rule-builder + Einstein-merchandiser-tweaks.
  - "Einstein Predictive Sort" sorting strategy editor.
  - "B2C Storefront" SFRA-based React/ISML hybrid.
  - "B2B Commerce" buyer-portal + Account Switcher + Quote Builder.
  - "Order Management Console" (OMS — distributed order management).
  - "Commerce Cloud Mobile App" merchandiser dashboard.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<merchandiser-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CatalogPublish", Oyatie::Action::"PriceChange",
      Oyatie::Action::"PromotionChange", Oyatie::Action::"InventoryChange",
      Oyatie::Action::"OrderPlace", Oyatie::Action::"OrderRefund",
      Oyatie::Action::"OrderCancel", Oyatie::Action::"ItemReturn",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShipmentDispatch", Oyatie::Action::"PaymentCapture",
      Oyatie::Action::"AuthorizationVoid", Oyatie::Action::"GiftCardCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"GiftCardRedeem", Oyatie::Action::"PriceBookUpdate",
      Oyatie::Action::"SearchIndexRebuild"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Storefront::"<storefront-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (action in [Oyatie::Action::"PaymentCapture", Oyatie::Action::"OrderRefund"] ? context.cell.is_pci_certified : true) &&
    Oyatie::Storefront::accessible(principal, resource.storefront_id)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Catalog` → `Oyatie::Catalog::definition`; `Category` → `Oyatie::Category::record`.
  - `Product.type{master/variant/set/bundle/option}` → `Oyatie::Product::product_class` (typed enum).
  - `Variant.stock_level` → `Oyatie::InventoryItem::available_quantity` (with reservation-token tracking).
  - `PriceBook.price_book_prices` → `Oyatie::PriceList::price_record[]` (currency + start_date + end_date + tier_quantity).
  - `Promotion.rank` + `exclusivity` → `Oyatie::Promotion::precedence_rank` + `exclusivity_scope` (preserves rule-stacking semantics).
  - `Basket` → `Oyatie::Cart::record` with `Oyatie::Cart::line_item[]`.
  - `Order` → `Oyatie::Order::record` with multi-shipment + multi-PSP support.
  - `PaymentInstrument.c_psp_token` → `Oyatie::PaymentMethod::tokenized_ref` (PSP-tokenized; PCI-Scope-Out per ADR-0251).
  - `Customer` → `Oyatie::Shopper::profile` (linked to `crm.contact` for B2B; standalone for B2C).
  - `Content Asset` → `Oyatie::ContentAsset::record`.
  - `Page` (Page Designer) → `Oyatie::PageLayout::definition`.
  - `Search Index` → `Oyatie::SearchIndex::definition` (re-built via `oya-shared-search`).
  - `Einstein Recommendation Set` → `Oyatie::RecommendationStrategy::definition`.

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: SCAPI + OCAPI export of Catalog + Category + Product + Variant + PriceBook + Promotion + Customer + Order + Content Asset + Page Designer pages; WebDAV cartridge inventory.
  2. **Land**: `oya-cloud-data-pipeline` ingests catalog data; per-cartridge code archived; Einstein training data exported.
  3. **Project**: per-Product master-variant graph projected with attribute-set preservation.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-BM-role projected to Cedar policy; per-storefront scope.
  5. **PSP migration**: per-payment-instrument token re-issuance via dual-PSP routing window.
  6. **Search index rebuild**: per-Locale Solr index rebuilt as `oya-shared-search` index with golden-query validation.
  7. **Page Designer port**: per-page JSON translated to Oyatie page layout DSL.
  8. **DNS cutover**: per-storefront DNS swap with 301-redirect map for legacy product URLs.
  9. **Sunset**: SCC instance termination after 90-day retention.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Inventory oversell during cut-over window**: dual-write inventory holds + reservation-token deduplication.
  - **Promotion stack explosion** (>20 stacked rules): per-rule precedence-graph cycle detection.
  - **Search-index divergence post-cut-over**: per-query golden-set comparison.
  - **Payment-gateway mismatch** (SCC's PSP vs new PSP): per-order retry policy + dual-route fallback.
  - **SEO 301-redirect leakage** (legacy product URLs hardcoded externally): per-URL redirect map + 410-gone after sunset window.
  - **Cartridge code orphan**: custom SFRA cartridges with bespoke JavaScript logic require per-cartridge port; runbook `scc-cartridge-port.md`.
  - **Page Designer custom-component gap**: bespoke React components require per-component re-author.
  - **Einstein model bootstrapping**: new model needs 30-60 days of training data; mitigation — parallel-train with shadow traffic.
  - **OCAPI deprecation timeline**: Salesforce migrating from OCAPI to SCAPI; per-integration API-version pin.
  - **Multi-site / multi-locale price-book inheritance**: SCC's per-site per-locale price-book precedence requires per-storefront mapping.
  - **B2B Account Switcher session-state**: per-shopper account-context cookie requires per-tenant projection.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — SCAPI + OCAPI + WebDAV + Business Manager export jobs; format — JSON + XML + cartridge .zip; duration — ~24 hours per major storefront with 1M SKUs; bandwidth — saturates ~50 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — custom attributes `c_*` retained as `legacy_scc_attribute_*`; Lossy fields — Einstein recommender historical-train weight; per-cartridge custom hooks.
  - **Cutover phase**: User re-auth via passkey for merchandisers + customer shopper-account preserved via email-based re-link; DNS swap with 30-day rollback; ACM cert re-issuance.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 14-day shadow checkout with per-cart price + tax + shipping comparison; cut-over gate — checkout-price-delta < 0.05% + cart-abandon-rate ≤ +1%; sunset — instance termination + 90-day retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Starter Storefront → **Bronze**; Growth → **Silver**; Plus → **Gold**; B2C+B2B+OMS+Einstein → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `marketplace` + `crm` + `payments` are canonical; `salesforce-commerce-cloud` + `demandware` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-010 - Salesforce Industries (Vlocity / OmniStudio / Industries CPQ)
- Vendor name and category: Salesforce Industries (Vlocity acquisition) / per-vertical Salesforce packs — Communications, Media & Entertainment (CME), Energy & Utilities, Insurance, Health, Government (Public Sector Solutions), Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Automotive, Financial Services / Salesforce ecosystem.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across crm + workflow-engine + ontology + per-vertical pack overlay). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: per-Industry Cloud Starter → **Bronze**; Growth → **Silver**; Plus → **Gold**; per-Industry Cloud Enterprise + OmniStudio + Industries CPQ + Einstein 1 → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `crm` (base CRM); `workflow-engine` (OmniStudio Integration Procedure + OmniScript + DataRaptor + Calculation Procedure + Industry Process Library analog); `ontology` (per-vertical entity extension); per-vertical pack (pack-IS-Utilities, pack-IS-Telco/CME, pack-IS-Auto, pack-IS-Insurance, pack-IS-Manufacturing, pack-IS-CG, pack-IS-PublicSector, pack-IS-Media).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (per Industry Cloud):
  - **CME (Communications)**: `vlocity_cmt__Account__c`, `vlocity_cmt__Order__c`, `Asset` (subscribed services per account), `vlocity_cmt__OrchestrationPlan__c`, `vlocity_cmt__OrchestrationItem__c`, `Product2` with `vlocity_cmt__ObjectClass__c` discriminator, `vlocity_cmt__PriceList__c`, `vlocity_cmt__OfferingProcedure__c` (TM Forum SID-aligned).
  - **Energy & Utilities**: `ServiceAccount`, `PremisesObject`, `BillingAccount`, `Asset` (meter, transformer, pole), `UsageRead`, `OutageEvent`, `WorkOrder`.
  - **Insurance**: `InsurancePolicy`, `InsuranceClaim`, `Coverage`, `PolicyCoverage`, `Endorsement`, `InsurancePolicyParticipant`, `InsuredAsset`, `Quote` with insurance-specific extensions.
  - **Health**: see D-012 Health Cloud.
  - **Manufacturing**: `Account` with `IsCustomerPortal`, `SalesAgreement`, `AccountForecast`, `WorkOrder`, `RebateProgram`, `RebatePayout`.
  - **Public Sector**: `BenefitDisbursement`, `Case` extension with `LicenseApplication`, `RegulatoryAuthorization`, `InvolvedParty`.
  - **Auto**: `VehicleAsset`, `Deal`, `DealerAllocation`, `VehicleProductConfiguration`.
  - OmniStudio common: `vlocity_cmt__OmniScript__c`, `vlocity_cmt__Element__c`, `vlocity_cmt__IntegrationProcedure__c`, `vlocity_cmt__VlocityDataPack__c` (artifact bundle), `vlocity_cmt__CalculationProcedure__c`, `vlocity_cmt__CalculationMatrix__c`, `vlocity_cmt__DataRaptor__c`.
  - Industries CPQ: bundles up to N levels deep with `OptionalityProvisional`, `Configuration Window`, `Promotional Discount`, `Time-Plan`.

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Standard Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs (per D-001) plus per-Industry custom objects.
  - OmniStudio: `POST /services/apexrest/vlocity_cmt/v3/IntegrationProcedure/<ProcedureName>` (server-side IP invocation).
  - DataPack export/import API: `POST /services/apexrest/vlocity_cmt/v3/DataPack/...`.
  - Industries CPQ: `POST /services/apexrest/vlocity_cmt/v3/cpq/...` (cart-build, validate, price, save).
  - TM Forum Open APIs (CME-aligned): TMF629 Customer, TMF632 Party, TMF637 Product Inventory, TMF666 Account, TMF678 Billing.
  - Industries Cloud bridges to Salesforce Field Service, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "OmniScript runner" guided multi-step branching wizard (e.g., "New Service Activation").
  - "FlexCards" reusable Lightning component-card composition.
  - "Industries CPQ Cart" with bundle tree + configuration window + promotion stack.
  - "Vlocity DataRaptor Designer" declarative data-mapping editor.
  - "Calculation Matrix" lookup-table style decision engine.
  - "Industry Process Library" pre-built process templates per vertical.
  - "Insurance Policy Admin Console" with endorsement-history + claim-pipeline.
  - "Utilities Service Account 360" with meter-graph + outage-event timeline.

- **Cedar permit shape** (per-vertical example for Insurance):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<underwriter-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"PolicyQuote", Oyatie::Action::"PolicyBind",
      Oyatie::Action::"PolicyEndorse", Oyatie::Action::"ClaimFile",
      Oyatie::Action::"ClaimPay", Oyatie::Action::"ClaimDeny",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoverageAdd", Oyatie::Action::"CoverageRemove",
      Oyatie::Action::"PolicyCancel", Oyatie::Action::"PolicyReinstate"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::InsurancePolicy::"<policy-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.contains("IS-Insurance") &&
    Oyatie::Licensure::valid_in(principal, resource.state_jurisdiction) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PolicyBind" ? principal.has_role("Underwriter") : true) &&
    (resource.premium_amount > 100000 ? principal.has_role("SeniorUnderwriter") : true)
  };
  ```
  Per-vertical verb sets: utilities — start-service/stop-service/read-meter/dispute-bill/report-outage; telco — port-number/activate-sim/change-plan/suspend-service/upgrade-device; auto — vehicle-trade-in/build-and-price/dealer-allocate/lease-buyout.

- **Specific ontology projection** (per-vertical):
  - Utilities: `ServiceAccount` → `Oyatie::Utility::service_account`; `UsageRead` → `Oyatie::Utility::meter_reading` (kWh/therm/gallon with unit-class enum); `OutageEvent` → `Oyatie::Utility::outage_event`.
  - Insurance: `InsurancePolicy.PremiumAmount` → `Oyatie::InsurancePolicy::premium_amount_minor_units`; `Coverage.Limit` → `Oyatie::Coverage::limit_amount_minor_units`; `Endorsement` → `Oyatie::Endorsement::record` with effective_date + premium_change.
  - CME: `vlocity_cmt__Order__c` → `Oyatie::TelcoOrder::record`; `Asset` → `Oyatie::SubscribedService::record` (MSISDN + ICCID + SIM-state).
  - OmniScript → `Oyatie::GuidedFlow::definition` (step-graph with branch nodes).
  - DataRaptor → `Oyatie::DataMapping::transform_rule`.
  - Industries CPQ bundle → `Oyatie::ProductBundle::tree` (with depth ≤ 10 enforced).

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: per-Industry-Cloud package inventory; DataPack export per OmniScript/IntegrationProcedure/DataRaptor/CalculationProcedure/CalculationMatrix; per-vertical-entity export with relationship junctions; per-CME catalog export; per-Insurance EPC (Tenant RBAC Governance Catalog) export.
  2. **Land**: artifact bundles in `oya-cloud-data-pipeline`.
  3. **Project**: per-OmniScript translated to Oyatie GuidedFlow DSL; per-DataRaptor → ontology mapping rules.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-Profile + per-PermissionSet projected; per-licensure state added as context attribute.
  5. **Per-vertical-pack activation**: per-tenant pack-IS-Utilities/IS-Insurance/etc. enabled with version-pin.
  6. **Parallel run**: sample journey (e.g., new-service-activation) with shadow workspace 14 days.
  7. **Cutover**: per-vertical-pack cut-over with regulatory-evidence preservation.
  8. **Sunset**: Industry-Cloud license termination per vertical with retained-audit period (insurance 7 years; utilities 5 years).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **OmniScript version drift mid-customer-journey**: per-session script-version-pin + checkpoint resume.
  - **Per-vertical regulatory rule drift** (new utility PUC ruling): pack-version-pin per tenant + rolling pack-update window.
  - **DataRaptor mapping ambiguity** (declarative-to-imperative gap): per-DataRaptor validation suite at import-time.
  - **Industries CPQ catalog product-bundle explosion** (>1000 bundle options): per-bundle config-cache + lazy resolution.
  - **Per-vertical license multi-tenancy bleed**: per-tenant license-key + Cedar scope check.
  - **TM Forum SID mapping mismatch**: per-CME-entity SID-version explicit pin.
  - **Insurance endorsement-history gap**: per-policy endorsement-chain replay with effective-date integrity check.
  - **Utilities meter-read time-series volume**: per-meter reading-table partitioning by month+meter_id.
  - **CalculationMatrix lookup-table version**: per-matrix version-pin + rolling update.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Vlocity DataPack CLI + Industry Cloud API; format — JSON DataPacks + Salesforce metadata XML; duration — ~12 hours per Industry Cloud package + per-vertical-entity volume; bandwidth — saturates ~30 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — per-Industry custom field naming (`vlocity_cmt__*` prefix preserved as legacy alias); Lossy fields — CalculationMatrix legacy lookup chains require manual port.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-vertical-pack activation with regulatory-context preservation; per-licensure validation; per-tenant DNS swap.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow on sample journey per vertical; cut-over gate — per-vertical regulatory-evidence parity (e.g., insurance policy-bind equivalence; utilities meter-billing parity ±$0.01); sunset — per-vertical license termination.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: per-Industry Cloud Starter → **Bronze**; Growth → **Silver**; Plus → **Gold**; per-Industry Cloud Enterprise + OmniStudio + Industries CPQ + Einstein 1 → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `crm` + per-vertical-pack are canonical; `salesforce-industries` + `vlocity` + per-Industry-Cloud names are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-011 - Salesforce Financial Services Cloud
- Vendor name and category: Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) / Salesforce ecosystem / wealth-management + retail-banking + insurance + commercial-banking + mortgage CRM with household-graph + life-event-driven advice.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across crm + payments + compliance + pack-IS-Banking + pack-IS-Insurance + pack-IS-Wealth). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: FSC Starter → **Bronze**; Growth → **Silver**; Plus → **Gold**; FSC Enterprise + Einstein + Data Cloud → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `crm` (household + account + Account-Contact-Relationship); `payments` (bank-account + transaction binding); `compliance` (KYC / AML / sanctioned-party / Reg-BI evidence); pack-IS-Banking + pack-IS-Insurance + pack-IS-Wealth; `intelligence` (next-best-action + life-event triggering + Einstein Relationship Insights).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (FSC standard + custom):
  - `Account` extended — `IsHousehold`, `IsIndividual`, `IsCustomerPortal`; Person-Account mode common.
  - `AccountContactRelation` (junction: Contact ↔ Account with role + IsPrimary + StartDate + EndDate; powers household-graph + multi-party advisor relationships).
  - `FinancialAccount` (Id, FinancialAccountNumber, FinancialAccountType in {Brokerage/IRA/Roth_IRA/401k/Trust/Checking/Savings/CD/Mortgage/LineOfCredit}, Balance, MarketValue, OwnerId, PrimaryOwnerId, JointOwnerId, FinancialAccountSourceId, IsActive, Status).
  - `FinancialHolding` (FinancialAccountId, AssetId, Symbol, Cusip, ISIN, Shares, BookValue, MarketValue, AssetClass, UnrealizedGain, IncomeYTD).
  - `FinancialGoal` (Id, ClientId, Type in {Retirement/Education/HomePurchase/Vacation/EmergencyFund}, TargetAmount, TargetDate, CurrentAmount, Status, Priority).
  - `LifeEvent` (Id, EventDate, EventType in {Marriage/Birth/Retirement/JobChange/Death/Divorce/HomePurchase/HealthEvent}, ClientId).
  - `Referral` (Id, FromId, ToId, ReferralReasonId, Status, ExpectedRevenue, ReferredDate).
  - `AdvisorAccount` (Id, AccountId, AdvisorId, RelationshipType in {Primary/Secondary/Specialist}, AppointmentDate).
  - `KYCEvidence__c` (custom; Id, ClientId, DocumentType, IssuedBy, ExpirationDate, VerifiedDate, RiskScore).
  - `Suitability__c` (custom; Id, ClientId, AdvisorId, Date, RiskTolerance in {Conservative/Moderate/Aggressive}, InvestmentObjective, TimeHorizon, LiquidityNeed, NetWorth, AnnualIncome).
  - `SalesforceFinancialPlanSnapshot__c` (advice record sealed at moment-of-advice for Reg-BI).
  - `FinServ__InteractionAttendee__c` (per-meeting attendee with role).
  - `FinServ__InsurancePolicy__c` (insurance-side; type, premium, coverage_amount, policy_status).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Standard Salesforce REST/SOAP for all objects.
  - FSC-specific REST: `GET /services/data/v59.0/sobjects/FinancialAccount/{Id}`.
  - Action API: `POST /services/data/v59.0/actions/standard/PerformBuilderActions` (for FSC Action Plan execution).
  - Einstein Relationship Insights API for graph traversal.
  - Salesforce (OData External Object) bridges to custodian feeds (Fidelity/Schwab/Pershing/Envestnet).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Household Canvas" relationship-graph view with primary/secondary advisor badges.
  - "Client Profile" with household-roll-up Assets+Liabilities + Goals + Life Events.
  - "Action Plan" multi-step compliance task list (e.g., open-IRA action plan).
  - "Book of Business" advisor dashboard.
  - "Goal Planner" with progress-bar + Monte-Carlo simulation tile.
  - "Compliant Data Sharing" with role-based redaction.
  - "Einstein Relationship Insights" with serendipitous-connection chips.
  - "Mortgage Lending" loan-origination cockpit.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<advisor-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"FinancialAccountOpen", Oyatie::Action::"HouseholdMemberLink",
      Oyatie::Action::"RelationshipStrengthSet", Oyatie::Action::"KYCRefresh",
      Oyatie::Action::"SuspiciousActivityReportFile", Oyatie::Action::"InvestorProfileCapture",
      Oyatie::Action::"RiskToleranceChange", Oyatie::Action::"AdviceCheckpointRun",
      Oyatie::Action::"SuitabilityReview", Oyatie::Action::"FinancialPlanSnapshotGenerate",
      Oyatie::Action::"ReferralRotate"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::ClientRelationship::"<rel-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.contains("IS-Wealth") &&
    Oyatie::FinraRegistration::active(principal) &&
    Oyatie::Jurisdiction::licensed(principal, resource.client_state) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SuspiciousActivityReportFile" ? principal.has_role("ComplianceOfficer") : true) &&
    Oyatie::ChineseWall::no_conflict(principal, resource)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Account` (household) → `Oyatie::Household::record` (with member-graph).
  - `AccountContactRelation` → `Oyatie::Relationship::edge` (typed: spouse/parent/child/sibling/business-partner/trustee/beneficiary).
  - `FinancialAccount` → `Oyatie::FinancialAccount::record` (preserves FinancialAccountType + custodian + status; Balance in minor-units i64 + currency_iso_code).
  - `FinancialHolding` → `Oyatie::Holding::record` (with Symbol + CUSIP + ISIN cross-identifier).
  - `FinancialGoal` → `Oyatie::FinancialGoal::record` (target + horizon + current + priority).
  - `LifeEvent` → `Oyatie::LifeEvent::record` (with trigger-rules for rebalance/advice).
  - `KYCEvidence__c` → `Oyatie::KYCRecord::evidence` (with regulatory-cadence-pin per FinCEN/CDD-rule).
  - `Suitability__c` → `Oyatie::SuitabilityAssessment::record` (Reg-BI/Form-CRS sealed evidence).
  - `SalesforceFinancialPlanSnapshot__c` → `Oyatie::AdviceSnapshot::immutable_record` (sealed in `oya-governance-evidence-store`).
  - Custodian feed → `Oyatie::CustodianReconciliation::record`.

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: FSC standard + custom-object export (Household via Account+IsHousehold filter; AccountContactRelation; FinancialAccount; FinancialHolding; FinancialGoal; LifeEvent; KYCEvidence__c; Suitability__c; Plan Snapshot artifacts); per-custodian feed inventory.
  2. **Land**: per-household graph reconstructed.
  3. **Project**: per-FinancialHolding holding-record with multi-currency support.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-Advisor + per-FINRA-registration + per-state-licensure context.
  5. **Per-state-DOI mapping**: per-state advisor-licensure context attribute.
  6. **Custodian-feed reconciliation**: per-account custodian feed (Fidelity/Schwab/Pershing) reconciliation with balance-tie ±$0.01.
  7. **KYC/AML provider migration**: per-tenant KYC vendor binding (LexisNexis/Refinitiv/ComplyAdvantage) via `oya-shared-compliance`.
  8. **Cutover**: per-household with relationship-graph preservation + Reg-BI evidence chain integrity check.
  9. **Sunset**: FSC license termination + retained-audit-evidence period (FINRA 4511: 6 years; SEC 17a-4: 7 years; state-DOI per-state).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Relationship-graph cycle** (household member also a related advisor): per-edge type-tag + cycle detection.
  - **KYC-vendor mismatch** on cut-over: per-client KYC-record import with vendor-source-pin + re-verification window.
  - **Suitability-evidence chain gap**: per-edit immutable diff + replay.
  - **Cross-border data residency** on EU client + US advisor: per-client residency-pin + advisor-jurisdiction check.
  - **Regulatory rule drift** (state-DOI changes): pack-version-pin per state with rolling update.
  - **FINRA WORM (Write-Once-Read-Many) requirement**: per-advice-record sealed immutably; cannot be deleted; mitigation — `oya-governance-evidence-store` WORM tier.
  - **Reg-BI care-obligation evidence**: per-recommendation must capture reasonable-basis + customer-specific-suitability evidence; mitigation — recommendation-template with mandatory-evidence-fields.
  - **Form CRS delivery cadence**: per-client annual Form-CRS delivery requires per-client cadence-tracker.
  - **Custodian-feed reconciliation timing**: T+1 reconciliation window vs T+0 advice; per-account reconciliation-status banner in UI.
  - **Mortgage Lending TRID compliance**: per-loan disclosure-timing window (3 days before closing); per-loan timer.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Bulk API + custom-object export + custodian-feed export; format — CSV + JSON + FINRA-archive format; duration — ~8 hours for 50k households + 200k accounts; bandwidth — saturates 30 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — FSC custom fields with `FinServ__` prefix preserved as legacy alias; Lossy fields — Einstein Relationship Insights graph-state requires re-training.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-advisor passkey + FINRA-CRD lookup; per-state licensure validation; per-household cut-over with relationship-graph atomic transfer.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with per-household goal + balance + relationship-graph reconciliation; cut-over gate — balance-tie ±$0.01 + relationship-graph isomorphism check; sunset — license termination + FINRA-7-year retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: FSC Starter → **Bronze**; Growth → **Silver**; Plus → **Gold**; FSC Enterprise + Einstein Relationship Insights + Data Cloud → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `crm` + pack-IS-Banking + pack-IS-Wealth + pack-IS-Insurance are canonical; `salesforce-financial-services-cloud` is benchmark alias.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-012 - Salesforce Health Cloud
- Vendor name and category: Salesforce Health Cloud / Salesforce ecosystem / patient + member CRM with FHIR R4 + HL7v2 bridges, care-team graph, care plans, care-gap detection, payer + provider + life-sciences workflows.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across crm + healthcare-integration + community + intelligence + pack-IS-Healthcare). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Health Cloud Starter → **Bronze**; Growth → **Silver**; Plus → **Gold**; HC Enterprise + Einstein for Health + Data Cloud → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `crm` (patient + caregiver + provider + payer relationships); `healthcare-integration` (FHIR R4 + HL7v2 + X12 + DICOM bridge); `community` (patient self-service portal); `intelligence` (care-gap detection + risk-stratification + Einstein Discovery for population health); pack-IS-Healthcare.

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Health Cloud objects):
  - `Account` (with `IsPatient` flag for patient-account; also represents payer / provider organizations).
  - `Contact` (caregiver / provider / patient-as-Person-Account).
  - `HealthCloudGA__EhrPatient__c` (EHR-sourced patient mirror).
  - `HealthCloudGA__CarePlan__c` (with goals + interventions + targets).
  - `HealthCloudGA__CarePlanGoal__c` + `HealthCloudGA__CarePlanProblem__c`.
  - `HealthCloudGA__CareTeam__c` + `HealthCloudGA__CareTeamMember__c`.
  - `HealthCloudGA__EhrEncounter__c` (clinical encounter; admission, outpatient, emergency).
  - `HealthCloudGA__Condition__c` (problem list).
  - `HealthCloudGA__Medication__c` + `HealthCloudGA__MedicationRequest__c`.
  - `HealthCloudGA__Observation__c` (labs, vitals, results).
  - `HealthCloudGA__Consent__c` (per-purpose + per-scope consent records).
  - `HealthCloudGA__CareGap__c` (HEDIS-aligned gap-in-care).
  - `HealthCloudGA__Referral__c` (provider-to-provider referral with closure loop).
  - `EligibilityRequest` + `EligibilityResponse` (X12 270/271).
  - `PriorAuthorizationRequest` + `PriorAuthorizationResponse` (X12 278).
  - `CoverageBenefit` (plan benefits exposed to member portal).
  - `HealthcareProvider` (provider directory; NPI, DEA, specialty).
  - `HealthcareFacility`.
  - `LifeSciencesEvent__c` (clinical trial events for L&S vertical).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Standard Salesforce REST/SOAP.
  - Health Cloud FHIR-bridge: `GET /services/data/v59.0/fhir/R4/Patient/{id}`, `POST /fhir/R4/Bundle`.
  - USCDI v3 bundle: per-patient FHIR Bundle conformance.
  - HL7v2 listener via Salesforce or external MLLP-to-REST gateway.
  - X12 EDI 270/271 (eligibility), 278 (prior-auth), 837 (claim submission), 835 (payment advice), 834 (enrollment).
  - DICOM-Web `/dicom-web/studies` (image reference).
  - Salesforce Health Cloud Einstein Risk Stratification API.
  - HealthCloud Action Plan engine (per Industries D-010).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Patient Card / Member Card" with timeline + care plan + care team + medications + conditions + recent encounters.
  - "Care Plan Console" with goals + interventions + targets + progress bars.
  - "Care Team Visualizer" with role badges (PCP, specialist, care-coordinator, caregiver, payer-CM).
  - "Care Gap Inbox" with HEDIS measure + due-date + member-outreach script.
  - "Provider Directory" with NPI/specialty search.
  - "Member Plan Comparison" tile.
  - "Utilization Management Workspace" (PA approval queue).
  - "Life Sciences Clinical Trial Coordinator".

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<care-coordinator-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CarePlanCreate", Oyatie::Action::"CareTeamMemberAdd",
      Oyatie::Action::"CareEventSchedule", Oyatie::Action::"ClinicalEncounterLog",
      Oyatie::Action::"ConsentDocument", Oyatie::Action::"ConsentRevoke",
      Oyatie::Action::"CareGapFile", Oyatie::Action::"CareGapClose",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShareWithPayer", Oyatie::Action::"ShareWithPharmacy",
      Oyatie::Action::"BreakGlassEmergencyView", Oyatie::Action::"MinorRedactAfterAgeOut",
      Oyatie::Action::"PriorAuthSubmit", Oyatie::Action::"EligibilityCheck"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::PatientResource::"<patient-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.contains("HIPAA") &&
    Oyatie::Consent::scope_includes(resource.patient_id, context.purpose) &&
    (resource.is_substance_use ? context.pack.contains("42-CFR-Part-2") : true) &&
    Oyatie::CareTeam::member(principal, resource.patient_id) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"BreakGlassEmergencyView" ? context.emergency_attestation_signed : true) &&
    Oyatie::Licensure::valid_in(principal, resource.patient_state) &&
    (resource.patient_age < 13 ? context.pack.contains("COPPA") : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Account` (patient) → `Oyatie::Patient::record` (MRN as `patient_external_id`).
  - `HealthCloudGA__CarePlan__c` → `Oyatie::CarePlan::record` (with versioning + history-chain).
  - `HealthCloudGA__CareTeamMember__c` → `Oyatie::CareTeamMember::edge` (typed: PCP/specialist/coordinator/caregiver/payer-CM).
  - `HealthCloudGA__EhrEncounter__c` → `Oyatie::ClinicalEncounter::record` (with FHIR Encounter resource projection).
  - `HealthCloudGA__Condition__c` → `Oyatie::Condition::record` (ICD-10 + SNOMED CT coded).
  - `HealthCloudGA__MedicationRequest__c` → `Oyatie::MedicationRequest::record` (RxNorm + NDC coded).
  - `HealthCloudGA__Observation__c` → `Oyatie::Observation::record` (LOINC coded; with reference-range).
  - `HealthCloudGA__Consent__c` → `Oyatie::Consent::scope_record` per ADR-0272.
  - `HealthCloudGA__CareGap__c` → `Oyatie::CareGap::record` (HEDIS measure + due-date).
  - X12 270/271/278 → `Oyatie::EDIMessage::record` with HL7-FHIR bridge tags.

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: Health Cloud object export (HealthCloudGA + custom); per-patient FHIR R4 USCDI v3 bundle export via FHIR-bridge endpoint; per-encounter HL7v2 message history export; per-consent record + scope export; per-care-plan version history; per-care-gap status.
  2. **Land** in `oya-cloud-data-pipeline` with per-patient partitioning.
  3. **Project** into `oya-shared-healthcare-integration` FHIR resource model; per-coding-system normalization (ICD-10 → SNOMED CT crosswalk; legacy ICD-9 retained).
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-patient consent-scope projection; per-care-team membership; per-licensure context.
  5. **Per-state-minor-consent**: per-state minor-consent rules (e.g., CA: 12+ for STI; WA: 13+ for mental-health) projected as Cedar context attributes.
  6. **Parallel run**: care-gap detection cohort comparison (HEDIS measure recompute); ±2% gap-detection delta tolerance.
  7. **Cutover**: per-tenant with consent-pin per patient.
  8. **Sunset**: HIPAA-mandated 6-year retention + state-specific (e.g., NY 6 years post-discharge for minors until age 21).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Consent-scope leak** (consent narrowed but query returns broader data): Cedar default-deny + per-query consent-scope projection.
  - **FHIR resource-version drift** (R4 vs R4B vs R5 during dual-write): per-resource version-pin + transformation rule.
  - **HL7v2 segment truncation** (legacy messages with non-standard Z-segments): per-segment custom-segment registry + audit on unknown.
  - **Care-team leak** (member-services seeing clinical-only): per-role attribute-based access with break-glass audit.
  - **Patient-merge dedup error**: per-merge reversible-window + clinical-attestation gate.
  - **Cross-state licensure** (provider treating across state-DEA boundary): per-encounter licensure check.
  - **Substance-use 42 CFR Part 2 leak**: per-record special-class tag with default-deny external-share.
  - **EU MDR medical-device data**: per-device-class registration; class-III devices require CE-mark validation.
  - **CMS Promoting Interoperability metric miss**: per-eligible-provider USCDI conformance check.
  - **ONC Cures Act information-blocking**: per-share-request response within 7 days; per-tenant compliance dashboard.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Bulk API + FHIR bridge + HL7v2 archive + X12 EDI archive; format — CSV + FHIR JSON + HL7 pipe-delimited + X12 EDI; duration — ~24 hours per 1M patients + per-coded-data volume; bandwidth — saturates 30 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — `HealthCloudGA__*` prefix preserved as legacy alias; Lossy fields — DICOM image binaries retained at vendor but reference projected.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-care-coordinator passkey enrollment + BAA validation per ADR-0247; per-patient consent re-affirmation for sensitive scopes.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with care-gap detection delta < 2%; eligibility-check delta < 0.1%; cut-over gate — clinical-data parity attestation by CMIO; sunset — HIPAA 6-year retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Health Cloud Starter → **Bronze**; Growth → **Silver**; Plus → **Gold**; HC Enterprise + Einstein for Health + Data Cloud → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `crm` + `healthcare-integration` + pack-IS-Healthcare are canonical; `salesforce-health-cloud` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-013 - Salesforce Field Service (formerly Field Service Lightning)
- Vendor name and category: Salesforce Field Service (FSL/FSO) / Salesforce ecosystem / dispatch console + mobile-technician offline-first app + route-optimization solver + parts inventory + appointment booking + preventive maintenance.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across itsm + crm + workflow-engine + offline-runtime + mobile-shell). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: FSL Starter → **Bronze**; Dispatcher → **Silver**; Field Service Plus + AI → **Gold**; Service Cloud + FSL + Asset 360 → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `itsm` (Work Order analog); `crm` (ServiceAppointment + ServiceResource); `workflow-engine` (dispatch orchestration); `mobile-shell` (technician mobile app with offline); `intelligence` (route optimization + ETA prediction + Einstein Visual Remote Assistant).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (FSL standard schema):
  - `WorkOrder` (Id, WorkOrderNumber, AccountId, ContactId, AssetId, ParentWorkOrderId, ServiceContractId, EntitlementId, Status, Priority, Subject, Description, StartDate, EndDate, Duration, DurationType, AddressType, Street/City/State/Country/PostalCode/Latitude/Longitude, ServiceTerritoryId, OperatingHoursId, ParentRecordId).
  - `WorkOrderLineItem` (WorkOrderId, AssetId, Product2Id, Quantity, UnitPrice, Discount, ListPrice, Subtotal, TotalPrice).
  - `ServiceAppointment` (Id, AppointmentNumber, ParentRecordId, SchedStartTime, SchedEndTime, ActualStartTime, ActualEndTime, ArrivalWindowStartTime, ArrivalWindowEndTime, DueDate, EarliestStartTime, Status, StatusCategory, Duration, ServiceTerritoryId, AddressType + Street + Lat/Long).
  - `ServiceResource` (Id, Name, IsActive, RelatedRecordId (to User), ResourceType in {Technician/Crew/Equipment}, IsCapacityBased, LocationId).
  - `ResourceAbsence` (start, end, type).
  - `ServiceTerritory` (Id, Name, OperatingHoursId, ParentTerritoryId, Address).
  - `ServiceTerritoryMember` (membership window).
  - `ServiceResourceSkill` (skill + level + certification).
  - `Skill` + `SkillRequirement` (per-WO skill match).
  - `AppointmentBundle` + `AppointmentBundleConfig` (bundle related appointments).
  - `OperatingHours` + `TimeSlot`.
  - `Asset` (post-sale product registry; serial number + warranty + service contract).
  - `MaintenancePlan` + `MaintenanceWorkRule` + `MaintenanceAsset`.
  - `ProductRequest` + `ProductRequestLineItem` (parts request).
  - `ProductConsumed` + `ProductTransfer` (parts truck inventory).
  - `ServiceReport` + `ServiceReportLayout` (post-visit PDF).
  - `WorkType` (template for WO type).
  - `SchedulingPolicy` + `WorkRule` + `ServiceObjective` (optimizer constraints).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: `GET /services/data/v59.0/sobjects/WorkOrder/{Id}`, `POST .../ServiceAppointment`.
  - FSL Mobile SDK: bidirectional offline sync with delta-pull + delta-push via Briefcase.
  - Field Service Optimization API: per-territory schedule-and-route invocation; per-policy what-if simulation.
  - Field Service Dispatcher Console REST.
  - Einstein Vision API for product/parts identification.
  - Visual Remote Assistant WebRTC video signaling.
  - Field Service Connected REST endpoints for IoT-asset integration.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Dispatcher Console" Gantt-board + map-view + appointment-list + KPI tiles; drag-drop appointment-to-resource scheduling.
  - "Service Resource Calendar" per-resource per-week capacity.
  - "Field Service Mobile App" (iOS/Android) offline-first with large-tap-targets, glove-friendly, briefcase-sync.
  - "Service Report" PDF generator with customer signature + photo evidence.
  - "Asset 360" customer-asset graph with service-history + warranty.
  - "Maintenance Plans" preventive-maintenance schedule generator.
  - "Crew Management" multi-resource grouping.
  - "Appointment Booking" customer-facing scheduling widget.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<technician-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"AppointmentSchedule", Oyatie::Action::"TechnicianDispatch",
      Oyatie::Action::"AssignmentAccept", Oyatie::Action::"AssignmentDecline",
      Oyatie::Action::"EnRoute", Oyatie::Action::"OnSite",
      Oyatie::Action::"WorkStart", Oyatie::Action::"WorkPause",
      Oyatie::Action::"WorkComplete", Oyatie::Action::"PartsRequest",
      Oyatie::Action::"PartConsumeFromTruck", Oyatie::Action::"CustomerSignatureCapture",
      Oyatie::Action::"PhotoEvidenceTake", Oyatie::Action::"EscalateToTier2",
      Oyatie::Action::"Reschedule", Oyatie::Action::"NoShowCustomer"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::WorkOrder::"<wo-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    Oyatie::ServiceTerritory::member(principal, resource.territory_id) &&
    Oyatie::Skill::matches(principal.skills, resource.required_skills) &&
    Oyatie::Licensure::valid_for(principal, resource.work_type, resource.state) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PartConsumeFromTruck" ? Oyatie::TruckInventory::has_part(principal.truck_id, resource.required_part) : true) &&
    (resource.requires_loto ? context.loto_signoff_complete : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `WorkOrder` → `Oyatie::WorkOrder::record` (with multi-shipment + parts + skill-requirement preservation).
  - `ServiceAppointment` → `Oyatie::ServiceAppointment::record` (with arrival-window + sched/actual time).
  - `ServiceResource` → `Oyatie::ServiceResource::record` (with `resource_type` enum + capacity model).
  - `ServiceResourceSkill` → `Oyatie::TechnicianSkill::record` (with skill + level + certification expiry).
  - `MaintenancePlan` → `Oyatie::MaintenancePlan::record` (cadence + condition-based triggers).
  - `ProductConsumed` → `Oyatie::PartConsumption::record` (idempotent per truck-event).
  - `ServiceReport` → `Oyatie::ServiceReport::pdf` with customer signature + photos.
  - `SchedulingPolicy` → `Oyatie::SchedulingPolicy::definition` (per-territory optimizer constraint set).
  - `WorkRule` → `Oyatie::WorkRule::definition` (match-skill, time-window, resource-availability).
  - `Asset` → `Oyatie::CustomerAsset::record` (serial + warranty + service-contract).

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: FSL object export (WorkOrder, ServiceAppointment, ServiceResource, ServiceTerritory, OperatingHours, AppointmentBundle, MaintenancePlan, Asset, ProductConsumed); Scheduling-Policy + Work-Rule + Service-Objective export; FSL Mobile offline-cache schema export.
  2. **Land**: per-territory partitioned ingest.
  3. **Project**: per-WorkOrder + per-Appointment graph with skill + territory + sched-state preservation.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-Technician territory-membership + skill + licensure projection.
  5. **Per-territory route-optimizer**: per-territory training-data + policy export; per-territory bootstrap of new optimizer with 14-day calibration.
  6. **Parts inventory**: per-truck inventory snapshot; per-part idempotent decrement reservation tokens.
  7. **Parallel run**: dispatch on sample territory for 72h with KPI comparison (dispatch-density + travel-time + SLA-attainment).
  8. **Cutover**: per-territory with appointment-state-pin; in-flight appointments complete on legacy.
  9. **Sunset**: FSL license termination + field-evidence retention (insurance + warranty 5-7 years).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Offline-sync conflict** (technician edited offline while dispatcher rescheduled): per-record vector-clock + manual-resolution UI for diverged fields.
  - **Route-optimizer SLA miss** on territory-rebalance: per-territory soft-constraint vs hard-constraint with degraded-mode fallback.
  - **Parts inventory bleed** across trucks: per-truck idempotent decrement + reservation token.
  - **Customer-signature-capture loss** (offline-only signature never uploaded): per-signature checksum + scheduled-replay queue.
  - **Appointment-bundle break** (bundled multi-WO appointment partially completed): per-bundle atomic-completion gate with manual-override audit.
  - **Skill certification expiry mid-WO**: per-WO skill-pin at dispatch + daily re-verify.
  - **Crew membership split** during reorg: per-crew member-history preservation.
  - **Geolocation drift** (GPS error in dense urban): per-arrival auto-correction + on-site manual confirm.
  - **LOTO (Lock-Out-Tag-Out) sign-off bypass**: per-WO mandatory step in workflow + audit on bypass-attempt.
  - **Photo evidence quota**: high-res photos accumulate fast; per-tenant storage quota + retention policy.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Bulk API + FSL REST + Mobile briefcase export; format — CSV + JSON + offline-DB schema; duration — ~6 hours per 50 territories + per-Asset-volume; bandwidth — saturates 30 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — `Address` polymorphic projected to typed address with normalization; Lossy fields — Einstein Visual Remote Assistant video recordings (24-hour TTL).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-technician passkey + skill-set + licensure projection; per-territory ESN handoff with appointment-state-pin.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 72h shadow on sample territory; KPI delta < 2% (travel-time + first-time-fix); cut-over gate — appointment-bundle integrity + per-truck inventory tie ±1 unit; sunset — license termination + 5-year retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: FSL Starter → **Bronze**; Dispatcher → **Silver**; Field Service Plus + AI → **Gold**; Service Cloud + FSL + Asset 360 → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `itsm` + `crm` + `mobile-shell` are canonical; `salesforce-field-service-lightning` is benchmark alias.
