### Section D-014 - Salesforce Experience Cloud (formerly Communities)
- Vendor name and category: Salesforce Experience Cloud / Community Cloud (legacy) / Salesforce ecosystem / external-facing site builder for customer + partner + employee communities + B2C portals + B2B partner portals + help-centers + microsites.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across community + identity-federation + workflow-studio + plugin-app-store). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Customer Community Login → **Bronze**; Customer Community Plus → **Silver**; Partner Community → **Gold**; Experience Cloud + LWR + Data Cloud → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `community` (multi-tenant federated community + open-membership channel; ADR-0249 marketplace community surface); `identity` (per-community guest-to-member federation); `workflow-studio` (per-community workflow editor); `plugin-app-store` (community lightning-component analog); `wiki` (Knowledge bridge); `cloud-cdn` (edge delivery).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Experience Cloud):
  - `Network` (Community/Experience Cloud Site; Id, Name, Status, NetworkType, UrlPathPrefix, OptionsAllowExternalUserSelfRegistration).
  - `NetworkMember` (NetworkId + MemberId; per-User per-Community membership).
  - `Profile` + `PermissionSet` (community-specific permission sets).
  - `Site` (Force.com Sites; legacy public-facing).
  - `FeedItem` + `FeedComment` (Chatter feed in community).
  - `Topic` + `TopicAssignment` (topic tagging).
  - `Question` + `QuestionVote` + `BestAnswer` (Q&A pattern).
  - `KnowledgeArticleVersion` (community-published Knowledge).
  - `IdeaTheme` + `Idea` + `IdeaComment` + `IdeaVote` (ideation pattern).
  - `User` with `IsPortalEnabled` flag and Community-tied Profile.
  - `ContentDocument` + `ContentVersion` (file library).
  - `ContentDistribution` (external file share).
  - `CmsContent` + `CmsContentChannel` + `CmsContentNode` (Salesforce CMS).
  - `ManagedContentVariant` (per-locale variant).
  - `ExperienceBundle` (deployable site metadata).
  - `LightningExperienceTheme` + `LightningComponentBundle` (LWR Aura + LWC components).
  - `Reputation` (community reputation level + points).
  - `Group` + `CollaborationGroup` + `CollaborationGroupMember` (Chatter group; member-private + customer-only options).
  - `NetworkSelfRegistration` (self-registration policy).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: `GET /services/data/v59.0/sobjects/Network/{Id}`, `POST .../connect/communities/{communityId}/feed-elements`.
  - REST API: `/services/data/v59.0/connect/communities/{communityId}/...` (high-level feed, group, file, topic operations).
  - Experience Cloud Bundles deploy via Metadata API.
  - Site.com deprecated; LWR (Lightning Web Runtime) sites use Aura/LWC components.
  - Embedded Service SDK for in-app community widgets.
  - Public site endpoints `https://<community-domain>/<site-prefix>/s/`.
  - SAML SSO + Social Sign-On (Google/Facebook/Apple/LinkedIn/MS) + custom OIDC.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Experience Builder" drag-drop site builder with Tile + Banner + Search + Feed + Topic-Catalog components.
  - "Community Workspaces" admin (Builder + Moderation + Dashboards + Recommendations + Content Targeting).
  - "Moderation Queue" with flagged-content + insight + rules.
  - "Reputation Leaderboard" with badge levels.
  - "Public Knowledge Catalog" SEO-indexed.
  - "Self-Service Help Center" template.
  - "Customer Account Portal" template.
  - "Partner Central" template.
  - "B2B Commerce Storefront" template.
  - "Sites Builder" classic.
  - "LWR templates" (Build Your Own LWR) for performance-critical sites.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<member-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CommunityJoin", Oyatie::Action::"CommunityLeave",
      Oyatie::Action::"CommunityPost", Oyatie::Action::"CommunityReply",
      Oyatie::Action::"CommunityModerate", Oyatie::Action::"PostPin",
      Oyatie::Action::"CommunityArchive", Oyatie::Action::"MemberInvite",
      Oyatie::Action::"MemberKick", Oyatie::Action::"PromoteToModerator",
      Oyatie::Action::"DemoteFromModerator", Oyatie::Action::"PackConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlagEscalate", Oyatie::Action::"MemberSuspend",
      Oyatie::Action::"MemberBan", Oyatie::Action::"EditOtherAsMod",
      Oyatie::Action::"TopicCreate", Oyatie::Action::"TopicsMerge"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Community::"<community-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    Oyatie::Community::member(principal, resource.community_id) &&
    (resource.audience_includes_minor ? context.pack.contains("COPPA") : true) &&
    (resource.audience_includes_minor && resource.jurisdiction == "US" ? context.kosa_safety_review_active : true) &&
    (resource.jurisdiction_set.contains("EU") ? context.dsa_transparency_report_emitted : true) &&
    (action in [Oyatie::Action::"MemberSuspend", Oyatie::Action::"MemberBan"] ? principal.has_role("CommunityModerator") : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Network` → `Oyatie::Community::definition` (with audience-type, brand-asset binding, pack-overlay).
  - `NetworkMember` → `Oyatie::Community::membership` (typed: guest/member/contributor/moderator/admin).
  - `FeedItem`/`FeedComment` → `Oyatie::Community::post`/`reply` (preserves @-mention + #-topic links).
  - `Topic` → `Oyatie::Topic::record`.
  - `Question`/`BestAnswer` → `Oyatie::Community::question` + `best_answer_id`.
  - `Idea` → `Oyatie::Community::idea` with vote-count + status.
  - `Reputation` → `Oyatie::Community::reputation_score` per-user-per-community.
  - `KnowledgeArticleVersion` → `Oyatie::KnowledgeArticle::record` (with audience-scope + locale tree).
  - `CmsContent` → `Oyatie::ContentAsset::record` (per-channel + per-locale variant).
  - `ExperienceBundle` → `Oyatie::Community::site_manifest` (pages + components + theme).
  - `LightningComponentBundle` → `Oyatie::PluginApp::component` (per ADR-0249 registry).
  - `NetworkSelfRegistration` → `Oyatie::Identity::self_register_policy` (per-community).
  - Cross-tenant `Network` shared with external orgs → `Oyatie::CrossTenantFederation::grant` per ADR-0313.

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: Experience Cloud Site export (Site, Page, Component, Theme via ExperienceBundle); per-community member + role + permission-set export; per-community CMS content export; per-topic + per-feed-item ingest; Self-Registration + Login-Flow export; Community-Builder LWC components.
  2. **Land**: per-community partitioned ingest.
  3. **Project**: per-page LWR template → Oyatie page-layout DSL; per-component → plugin-app-store entry.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-NetworkMember per-Role projected to Cedar policy; per-community scope.
  5. **Identity federation**: per-community Self-Registration policy → `oya-shared-identity` self-register flow; SAML SSO + Social Sign-On rebinding.
  6. **Moderation history**: per-flag + per-moderator-action import.
  7. **Per-locale content**: CMS managed-content variant tree imported.
  8. **Parallel run**: 30-day shadow on sample community with traffic-mirror at ingress.
  9. **Cutover**: per-community DNS swap + member-notification window.
  10. **Sunset**: Experience Cloud license termination + GDPR-Art-20 export retained.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Moderation overload during incident**: per-community surge-detection + auto-escalation to compliance officer.
  - **Federation trust-break**: per-federation link revocation; cross-tenant content becomes read-only then archived per ADR-0313.
  - **PII leak via community search**: per-PII-field default-deny in search index unless explicit consent per ADR-0272.
  - **DSA transparency-report missed deadline**: per-community DSA cadence monitoring (annual + ad-hoc for major incidents).
  - **Cross-jurisdiction content conflict**: per ADR-0304 conflict-resolution + per-region content-visibility per ADR-0251.
  - **SSO redirect-loop on guest-to-member upgrade**: per-session state-machine with idempotent SSO entry.
  - **Community URL scheme break**: legacy URL `/<community-prefix>/<page>` requires 301 map.
  - **LWR vs Aura runtime mismatch**: LWR sites have different theme model; per-template port.
  - **Embedded Service SDK widget**: in-app community widget on external sites requires SDK-replacement.
  - **Public Knowledge SEO loss** on URL change: per-article 301 redirect with canonical-pin.
  - **Self-Registration spam**: per-community CAPTCHA + rate-limit + abuse-detect.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Bulk API + REST + Metadata API + ExperienceBundle export; format — JSON + LWC source + CSS; duration — ~4 hours per 10 communities + per-content-volume; bandwidth — saturates 30 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Community URL prefixes preserved as redirect paths; Lossy fields — Reputation history (rebuilt from feed events); per-community Recommendations training-data.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-community DNS + ACM cert; member-notification window 14 days pre-cutover; per-Profile permission projection.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with traffic-mirror; cut-over gate — page-render parity + Knowledge-search-result parity + member-login parity; sunset — license termination + 90-day retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Customer Community Login → **Bronze**; Customer Community Plus → **Silver**; Partner Community → **Gold**; Experience Cloud + LWR + Data Cloud → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `community` is canonical; `salesforce-communities` + `salesforce-experience-cloud` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-015 - Salesforce Trailhead
- Vendor name and category: Salesforce Trailhead / Salesforce ecosystem / learning + skill credentialing + Trailblazer-Community-bridge + Trailmix-playlist + MyTrailhead (private-tenant variant) + Trailhead-Academy (instructor-led) + Trailblazer-(talent-marketplace).
- Coverage tier: D (microservice: `learning-management`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: public Trailhead → **Bronze**; MyTrailhead branded → **Silver**; MyTrailhead with custom-content + assessments + cohort-mgmt → **Gold**; MyTrailhead + Trailhead-Academy instructor-led + Trailblazer-hiring → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `learning-management` (Course + Module + Unit + Trail + Trailmix + Badge + Superbadge + Certification); `identity` (W3C-VC credential binding + Trailblazer-ID federation); `community` (Trailblazer-Community surfaces tie into `community` per D-014); `intelligence` (skill-graph + next-best-course + adaptive-difficulty); `marketplace` (Trailblazer-job-board + paid-course enrollment + ADR-0249 multi-category marketplace surface).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Trailhead + MyTrailhead):
  - `Trail` (curated learning path; Id, Title, Slug, Level: Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced, Tags[], Audience, Description, EstimatedTimeMinutes).
  - `Module` (atomic learning unit composed of Units + a Quiz/Challenge; ModuleType: badge / project / superbadge).
  - `Unit` (sub-module step with content + optional inline-quiz).
  - `Challenge` (hands-on assessment that runs against a Salesforce Trailhead Playground org with verification-script).
  - `Quiz` (multiple-choice assessment with per-Question + per-Answer-Choice + scoring rules).
  - `Badge` (earned credential; PointsAwarded, BadgeUrl, IssuedDate, EarnedByUserId).
  - `Superbadge` (capstone scenario-based badge; prerequisite-chain).
  - `SuperbadgeSuper` (Specialist-level meta-credential composed from Superbadges).
  - `Trailmix` (user-curated playlist; OwnerUserId, Items[Trail|Module|Project], Visibility).
  - `TrailblazerProfile` (public profile; Username, AvatarUrl, Rank: Scout/Hiker/Explorer/Adventurer/Mountaineer/Expeditioner/Ranger/All Star Ranger/Double Star Ranger/Triple Star Ranger, Points, BadgesEarned).
  - `Certification` (Salesforce-Certified credential; CredentialId, CertName, ExpirationDate, MaintenanceCycle).
  - `Trailhead Playground` (per-user ephemeral SF org used for Challenge verification).
  - `MyTrailhead Tenant` (private-branded learning portal; OrgId, BrandTheme, ContentLibrary).
  - `Custom Content` (uploaded HTML/Markdown/SCORM/xAPI module in MyTrailhead).
  - `Assessment Item Bank` (Question, AnswerChoices, CorrectChoice, Difficulty, ItemAnalytics).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Trailhead Profile API (read-only): `GET https://trailblazer.me/id/<username>` (HTML scrape + structured JSON-LD); unofficial GraphQL endpoint `POST https://profile.api.trailhead.com/graphql` (Query: GetTrailheadProfileData + GetTrailheadProfileBadges + GetTrailheadProfileCertifications + GetTrailheadProfileSkills + GetTrailheadProfileSuperbadges).
  - MyTrailhead Content API (Salesforce CMS REST): `/services/data/v59.0/connect/cms/...` for managed-content variant + `/services/data/v59.0/connect/communities/{communityId}/...` for Trailblazer-Community.
  - SCORM 1.2 + SCORM 2004 import endpoint (per-module upload to MyTrailhead).
  - xAPI (Experience API / Tin-Can) statement-emitter at `https://my.trailhead.com/xapi/statements`.
  - W3C Verifiable Credentials issuance (badge → VC JSON-LD) emerging in Salesforce credential surface.
  - Webhook on badge-earn → external system (HRIS + LMS bridge).
  - Trailhead Playground spin-up via Salesforce Org Provisioning API.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Trailhead.com" learner homepage with personalized recommendations (skill + role + product).
  - "Trail" linear progression UI with module-tile-grid + completion-checkmark.
  - "Module" reader view with embedded "Hands-on Challenge" launcher + Trailhead-Playground deep-link.
  - "Trailmix" curator-editor (drag-drop ordering).
  - "Ranger Rank" gamification with point-cumulative + level-up animation.
  - "Trailblazer Community" forum tabs interleaved with learning content.
  - "MyTrailhead Studio" tenant-admin for branded portal + content authoring.
  - "Trailhead Academy" instructor-led calendar + Zoom-integration + cohort-roster.
  - "Trailblazer Connect" talent-marketplace tied to public profile.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<learner-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"LearningEnroll", Oyatie::Action::"LearningStartModule",
      Oyatie::Action::"LearningSubmitChallenge", Oyatie::Action::"LearningClaimBadge",
      Oyatie::Action::"LearningShareBadge", Oyatie::Action::"LearningRedeemCredential",
      Oyatie::Action::"LearningInstructorGrade", Oyatie::Action::"LearningPeerReview",
      Oyatie::Action::"LearningRetakeQuiz", Oyatie::Action::"LearningViewCertificate",
      Oyatie::Action::"LearningRevokeCredential", Oyatie::Action::"LearningPublishTrail",
      Oyatie::Action::"LearningVersionBumpTrail", Oyatie::Action::"LearningMarkPrerequisiteComplete",
      Oyatie::Action::"LearningProvisionPlayground"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::LearningPath::"<path-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (resource.audience_includes_minor ? context.pack.contains("COPPA") : true) &&
    (resource.audience_includes_minor && resource.jurisdiction == "US" ? context.parental_consent_on_file : true) &&
    (resource.is_us_edu_integration ? context.pack.contains("FERPA") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"LearningInstructorGrade" ? principal.has_role("LearningInstructor") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"LearningRevokeCredential" ? principal.has_role("LearningAdmin") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"LearningPublishTrail" ? principal.has_role("LearningAuthor") : true) &&
    (context.ai_grading_active ? context.pack.contains("EU-AI-Act") && context.model_card_url_emitted : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Trail` → `Oyatie::Learning::trail` (with prerequisite-graph + estimated-time + audience-tag).
  - `Module` → `Oyatie::Learning::module` (badge / project / superbadge sub-type).
  - `Unit` → `Oyatie::Learning::unit` (with content-block tree + inline-quiz binding).
  - `Challenge` → `Oyatie::Learning::challenge` (with verification-script + playground-spec).
  - `Quiz` → `Oyatie::Learning::assessment` (with item-bank reference + scoring-rubric).
  - `Badge` → `Oyatie::Learning::badge` AND `Oyatie::Identity::verifiable_credential` (dual-write with W3C VC JSON-LD).
  - `Superbadge` → `Oyatie::Learning::superbadge` (with prerequisite-chain).
  - `Trailmix` → `Oyatie::Learning::trailmix` (user-curated playlist).
  - `TrailblazerProfile` → `Oyatie::Community::learner_profile` (with rank + points + badge-shelf).
  - `Certification` → `Oyatie::Identity::certification` (with maintenance-cycle + expiration + revocation-list).
  - `Trailhead Playground` → `Oyatie::Learning::sandbox_provision` (ephemeral env-spec; tied to `compute` substrate).
  - `MyTrailhead Tenant` → `Oyatie::Learning::tenant_portal` (with brand-theme + content-library scope).
  - `Custom Content` (SCORM/xAPI) → `Oyatie::Learning::external_content_module` (with launcher-spec + statement-emission contract).
  - `Assessment Item Bank` → `Oyatie::Learning::item_bank` (with item-analytics: difficulty + discrimination + point-biserial).
  - Cross-tenant credential portability → `Oyatie::CrossTenantFederation::credential_grant` per ADR-0313.

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: per-user badge + certification + Trailmix export via Trailhead profile GraphQL; MyTrailhead custom-content export (SCORM/xAPI/Markdown bundles); item-bank export with item-analytics; per-cohort progress snapshot; per-Trail prerequisite-graph YAML; instructor-roster + Trailhead-Academy session log.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant partitioned ingest with per-user PII tagging.
  3. **Project**: Trail → trail ontology entity; Module → module + assessment; Badge → dual-write VC.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-tenant per-cohort per-role policy (learner / instructor / admin / author).
  5. **Identity federation**: Trailblazer-ID → Oyatie SSO; federation-bridge for cross-tenant credential.
  6. **Item-analytics rebuild**: per-item difficulty + discrimination recomputed against rolling-30-day attempts.
  7. **Playground provisioning**: per-Challenge sandbox-spec → ephemeral compute env (per ADR-0254 K8s + Cloud Hypervisor).
  8. **VC mint**: per-badge re-mint as W3C VC with Oyatie issuer-key + retain Salesforce-issuer chain.
  9. **Parallel run**: 30-day shadow cohort with dual-credential issuance.
  10. **Cutover**: per-tenant credential authority switch; verifier endpoints updated.
  11. **Sunset**: Trailhead/MyTrailhead subscription termination + 7-year credential retention.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Badge-issuance-double** during dual-issue window: per-badge idempotency-key per-user per-trail with reservation token.
  - **Credential-revoke-propagation**: revocation not reflected in 3rd-party verifier — per-credential revocation-list endpoint + push to known verifiers + StatusList2021 emission.
  - **Prerequisite-graph cycle**: per-trail topological-sort validation at publish-time; emit cycle-path on rejection.
  - **Per-locale assessment equivalence drift**: per-item translation-equivalence validation (forward + back-translation; cohort-performance parity check).
  - **Instructor-grade bias** (auto-grade vs manual-grade divergence): per-assessment bias-monitor + calibration sample.
  - **VC signer-key rotation**: badges signed with rotated-out key fail verification — per-key rotation schedule + StatusList2021 entry + retroactive re-signature.
  - **Trailhead-Playground orphan org**: sandbox not torn down after challenge — per-playground TTL + reaper job.
  - **SCORM 1.2 vs SCORM 2004 statement-shape divergence**: per-import normalization to xAPI canonical.
  - **xAPI statement-replay**: duplicate completion-emission — per-statement idempotency-key + LRS dedup.
  - **Ranger-rank inflation** (point manipulation): per-action signed-event ledger + audit on point-cumulative.
  - **Public profile PII leakage** when MyTrailhead-Tenant federates public profile: per-tenant visibility policy + default-deny on bridge.
  - **Cross-tenant credential portability conflict** (badge issued by tenant A, learner moves to tenant B): per ADR-0313 sovereign-child + credential-passport pattern.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Trailhead GraphQL + Profile API + MyTrailhead Content API + SCORM/xAPI exporter; format — JSON-LD + SCORM-PIF + xAPI statement bundle; duration — ~6 hours per 100k learners; bandwidth — saturates 50 Mbps for content-asset transfer.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Trail-slug→trail-uuid (preserve as alias); Trailblazer-Rank→learner-rank with point-multiplier alignment; lossy — public-profile-only social metrics rebuilt from first-party engagement.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-tenant credential authority switch; dual-issue window 30 days; verifier endpoint DNS update with 90-day caching honored.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow cohort with credential dual-issue; cut-over gate — per-credential VC-verification parity + per-item attempt-result parity ≥ 99.5%; sunset — Trailhead/MyTrailhead subscription termination + 7-year credential retention per learner-rights pack.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: public Trailhead → **Bronze**; MyTrailhead branded → **Silver**; MyTrailhead with custom-content + assessments + cohort-mgmt → **Gold**; MyTrailhead + Trailhead-Academy instructor-led + Trailblazer-hiring → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `learning-management` is canonical; `salesforce-trailhead` + `mytrailhead` + `trailhead-academy` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-016 - ServiceNow ITSM
- Vendor name and category: ServiceNow IT Service Management / ServiceNow ecosystem / ITIL-v4-aligned incident + problem + change + request + knowledge + on-call-scheduling (DevOps-aware) + SLA-engine + agent-workspace + virtual-agent + predictive-intelligence + AI-Search.
- Coverage tier: D (microservice: `itsm`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: ITSM Standard → **Bronze**; ITSM Professional (with Predictive Intelligence + Agent Workspace) → **Silver**; ITSM Enterprise (with Performance Analytics + Virtual Agent + On-Call Scheduling) → **Gold**; ITSM Enterprise Plus (with AI Search + Process Optimization + Predictive Field Service Bridge) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `itsm` (Incident + Problem + Change + Request + Knowledge); `workflow-engine` (Flow Designer + classic-Workflow Editor analog); `cmdb` (CI graph as `itsm` capability tier per ADR-0131); `intelligence` (Predictive Intelligence categorization + AI Search); `community` (Service Portal + customer-knowledge front-end); `mobile-shell` (Now Mobile App analog); `contact-center` (Agent Workspace omni-routing tie).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (ServiceNow ITSM tables):
  - `incident` (number, short_description, description, caller_id→sys_user, opened_by→sys_user, opened_at, assignment_group→sys_user_group, assigned_to→sys_user, category, subcategory, priority, urgency, impact, state {1=New, 2=In Progress, 3=On Hold, 6=Resolved, 7=Closed, 8=Canceled}, cmdb_ci, resolved_at, closed_at, resolution_code, close_notes).
  - `problem` (number, short_description, related_incidents[], problem_state {Open / Known Error / Pending Change / Closed}, workaround, root_cause, known_error: bool).
  - `change_request` (number, type {Normal/Standard/Emergency}, risk, impact, state, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, cab_required: bool, cab_date, backout_plan, implementation_plan, test_plan, approval state-flow).
  - `change_task` (parent change_request, task-state, planned_start, planned_end).
  - `sc_request` (parent request shell for catalog requests); `sc_req_item` (RITM line-item bound to `sc_cat_item`); `sc_task` (catalog task assigned to fulfillment team).
  - `sc_cat_item` (catalog item with variables); `sc_category` (catalog category); `sc_catalog` (service catalog).
  - `kb_knowledge` (article_body, kb_category, workflow_state {draft/review/published/retired}, valid_to, author).
  - `kb_knowledge_base` (Knowledge Base container with publish-workflow).
  - `sys_user` (user_name, email, active, vip, department, location); `sys_user_group` (manager, parent, type).
  - `cmdb_ci` (parent of all CI classes; sys_class_name discriminator).
  - `sla_definition` (table, condition, duration, schedule, retroactive); `task_sla` (per-task SLA instance with business_time_left, business_percentage, has_breached).
  - `sys_journal_field` (work_notes + comments audit).
  - `business_rule` (server-side script triggered on insert/update/delete/query); `client_script` (browser-side); `ui_policy`; `script_include`; `flow` (Flow Designer flow).
  - `sys_update_set` (deployment unit grouping config changes); `sys_update_xml` (XML payload of customization).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Table API: `GET /api/now/table/{table_name}?sysparm_query=...&sysparm_fields=...&sysparm_limit=...` (paginated with sysparm_offset); `POST /api/now/table/{table_name}` (create); `PATCH /api/now/table/{table_name}/{sys_id}` (update).
  - Aggregate API: `GET /api/now/stats/{table_name}?sysparm_count=true&sysparm_avg_fields=...&sysparm_group_by=...`.
  - Import Set API: `POST /api/now/import/{staging_table}` (bulk ingest with transform-map).
  - Attachment API: `POST /api/now/attachment/file?table_name=...&table_sys_id=...&file_name=...`.
  - Scripted REST API: `/api/<namespace>/<resource>` (custom endpoints declared in Studio).
  - GraphQL API (Now Platform; emerging surface).
  - Service Catalog API: `GET /api/sn_sc/servicecatalog/catalogs/{sys_id}/items`.
  - Knowledge API: `GET /api/sn_km_api/knowledge/articles`.
  - Notification: Push Application Service via `/api/now/notification/...`; Email via inbound action; webhook via REST Message → outbound.
  - Stream + Subscription: Real-time updates via WebSocket (Agent Workspace) + Platform Events.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Agent Workspace" unified console (multi-tab + contextual sidebar + AI-Search + agent-chat).
  - "Service Portal" branded employee/customer self-service portal.
  - "Now Mobile App" iOS/Android for end-user self-service + on-call agent.
  - "Virtual Agent" conversational interface with NLU intents.
  - "Performance Analytics" dashboards with KPI scorecards + drill-down + breakdowns.
  - "Now Studio" (formerly Studio) IDE for app development (table designer + flow designer + UI builder).
  - "Flow Designer" no-code workflow editor with actions + subflows.
  - "Form Designer" form layout editor with related-list configuration.
  - "List View" universal data-grid with personalized filters + breakpoints + grouping.
  - "Major Incident Workbench" live war-room view with comms + timeline + impact.
  - "CAB Workbench" Change Advisory Board dashboard with collision-detection + risk-scoring.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<agent-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"ItsmOpenIncident", Oyatie::Action::"ItsmAssignToGroup",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItsmAssignToIndividual", Oyatie::Action::"ItsmEscalatePriority",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItsmLinkToProblem", Oyatie::Action::"ItsmLinkToChange",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItsmLinkToCI", Oyatie::Action::"ItsmAttachKnowledgeArticle",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItsmResolve", Oyatie::Action::"ItsmCloseResolved",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItsmReopen", Oyatie::Action::"ItsmWithdraw",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItsmRunMajorIncidentProtocol", Oyatie::Action::"ItsmDeclareMajorIncident",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItsmPostMajorIncidentReview", Oyatie::Action::"ItsmFileRCA",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItsmApproveChange", Oyatie::Action::"ItsmRejectChange",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItsmCabSchedule", Oyatie::Action::"ItsmBreakGlassPHIView"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Incident::"<inc-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ItsmDeclareMajorIncident" ? principal.has_role("IncidentCommander") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ItsmApproveChange" ? principal.has_role("CABMember") && context.cab_quorum_met : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ItsmBreakGlassPHIView" ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && context.break_glass_attestation : true) &&
    (resource.priority == "P1" ? context.on_call_assigned : true) &&
    (resource.cmdb_ci.in_scope_for("SOX") ? context.sox_change_evidence_sealed : true) &&
    (resource.cmdb_ci.fedramp_baseline == "Moderate" ? context.fedramp_cab_evidence_sealed : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `incident` → `Oyatie::Itsm::incident` (preserve number as `external_number`; map state-codes to Oyatie state-enum).
  - `problem` → `Oyatie::Itsm::problem` (with workaround + root-cause + known-error flag).
  - `change_request` → `Oyatie::Itsm::change_request` (type + risk + impact + CAB-required + planned-window).
  - `change_task` → `Oyatie::Itsm::change_task` (parent linkage preserved).
  - `sc_request`/`sc_req_item`/`sc_task` → `Oyatie::Itsm::request` / `request_item` / `request_task` (RITM hierarchy preserved).
  - `sc_cat_item` → `Oyatie::Itsm::catalog_item` (with variables → form-schema).
  - `kb_knowledge` → `Oyatie::Knowledge::article` (with workflow-state + valid-to + author + KB-category).
  - `cmdb_ci` → `Oyatie::Cmdb::ci` (class-hierarchy preserved; see D-020).
  - `sla_definition`/`task_sla` → `Oyatie::Sla::definition` / `instance` (with clock-state replay).
  - `business_rule` → `Oyatie::Workflow::server_hook` (with cycle-detection at import).
  - `flow` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::flow` (per ADR-0249 workflow-studio).
  - `sys_user` / `sys_user_group` → `Oyatie::Identity::user` / `group` (with manager-chain).
  - `sys_update_set` → `Oyatie::Deployment::change_bundle` (with topological-sort on import).
  - `sys_journal_field` → `Oyatie::Audit::comment_thread` (preserves work-notes / comments distinction).
  - `major_incident` → `Oyatie::Itsm::major_incident` (with war-room + comms + post-mortem binding).

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: Table API paged + delta-capture export of incident + problem + change_request + change_task + sc_request + sc_req_item + sc_task + kb_knowledge + cmdb_ci; per-table dictionary + ACL + business-rule + UI-policy export; per-Flow + classic-Workflow definition export; SLA-definition + task_sla with clock-state.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant partitioned ingest with PII-tagging on `sys_journal_field`.
  3. **Project**: tables → ontology entities; business-rules → workflow server-hooks with cycle-detection.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-assignment-group per-role policy with manager-chain.
  5. **Update-set ordering**: topological sort on `sys_update_set` graph before import.
  6. **SLA replay**: per-`task_sla` deterministic clock-replay with Business-Hours schedule rebind.
  7. **Knowledge migration**: per-`kb_knowledge` workflow-state preserved; per-attachment binary transfer.
  8. **CMDB sync**: per-`cmdb_ci` with class-hierarchy import (see D-020 for IRE precedence).
  9. **Parallel run**: 14-day shadow on sample assignment-group with traffic-mirror at REST ingress.
  10. **Cutover**: per-group cut-over with assignment-state-pin + open-incident SLA-clock preservation.
  11. **Sunset**: ServiceNow instance decom with audit retention 7 years (SOX) or per-pack longer.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Business-rule recursion** (server-side script that re-fires update on itself): per-rule recursion-depth limit + cycle detection at import.
  - **SLA clock-pause inconsistency** (Business Hours schedule diverge between ServiceNow and Oyatie): per-SLA clock-replay with deterministic timestamps + per-tenant schedule binding.
  - **Update-Set dependency-graph break** (update-set imported out of order): per-update-set topological sort at import-time with explicit dependency manifest.
  - **Assignment-group reorg mid-incident** (group split or merged during migration): per-incident historical-group-pin with rebind audit + manager-chain projection.
  - **CMDB CI orphan reference** (incident references CI deleted during migration): per-reference soft-delete with retention window + reconciliation engine resolution.
  - **Major-Incident war-room duplicate-spawn**: per-MI single-channel guarantee + idempotent spawn token.
  - **ACL evaluation-order divergence** (Glide ACL row+field+operation order ≠ Cedar evaluation): per-table ACL projection with evaluation-order test fixture.
  - **MID Server discovery limits** (during CMDB sync; MID-Server bandwidth saturation): per-MID-Server rate-limit + tiered discovery cadence.
  - **Flow Designer subflow cycles**: per-Flow topological-sort + cycle-detection at publish.
  - **Predictive Intelligence categorization drift** (ML model degrades on cutover): per-model retraining + shadow-categorization comparison for 30 days.
  - **Virtual Agent intent-overlap** with Oyatie NLU: per-intent disambiguation with confidence threshold.
  - **CAB collision** (two changes scheduled for same CI in same window): per-CAB collision-detection at scheduling.
  - **Knowledge KB-publish-state drift** (in-flight review during migration): per-article state-pin with reviewer-rebind.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — ServiceNow Table API + Aggregate API + Attachment API + Update Set XML export; format — JSON + XML; duration — ~8 hours per 1M tickets; bandwidth — saturates 100 Mbps at peak.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — number-prefix (INC vs OYA-INC) preserve as alias; state-codes mapped via deterministic table; lossy — Performance Analytics historical scorecards rebuilt from raw events; CAB-comment threading rebuilt from `sys_journal_field`.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-assignment-group cut-over with SLA-clock state preservation; 14-day dual-write window for in-flight tickets; DNS swap + email-inbound-redirect.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 14-day shadow with traffic-mirror; cut-over gate — per-incident state-parity ≥ 99.9% + SLA-breach-parity ≥ 99.5% + CMDB-CI-reference-integrity 100%; sunset — instance termination + 7-year audit retention (SOX) or 10-year (FedRAMP-High).

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: ITSM Standard → **Bronze**; ITSM Professional → **Silver**; ITSM Enterprise → **Gold**; ITSM Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `itsm` is canonical; `servicenow-itsm` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-017 - ServiceNow Customer Service Management
- Vendor name and category: ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM) / ServiceNow ecosystem / B2B + B2C external case management + Service-Org + Account-Contract + Product-Asset-Service + Field-Service bridge + Partner-Service-Portal + Customer-Service-Portal + Omni-Channel routing (Voice + Chat + Email + Web-Form + SMS + Social) + Customer-Workflow + Predictive Intelligence + Service Operations Workspace.
- Coverage tier: D (microservices: `itsm` for case + `contact-center` for omnichannel). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: CSM Standard → **Bronze**; CSM Professional (with Predictive Intelligence + Agent Workspace) → **Silver**; CSM Enterprise (with Service Operations Workspace + Performance Analytics + Walk-Up Experience) → **Gold**; CSM Enterprise Plus (with Industry-CSM packs: Financial Services / Healthcare / Manufacturing / Telco / Public Sector) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `itsm` (Case + Service-Org + Account-Contract + Entitlement + Product-Asset-Service); `contact-center` (Omni-Channel: voice + chat + email + web-form + SMS + WhatsApp routing); `community` (Customer-Service-Portal + Partner-Portal); `intelligence` (predictive case-routing + auto-classification + sentiment); `crm` (Account + Contact bridge per ADR-0249); `field-service` (CSM→FSM hand-off per D-024).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (ServiceNow CSM tables):
  - `sn_customerservice_case` (number, short_description, description, account→customer_account, contact→customer_contact, priority, state {1=New, 10=Awaiting Info, 18=Awaiting Problem, 20=Awaiting Vendor, 6=Resolved, 7=Closed, 8=Canceled}, contact_type {email/phone/web/chat/social/walk-in}, assignment_group, assigned_to, entitlement, product, asset, parent_case, case_relationship_type).
  - `customer_account` (name, account_number, parent_account, account_type {Customer/Partner/Prospect}, industry, account_status, primary_contact).
  - `customer_contact` (user_name, email, account→customer_account, title, communication_preferences).
  - `consumer_user` (B2C consumer; first_name, last_name, email, opt-in, communication_preferences).
  - `product_asset` (serial_number, model, install_date, warranty_start, warranty_end, install_location, owner, asset_state {in-use/in-stock/retired/lost/stolen}).
  - `service_contract` (number, contract_type, start_date, end_date, sla_definition, customer_account, contract_value, renewal_terms).
  - `entitlement` (name, customer_account, service_contract, entitlement_type {chat/phone/email/24x7/business-hours}, unit_count {hours/cases/incidents}, used_count, expiration_date).
  - `case_relationship` (parent_case, child_case, relationship_type {parent / child / related / duplicate / merged}).
  - `partner_contact` (partner_account, contact, role_in_partner_org).
  - `sys_user` with `is_customer: true` flag + `is_partner: true` flag for dual-role users.
  - `csm_consumer` (B2C consumer profile separate from `sys_user`).
  - `sn_customerservice_case_action` (every case-action audit row).
  - `interaction` (omni-channel interaction record with channel + agent + start_time + end_time + context-bag).
  - `chat_queue_entry` (live-chat routing record); `wxt_queue_entry` (workflow queue routing).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Table API: `GET /api/now/table/sn_customerservice_case` + per-field filtering + paginated.
  - CSM-specific Scripted REST APIs: `/api/sn_customerservice/case/{sys_id}` + `/api/sn_customerservice/entitlement/{sys_id}`.
  - Service Portal API: `/api/sn_sc/v1/portal/...` (portal-content for Customer-Service-Portal).
  - Omni-Channel Engine API: per-channel ingestion via REST Message → `interaction` table.
  - Twilio (voice) + LivePerson + Genesys integrations registered in CSM connector store.
  - WhatsApp Business + Facebook Messenger + Twitter DM integrations via Omni-Channel.
  - Walk-Up Experience kiosk API: `/api/sn_walkup/...`.
  - Predictive Intelligence API: `/api/sn_ml/...` (categorization + similarity + clustering).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Service Operations Workspace" CSM-specific unified console.
  - "Customer Service Portal" branded customer self-service.
  - "Partner Portal" multi-tier partner self-service with account-scope.
  - "Walk-Up Experience" kiosk for physical-location intake.
  - "Now Mobile App" customer + agent mobile.
  - "Virtual Agent" customer-facing conversational AI.
  - "Customer Central" 360-view of case + account + contract + asset + interaction history.
  - "Case Form" with related-list: cases on account + open entitlements + asset history + product hierarchy.
  - "Action History" timeline of every touchpoint.
  - "Knowledge Workbench" customer-facing knowledge with feedback + suggestion.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<agent-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CsmCreateCase", Oyatie::Action::"CsmLinkToAccount",
      Oyatie::Action::"CsmLinkToContract", Oyatie::Action::"CsmEscalate",
      Oyatie::Action::"CsmTransferQueue", Oyatie::Action::"CsmRouteToFieldService",
      Oyatie::Action::"CsmAttachProductAsset", Oyatie::Action::"CsmRunEntitlementCheck",
      Oyatie::Action::"CsmConsumeEntitlement", Oyatie::Action::"CsmWithdrawCase",
      Oyatie::Action::"CsmRequestFeedbackSurvey", Oyatie::Action::"CsmCloseFromBridge",
      Oyatie::Action::"CsmMergeCase", Oyatie::Action::"CsmViewPHI",
      Oyatie::Action::"CsmViewPCIData", Oyatie::Action::"CsmCommunityPost"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::CustomerCase::"<case-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (resource.case_account == principal.scope_account || principal.has_role("CsmCrossAccountAgent")) &&
    (resource.classification == "PHI" ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && principal.has_role("HIPAA_AGENT") : true) &&
    (resource.classification == "PCI" ? context.pack.contains("PCI-DSS") && principal.has_role("PCI_AGENT") : true) &&
    (resource.consumer_minor ? context.pack.contains("COPPA") && context.parental_consent_on_file : true) &&
    (resource.jurisdiction_set.contains("EU") && resource.case_type == "consumer_complaint" ? context.dsa_transparency_report_emitted : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CsmConsumeEntitlement" ? context.entitlement_reservation_token_valid : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CsmRouteToFieldService" ? context.fsm_hand_off_contract_satisfied : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `sn_customerservice_case` → `Oyatie::Csm::case` (with B2B vs B2C discriminator + multi-channel intake metadata).
  - `customer_account` → `Oyatie::Csm::account` (with parent-chain + account-type variant).
  - `customer_contact` → `Oyatie::Csm::contact` (with communication-preference + B2B/B2C bridge).
  - `consumer_user` → `Oyatie::Csm::consumer` (B2C only; with opt-in consent).
  - `product_asset` → `Oyatie::Csm::product_asset` (with serial + warranty + install-location + asset-state).
  - `service_contract` → `Oyatie::Csm::service_contract` (with renewal-terms + SLA-binding).
  - `entitlement` → `Oyatie::Csm::entitlement` (with unit-count + used-count + reservation-token semantics).
  - `case_relationship` → `Oyatie::Csm::case_relationship` (parent / child / related / duplicate / merged preserved as DAG).
  - `partner_contact` → `Oyatie::Csm::partner_contact` (with role-in-partner-org).
  - `interaction` → `Oyatie::Csm::interaction` (omni-channel record with context-bag).
  - `chat_queue_entry` → `Oyatie::ContactCenter::queue_entry` (per ADR-0249 contact-center).
  - Dual-role user (employee + customer same email) → `Oyatie::Identity::user` with `role_set` per ADR-0244 tenant scoping.

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: Table API export of `sn_customerservice_case` + `customer_account` + `customer_contact` + `consumer_user` + `product_asset` + `service_contract` + `entitlement` + `case_relationship` + `partner_contact` + `interaction`; per-Omni-Channel route-config export; per-portal Service-Portal site export.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant partitioned ingest with PII tagging + PHI/PCI classification on case-body.
  3. **Project**: tables → ontology entities; case-relationship DAG preserved with parent-child semantics.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-account scope + per-agent role + per-classification access (HIPAA/PCI/PII).
  5. **Entitlement reservation**: per-entitlement used-count migration with idempotent consume token to prevent double-consume during dual-write.
  6. **Omni-channel route projection**: ServiceNow route-config → `contact-center` routing-rule with channel-priority + skill-routing.
  7. **Portal migration**: Customer-Service-Portal + Partner-Portal → `community` per D-014 pattern.
  8. **Dual-role resolution**: employee+customer same email → single `Oyatie::Identity::user` with role-set.
  9. **Parallel run**: 14-day shadow on sample queue with traffic-mirror at REST + omni-channel ingress.
  10. **Cutover**: per-account cut-over with entitlement-state-pin + open-case SLA preservation.
  11. **Sunset**: CSM instance decom + 7-year case retention (GDPR Art-15/20 export retained) + consumer-data deletion-rights honored.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Dual-role user** (employee + customer same email): per-user role-tagging + Cedar context resolution + audit on role-elevation.
  - **Entitlement over-consume on parallel-run**: per-entitlement idempotent consume with reservation-token + atomic decrement.
  - **Partner-portal cross-account leak**: per-portal account-scoping default-deny + Cedar scope-check on every list-query.
  - **Omni-channel handoff context-loss** (chat-to-voice): per-session context-bag with TTL + handoff-event preservation in `interaction` chain.
  - **Product-asset binding stale** (asset replaced after warranty start): per-asset versioning + warranty-event log + replacement-event emission.
  - **Case merge comment-thread duplication**: per-merge journal-replay with dedup-key (timestamp + author + content-hash).
  - **Consumer-data deletion-right vs case-evidence retention**: per ADR-0251 GDPR Art-17 vs case-retention reconciliation; pseudonymization on consumer-request while preserving case audit chain.
  - **Walk-Up kiosk → online case continuity**: per-walk-up session-token bridge to online case.
  - **Field-service hand-off without entitlement-check** (FSM dispatched without contract verification): per-handoff contract Cedar gate.
  - **Predictive-routing model drift on new product launch**: per-model retraining + shadow-routing comparison for 14 days.
  - **Social-channel DM rate-limit** (Twitter/Facebook/WhatsApp per-channel limits): per-channel rate-limit + queue-backpressure.
  - **DSA transparency report missed** for EU consumer complaints: per-case DSA cadence monitor + alert on threshold.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — ServiceNow Table API + CSM-specific Scripted REST API + Service Portal API + Omni-Channel config export; format — JSON + portal-bundle XML; duration — ~6 hours per 500k cases; bandwidth — saturates 80 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — case-number prefix preserved as alias; case-state codes mapped via deterministic table; channel-type normalized; lossy — Predictive Intelligence training-data rebuilt from raw case-history.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-account cut-over with entitlement-state preservation; 14-day dual-write window; portal DNS swap + email-inbound + omni-channel webhook redirect.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 14-day shadow with traffic-mirror; cut-over gate — per-case state-parity ≥ 99.9% + entitlement-balance-parity 100% + portal-login-parity ≥ 99.5%; sunset — CSM instance decom + 7-year retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: CSM Standard → **Bronze**; CSM Professional → **Silver**; CSM Enterprise → **Gold**; CSM Enterprise Plus (Industry-CSM) → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `itsm` + `contact-center` + `community` are canonical; `servicenow-csm` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-018 - ServiceNow HR Service Delivery
- Vendor name and category: ServiceNow HR Service Delivery (HRSD) / ServiceNow ecosystem / employee-facing HR cases + Lifecycle Events + Enterprise Onboarding + Employee Center + Employee Document Management + Listening Posts + HR Knowledge + Employee Relations + Health & Safety (post-COVID) + Workplace Safety + Journey Designer + Manager Hub.
- Coverage tier: D (microservices: `itsm` HRSD-tier + `hcm` + `performance-management` + `learning-management`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: HRSD Standard → **Bronze**; HRSD Professional (with Lifecycle Events + Enterprise Onboarding) → **Silver**; HRSD Enterprise (with Employee Document Management + Listening Posts + Manager Hub) → **Gold**; HRSD Enterprise Plus (with Journey Designer + Health & Safety + Workplace Safety + Predictive Intelligence) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `itsm` (HR-case shape with restricted-fields semantics); `hcm` (employee + position + supervisory-org); `workflow-engine` (employee-lifecycle Journey orchestration); `community` (Employee Center portal); `learning-management` (compliance training trigger); `mobile-shell` (Now Mobile for employees + managers).

  - `sn_hr_core_case_payroll` (payroll-related case with year + period + earnings/deduction subject).

  - `sn_hr_lifecycle_events_case` (parent for orchestrated lifecycle journey: onboarding / offboarding / role-change / leave / return).
  - `sn_hr_lifecycle_events_activity` (atomic step in lifecycle: assign-laptop, schedule-orientation, complete-paperwork, revoke-access).
  - `sn_hr_journey` (Journey Designer journey definition; phases, steps, assignment rules).
  - `sn_hr_journey_instance` (per-employee journey run).
  - `sn_hr_employee_document` (Employee Document Management; doc_type, valid_from, valid_to, confidentiality_level, signed_by, signature_evidence).
  - `sn_hr_listening_post` (pulse-survey or stay-interview campaign).
  - `sn_hr_listening_post_response` (per-employee response with optional anonymization).
  - `sn_hr_case_acknowledgment` (employee acknowledgment of policy/notice).
  - `hr_topic_category` + `hr_topic` + `hr_subtopic` (taxonomy for case routing).
  - `sn_hr_core_assignment_group` (HR-specific assignment group with cross-tenant visibility flags).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - HR Scoped REST API: `/api/sn_hr_core/case/{sys_id}` + `/api/sn_hr_lifecycle_events/case/{sys_id}` + `/api/sn_hr_lifecycle_events/activity/{sys_id}`.
  - Employee Center Portal API: `/api/sn_hr_sp/...` for employee-facing portal content.
  - Journey Designer API: `/api/sn_hr_journey/instance/{sys_id}/...`.
  - Employee Document Management API: `/api/sn_hr_edm/document/{sys_id}` + signed-URL generation for confidential docs.
  - HR Knowledge API: `/api/sn_km_api/knowledge/articles?audience=employee`.
  - Listening Posts API: `/api/sn_hr_lp/survey/{sys_id}/response`.
  - Per-restricted-table ACL evaluation via standard ServiceNow Glide ACL (table + field + operation).
  - Webhook on lifecycle-event-state-change → HRIS bridge (Workday / SuccessFactors / BambooHR).
  - HRIS connector for `sys_user` + `sn_hr_core_profile` bidirectional sync.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Employee Center" branded multi-experience portal (catalog + knowledge + cases + tasks + journeys).
  - "Now Mobile App" employee self-service + manager approvals.
  - "Manager Hub" desktop-primary console for people-manager.
  - "Virtual Agent" HR-tuned conversational AI with intent library.
  - "Journey Designer" no-code authoring of multi-phase lifecycle journeys.
  - "Lifecycle Events Workbench" admin view of in-flight journeys.
  - "Employee Document Wallet" mobile-first document access.
  - "Listening Posts Authoring" survey designer with branching + anonymization.
  - "Employee Relations Workbench" restricted-access case management with attorney-client-privilege banner + audit-trail UI.
  - "HR Agent Workspace" for HR specialist with multi-tab + contextual sidebar.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<hr-specialist-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"HrOpenCase", Oyatie::Action::"HrViewRedactedEmployeeData",
      Oyatie::Action::"HrViewUnrestrictedEmployeeData", Oyatie::Action::"HrTriggerLifecycleEvent",
      Oyatie::Action::"HrAssignToSpecialist", Oyatie::Action::"HrEscalateToEmployeeRelations",
      Oyatie::Action::"HrFileGrievance", Oyatie::Action::"HrRunComplianceTraining",
      Oyatie::Action::"HrSignAcknowledgment", Oyatie::Action::"HrViewEmployeeDocument",
      Oyatie::Action::"HrUploadEmployeeDocument", Oyatie::Action::"HrCloseCase",
      Oyatie::Action::"HrInvokeAttorneyClientPrivilege", Oyatie::Action::"HrFileOSHAIncident",
      Oyatie::Action::"HrNotifyWorksCouncil"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::HrCase::"<case-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    redaction.applied(context.purpose) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (resource.confidential ? principal.has_role("HR_CONFIDENTIAL_AGENT") : true) &&
    (resource.employee_relations ? principal.has_role("EMPLOYEE_RELATIONS_AGENT") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HrInvokeAttorneyClientPrivilege" ? principal.has_role("HR_COUNSEL") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HrViewUnrestrictedEmployeeData" ? context.purpose in ["payroll-correction", "lifecycle-event", "audit"] : true) &&
    (resource.subject_employee_jurisdiction == "FR" && action.touches_employment_terms ? context.works_council_notification_pending == false : true) &&
    (resource.subject_employee_jurisdiction == "DE" && action.touches_employment_terms ? context.betriebsrat_notification_pending == false : true) &&
    (resource.subject_employee_jurisdiction == "KR" && action.touches_employment_terms ? context.kr_labor_standards_pack_active : true) &&
    (resource.medical_data ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") || context.pack.contains("ADA_FMLA") : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `sn_hr_core_case` → `Oyatie::Hr::case` (with confidential + restricted-data flags).
  - `sn_hr_core_profile` → `Oyatie::Hcm::employee` (bridged with `hcm` per D-026 Workday HCM canonical).
  - `sn_hr_core_case_employee_relations` → `Oyatie::Hr::employee_relations_case` (with privilege flag + investigation-status).
  - `sn_hr_core_case_payroll` → `Oyatie::Hr::payroll_case` (with period + earnings reference).
  - `sn_hr_core_case_benefits` → `Oyatie::Hr::benefits_case` (with plan + enrollment + life-event).
  - `sn_hr_core_case_safety` → `Oyatie::Hr::safety_case` (with OSHA-reportable + injury-type).
  - `sn_hr_lifecycle_events_case` + `_activity` → `Oyatie::Hr::lifecycle_event` + `lifecycle_activity` (preserves activity DAG).
  - `sn_hr_journey` + `sn_hr_journey_instance` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::journey_template` + `journey_instance`.
  - `sn_hr_employee_document` → `Oyatie::Hr::employee_document` (with confidentiality-level + signature evidence; signed-URL on retrieve).
  - `sn_hr_listening_post` + `_response` → `Oyatie::Hr::listening_post` + `response` (with optional anonymization + per-response k-anonymity guard).
  - `sn_hr_case_acknowledgment` → `Oyatie::Hr::acknowledgment` (preserves signature + timestamp + IP).
  - `hr_topic` taxonomy → `Oyatie::Hr::topic` (with per-pack regulatory-overlay).
  - `sys_user` (HR-touched) → `Oyatie::Identity::user` with `hr_profile_link` (cross-product reference).

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: HR Scoped REST + Table API export of `sn_hr_core_case` + `sn_hr_core_profile` + `_employee_relations` + `_payroll` + `_benefits` + `_safety` + `sn_hr_lifecycle_events_case` + `_activity` + `sn_hr_journey` + `sn_hr_journey_instance` + `sn_hr_employee_document` (binaries via signed-URL); listening-post + acknowledgment audit.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-jurisdiction partitioned ingest; PII/PHI/medical tagging at field-level.
  3. **Project**: tables → ontology entities; lifecycle-events DAG preserved.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-jurisdiction + per-confidentiality + per-role policy; works-council and Betriebsrat overlays activated.
  5. **Document migration**: per-employee-document binary transfer with confidentiality-level preserved + signed-URL re-mint.
  6. **Journey instance state-pin**: in-flight journeys preserve current-phase + current-step + assignment + due-dates.
  7. **Listening-post anonymization preservation**: per-survey k-anonymity guard; never re-identify in migration.
  8. **HRIS bridge rebind**: Workday/SuccessFactors/BambooHR connector re-registered with new endpoint.
  9. **Parallel run**: 30-day shadow on sample org-unit; cross-validate Lifecycle journey completion-parity.
  10. **Cutover**: per-org-unit cut-over; per-pack jurisdictional gate; works-council notification if applicable.
  11. **Sunset**: HRSD instance decom with per-jurisdiction retention (US 4y / EU 10y payroll-adjacent / KR 3y employment-records / DE 10y for accident records).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Confidential-case leak via search index**: per-case data-class tag + search-index ACL with default-deny on confidential + restricted-data flag.
  - **Lifecycle-orchestration partial-completion** (offboarding stops mid-asset-return): per-step compensating-action + manual-review queue + idempotent re-entry.
  - **Per-country labor-law pack drift**: pack-version-pin per employee-jurisdiction + rolling update with diff-report; per-country works-council/Betriebsrat notification gate.
  - **Cross-tenant shared services** (parent HR + subsidiary HR): per ADR-0313 sovereign-child boundary with federated case routing.
  - **Employee self-service spoof** (employee accessing another's case via URL guess): per-case principal-equals-subject default-deny + Cedar context.subject_user check.
  - **Attorney-client privilege break** during migration (case touched by non-counsel): per-case privilege-flag preservation + access-log audit + counsel-only-restore.
  - **OSHA-reportable injury mis-classification**: per-case OSHA-300 / OSHA-301 / OSHA-300A binding with per-injury severity rubric.
  - **Anonymized survey de-anonymization risk**: per-response k-anonymity ≥ 5 + redact-field-set + audit on join-attempt.
  - **EEO-1 + OFCCP + Section-503 + VEVRAA reporting cadence gap**: per-cadence emission + audit-trail.
  - **Works-council notification missed** for France L-1232 / Germany BetrVG / Korea Labor Standards: per-jurisdiction action-gate with notification-pending state.
  - **HRIS sync conflict** (Workday vs ServiceNow on employee-status): per ADR-0145 inter-microservice contract with HRIS-authoritative-source pin.
  - **Document signature evidence loss**: per-document signature-chain preservation (PKCS#7 / W3C VC where applicable).

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — HR Scoped REST + Table API + Document signed-URL exporter + Listening-Post API; format — JSON + PDF/A-3 for documents + xAPI for journey-activity statements; duration — ~12 hours per 100k employees; bandwidth — saturates 50 Mbps for document binaries.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — case-number prefix preserved as alias; lifecycle-state preserved; journey-instance current-step preserved; lossy — Listening-Post sentiment-scoring rebuilt from raw text under k-anonymity.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-org-unit + per-jurisdiction cut-over with works-council notification 30 days prior where required; HRIS connector rebind; Employee Center DNS swap.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with traffic-mirror; cut-over gate — per-case state-parity ≥ 99.9% + lifecycle-journey-completion-parity 100% + document-retrieval-parity 100% + per-jurisdiction labor-law gate green; sunset — instance decom + per-jurisdiction retention (US 4y / EU 10y / KR 3y / DE 10y safety records).

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: HRSD Standard → **Bronze**; HRSD Professional → **Silver**; HRSD Enterprise → **Gold**; HRSD Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `itsm` (HRSD-tier) + `hcm` are canonical; `servicenow-hrsd` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-019 - ServiceNow Now Platform
- Vendor name and category: ServiceNow Now Platform / ServiceNow ecosystem / low-code PaaS substrate underlying every ServiceNow product (ITSM/CSM/HRSD/ITOM/SecOps/GRC/FSM/SPM) — Table Engine + Glide Server-Side Scripting + Flow Designer + IntegrationHub + Now Experience Framework (UI Builder + Service Portal + Mobile App) + Now Assist (GenAI) + AI Search + Predictive Intelligence + NLU + Performance Analytics + Studio (Application Development) + Now Store + Update Sets + Scoped Applications + ATF (Automated Test Framework) + DevOps Change Velocity + Source Control Integration.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `workflow-studio` + `apigw` + `ontology` + `plugin-app-store` + `intelligence` + `observability` + `wiki`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Now Platform Standard → **Bronze**; Now Platform Professional (with IntegrationHub Pro + Performance Analytics + Now Mobile) → **Silver**; Now Platform Enterprise (with AI Search + Predictive Intelligence + Process Optimization + Studio + ATF) → **Gold**; Now Platform Enterprise Plus (with Now Assist GenAI + Process Mining + Workflow Studio Advanced) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `workflow-studio` (Flow Designer + Decision Builder + IntegrationHub spoke analog); `apigw` (Scripted REST + Now-Platform-REST + GraphQL + RIDAC bridge); `ontology` (Table + Field + Reference + Dictionary projection); `plugin-app-store` (Now-Store scoped-application analog per ADR-0249); `intelligence` (NLU + Predictive Intelligence + Now Assist GenAI); `observability` (Performance Analytics + Process Mining); `wiki` (Knowledge bridge).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Now Platform metadata tables):
  - `sys_app` (scoped application; name, scope, version, vendor, source).
  - `sys_app_module` (application navigation module).
  - `sys_db_object` (table definition; name, label, super_class, extends, scope, sys_class_name).
  - `sys_dictionary` (field definition; element, internal_type, max_length, mandatory, reference, calculation, dynamic_default_value, choice_table).
  - `sys_glide_object` (field-type registry).
  - `sys_security_acl` (ACL row; table.field, operation [read/write/create/delete/execute], roles, script-condition, advanced: bool, order).
  - `sys_user_role` + `sys_user_group_role` + `sys_user_has_role` (role binding graph).
  - `sys_script` (Business Rule; table, when [before/after/async/display/query], action [insert/update/delete/query], order, condition, script).
  - `sys_script_include` (server-side reusable script library; api_name, accessible_from, script).
  - `sys_script_client` (Client Script; table, type [onChange/onLoad/onSubmit/onCellEdit], applies_to [all/desktop/mobile/service-portal], script).
  - `sys_ui_policy` (UI Policy; table, condition, ui_policy_actions[mandatory/visible/readonly]).
  - `sys_ui_action` (UI Action button/menu/related-list button).
  - `sys_ui_form_section` + `sys_ui_view` (form layout per view).
  - `sys_flow` (Flow Designer flow; trigger, condition, actions[]).
  - `sys_subflow` (callable subflow).
  - `sys_hub_action_type` + `sys_hub_action_input` + `sys_hub_action_output` (IntegrationHub action).
  - `sys_hub_step_ext` (step in IntegrationHub action; type: REST/SOAP/Powershell/Bash/Python).
  - `sys_update_set` (deployment unit; state [in-progress/complete], release_date, parent).
  - `sys_update_xml` (XML payload of a customization; payload, action [INSERT_OR_UPDATE/DELETE], target_name, target_table).
  - `sys_atf_test` + `sys_atf_test_step` (Automated Test Framework).
  - `sys_rest_message` + `sys_rest_message_fn` (outbound REST integration registration).
  - `sys_soap_message` + `sys_soap_message_function` (outbound SOAP).
  - `sysevent_email_action` (notification template).
  - `sys_properties` (system properties / feature flags).
  - `sys_choice` (dropdown choice values per field).
  - `sys_metadata_link` (cross-table relationship metadata).
  - `sys_app_file` (any file stored in scoped-app: image / template / asset).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Table API (canonical CRUD): `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/now/table/{table_name}`.
  - Aggregate API: `GET /api/now/stats/{table_name}`.
  - Import Set API: `POST /api/now/import/{staging_table_name}` (bulk ingest with transform-map).
  - Scripted REST API: developer-defined `/api/<namespace>/<resource>` registered via `sys_ws_definition` + `sys_ws_operation`.
  - GraphQL API (Now Platform; emerging): `POST /api/now/graphql` with schema introspection.
  - Now Platform RIDAC (Resource-Identifier Discovery + Action Control): emerging unified API.
  - Attachment API: `POST /api/now/attachment/file?table_name=...`.
  - Update Set XML export: `GET /sys_update_set.do?sysparm_sys_id={sys_id}&XML` (full XML payload).
  - Application export: Studio "Publish to Update Set" or "Publish to Now Store".
  - IntegrationHub action runtime: invoked via Flow Designer step or REST Message.
  - Webhook on metadata change: emerging via Now Platform events.
  - Source Control (Git) integration: Studio with branch-per-developer + Pull Request workflow.
  - DevOps Change Velocity: change_request auto-creation from CI/CD pipeline.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Studio" application development IDE with Table Designer + Form Layout + Flow Designer + Script Editor.
  - "Flow Designer" no-code workflow editor with trigger + actions + subflows + branching + Wait For Condition.
  - "Decision Builder" decision-table-style authoring.
  - "IntegrationHub Spoke" packaged integrations to 3rd party (Slack, Microsoft Teams, ServiceNow Vault, AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Salesforce, Workday).
  - "UI Builder" Now Experience Framework component-based page authoring.
  - "App Engine Studio" citizen-developer no-code app authoring.
  - "Now Store" application marketplace (free + paid + ServiceNow-published + partner-published).
  - "Performance Analytics Designer" KPI scorecard authoring.
  - "Process Optimization" process-mining UI with bottleneck detection.
  - "Now Assist Studio" (GenAI prompt authoring).
  - "ATF Designer" test-step authoring with browser-recording.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<developer-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"PlatformInstallApplication", Oyatie::Action::"PlatformConfigureApplication",
      Oyatie::Action::"PlatformCustomizeTableExtension", Oyatie::Action::"PlatformPublishFlow",
      Oyatie::Action::"PlatformRunFlow", Oyatie::Action::"PlatformDebugFlow",
      Oyatie::Action::"PlatformExportUpdateSet", Oyatie::Action::"PlatformImportUpdateSet",
      Oyatie::Action::"PlatformVersionBumpApplication", Oyatie::Action::"PlatformRegisterRestMessage",
      Oyatie::Action::"PlatformSubscribePlatformEvent", Oyatie::Action::"PlatformPublishToStore",
      Oyatie::Action::"PlatformGitCommit", Oyatie::Action::"PlatformRunATF",
      Oyatie::Action::"PlatformInvokeGenAI"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Application::"<app-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PlatformCustomizeTableExtension" ? principal.has_role("Developer") && resource.scope == principal.developer_scope : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PlatformImportUpdateSet" ? context.update_set_topological_sort_validated && context.dependency_graph_resolved : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PlatformPublishToStore" ? context.supply_chain_attestation_emitted && context.sbom_signed : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PlatformInvokeGenAI" ? context.pack.contains("EU-AI-Act") && context.model_card_url_emitted : true) &&
    (resource.scope_is_oob ? principal.has_role("PlatformAdmin") : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `sys_app` → `Oyatie::PluginApp::application` (with scope + version + vendor + supply-chain-attestation per ADR-0247 + 0293).
  - `sys_db_object` → `Oyatie::Ontology::entity` (table definition with super-class chain).
  - `sys_dictionary` → `Oyatie::Ontology::field` (with type + cardinality + reference + calculation).
  - `sys_security_acl` → `Oyatie::Cedar::policy` (with row-level + field-level + operation-level).
  - `sys_script` (Business Rule) → `Oyatie::Workflow::server_hook` (with when + action + order + cycle-detection).
  - `sys_script_include` → `Oyatie::Workflow::script_library` (with API surface + accessible-from scope).
  - `sys_script_client` → `Oyatie::Workflow::client_hook` (with type + applies-to).
  - `sys_ui_policy` → `Oyatie::FormSchema::policy` (mandatory/visible/readonly).
  - `sys_ui_action` → `Oyatie::FormSchema::action` (button / menu / related-list).
  - `sys_flow` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::flow` (with trigger + actions + branching).
  - `sys_subflow` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::subflow`.
  - `sys_hub_action_type` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::integration_action`.
  - `sys_update_set` → `Oyatie::Deployment::change_bundle` (with topological-sort + dependency-manifest).
  - `sys_atf_test` → `Oyatie::Testing::automated_test` (with steps + assertions).
  - `sys_rest_message` → `Oyatie::Apigw::outbound_integration`.
  - `sys_properties` → `Oyatie::FeatureFlag::registry` (per-tenant + per-environment).
  - `sys_app_file` → `Oyatie::PluginApp::asset` (with content-hash + signature).

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: per-scoped-application Update Set XML export with topological-sort manifest + Now Store license inventory + REST/SOAP message registration export + System-Properties export + ATF test set + UI Builder pages + Performance Analytics indicators + Source Control branch export if Git-integrated.
  2. **Land**: per-application + per-scope partitioned ingest with supply-chain provenance (SBOM signed).
  3. **Project**: tables → ontology entities; Business Rules → workflow server-hooks with cycle-detection; Flows → workflow-studio flows; UI Builder pages → form-schema policies.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: ACLs (row + field + operation) projected to Cedar policies with explicit evaluation-order test fixture.
  5. **Update-Set topological-sort**: per-application dependency graph validated; transitive dependencies resolved; OOB-modifications quarantined.
  6. **Script transformer**: Glide-API calls transformed via allow-list to supported Oyatie equivalents; un-supported calls fail import.
  7. **IntegrationHub spoke rebind**: per-spoke credential re-mint + endpoint update; OAuth-token refresh chain rebound.
  8. **Now-Store license rebind**: per-license re-mint with tenant-binding; per-application supply-chain attestation per ADR-0247.
  9. **GenAI model card**: per Now Assist GenAI surface — model card URL + recourse path emitted per EU AI Act pack.
  10. **Parallel run**: 30-day shadow on sample scoped-application with feature-flag dual-route.
  11. **Cutover**: per-application cut-over with feature-flag toggle + canary cohort.
  12. **Sunset**: Now Platform license termination + per-application code-and-data retention per pack (SOX 7y).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Scoped-application cross-scope access** (one scope reads private table of another): Cedar scope-check per request + audit on cross-scope reference.
  - **Business-rule order-of-execution divergence** (Now vs target): per-rule explicit-order + topological replay at import; assertion harness against golden trace.
  - **Script-include legacy-API drift** (Glide-API calls in scripts that have no Oyatie equivalent): per-script transformer with allow-list; un-supported = fail-fast import.
  - **Update-Set transitive-dependency miss**: per-update-set dependency-graph validation; un-resolved = block import + manifest-augmentation UI.
  - **Now-Store app-license tenant-key handoff**: per-license re-mint + tenant-binding + signature-chain preservation.
  - **ATF test-step browser-recording brittleness** (XPath/CSS selector drift): per-test selector-stability assertion + auto-heal.
  - **IntegrationHub spoke OAuth-token refresh failure**: per-spoke health-check + dead-letter queue.
  - **Performance Analytics scorecard historical-data loss**: per-indicator raw-event re-emission + scorecard rebuild.
  - **Source-Control merge-conflict on update-set parallel commits**: per-developer branch + PR-gated merge + conflict-resolution UI.
  - **GenAI prompt-injection or hallucination on customer data**: per-invocation Cedar gate + redaction-applied + audit-trail + model-card.
  - **App Engine Studio citizen-dev abuse** (non-developer creates unsanctioned app): per-tenant citizen-dev quota + admin approval gate.
  - **DevOps Change Velocity unauthorized auto-deploy**: per-pipeline Cedar gate + CAB-evidence requirement.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Update Set XML export + Now Store license inventory + REST Message export + Source Control branch export; format — XML (Update Set) + JSON (metadata) + signed SBOM; duration — ~24 hours per 100 scoped applications; bandwidth — saturates 100 Mbps for asset-binary transfer.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — scoped-table names preserved as aliases; Glide-API → Oyatie-API allow-list mapping; lossy — Process-Mining historical traces rebuilt from raw event log.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-application feature-flag dual-route 30 days; canary 10% → 50% → 100%; per-supply-chain attestation gate.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with feature-flag dual-route; cut-over gate — per-application functional-parity ≥ 99.5% + ACL-evaluation-parity 100% + business-rule-order-parity 100% + IntegrationHub-spoke health green + ATF-test pass-rate ≥ 99%; sunset — Now Platform license termination + 7-year code retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Now Platform Standard → **Bronze**; Now Platform Professional → **Silver**; Now Platform Enterprise → **Gold**; Now Platform Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `workflow-studio` + `apigw` + `plugin-app-store` + `ontology` are canonical; `servicenow-now-platform` is benchmark alias.
