### Section D-020 - ServiceNow CMDB
- Vendor name and category: ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB) / ServiceNow ecosystem / IT-asset + Service Graph + Common Service Data Model (CSDM 4.0) + Discovery + Service Mapping + Identification & Reconciliation Engine (IRE) + Service Graph Connectors + MID Server fleet + Hardware Asset Management + Software Asset Management (SAM) + Software License Management + Cloud Discovery + Container Discovery (Kubernetes) + CMDB Health Dashboard + CMDB Workspace.
- Coverage tier: D (microservice: `itsm` with CMDB capability tier per ADR-0131; promotes to standalone `cmdb` µservice when scale demands per Wave-3-H roadmap). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: CMDB Standard → **Bronze**; CMDB Pro (with Discovery + IRE) → **Silver**; CMDB Enterprise (with Service Mapping + Service Graph Connectors + SAM-Foundation) → **Gold**; CMDB Enterprise Plus (with SAM-Premium + Cloud + Container Discovery + Workspace + Health Dashboard) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `itsm` (CMDB capability tier with CI graph); `data-pipeline` (Discovery + Service Mapping ingest at scale); `ontology` (CI-class + relationship-type projection per CSDM 4.0); `intelligence` (Service Graph Connector recommendations + anomaly + lifecycle insight); `cmdb-discovery` (MID-Server analog as remote-edge agent + pattern execution).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (ServiceNow CMDB tables + CSDM 4.0):
  - `cmdb_ci` (root configuration-item parent table; name, sys_class_name, asset_tag, serial_number, manufacturer, model_id, install_status {1=Installed, 2=In Maintenance, 6=In Stock, 7=Retired, 8=Stolen, 100=Absent}, operational_status, environment, location, owned_by, support_group, last_discovered, first_discovered, discovery_source, attestation: bool).
  - `cmdb_ci_computer` (subclass; cpu_count, cpu_speed, ram, disk_space, os, os_version, host_name).
  - `cmdb_ci_server` (subclass; ip_address, fqdn, virtual: bool, cluster_member_of).
  - `cmdb_ci_appl` (Application; vendor, version, host_id, application_id).
  - `cmdb_ci_business_app` (Business Application per CSDM; tier-1 Business level CI).
  - `cmdb_ci_business_service` (Business Service; service_classification, owned_by, supported_by, customer_facing: bool).
  - `cmdb_ci_service_technical` (Technical Service; supports → Business Service).
  - `cmdb_ci_service_auto` (Application Service auto-discovered).
  - `cmdb_ci_service_offering` (Service Offering tied to Service Portfolio).
  - `cmdb_ci_vm_instance` (VM); `cmdb_ci_container` (Container); `cmdb_ci_kubernetes_pod`; `cmdb_ci_kubernetes_service`.
  - `cmdb_ci_cluster` + `cmdb_ci_cluster_resource` (cluster topology).
  - `cmdb_ci_network_adapter` + `cmdb_ci_ip_address` + `cmdb_ci_network_segment`.
  - `cmdb_ci_database` + `cmdb_ci_db_catalog` + `cmdb_ci_db_instance`.
  - `cmdb_ci_storage_volume` + `cmdb_ci_lun`.
  - `cmdb_rel_type` (relationship-type catalog; parent_descriptor / child_descriptor; e.g., "Depends on::Used by", "Runs on::Runs", "Hosted on::Hosts", "Contains::Contained by", "Sends data to::Receives data from", "Manages::Managed by").
  - `cmdb_rel_ci` (relationship instance; parent CI, child CI, type, port: int).
  - `cmdb_metadata` + `cmdb_ire_rule` (IRE identifier rules per class; identifier-attributes, dependent-attributes, precedence).
  - `cmdb_ireboot_rule` (re-identification rule for changed CIs).
  - `cmdb_data_source` + `cmdb_data_source_authority` (authority precedence per source per attribute).
  - `cmdb_health_metric` (per-CI-class health: correctness + completeness + compliance score).
  - `discovery_classy_pattern` + `discovery_classy_step` (Pattern definition for Service Mapping).
  - `discovery_credentials` + `discovery_credentials_affinity` (per-target credential binding).
  - `ecc_agent` (MID Server registration).
  - `samp_sw_install` + `samp_sw_product_definition` + `samp_sw_license_metric` (Software Asset Management tables).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Table API: `GET /api/now/table/cmdb_ci?sysparm_query=sys_class_name=cmdb_ci_server` (paginated).
  - CMDB API (CMDB-Aware REST API; CSDM-aware): `POST /api/now/cmdb/instance/{class_name}` (with IRE invocation; payload identifies CI via identifier-attributes; returns sys_id + reconciliation-trace).
  - Identification & Reconciliation Engine endpoint: `POST /api/now/identifyreconcile` (bulk insert with IRE; returns identification-result per record).
  - Service Graph Connector framework: vendor publishes JSON payload conforming to CSDM; uses `cmdb/meta/connector_definition` registration.
  - CMDB Query Builder (graph-traversal queries): `POST /api/now/cmdb/query` with traversal-spec.
  - Discovery: MID Server pulls schedule from `discovery_schedule`; executes Patterns → returns CIs via ecc_queue → IRE processes.
  - Service Mapping: top-down from Business Application; uses entry-point definition + traffic-pattern.
  - Cloud Discovery: per-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI) account credential + API-poll pattern.
  - Container Discovery: K8s API + per-cluster credential + namespace-scope.
  - Health Dashboard: per-CI-class correctness/completeness/compliance scores.
  - Asset API: `/api/now/table/alm_asset` (Hardware Asset Management bridge).
  - SAM API: `/api/now/sam/...` for software-asset and license-metric.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "CMDB Workspace" unified console with CI search + class-tree + health-score.
  - "Service Map" visualization (force-directed graph with business-service drill-in).
  - "CMDB Health Dashboard" per-class correctness + completeness + compliance.
  - "Dependency Views" change-impact visualization for CAB.
  - "Discovery Dashboard" per-MID-Server + per-pattern execution status.
  - "Service Graph Connector Studio" connector authoring.
  - "Software Asset Workspace" license-position + true-up + reclamation.
  - "Hardware Asset Workspace" asset lifecycle + chain-of-custody.
  - "Pattern Designer" Service Mapping pattern authoring (with palette of probe steps).
  - "CSDM Data Foundation Dashboard" CSDM-conformance per-tenant.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<config-mgr-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CmdbDiscover", Oyatie::Action::"CmdbCreateCI",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmdbUpdateCI", Oyatie::Action::"CmdbRetireCI",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmdbRelateCI", Oyatie::Action::"CmdbBreakRelation",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmdbCertifyCI", Oyatie::Action::"CmdbRecertifyCI",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmdbSetTrustScore", Oyatie::Action::"CmdbRunReconciliation",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmdbSetAuthoritativeSource", Oyatie::Action::"CmdbBuildServiceMap",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmdbReclaimSoftwareLicense", Oyatie::Action::"CmdbAuditAssetChainOfCustody"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::ConfigurationItem::"<ci-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmdbSetAuthoritativeSource" ? principal.has_role("CmdbAdmin") : true) &&
    (resource.ci_class in ["pci_ci_payment_terminal", "pci_ci_pos"] ? context.pack.contains("PCI-DSS") : true) &&
    (resource.ci_class.in_scope_for("SOX") ? context.sox_audit_evidence_pinned : true) &&
    (resource.ci_class.in_scope_for("HIPAA") ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && context.phi_environment_attested : true) &&
    (resource.ci_class == "cmdb_ci_kubernetes_pod" && resource.environment == "production" ? context.production_change_evidence_satisfied : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmdbReclaimSoftwareLicense" ? context.true_up_reconciliation_attested : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `cmdb_ci` → `Oyatie::Cmdb::ci` (root; with CSDM-aligned class-hierarchy).
  - `cmdb_ci_computer`, `cmdb_ci_server`, `cmdb_ci_appl`, etc. → per-subclass Oyatie entities preserving inheritance.
  - `cmdb_ci_business_app`, `cmdb_ci_business_service`, `cmdb_ci_service_technical`, `cmdb_ci_service_offering` → Oyatie service-tier ontology (Business / Technical / Service-Offering).
  - `cmdb_ci_vm_instance`, `cmdb_ci_container`, `cmdb_ci_kubernetes_*` → Oyatie compute-substrate CIs (binding to ADR-0254 K8s + Cloud Hypervisor).
  - `cmdb_rel_ci` → `Oyatie::Cmdb::ci_relationship` (with type from rel_type catalog + bidirectional parent/child role; preserves "Depends on::Used by" semantics).
  - `cmdb_ire_rule` → `Oyatie::Cmdb::identifier_rule` (per-class identifier-attributes + precedence).
  - `cmdb_data_source` + `cmdb_data_source_authority` → `Oyatie::Cmdb::data_source` + `authority_rule`.
  - `cmdb_health_metric` → `Oyatie::Cmdb::health_score` (correctness + completeness + compliance per CI-class).
  - `discovery_classy_pattern` → `Oyatie::Cmdb::discovery_pattern` (Service Mapping pattern as YAML).
  - `ecc_agent` → `Oyatie::Cmdb::edge_agent` (MID-Server analog; per ADR for remote-edge agent).
  - `samp_sw_install` + `samp_sw_product_definition` + `samp_sw_license_metric` → Oyatie software-asset + license-metric (per ADR-0058 software-license-mgmt).

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: Table API + CMDB API export of `cmdb_ci` + all child-class tables (class-hierarchy preserved); per-relationship export from `cmdb_rel_ci` with `cmdb_rel_type` taxonomy; IRE rule export with precedence chain; per-Pattern export from `discovery_classy_pattern`; per-Connector export from Service Graph Connector framework; SAM software-install + license-metric export; per-MID-Server registration export.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-CI-class partitioned ingest; CSDM-conformance scored at land-time.
  3. **Project**: tables → per-class Oyatie entities; relationships → typed edges; service-tiers preserved.
  4. **Backfill IRE**: per-class identifier-attributes + dependent-attributes + precedence chain projected.
  5. **Backfill authority precedence**: per-data-source per-attribute authority rule preserved.
  6. **Pattern translation**: Service Mapping Pattern → Oyatie discovery-pattern YAML with equivalent probe-step semantics.
  7. **MID-Server fleet rebind**: per-MID-Server credential rotation + endpoint update + bandwidth quota.
  8. **Cloud Discovery rebind**: per-cloud-account credential re-mint + API-poll cadence preserved.
  9. **Container Discovery rebind**: per-K8s-cluster credential + namespace-scope.
  10. **Health-score baseline**: per-CI-class baseline correctness/completeness/compliance.
  11. **Parallel run**: 7-day shadow discovery on sample CI-class with reconciliation-parity check.
  12. **Cutover**: per-CI-class cut-over with authority-source switch; in-flight Discovery cycle preserved.
  13. **Sunset**: ServiceNow CMDB instance decom + 7-year audit retention + SAM license true-up evidence preserved.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **CI-class-hierarchy collision** on cross-tenant merge: per-class namespace + collision-resolution with explicit fork-or-merge UI.
  - **Reconciliation-precedence ambiguity** (two sources, equal authority): per-rule tie-breaker (timestamp + source-trust-score) + admin-decision queue.
  - **Service-Map cycle** (mutual depends-on): per-relationship cycle detection at write-time; emit cycle-path on rejection.
  - **Stale-CI proliferation** (no discovery for >30d): per-CI staleness-flag + recertify workflow trigger + auto-retire after 90d.
  - **Over-relate** (CI with 10k+ relations): per-CI relation-cap + relationship-class indexing.
  - **IRE identification false-merge** (two CIs incorrectly identified as same): per-IRE-rule dependent-attribute confirmation + manual-split UI.
  - **MID-Server discovery bandwidth saturation**: per-MID-Server rate-limit + tiered discovery cadence + priority queue.
  - **Cloud-Discovery API rate-limit** (AWS/Azure/GCP throttling): per-cloud-account exponential-backoff + concurrency cap.
  - **Container ephemerality** (K8s pod created+destroyed in < discovery-cycle): per-cluster event-stream subscription (vs poll) for short-lived CIs.
  - **SAM license-true-up under-count** (install detected but not metered): per-product license-metric audit + raw-install reconciliation.
  - **CSDM-conformance drift** (CIs not aligned to CSDM 4.0): per-class CSDM-conformance scorecard + remediation workflow.
  - **Pattern brittleness on OS/version upgrade**: per-pattern version-bracket + auto-fallback chain.
  - **Discovery-credential leak**: per-credential OpenBao reference + audit on retrieval.
  - **Service-Mapping entry-point change** (URL/IP change): per-entry-point version + re-baseline workflow.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Table API + CMDB API + Service Graph Connector definitions + Discovery Pattern XML + IRE rule export; format — JSON + XML + YAML; duration — ~16 hours per 5M CIs + 50M relationships; bandwidth — saturates 200 Mbps at peak.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — sys_class_name → ontology entity-type (preserved as alias); rel_type bidirectional descriptor preserved; lossy — Health-score historical trend rebuilt from raw events; Service-Map historical snapshots rebuilt from rel-history.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-CI-class cut-over with authority-source switch; in-flight Discovery cycle preserved; MID-Server fleet rebind with credential rotation.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 7-day shadow discovery with reconciliation-parity ≥ 99.9% + service-map-shape-parity ≥ 99.5% + IRE-identification-parity 100% + SAM-license-position-parity 100%; sunset — instance decom + 7-year retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: CMDB Standard → **Bronze**; CMDB Pro → **Silver**; CMDB Enterprise → **Gold**; CMDB Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

### Section D-021 - ServiceNow IT Operations Management
- Vendor name and category: ServiceNow IT Operations Management (ITOM) / ServiceNow ecosystem / Event Management + Discovery + Service Mapping + Cloud Management (Cloud Provisioning + Governance) + AIOps (Predictive AIOps + Health Log Analytics) + Operational Intelligence + Service Operations Workspace + ITOM Optimization + Now Assist for ITOM.
- Coverage tier: D (microservices: `itsm` ITOM capability tier + `incident-management` for event-to-alert promotion + cross-link to `cmdb` per D-020). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: ITOM Visibility → **Bronze** (Discovery only); ITOM Health → **Silver** (Discovery + Event Management); ITOM Optimization → **Gold** (above + Service Mapping + Cloud Discovery + Cloud Provisioning); ITOM AIOps → **Platinum** (above + Predictive AIOps + Health Log Analytics + Operational Intelligence + Now Assist).
- Oyatie destination: `itsm` (Event + Alert + Incident-correlation tier); `incident-management` (PagerDuty-style paging + war-room when severity ≥ HIGH); `intelligence` (AIOps anomaly detection + alert noise reduction + RCA suggestion); `cmdb` (per Discovery + Service Mapping per D-020); `data-pipeline` (event ingestion at 100k+ TPS); `observability` (log/metric/trace bridge per ADR-0130).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (ServiceNow ITOM tables):
  - `em_event` (raw monitoring event; source, type, resource, node, severity {0=Clear, 1=Critical, 2=Major, 3=Minor, 4=Warning, 5=Info}, description, additional_info JSON, message_key, time_of_event, sys_created_on, processing_notes, state {Ready/Processed/Error/Ignore}).
  - `em_alert` (correlated alert; group_id, primary_event_id, count, severity, cmdb_ci, state {Open/Reopen/Closed/Acknowledged}, acknowledged_by, acknowledged_at, work_notes, correlation_rule, last_event_time).
  - `em_match_rule` (event-to-alert correlation rule; conditions, group-by fields, time-window).
  - `em_event_rule` (event transformation rule; filter, transform script, target CI binder).
  - `em_alert_management_rule` (alert lifecycle automation; trigger + action; e.g., auto-acknowledge after N occurrences, auto-close on Clear).
  - `em_alert_action` (action history per alert; runbook executed, parameters, result).
  - `em_remediation` (runbook-action catalog; name, script, parameters, target-CI-class, requires-approval: bool).
  - `em_remediation_subflow` (Flow Designer subflow bound to remediation; with rollback subflow).
  - `em_impact_calculation_rule` (rule for business-service impact rollup from CI-alert).
  - `em_impact_status` (per-CI business-impact rollup; severity, last_calculation, contributing_alerts).
  - `em_alert_correlation_solution` (AIOps-learned correlation; pattern-id, confidence, training_run_id).
  - `cmdb_health_log` (Health Log Analytics raw log stream).
  - `hla_anomaly` (Health Log Analytics anomaly detection result; ci, anomaly_score, baseline, observed, time_window).
  - `cloud_management_resource` (Cloud Provisioning: AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI resource definition).
  - `cloud_management_blueprint` (Cloud blueprint: TFE-style infrastructure-as-code).
  - `cloud_management_stack` (provisioned stack instance).
  - `cloud_management_policy` (governance policy; cost-cap, region-restriction, tag-mandatory).
  - `service_offering` (ITOM service-offering bridge to Service Portfolio).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Event Management Connector API: `POST /api/global/em/jsonv2` (canonical event-ingest endpoint; bulk JSON array).
  - Per-source webhooks: Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, SolarWinds, SCOM, Prometheus Alertmanager — all push to em-jsonv2 endpoint.
  - MID Server pull integrations (legacy monitoring tools).
  - Table API: `GET /api/now/table/em_alert` + `GET /api/now/table/em_event`.
  - Alert Management API: `PATCH /api/now/table/em_alert/{sys_id}` for state-transition.
  - Remediation API: `POST /api/now/em/remediation/{sys_id}/execute` (with parameters + target-CI).
  - Health Log Analytics API: `POST /api/now/hla/ingest` (raw log ingest); `GET /api/now/hla/anomaly`.
  - Cloud Provisioning API: `POST /api/sn_cmp/v1/blueprint/{sys_id}/provision` + `DELETE /api/sn_cmp/v1/stack/{sys_id}`.
  - Cloud Discovery: per-cloud-account API poll via MID-Server.
  - Operational Intelligence API: `GET /api/now/operational_intelligence/anomaly` + `POST /api/now/operational_intelligence/baseline/recompute`.
  - Subscription: WebSocket stream for live-alert updates in SOW (Service Operations Workspace).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Service Operations Workspace" (SOW) — unified SRE console with alert-stream + service-impact-view + topology-graph.
  - "Event Management Workspace" — alert triage + correlation insight + remediation launcher.
  - "Service Health Dashboard" per-Business-Service impact + dependent-CI fan-out.
  - "Predictive AIOps Workbench" — anomaly + forecasted-incident + correlation-pattern UI.
  - "Cloud Operations Workspace" — multi-cloud resource inventory + cost + policy-violation.
  - "Cloud Blueprint Designer" — IaC-like authoring of provisioning bundles.
  - "Operational Intelligence" — per-metric anomaly with adaptive baseline.
  - "Health Log Analytics Workspace" — log-based anomaly + clustering.
  - "Now Assist for ITOM" — GenAI for alert-summarization + RCA-suggestion + runbook-recommendation.
  - "On-Call Schedule" (basic; integrates with PagerDuty/Splunk On-Call for advanced).

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<sre-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"ItomIngestEvent", Oyatie::Action::"ItomDedupeEvent",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItomCorrelateToAlert", Oyatie::Action::"ItomEscalateAlertToIncident",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItomAcknowledgeAlert", Oyatie::Action::"ItomSuppressAlert",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItomRunRunbookAction", Oyatie::Action::"ItomTriggerSelfHealing",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItomSnoozeAlert", Oyatie::Action::"ItomRunPatternDiscovery",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItomProvisionCloudResource", Oyatie::Action::"ItomDestroyCloudResource",
      Oyatie::Action::"ItomRetrainAIOpsModel", Oyatie::Action::"ItomInvokeNowAssist"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Alert::"<alert-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ItomRunRunbookAction" ? context.runbook_destructive_step_dry_run_passed && context.target_ci_confirmed : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ItomTriggerSelfHealing" ? context.cool_down_satisfied && context.repeat_count_below_cap : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ItomProvisionCloudResource" ? context.cost_cap_check_passed && context.region_allowed_by_pack : true) &&
    (resource.affected_ci_class.in_scope_for("PHI") ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && context.phi_alert_masked : true) &&
    (resource.affected_ci_class.in_scope_for("SOX") && action == Oyatie::Action::"ItomRunRunbookAction" ? context.sox_change_evidence_pinned : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ItomInvokeNowAssist" ? context.pack.contains("EU-AI-Act") && context.model_card_url_emitted : true) &&
    (resource.severity == "P1" ? context.on_call_assigned && context.war_room_channel_provisioned : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `em_event` → `Oyatie::Itom::event` (raw monitoring event with source + type + resource + severity-code).
  - `em_alert` → `Oyatie::Itom::alert` (correlated alert with group-id + primary-event + correlation-rule).
  - `em_match_rule` → `Oyatie::Itom::correlation_rule` (with group-by fields + time-window).
  - `em_event_rule` → `Oyatie::Itom::event_rule` (filter + transform-script + CI-binder).
  - `em_alert_management_rule` → `Oyatie::Itom::alert_automation_rule` (trigger + action).
  - `em_remediation` → `Oyatie::Itom::runbook_action` (with target-CI-class + approval requirement).
  - `em_remediation_subflow` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::remediation_flow` (with rollback path).
  - `em_impact_calculation_rule` → `Oyatie::Itom::impact_rule` (per-service-tier rollup).
  - `em_impact_status` → `Oyatie::Itom::business_service_impact` (with contributing-alert graph).
  - `em_alert_correlation_solution` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::aiops_correlation_pattern` (with confidence + training-run-id).
  - `cmdb_health_log` → `Oyatie::Observability::log_stream` (HLA bridge per ADR-0130).
  - `hla_anomaly` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::anomaly` (with baseline + observed + time-window).
  - `cloud_management_resource` / `cloud_management_blueprint` / `cloud_management_stack` → Oyatie `cloud-orchestrator` entities (binding to `compute` substrate).
  - `cloud_management_policy` → `Oyatie::Cedar::cloud_governance_policy`.

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: ITOM Event Management connector config export (per-source); per-`em_match_rule` + `em_event_rule` + `em_alert_management_rule` export with priority; per-`em_remediation` + subflow export with credential-vault binding; per-Discovery + Service-Mapping pattern export (cross-reference D-020); per-MID-Server integration config export; AIOps model + training-data export with retention; Cloud Provisioning blueprint + stack inventory export; per-cloud-policy export.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-source + per-CI partitioned event-ingest with backpressure.
  3. **Project**: tables → ontology entities; remediation runbook → workflow-studio remediation_flow with rollback.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-runbook approval-gate + per-cloud-resource cost-cap + per-region allow-list.
  5. **Credential rebind**: per-runbook credential → OpenBao reference; per-cloud-account credential rotation.
  6. **AIOps model migration**: per-model retraining trigger; shadow-correlation comparison for 14 days; canary-evaluation gate.
  7. **HLA baseline rebuild**: per-CI-class baseline recomputed against rolling-30-day logs.
  8. **Cloud-state reconciliation**: per-stack state-pin; in-flight provisions preserved; cost-meter migration.
  9. **Parallel run**: 7-day shadow event ingestion with correlation-parity ≥ 99%.
  10. **Cutover**: per-team cut-over with on-call rotation rebind; alert-stream cut-over via per-source webhook DNS swap.
  11. **Sunset**: ITOM instance decom + 7-year audit retention + AIOps model retention per pack.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Event flood under regional outage** (1M+ events/min from single source): per-source rate-limit + tiered-backpressure with priority preservation; severity-0 (Clear) drop-priority.
  - **Alert-correlation false-merge** (two unrelated incidents merged): per-correlation rule + manual-split UI + confidence-threshold gate.
  - **Runbook-action credential leak**: per-action credential-pin + OpenBao reference + audit on retrieval.
  - **Self-healing loop** (heal triggers same alert again): per-policy cool-down + repeat-count cap + auto-disable on N repeats.
  - **AIOps model drift**: per-model drift-detection + retraining trigger + canary-evaluation; rollback if precision/recall regression.
  - **Destructive remediation run on wrong CI**: per-step asset-confirmation + dry-run mandatory before live + multi-party approval for blast-radius > N.
  - **HLA anomaly false-positive flood** during cohort change (new product launch): per-cohort baseline-rebuild + suppress-window.
  - **Cloud-provisioning cost runaway**: per-tenant cost-cap with hard-stop + soft-warn + alert.
  - **Cloud-resource orphan** (stack destroyed but resource leaked): per-cloud-account drift-detection + reaper.
  - **MID-Server bandwidth saturation**: per-MID-Server rate-limit + tiered cadence + priority queue.
  - **Service-impact rollup arithmetic-drift** (sum-of-children ≠ parent): per-impact rule deterministic-replay assertion.
  - **Now Assist hallucination on RCA**: per-invocation Cedar gate + model-card + redaction-applied; analyst-review required before action.
  - **War-room channel duplicate-spawn** on major-incident: per-MI idempotent-spawn token + single-channel guarantee.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — ITOM Event Management connector API + Table API + Cloud Provisioning blueprint export + AIOps model serialization + HLA log-stream snapshot; format — JSON + YAML for blueprint + ONNX/PMML for models; duration — ~12 hours per 5k CIs + 10M events/day baseline; bandwidth — saturates 200 Mbps at peak.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — em_event severity-code (0..5) mapped to Oyatie severity-enum; alert-state preserved; lossy — historical correlation-patterns rebuilt from raw event-stream.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-team cut-over with on-call rotation rebind; alert-stream cut-over via per-source webhook DNS swap; cloud-provisioning blueprint dual-write 14-days.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 7-day shadow event-ingestion with correlation-parity ≥ 99% + impact-rollup-parity ≥ 99.5% + remediation-execution-parity 100% + cloud-stack-state-parity 100%; sunset — ITOM license termination + 7-year audit retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: ITOM Visibility → **Bronze**; ITOM Health → **Silver**; ITOM Optimization → **Gold**; ITOM AIOps → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `itsm` + `incident-management` + `intelligence` + `cmdb` are canonical; `servicenow-itom` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-022 - ServiceNow Security Operations
- Vendor name and category: ServiceNow Security Operations (SecOps) / ServiceNow ecosystem / Security Incident Response (SIR) + Vulnerability Response (VR) + Threat Intelligence (TI) + Configuration Compliance + Security Posture Control + SOAR (Security Orchestration Automation Response) + Now Assist for SecOps + Predictive Intelligence for SecOps + Risk-based Vulnerability Mgmt + Continuous Authorization + STIX/TAXII feed integration.
- Coverage tier: D (microservices: `itsm` SecOps capability tier + `data-pipeline` for SIEM/EDR ingest + cross-link to `cmdb` per D-020 for asset binding + cross-link to `compliance` per ADR-0251). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: SIR Standard → **Bronze**; SIR Professional + VR + TI → **Silver**; SecOps Enterprise (with Configuration Compliance + Risk-based Vulnerability + Continuous Authorization) → **Gold**; SecOps Enterprise Plus (with SOAR Premium + Predictive Intelligence + Now Assist) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `itsm` (Security-Incident + Vulnerability-Item + Threat-Intel tier); `data-pipeline` (SIEM + EDR + STIX/TAXII ingest at high TPS); `intelligence` (auto-triage + IOC enrichment + MITRE-ATT&CK auto-tag + RCA narrative); `incident-management` (critical-SIR paging + war-room); `compliance` (per ADR-0251 control mapping + continuous-authorization evidence).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (ServiceNow SecOps tables):
  - `sn_si_incident` (Security Incident; number, short_description, category, subcategory, attack_vector, mitre_techniques[], priority {Critical/High/Moderate/Low}, business_impact, state {Draft/Analysis/Contain/Eradicate/Recover/Review/Closed}, kill_chain_phase {Recon/Weaponization/Delivery/Exploitation/Installation/C2/ActionsOnObjectives}, classification {TLP-Red/Amber/Green/White} per TLP 2.0, calculated_severity, assigned_to, group_id).

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<soc-analyst-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsOpenSIR", Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsClassifySIR",
      Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsLinkToIOC", Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsRunIOCLookup",
      Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsContainAffectedAsset", Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsIsolateEndpoint",
      Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsBlockIPAtFirewall", Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsRunIRPlaybook",
      Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsGenerateAttackNarrative", Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsFileVuln",
      Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsAssignVulnToOwner", Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsAcceptRisk",
      Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsDeferVuln", Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsMarkFalsePositive",
      Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsRevealPII", Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsExportEvidence",
      Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsInvokeNowAssist"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::SecurityIncident::"<sir-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    clearance_level_allows(principal, resource.classification) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (resource.tlp == "RED" ? principal.clearance >= "SECRET" : true) &&
    (resource.tlp == "AMBER+STRICT" ? principal.has_role("AmberStrictAllowed") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsIsolateEndpoint" ? context.containment_dry_run_passed && context.endpoint_owner_notified : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsBlockIPAtFirewall" ? context.firewall_change_approved && context.blast_radius_acknowledged : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsAcceptRisk" ? principal.has_role("RiskAcceptor") && context.acceptance_evidence_pinned : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsRevealPII" ? context.purpose in ["legal-discovery", "breach-notification", "law-enforcement-request"] && context.legal_hold_active : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SecOpsExportEvidence" ? context.chain_of_custody_witness_present : true) &&

  };

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: SecOps Scoped REST export of SIR + Task + Playbook + Playbook-Step + Affected-User + Affected-Asset + Evidence (with chain-of-custody log) + Attack-Narrative; VR export of Vulnerable-Item + Vulnerability catalog + Detection records; TI export of Observable + Indicator + Campaign + Threat-Actor + Attack-Pattern; per-IR-playbook execution-history export.

  5. **Evidence migration**: per-evidence hash-chain immutability preserved + dual-write window during active-investigation cut-over.
  6. **Integration rebind**: per-scanner / EDR / firewall / SIEM / IAM / email-gateway connector re-mint with credential rotation.
  7. **STIX/TAXII feed rebind**: per-feed-collection re-registration; TLP-tag preservation per record.

  9. **Configuration Compliance baseline**: per-CIS / DISA-STIG benchmark re-evaluated.
  10. **Continuous Authorization evidence bridge**: per-control evidence emitted to `compliance` µservice per ADR-0251.
  11. **Parallel run**: 14-day shadow on sample SIR cohort with chain-of-custody dual-witness.
  12. **Cutover**: per-team cut-over with on-call rotation rebind; per-active-investigation manual approval; legal-hold preservation.
  13. **Sunset**: SecOps instance decom with chain-of-custody preservation 7-10 years + per-jurisdiction breach-notification audit retention.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Chain-of-custody break on migration** of active investigation: per-SIR custody-log immutable export + dual-write window + hash-chain continuity verification at cutover.
  - **IR-playbook destructive-step run-on-wrong-asset**: per-step asset-confirmation + dry-run mode mandatory before live + multi-party approval for blast-radius > N.
  - **IOC feed-staleness** (expired threat-intel still actioning): per-IOC TTL + auto-deprecation + feed-health monitor.
  - **Vuln-scan data leak** (scan results visible to wrong owner): per-asset Cedar scope + clearance check + audit on cross-tenant query.
  - **False-positive marking abuse** (analyst over-marks FP to clear queue): per-analyst FP-rate monitor + supervisor review trigger + audit-trail.
  - **PII reveal abuse on affected-user data**: per-reveal Cedar gate with purpose-clause + audit-trail + manager-attestation.
  - **TLP mis-classification** (data shared beyond TLP-RED scope): per-share Cedar TLP-check + automated DLP scan.
  - **MITRE-ATT&CK auto-tag drift** (technique-IDs change between versions): per-technique version-pin + diff-report on rebase.
  - **EDR containment cascade-failure** (isolate-endpoint breaks business-critical service): per-asset business-impact pre-check + alert + manual-override.
  - **Firewall-block rule conflict** (new rule conflicts with existing): per-firewall rule-set diff + approval-gate + rollback-plan.
  - **Breach-notification cadence missed** (GDPR 72h / HIPAA 60d / state laws): per-breach cadence monitor + auto-escalation.
  - **STIX 2.1 round-trip data loss** (custom properties dropped): per-bundle round-trip test + custom-property preservation.
  - **Risk-score arithmetic drift** (CVSS × EPSS calc differs from vendor): per-formula deterministic-replay assertion.
  - **Continuous Authorization evidence-gap** (control reports green but no evidence emitted): per-control evidence-mandatory gate.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — SecOps Scoped REST + STIX/TAXII feed export + per-scanner connector export + per-EDR connector export + IR-playbook export with execution-history; format — STIX 2.1 bundle + JSON + signed evidence-bundle; duration — ~16 hours per 10k SIRs + 1M vulns + 500k IOCs; bandwidth — saturates 100 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — TLP-classification preserved verbatim; MITRE-technique-ID preserved with version-pin; lossy — Predictive-Intelligence training-data rebuilt from raw SIR history.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-team cut-over with on-call rotation rebind; per-active-investigation manual approval; chain-of-custody dual-witness; legal-hold preservation for litigation-active SIRs.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 14-day shadow with traffic-mirror; cut-over gate — per-SIR state-parity ≥ 99.9% + chain-of-custody-integrity 100% + IOC-feed-freshness ≤ 5 min + STIX-round-trip-parity 100%; sunset — instance decom + 7-10 year retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: SIR Standard → **Bronze**; SIR Professional + VR + TI → **Silver**; SecOps Enterprise → **Gold**; SecOps Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `itsm` (SecOps tier) + `data-pipeline` + `intelligence` + `compliance` are canonical; `servicenow-secops` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-023 - ServiceNow GRC
- Vendor name and category: ServiceNow Governance Risk Compliance (GRC) / Integrated Risk Management (IRM) — rebranded portfolio: Policy & Compliance Mgmt + Risk Mgmt + Audit Mgmt + Vendor Risk Mgmt (VRM) + Business Continuity Mgmt (BCM) + Operational Risk + Privacy Mgmt + Regulatory Change Mgmt + Continuous Authorization & Monitoring + ESG Mgmt — ServiceNow ecosystem / control authoring + attestation + assessment + finding + remediation.
- Coverage tier: D (microservices: `itsm` GRC capability tier + `compliance` substrate per ADR-0251 + cross-link to `evidence-store` for per-control evidence ledger + cross-link to `marketplace` for VRM). - **Vendor data model and top objects** (ServiceNow GRC tables):

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<compliance-officer-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"GrcPublishPolicy", Oyatie::Action::"GrcRetirePolicy",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrcCertifyPolicyAck", Oyatie::Action::"GrcRegisterControl",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrcTestControl", Oyatie::Action::"GrcAttestControlEffective",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrcFileAuditFinding", Oyatie::Action::"GrcRemediateFinding",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrcCloseFinding", Oyatie::Action::"GrcIdentifyRisk",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrcAssessRisk", Oyatie::Action::"GrcAcceptRisk",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrcTransferRisk", Oyatie::Action::"GrcMitigateRisk",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrcRunAttestationCampaign", Oyatie::Action::"GrcOnboardVendor",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrcActivateContinuityPlan", Oyatie::Action::"GrcFileDPIA",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrcImportRegulatoryChange", Oyatie::Action::"GrcEmitESGMetric"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Control::"<ctrl-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"GrcAcceptRisk" ? principal.has_role("RiskAcceptor") && context.risk_acceptance_evidence_pinned && resource.residual_risk <= principal.risk_acceptance_authority : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"GrcAttestControlEffective" ? context.test_evidence_pinned && context.test_artifact_signature_valid : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"GrcCloseFinding" ? context.remediation_complete_evidence_pinned && context.management_response_recorded : true) &&
    (resource.authoritative_source == "SOX" ? context.sox_segregation_of_duties_check_passed : true) &&
    (resource.authoritative_source == "PCI-DSS" ? context.pack.contains("PCI-DSS") && principal.has_role("PCI_ASSESSOR") : true) &&
    (resource.authoritative_source == "FedRAMP" ? context.pack.contains("FedRAMP-Moderate") || context.pack.contains("FedRAMP-High") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"GrcFileDPIA" ? resource.processing_high_risk == true : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"GrcRunAttestationCampaign" ? context.reading_time_floor_set && context.comprehension_quiz_attached : true)
  };
  ```

  - `sn_risk_risk` → `Oyatie::Grc::risk` (with treatment + inherent + residual).

  - `sn_audit_engagement` → `Oyatie::Grc::audit_engagement`.

  - `sn_priv_dpia` → `Oyatie::Privacy::dpia`.
  - `sn_grc_regulatory_change` → `Oyatie::Grc::regulatory_change` (with feed-source + impacted-controls).

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: GRC table export of Policy + Policy-Statement + Control + Control-Test + Authoritative-Source + Citation + Mapping + Risk + Risk-Assessment + KRI/KPI + Audit-Engagement + Finding + Remediation + Workpaper + Attestation-Campaign + Response + Issue + Vendor + Vendor-Assessment + BCM + Privacy + Regulatory-Change + ESG-Metric.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-authoritative-source partitioned ingest with citation-traceability preserved.
  3. **Project**: tables → ontology entities; control-citation mappings preserved with confidence-score.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-control authoritative-source binding; per-pack regulatory overlay activated per ADR-0251.
  5. **Workpaper migration**: per-workpaper immutability preserved + hash-chain continuity; dual-witness on active engagement.
  6. **Evidence chain rebind**: per-control evidence-template + auto-collected evidence sources re-registered.
  7. **Indicator source rebind**: KRI/KPI measurement sources (Splunk/Datadog/CMDB/SecOps) re-registered with credential rotation.
  8. **Regulatory-change feed rebind**: per-feed subscription re-registered (UCF / Thomson Reuters / Wolters Kluwer).
  9. **Attestation-campaign state-pin**: in-flight campaigns preserve current respondents + due-dates.
  10. **VRM bridge**: per-vendor cross-link to `marketplace` supplier records.
  11. **Privacy RoPA + DPIA migration**: per-processing-activity GDPR Art-30 record preserved.
  12. **Parallel run**: 30-day shadow attestation campaign with response-parity verification.
  13. **Cutover**: per-program cut-over with regulatory-cadence preserved; SOX-quarter / GDPR-72h / HIPAA-60d clocks honored.
  14. **Sunset**: GRC instance decom with per-pack retention (SOX 7y / FedRAMP 6y / HIPAA 6y / GDPR breach-records 5y).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Control-test-evidence orphan** (test marked effective without artifact): per-test artifact-mandatory gate + signature-validity check.
  - **Attestation-fatigue gaming** (respondents click-through without reading): per-survey reading-time floor + comprehension-quiz threshold.
  - **Risk-tolerance threshold-drift** (executive changes appetite mid-cycle): per-cycle threshold-pin + diff-audit on change.
  - **Audit-finding double-counting** across engagements: per-finding deduplication on cross-engagement with control-affected key.
  - **Regulatory-pack version-mismatch** (per-pack control mapping outdated): per-pack version-pin + rolling update with diff-report + impact-analysis.
  - **Control-citation traceability break** (citation deprecated by regulator): per-citation version-bracket + auto-rebase to successor.
  - **Workpaper hash-chain break**: per-workpaper SHA-256 chain + hash-mismatch alert + custodian-chain audit.
  - **Risk-aggregation arithmetic-drift** (parent-risk ≠ sum-of-child-residuals): per-aggregation formula deterministic-replay assertion.
  - **Continuous Authorization false-green** (auto-collected evidence stale): per-evidence TTL + auto-deprecation + alert on threshold.
  - **VRM scope-creep** (vendor risk reused beyond original purpose): per-vendor purpose-clause + audit on re-use.
  - **DPIA missing** for high-risk processing: per-processing-activity high-risk gate + auto-DPIA-trigger.
  - **Regulatory-change feed-source compromise** (feed manipulated): per-feed integrity-signature + source-attestation.
  - **ESG-metric tampering** (favorable metric over-reported): per-metric immutable baseline + actual-emission audit + external-assurance gate.
  - **Cross-engagement control re-test drift** (same control tested differently by two engagements): per-control test-methodology pin + alignment-review.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — GRC Scoped REST + Policy & Compliance API + Risk API + Audit API + Attestation Campaign API + Workpaper signed-URL exporter + Regulatory Change feed export; format — JSON + PDF/A-3 for workpapers + XBRL for SOX/ESG metrics; duration — ~12 hours per 10k controls + 5k risks + 1k engagements; bandwidth — saturates 50 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — control-citation preserved verbatim; risk-treatment enum preserved; lossy — Monte-Carlo simulation results rebuilt from risk-input parameters.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-program cut-over with regulatory-cadence preserved; SOX-quarter / GDPR-72h / HIPAA-60d clocks honored; attestation-campaign state-pin.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with response-parity verification; cut-over gate — per-control state-parity ≥ 99.9% + citation-traceability 100% + workpaper-hash-integrity 100% + attestation-response-parity ≥ 99.5% + continuous-authorization-evidence-freshness ≤ 24h; sunset — instance decom + per-pack retention (SOX 7y / FedRAMP 6y).

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: GRC Standard → **Bronze**; GRC Pro → **Silver**; GRC Enterprise → **Gold**; GRC Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `itsm` (GRC tier) + `compliance` + `evidence-store` are canonical; `servicenow-grc` + `servicenow-irm` are benchmark aliases.

      Oyatie::Action::"FsmLinkToChange", Oyatie::Action::"FsmLinkToRequestItem",
      Oyatie::Action::"FsmEscalateToNOC", Oyatie::Action::"FsmGenerateNarrative",
      Oyatie::Action::"FsmTransferTruckStock", Oyatie::Action::"FsmSafetyCheckIn",
      Oyatie::Action::"FsmSafetyCheckOut", Oyatie::Action::"FsmSubmitTimeCard"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::WorkOrder::"<wo-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (principal.qualifications.contains(resource.qualification_required) || context.contractor_override_authorized) &&
    (principal.qualifications.all_unexpired_at(context.scheduled_start) || context.daily_reverify_pending == false) &&
    (resource.dispatch_territory in principal.assigned_territories || context.cross_territory_assignment_approved) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"FsmDispatch" ? principal.has_role("Dispatcher") && context.gantt_scope_check_passed : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"FsmOnSite" && resource.safety_required ? context.lone_worker_check_in_active : true) &&
    (resource.work_classification.in_scope_for("OSHA") ? context.pack.contains("OSHA") && principal.has_qualification("OSHA-10") : true) &&
    (resource.work_classification.in_scope_for("NERC-CIP") ? context.pack.contains("NERC-CIP") && principal.has_role("NERC_CIP_AUTHORIZED") : true) &&
    (resource.work_classification.in_scope_for("FDA-GxP") ? context.pack.contains("FDA-GxP") && context.gxp_attestation_pinned : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `wm_order` → `Oyatie::FieldService::work_order` (preserve number; WO-type variant).
  - `wm_task` → `Oyatie::FieldService::wo_task` (with planned + actual times + dispatch-state).
  - `wm_agent` → `Oyatie::FieldService::technician` (with skills + qualifications + territories).
  - `wm_skill` / `wm_qualification` → `Oyatie::FieldService::skill` / `qualification` (with expiration + recert cadence).
  - `wm_dispatch_group` → `Oyatie::FieldService::dispatch_group`.
  - `wm_shift` → `Oyatie::FieldService::shift_pattern`.
  - `wm_territory` → `Oyatie::FieldService::territory` (with polygon geo).
  - `wm_customer_asset` → `Oyatie::Csm::product_asset` (cross-link to D-017 + D-013 CSM/FSL asset).
  - `wm_part` + `wm_part_requirement` + `wm_truck_stock` → Oyatie parts entities (with reservation + consumption + replenish).
  - `wm_preventive_maintenance` → `Oyatie::FieldService::pm_plan` (with cadence + template WO).
  - `wm_time_card` → `Oyatie::FieldService::time_card` (with technician + date + hours).
  - `wm_crew` → `Oyatie::FieldService::crew` (multi-technician dispatch).
  - `wm_contractor` → `Oyatie::Marketplace::contractor` (per ADR-0249 multi-category marketplace).
  - `wm_appointment_booking_slot` → `Oyatie::FieldService::appointment_slot`.
  - `wm_service_bridge_link` → `Oyatie::FieldService::service_bridge` (with ITSM link).
  - `wm_customer_signature` → `Oyatie::FieldService::signature_evidence` (with image + timestamp + GPS).
  - `wm_safety_check_in` → `Oyatie::FieldService::safety_attestation` (lone-worker + hazard).

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: FSM Scoped REST + Table API export of `wm_order` + `wm_task` + `wm_agent` + `wm_skill` + `wm_qualification` + `wm_dispatch_group` + `wm_shift` + `wm_territory` + `wm_customer_asset` + `wm_part` + `wm_part_requirement` + `wm_truck_stock` + `wm_preventive_maintenance` + `wm_time_card` + `wm_crew` + `wm_contractor` + `wm_appointment_booking_slot` + `wm_service_bridge_link` + `wm_customer_signature` + `wm_safety_check_in`; Dispatcher Workspace config export; per-Customer-Asset warranty + service-contract bind.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-territory partitioned ingest with PII tagging on customer-address + signature.
  3. **Project**: tables → ontology entities; service-bridge preserved with ITSM cross-link.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-territory + per-qualification + per-shift policy with daily-recert gate.
  5. **Qualification + skill rebind**: per-technician qualification expiration calendar projected; recert workflow triggered.
  6. **Customer-asset bridge**: cross-link to CSM (D-017) product_asset with warranty + service-contract.
  7. **Parts inventory state-pin**: per-truck-stock current quantity preserved + reservation tokens active.
  8. **PM plan state-pin**: per-PM next-due date preserved; in-flight PM WOs preserved.
  9. **Connected Operations webhook rebind**: IoT-event-to-WO endpoints re-registered.
  10. **Contractor portal rebind**: external-contractor SSO + per-vendor scope.
  11. **Service-Bridge sync**: FSM ↔ ITSM bidirectional sync re-established.
  12. **Parallel run**: 14-day shadow on sample territory with dispatch-decision parity.
  13. **Cutover**: per-territory cut-over with on-call rotation + active-WO state-pin; appointment-booking DNS swap.
  14. **Sunset**: FSM instance decom + 7-year audit retention (signature evidence + safety check-in records); OSHA injury-records 5y; NERC-CIP records 3y.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **WO-to-Incident bridge loop** (incident creates WO creates incident creates WO): per-bridge cycle detection at write-time + loop-budget.
  - **Dispatcher Gantt cross-territory drag** (dispatcher accidentally drags into another territory): per-drag scope check + Cedar territory-allowance.
  - **Offline-edit replay-order conflict** (technician edits offline, conflict with online edit at sync): per-edit vector-clock with operator confirmation + 3-way merge UI.
  - **Qualification expiry mid-WO** (technician cert expires during multi-day job): per-WO qualification-pin at dispatch with daily re-verify + grace-period before block.
  - **Shift-handoff context-loss**: per-WO handoff-note mandatory at shift boundary + acknowledgment by incoming technician.
  - **Parts shortage with multiple WOs claiming same part**: per-part reservation-token + atomic-decrement; preference for highest-priority WO.
  - **Truck-stock loss / theft / damage**: per-truck audit-cycle + variance-investigation workflow.
  - **Customer-signature spoof** (signature captured but not by customer): per-capture timestamp + GPS + biometric-binding option + audit on dispute.
  - **Lone-worker safety check-in missed**: per-check-in cadence + auto-escalate-to-dispatcher on miss.
  - **Connected Operations event-flood** (IoT device emits 1000+ events/min): per-source rate-limit + dedup-window before WO-spawn.
  - **PM cadence drift on asset replacement** (replaced asset inherits old PM schedule): per-asset replacement-event + PM-recompute.
  - **Contractor scope-creep** (contractor WO touches in-scope-employee-only work): per-WO contractor-allowed-class check.
  - **Appointment-booking double-book** (two customers book overlapping slots): per-slot atomic-reserve + capacity-decrement.
  - **Now Assist hallucination on repair-recommendation**: per-invocation Cedar gate + model-card + technician-review-required before action.
  - **GPS-tracking privacy concern** (technician GPS shared beyond purpose): per-tenant GPS-share Cedar gate + purpose-clause.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — FSM Scoped REST + Table API + Dispatcher Workspace config + Mobile-App offline cache export + Customer-Asset bridge + PM plan export; format — JSON + PNG/JPEG for signature/photo evidence + GeoJSON for territory; duration — ~10 hours per 100k WOs + 50k technicians + 1M customer-assets; bandwidth — saturates 80 Mbps with signature/photo binaries.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — WO-number prefix preserved as alias; dispatch-state mapped via deterministic table; lossy — Gantt historical replay rebuilt from `wm_task` time-series; route-optimization historical decisions rebuilt from raw dispatch-events.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-territory cut-over with on-call rotation rebind + active-WO state-pin; appointment-booking DNS swap; technician-mobile force-resync 24h pre-cutover.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 14-day shadow with dispatch-decision-parity verification; cut-over gate — per-WO state-parity ≥ 99.9% + dispatch-board-render-parity ≥ 99.5% + qualification-gate 100% + parts-reservation-parity 100% + signature-evidence-integrity 100%; sunset — FSM instance decom + 7-year retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: FSM Standard → **Bronze**; FSM Professional → **Silver**; FSM Enterprise → **Gold**; FSM Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `itsm` (FSM tier) + `mobile-shell` + `crm` + `marketplace` are canonical; `servicenow-fsm` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-025 - ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management
- Vendor name and category: ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) / formerly IT Business Management (ITBM) / ServiceNow ecosystem / Innovation Mgmt (Idea) + Demand Mgmt + Investment Funding + Project Portfolio Mgmt (PPM) + Program Mgmt + Agile Development 2.0 (SAFe-aware) + Test Mgmt 2.0 + Resource Mgmt (capacity-planning + utilization) + Time Card + Expense Line + Financial Mgmt (budget-vs-actual) + Scenario Planning + Benefits Realization + Application Portfolio Mgmt (APM) + Strategic Planning Workspace.
- Coverage tier: D (microservices: `itsm` SPM capability tier + cross-link to `financial-planning` for budget rollup + cross-link to `intelligence` for portfolio scoring + cross-link to `marketplace` for vendor-engagement). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: SPM Standard (PPM only) → **Bronze**; SPM Professional (with Demand + Resource Mgmt + Time/Expense) → **Silver**; SPM Enterprise (with Agile 2.0 + Test Mgmt 2.0 + Financial Mgmt + Application Portfolio Mgmt) → **Gold**; SPM Enterprise Plus (with Scenario Planning + Benefits Realization + Strategic Planning Workspace + Now Assist) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `itsm` (Project + Program + Demand + Idea workspace); `financial-planning` (investment-portfolio rollup + budget vs actual + scenario simulation); `workflow-engine` (stage-gate + governance); `intelligence` (portfolio scoring + AI-based scenario planning + capacity-planning ML); `apm` (Application Portfolio Mgmt — capability tier within `itsm`).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (ServiceNow SPM tables):

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<pmo-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"SpmSubmitIdea", Oyatie::Action::"SpmQualifyDemand",
      Oyatie::Action::"SpmScoreDemand", Oyatie::Action::"SpmApproveStageGate",
      Oyatie::Action::"SpmAllocateResource", Oyatie::Action::"SpmPlanSprint",
      Oyatie::Action::"SpmLinkEpic", Oyatie::Action::"SpmBaselineSchedule",
      Oyatie::Action::"SpmLogTime", Oyatie::Action::"SpmLogExpense",
      Oyatie::Action::"SpmReforecast", Oyatie::Action::"SpmReplanScenario",
      Oyatie::Action::"SpmArchiveInvestment", Oyatie::Action::"SpmSunsetApplication",
      Oyatie::Action::"SpmEmitBenefitActual", Oyatie::Action::"SpmInvokeNowAssist"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Investment::"<inv-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SpmApproveStageGate" ? principal.has_role("StageGateApprover") && resource.stage_gate_authority_level <= principal.authority_level : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SpmAllocateResource" ? context.resource_capacity_check_passed && context.reservation_token_valid : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SpmReforecast" ? principal.has_role("FinancialApprover") && context.variance_threshold_acknowledged : true) &&
    (resource.is_capex && action.touches_capex ? context.pack.contains("SOX") && context.capex_evidence_pinned : true) &&
    (resource.is_federal_program ? context.pack.contains("FedRAMP") && context.federal_evidence_pinned : true) &&
    (resource.is_life_sciences_program ? context.pack.contains("FDA-GxP") && context.gxp_evidence_pinned : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SpmEmitBenefitActual" ? context.actual_evidence_signed && context.baseline_unchanged : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SpmInvokeNowAssist" ? context.pack.contains("EU-AI-Act") && context.model_card_url_emitted : true)
  };
  ```

  - `risk` → `Oyatie::Spm::project_risk` (per-project risk-register entry).
  - `pm_resource` → `Oyatie::Spm::resource_pool_member`.
  - `resource_allocation` → `Oyatie::Spm::resource_allocation` (per-resource per-week per-project).

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: SPM Scoped REST + Table API export of idea + dmn_demand + dmn_resource_plan + pm_investment + pm_project + pm_program + pm_portfolio + planned_task + risk + pm_resource + resource_allocation + time_card + expense_line + rate_card + rm_epic + rm_story + rm_theme + rm_sprint + rm_release + rm_test_plan + rm_test_case + rm_test_execution + pm_scenario + pm_scenario_investment + apm_application + apm_business_capability + pm_benefit + pm_strategic_objective.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-portfolio partitioned ingest with capex-flag + program-type tagging.
  3. **Project**: tables → ontology entities; WBS hierarchy + predecessor-graph preserved; critical-path recomputed.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-investment authority-level + per-stage-gate approval-chain + per-resource utilization-cap.
  5. **Resource allocation reservation**: per-resource per-week capacity migrated with reservation-token to prevent double-allocation.
  6. **Time-card + expense state-pin**: in-flight approval chains preserved.
  7. **Benefits baseline pin**: per-benefit baseline immutable; only actual-emission allowed post-migration.
  8. **Application portfolio rationalization**: per-application lifecycle-stage + TCO + business-value preserved.
  9. **Scenario state preservation**: per-scenario optimization-result + constraint-set preserved.
  10. **Agile state-pin**: in-flight sprints preserve committed-points + day-by-day burndown.
  11. **Parallel run**: 30-day shadow on sample portfolio with rollup-parity verification.
  12. **Cutover**: per-portfolio cut-over with budget-cycle + sprint-cycle preservation; financial-period boundaries honored.
  13. **Sunset**: SPM instance decom + 7-year retention (SOX capex-tracking) + per-pack regulated-program retention (FedRAMP 6y / FDA-GxP 10y post-product-discontinue).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Scenario-rollup arithmetic-drift** (target rounds vs source): per-scenario per-currency precision-pin + deterministic-replay assertion.
  - **Resource double-allocation** across projects: per-resource per-week capacity check + reservation-token + atomic-decrement.
  - **Stage-gate approval-bypass via direct-edit**: per-stage-gate Cedar permit + audit on edit + dual-approval for high-value gate.
  - **Benefits-realization metric-tampering**: per-metric immutable baseline + actual-emission audit + external-assurance gate.
  - **Agile-classic hybrid sync-drift**: per-epic single-source-of-truth pin (classic vs agile) with read-replica on the other.
  - **Sprint-board point-inflation** (team gaming velocity): per-team velocity-trend monitor + supervisor review.
  - **Time-card padding** (hours logged not actually worked): per-time-card variance vs project-actuals + sample-audit.
  - **Expense-line miscategorization** (opex booked as capex for SOX): per-expense category-validation + auditor-review gate.
  - **Critical-path recomputation drift** (after task-update): per-recompute deterministic-replay + diff-report.
  - **Application TCO miscount** (cloud cost not attributed): per-application cost-attribution rule + reconciliation with cloud-billing.
  - **Scenario-optimization constraint conflict** (infeasible optimization): per-scenario constraint-satisfiability check + relaxation-suggestion UI.
  - **Benefit-actual collection lag** (post-close benefits unrecorded): per-benefit collection-cadence + auto-reminder.
  - **Strategic-objective alignment drift** (investment scope creeps from original objective): per-investment alignment-review at stage-gate.
  - **Test-execution result-tampering** (test marked pass without execution): per-execution evidence-pinned + audit on result-change.
  - **Now Assist hallucination on executive summary**: per-invocation Cedar gate + model-card + human-review-required.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — SPM Scoped REST + Table API + Agile API + APM API + Scenario Planning API; format — JSON + MS-Project XML (for Gantt) + per-currency precision-preserved decimals; duration — ~10 hours per 5k projects + 50k tasks + 10k resources + 500k time-cards; bandwidth — saturates 50 Mbps.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — project-number prefix preserved as alias; state-codes mapped deterministically; lossy — Now Assist insight rebuilt from raw data; scenario-optimization re-run with same constraints.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-portfolio cut-over with budget-cycle + sprint-cycle preservation; financial-period boundaries honored; reservation-token migration.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with rollup-parity verification; cut-over gate — per-investment state-parity ≥ 99.9% + budget-vs-actual-parity 100% + resource-allocation-parity 100% + agile-velocity-parity 100% + critical-path-parity 100%; sunset — instance decom + 7-year SOX retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: SPM Standard → **Bronze**; SPM Professional → **Silver**; SPM Enterprise → **Gold**; SPM Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `itsm` (SPM tier) + `financial-planning` + `apm` are canonical; `servicenow-spm` and `servicenow-itbm` are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-026 - Workday HCM
- Vendor name and category: Workday Human Capital Management (HCM) / Workday ecosystem / Core HR + Worker Profile + Position Mgmt + Supervisory-Org + Compensation + Benefits + Absence + Time-Tracking + Workforce Planning + Talent Optimization (Performance D-030 + Succession + Career) + Learning (D-031) + Recruiting (D-029) + Workday Skills Cloud (skill-graph with ML inference) + Workday Help (employee Tier-1 case) + Workday Assistant (conversational) + Workday Journeys (lifecycle event orchestration) + Workday Adaptive Planning (D-028) + Workday Extend (custom-application).
- Coverage tier: D (microservice: `hcm`; cross-link to `payroll` separate µservice + `learning-management` D-031 + `performance-management` D-030 + `workflow-engine` for Workday Business Process Framework analog). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: HCM Core (Worker + Position + Supervisory-Org) → **Bronze**; HCM Pro (with Compensation + Benefits + Absence) → **Silver**; HCM Enterprise (with Time Tracking + Workforce Planning + Skills Cloud + Journeys + Help + Assistant) → **Gold**; HCM Enterprise Plus (with Adaptive Planning + Extend + per-country Localization Pack + Connected-Person AI) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `hcm` (Worker + Position + Supervisory-Org + Compensation + Benefits + Absence + Time-Tracking + Skills); `payroll` (separate µservice for pay-component + tax + garnishment + integration to Workday Payroll D-027 or ADP/Ceridian); `workflow-engine` (Business Process Framework analog with consultative + serial + parallel + conditional routes); `learning-management` (D-031 bridge); `performance-management` (D-030 bridge); `recruiting` (D-029 bridge); `community` (Worker Self-Service portal); `mobile-shell` (Workday Mobile analog).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Workday HCM object model):

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<hr-bp-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmHire", Oyatie::Action::"HcmTerminate",
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmTransfer", Oyatie::Action::"HcmPromote",
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmDemote", Oyatie::Action::"HcmChangeCompensation",
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmChangeJob", Oyatie::Action::"HcmChangePosition",
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmPlaceOnLeave", Oyatie::Action::"HcmReturnFromLeave",
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmEnrollInBenefit", Oyatie::Action::"HcmAddDependent",
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmAddBeneficiary", Oyatie::Action::"HcmImportSalarySurvey",
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmRunMeritCycle", Oyatie::Action::"HcmRunPromotionCycle",
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmFileGrievance", Oyatie::Action::"HcmRunOrgChartSnapshot",
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmRunCalibration", Oyatie::Action::"HcmCreateJourney",
      Oyatie::Action::"HcmDelegateAuthority"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Worker::"<worker-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    delegated_authority_holds(principal, resource) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose) &&
    (principal.has_role("HRBP") && principal.scope_org.contains(resource.supervisory_org) || principal.has_role("HR_ADMIN")) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HcmChangeCompensation" ? context.compensation_grade_in_band && context.budget_gate_passed : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HcmTerminate" ? context.exit_interview_scheduled && context.access_revocation_plan_ready : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HcmRunMeritCycle" ? context.calibration_complete && context.budget_allocation_approved : true) &&
    (resource.worker_jurisdiction == "FR" && action.touches_employment_terms ? context.works_council_l1232_notification_complete : true) &&
    (resource.worker_jurisdiction == "DE" && action.touches_employment_terms ? context.betriebsrat_notification_complete : true) &&
    (resource.worker_jurisdiction == "KR" && action.touches_employment_terms ? context.pack.contains("KR-LaborStandards") : true) &&
    (resource.worker_jurisdiction == "IN" && action.touches_grievance ? context.pack.contains("IN-PoSH") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HcmDelegateAuthority" ? context.delegation_token_ttl_valid && resource.delegation_chain_depth < 3 : true) &&
    (resource.contains_medical_data && action.touches_medical ? context.pack.contains("ADA-FMLA") || context.pack.contains("HIPAA") : true)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Worker` → `Oyatie::Hcm::worker` (employee + contingent union; preserve Worker_ID as alias).
  - `Position` → `Oyatie::Hcm::position` (with effective-dating + headcount tracking).
  - `Job_Profile` → `Oyatie::Hcm::job_profile` (with FLSA + management-level).
  - `Supervisory_Organization` → `Oyatie::Hcm::supervisory_org` (with parent-chain + effective-dating).
  - `Cost_Center` / `Location` / `Region` → Oyatie geographic + accounting entities.
  - `Compensation_Package` → `Oyatie::Hcm::compensation_package` (with effective-date + plan-assignments).
  - `Compensation_Grade` + `Compensation_Plan` → `Oyatie::Hcm::comp_grade` + `comp_plan` (per-locale-currency variants preserved).
  - `Benefit_Plan` + `Benefit_Enrollment` → `Oyatie::Hcm::benefit_plan` + `enrollment` (per-locale + plan-year).
  - `Dependent` / `Beneficiary` → `Oyatie::Hcm::dependent` / `beneficiary`.
  - `Absence_Request` → `Oyatie::Hcm::absence_request` (with absence-type + state-PFL binding).
  - `Time_Block` → `Oyatie::Hcm::time_block` (with project / cost-center allocation).
  - `Business_Process_Step` + `Business_Process_Definition` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::business_process_step` + `definition` (preserve consultative / serial / parallel / conditional + delegation).
  - `Calculated_Field` → `Oyatie::Hcm::calculated_field` (with formula + cycle-detection).
  - `Worker_Skills` → `Oyatie::Hcm::skill_assignment` (with source-tag + inference-provenance).
  - `Career_Profile` → `Oyatie::Hcm::career_profile`.
  - `Journey` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::journey_template` (lifecycle-event orchestration).
  - `Workday_Help_Case` → `Oyatie::Hr::case` (cross-link to D-018 HRSD-shape).
  - `Delegation_Token` → `Oyatie::Identity::delegation_token` (with TTL + scope + auto-rebind).

- **Specific workflow steps**:
  1. **Extract**: WWS export of Worker + Position + Job_Profile + Supervisory_Org + Cost_Center + Location + Compensation_Package + Compensation_Grade + Compensation_Plan + Benefit_Plan + Benefit_Enrollment + Dependent + Beneficiary + Absence_Request + Time_Block + Business_Process_Definition + Business_Process_Step + Calculated_Field + Worker_Skills + Career_Profile + Journey + Workday_Help_Case + Delegation_Token; Workday custom-report (RaaS) export for organization-historical snapshots.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-country partitioned ingest with per-field PII/medical classification.
  3. **Project**: tables → ontology entities; Supervisory-Org parent-chain + effective-dating preserved; BP framework projected with consultative + serial + parallel + conditional + delegation semantics.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-jurisdiction + per-scope-org + per-role + per-action policy with works-council + Betriebsrat overlays activated.
  5. **Calculated-field formula transformation**: per-formula cycle-detection + dependency-graph build + transformation to Oyatie expression language.
  6. **Compensation grade migration**: per-grade per-locale-currency preserved; in-grade-band check Cedar gate.
  7. **Benefit-vendor connector rebind**: per-vendor connector (medical/dental/401k/HSA) re-registered with credential rotation.
  8. **Per-country payroll-input rebind**: per-country tax-table + garnishment-rule + pay-component mapping.
  9. **Journey state-pin**: in-flight journeys preserve current-step + assignments + due-dates.
  10. **Skills Cloud migration**: per-worker skill-assignment with inference-provenance preserved + ML-model rebuild for new inferences.
  11. **Delegation token migration**: per-token TTL + scope + auto-rebind to next-in-chain on expiry.
  12. **Parallel run**: 30-day shadow with payroll-cycle preview parity ≥ 99.99% (cent-level reconciliation).
  13. **Cutover**: per-country cut-over with delegation-token migration + works-council notification (FR L-1232 / DE BetrVG) 30 days prior; benefit-vendor cut-over aligned with plan-year boundary.
  14. **Sunset**: Workday tenant termination with per-jurisdiction employee-record retention (US 4y employment / EU 10y payroll-adjacent / KR 3y employment / JP 5y employment / DE 10y payroll + 10y accident).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Business-process orphan** (process started but Initiator left the org): per-process delegation-fallback + auto-reassign on terminate + re-route to manager-of-initiator.
  - **Calculated-field circular dependency**: per-formula cycle detection at import + dependency-graph build with topological-sort.
  - **Compensation-plan grade overlap** (worker eligible for two plans): per-worker plan-precedence + audit on dual-assignment + manager-resolve UI.
  - **Per-country payroll-input config drift**: per-country tax-table version-pin per pay-cycle + auto-rebase on regulator update.
  - **Delegation-token expiry mid-process**: per-token TTL + auto-rebind to next-in-chain + escalation-on-no-chain.
  - **Org-chart snapshot-staleness during reorg**: per-snapshot timestamp-pin + comparison report + reorg-in-progress flag.
  - **Effective-dating retroactive change conflict** (back-dated change touches already-processed pay-period): per-change pay-period-impact analysis + correction-payroll gate.
  - **Benefit-enrollment qualifying-life-event window expired**: per-enrollment QLE-window check + late-enrollment penalty calculation.
  - **Absence-balance accrual rule drift** (state-PFL rule changes mid-year): per-locale accrual-formula version-pin + retroactive recompute.
  - **Time-tracking meal/break-attestation gap** (CA / IL / NY state law): per-state attestation-required gate + missing-attestation alert.
  - **Skills Cloud ML-inference drift** (skill-graph re-inference produces different results): per-worker inference-history + change-explanation + manager-validate gate.
  - **Manager-chain cycle** (A reports to B reports to A): per-supervisory-org write-time cycle detection.
  - **Workforce planning what-if data-leak** (planning scenario uses real worker IDs visible to wrong audience): per-scenario data-class + Cedar access-check.
  - **Workday Extend custom-app supply-chain risk**: per-Extend-app SBOM + signature per ADR-0247 + 0293.
  - **GDPR Art-17 deletion vs employment-record retention conflict**: per-jurisdiction retention-floor vs deletion-right reconciliation (pseudonymization where deletion-right wins).
  - **Adaptive Planning sync-drift** (HCM headcount vs Adaptive plan): per-cycle reconciliation + diff-report.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Workday WWS (SOAP) + Workday REST (where available) + RaaS custom-report + EIB outbound + Workday Studio extract; format — XML (WWS) + JSON (REST) + CSV (EIB); duration — ~24 hours per 100k workers + 200k positions + 1M time-blocks/month + 50 BP definitions; bandwidth — saturates 30 Mbps (Workday throttles aggressive extracts).
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Worker_ID preserved as alias; Effective-Dating preserved verbatim; BP framework projected with semantic preservation; lossy — Workday Assistant conversational-history rebuilt; Skills Cloud ML inferences re-run on Oyatie ML.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-country cut-over with delegation-token migration; works-council notification 30 days prior (FR L-1232 / DE BetrVG); benefit-vendor cut-over aligned with plan-year boundary; payroll cut-over at pay-cycle boundary with parallel-run cent-level reconciliation.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with payroll-cycle preview parity ≥ 99.99% (cent-level) + benefit-enrollment-parity 100% + absence-balance-parity 100% + org-chart-shape-parity 100% + BP-execution-parity 100% + skills-inference-parity ≥ 95% (acceptable ML-drift); sunset — Workday tenant termination + per-jurisdiction retention (US 4y / EU 10y / KR 3y / JP 5y / DE 10y).

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: HCM Core → **Bronze**; HCM Pro → **Silver**; HCM Enterprise → **Gold**; HCM Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `hcm` is canonical; `workday-hcm` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-027 - Workday Financials
- Vendor name and category: Workday Financial Management / Workday ecosystem / general-ledger + revenue (ASC-606 / IFRS-15) + procurement (D-032 bridge) + accounts-receivable + accounts-payable + projects (Project Billing) + fixed-assets (Asset Lifecycle) + grants (for non-profit/higher-ed) + financial-consolidation + financial-close + tax + treasury (cash position) + Banking + Settlement + Auditor-Workspace + Workday Prism Analytics (financial-data-warehouse on Workday-native) + Worktag-based dimensional accounting.
- Coverage tier: B (partial coverage by `finance-erp` from ADR-0315 + capability tier on `marketplace` + `payments`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Core GL (Book + Ledger + Journal + Account + Worktag) → **Bronze**; FIN Pro (with AR + AP + Fixed-Asset + Project Billing + Banking) → **Silver**; FIN Enterprise (with Multi-Book + Multi-Entity + Intercompany + Consolidation + Revenue + Auditor-Workspace) → **Gold**; FIN Enterprise Plus (with Prism Analytics + Treasury + Grants + per-country GAAP packs + Tax-Reporting overlays) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `finance-erp` (per ADR-0315 — Book + Ledger + Journal + Worktag + AR + AP + Fixed-Asset + Project-Billing + Consolidation + Close); `marketplace` (procurement seam — supplier + PO + contract per D-032); `payments` (AR + AP payment rails — ACH + SEPA + Wire + RTP + Faster-Payments + BOK21-EBPP + Zengin); `data-warehouse` (Prism Analytics analog — financial-data-mart); `workflow-engine` (multi-currency + multi-book + multi-entity close BP framework analog); `compliance-pack` (per-country GAAP + tax overlays); `audit-trail` (immutable journal + Cedar evidence per ADR-0247).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Workday Financial Management object model):
  - `Company` (legal entity; Company_ID, Country, Currency, Functional_Currency, Tax_ID, Fiscal_Schedule_Reference, Default_Worktag_Set, Intercompany_Partner: bool).
  - `Book` (per-Company accounting book; Book_Code, Book_Type {Primary / Secondary / Tax / Management}, GAAP_Basis {US-GAAP / IFRS / Local-GAAP / Tax-GAAP}, Reporting_Currency, Posting_Allowed: bool).
  - `Ledger_Account` (chart-of-accounts; Account_Code, Account_Name, Account_Type {Asset / Liability / Equity / Revenue / Expense / Statistical}, Account_Posting_Rules[], Account_Set_Reference, Summary_Only: bool, Worktag_Usage[]).
  - `Account_Posting_Rule` (per-Account Cedar-like rule; Conditions {Worktag_Type_Required[] / Worktag_Value_Restricted[]}, Action {Allow / Disallow / Warn}, Effective_Date).
  - `Worktag` (Workday's dimensional-accounting primitive — replaces traditional segment-based COA; Worktag_Type {Cost_Center / Region / Program / Project / Grant / Fund / Custom_Org / Spend_Category / Revenue_Category / Customer / Supplier / Worker / etc.}, Worktag_Value, Hierarchy_Parent, Default_For_Account_Type).
  - `FDM` (Foundation Data Model; the master hierarchy graph linking Company + Book + Ledger_Account + Worktag dimensions with effective-dating).
  - `Journal_Entry_Header` (JE_Number, Book_Reference, Company_Reference, Period_Reference, Currency, Journal_Source {Manual / Subledger / Allocation / Translation / Elimination / Close}, Posting_Date, Status {Draft / In_Progress / Posted / Reversed / Cancelled}, Created_By, Approved_By_Chain[]).
  - `Journal_Line` (Line_Number, Account_Reference, Worktag_Set, Debit_Amount, Credit_Amount, Currency, FX_Rate, Memo, Subledger_Reference).
  - `Subledger` (per-Source — AR / AP / Fixed-Asset / Project / Payroll / Inventory; rolls up to GL via Account-Posting-Rules).
  - `Customer` (Customer_ID, Customer_Group, Bill_To_Address, Payment_Terms, Credit_Limit, Worktag_Defaults).
  - `Supplier` (Supplier_ID, Supplier_Group, Remit_To_Address, Payment_Terms, Tax_ID, Bank_Account_Reference, 1099_Reportable: bool).
  - `Supplier_Invoice` (Invoice_Number, Supplier_Reference, Invoice_Date, Due_Date, Total_Amount, Lines[Line_Number / Account / Worktag / Amount / Tax], Match_Status {Unmatched / 2-Way / 3-Way / Discrepancy}, PO_Reference[], Receipt_Reference[]).
  - `Customer_Invoice` (Invoice_Number, Customer_Reference, Bill_Date, Due_Date, Lines[], Revenue_Recognition_Reference, Tax_Lines[], Total_Amount).
  - `Revenue_Contract` (per ASC-606 / IFRS-15; Contract_Number, Customer_Reference, Performance_Obligations[POB_ID / Description / Standalone_Selling_Price / Allocation / Recognition_Pattern {Point-in-Time / Over-Time / Milestone / Usage}], Contract_Modifications[]).
  - `Allocation_Rule` (Source_Account_Set, Target_Worktag_Set, Driver_Statistic, Basis_Type {Percentage / Statistical / Equal / Custom_Formula}, Effective_Date_Range).
  - `Fixed_Asset` (Asset_Number, Asset_Class, Acquisition_Date, Acquisition_Cost, Useful_Life, Depreciation_Method {Straight-Line / Declining-Balance / Units-of-Production}, Salvage_Value, In_Service_Date, Disposal_Date, Worktag_Set).
  - `Project` (Project_ID, Project_Type {Capital / Internal / Billable / Grant-Funded}, Budget, Start_Date, End_Date, PI_Reference, Worktag_Set, Project_Plan_Reference).
  - `Period` (Period_Code, Fiscal_Year, Period_Number, Open_For_Subledger: bool, Open_For_GL: bool, Hard_Close_Date, Soft_Close_Date).
  - `Bank_Account` (Bank_Account_Number_Masked, Routing, SWIFT, IBAN, Company_Reference, Currency).
  - `Bank_Statement` (Statement_Date, Bank_Account_Reference, Lines[], Imported_From {SFTP / BAI2 / MT940 / CAMT-053 / Plaid / Open-Banking-PSD2}).
  - `Tax_Code` (Jurisdiction, Tax_Type {VAT / Sales / Use / GST / Consumption / Withholding}, Rate, Effective_Date, Direction {Input / Output}).
