- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Expense Submit Mobile" — receipt-snap + auto-OCR + classify + voice-memo for business-purpose; drag-drop multi-receipt batch.
  - "Smart Match" — corp-card transaction auto-match to OCR'd receipt with confidence score + manual-confirm UI.
  - "Personal Flag" — single-tap to mark a corp-card transaction as personal (creates owe-back).
  - "Mileage Tracker" — auto-track via mobile-GPS with start/stop + manual-edit + map-verify.
  - "Approver Mobile" — one-swipe approve/return with full-line + receipt-image preview + policy-violation flag.
  - "Per-Diem Picker" — auto-fill per-diem based on city + date + first/last-day-proration.
  - "Receipt Wallet" — long-term receipt-archive with search + tax-prep export.
  - "Trip Bundle" — group expenses under a Trip with itinerary-attach + per-day-summary.
  - "Finance Audit Console" — desktop reconciliation with corp-card-vs-ER variance + outstanding-cash-advance + policy-violation tracker.
  - "Delegate Authority" — submit/approve on behalf with audit-trail.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<employee-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"ExpCreateReport", Oyatie::Action::"ExpAttachReceipt",
      Oyatie::Action::"ExpClassifyExpenseType", Oyatie::Action::"ExpClaimMileage",
      Oyatie::Action::"ExpMarkPersonalOnCard", Oyatie::Action::"ExpSubmitForApproval",
      Oyatie::Action::"ExpApproveReport", Oyatie::Action::"ExpReturnToSubmitter",
      Oyatie::Action::"ExpReimburse", Oyatie::Action::"ExpRunPolicyViolationCheck",
      Oyatie::Action::"ExpReconcileCardTransaction", Oyatie::Action::"ExpClaimPerDiem",
      Oyatie::Action::"ExpRequestCashAdvance", Oyatie::Action::"ExpSettleCashAdvance",
      Oyatie::Action::"ExpRecoverVat", Oyatie::Action::"ExpDelegateAuthority"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::ExpenseReport::"<er-uuid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ExpCreateReport" ? principal.has_role("Employee") || principal.delegate_authority_for(resource.submitter, "Submit-On-Behalf") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ExpSubmitForApproval" ? all_required_receipts_attached(resource) && all_policy_violations_justified(resource) && submission_within_time_limit(resource, context.tenant_policy_days) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ExpApproveReport" ? !submitted_by(principal, resource) && principal.approval_authority_amount >= resource.total && (principal.is_manager_of(resource.submitter) || principal.delegate_authority_for(resource.submitter.manager, "Approve-On-Behalf")) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ExpClaimMileage" ? mileage_rate_valid_at_date(context.mileage_rate, context.trip_date) && map_verified(context.mileage_log) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ExpClaimPerDiem" ? per_diem_schedule_valid_at_date(context.schedule, context.trip_start_date) && per_diem_jurisdiction_matches(context.trip_destination, context.schedule) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ExpMarkPersonalOnCard" ? card_transaction_belongs_to(principal, context.txn) && !already_personal_flagged(context.txn) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ExpReimburse" ? resource.status == "Approved" && bank_account_verified(resource.submitter) && !on_audit_hold(resource) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ExpRecoverVat" ? resource.line.jurisdiction.in_eu_vat_recovery_eligible && receipt_has_vat_breakdown(resource.line.receipt) && vendor_vat_id_validated(resource.line.vendor) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ExpRequestCashAdvance" ? !outstanding_cash_advance_above_threshold(principal, context.tenant_policy_max) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"ExpDelegateAuthority" ? principal.has_role("Manager") || context.delegation_self_only : true) &&
    (resource.line.expense_type.is_entertainment && resource.line.attendee_count > 1 ? context.attendee_list_provided && context.business_purpose_documented : true) &&
    (resource.line.expense_type.is_gift ? context.gift_disclosure_required && context.recipient_relationship_documented : true) &&
    sox_segregation_of_duties_check(principal, action, resource) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Expense_Report_Header` → `Oyatie::Expense::expense_report` (with trip + status + approval-chain).
  - `Expense_Line` → `Oyatie::Expense::expense_line` (with personal-flag + policy-violation refs).
  - `Expense_Type` → `Oyatie::Expense::expense_type` (with per-diem-eligible + mileage-eligible + receipt-required).
  - `Receipt` → `Oyatie::Expense::receipt` (with OCR-fields + confidence-score + manual-confirmation-flag).
  - `Corp_Card_Transaction` → `Oyatie::Expense::corp_card_transaction` (with MCC + source-stream + match-status).
  - `Mileage_Log` → `Oyatie::Expense::mileage_log` (with map-verify + IRS-rate-pin).
  - `Mileage_Rate_Table` → `Oyatie::Expense::mileage_rate_table` (per-jurisdiction + per-effective-date).
  - `Per_Diem_Schedule` → `Oyatie::Expense::per_diem_schedule` (per-jurisdiction + per-effective-date + proration-rule).
  - `Policy_Rule` → `Oyatie::Cedar::expense_policy_rule` (projected as Cedar policy fragments per ADR-0243).
  - `Policy_Violation` → `Oyatie::Expense::policy_violation` (with rule-reference + justification + resolution).
  - `Reimbursement_Payment` → `Oyatie::Payments::reimbursement_payment` (cross-link to payments µservice).
  - `Travel_Itinerary` → `Oyatie::Expense::travel_itinerary` (cross-link to travel-mgmt vendor — TripActions / Navan / Concur Travel / Egencia).
  - `Cash_Advance` → `Oyatie::Expense::cash_advance` (with settle-tracking + open-balance).
  - `Delegate_Authority` → `Oyatie::Identity::delegation_token` (cross-link to D-026 HCM delegation).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Workday Expenses displacement journey):
  1. **Extract**: WWS export of Expense_Report_Header + Expense_Line + Expense_Type + Receipt (with binary image + OCR fields) + Corp_Card_Transaction (full history + reconciled-status) + Mileage_Log + Mileage_Rate_Table (per-version per-jurisdiction) + Per_Diem_Schedule (per-version per-jurisdiction) + Policy_Rule + Policy_Violation + Reimbursement_Payment + Travel_Itinerary + Cash_Advance + Delegate_Authority.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-submitter partitioned ingest; per-receipt binary in object-store with hash-pin; per-card-transaction encryption with last-4-only-display.
  3. **Project**: Expense_Type taxonomy preserved; Policy_Rule projected as Cedar policy fragments; per-receipt OCR fields + confidence preserved; corp-card source-stream provenance preserved.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-cost-center + per-expense-type + per-role + per-action policy; submission time-limit + receipt-required + approval-authority-amount + personal-flag-audit; SOX segregation-of-duties.
  5. **Receipt-OCR rebuild**: per-receipt re-OCR for confidence-score harmonization + manual-confirmation flag re-evaluation; receipt-binaries pinned to tenant object-store.
  6. **Corp-card feed rebind**: per-card-program (Visa VCF4 / Amex GL1025 / Mastercard CDF / Brex / Ramp / Divvy / Bento) connector credential rotation; daily-feed cutover at statement-day-boundary; in-flight unmatched-transactions migrated as-is.
  7. **Travel-mgmt rebind**: per-vendor (TripActions / Navan / Concur Travel / Egencia) OAuth re-grant + itinerary-import preservation.
  8. **Mileage-rate-table migration**: per-jurisdiction per-effective-date version-pin; in-flight reports pinned to start-date rate.
  9. **Per-diem-schedule migration**: per-jurisdiction per-effective-date version-pin; GSA / DSSR source preserved; first-last-day-proration rules preserved.
  10. **Policy-rule rebuild**: per-rule formula transformation to Oyatie expression-language; Cedar fragment projection; per-rule action-policy preserved.
  11. **VAT-recovery rebind**: per-jurisdiction VAT-recovery rule preserved; per-receipt VAT-breakdown OCR enhanced; vendor-VAT-ID validation pipeline rebound.
  12. **Reimbursement-payment rebind**: per-method (direct-deposit / payroll-bundle / wire / check) connector rebind; per-bank account-verification preserved.
  13. **Delegate-authority migration**: per-token preserved; scope (Submit-On-Behalf / Approve-On-Behalf) preserved; TTL preserved.
  14. **Parallel run**: 60-day shadow with sample submission cycle + corp-card reconciliation + mileage-calc + per-diem-calc + VAT-recovery + reimbursement-payment parity ≥ 99.99% (cent-level).
  15. **Cutover**: per-population cut-over with delegate-authority migration; corp-card-feed cut-over at statement-day boundary; in-flight ERs state-pinned + carried-over.
  16. **Sunset**: Workday Expenses tenant termination with audit-trail retention per SOX (7y) + per-jurisdiction tax-records (US 7y / EU 10y / KR 5y / JP 7y) + receipt-image retention per VAT-recovery rule (EU 10y per Directive 2006/112/EC).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Receipt-OCR field-misread** (currency / amount / vendor): per-line manual-confirm gate + confidence-score threshold + auto-flag-below-90% + re-OCR with alternative engine.
  - **Per-diem-rate stale at submission** (rate changed between trip-end and submission): per-trip rate-pin at trip-start-date + override-with-justification.
  - **Corp-card-transaction duplicate-match** (same transaction matched twice — once auto, once manual): per-transaction idempotency-key + Cedar-gate on second-match.
  - **Personal-expense flag bypass** (employee mis-classifies personal as business): per-line policy-violation-detector + AI-anomaly check + audit on personal-to-business reclassify.
  - **VAT-recovery jurisdiction-mismatch** (trip-destination jurisdiction vs receipt-vendor-jurisdiction differ): per-receipt jurisdiction-pin + recovery-rule check + manual-resolve.
  - **Mileage-log map-verification false-positive** (route claimed differs from map-reasonable route): per-log map-verify + variance-alert + manager-confirm-on-anomaly.
  - **Per-diem first/last-day-proration error** (half-day rule misapplied): per-trip first/last-day rule per-jurisdiction + auto-apply + audit.
  - **Corp-card-feed format-drift** (Visa releases new VCF version): per-card-program format-version-pin + parser-version-pin + alert-on-drift.
  - **Cash-advance settle-orphan** (employee leaves with open advance): per-advance auto-recoup-from-final-paycheck + grievance-process.
  - **Policy-rule conflict** (per-day cap vs per-trip cap inconsistent): per-rule priority + tie-breaker + audit-on-conflict.
  - **Multi-currency FX-rate drift** (rate at submission vs reimbursement differs by 5%): per-line FX-rate-pin at submission + variance-disclosure + reimbursement-rate-policy {Pin-at-Submission / Pin-at-Reimbursement / Per-Tenant-Choice}.
  - **Entertainment expense attendee-list missing**: per-line attendee-required gate + per-attendee Cedar check (no per-customer regulatory leak).
  - **Gift expense recipient-disclosure miss**: per-line gift-disclosure-required + recipient-relationship documented (FCPA risk).
  - **Delegate-authority over-scope** (delegate approves their own report indirectly through delegated authority): per-delegation chain-check + Cedar gate on self-approval.
  - **Audit-hold release without justification**: per-hold release-Cedar-check + audit on early-release.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — WWS + REST + per-corp-card-feed (Visa VCF4 / Amex GL1025 / Mastercard CDF / per-vendor API) + Travel-Mgmt API; format — XML / JSON / CSV / VCF4 / GL1025 / CDF; duration — ~12-24 hours per 100k expense-reports + 1M expense-lines + 500k receipts (with binaries) + 2M corp-card transactions + 5y mileage-log history; bandwidth — heavy on receipt-binaries (saturates 100 Mbps).
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Expense_Type taxonomy preserved; per-receipt OCR fields + confidence preserved; Policy_Rule projected as Cedar policy fragments; lossy — Workday Worklets rebuilt natively; AI-policy-detect retrained on Oyatie ML.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-population cut-over with delegate-authority migration; corp-card-feed cut-over at statement-day boundary; in-flight ERs state-pinned + carried-over; mileage-rate + per-diem-schedule re-versioned at fiscal-year boundary.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-day shadow with sample submission cycle + corp-card reconciliation + mileage-calc + per-diem-calc + VAT-recovery + reimbursement-payment parity ≥ 99.99% (cent-level); sunset — Workday Expenses tenant termination + audit-trail retention per SOX (7y) + per-jurisdiction tax (US 7y / EU 10y / KR 5y / JP 7y) + receipt-image retention per VAT-recovery (EU 10y).

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Expense Core → **Bronze**; Expense Pro → **Silver**; Expense Enterprise → **Gold**; Expense Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `finance-erp` + `marketplace` are canonical; `workday-expenses` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-034 - Jira Software
- Vendor name and category: Atlassian Jira Software (Cloud + Data Center) / Atlassian ecosystem / Agile Project Management — Issue Type Scheme + Workflow Scheme + Permission Scheme + Notification Scheme + Screen Scheme + Field Configuration Scheme + Sprint/Epic/Story/Subtask/Bug/Task hierarchy + Backlog + Board (Scrum + Kanban) + Roadmap + Versions/Releases + Components + Advanced Roadmaps (formerly Portfolio for Jira) + JQL (Jira Query Language) + Custom Fields + Smart-Links + Automation Rules + Webhooks + REST API v3 + Atlassian Marketplace + Forge + Connect.
- Coverage tier: B (partial: capability tier on `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + new µservice plausible in Wave-3-H). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Jira Core (Issue + Workflow + Sprint + Board + JQL) → **Bronze**; Jira Pro (with Custom Fields + Schemes + Versions + Components + Automation + Roadmap) → **Silver**; Jira Enterprise (with Advanced Roadmaps + Cross-Project Dependencies + Permission Scheme Variants + SLA + Audit-Log) → **Gold**; Jira Enterprise Plus (with Multi-Site Federation + Sandbox Cloning + Data Residency Pin + Atlassian Intelligence AI + Compass-Integration) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `workflow-engine` (issue state-machine + custom workflow + transition + screen + field-configuration + scheme-binding); `developer-sdk` (per-repo + per-branch + per-PR issue link via D-037 Bitbucket); `intelligence` (sprint-health + velocity prediction + cycle-time analysis + bottleneck detect); `marketplace` (Atlassian Marketplace apps → plugin-app-store per ADR-0249); `community` (issue-comments + reactions); `apigw` (REST/Webhook surface + JQL endpoint); `workflow-studio` (Automation rules — when-condition-action editor).

  ```
      Oyatie::Action::"AgileCreateIssue", Oyatie::Action::"AgileTransitionStatus",
      Oyatie::Action::"AgileAssign", Oyatie::Action::"AgileComment",
      Oyatie::Action::"AgileLogWork", Oyatie::Action::"AgileSetStoryPoints",
      Oyatie::Action::"AgileLinkIssue", Oyatie::Action::"AgileCloneIssue",
      Oyatie::Action::"AgileMoveToSprint", Oyatie::Action::"AgileStartSprint",
      Oyatie::Action::"AgileCompleteSprint", Oyatie::Action::"AgileRunJqlQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"AgileBulkEdit", Oyatie::Action::"AgileScheduleVersionRelease",
      Oyatie::Action::"AgileEditWorkflow", Oyatie::Action::"AgileEditPermissionScheme",
      Oyatie::Action::"AgileInstallMarketplaceApp"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Issue::"<issue-key>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    permission_scheme_grants(principal, action, resource.project) &&
    issue_security_level_allows(principal, resource.security_level) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AgileTransitionStatus" ? workflow_transition_allowed(resource.workflow, resource.status, context.target_status) && transition_conditions_satisfied(context) && transition_validators_pass(context) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AgileMoveToSprint" ? sprint_in_active_or_future_state(context.sprint) && !sprint_locked(context.sprint) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AgileStartSprint" ? principal.has_role("ScrumMaster") || principal.has_role("ProjectAdmin") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AgileCompleteSprint" ? principal.has_role("ScrumMaster") || principal.has_role("ProjectAdmin") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AgileBulkEdit" ? context.bulk_size <= principal.tenant.bulk_edit_limit : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AgileEditWorkflow" ? principal.has_role("JiraAdmin") && !workflow_in_use_with_in_flight_issues(context.workflow) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AgileEditPermissionScheme" ? principal.has_role("JiraAdmin") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AgileInstallMarketplaceApp" ? principal.has_role("OrgAdmin") && marketplace_app_security_reviewed(context.app) : true) &&
    (resource.project.requires_iec_62304 && action.touches_state ? context.pack.contains("IEC-62304") && safety_class_audit_pass : true) &&
    (resource.project.requires_part_11 && action.touches_data ? context.pack.contains("FDA-Part-11") && context.esign_completed : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Issue` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::issue` (preserve Issue_Key as alias; ADF description preserved).
  - `Issue_Type` + `Issue_Type_Scheme` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::issue_type` + `issue_type_scheme` (with hierarchy-level).
  - `Project` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::project` (with scheme-bindings).
  - `Workflow` + `Workflow_Scheme` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::workflow` + `workflow_scheme` (with states + transitions + conditions + validators + post-functions).
  - `Permission_Scheme` → `Oyatie::Cedar::permission_scheme` (projected as Cedar policy bundle).
  - `Screen` + `Screen_Scheme` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::screen` + `screen_scheme` (with tabs + field-layout).
  - `Field_Configuration` + `Field_Configuration_Scheme` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::field_config` + `field_config_scheme`.
  - `Notification_Scheme` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::notification_scheme` (with event → recipient mapping).
  - `Custom_Field` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::custom_field` (with type + context + options).
  - `Sprint` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::sprint` (with state + goal + board-ref).
  - `Board` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::board` (with column-mappings + swimlanes + filter).
  - `Version` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::version` (with released-flag + release-date).
  - `Component` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::component` (with lead + assignee-type).
  - `Link_Type` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::link_type` (with inward/outward names).
  - `Comment` → `Oyatie::Community::comment` (with ADF body + visibility + reactions).
  - `Work_Log` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::work_log` (with time-spent + visibility).
  - `Filter` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::saved_filter` (with JQL → Oyatie-Query-Language transformation + subscription).
  - `Automation_Rule` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::automation_rule` (trigger-condition-action visual rule).
  - `Smart_Link` → `Oyatie::Community::smart_link` (auto-card-render).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Jira Software displacement journey):
  1. **Extract**: REST + GraphQL + JCMA export of Project + Issue + Issue_Type_Scheme + Workflow + Workflow_Scheme + Permission_Scheme + Screen + Screen_Scheme + Field_Configuration + Field_Configuration_Scheme + Notification_Scheme + Custom_Field + Sprint + Board + Version + Component + Link_Type + Comment + Work_Log + Filter + Automation_Rule + Attachment (binary).
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-project partitioned ingest; Issue_Key preserved as alias for URL-redirect; ADF body preserved with renderer-shim.
  3. **Project**: Scheme-bindings preserved (workflow + permission + notification + screen + field-config + issue-type); Permission Scheme projected as Cedar policy bundle; JQL queries transformed to Oyatie-Query-Language with semantic-preservation.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-project + per-issue-security + per-role + per-action policy with permission-scheme projection; per-project IEC-62304 + FDA-Part-11 + GDPR overlays activated where applicable.
  5. **Workflow migration**: per-workflow state-machine projected; transition conditions + validators + post-functions transformed; in-flight issues state-pinned + manual-resolution UI for mismatches.
  6. **Custom-field migration**: per-customfield context preserved; per-customfield options preserved; per-customfield value-history preserved.
  7. **Sprint/Board migration**: per-board column-status-mappings + swimlanes + quick-filters preserved; in-flight active sprints carried-over with state-pin; closed sprints preserved as historical.
  8. **JQL → OQL transformation**: per-saved-filter JQL parsed to AST + transformed to Oyatie-Query-Language; per-filter subscription preserved; per-customfield reference resolved (if customfield deleted, manual-resolve UI).
  9. **Marketplace-app inventory + replacement**: per-installed-app inventory + per-app replacement-mapping to plugin-app-store; gap-list with feature-loss-disclosure; Forge apps re-deploy on Oyatie runtime; apps OAuth re-grant.
  10. **Automation-rule migration**: per-rule trigger-condition-action transformed to workflow-studio rule; smart-values resolved; in-flight runs paused + drained pre-cutover.
  11. **Issue-link + Smart-link rebind**: per-link historical-redirect with single-hop guarantee; per-Smart-Link external-URL → auto-card-render rebound.
  12. **Attachment migration**: per-attachment binary moved to object-store; per-attachment hash-pin + virus-scan re-run.
  13. **Parallel run**: 60-day shadow with sample sprint cycle + per-customfield-write parity + per-transition parity + per-JQL-execution parity ≥ 99.9%.
  14. **Cutover**: per-project cut-over with Issue-Key URL-redirect for 24 months; per-board / per-roadmap URL-redirect; per-Webhook URL re-register.
  15. **Sunset**: Jira license sunset with issue-history retention per tenant policy (typically 7 years for regulated tenants; indefinite for non-regulated).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Issue-link redirect-loop on key-rename** (PROJ-123 renamed to NEWPROJ-456 via project-key change): per-key historical-redirect with single-hop guarantee + cycle-detection on redirect-chain.
  - **Workflow-state migration mid-issue** (in-progress issue with state not in new scheme): per-issue state-mapping with manual-resolution UI + Cedar gate on auto-transition.
  - **Per-Marketplace-app gap** (app exists in Jira but not in plugin-app-store): per-app replacement-mapping or feature-loss-disclosure + Forge-app re-deploy where possible.
  - **JQL custom-field-reference break** (JQL referencing field that no longer exists): per-query field-resolution + saved-filter migration + auto-substitution with placeholder + manual-fix tracker.
  - **Epic-children orphan on cross-project move** (epic moved to new project but children stay): per-move parent-child link preservation + audit + cascade-move-with-confirm.
  - **Subtask parent-cycle** (subtask attached to subtask): per-issue write-time hierarchy-validation + cycle-rejection.
  - **Permission-scheme rollup ambiguity** (per-project + per-issue-security + per-role variants conflict): per-effective-permission computation at access + audit on every access.
  - **Sprint mid-flight reorg** (sprint started, issues added/removed by non-scrum-master): per-sprint Cedar-gate + audit on modification.
  - **Story-points scale-mismatch on cross-team migration** (team-A uses Fibonacci 1-2-3-5-8; team-B uses linear 1-2-3-4-5): per-team scale-preserve + conversion-disclosure on cross-team-rollup.
  - **Automation-rule recursion** (rule firing rule firing rule): per-rule depth-cap + cycle detection + circuit-breaker.
  - **Attachment-virus-scan miss** (legacy attachment uploaded pre-scan-policy): per-attachment re-scan on migration + quarantine on hit.
  - **ADF rendering break** (legacy ADF version not rendering in new viewer): per-ADF version-pin + renderer-shim + plain-text-fallback.
  - **Smart-Link external-URL leak** (URL with auth-token cached in card): per-URL token-scrub + refresh-on-render.
  - **Bulk-edit out-of-undo-window** (5000-issue bulk-edit, mistake found day 8): per-bulk-edit extended-audit + manual-rollback UI.
  - **Cross-project dependency orphan** (epic A in PROJ-1 depends on epic B in PROJ-2; PROJ-2 archived): per-dependency archived-detect + alert + manual-resolve.
  - **Audit-log staleness** (audit-log ingestion lag during high-write): per-tenant audit-log SLA + alert on lag.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — JCMA (Jira Cloud Migration Assistant) + REST API v3 + GraphQL + Webhooks-for-test + Forge-app exports; format — JSON / XML / ADF; duration — ~24-48 hours per 500k issues + 50k sprints + 500 boards + 500 workflows + 1k custom-fields + 5M comments + 1M work-logs + 500k attachments; bandwidth — heavy on attachments.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Issue_Key preserved as alias; scheme-bindings preserved (workflow + permission + notification + screen + field-config + issue-type); Permission Scheme projected as Cedar policy bundle; JQL → OQL transformation with semantic-preservation; lossy — Atlassian Intelligence AI features rebuilt natively; some Marketplace-apps no replacement (gap-list).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-project cut-over with Issue-Key URL-redirect for 24 months; per-board / per-roadmap URL-redirect; per-Webhook URL re-register; per-Marketplace-app rebind or replacement; per-Automation-rule re-enable post-validation.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-day shadow with sample sprint cycle + per-customfield-write parity + per-transition parity + per-JQL-execution parity ≥ 99.9% + per-Automation-rule-fire parity ≥ 99% + per-Webhook delivery parity 100%; sunset — Jira license sunset with issue-history retention per tenant policy (7 years regulated; indefinite non-regulated); per-project URL-redirect through 24-month post-cutover.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Jira Core → **Bronze**; Jira Pro → **Silver**; Jira Enterprise → **Gold**; Jira Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `workflow-engine` (with agile capability tier) is canonical; `jira-software` is benchmark alias.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-035 - Jira Service Management
- Vendor name and category: Atlassian Jira Service Management (JSM, formerly Jira Service Desk) / Atlassian ecosystem / ITSM (IT Service Management, ITIL v4-aligned) + Customer-Service Portal + Service-Project + Request-Type + Queue + SLA Goals + Approval Steps + Forms (Atlassian Forms) + Customer Portal vs Agent View + Assets (formerly Insight CMDB) + Asset Schema + Asset Relationships + Incident Management + Major-Incident + Problem Management + Change Management (Change Advisory Board + Approval Routing) + Knowledge Base (Confluence-backed) + Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) + Conversational Ticketing (Slack / MS-Teams) + Atlassian Intelligence (intent-detect + agent-assist) + Statuspage integration.
- Coverage tier: D (microservice: `itsm` JSM tier). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: ITSM Core (Ticket + Queue + Request-Type + SLA + Customer-Portal + Agent-View) → **Bronze**; ITSM Pro (with Approval Steps + Forms + KB-Integration + Canned Responses + Automation + Incident + CSAT) → **Silver**; ITSM Enterprise (with Assets/CMDB + Asset Relationships + Problem + Change + Major-Incident + Statuspage + Service-Catalog) → **Gold**; ITSM Enterprise Plus (with Intent-Detect AI + Agent-Assist + Virtual Agent + Auto-Triage + per-region Data Residency + ITIL-Audit-Trail) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `itsm` (ticket + queue + SLA + request-type + canned-response + automation + incident + problem + change); `community` (customer portal — branded self-service); `workflow-engine` (request-type workflow + approval-step routing); `intelligence` (intent-detection + agent-assist + virtual-agent + auto-triage); `service-catalog` (Assets/CMDB analog — service + asset + relationship); `wiki` (knowledge-base integration per D-036 Confluence); `incident-management` (Major-Incident + Statuspage + war-room); `apigw` (REST + Webhook + conversational-ticketing).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (JSM object model):
  - `Service_Project` (Project_Key {HELP}, Project_ID, Project_Type {IT-Service-Management / Customer-Service-Management / HR-Service / Legal-Service / Facilities-Service / Custom-Service}, Service_Project_Lead, Project_Category, Portal_URL, Portal_Branding, Request_Type_Refs[], Queue_Refs[], SLA_Refs[], Permission_Scheme_Ref, Notification_Scheme_Ref, Approval_Configuration_Ref).
  - `Request_Type` (Type_ID, Name, Description, Icon, Issue_Type_Reference, Service_Project_Reference, Portal_Group {Help / Order / IT / HR / etc.}, Fields[per-field {Field_Type / Required / Help-Text / Default-Value / Validation}], Workflow_Reference, Customer_Visible: bool).
  - `Customer` (Customer_ID, Email, Display_Name, Account_Type {Internal / External / Anonymous}, Organization_References[], Portal_Login_Method {Atlassian-Account / SSO / Email-Magic-Link}).
  - `Organization` (Org_ID, Name, Customers[], Service_Projects_Granted[]).
  - `Ticket` (Issue extending Jira Issue model with JSM-specific fields; Ticket_ID inherits Issue_Key {HELP-123}, Request_Type_Reference, Reporter_Customer_Reference, Approval_Steps[], SLA_Snapshots[], Linked_Assets[], Linked_Changes[], Linked_Incidents[], Service_Project_Reference, Queue_Memberships[], Resolution_Reference, Resolution_Notes).
  - `Queue` (Queue_ID, Name, Service_Project_Reference, JQL_Filter, Order_By, Columns_Displayed[], Default_Assignee_Strategy {Round-Robin / Load-Balance / Skill-Match / Manual}).
  - `SLA_Goal` (SLA_ID, Name, Service_Project_Reference, Goal_Definition[Per-Priority → Target_Duration / Business_Calendar / Pause_Conditions / Start_Conditions / Stop_Conditions]).
  - `Business_Calendar` (Calendar_ID, Time_Zone, Working_Days[], Working_Hours_Per_Day, Holidays[], Per-Region-Calendar-Reference).
  - `SLA_Snapshot` (per-Ticket per-SLA; Goal_Reference, Start_Time, Pause_Periods[], Stop_Time, Elapsed_Working_Time, Remaining_Time, Breach_Status {Within / Breached / Approaching-Breach}).
  - `Approval_Step` (Step_ID, Ticket_Reference, Approvers[], Decision {Pending / Approved / Declined / Withdrawn}, Decision_Date, Approver_Source {Reporter-Manager / Field-Value / Role / Custom-Plugin}, Approval_Type {Any-Approver / Majority / All-Approvers}).
  - `Form` (Atlassian Forms; Form_ID, Service_Project_Reference, Fields[], Conditional_Logic_Rules, Submitted_Data_Mapping).
  - `Asset` (Asset_ID, Asset_Schema_Reference, Asset_Type_Reference, Attributes_Per_Type[], External_System_Reference (for imported assets), Status {Active / Retired / Lost / Stolen / Repair}, Owner_Reference, Location_Reference, Parent_Asset_Reference (for sub-assets)).
  - `Asset_Schema` (Schema_ID, Name, Description, Asset_Type_Refs[], Reference_Type_Refs[]).
  - `Asset_Type` (Type_ID, Schema_Reference, Name, Attributes[Attribute_Name / Type {String / Integer / Reference / Date / Boolean / URL / IP-Address / Group / User / Custom} / Required / Default]).
  - `Asset_Reference_Type` (Reference_ID, From_Type, To_Type, Reference_Name, Cardinality {One-to-One / One-to-Many / Many-to-Many}).
  - `Asset_Relationship` (Relationship_ID, From_Asset, To_Asset, Reference_Type, Created_Date).
  - `Canned_Response` (Response_ID, Title, Body, Owner, Shared_With, Tags, Per-Customer-Variable-Refs).
  - `Automation_Rule` (extending Jira Automation with JSM-triggers — request-created / SLA-approaching-breach / customer-replied / approval-decision / asset-state-change).
  - `CSAT_Survey` (Survey_ID, Ticket_Reference, Sent_Date, Response_Date, Rating, Feedback, Sentiment_Score).
  - `Major_Incident` (Incident_ID, Severity_Tier {SEV-1 / SEV-2 / SEV-3 / SEV-4}, Status, War_Room_Reference, Incident_Commander, Communicator, Affected_Services[], Statuspage_Component_References[], Post_Mortem_Reference).
  - `Change_Request` (Change_ID, Type {Standard / Normal / Emergency}, Risk_Score, CAB_Approvers[], Implementation_Window, Backout_Plan, Linked_Assets[], Linked_Incidents_Resolved[]).
  - `Conversation_Channel` (Slack-Channel-ID / MS-Teams-Channel-ID, Bot_Token, Service_Project_Routing).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST API v3: extends Jira REST + `/rest/servicedeskapi/request` + `/servicedesk/{id}/queue` + `/servicedesk/{id}/requesttype` + `/servicedesk/sla` + `/assets/workspace/{id}/v1/object`.
  - Assets REST: `/jsm/assets/workspace/{workspaceId}/v1/object` + `/objectschema` + `/objecttype`.
  - Forms API: per-Form schema-fetch + submission-fetch.
  - Webhooks: per-event (request-created / status-changed / SLA-breached / approval-decision / asset-state-change / customer-replied).
  - Conversational-Ticketing API: Slack / MS-Teams bot integration.
  - Atlassian Intelligence API: intent-detect + auto-categorize + agent-assist suggestions.
  - SCIM 2.0 + SAML SSO via Atlassian Access.
  - Statuspage API: per-component status-update.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Customer Portal" — branded self-service portal with request-type catalog + KB-search + ticket-status + organization-shared-tickets; mobile-primary.
  - "Agent View" — desktop queue-and-ticket with column-customization + bulk-action + SLA-clock + customer-context.
  - "Queue" — JQL-filtered ticket-list with default assignee strategy.
  - "Request-Type Builder" — visual form-builder with field-types + conditional logic + workflow-binding.
  - "SLA Visual Configurator" — per-priority goal + business-calendar + start/pause/stop conditions.
  - "Approval Step Inline" — in-ticket approval-action with one-click approve/decline + signature.
  - "Assets Explorer" — graph view of asset-schema with relationships + filter + bulk-edit.
  - "Asset Card" — per-asset 360 with attributes + relationships + linked-tickets + owner + location.
  - "Major-Incident War Room" — live-view with severity + commander + comms + affected-services + Statuspage-sync.
  - "Change Calendar" — implementation-window timeline with conflict-detect.
  - "Knowledge Base Browser" — embedded Confluence (or native) with search + auto-suggest on ticket-create.
  - "CSAT Tile" — post-resolve survey with sentiment-analysis.
  - "Conversational Ticket via Slack/Teams" — bot-driven ticket-create + status-check + reply-from-channel.
  - "Statuspage Component Status" — embedded status-page editor.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<agent-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"JsmCreateTicket", Oyatie::Action::"JsmTransitionTicket",
      Oyatie::Action::"JsmAssignToQueue", Oyatie::Action::"JsmEscalate",
      Oyatie::Action::"JsmLinkToChange", Oyatie::Action::"JsmLinkToAsset",
      Oyatie::Action::"JsmRunAutomation", Oyatie::Action::"JsmAttachCannedResponse",
      Oyatie::Action::"JsmRunSlaCheck", Oyatie::Action::"JsmRunAssetReconciliation",
      Oyatie::Action::"JsmMarkAsIncident", Oyatie::Action::"JsmDeclareMajorIncident",
      Oyatie::Action::"JsmCsatSurveyEmit", Oyatie::Action::"JsmApproveStep",
      Oyatie::Action::"JsmEditFormSchema", Oyatie::Action::"JsmEditAssetSchema",
      Oyatie::Action::"JsmRespondAsCustomer"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Ticket::"<ticket-key>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    permission_scheme_grants(principal, action, resource.service_project) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"JsmCreateTicket" ? (principal.is_customer_of(resource.service_project) || principal.has_role("Agent")) && request_type_visible_to(principal, resource.request_type) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"JsmAssignToQueue" ? principal.has_role("Agent") && queue_visible_to(principal, context.queue) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"JsmEscalate" ? escalation_path_valid(resource, context.escalation_tier) && !already_at_top_tier(resource) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"JsmDeclareMajorIncident" ? principal.has_role("IncidentCommander") || principal.has_role("OnCallEngineer") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"JsmApproveStep" ? approver_in_approval_step(principal, context.step) && !already_approved_by(principal, context.step) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"JsmLinkToChange" ? context.change.implementation_window_includes(context.now) || context.change.type == "Emergency" : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"JsmCsatSurveyEmit" ? !survey_cooldown_active(resource.reporter, context.cooldown_days) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"JsmRunAutomation" ? automation_depth_under_cap(context.depth) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"JsmRespondAsCustomer" ? principal == resource.reporter || principal.in_same_organization_as(resource.reporter) : true) &&
    (resource.has_pii && resource.customer.jurisdiction == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") : true) &&
    (resource.service_project.is_healthcare ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") : true) &&
    (resource.service_project.is_federal ? context.pack.contains("FedRAMP") : true) &&
    sla_paused_correctly_during_customer_wait(resource) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Service_Project` → `Oyatie::Itsm::service_project` (with portal-branding + request-type-refs).
  - `Request_Type` → `Oyatie::Itsm::request_type` (with portal-group + workflow-ref + customer-visible flag).
  - `Customer` → `Oyatie::Identity::customer_principal` (with portal-login-method).
  - `Organization` → `Oyatie::Itsm::organization` (with customer-list + service-project-grants).
  - `Ticket` → `Oyatie::Itsm::ticket` (extends `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::issue` from D-034 with JSM fields).
  - `Queue` → `Oyatie::Itsm::queue` (with JQL → OQL + default-assignee strategy).
  - `SLA_Goal` + `SLA_Snapshot` → `Oyatie::Itsm::sla_goal` + `sla_snapshot` (with business-calendar + pause-conditions).
  - `Business_Calendar` → `Oyatie::Itsm::business_calendar` (with time-zone + working-hours + holidays).
  - `Approval_Step` → `Oyatie::Itsm::approval_step` (with approver-source + approval-type).
  - `Form` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::form` (with conditional-logic + submitted-data-mapping).
  - `Asset` → `Oyatie::ServiceCatalog::asset` (with asset-type + attributes + external-system-ref).
  - `Asset_Schema` + `Asset_Type` + `Asset_Reference_Type` → `Oyatie::ServiceCatalog::asset_schema` + `asset_type` + `reference_type`.
  - `Asset_Relationship` → `Oyatie::ServiceCatalog::asset_relationship`.
  - `Canned_Response` → `Oyatie::Itsm::canned_response` (with per-customer variable-refs).
  - `Automation_Rule` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::automation_rule` (extending D-034 automation).
  - `CSAT_Survey` → `Oyatie::Itsm::csat_survey` (with sentiment-score).
  - `Major_Incident` → `Oyatie::IncidentManagement::major_incident` (with severity + war-room + Statuspage refs).
  - `Change_Request` → `Oyatie::Itsm::change_request` (with type + risk-score + CAB-approvers + backout-plan).
  - `Conversation_Channel` → `Oyatie::Community::conversational_channel` (Slack/Teams routing).

- **Specific workflow steps** (JSM displacement journey):
  1. **Extract**: REST + Assets-REST + Forms-API + JCMA export of Service_Project + Request_Type + Customer + Organization + Ticket + Queue + SLA_Goal + Business_Calendar + SLA_Snapshot + Approval_Step + Form + Asset (+ Schema + Type + Reference + Relationship) + Canned_Response + Automation_Rule + CSAT_Survey + Major_Incident + Change_Request + Conversation_Channel.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-service-project partitioned ingest; per-customer PII classification; per-Asset external-system-reference preserved.
  3. **Project**: Ticket inherits from Issue (D-034 base); Asset/Schema/Type/Reference graph preserved; SLA business-calendar preserved per region.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-service-project + per-customer + per-organization + per-role + per-action policy; SLA-pause-during-customer-wait gate; per-jurisdiction GDPR + HIPAA + FedRAMP packs activated.
  5. **Portal branding migration**: per-portal CSS + logo + theme + custom-HTML preserved; per-locale text preserved; URL-redirect from `/servicedesk/customer/portal/{id}` to Oyatie portal-URL.
  6. **SLA-clock migration**: per-SLA business-calendar pinned at extract-time; per-snapshot elapsed-time + pause-history preserved; mid-flight SLA-clocks state-pinned + replayed on parallel-run.
  7. **Assets/CMDB migration**: per-schema field-mapping + validation; per-asset external-system-reference rebound; per-relationship cardinality preserved.
  8. **Approval-step migration**: per-step approver-source preserved (reporter-manager / field-value / role / custom-plugin); in-flight approvals state-pinned + carried-over.
  9. **Form schema migration**: per-form fields + conditional-logic preserved; submitted-data-mapping preserved.
  10. **Automation-rule migration**: per-rule trigger-condition-action transformed (extending D-034 path); JSM-specific triggers (SLA-approaching-breach, customer-replied, approval-decision, asset-state-change) preserved.
  11. **Canned-response migration**: per-response per-customer-variable-refs resolved; per-tenant template-shareability preserved.
  12. **Major-Incident integration rebind**: Statuspage connector OAuth re-grant + per-component mapping preserved; war-room Slack/Teams channel-link preserved.
  13. **Conversational-ticketing rebind**: Slack/MS-Teams bot OAuth re-grant + per-channel routing preserved.
  14. **Atlassian Intelligence retrain**: per-tenant intent-detect + auto-categorize + agent-assist model retrained on historical ticket-data; EU-AI-Act overlay activated.
  15. **Parallel run**: 60-day shadow with sample queue + per-SLA-clock parity + per-approval-step parity + per-asset-state-change parity + per-CSAT-survey-emit parity ≥ 99.9%.
  16. **Cutover**: per-queue cut-over with customer-portal URL-redirect for 24 months; per-Webhook URL re-register; per-Marketplace-app rebind.
  17. **Sunset**: JSM sunset with ticket-history retention per tenant policy + Asset-history retention per ITIL audit (7 years for ITGC); customer-data per GDPR / KR-PIPA retention.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **SLA-clock business-calendar drift** (calendar changed mid-ticket — e.g., new holiday added): per-SLA calendar-pin at ticket-create + replay + variance-disclosure.
  - **Assets/Insight asset-schema mismatch on cut-over** (schema-field renamed or type-changed): per-schema field-mapping + validation + per-asset migration-error report.
  - **Portal-CSS-customization break on new shell**: per-portal theme-export + style-shim + responsive-layout test + per-locale rendering check.
  - **Automation-rule recursion** (rule firing rule firing rule): per-rule depth-cap + cycle detection + circuit-breaker (shared with D-034).
  - **CSAT survey-spam on bulk-close** (1000 tickets closed at once, 1000 CSAT emails sent): per-customer survey-cooldown window + bulk-emit rate-limit + opt-out tracking.
  - **SLA-pause-during-customer-wait misconfigure** (clock kept running while waiting on customer): per-SLA pause-condition Cedar-gate + audit on pause/resume.
  - **Approval-step approver-orphan** (approver left org mid-flight): per-step delegation-fallback + auto-reroute to manager + skip-after-N-days with rationale.
  - **Major-Incident Statuspage-sync drift** (incident updated in JSM but not pushed to Statuspage): per-incident outbox + retry + manual-resync UI.
  - **Asset-relationship cycle** (CMDB graph cycle — asset A depends on B depends on A): per-relationship write-time topological-sort + cycle-rejection.
  - **Knowledge-base attached but not visible to customer** (KB-article restricted, but auto-suggested on portal): per-KB-article portal-visibility-pre-suggest gate.
  - **Conversational-channel context-leak** (Slack-message in public channel inadvertently posts confidential ticket): per-channel privacy-pin + ticket-create-channel-validation.
  - **Anonymous-portal-submission abuse** (spam tickets from anonymous email): per-tenant CAPTCHA + rate-limit + auto-spam-filter.
  - **Change-Request implementation-window collision** (two Changes overlap window): per-change implementation-window-graph + conflict-detect + CAB-review-on-conflict.
  - **Forms conditional-logic break** (field-dependency mid-fill): per-form state-preserve + partial-save + resumable-link.
  - **Per-Marketplace-app gap** (JSM app no replacement in plugin-app-store): per-app replacement-mapping + feature-loss-disclosure.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — REST + Assets-REST + Forms-API + JCMA + Statuspage-API + Atlassian Intelligence-API; format — JSON / XML; duration — ~24-48 hours per 500k tickets + 100k assets + 1k request-types + 500 queues + 200 SLAs + 5k canned-responses + 50 Major-Incidents (over 5y); bandwidth — moderate.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Ticket inherits Issue base from D-034 with JSM-specific extensions; Asset/Schema/Type/Reference graph preserved; SLA business-calendar preserved per-region; lossy — Atlassian Intelligence rebuilt natively; some Marketplace-apps no replacement (gap-list).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-queue cut-over with customer-portal URL-redirect for 24 months; per-Webhook URL re-register; per-Marketplace-app rebind; Statuspage cutover at next quiet-period (no active incidents).
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-day shadow with sample queue + per-SLA-clock parity + per-approval-step parity + per-asset-state-change parity + per-CSAT-survey-emit parity ≥ 99.9% + portal-render parity 100% across locales + Major-Incident-to-Statuspage parity 100%; sunset — JSM sunset with ticket-history retention per tenant policy + Asset-history per ITIL audit (7y ITGC); customer-data per GDPR / KR-PIPA retention.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: ITSM Core → **Bronze**; ITSM Pro → **Silver**; ITSM Enterprise → **Gold**; ITSM Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `itsm` + `community` are canonical; `jira-service-management` and `jsm` are benchmark aliases.
