### Section D-036 - Confluence
- Vendor name and category: Atlassian Confluence (Cloud + Data Center) / Atlassian ecosystem / team wiki + documentation + knowledge management — Space + Page hierarchy (Page Tree) + Template + Blueprint + Macros + Inline Comments + Page Restrictions (per-page + inherited from space) + Page Tree + Labels + Spaces (Site / Personal / Team) + Whiteboards + Databases (newer feature, table-with-relations) + Smart-Links + Mentions + Page Watch (subscribe) + Drafts + Auto-Suggest (Atlassian Intelligence) + Confluence Cloud Migration Assistant (CCMA) + Atlassian Marketplace apps + Forge / macro framework.
- Coverage tier: A (already covered: `wiki` + `community` + `drive` + capability tier on `learning-management`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Wiki Core (Space + Page + Tree + Comment + Attachment + Label) → **Bronze**; Wiki Pro (with Templates + Blueprints + Inline Comments + Macros + Page Restrictions + Page Watch + Mentions) → **Silver**; Wiki Enterprise (with Whiteboards + Databases + Smart-Links + AI-Summary + Cross-Space Search + Archive Cadence) → **Gold**; Wiki Enterprise Plus (with FDA-Part-11 e-sign on SOP + ITAR space-scoping + Audit-Log + Atlassian Intelligence + Knowledge-Graph) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `wiki` (page + space + tree + version-tree + template + blueprint); `drive` (attachments + asset versions + binary storage); `community` (comment + inline-comment + reaction + page-watch + mention); `intelligence` (semantic search + AI-summary + auto-tag + related-page recommend); `plugin-app-store` (macro + Confluence-app analog per ADR-0249); `whiteboard` (Confluence Whiteboards analog — interactive surface); `database` (Confluence Databases analog — when more table-of-records than free-form-page).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Confluence object model):
  - `Space` (Space_Key {DOCS}, Space_ID, Space_Name, Description, Space_Type {Global / Personal / Team / Knowledge-Base / Project-Bound}, Status {Current / Archived}, Default_Permission_Refs[], Homepage_Page_Reference, Sidebar_Customization, Color_Scheme, Logo_Reference).
  - `Page` (Page_ID, Space_Reference, Title, Body (Confluence Storage Format — XML-based; or ADF — Atlassian Document Format), Parent_Page_Reference (for tree), Status {Current / Draft / Trashed / Historical}, Version_Number, Created_Date, Created_By, Last_Modified, Last_Modified_By, Restrictions_Per_Mode {View / Edit → Allowed_Users[] / Allowed_Groups[]}, Labels[], Watchers[], Children_Pages[], Position_Order_In_Parent, Editor_Mode {Old / Fabric / Markdown}).
  - `Page_Version` (Version_ID, Page_Reference, Version_Number, Created_Date, Created_By, Changed_Body, Diff_From_Previous, Minor_Edit: bool, Restoration_Allowed: bool).
  - `Template` (Template_ID, Space_Reference (or Global), Name, Description, Body, Mandatory_Fields[], Variable_Placeholders[]).
  - `Blueprint` (Blueprint_ID — system-defined; Examples: Decision / Meeting-Notes / Product-Requirements / How-To / Retrospective / Project-Plan; Pre-Filled-Content, Pre-Linked-Macros, Wizard-Steps).
  - `Macro_Instance` (Macro_ID, Page_Reference, Macro_Name {Code / Status / Info-Panel / Note-Panel / Warning-Panel / Children-Display / Page-Tree / Table-of-Contents / Jira-Issue / Lucidchart / Draw-io / Confluence-Database-Embed / Live-Search / Excerpt / Include / Roadmap / Gallery / Custom-Plugin}, Parameters[], Body (for body-macros)).
  - `Comment` (Comment_ID, Page_Reference, Author, Body, Created, Reply_To (for threaded), Resolved: bool (for inline)).
  - `Inline_Comment` (Comment with selection-anchor; Anchor_Text_Hash, Selection_Range_Start, Selection_Range_End, Highlighting-Color).
  - `Attachment` (Attachment_ID, Page_Reference, File_Name, MIME_Type, Size_Bytes, Storage_Reference, Version_Number, Uploaded_Date, Uploaded_By, Comment).
  - `Label` (Label_Name, Owner (when personal), Applied_To[Pages] + Applied_To[Attachments]).
  - `Restriction` (Restriction_ID, Resource_Reference {Page / Space}, Mode {View / Edit}, Allowed_Principals[Users / Groups], Inherited_From_Parent: bool).
  - `Whiteboard` (Whiteboard_ID, Space_Reference, Title, Created_Date, Last_Edit, Content_Snapshot, Collaborators[], Comment_Threads[]).
  - `Database` (Database_ID, Space_Reference, Schema_Definition[Columns[]], Rows[], Views[Grid / Board / Calendar / Gallery / Timeline]).
  - `Smart_Link` (URL → Auto-Card or Inline-Render).
  - `Page_Properties` (per-Page key-value metadata; used with Page-Properties-Report macro for cross-page aggregation).
  - `Likes_Reactions` (Page / Comment → Reactor → Reaction-Type {Like / Heart / Thumbs-Up / Custom-Emoji}).
  - `Page_Watch` (Watcher → Page-or-Space → Cadence {Real-Time / Daily / Weekly}).
  - `Audit_Log_Entry` (Action, Actor, Target, Timestamp, IP, User-Agent).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST API v2: `https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki/api/v2/pages/{pageId}` + `/spaces` + `/spaces/{id}/pages` + `/blogposts` + `/labels` + `/attachments`.
  - REST API v1 (legacy): `/rest/api/content` + `/space` + `/user` + `/template` + `/longtask` (for export jobs).
  - Atlassian Document Format (ADF): JSON-based rich-content schema.
  - Confluence Storage Format (legacy): XML-based content (for older pages and macros).
  - Forge macros (newer): manifest-based with sandboxed JS runtime.
  - macros (legacy): JWT-authenticated iframe.
  - CCMA (Confluence Cloud Migration Assistant): bulk export/import.
  - Webhooks: per-event (page-created / updated / archived / restored / commented / liked / restriction-changed).
  - SCIM 2.0 + SAML SSO via Atlassian Access.
  - Audit Log API: per-tenant change-log feed.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Page Editor" — fabric editor (rich-text) with slash-commands + macros + inline-comment + suggestion-mode + auto-save + collaborative-cursors.
  - "Page Tree" — sidebar with hierarchy of pages within a space; drag-drop reorder.
  - "Space Sidebar" — per-space navigation with shortcuts + recent + pages + blueprints.
  - "Templates Picker" — choose-template on page-create with mandatory-fields wizard.
  - "Inline Comment" — text-selection + comment-icon → comment-thread anchored to selection; resolve-on-fix.
  - "Page History / Version Diff" — version-list with side-by-side diff + restore.
  - "Page Restrictions Dialog" — per-page View / Edit restrictions with inherited-from-parent flag.
  - "Macros Browser" — searchable macro-catalog with preview.
  - "Whiteboards" — collaborative free-form drawing surface.
  - "Databases" — table-with-relations + multi-view (grid / board / calendar / gallery / timeline).
  - "Smart-Link Auto-Card" — paste URL renders inline-card with title + status (Jira-issue, Bitbucket-PR, Figma-file, etc.).
  - "Mentions" — @-user inline with notification.
  - "Page Watch" — subscribe to changes with email/in-app cadence.
  - "Search" — full-text + semantic with filter-by-space / label / contributor / date.
  - "Atlassian Intelligence" — AI-summarize-page + auto-tag + question-answering.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<author-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"WikiCreatePage", Oyatie::Action::"WikiEditPage",
      Oyatie::Action::"WikiPublishPage", Oyatie::Action::"WikiRestrictPage",
      Oyatie::Action::"WikiMovePage", Oyatie::Action::"WikiCopyPage",
      Oyatie::Action::"WikiArchivePage", Oyatie::Action::"WikiRestorePage",
      Oyatie::Action::"WikiComment", Oyatie::Action::"WikiReact",
      Oyatie::Action::"WikiMention", Oyatie::Action::"WikiLinkFrom",
      Oyatie::Action::"WikiAttachFile", Oyatie::Action::"WikiRunMacro",
      Oyatie::Action::"WikiWatchPage", Oyatie::Action::"WikiRequestAccess",
      Oyatie::Action::"WikiEsignSop", Oyatie::Action::"WikiExportSpace"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Page::"<page-id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    restriction_allows(principal, action, resource) &&
    space_permission_allows(principal, action, resource.space) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"WikiCreatePage" ? space_permission_grants(principal, "create-page", resource.space) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"WikiEditPage" ? !page_locked_for_legal_hold(resource) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"WikiRestrictPage" ? principal.has_role("SpaceAdmin") || principal.created_page(resource) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"WikiMovePage" ? destination_space_allows(principal, context.destination_space) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"WikiArchivePage" ? !page_referenced_by_active_links(resource) || context.cascade_link_redirect_acknowledged : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"WikiAttachFile" ? !attachment_exceeds_size_limit(context.attachment, principal.tenant.attachment_max_mb) && virus_scan_clean(context.attachment) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"WikiRunMacro" ? macro_authorized_in_space(context.macro, resource.space) && macro_app_security_reviewed(context.macro) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"WikiEsignSop" ? resource.is_sop && context.pack.contains("FDA-Part-11") && esign_witness_attested(context.esign) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"WikiExportSpace" ? principal.has_role("SpaceAdmin") && data_residency_compliant_export(context.destination) : true) &&
    (resource.space.contains_itar_content && action.touches_content ? context.pack.contains("ITAR") && principal.itar_authorized : true) &&
    (resource.space.is_personal ? principal == resource.space.owner : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Space` → `Oyatie::Wiki::space` (with type + sidebar + branding + homepage-ref).
  - `Page` → `Oyatie::Wiki::page` (with parent-ref + version-number + restrictions + watchers).
  - `Page_Version` → `Oyatie::Wiki::page_version` (with diff-from-previous + restoration-allowed).
  - `Template` → `Oyatie::Wiki::template` (with mandatory-fields + variable-placeholders).
  - `Blueprint` → `Oyatie::Wiki::blueprint` (with pre-filled-content + wizard-steps).
  - `Macro_Instance` → `Oyatie::Wiki::macro_instance` (with macro-name + parameters; mapped to plugin-app-store macro per ADR-0249).
  - `Comment` + `Inline_Comment` → `Oyatie::Community::page_comment` + `inline_comment` (with selection-anchor + resolved-flag).
  - `Attachment` → `Oyatie::Drive::attachment` (cross-link to drive µservice with version + storage-ref).
  - `Label` → `Oyatie::Wiki::label` (with applied-to multi-target).
  - `Restriction` → `Oyatie::Cedar::page_restriction` (projected as Cedar policy fragments per ADR-0243).
  - `Whiteboard` → `Oyatie::Whiteboard::board` (cross-link to whiteboard µservice when interactive).
  - `Database` → `Oyatie::Database::wiki_database` (cross-link to database µservice for table-of-records).
  - `Smart_Link` → `Oyatie::Community::smart_link` (auto-card-render).
  - `Page_Properties` → `Oyatie::Wiki::page_properties` (key-value metadata for aggregation).
  - `Likes_Reactions` → `Oyatie::Community::reaction`.
  - `Page_Watch` → `Oyatie::Wiki::page_watch` (with cadence).
  - `Audit_Log_Entry` → `Oyatie::AuditTrail::audit_log_entry` (per ADR-0247).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Confluence displacement journey):
  1. **Extract**: REST v2 + REST v1 + CCMA + per-Forge-app + per-Connect-app exports of Space + Page + Page_Version (full tree) + Template + Blueprint + Macro_Instance + Comment + Inline_Comment + Attachment + Label + Restriction + Whiteboard + Database + Smart_Link + Page_Properties + Likes_Reactions + Page_Watch + Audit_Log_Entry.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-space partitioned ingest; per-page Confluence Storage Format → ADF transformation pre-flight; per-attachment binary moved to drive object-store.
  3. **Project**: Page-tree hierarchy preserved; per-page version-tree preserved with diff + restoration-allowed; restrictions projected as Cedar policy fragments; per-macro mapped to plugin-app-store entry; Whiteboards → whiteboard µservice; Databases → database µservice.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-space + per-page + per-restriction + per-role + per-action policy; FDA-Part-11 e-sign on SOP pages; ITAR space-scoping; per-jurisdiction GDPR / KR-PIPA / data-residency packs activated.
  5. **Page-version-tree migration**: per-page version-tier strategy (full / snapshot / delta) with archival for pages > 1000 versions; restoration-allowed preserved.
  6. **Template + Blueprint migration**: per-template mandatory-fields + variable-placeholders preserved; system-blueprints rebuilt natively; custom-blueprints preserved.
  7. **Macro migration**: per-Marketplace-macro inventory + replacement-mapping to plugin-app-store; gap-list with manual-rewrite tracker; Forge macros re-deploy on Oyatie runtime; macros OAuth re-grant; legacy storage-format macros transformed to ADF.
  8. **Inline-comment migration**: per-comment selection-anchor + resolved-flag preserved; anchor-text-hash recomputed against new-body for drift-detect.
  9. **Whiteboard migration**: per-whiteboard content-snapshot exported (where format permits) → whiteboard µservice with format-shim; legacy non-interactive whiteboards rendered as page-attachments.
  10. **Database migration**: per-database schema + rows + views preserved → database µservice; view-types preserved.
  11. **Attachment migration**: per-attachment binary moved to drive object-store with content-hash dedupe; per-attachment version preserved; virus-scan re-run.
  12. **Smart-Link rebind**: per-Smart-Link external-URL → auto-card-render rebound (Jira-issue per D-034, Bitbucket-PR per D-037, etc.).
  13. **Page-watch + reactions migration**: per-watcher cadence + per-reaction preserved.
  14. **Atlassian Intelligence retrain**: per-tenant semantic-search index rebuilt + AI-summary model retrained; EU-AI-Act overlay.
  15. **Parallel run**: 60-day shadow with sample space + per-page edit-cycle + per-restriction enforcement + per-macro-render parity + per-comment-thread parity ≥ 99.9%.
  16. **Cutover**: per-space cut-over with URL-redirect on page-id for 24 months; per-Webhook URL re-register; per-Marketplace-macro rebind or replacement.
  17. **Sunset**: Confluence license sunset with page-history retention per tenant policy (typically 7 years for regulated SOPs; indefinite for general knowledge); Audit-log retention per ITGC 7y.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Page-version-tree depth-explosion** (10k+ versions on a single page from frequent edits): per-page version-tier (full / snapshot / delta) with archival; full-version every Nth + delta in between.
  - **Restriction-rollup ambiguity** (page + space + parent-page rules conflict): per-effective-permission computation + audit on each access + restriction-visualizer UI.
  - **Macro-deprecation** (legacy macro no replacement in plugin-app-store): per-macro feature-loss-disclosure + manual-rewrite tracker + fallback-render-as-placeholder.
  - **Cross-space-link-rot on space-rename** (DOCS-1 → NEWDOCS-1): per-link historical-redirect + single-hop guarantee + cycle-detect.
  - **Attachment-deduplication** (same file uploaded N times across pages): per-file content-hash dedupe with reference-counting + delete-only-on-zero-references.
  - **Inline-comment anchor-drift** (anchor-text changed during body-edit): per-comment anchor-text-hash recompute + drift-detect + show-as-detached on miss.
  - **Storage-format → ADF transformation lossy** (legacy XML macro-properties not mapping cleanly): per-page transformation-report + manual-review for lossy items.
  - **Page-restrictions inheritance break** (parent restriction-change orphans children): per-page effective-permission recompute on parent-change + audit.
  - **Mention notification storm** (1 page edit @-mentions 500 users): per-page mention-rate-limit + bulk-notify dampening.
  - **Page-Properties macro aggregation cycle** (page A includes B includes A): per-include cycle-detect + max-depth-cap.
  - **Whiteboard content-format-lossy** (proprietary Whiteboard format not fully renderable): per-board format-shim + fallback-to-image-render + manual-redraw tracker.
  - **Database view-type loss** (Calendar view loses time-zone on migration): per-view metadata-preserve + tz-pin.
  - **CCMA-export rate-limit** (large-tenant export throttled by Atlassian): per-tenant export-job-orchestration + retry-with-backoff + partial-resume.
  - **Per-Marketplace-app supply-chain risk** (legacy macro-app no longer maintained): per-app SBOM + signature check per ADR-0293 + retire-on-no-support.
  - **Audit-log retention vs GDPR-deletion conflict**: per-log entry pseudonymization-on-deletion-request + retention-floor for legal.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — CCMA (Confluence Cloud Migration Assistant) + REST v2 + REST v1 + Forge/Connect-app exports + Atlassian Intelligence-API snapshots; format — JSON / ADF / XML (storage-format) + attachment binaries; duration — ~48-72 hours per 500k pages + 5M page-versions + 1M attachments (with binaries) + 100k comments + 500 templates + 1k macros + 50 whiteboards + 100 databases; bandwidth — heavy on attachments + page-version-tree.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Page-tree hierarchy preserved; per-page version-tree preserved with diff + restoration-allowed; restrictions projected as Cedar policy fragments; per-macro mapped to plugin-app-store; Whiteboards → whiteboard µservice; Databases → database µservice; lossy — storage-format → ADF transformation has documented lossy items; some Marketplace-macros no replacement (gap-list).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-space cut-over with URL-redirect on page-id for 24 months; per-Webhook URL re-register; per-Marketplace-macro rebind or replacement; CCMA tenant-snapshot taken at cut-over freeze-window.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-day shadow with sample space + per-page edit-cycle + per-restriction enforcement + per-macro-render parity + per-comment-thread parity ≥ 99.9% + per-attachment access parity 100% + search-result parity ≥ 95%; sunset — Confluence license sunset with page-history retention per tenant policy (7y regulated SOPs; indefinite general); Audit-log retention per ITGC 7y.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Wiki Core → **Bronze**; Wiki Pro → **Silver**; Wiki Enterprise → **Gold**; Wiki Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `wiki` + `drive` + `community` are canonical; `confluence` is benchmark alias.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-037 - Bitbucket Cloud
- Vendor name and category: Atlassian Bitbucket Cloud (and Data Center) / Atlassian ecosystem / Git-hosting + PR workflow + Bitbucket Pipelines (CI/CD) — Workspace + Project + Repository + Branch + Pull Request + Pipelines YAML + Branch Permissions (Branch Protection) + Deployments (Environments) + Code Insights + Pipeline Variables (Repo-scope + Workspace-scope + Deployment-scope + Secured) + Code Owners + Merge Checks + Smart-Mirroring (Data Center) + IP Allowlist + Atlassian Marketplace apps + Forge / Connect.
- Coverage tier: A (already covered: `developer-sdk` + `foundry` + capability tier on `apigw`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Bitbucket Core (Repo + Branch + Commit + PR + Code-Review + Merge) → **Bronze**; Bitbucket Pro (with Pipelines YAML + Branch Permissions + Code-Owners + Merge Checks + Pipeline Variables + Deployments) → **Silver**; Bitbucket Enterprise (with Code Insights + IP Allowlist + Multi-Workspace + Deployment Environments + Secret Scanning + Required Builds) → **Gold**; Bitbucket Enterprise Plus (with Smart-Mirroring + Audit-Log + Data Residency + SLSA Provenance + Sigstore Signing) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `developer-sdk` (repo + branch + commit + PR + code-review + code-owner + merge-check); `foundry` (Bitbucket Pipelines analog + pipeline-definition + pipeline-run + deployment + pipeline-variable); `plugin-app-store` (Bitbucket-app per ADR-0249); `cloud-iac` (pipeline runner infrastructure + Kubernetes pods); `kms` (secured pipeline-variables + secret-vault per ADR-0247); `audit-trail` (pipeline-run + merge-action provenance per ADR-0293 SLSA); `marketplace` (third-party CI/CD apps + integrations).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Bitbucket Cloud object model):
  - `Workspace` (Workspace_Slug, Workspace_ID, Name, Type {Personal / Team / Organization}, IP_Allowlist[], SAML_SSO_Required: bool, OAuth_Apps_Allowed: bool, Default_Branch_Permission_Template).
  - `Project` (Project_Key, Workspace_Reference, Name, Description, Avatar, Private: bool, Default_Permissions).
  - `Repository` (Repo_Slug, Workspace_Reference, Project_Reference, Name, Description, Git_URL, SSH_URL, HTTPS_URL, Default_Branch, Size_Bytes, LFS_Enabled: bool, Mirroring_Configuration, Webhook_References[], Branch_Permission_Refs[], Pipeline_Configuration_Reference, Deployment_Environment_Refs[]).
  - `Branch` (Branch_Name, Repo_Reference, Latest_Commit_SHA, Protected: bool, Branch_Permission_References[], Default_Reviewers_Override[]).
  - `Commit` (SHA, Repo_Reference, Author_Name + Email, Committer_Name + Email, Message, Parent_SHAs[], Tree_SHA, Date, Signed: bool, Signing_Key_Reference).
  - `Pull_Request` (PR_ID, Repo_Reference, Title, Description, Source_Branch, Destination_Branch, Status {Open / Merged / Declined / Superseded}, Author, Reviewers[], Default_Reviewers_From_Codeowners[], Required_Reviewers_Met: bool, Merge_Strategy {Merge-Commit / Squash / Fast-Forward-Only / Squash-Fast-Forward}, Created_Date, Updated_Date, Merge_Commit_SHA, Closed_By, Closed_Date, Conflicts_With_Destination: bool).
  - `Code_Review` (Review_ID, PR_Reference, Reviewer, Status {Approved / Requested-Changes / Commented-Without-Decision}, Review_Comment_Refs[]).
  - `Review_Comment` (Comment_ID, PR_Reference, Author, Body, File_Path, Line_Number, Side {Old / New}, Resolved: bool, Thread_References[]).
  - `Code_Owner_Rule` (Rule_ID, Repo_Reference, Path_Glob (e.g., `/src/auth/**`), Owners[Users / Groups / Email-Aliases], Required: bool).
  - `Branch_Permission` (Permission_ID, Repo_Reference, Branch_Pattern (e.g., `main`, `release/*`), Type {Allow-Push / Allow-Force-Push / Allow-Delete / Allow-Merge-Without-PR / Require-Approvals-Count / Require-Default-Reviewer / Require-Builds-Pass / Require-Tasks-Resolved / Reset-Approvals-On-New-Commit}, Allowed_Principals[]).
  - `Merge_Check` (Check_ID, Repo_Reference, Type {Min-Approvals / Min-Default-Reviewers / Builds-Pass / Tasks-Resolved / Codeowner-Approved / Linear-History-Required / Up-To-Date-With-Destination / Custom-Webhook-Check}, Threshold, Required: bool).
  - `Pipeline_Configuration` (Config_ID — typically `bitbucket-pipelines.yml`; Image, Pipelines{Default[steps] / Branches{Branch-Pattern → [steps]} / Pull-Requests / Tags / Custom / Schedules / After-Script}, Definitions{Caches / Services / Steps}, Options{Max-Time / Size / Docker / Runtime / IP-Allow}).
  - `Pipeline_Run` (Run_ID, Repo_Reference, Trigger {Push / PR / Manual / Scheduled / Webhook}, Triggering_Commit_SHA, Status {Pending / Running / Successful / Failed / Stopped / Error / Halted}, Steps[Step_Number / Name / Status / Logs_URL / Artifacts_Refs / Duration_Sec], Started_Date, Completed_Date, Total_Duration).
  - `Deployment` (Deploy_ID, Pipeline_Run_Reference, Environment_Reference, Status {In-Progress / Successful / Failed / Stopped / Rolled-Back}, Deployer, Deployed_Commit_SHA, Started, Completed).
  - `Deployment_Environment` (Env_ID, Repo_Reference, Name, Type {Test / Staging / Production / Custom}, Manual_Approval_Required: bool, Deploy_Restriction_Refs[], Environment_Variable_References[]).
  - `Pipeline_Variable` (Var_ID, Scope {Workspace / Repository / Deployment-Environment}, Key, Value (encrypted-if-secured), Secured: bool, System: bool).
  - `Webhook` (Hook_ID, Repo_Reference, URL, Events_Subscribed[], Secret, Active: bool, Last_Delivery_Status).
  - `Issue` (legacy Bitbucket-Issues — being deprecated in favor of Jira; ID, Repo_Reference, Status, Kind {Bug / Enhancement / Proposal / Task}, Priority).
  - `Snippet` (small code-shares; Snippet_ID, Workspace, Files[], Owner, Visibility).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST API 2.0: `https://api.bitbucket.org/2.0/repositories/{workspace}/{repo_slug}` + `/pullrequests` + `/commits` + `/branches` + `/pipelines/` + `/deployments_config/environments` + `/pipelines_config/variables`.
  - Git Smart HTTP/SSH protocol: standard Git transport for clone + push + fetch.
  - Webhooks: per-event (repo:push / pullrequest:created / pullrequest:approved / pullrequest:merged / pipeline:state-update / etc.).
  - Bitbucket Pipelines API: pipeline-trigger + step-control + artifact-download.
  - Code Insights API: annotation + report per-commit (third-party static-analyzer integration).
  - Atlassian Marketplace API: per-app install/manage.
  - OAuth 2.0 + App Passwords + Repository Access Tokens (per-repo PAT) + Workspace Access Tokens.
  - SCIM 2.0 + SAML SSO via Atlassian Access.
  - Audit Log API: per-workspace change-log feed.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "PR Review" — desktop with file-diff + inline-comment + suggestion-mode + tasks + approvals + merge-checks status + side-by-side or unified view.
  - "Pipelines Dashboard" — per-repo pipeline-runs with status + duration + logs + artifacts + manual-step trigger.
  - "Deployments" — per-env deployment-history with status + commit + deployer + rollback-button.
  - "Code Insights Sidebar" — annotations from SonarQube / Snyk / SecurityScorecard / etc. inline on PR diff.
  - "Branch Permissions" — per-pattern visual editor with allow/deny actions.
  - "Pipeline Variables" — workspace / repo / env-scoped variables with secured-flag visualization.
  - "Repository Settings" — per-repo with permissions + webhooks + pipelines + branch-protection + integrations.
  - "Mobile PR Approve" — one-tap approve + view-diff + comment.
  - "Smart-Mirroring" (Data Center) — read-only mirrors in remote regions with sync-status.
  - "Audit Log" — workspace-level change-log with filter + export.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<dev-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CodeCreateRepo", Oyatie::Action::"CodeClone",
      Oyatie::Action::"CodePush", Oyatie::Action::"CodeForcePush",
      Oyatie::Action::"CodeCreateBranch", Oyatie::Action::"CodeDeleteBranch",
      Oyatie::Action::"CodeProtectBranch", Oyatie::Action::"CodeCreatePr",
      Oyatie::Action::"CodeApprovePr", Oyatie::Action::"CodeMergePr",
      Oyatie::Action::"CodeRebasePr", Oyatie::Action::"CodeRunPipeline",
      Oyatie::Action::"CodeRetryFailedStep", Oyatie::Action::"CodeDeployFromPipeline",
      Oyatie::Action::"CodeManagePipelineVariable", Oyatie::Action::"CodeRunCodeownerCheck",
      Oyatie::Action::"CodeManageBranchPermission", Oyatie::Action::"CodeViewSecuredLog"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Repo::"<repo-slug>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    workspace_membership(principal, resource.workspace) &&
    repo_permission_grants(principal, action, resource) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CodeForcePush" ? branch_permission_allows_force_push(resource, context.branch, principal) && !context.branch_protected_main_or_release : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CodeMergePr" ? merge_checks_all_pass(context.pr) && required_approvals_met(context.pr) && codeowner_approvals_met(context.pr) && builds_pass(context.pr) && !context.pr.conflicts_with_destination : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CodeApprovePr" ? !pr_authored_by(principal, context.pr) && !already_approved_by(principal, context.pr) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CodeProtectBranch" ? principal.has_role("RepoAdmin") || principal.has_role("WorkspaceAdmin") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CodeDeployFromPipeline" ? deployment_env_approval_met(context.env, context.pr) && !context.env.deploy_restriction_blocks(principal) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CodeManagePipelineVariable" ? principal.has_role("RepoAdmin") && (context.var.secured ? principal.has_role("SecretManager") : true) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CodeViewSecuredLog" ? principal.has_role("SecurityAdmin") && log_redact_applied(context.log) : true) &&
    (resource.is_export_controlled && action.exposes_source ? context.pack.contains("ITAR") && principal.itar_authorized : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CodeRunPipeline" && context.pipeline.touches_production ? slsa_provenance_required && context.pack.contains("SLSA-L3") : true) &&
    ip_allowlist_check(principal, resource.workspace.ip_allowlist) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Workspace` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::workspace` (with IP-allowlist + SSO + OAuth-app policy).
  - `Project` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::project_group` (with default-permissions).
  - `Repository` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::repository` (with LFS + mirroring-config + default-branch).
  - `Branch` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::branch` (with protected-flag + default-reviewers-override).
  - `Commit` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::commit` (with signed-flag + signing-key-ref + parent-SHAs).
  - `Pull_Request` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::pull_request` (with merge-strategy + required-reviewers-met).
  - `Code_Review` + `Review_Comment` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::code_review` + `review_comment` (with side + file + line + thread).
  - `Code_Owner_Rule` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::codeowner_rule` (with path-glob + owners).
  - `Branch_Permission` → `Oyatie::Cedar::branch_permission` (projected as Cedar policy fragments per ADR-0243).
  - `Merge_Check` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::merge_check` (with type + threshold + required-flag).
  - `Pipeline_Configuration` → `Oyatie::Foundry::pipeline_definition` (with image + branches + steps + caches + services + options).
  - `Pipeline_Run` → `Oyatie::Foundry::pipeline_run` (with trigger + steps + status + logs + artifacts).
  - `Deployment` → `Oyatie::Foundry::deployment` (with env + commit + status + deployer).
  - `Deployment_Environment` → `Oyatie::Foundry::deployment_environment` (with manual-approval + deploy-restrictions).
  - `Pipeline_Variable` → `Oyatie::Foundry::pipeline_variable` (with scope + secured-flag → KMS binding per ADR-0247).
  - `Webhook` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::webhook` (with event-subscriptions + secret + last-delivery).
  - `Issue` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::legacy_issue` (Bitbucket-Issues deprecation marker — redirect to Jira per D-034).
  - `Snippet` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::snippet`.

- **Specific workflow steps** (Bitbucket Cloud displacement journey):
  1. **Extract**: REST 2.0 + Git Smart HTTP/SSH clone + Bitbucket Pipelines API + Code Insights API + Audit Log API; per-repo full-history Git clone (with LFS objects) + per-Marketplace-app inventory.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-workspace partitioned ingest; per-repo Git mirror created on Oyatie Git substrate with `oya git` per `feedback_oya_git_canonical_2026_05_18`; per-LFS-object content-addressable storage.
  3. **Project**: Workspace + Project + Repository hierarchy preserved; per-repo branch-permissions projected as Cedar policy fragments; per-pipeline YAML preserved with image/step/cache/service definitions; per-deployment environment preserved with manual-approval + restrictions.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-workspace + per-repo + per-branch + per-action policy; SLSA-L3 + Sigstore + IP-allowlist + data-residency packs activated; per-secured-variable KMS binding.
  5. **Git history migration**: per-repo full-history clone preserving commits + tags + branches + LFS objects; signing-key references rebound; SBOM regenerated per ADR-0293.
  6. **Pipeline YAML migration**: per-`bitbucket-pipelines.yml` parsed + transformed to Oyatie Foundry pipeline-definition with semantic-preservation; per-step image + cache + service preserved; per-pipeline-run history retained for 5 years.
  7. **Branch-permission migration**: per-pattern (`main`, `release/*`, etc.) projected as Cedar policy fragments; reset-approvals-on-new-commit + require-builds-pass + codeowner-approved preserved.
  8. **Code-owner-rule migration**: per-path-glob owners + required-flag preserved; integration with PR-merge-check.
  9. **Pipeline-variable migration**: per-scope (workspace / repo / env) preserved; secured-variables migrated to KMS with token-rotation; per-deployment-env variable preserved.
  10. **Webhook URL re-register**: per-webhook URL + events + secret preserved; per-tenant rate-limit applied.
  11. **Code-Insights connector rebind**: per-static-analyzer (SonarQube / Snyk / SecurityScorecard / Checkmarx) connector OAuth re-grant; per-commit annotation pipeline rebound.
  12. **Marketplace-app inventory + replacement**: per-app replacement-mapping to plugin-app-store; gap-list with feature-loss-disclosure; Forge-apps re-deploy.
  13. **Deployment-env migration**: per-env (test / staging / prod) preserved with manual-approval + deploy-restrictions; per-env variable preserved.
  14. **Smart-Mirroring rebind** (Data Center): per-mirror region preserved + sync-cadence preserved.
  15. **Parallel run**: 30-day shadow with sample push + PR + pipeline-run + deployment parity ≥ 99.9%; per-PR-merge-check parity 100%.
  16. **Cutover**: per-repo cut-over with PR-URL-redirect for 24 months; per-Webhook URL re-register; per-Marketplace-app rebind; per-deployment-env cutover at next quiet-period (no in-flight deploys).
  17. **Sunset**: Bitbucket license sunset with audit-log retention per ITGC 7y; per-pipeline-run history retention per SLSA + compliance-pack mandate.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Large-monorepo clone-timeout** (10GB+ repo, slow network): per-clone shallow-fetch + pack-file optimization + resumable-clone + parallel ref-fetch.
  - **Pipeline-variable-leak on log** (secured-variable accidentally `echo`'d): per-variable mask + log-scrub + post-run secrets-scanner.
  - **Branch-protection-bypass via admin-override**: per-bypass audit + Slack-notify + dual-control on protection-disable + audit-on-re-enable.
  - **PR-merge-train ordering** (multiple PRs in flight, rebase races): per-train serialize + rebase-on-failure + automatic re-validation of merge-checks.
  - **LFS-pointer migration** (Git-LFS attachment): per-object content-addressable migration + verifier + dedupe across repos.
  - **Force-push history-loss** (force-push on protected branch destroys commits): per-branch reflog-archive + restore-on-incident.
  - **Merge-check race condition** (PR approved + build green, then push lands → merge with stale state): per-merge merge-check re-evaluation + reset-approvals-on-new-commit.
  - **Pipeline-runner OOM on large monorepo**: per-pipeline resource-config + monitor + auto-scale + step-timeout.
  - **Deployment environment skip** (deploy to prod without staging): per-env required-predecessor-env check + Cedar gate.
  - **Codeowner-rule overlap** (multiple rules match same path): per-rule priority + last-match-wins documented + audit on ambiguity.
  - **Pipeline-YAML drift on parser-version-upgrade**: per-tenant YAML-parser version-pin + opt-in upgrade + dry-run.
  - **Webhook delivery silently failing** (target endpoint returns 500): per-webhook retry-with-backoff + alert-on-failure + manual-replay.
  - **Smart-Mirror sync-drift** (DC mirror falls behind primary): per-mirror lag-SLA + alert + manual-resync.
  - **Marketplace-app supply-chain risk** (legacy CI/CD-app no longer maintained): per-app SBOM + signature check per ADR-0293.
  - **Audit-log retention vs GDPR-deletion conflict**: per-log pseudonymization-on-request + retention-floor for ITGC.
  - **Pipeline pulling private base-image without auth**: per-pipeline image-pull-secret pre-flight check + Cedar gate.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — REST 2.0 + Git Smart HTTP/SSH + Pipelines API + Code Insights API + Audit Log API + Bitbucket Cloud Migration Assistant; format — JSON / Git / YAML; duration — ~24-48 hours per 1k repos + 10TB Git history (with LFS) + 100k PRs + 50k pipeline-runs + 5y audit-log; bandwidth — heavy on Git clone (saturates 1 Gbps).
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Workspace + Project + Repository hierarchy preserved; per-repo branch-permissions projected as Cedar policy fragments; per-pipeline YAML preserved with image/step/cache/service definitions; per-deployment environment preserved with manual-approval + restrictions; lossy — Atlassian Code Insights re-bound to per-vendor static-analyzer; some Marketplace-apps no replacement (gap-list).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-repo cut-over with PR-URL-redirect for 24 months; per-Webhook URL re-register; per-Marketplace-app rebind; per-deployment-env cutover at next quiet-period.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with sample push + PR + pipeline-run + deployment parity ≥ 99.9% + per-PR-merge-check parity 100% + Git-history parity 100% (commit-SHA preserved) + per-secured-variable access parity 100%; sunset — Bitbucket license sunset with audit-log retention per ITGC 7y + pipeline-run history per SLSA mandate.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Bitbucket Core → **Bronze**; Bitbucket Pro → **Silver**; Bitbucket Enterprise → **Gold**; Bitbucket Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `developer-sdk` + `foundry` are canonical; `bitbucket` and `bitbucket-cloud` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-038 - Trello
- Vendor name and category: Atlassian Trello / Atlassian ecosystem / Lightweight Kanban + personal/team task boards — Workspace (formerly Team) + Board + List + Card + Label + Checklist + Power-Ups (third-party app extensions) + Butler (automation) + Workspace Members + Board Members + Card Members + Card Stickers + Card Cover (image) + Custom Fields (per-card) + Card Templates + Map view + Calendar view + Timeline view + Dashboard view + Trello Enterprise (SSO + Atlassian Access + Org-Wide-Permissions + Data Export).
- Coverage tier: A (capability tier on `workflow-studio` + `community` + plugin-app-store). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Trello Core (Workspace + Board + List + Card + Label + Member + Comment + Attach) → **Bronze**; Trello Pro (with Checklist + Due-Date + Custom-Fields + Card-Template + Multi-View + Power-Ups) → **Silver**; Trello Enterprise (with Butler-Automation + Workspace-Permissions + Atlassian-Access SSO + Data Export + Board Templates) → **Gold**; Trello Enterprise Plus (with Org-Wide-Permissions + Audit-Log + per-region Data Residency + Power-Up Admin Controls + Atlassian Intelligence) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `workflow-studio` (board + list + card with simple state-machine + multi-view + automation-rule); `community` (per-board comment + react + mention + member-presence); `plugin-app-store` (Trello Power-Up analog per ADR-0249); `mobile-shell` (mobile-primary board with drag-drop); `drive` (attachment storage); `identity` (workspace + board + guest membership).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Trello object model):
  - `Workspace` (formerly Team; Workspace_ID, Display_Name, Description, Logo_URL, Website_URL, Visibility {Private / Public}, Members[], Board_Refs[], Permission_Level, Org_Admin_Refs[], SSO_Required: bool, Plan {Free / Standard / Premium / Enterprise}).
  - `Board` (Board_ID, Workspace_Reference, Name, Description, Background {Color / Photo / Gradient}, Visibility {Private / Workspace / Public / Org}, Closed: bool, Archived: bool, Lists_Refs[], Member_Refs[], Power_Ups_Enabled[], Label_Refs[], Custom_Field_Defs[], Pinned: bool, Self-Joinable: bool, Voting_Allowed: bool, Card_Aging_Mode {Pirate / Regular / None}, Comments_Allowed_By {Members / Workspace-Members / Public}, Invitations_Allowed_By {Admins / Members}).
  - `List` (List_ID, Board_Reference, Name, Position (float for ordering — Lexorank-like), Closed: bool, Subscribed_Members[], Card_Refs[]).
  - `Card` (Card_ID, List_Reference, Board_Reference, Name, Description (Markdown), Position (float), Due_Date, Due_Complete: bool, Closed: bool, Subscribed: bool, Cover {Image_Reference / Color / Size {Half / Full}}, Members_Assigned[], Labels[], Checklists[], Custom_Field_Values[], Comments[], Attachments[], Stickers[], Activity_Log[], Created_From {Template_Reference / Email / Web / Mobile / API / Butler}).
  - `Label` (Label_ID, Board_Reference, Name, Color {Green / Yellow / Orange / Red / Purple / Blue / Sky / Lime / Pink / Black / None}, Uses_Count).
  - `Checklist` (Checklist_ID, Card_Reference, Name, Position, Items[Item_ID / Name / State {Incomplete / Complete} / Position / Due_Date / Assigned_Member]).
  - `Custom_Field_Definition` (per-Board; Field_ID, Name, Type {Checkbox / Date / List-Select / Number / Text}, Options[] (for List-Select), Display_On_Card_Front: bool).
  - `Custom_Field_Value` (per-Card per-FieldDef; Value (typed)).
  - `Attachment` (Attachment_ID, Card_Reference, URL (when link) or File_Storage_Reference, Name, MIME_Type, Size_Bytes, Uploaded_Date, Uploaded_By, Cover_Used: bool).
  - `Comment` (Comment_ID, Card_Reference, Author, Body (Markdown), Created_Date, Mentions[], Reactions[]).
  - `Sticker` (Sticker_ID, Card_Reference, Image, X_Y_Position, Rotation, Z_Index).
  - `Member` (Member_ID, Username, Full_Name, Avatar_URL, Email (if visible), Workspace_Memberships[Role], Board_Memberships[Role: Admin / Normal / Observer]).
  - `Guest_Membership` (per-Board guest with scoped-access; Guest_Member_ID, Board_Reference, Permissions_Scope).
  - `Power_Up` (PowerUp_ID, Board_Reference, App_Reference (Marketplace app or custom), Configuration_JSON, Enabled: bool, Permissions_Granted[], Webhook_URL, Authentication_Reference (API key / OAuth token), Capabilities[card-buttons / board-buttons / card-back-section / card-detail-badges / card-from-url / authorization-status / show-settings / show-authorization / format-url]).
  - `Butler_Rule` (Rule_ID, Board_Reference (or Workspace-Reference for Multi-Board), Type {Rule / Card-Button / Board-Button / Scheduled / Due-Date-Command}, Trigger_Condition, Actions[Move / Copy / Archive / Set-Due / Sort / Mention / Webhook / Custom-Field-Edit / Add-Checklist / etc.], Enabled: bool, Created_By, Last_Run, Run_Count).
  - `View` (per-Board view; Type {Board (default kanban) / Timeline / Calendar / Dashboard / Map / Table}, Configuration_JSON).
  - `Card_Template` (Template_ID, Board_Reference, Name, Pre_Filled_Card_Fields, Display_On_Add_Card_Menu: bool).
  - `Board_Template` (Org / Marketplace template; Template_ID, Display_Name, Description, Categories[], Lists_Pre_Defined[], Cards_Pre_Defined[]).
  - `Activity_Entry` (per-Card or per-Board; Entry_ID, Type {createCard / updateCard / moveCard / addMember / removeMember / commentCard / addAttachmentToCard / etc.}, Author, Date, Data {JSON of change}).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST API v1: `https://api.trello.com/1/boards/{id}` + `/lists/{id}` + `/cards/{id}` + `/members/{id}` + `/checklists/{id}` + `/labels/{id}` + `/organizations/{id}` + `/actions/{id}` + `/customFields/{id}` + `/notifications/{id}` + `/search?query=...&modelTypes=cards,boards,members`.
  - Webhooks: per-Model (Board / Card / List / Member / Organization) → URL → events.
  - Power-Up SDK: client-side JS-bridge for board-iframe-embed; capabilities {card-buttons / board-buttons / etc.}.
  - Butler API: per-Rule trigger + execution + log.
  - Trello Atlassian-Access bridge: SSO + SCIM + audit-log.
  - OAuth 1.0a + Personal Tokens + Application Keys.
  - GraphQL (limited, internal-mostly).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Board View (Kanban)" — horizontal-scrolling lists with draggable cards; per-card label-color stripe + member-avatars + due-date badge + checklist-progress.
  - "Card Back" — expanded card-detail with description (Markdown) + members + labels + checklists + due-date + attachments + custom-fields + power-up-sections + comments + activity.
  - "Timeline View" — Gantt-like with start/due-date positioning.
  - "Calendar View" — month/week calendar with due-dates.
  - "Dashboard View" — board-level stats: cards-per-list / cards-per-label / cards-per-member / overdue.
  - "Map View" — cards plotted on map (when location-field used).
  - "Table View" — spreadsheet-like cross-list view.
  - "Butler Automation Editor" — natural-language rule-builder ("when a card is moved to Done, mark all checklist items complete and archive the card after 7 days").
  - "Power-Up Catalog" — Marketplace-browser with install + configure.
  - "Card Templates" — per-board template-list with one-click-card-create.
  - "Board Templates" — Org + Marketplace gallery.
  - "Mobile App" — mobile-primary with offline-sync + push-notify + quick-add.
  - "Workspace Sidebar" — per-workspace boards + members + settings.
  - "Card Cover" — Unsplash-integrated cover-image with half/full size.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<member-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"KanbanCreateBoard", Oyatie::Action::"KanbanCreateList",
      Oyatie::Action::"KanbanCreateCard", Oyatie::Action::"KanbanMoveCard",
      Oyatie::Action::"KanbanArchiveCard", Oyatie::Action::"KanbanAddMember",
      Oyatie::Action::"KanbanAddLabel", Oyatie::Action::"KanbanSetDueDate",
      Oyatie::Action::"KanbanAddChecklist", Oyatie::Action::"KanbanComment",
      Oyatie::Action::"KanbanAttach", Oyatie::Action::"KanbanInstallPowerUp",
      Oyatie::Action::"KanbanConfigureAutomation", Oyatie::Action::"KanbanShareBoard",
      Oyatie::Action::"KanbanInviteGuest", Oyatie::Action::"KanbanEditCustomField",
      Oyatie::Action::"KanbanExportBoard"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Card::"<card-id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    board_membership(principal, resource.board) &&
    workspace_visibility_allows(principal, resource.board.workspace) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"KanbanCreateBoard" ? workspace_admin_or_member_with_create(principal, context.workspace) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"KanbanMoveCard" ? board_role_allows_move(principal, resource.board) && !card_locked_by_butler_rule(resource) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"KanbanInstallPowerUp" ? principal.has_role("BoardAdmin") && powerup_admin_allowed(context.powerup, resource.board.workspace) && powerup_security_reviewed(context.powerup) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"KanbanConfigureAutomation" ? principal.has_role("BoardAdmin") && butler_rule_depth_under_cap(context.rule, 5) && !butler_rule_introduces_cycle(context.rule, resource.board.butler_rules) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"KanbanInviteGuest" ? principal.has_role("BoardAdmin") && context.guest_permissions_scoped : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"KanbanShareBoard" ? context.target_visibility != "Public" || principal.tenant.public_boards_allowed : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"KanbanExportBoard" ? principal.has_role("WorkspaceAdmin") && data_residency_compliant_export(context.destination) : true) &&
    (resource.board.workspace.plan == "Enterprise" ? sso_enforced(principal) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.user_jurisdiction == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.has_minor_users ? context.pack.contains("COPPA") && minor_user_consent_validated(principal) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"KanbanAttach" ? !attachment_exceeds_size_limit(context.attachment, principal.tenant.attachment_max_mb) && virus_scan_clean(context.attachment) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Workspace` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::workspace` (with members + plan + SSO-required).
  - `Board` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::kanban_board` (with visibility + power-ups + card-aging-mode + comments-allowed-by + invitations-allowed-by).
  - `List` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::kanban_list` (with Lexorank-position + closed-flag + subscribed-members).
  - `Card` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::kanban_card` (with Lexorank-position + cover + members + labels + checklists + custom-field-values + activity-log).
  - `Label` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::kanban_label` (with color + uses-count).
  - `Checklist` + items → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::kanban_checklist` + `checklist_item` (with state + due-date + assigned-member).
  - `Custom_Field_Definition` + `Custom_Field_Value` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::custom_field_def` + `custom_field_value`.
  - `Attachment` → `Oyatie::Drive::attachment` (cross-link to drive µservice).
  - `Comment` → `Oyatie::Community::comment` (with Markdown body + mentions + reactions).
  - `Sticker` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::kanban_sticker` (with position + rotation + z-index).
  - `Member` → `Oyatie::Identity::member` (with workspace + board memberships and roles).
  - `Guest_Membership` → `Oyatie::Identity::guest_membership` (with scoped-access).
  - `Power_Up` → `Oyatie::PluginAppStore::powerup_app` (cross-link to plugin-app-store entry).
  - `Butler_Rule` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::butler_rule` (with trigger + actions + depth-cap + cycle-detect).
  - `View` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::view` (multi-view configurations).
  - `Card_Template` + `Board_Template` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::card_template` + `board_template`.
  - `Activity_Entry` → `Oyatie::AuditTrail::activity_entry` (per ADR-0247).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Trello displacement journey):
  1. **Extract**: REST API v1 export of Workspace + Board + List + Card + Label + Checklist + Custom_Field_Def + Custom_Field_Value + Attachment + Comment + Sticker + Member + Guest_Membership + Power_Up + Butler_Rule + View + Card_Template + Board_Template + Activity_Entry; per-attachment binary download.
  2. **Land**: per-tenant + per-workspace + per-board partitioned ingest; per-attachment binary moved to drive object-store with content-hash dedupe.
  3. **Project**: Board → List → Card → Checklist hierarchy preserved; Lexorank-position preserved for stable ordering; per-board power-ups + custom-fields + butler-rules preserved.
  4. **Backfill Cedar**: per-workspace + per-board + per-role + per-action policy; guest-scope preservation; per-tenant SSO enforcement + GDPR + COPPA (when minor users) + data-residency packs.
  5. **Power-Up migration**: per-Power-Up inventory + replacement-mapping to plugin-app-store; per-Power-Up configuration-JSON preserved; per-Power-Up OAuth-token rotation; gap-list with feature-loss-disclosure.
  6. **Butler-Rule migration**: per-rule trigger-action transformation to workflow-studio rule; depth-cap + cycle-detect enforced; scheduled-rules cron-equivalent preserved; in-flight rule-runs paused + drained pre-cutover.
  7. **Custom-Field migration**: per-field-def type preserved (Checkbox / Date / List-Select / Number / Text); per-card-value preserved.
  8. **View migration**: per-view configuration (Timeline / Calendar / Dashboard / Map / Table) preserved with multi-view rendering.
  9. **Attachment migration**: per-attachment binary moved to drive object-store with virus-scan re-run + content-hash dedupe; per-attachment cover-used flag preserved.
  10. **Member + Guest migration**: per-workspace + per-board member-roles preserved; per-guest scoped-permissions preserved; SSO re-bind for Enterprise tenants.
  11. **Card template + Board template migration**: per-template pre-filled-fields preserved.
  12. **Activity-log migration**: per-card + per-board activity-history preserved (typical retention 1 year for free; longer for Premium/Enterprise).
  13. **Parallel run**: 14-day shadow with sample board + card-move + butler-rule-fire + power-up-render parity ≥ 99.9% + per-attachment access parity 100%.
  14. **Cutover**: per-board cut-over with member-notification + URL-redirect on board-id for 12 months; per-Webhook URL re-register; per-Power-Up rebind.
  15. **Sunset**: Trello license sunset with board-history retention per tenant policy (1y free / indefinite Premium/Enterprise); per-attachment retention per Drive policy.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Card-move concurrent-edit conflict** (two users drag-drop simultaneously): per-card vector-clock + last-writer-wins with audit + UI conflict-banner.
  - **Power-Up-API gap** (Trello Power-Up using API not in plugin-app-store): per-Power-Up replacement-map + feature-loss-disclosure + Power-Up-Disabled placeholder.
  - **Butler-automation recursion** (rule moves card to list, another rule triggers on list-arrive, loops): per-rule depth-cap (typically 5) + cycle-detect + circuit-breaker.
  - **Guest-invite scope-leak** (guest sees more than intended via Power-Up data exposure): per-guest scoped-view + Power-Up data-Cedar-check + audit on access.
  - **Attachment-orphan on board-delete**: per-attachment cascade-delete with retention window (typically 90 days for restore).
  - **Lexorank position-collision** (two cards land at exact same position): per-list rebalance-on-collision + reorder.
  - **Activity-log staleness** (high-write board lags activity-feed): per-board activity-feed SLA + alert on lag.
  - **Card-Cover image-resize lossy** (Unsplash image cached at wrong resolution): per-cover image-pipeline + multi-resolution cache.
  - **Public-board indexing accidental** (board flipped to Public, indexed by search engines): per-board visibility-change Cedar gate + warning-modal + retroactive-noindex on revert.
  - **Minor-user COPPA violation** (Trello account by < 13yo without parental consent): per-tenant minor-user consent-validation gate + age-verify.
  - **Workspace SSO bypass via personal API token**: per-tenant Atlassian-Access enforce + personal-token deprecation on enterprise.
  - **Board-Template Marketplace supply-chain risk** (template installs malicious Power-Up): per-template SBOM + per-Power-Up signature check per ADR-0293.
  - **Mobile-offline-sync conflict** (offline edits stale; rebase loses data): per-card conflict-detection + 3-way-merge UI.
  - **Search-result data-leak** (cross-workspace search returns boards user can't access): per-search Cedar-filter + audit.
  - **Comment @-mention notification storm** (mention "@board" notifies 100 members at once): per-mention rate-limit + bulk-notify dampening.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Trello REST API v1 + Power-Up SDK exports + Butler API + Webhook-history; format — JSON; duration — ~6-12 hours per 10k boards + 100k lists + 1M cards + 5M card-activities + 500k attachments + 1k Butler-Rules + 200 Power-Up installations; bandwidth — moderate, heavy on attachment-binaries.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Board → List → Card → Checklist hierarchy preserved; Lexorank-position preserved; per-board power-ups + custom-fields + butler-rules preserved; lossy — Trello-specific features (Card-Aging visual + Stickers placement-fidelity) approximated; some Power-Ups no replacement (gap-list).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-board cut-over with member-notification + URL-redirect on board-id for 12 months; per-Webhook URL re-register; per-Power-Up rebind; per-Butler-rule re-enable post-validation.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 14-day shadow with sample board + card-move + butler-rule-fire + power-up-render parity ≥ 99.9% + per-attachment access parity 100% + multi-view rendering parity 100%; sunset — Trello license sunset with board-history retention per tenant policy (1y free / indefinite Premium/Enterprise) + per-attachment retention per Drive policy.

- **Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316**: Trello Core → **Bronze**; Trello Pro → **Silver**; Trello Enterprise → **Gold**; Trello Enterprise Plus → **Platinum**.

- Naming justification: `workflow-studio` (kanban tier) is canonical; `trello` is benchmark alias.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-039 - Atlassian Open DevOps
- Vendor name and category: Atlassian Open DevOps (Jira + Bitbucket + Confluence + Opsgenie + Compass + Jira Product Discovery + Atlassian Intelligence + Atlassian Analytics integrated workflow) / Atlassian ecosystem / DevOps platform composition + cross-product unified-search + cross-product Smart-Link auto-card + per-product BPMN-style automation rules + cross-product OAuth-2.0 mesh.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `wiki` + `incident-management` + `service-catalog`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: cross-product link basic (Jira-Bitbucket commit-id binding) → **Bronze**; cross-product Smart-Link auto-card + deployment-to-issue gating → **Silver**; cross-product unified-search + Compass scorecards + Jira-Product-Discovery ideation → **Gold**; Atlassian Intelligence cross-product + Atlassian Analytics with cross-product data-lake → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `workflow-engine` (issue + sprint + board + roadmap from D-034); `developer-sdk` (repo + PR + branch + pipeline from D-037); `wiki` (page + space + smart-link from D-036); `incident-management` (Opsgenie alert + on-call + escalation); `service-catalog` (Compass: `microservice` projection of dev-owned services with scorecards); `intelligence` (Jira Product Discovery for ideation + Atlassian Intelligence cross-product); `analytics` (Atlassian Analytics — cross-product reports); `marketplace` (Atlassian Marketplace cross-product apps); `apigw` (cross-product REST/Webhook + Forge-bridge).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Open DevOps cross-product join model):
  - `Cross_Product_Link` (Link_ID, Source_Product {Jira / Bitbucket / Confluence / Opsgenie / Compass / JPD}, Source_Object_ID, Target_Product, Target_Object_ID, Link_Type {Implements / FixedBy / RelatesTo / Documents / Blocks / DeployedBy / IncidentImpacts / MonitoredBy / DiscoveredIn / EpicChildOf / PageReferences}, Created_By, Created_At, Updated_At).
  - `Compass_Component` (Component_ID, Name, Type {Service / Library / Application / Other}, Owner_Team_Reference, Description, Lifecycle {Active / Deprecated / End-of-Life}, Repo_Links[], Datadog_Link, PagerDuty_Link, Documentation_Links[], Slack_Channel, Scorecards[], Metrics[], Custom_Fields[]).
  - `Compass_Scorecard` (Scorecard_ID, Name, Description, Criteria[Criterion_Name → Required_Score / Evaluation_Logic], Components_Bound[], Score_History[]).
  - `Compass_Event` (Event_ID, Component_Reference, Event_Type {Deployment / Incident / On-Call / Release / Pull-Request-Merged}, Timestamp, Metadata).
  - `JPD_Idea` (Idea_ID, Title, Description, Insights[Insight_Source: User-Interview / Sales-Call / Support-Ticket / Survey], Impact_Score, Effort_Score, Score, Status {Backlog / Discovery / Delivery / Released / Archived}, Assignee, Project_Reference).
  - `JPD_Insight` (Insight_ID, Idea_Reference, Source_Type, Source_URL, Excerpt, Date_Captured, Author).
  - `Atlassian_Intelligence_Action` (AI_Action_ID, Type {Summarize / Generate / Translate / Define-Term / Action-Item-Extract / Predict / Triage}, Source_Object, Result, Confidence_Score, Created_At, Reviewed: bool).
  - `Atlassian_Analytics_Dashboard` (Dashboard_ID, Name, Cross_Product_Charts[Chart_ID → SQL-Query-Against-Data-Lake], Filters[], Refresh_Cadence).
  - `Atlassian_Access_Org` (Org_ID, Name, Members[], SAML_Config, SCIM_Config, Audit_Log_Stream_Config, Bound_Products[]).
  - `Forge_App` (App_ID, Manifest, Modules[], Permissions[], Tenant_Installations[]).
  - `Smart_Link_Provider` (Provider_ID, URL_Pattern, Auto_Card_Renderer, Auth_Method).
  - `Cross_Product_Webhook` (Webhook_ID, Source_Product, Event_Type, Subscriber_URL, Filter_JQL_or_CQL, Auth_Token_Reference).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST APIs: `https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/{cloudid}/...` (Jira); `https://api.bitbucket.org/2.0/...` (Bitbucket); `https://api.atlassian.com/ex/confluence/{cloudid}/...` (Confluence); `https://api.opsgenie.com/v2/...` (Opsgenie); `https://your-domain.atlassian.net/gateway/api/compass/...` (Compass).
  - GraphQL API: `/gateway/api/graphql` — unified cross-product graph (newer surface; covers cross-product references + Compass + Atlassian Analytics).
  - Smart Link Resolver API: per-URL-pattern → card-render JSON.
  - Forge Platform: manifest.yml + per-tenant RBAC storage + per-tenant rollout + per-app permission grant.
  - (legacy): JWT-iframe + REST callback.
  - Atlassian Access: SCIM + SAML + Audit Log streaming + IP allowlist + Data-Residency-policy.
  - Atlassian Intelligence API: per-AI-action invocation with source-context + confidence-score.
  - Atlassian Analytics: per-data-lake SQL-query endpoint (read-only, cross-product).
  - Webhooks: per-product per-event outbound POST with cross-product correlation-id.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Compass Home" — service-list grouped by team with scorecard badges + recent-deployment + incident-status.
  - "Service Detail" — component dashboard with metrics + scorecards + recent activity + linked repos + on-call + runbook links.
  - "Scorecard Builder" — criterion-list with auto-evaluation rules + manual-attestation toggle.
  - "Atlassian Smart Link Auto-Card" — paste URL across products renders contextual card.
  - "Cross-Product Search" — federated search across Jira issue + Confluence page + Bitbucket file + Opsgenie alert + Compass service.
  - "Atlassian Intelligence Assistant" — sidebar panel for summarize / generate / extract-action-items / triage across products.
  - "Atlassian Analytics Dashboard" — cross-product chart-builder with SQL-against-data-lake.
  - "JPD Idea Board" — idea-list with prioritization-matrix (impact × effort) + insight-cards + status-pipeline.
  - "JPD Idea-to-Epic Conversion" — promote idea to Jira epic with field-mapping + insight-carry-forward.
  - "DevOps Pipeline View" — per-Jira-issue commit/PR/build/deploy timeline.
  - "On-Call Schedule" — Opsgenie rotation overlay with escalation graph.
  - "Org Admin Console" — Atlassian Access: SSO / SCIM / data-residency / audit-stream policy editor.

- **Cedar permit shape** (composed cross-product permit):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<dev-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsLinkObjects", Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsCreateService",
      Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsAttachScorecard", Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsRunScorecardEval",
      Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsEmitComponentEvent", Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsRunCrossProductSearch",
      Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsInvokeAI", Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsQueryAnalytics",
      Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsPromoteIdeaToEpic", Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsConfigureSmartLink",
      Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsInstallForgeApp", Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsConfigureSCIM",
      Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsConfigureSSO", Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsStreamAuditLog"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::ServiceCatalogComponent::"<comp-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::JpdIdea::"<idea-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CrossProductLink::"<link-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    cross_product_permission_intersection(principal, resource) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsInstallForgeApp" ? principal.has_role("OrgAdmin") && marketplace_app_security_reviewed(context.app) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsConfigureSSO" ? principal.has_role("OrgAdmin") && context.dual_admin_approval : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsConfigureSCIM" ? principal.has_role("OrgAdmin") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsQueryAnalytics" ? analytics_data_lake_residency_matches_principal(principal, context.query) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"DevOpsInvokeAI" ? context.pack.allows_ai_processing(resource.classification) && ai_consent_recorded(principal, resource) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    (resource.requires_slsa ? context.pack.contains("SLSA-L3") && provenance_attestation_present(resource) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Cross_Product_Link` → `Oyatie::Ontology::cross_product_link` (with source + target + link-type + tenant scope).
  - `Compass_Component` → `Oyatie::ServiceCatalog::component` (with owner-team-ref + lifecycle + linked-repos + scorecard-bindings).
  - `Compass_Scorecard` → `Oyatie::ServiceCatalog::scorecard` (with criteria + evaluation-logic + score-history).
  - `Compass_Event` → `Oyatie::ServiceCatalog::component_event` (deployment + incident + on-call + release).
  - `JPD_Idea` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::idea` (with insights + impact-effort-score + status-pipeline).
  - `JPD_Insight` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::idea_insight` (with source-attribution + excerpt).
  - `Atlassian_Intelligence_Action` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::ai_action` (with type + result + confidence + reviewed-flag).
  - `Atlassian_Analytics_Dashboard` → `Oyatie::Analytics::dashboard` (with cross-product chart-bindings).
  - `Atlassian_Access_Org` → `Oyatie::Identity::org` (with SSO + SCIM + audit-stream config).
  - `Forge_App` → `Oyatie::Marketplace::forge_app` (with manifest + modules + tenant-installations).
  - `Smart_Link_Provider` → `Oyatie::Community::smart_link_provider`.
  - `Cross_Product_Webhook` → `Oyatie::ApiGw::cross_product_webhook`.

- **Specific workflow steps** (Open DevOps displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant inventory of Jira projects (D-034) + Bitbucket workspaces (D-037) + Confluence spaces (D-036) + Opsgenie teams + Compass components + JPD projects + installed Forge/apps + Atlassian Analytics dashboards + Atlassian Access org config.
  2. **Cross-product link extraction**: per-Cross_Product_Link export via GraphQL `/gateway/api/graphql`; per-link source + target + link-type + tenant preserved.
  3. **Per-subsystem extraction**: leverage D-034 + D-036 + D-037 + D-085-Opsgenie playbooks; coordinate timing for cross-product consistency window.
  4. **Compass component extraction**: per-component dependency-graph + scorecard + event-history; per-team ownership binding.
  5. **JPD extraction**: per-idea + per-insight + per-prioritization-matrix-config; per-idea-to-epic link history preserved.
  6. **Atlassian Intelligence audit-trail**: per-AI-action history retained for compliance; per-action confidence + reviewer + reviewed-at.
  7. **Atlassian Analytics extraction**: per-dashboard + per-chart SQL → Oyatie Analytics query transformation; per-data-lake schema mapped.
  8. **Atlassian Access export**: SAML + SCIM + audit-stream + IP-allowlist + data-residency policy → Oyatie identity config.
  9. **Forge / app inventory**: per-app manifest + tenant-installs → marketplace; per-app gap-list + replacement-mapping + re-deploy on Oyatie Forge-runtime.
  10. **Smart-Link provider extraction**: per-URL-pattern auto-card-renderer + auth-method → Oyatie smart-link registry.
  11. **Cross-product permission intersection backfill**: per-link compute effective permission (Jira-view AND Confluence-view AND Bitbucket-view), record in Cedar policy.
  12. **Cross-product webhook re-register**: per-Webhook URL + filter + auth-token → Oyatie cross-product event-bus.
  13. **Cross-product unified-search re-index**: federated search across Jira / Bitbucket / Confluence / Opsgenie / Compass.
  14. **Parallel run**: 60-day shadow with cross-product link traversal + Smart-Link card-render + scorecard-eval + AI-action invocation parity ≥ 99.9%.
  15. **Cutover**: per-subsystem cut-over per its own dossier; per-cross-product-link URL preservation for 24 months.
  16. **Sunset**: per-product license sunset; cross-product link history retained per tenant policy.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Cross-product link orphan** (issue references PR in repo that was deleted): per-link periodic-validate + soft-remove with tombstone + UI degraded-card.
  - **Cross-product permission divergence** (Jira allows view but Confluence does not): per-link permission-intersection display + per-product fallback.
  - **Product-discovery-to-epic conversion loss** (JPD custom fields dropped on epic promote): per-field mapping registry + lossy-disclosure UI + manual-resolve.
  - **Scorecard-metric staleness** (per-criterion data source unavailable): per-metric pull-cadence + freshness-floor + stale-badge.
  - **Cross-product search index divergence** (Confluence indexed but Jira not): per-product index + federated query with per-product health-check + degraded-search-mode.
  - **Atlassian Intelligence hallucination** (AI summary mis-states issue state): per-AI-action confidence-threshold + human-review-gate for HIGH-stakes actions.
  - **Forge app sandbox-escape attempt**: per-Forge-module sandboxed-runtime + permission-scope enforce + suspicious-pattern detect + revoke.
  - **Atlassian Analytics SQL cost-spike** (full-table-scan on cross-product table): per-query cost-estimate + reject-above-budget + auto-suggest index.
  - **Smart-Link provider auth-token leak** (cached card includes Bearer token): per-URL token-scrub + refresh-on-render + provider audit.
  - **Atlassian Access SCIM-deprovision-cascade** (SCIM removes user → loses Jira access → cross-product link orphans): per-user soft-deprovision + grace-period + cross-link-handoff.
  - **Cross-product webhook fan-out storm** (1 source event triggers 50 webhook fan-outs across products): per-webhook fan-out-cap + idempotency + dedup.
  - **JPD-to-Jira-epic backfire** (idea promoted but epic discarded; insight history lost): per-idea status-lifecycle + insight-archive on idea-archive.
  - **Compass component-rename break** (renaming Compass component breaks all linked dashboards): per-rename historical-alias + URL-redirect + dashboard-refresh.
  - **Atlassian Access dual-issuer SSO downtime** (SAML issuer migration mid-flight): per-app dual-issuer window + cutover-test.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Atlassian REST + GraphQL `/gateway/api/graphql` + Forge admin API + per-product migration assistants; format — JSON / ADF / Forge-manifest YAML; duration — ~5-7 days per org with cross-product orchestration; bandwidth — heavy on cross-product link traversal.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — Cross_Product_Link preserved with source+target+type; Compass component + scorecard + event preserved; JPD idea+insight preserved; Atlassian Intelligence action history preserved with confidence; lossy — some Atlassian-Intelligence-only models rebuilt natively; some Marketplace apps no replacement (gap-list).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-subsystem cut-over per its own dossier; cross-product link URL preservation for 24 months; per-Smart-Link provider re-register; per-Forge-app re-deploy; per-cross-product-webhook re-register; per-Atlassian-Analytics dashboard re-bind.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-day shadow with cross-product link traversal parity + Smart-Link card-render parity + scorecard-eval parity + AI-action invocation parity ≥ 99.9% + cross-product search recall ≥ 99% + cross-product permission intersection parity 100%; sunset — per-product license sunset with cross-product link history retained per tenant policy.

- Workflow template library: `devops.issue-to-deploy` (Jira-Bitbucket-Pipelines bridge); `devops.incident-to-postmortem` (Opsgenie-to-Confluence); `devops.idea-to-epic-to-release` (Jira-Product-Discovery to Jira to Bitbucket); `devops.service-catalog-scorecard`; `devops.cross-product-search-federate`; `devops.atlassian-intelligence-invoke-with-confidence-gate`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar engineer + EM + PM; desktop-primary with cross-product navigation; per-team scorecard tile; cross-product Smart-Link auto-card on every text-input.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + SLSA-L3 + supply-chain attestation; per-tenant data-residency (US / EU / AU); FedRAMP-Mod/High for federal-dev tenants; per-tenant audit-stream retention.
- Migration path from vendor: per individual subsystem (D-034 + D-036 + D-037 + D-085) + per-cross-link integration mapping (Jira-issue ↔ Bitbucket-PR ↔ Confluence-page ↔ Opsgenie-incident ↔ Compass-service).
- Naming justification: composed of canonical names; `atlassian-open-devops` is benchmark alias only.

### Section D-040 - Microsoft Dynamics 365
- Vendor name and category: Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Microsoft ecosystem / CRM + ERP platform (Sales / Customer Service / Marketing / Field Service / Finance / Supply Chain Management / Commerce / Human Resources / Project Operations / Customer Insights — Data + Journeys / Business Central / Fraud Protection / Customer Voice / Sales Insights / Customer Service Insights / Connected Spaces / Intelligent Order Management / Remote Assist).
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `crm` + `finance-erp` (per ADR-0315) + `marketing-automation` + `itsm` + `field-service` + `commerce` (marketplace) + `hcm` + per-app capability tier). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: per-D365-app license tier maps via lookup — D365 Sales Professional → **Bronze**; D365 Sales Enterprise → **Silver**; D365 Sales Premium → **Gold**; D365 Sales Premium + Copilot for Sales → **Platinum** (mirrored for each D365 app).
- Oyatie destination: per-D365-app routing — Sales → `crm` (Lead + Opportunity + Account + Contact + Quote + Order + Invoice); Customer Service → `itsm` + `crm`; Marketing / Customer Insights → `marketing-automation`; Field Service → `field-service` + `cloud-iot`; Finance + Supply Chain + Project Operations + Business Central → `finance-erp` per ADR-0315; HR → `hcm`; Commerce → `commerce` + `pos`; Customer Voice → `survey`; Sales Insights / Service Insights → `intelligence`; Dataverse → `ontology`; Power Automate → `workflow-engine`; Power Apps → `workflow-studio`; Power BI → `analytics`; Copilot for D365 → `intelligence`; AppSource → `marketplace`.

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (D365 / Dataverse model):

  - `Dataverse_Attribute` (Logical_Name, Type {String / Memo / Integer / Decimal / Boolean / DateTime / Lookup / OptionSet / MultiSelectOptionSet / Image / File}, Required_Level, Max_Length, Format).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:

  - Microsoft Graph cross-product API: `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/...` for cross-D365-product entity access.
