- **Cedar permit shape** (per-D365-entity, e.g., Opportunity):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<sales-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CrmCreateOpportunity", Oyatie::Action::"CrmUpdateOpportunity",
      Oyatie::Action::"CrmAdvanceBPFStage", Oyatie::Action::"CrmCloseOpportunityWon",
      Oyatie::Action::"CrmCloseOpportunityLost", Oyatie::Action::"CrmCreateQuote",
      Oyatie::Action::"CrmCreateOrder", Oyatie::Action::"CrmAssignOwner",
      Oyatie::Action::"CrmInvokeCopilot", Oyatie::Action::"CrmRunFetchXmlQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"CrmRunPowerAutomateFlow", Oyatie::Action::"CrmImportSolution",
      Oyatie::Action::"CrmConfigureSecurityRole", Oyatie::Action::"CrmExportDataverseEntity"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Opportunity::"<opp-id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    security_role_privilege_grants(principal, action, resource, context.depth_scope) &&
    business_unit_ownership_allows(principal.business_unit, resource.owning_business_unit, context.depth_scope) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CrmAdvanceBPFStage" ? bpf_required_fields_satisfied(resource, context.target_stage) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CrmCloseOpportunityWon" ? resource.has_at_least_one_quote || resource.has_at_least_one_order : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CrmInvokeCopilot" ? context.pack.allows_ai_processing(resource.classification) && ai_consent_recorded(principal, resource) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CrmImportSolution" ? principal.has_role("SystemAdministrator") && solution_security_reviewed(context.solution) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CrmConfigureSecurityRole" ? principal.has_role("SystemAdministrator") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CrmRunFetchXmlQuery" ? fetchxml_within_resource_quota(context.query) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.industry == "Banking" ? context.pack.contains("FFIEC") || context.pack.contains("BankRegFIScopeKR") : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Account` → `Oyatie::Crm::account` (with parent + industry + revenue + ownership).
  - `Contact` → `Oyatie::Crm::contact` (with parent-customer + job-title + manager).
  - `Lead` → `Oyatie::Crm::lead` (with source + status + score).
  - `Opportunity` → `Oyatie::Crm::opportunity` (with stage + probability + BPF binding).
  - `Quote` → `Oyatie::Crm::quote` (with quote-lines + effective-window).
  - `Order` → `Oyatie::Crm::sales_order` (with order-lines + pricing-config).
  - `Invoice` → `Oyatie::Crm::invoice` (with invoice-lines + due-date).
  - `Incident` → `Oyatie::Itsm::case` (with priority + SLA + origin).
  - `Workorder` → `Oyatie::FieldService::work_order` (with asset + booking + service-type).
  - `Customerjourney` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::journey` (with trigger + steps + active).
  - `Marketingsegment` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::segment` (with query + refresh-cadence).
  - `Dataverse_Entity` (custom) → `Oyatie::Ontology::custom_entity` (placeholder pending mapping).
  - `Dataverse_Attribute` → `Oyatie::Ontology::attribute` (with type + required-level).
  - `Business_Process_Flow` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::business_process_flow` (with stages + branch-logic).
  - `Power_Automate_Flow_Reference` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::flow_reference`.
  - `Solution` → `Oyatie::Marketplace::solution` (managed/unmanaged + components).
  - `Security_Role` → `Oyatie::Cedar::security_role_template` (with per-entity privilege × depth).

- **Specific workflow steps** (D365 displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant inventory of enabled D365 apps + AppSource installs + Power Apps + Power Automate flows + Power BI workspaces + Customer Insights instances + custom Dataverse entities + custom plugins + security roles.
  2. **Solution export**: per-D365-app solution `.zip` export (managed + unmanaged) with all components — entities + attributes + relationships + forms + views + business-rules + workflows + plugins + web-resources.
  3. **Dataverse entity export**: per-entity record export via Web API (OData v4) with attachments + image-fields + file-fields + audit-history.
  4. **Per-D365-app data extraction**: Sales (Account/Contact/Lead/Opportunity/Quote/Order/Invoice/Activity); Service (Case/Knowledge-Article/Entitlement/SLA); Marketing (Journey/Segment/Email-Template/Event); Field Service (WorkOrder/Asset/Booking/Resource); Finance (GL/Vendor/Customer/Bank-Account/Journal); Supply Chain (Item/PO/Receipt/Inventory); HR (Worker/Position/Compensation/Leave); Project Operations (Project/Task/Time-Entry/Expense); Commerce (Catalog/Channel/Order/Customer-Loyalty).
  5. **Power Automate Flow export**: per-flow `.json` + connection-references + environment-variables + on-prem-gateway dependency-map.
  6. **Power Apps export**: per-canvas-app `.msapp` (Power-Fx preserved) + per-model-driven-app sitemap + form + view.
  7. **Custom plugin migration**: per-plugin (.NET assembly) decompile + step-config export → re-implement on Oyatie workflow-engine sandbox-runtime.
  8. **Business Process Flow export**: per-BPF stages + steps + branch-logic + entity-bindings.
  9. **Security role export**: per-role per-entity privilege × depth → Cedar policy template; per-team membership → Oyatie team binding.
  10. **AppSource ISV solution inventory**: per-installed-ISV per-license per-replacement-mapping.
  11. **Customer Insights data-source migration**: per-source ingestion-config + per-unified-profile lineage + per-measure + per-segment.
  12. **Per-D365-app destination shell**: Sales → `crm` workspace; Service → `itsm` workspace; Field Service → blue-collar mobile shell + dispatch desktop.
  13. **Per-tenant SSO + SCIM migration**: Entra ID config → Oyatie identity per D-051.
  14. **Parallel run**: 60-90 day shadow with sample sales-pipeline + case-flow + workorder + journey-execute + Power-Automate-Flow parity ≥ 99.9%.
  15. **Cutover**: per-D365-app cut-over with URL-redirect for 24 months; per-Power-Automate-Flow re-bind; per-Power-App publish; per-AppSource-app re-install or replace.
  16. **Sunset**: per-D365-app license sunset; Dataverse retention per tenant policy (typically 7-10 years for regulated tenants).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Dataverse custom-entity orphan** (custom entity with no clear Oyatie mapping): per-entity placeholder + manual-mapping queue + per-tenant review.
  - **Power-Automate Flow with on-premises-data-gateway** (flow depends on on-prem SQL): per-flow dependency export + gateway-replacement plan + bridge-connector.
  - **Per-D365-app license-bleed** (one app sees data from another via shared Dataverse): per-app Cedar scope check + cross-app audit.
  - **Cross-D365-app embedded view break** (Sales embeds Customer-Service case in Account form): per-embed re-implementation via cross-µservice projection iframe.
  - **Plugin assembly (.NET DLL)** with custom code: per-plugin migration to Oyatie workflow-engine step + sandbox-runtime + per-plugin code-review gate.
  - **BPF stage-skip on stage-gate change** (in-flight opportunities with deprecated stage): per-BPF historical-stage-pin + manual-advance UI.
  - **Security role depth-scope drift** (BU-Children depth interprets differently in target): per-role golden-test + audit.
  - **FetchXML query-syntax drift** (FetchXML semantics ≠ Oyatie-Query-Language): per-query transformation + golden-test on row-set parity.
  - **Customer Insights profile-unification drift** (match-rules merge profiles differently): per-rule golden-test + per-profile lineage-audit.
  - **Journey mid-execution carryover** (customers paused mid-step on cutover): per-journey checkpoint + resume + de-dup.
  - **Field Service booking-conflict on cutover** (scheduled workorders with stale resources): per-booking re-confirm + per-resource availability re-sync.
  - **Per-Currency-Exchange-Rate drift** (D365 multi-currency rounding differs): per-amount golden-test + rounding-policy-pin.
  - **AppSource ISV gap** (installed ISV with no Oyatie marketplace equivalent): per-ISV replacement-mapping or feature-loss-disclosure.
  - **Solution dependency-cycle on import** (A depends on B depends on A): per-solution topological-import + cycle-break manual-resolve.
  - **Audit-history pagination loss** (audit table > 10M rows hits Web API throttle): per-entity bulk-export with backoff + dual-read verifier.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Power Platform CLI (pac) + Dataverse Web API + Configuration Migration Tool + per-D365-app data-management framework (DMF) + AppSource API; format — JSON / OData / `.zip` solution / `.msapp` / `.csproj`; duration — ~2-4 weeks per tenant depending on app count and data volume; bandwidth — heavy on Dataverse entity-records.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — per-D365-app entity → Oyatie µservice; custom Dataverse entities to ontology with placeholder; per-Security-Role to Cedar policy template; per-BPF to workflow-engine BPF; per-Power-Automate-Flow to workflow-engine; per-Power-App to workflow-studio; lossy — Atlassian Intelligence / Copilot models rebuilt natively on Oyatie intelligence; some AppSource ISVs no replacement (gap-list with feature-loss-disclosure).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-D365-app cut-over with URL-redirect for 24 months; per-Power-Automate-Flow re-bind; per-Power-App publish; per-AppSource-app re-install or replace; per-tenant SSO + SCIM via Entra ID per D-051 cutover.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-90 day shadow with sample sales-pipeline + case-flow + workorder + journey-execute + Power-Automate-Flow parity ≥ 99.9% + per-entity row-count parity 100% + per-audit-history retention parity 100%; sunset — per-D365-app license sunset; Dataverse retention per tenant policy (7-10 years regulated; indefinite for legal-hold).

- Workflow template library: per-D365-app workflow → oyatie workflow-template; `dynamics.power-automate-flow-import`; `dynamics.business-process-flow-import`; `dynamics.dataverse-entity-projection`; `dynamics.security-role-to-cedar`; `dynamics.customer-insights-profile-unification-import`.
- UX shell adaptation: per-D365-app destination shell (e.g., Sales → `crm` workspace; Field Service → blue-collar mobile + dispatch desktop); per-tenant theming; Copilot-side-panel as Oyatie-Intelligence-side-panel.
- Pack overlay applicable: per-D365-app — SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA baseline; per-vertical pack (Healthcare/HIPAA + KR-medical for Health-Accelerator; Banking/FFIEC + KR-BankRegFIScope for FSI-Accelerator; Public Sector/FedRAMP-High + KR-public-records for Government); FDA-Part-11 for life-sciences Field Service; SOX for Finance.
- Naming justification: per-canonical-µservice; `microsoft-dynamics-365` and per-D365-app names are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-041 - Microsoft Power Apps
- Vendor name and category: Microsoft Power Apps / Microsoft ecosystem / low-code app builder — Canvas Apps + Model-Driven Apps + Dataverse + Custom Pages + AI Builder + Component Framework (PCF) + Power Apps Portals (now Power Pages, see D-044) + Mobile-Player + Embed-in-Teams.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `workflow-studio` + `ontology` + `apigw` + `plugin-app-store`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Canvas-app with standard connectors → **Bronze**; Canvas-app with premium connectors + Dataverse → **Silver**; Model-driven app with security-roles + BPF + Dataverse → **Gold**; AI Builder + PCF + ALM + Managed Environments + DLP-policies → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `workflow-studio` (canvas-app UI builder + model-driven app); `ontology` (Dataverse projection per D-040 entity model); `apigw` (custom connector + premium connector); `plugin-app-store` (publish-to-org analog + AppSource); `intelligence` (AI Builder models); `cloud-iac` (Managed Environment + on-prem data gateway); `identity` (per-app sharing + per-role access).

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<maker-or-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeCreateApp", Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeEditApp",
      Oyatie::Action::"LowCodePublishApp", Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeShareApp",
      Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeRunApp", Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeRunPowerFxFormula",
      Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeInstallConnector", Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeConfigureEnvironment",
      Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeCreateDataverseTable", Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeImportSolution",
      Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeExportAppPackage", Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeTrainAIBuilderModel",
      Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeInvokeAIBuilderModel", Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeConfigureDLP",
      Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeDeployPCFControl"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::LowCodeApp::"<app-id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    environment_scoped_role_grants(principal, action, resource.environment) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeConfigureDLP" ? principal.has_role("PowerPlatformAdmin") || principal.has_role("EnvironmentAdmin") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeInstallConnector" ? connector_license_present(principal, context.connector) && !dlp_policy_blocks(resource.environment, context.connector) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeImportSolution" ? principal.has_role("EnvironmentAdmin") && solution_security_reviewed(context.solution) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeRunPowerFxFormula" ? formula_runtime_budget_available(principal, context.budget) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeTrainAIBuilderModel" ? context.pack.allows_ai_training(context.dataset.classification) && ai_dataset_consent_recorded(context.dataset) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"LowCodeInvokeAIBuilderModel" ? context.pack.allows_ai_processing(resource.classification) : true) &&
    (resource.requires_premium_license ? user_has_premium_license(principal) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

  - `Connection_Reference` → `Oyatie::ApiGw::connection_reference` (with per-env override).
  - `Power_Fx_Formula` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::formula` (with expression + return-type + dependencies).
  - `Dataverse_Table` / `Dataverse_Column` / `Dataverse_Relationship` → per D-040 ontology mapping.
  - `Business_Rule` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::business_rule` (with scope + conditions + actions).
  - `Component_Framework_Control` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::pcf_control` (with manifest + TS-bundle + CSS-bundle).
  - `AI_Builder_Model` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::ai_builder_model` (with type + dataset + accuracy + published-flag).
  - `Dlp_Policy` → `Oyatie::Compliance::dlp_policy` (with connector-grouping + environment-binding).
  - `Solution` → `Oyatie::Marketplace::solution` (per D-040).
  - `Sharing_Role_Assignment` → `Oyatie::Cedar::app_sharing_role_assignment`.

- **Specific workflow steps** (Power Apps displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant per-environment per-app inventory; per-environment DLP-policy + Managed-Environment-flag; per-environment connector + AI-Builder-model + PCF-control + custom-connector inventory.
  2. **Solution export**: per-solution `.zip` (managed + unmanaged) with all app + flow + entity + role + business-rule + custom-connector + AI-Builder-model artifacts.
  3. **Canvas-app extraction**: per-app `.msapp` via `pac canvas pack/unpack` with Power-Fx formula-bundle preserved; per-app screen-tree + control-properties + theme + media-asset.
  4. **Model-driven-app extraction**: per-app sitemap + forms (Main / Quick-View / Quick-Create / Card) + views + charts + dashboards + business-rules + role-bindings.
  5. **Custom-page extraction**: per-page Power-Fx + embedded-in model-driven-app reference.
  6. **Custom-connector extraction**: per-connector OpenAPI v2 manifest + operations + auth-config + rate-limits.
  7. **Connection-reference extraction**: per-environment per-reference auth-config + per-env-override values.
  8. **PCF control extraction**: per-control manifest.xml + TypeScript bundle + CSS bundle + dependency packages.
  9. **AI Builder model extraction**: per-model type + training-dataset (with sensitivity-classification) + accuracy + published-version + invocation-history.
  10. **DLP-policy extraction**: per-policy connector-grouping (Business / Non-Business / Blocked) + custom-pattern + environment-binding.
  11. **Dataverse entity export**: per D-040 (since Power Apps Dataverse shares schema with D365).
  12. **Sharing role-assignment extraction**: per-app per-user/group/team/tenant role.
  13. **Power-Fx formula migration**: per-formula AST-parse + per-built-in-function compatibility-mapping + per-data-source rebind + per-control reference-update.
  14. **Per-app destination shell**: canvas-app → workflow-studio canvas; model-driven-app → workflow-studio model-driven; custom-page → embedded canvas-page.
  15. **Parallel run**: 60-day shadow with per-app function-execution parity + per-formula golden-test ≥ 99.9% + per-AI-Builder-model accuracy delta < 1%.
  16. **Cutover**: per-app cut-over with URL-redirect for 24 months; per-Power-Apps-Mobile-Player re-distribute; per-custom-connector re-publish; per-AI-Builder-model re-publish.
  17. **Sunset**: per-environment + per-app Power Apps license sunset; Dataverse retention per D-040 cutover.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Power-Fx formula-semantics drift** (formula behavior diverges between source and target): per-formula compatibility-shim + golden-test set + per-built-in-function mapping registry + lossy-disclosure UI.
  - **Premium-connector license-bleed** (citizen-dev uses premium connector without license): per-connector license-check at runtime + per-user license-bind audit + UI degraded-mode.
  - **Dataverse-table relationship-cardinality mismatch** (1:N vs N:N drift on import): per-relationship cardinality-pin at import + per-pair validator.
  - **Solution-import dependency-graph break** (managed solution layer ordering wrong): per-solution topological-import with rollback + per-component-version pin.
  - **Canvas-app screen-size variance** (mobile vs tablet vs desktop): per-screen layout-pin + responsive-shim + per-form-factor test-recorder.
  - **PCF control sandbox-escape attempt** (custom TypeScript with DOM-access beyond control-bounds): per-PCF sandboxed-runtime + permission-scope enforce + suspicious-pattern detect.
  - **AI Builder model accuracy regression** (re-trained model drift > threshold): per-model golden-set validation + accuracy-floor + auto-rollback.
  - **AI Builder dataset PII-bleed** (training data includes PII not consented for AI training): per-dataset classification + consent-gate + redaction.
  - **DLP-policy connector-classification mismatch** (vendor Business-class connector mapped to Oyatie Non-Business): per-policy review + per-tenant override.
  - **Custom-connector OAuth-token rotation lag** (per-connection token expires mid-run): per-connection token-refresh + retry + alert.
  - **Connection-reference per-env-override missing on import**: per-reference per-env validator + UI warning.
  - **Canvas-app variable scope-bleed** (global / context / collection variable mis-mapped): per-variable scope-pin + per-formula re-bind.
  - **Mobile-Player offline-sync conflict** (offline edits collide on sync): per-collection conflict-resolver + per-record vector-clock.
  - **PCF control framework-version drift** (control built for older PCF version): per-control version-pin + compatibility-shim.
  - **Solution-managed-layer "stuck"** (managed component prevents unmanaged override): per-layer audit + per-component force-replace UI.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — `pac canvas pack/unpack` + `pac solution export/import` + Power Apps Admin REST + Dataverse Web API + PCF Control SDK + AI Builder REST; format — `.msapp` / `.zip` solution / `.json` connector-manifest / `.csproj`; duration — ~1-3 weeks per tenant depending on app count and Dataverse volume; bandwidth — heavy on PCF bundles + AI Builder datasets.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — per-canvas-app `.msapp` Power-Fx formula preserved with compatibility-shim; per-model-driven-app sitemap + form + view preserved; per-custom-connector OpenAPI-v2 preserved; per-PCF control TypeScript preserved with sandboxed-runtime; per-AI-Builder model per-type re-train if accuracy drift > 1%; lossy — some Premium-only built-in functions rebuilt natively; some PCF-control browser-only APIs unavailable in sandbox (gap-list with feature-loss-disclosure).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-app cut-over with URL-redirect for 24 months; per-Power-Apps-Mobile-Player re-distribute; per-custom-connector re-publish; per-AI-Builder-model re-publish; per-DLP-policy re-bind; per-environment Managed-Environment-flag re-apply.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-day shadow with per-app function-execution parity + per-formula golden-test ≥ 99.9% + per-AI-Builder-model accuracy delta < 1% + per-PCF control render-parity + per-canvas-app screen-size-render-parity + per-DLP-policy enforcement parity 100%; sunset — per-environment + per-app Power Apps license sunset; Dataverse retention per tenant policy.

- Workflow template library: `lowcode.canvas-app-publish-with-formula-validation`; `lowcode.model-driven-app-publish-with-form-script`; `lowcode.connector-rate-limit-policy`; `lowcode.dataverse-table-projection-to-ontology`; `lowcode.solution-import-export`; `lowcode.ai-builder-train-with-consent-gate`; `lowcode.pcf-control-publish-with-sandbox-attestation`; `lowcode.dlp-policy-enforce`.
- UX shell adaptation: citizen-developer + pro-dev mixed; desktop-primary canvas-designer; per-app preview on mobile + desktop simulator; in-Teams embed shell for Teams-published apps.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + supplier-security (per-connector + per-third-party-app supply-chain attestation); per-AI-Builder pack-allows-AI-training gate.
- Naming justification: `workflow-studio` is canonical; `microsoft-power-apps` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-042 - Microsoft Power BI
- Vendor name and category: Microsoft Power BI / Microsoft ecosystem / BI + analytics + paginated-report + dataflow + datamart + semantic-model + Power BI Service + Power BI Desktop + Power BI Mobile + Power BI Embedded + Power BI Premium + Microsoft Fabric integration (Lakehouse / OneLake / Direct Lake).
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `analytics` + `data-pipeline` (Power BI Dataflows) + `data-warehouse` (semantic-model) + `intelligence`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Power BI Free + Desktop → **Bronze**; Power BI Pro per-user license + workspace sharing → **Silver**; Power BI Premium per-user + paginated reports + AI visuals → **Gold**; Power BI Premium per-capacity + Fabric integration + Copilot for BI + Direct Lake on OneLake + multi-geo → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `analytics` (report + dashboard + visual + scorecard); `data-pipeline` (Power BI Dataflow + datamart); `data-warehouse` (semantic-model = DAX-driven calculation layer; Direct Lake on OneLake bridge); `intelligence` (Power BI Q&A natural-language + Copilot for BI + AI Insights); `cloud-iac` (per-capacity premium SKU sizing + per-region multi-geo); `identity` (per-RLS-role + per-OLS-role); `apigw` (per-Embedded-token + per-Direct-Query gateway).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Power BI tenant model):
  - `Workspace` (Workspace_ID, Name, Type {Personal / Shared / Premium / Pro / Premium-Per-User}, Capacity_Reference, Region, State {Active / Deleted}, Users[Workspace_Role: Admin / Member / Contributor / Viewer], Description).
  - `Report` (Report_ID, Name, Workspace_Reference, Dataset_Reference, Type {Power-BI / Paginated}, Pages[Page_ID → Visuals[Visual_ID → Type + DataBindings + Filters]], Bookmarks[], Theme, Layout {Phone-Layout / Desktop-Layout / Tablet-Layout}, Published_Version).
  - `Dataset` / `Semantic_Model` (Dataset_ID, Name, Workspace_Reference, Mode {Import / DirectQuery / Composite / Live-Connection / Direct-Lake}, Tables[Table_Name → Columns + Measures + Calculated-Columns + Calculation-Groups + Hierarchies + Partitions], Relationships[From_Table.From_Column → To_Table.To_Column + Cardinality {1-to-1 / 1-to-Many / Many-to-1 / Many-to-Many} + Direction {Single / Both}], DAX_Measures[Measure_Name → Expression + Format-String + Display-Folder], M_Queries[Query_Name → Power-Query-M-Script], Refresh_Schedule, Storage_Format {Tabular / Multidimensional}, Compatibility_Level).
  - `Dataflow` (Dataflow_ID, Name, Workspace_Reference, Power_Query_M_Bundle, Entities[Entity_Name → Query], Linked_Entities, Computed_Entities, Refresh_Schedule, Incremental_Refresh_Policy, Enhanced_Compute_Engine: bool).
  - `Datamart` (Datamart_ID, Name, Workspace_Reference, Backing_SQL_DB_Reference, Auto_Generated_Semantic_Model_Reference).
  - `Dashboard` (Dashboard_ID, Name, Workspace_Reference, Tiles[Tile_ID → Source_Visual / Source_Dataset / Source_Report], Layout, Data_Alerts_Bound[]).
  - `Paginated_Report` (Report_ID, Name, Workspace_Reference, RDL_Bundle, Parameters[Param_Name → Type + Default + Allowed-Values], Data_Sources_Bound[], Subscriptions_Bound[]).

  - `Deployment_Pipeline` (Pipeline_ID, Name, Stages {Dev / Test / Prod}, Workspace_Per_Stage, Rules[Rule_ID → Dataset_Parameter_Override + Data_Source_Override + RLS_Member_Override]).

  - `Object_Level_Security_Role` (Role_ID, Dataset_Reference, Hidden_Tables[], Hidden_Columns[], Members).
  - `Data_Gateway` (Gateway_ID, Type {Personal / Standard / VNet}, Cluster_Members[], Region, Data_Sources_Bound[]).
  - `Data_Source` (Source_ID, Type {SQL-Server / Oracle / PostgreSQL / MySQL / SharePoint / Web / Excel / Snowflake / BigQuery / Redshift / Salesforce / Dynamics / OData / etc.}, Credential_Reference, Privacy_Level {None / Public / Organizational / Private}).
  - `Capacity` (Capacity_ID, SKU {EM1-EM3 / A1-A6 / P1-P5 / F-SKU-Fabric}, Region, State {Active / Paused}, Workloads {Datasets / Dataflows / Paginated / AI / AutomatedML}).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<analyst-or-viewer-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"BiCreateReport", Oyatie::Action::"BiEditReport",
      Oyatie::Action::"BiPublishReport", Oyatie::Action::"BiShareReport",
      Oyatie::Action::"BiEmbedReport", Oyatie::Action::"BiRefreshDataset",
      Oyatie::Action::"BiScheduleRefresh", Oyatie::Action::"BiCreateDataflow",
      Oyatie::Action::"BiRunDataflow", Oyatie::Action::"BiCreatePaginatedReport",
      Oyatie::Action::"BiRunPaginatedExport", Oyatie::Action::"BiConfigureRLS",
      Oyatie::Action::"BiConfigureOLS", Oyatie::Action::"BiRunQAndAQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"BiRunDAXQuery", Oyatie::Action::"BiPromoteToPipelineStage",
      Oyatie::Action::"BiInvokeCopilot", Oyatie::Action::"BiSubscribeReport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::Report::"<report-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Dataset::"<dataset-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Workspace::"<ws-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    workspace_role_grants(principal, action, resource.workspace) &&
    row_level_security_evaluates(principal, resource.dataset, context.row_predicates) &&
    object_level_security_visible(principal, resource.dataset, context.requested_columns) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"BiPromoteToPipelineStage" ? principal.has_role("PipelineAdmin") && all_required_rules_pass(context.pipeline, context.target_stage) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"BiConfigureRLS" ? principal.has_role("WorkspaceAdmin") || principal.has_role("DatasetOwner") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"BiEmbedReport" ? embed_token_within_budget(context.embed_token, resource) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"BiRefreshDataset" ? gateway_credentials_valid(resource.gateway) && capacity_has_budget(resource.capacity, "refresh") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"BiInvokeCopilot" ? context.pack.allows_ai_processing(resource.classification) && ai_consent_recorded(principal, resource) : true) &&
    (resource.sensitivity_label == "HighlyConfidential" ? principal.has_clearance(resource.sensitivity_label) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && capacity_pinned_to_region(resource.capacity, "EU") : true) &&
    (resource.contains_sox_financial_data ? context.pack.contains("SOX") && audit_trail_present(action, principal) : true) &&
    (resource.contains_phi ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && phi_minimum_necessary_check(principal, context.requested_columns) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Workspace` → `Oyatie::Analytics::workspace` (with capacity + region + roles).
  - `Report` → `Oyatie::Analytics::report` (with pages + visuals + bookmarks + theme + layout).
  - `Dataset` / `Semantic_Model` → `Oyatie::DataWarehouse::semantic_model` (with tables + relationships + measures + queries + mode).
  - `Dataflow` → `Oyatie::DataPipeline::dataflow` (with M-script + entities + incremental-refresh-policy).
  - `Datamart` → `Oyatie::DataWarehouse::datamart` (with backing-SQL + auto-semantic-model).
  - `Dashboard` → `Oyatie::Analytics::dashboard` (with tiles + alert-bindings).
  - `Paginated_Report` → `Oyatie::Analytics::paginated_report` (with RDL + parameters + subscriptions).
  - `App` → `Oyatie::Analytics::app` (with audiences + content-subset).
  - `Deployment_Pipeline` → `Oyatie::Analytics::deployment_pipeline` (with stages + rules).
  - `Row_Level_Security_Role` → `Oyatie::Cedar::rls_role` (projected as Cedar policy with DAX predicate transformation).
  - `Object_Level_Security_Role` → `Oyatie::Cedar::ols_role` (with hidden-tables + hidden-columns).
  - `Data_Gateway` → `Oyatie::DataPipeline::gateway` (with cluster + region + sources).
  - `Data_Source` → `Oyatie::DataPipeline::data_source` (with credential-binding + privacy-level).
  - `Capacity` → `Oyatie::Analytics::capacity` (with SKU + region + workloads).
  - `Subscription` → `Oyatie::Analytics::subscription` (with recipients + cadence + format).
  - `Data_Alert` → `Oyatie::Analytics::data_alert` (with condition + threshold + recipients).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Power BI displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant per-workspace per-capacity inventory; per-tenant Premium + Pro + PPU license counts; per-workspace dataset + report + dashboard + dataflow + datamart + paginated-report + app + scorecard inventory.
  2. **Workspace export**: per-workspace `.pbix` / `.pbit` for every report + dataset; `.rdl` for every paginated-report; per-dataflow M-script; per-datamart SQL schema + data; per-app publication metadata.
  3. **Semantic-model extraction via XMLA**: per-dataset TMSL + TOM extract — tables + columns + measures + calc-groups + hierarchies + partitions + relationships + RLS + OLS.
  4. **DAX-measure extraction**: per-measure expression + format-string + display-folder; per-measure dependency-graph.
  5. **Power-Query M-script extraction**: per-dataset per-query M-script with parameters + applied-steps.
  6. **RLS / OLS role extraction**: per-role DAX filter expression + member list; per-OLS hidden-tables + hidden-columns.
  7. **Gateway extraction**: per-gateway cluster + region + per-data-source credential-reference (move credentials to OpenBao).
  8. **Capacity sizing**: per-capacity SKU + region + workload profile → target Oyatie cluster sizing.
  9. **Deployment-pipeline extraction**: per-pipeline dev/test/prod stage + per-rule (parameter + source + RLS member override).
  10. **Subscription + Data Alert extraction**: per-subscription cadence + recipients + format; per-alert condition + threshold + recipients.
  11. **Scorecard / Metric extraction**: per-metric owner + target + current + historical + linked-visual.
  12. **DAX → Oyatie-Analytics-DAX-Dialect transformation**: per-measure AST-parse + per-built-in-function compatibility-mapping + per-time-intelligence-function preserve + per-context-transition preserve.
  13. **M → Oyatie-Pipeline-Transformation transformation**: per-applied-step compatibility-mapping.
  14. **Per-workspace destination shell**: report → analytics workspace; dashboard → analytics dashboard; dataset → data-warehouse semantic-model; dataflow → data-pipeline.
  15. **Embed-token re-issuance**: per-Embedded-app token-mint endpoint re-bind.
  16. **Parallel run**: 60-day shadow with per-report render parity (per-page per-visual pixel diff < 1%) + per-measure value parity ≥ 99.99% + per-RLS filter parity 100% + per-refresh schedule parity + per-Q&A query parity ≥ 95%.
  17. **Cutover**: per-workspace cut-over with URL-redirect for 24 months; per-report Embed-URL re-bind; per-app re-publish; per-subscription re-enable; per-Embedded-app re-config.
  18. **Sunset**: Power BI capacity + license sunset; per-tenant dataset retention per policy (7 years for SOX-bound financial reports).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **DAX-measure precision drift** (target SQL semantics ≠ DAX context-transition): per-measure golden-test on per-filter-context test-set + per-time-intelligence corner-case audit.
  - **RLS-policy bypass via DirectQuery** (DirectQuery mode different RLS path than Import mode): per-mode RLS-check + per-mode golden-test.
  - **OLS column-leak via cross-table-relationship** (OLS-hidden column referenced via measure from non-OLS table): per-relationship OLS-propagation audit.
  - **Gateway data-source credential leak**: per-gateway credential-pin + OpenBao reference + per-credential audit on use.
  - **Dataset-refresh-failure cascade** (downstream report broken on refresh fail): per-refresh failure-alert + per-dependent-report grace-render with stale-data-banner.
  - **Deployment-pipeline promotion-race** (two pipeline-admins promote simultaneously): per-stage promote-token + serialize.
  - **Pipeline-rule parameter-override drift** (prod-rule param differs from dev-rule param silently): per-rule diff + warning + manual-approve.
  - **Power-Query M-script source-change** (data source path changed externally): per-query data-source-resolution + alert + manual-fix.
  - **Incremental-refresh partition-mismatch** (partition-key spec changes between source and target): per-partition validator + full-refresh fallback.
  - **Multi-geo dataset-residency violation** (dataset replicates to non-allowed region): per-capacity region-pin + per-dataset residency-policy check on create.
  - **Sensitivity-label downgrade attempt** (user with no clearance saves report as Public): per-action label-downgrade-policy + admin-approval.
  - **Embed-token over-permission** (token issued with too broad RLS-member): per-token RLS-member-scope check + per-token TTL.
  - **Copilot-for-BI DAX-hallucination** (Copilot generates DAX with wrong measure-reference): per-Copilot-output validate-against-model + per-suggestion human-review gate.
  - **Q&A NLP terminology drift** (user-defined synonyms break post-migration): per-synonym registry preserve + per-Q&A query golden-test.
  - **Lineage view stale on rapid edits**: per-tenant lineage-refresh SLA + alert on staleness.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Power BI REST + XMLA-endpoint (TMSL/TOM) + ALM-Toolkit + Tabular-Editor + `.pbix` / `.pbit` / `.rdl` file-format + Power BI Admin REST; format — JSON + TMSL + DAX + M + RDL + binary `.pbix`; duration — ~2-6 weeks per tenant depending on workspace count and dataset complexity; bandwidth — heavy on `.pbix` and dataset-refresh.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — per-dataset TMSL preserved; per-DAX-measure transformed with golden-test; per-M-script transformed with applied-step mapping; per-RLS to Cedar policy with DAX→Cedar predicate transformation; per-OLS to Cedar policy; per-deployment-pipeline stage + rule preserved; lossy — some DAX time-intelligence functions with corner-case edge-behavior rebuilt with golden-test verification; some Power-Query M connectors require Oyatie native connector (gap-list with feature-loss-disclosure).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-workspace cut-over with URL-redirect for 24 months; per-report Embed-URL re-bind; per-app re-publish; per-subscription re-enable; per-Embedded-app re-config; per-capacity region-pin + workload-config re-apply.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-day shadow with per-report render parity (per-page per-visual pixel diff < 1%) + per-measure value parity ≥ 99.99% + per-RLS filter parity 100% + per-OLS visibility parity 100% + per-refresh schedule parity + per-Q&A query parity ≥ 95% + per-Copilot output review-rate; sunset — Power BI capacity + license sunset; per-tenant dataset retention per policy (7 years SOX; 6 years GLBA; tenant-policy-determined non-regulated).

- Workflow template library: `bi.dataset-refresh-on-cadence`; `bi.report-publish-with-RLS-validation`; `bi.dataflow-execute-with-incremental-refresh`; `bi.workspace-promotion-pipeline` (dev → test → prod); `bi.paginated-report-render-and-export`; `bi.embed-token-mint-with-budget`; `bi.copilot-invoke-with-validate-output`; `bi.lineage-refresh-and-impact-analyze`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (BI-author + analyst + executive); desktop-primary report-editor with DAX-editor; tablet for executive read; mobile for offline-favorites; per-workspace permissions.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA; SOX (BI reports used for financial-reporting); HIPAA (PHI-tagged dataset); GLBA (banking BI); FedRAMP-Mod/High (Government cloud); per-tenant data-residency (multi-geo capacity); per-sensitivity-label policy.
- Naming justification: `analytics` + `data-pipeline` + `data-warehouse` are canonical; `microsoft-power-bi` is benchmark alias.

### Section D-043 - Microsoft Power Automate
- Vendor name and category: Microsoft Power Automate (Flow lineage) / Microsoft ecosystem / workflow automation + RPA (Power Automate Desktop) + business-process flow + Process Advisor / Process Mining + AI Builder integration + per-environment Solution + DLP-policy + on-premises Data Gateway + Hosted Machine Group.
- Coverage tier: A (capability tier on `workflow-engine` + `workflow-studio`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: cloud-flows with standard connectors → **Bronze**; cloud-flows with premium connectors + Dataverse → **Silver**; cloud-flows + attended-RPA + AI-Builder → **Gold**; cloud + attended + unattended-RPA + Process Mining + Hosted Machine Groups + Copilot-for-Power-Automate → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `workflow-engine` (flow runtime — Logic-App-DSL execution); `workflow-studio` (flow designer + Process Mining UX); `apigw` (connector registry + per-connector rate-limit + DLP); `intelligence` (AI Builder model invocation + Process Mining); `cloud-iac` (on-prem-data-gateway provisioning + Hosted Machine Group); `compliance` (DLP-policy per-tenant); `identity` (per-flow per-connection-reference per-user binding).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Power Automate platform model):
  - `Flow_Definition` (Flow_ID, Display_Name, Type {Automated / Instant / Scheduled / Approval / Business-Process / Desktop-Flow / Cloud-Flow}, Environment_Reference, Solution_Reference, Trigger {Type + Source-Connector + Filter-Expression + Polling-Cadence-or-Webhook}, Actions[Action_ID → Type + Connector_Reference + Inputs + Outputs + Run-After-Conditions + Retry-Policy], State {Started / Stopped / Suspended}, Owner, Created_On, Modified_On, Published_Version).
  - `Flow_Run` (Run_ID, Flow_Reference, Trigger_Time, Status {Running / Succeeded / Failed / Cancelled / TimedOut}, Inputs, Outputs, Action_Runs[Action_ID → Status + Inputs + Outputs + Duration + Error], Triggered_By_Principal).
  - `Connector` (per D-041 Connector): Standard / Premium / Custom / Independent-Publisher + per-operation per-rate-limit + per-throttle.
  - `Connection_Reference` (per D-041 Connection_Reference).
  - `Environment` (per D-041 Environment).
  - `Environment_Variable` (Variable_Name, Type {String / Number / Boolean / JSON / Data-Source}, Current_Value_Per_Environment[]).
  - `RPA_Bot` (Bot_ID, Type {Attended / Unattended}, Desktop_Flow_Bundle (.ppd), Trigger_Type {Manual / Cloud-Flow-Triggered / Scheduled}, Machine_Group_Reference, Run_Credentials_Reference, Created_On).
  - `Desktop_Flow_Bundle` (Bundle_ID, Steps[Step_ID → Action_Type (UI-Click / Type-Text / Read-Spreadsheet / Run-Script / Wait-For-Image / Extract-OCR / etc.) + Selector + Inputs + Outputs + Error_Handler], Subflows[]).
  - `Machine_Group` (Group_ID, Type {Self-Hosted / Hosted-Microsoft-Managed}, Capacity, Members[Machine_ID → State + Last_Heartbeat], OS_Image_Reference).
  - `AI_Builder_Model_Reference` (per D-041 AI_Builder_Model).
  - `Process_Advisor_Process` (Process_ID, Name, Process_Type {Task-Mining / Process-Mining}, Recordings[], Insights[], Variants[Variant_ID → Steps + Frequency + Duration]).
  - `On_Prem_Data_Gateway` (Gateway_ID, Cluster_Members[], Region, Bound_Data_Sources[], Bound_Connections[]).
  - `Business_Process_Flow_Definition` (per D-040 Business_Process_Flow).
  - `Dlp_Policy` (per D-041 Dlp_Policy with connector-grouping Business / Non-Business / Blocked + Custom-Pattern).
  - `Approval` (Approval_ID, Type {First-To-Respond / Everyone-Must-Respond / Custom-Responses}, Requester, Recipients, Subject, Details, Status {Pending / Approved / Rejected / Cancelled}, Responses[]).
  - `Action_Set` / `Scope` (Container for actions with shared run-after-conditions, used for try-catch-finally pattern).
  - `Hosted_RPA_Run` (Run_ID, Bot_Reference, Machine_Reference, Start_Time, End_Time, Status, Screenshots[], Logs).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Power Automate REST (Maker): per-flow CRUD + per-flow trigger + per-flow run-history.
  - Power Automate Management REST (Admin): per-environment per-tenant DLP + per-environment-variable + per-connection-reference.
  - Flow Designer JSON Schema: per-flow definition as Logic-App-DSL JSON (compatible with Azure Logic Apps).
  - Power Automate Desktop SDK: per-`.ppd` file format + per-action library + COM/UIA selector engine.
  - Power Platform CLI (pac): `pac flow export/import`, `pac connection list/create`, `pac data export/import`.
  - Approvals API: per-approval request + per-response + per-history.
  - Process Advisor API: per-process recording + per-insight + per-variant analysis.
  - AI Builder REST (per D-041): per-model invoke from flow action.
  - Webhooks: per-flow inbound webhook trigger + per-flow outbound HTTP action.
  - Service-Bus + Event-Grid integration for cross-flow async messaging.
  - Custom Connector API + OpenAPI v2 import.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Flow Designer (Cloud)" — vertical step-list with trigger at top + actions cascading + per-action expand/collapse + run-after-conditions + per-action input/output binding via dynamic-content picker + expression-builder.
  - "Flow Run History" — per-flow per-run timeline with success/fail per-step + replay-from-step.
  - "Flow Templates Gallery" — per-template browse + customize before deploy.
  - "Connections Library" — per-environment per-connector per-connection list + auth-status.
  - "Power Automate Desktop Designer" — RPA designer with action-pane on left + step-canvas in middle + UI-element selector + variables-pane on right.
  - "Machine Group Console" — per-group per-machine state + heartbeat + assign-bot.
  - "Process Advisor Recordings" — per-recording playback with step-by-step variant analysis + bottleneck-highlight.
  - "Approvals Center" — per-user assigned + history with respond inline.
  - "Solution Explorer" — per-solution flow + connection-reference + environment-variable + AI-Builder-model.
  - "DLP Policy Editor" — per-policy connector grouping + custom pattern.
  - "Run-Now" — manual trigger with input parameters.
  - "Test Pane" — per-flow per-test-input run with assert.
  - "AI Builder Integration Pane" — drop-in flow-step using AI-Builder model.
  - "Copilot for Power Automate" — natural-language flow-creation pane.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<maker-or-runner-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"FlowCreate", Oyatie::Action::"FlowEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlowPublish", Oyatie::Action::"FlowRun",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlowSchedule", Oyatie::Action::"FlowShare",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlowInstallConnector", Oyatie::Action::"FlowRunOnPremGatewayAction",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlowConfigureRPABot", Oyatie::Action::"FlowRunRPAAttended",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlowRunRPAUnattended", Oyatie::Action::"FlowInvokeAIBuilder",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlowDebugRun", Oyatie::Action::"FlowRetryFailedStep",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlowRespondToApproval", Oyatie::Action::"FlowAnalyzeProcess",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlowConfigureDLP", Oyatie::Action::"FlowProvisionMachineGroup"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Flow::"<flow-id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    environment_scoped_role_grants(principal, action, resource.environment) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"FlowConfigureDLP" ? principal.has_role("PowerPlatformAdmin") || principal.has_role("EnvironmentAdmin") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"FlowInstallConnector" ? connector_license_present(principal, context.connector) && !dlp_policy_blocks(resource.environment, context.connector) && data_classification_compatible(context.connector, resource.environment.dlp_policy) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"FlowRunRPAUnattended" ? principal.has_role("RPAOperator") && machine_group_capacity_available(context.machine_group) && rpa_credentials_present(context.bot) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"FlowInvokeAIBuilder" ? context.pack.allows_ai_processing(resource.classification) && ai_consent_recorded(principal, resource) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"FlowRespondToApproval" ? approval_recipient_includes(context.approval, principal) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"FlowRunOnPremGatewayAction" ? gateway_healthy(context.gateway) && gateway_credentials_valid(context.gateway) : true) &&
    (resource.has_unattended_rpa ? context.pack.contains("RPA-Vault") && two_person_rule_for_bot_credential(context.bot) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    flow_consumption_budget_available(principal, context.estimated_consumption) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Flow_Definition` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::flow_definition` (with trigger + actions + run-after-conditions + retry-policy).
  - `Flow_Run` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::flow_run` (with status + per-action result + duration + error + replay-pointer).
  - `Connector` → `Oyatie::ApiGw::connector` (per D-041).
  - `Connection_Reference` → `Oyatie::ApiGw::connection_reference` (per D-041).
  - `Environment` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::environment` (per D-041).
  - `Environment_Variable` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::environment_variable` (with per-env override).
  - `RPA_Bot` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::rpa_bot` (with attended/unattended + .ppd-bundle + machine-group + credentials).
  - `Desktop_Flow_Bundle` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::desktop_flow_bundle` (with steps + selectors + subflows).
  - `Machine_Group` → `Oyatie::CloudIac::rpa_machine_group` (with capacity + members + OS-image).
  - `AI_Builder_Model_Reference` → per D-041 AI_Builder_Model.
  - `Process_Advisor_Process` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::process_mining_process` (with recordings + insights + variants).
  - `On_Prem_Data_Gateway` → `Oyatie::DataPipeline::gateway` (per D-042).
  - `Business_Process_Flow_Definition` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::business_process_flow` (per D-040).
  - `Dlp_Policy` → `Oyatie::Compliance::dlp_policy` (per D-041).
  - `Approval` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::approval` (with type + recipients + status + responses).
  - `Hosted_RPA_Run` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::rpa_run` (with screenshots + logs + machine-binding).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Power Automate displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant per-environment flow inventory (cloud + desktop + scheduled + instant + approval + business-process); per-environment RPA-bot + machine-group + AI-Builder-model + DLP-policy + custom-connector inventory.
  2. **Solution export**: per-solution `.zip` (managed + unmanaged) with all flow + connection-reference + environment-variable + AI-Builder-model + custom-connector + DLP-policy artifacts.
  3. **Cloud-flow export**: per-flow Logic-App-DSL JSON (compatible with Azure Logic Apps); per-flow trigger + action + run-after-conditions + retry-policy + dynamic-content-binding.
  4. **Desktop-flow / RPA export**: per-`.ppd` file with all UI-action steps + selectors (UIA + CSS + image-based) + variables + subflows + error-handlers + screenshots.
  5. **Connection-reference + Environment-variable export**: per-environment per-reference with auth-config + per-env override values.
  6. **Custom-connector export**: per-connector OpenAPI v2 manifest + auth-config + rate-limits + operations.
  7. **AI Builder model export** (per D-041): per-model type + dataset + accuracy + invocation-history.
  8. **DLP-policy export**: per-policy connector-grouping (Business / Non-Business / Blocked) + custom-pattern + environment-binding.
  9. **Process Advisor export**: per-process recordings + variants + insights + duration + frequency.
  10. **Machine-group export**: per-group capacity + members + OS-image + assignment.
  11. **Approval history export**: per-approval per-response with timestamp + responder.
  12. **Flow-run-history export**: per-run-id status + per-action result + retention per policy.
  13. **Logic-App-DSL → Oyatie-Flow-DSL transformation**: per-trigger compatibility + per-action mapping + per-expression-function compatibility (Workflow Definition Language functions) + per-dynamic-content rebind.
  14. **Per-environment destination shell**: cloud-flow → workflow-engine; desktop-flow → workflow-engine with RPA sandboxed-runner; approval → workflow-engine approval task; process-mining → intelligence process-mining.
  15. **Parallel run**: 60-day shadow with per-flow trigger-fire parity + per-action result parity ≥ 99.9% + per-RPA-bot UI-interaction parity (per-step screenshot diff < 1%) + per-AI-Builder invocation parity + per-approval response parity 100%.
  16. **Cutover**: per-flow cut-over with trigger re-bind; per-RPA-bot re-deploy + machine-group re-provision; per-AI-Builder model re-publish; per-custom-connector re-publish; per-DLP-policy re-apply; per-approval in-flight migration with respond-link rewrite.
  17. **Sunset**: Power Automate license sunset; per-tenant flow-run-history retention per policy (typically 28-90 days for non-regulated; 7 years for SOX-bound flows).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Per-connector premium-license-bleed** (citizen-dev uses premium connector without license): per-connector license + DLP-policy check on each run.
  - **RPA-bot credential-leak** (bot stores credentials in plain text): per-bot credential-vault binding + audit on access + secret-scan on `.ppd`.
  - **Flow-run cost-explosion** (premium-connector + high-frequency loop): per-flow consumption-budget + per-environment quota + alert + auto-suspend.
  - **On-prem-gateway high-availability gap** (single-gateway-instance becomes SPOF): per-gateway cluster + failover with health-check.
  - **Flow-version drift** (live flow vs draft inconsistent): per-version explicit promotion + rollback + diff-viewer.
  - **RPA UI-selector brittleness** (button-rename in target app breaks UI-click step): per-selector multi-strategy (UIA + CSS + image + OCR fallback) + per-step screenshot-diff alarm.
  - **Concurrent flow-run race-condition** (two runs update same record): per-flow concurrency-control + per-record optimistic-lock.
  - **Logic-App-DSL expression-function drift** (`utcNow()` semantics differ): per-function compatibility-mapping + golden-test on per-function output.
  - **Dynamic-content binding break on schema-change** (upstream connector adds/removes field): per-flow schema-validate-on-publish + per-flow run-time-validate + alert.
  - **Approval-link-recipient-spoofing** (approval response URL guessable): per-approval signed-token + per-recipient binding + audit.
  - **Process Mining PII-bleed** (recordings include user-PII): per-recording redact-on-ingest + per-recording per-actor consent.
  - **Hosted Machine Group quota-overrun** (unattended runs > capacity): per-group capacity-monitor + queue-overflow alert + per-run priority.
  - **Custom-connector OAuth-token-rotation lag**: per-connection token-refresh + retry + audit.
  - **DLP-policy mis-classification** (Business-connector accidentally in Non-Business group): per-policy review + per-tenant override + audit.
  - **AI Builder model retired without notice** (vendor sunsets model type): per-model deprecation-detect + per-flow migration-suggest + dual-run window.
  - **Approval response after-flow-timeout** (approver responds after flow already errored): per-approval timeout-policy + per-response idempotent handler.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — `pac flow export/import` + Power Automate REST (Maker + Management) + `.ppd` file format + Power Automate Desktop SDK + Process Advisor API; format — JSON (Logic-App-DSL) + `.ppd` (XML-based) + `.zip` solution + OpenAPI-v2 connector-manifest; duration — ~1-4 weeks per tenant depending on flow + RPA-bot count; bandwidth — heavy on RPA recordings + flow-run-history.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — per-flow Logic-App-DSL preserved with per-expression-function compatibility-mapping; per-RPA-bot `.ppd` preserved with sandboxed-runner; per-connector OpenAPI preserved; per-AI-Builder model per D-041; per-DLP-policy connector-grouping preserved; per-approval lifecycle preserved; lossy — some Workflow Definition Language built-in functions with corner-case edge-behavior rebuilt with golden-test; some UI-selector strategies require Oyatie native selector-engine extension (gap-list with feature-loss-disclosure).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-flow cut-over with trigger re-bind; per-RPA-bot re-deploy + machine-group re-provision; per-AI-Builder model re-publish; per-custom-connector re-publish; per-DLP-policy re-apply; per-approval in-flight migration with respond-link rewrite + dual-link window.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-day shadow with per-flow trigger-fire parity + per-action result parity ≥ 99.9% + per-RPA-bot UI-interaction parity (per-step screenshot diff < 1%) + per-AI-Builder invocation parity + per-approval response parity 100% + per-DLP-policy enforcement parity 100%; sunset — Power Automate license sunset; per-tenant flow-run-history retention per policy.

- Workflow template library: `flow.publish-with-test-set`; `flow.rpa-bot-orchestrate`; `flow.business-process-flow-orchestrate`; `flow.ai-builder-form-processor-bind`; `flow.error-handling-with-retry-and-dead-letter`; `flow.consumption-budget-enforce`; `flow.approval-with-timeout-and-escalation`; `flow.process-mining-recording-redact`; `flow.unattended-rpa-two-person-credential-check`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office + citizen-developer; desktop-primary flow-designer with step-graph; per-environment dev/test/prod; mobile run-history monitor + approval-respond.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA; per-connector DLP-policy; per-RPA-bot privileged-credential vault (RPA-Vault pack); per-AI-Builder pack-allows-AI-training/processing gate; SOX for finance-bound flows; HIPAA for PHI-bound flows.
- Naming justification: `workflow-engine` + `workflow-studio` are canonical; `microsoft-power-automate` and `microsoft-flow` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-044 - Microsoft Power Pages

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::PortalUser::"<portal-user-id-or-Anonymous>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"PortalView", Oyatie::Action::"PortalSubmitForm",

      Oyatie::Action::"PortalListDownload", Oyatie::Action::"PortalCallWebApi",
      Oyatie::Action::"PortalRegister", Oyatie::Action::"PortalRedeemInvitation",
      Oyatie::Action::"PortalConfigureSite", Oyatie::Action::"PortalConfigureTablePermission",
      Oyatie::Action::"PortalConfigureWebRole", Oyatie::Action::"PortalConfigureIDP",
      Oyatie::Action::"PortalConfigureCustomDomain", Oyatie::Action::"PortalPublish"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::PortalSite::"<site-id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    page_web_role_grants(principal, action, resource.page) &&
    table_permission_scope_resolves(principal, action, resource.bound_table, resource.contact_owner, context.requested_record) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PortalConfigureSite" || action == Oyatie::Action::"PortalConfigureTablePermission" || action == Oyatie::Action::"PortalConfigureWebRole" || action == Oyatie::Action::"PortalConfigureIDP" || action == Oyatie::Action::"PortalConfigureCustomDomain" || action == Oyatie::Action::"PortalPublish" ? principal.has_role("SiteAdmin") || principal.has_role("EnvironmentAdmin") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PortalRegister" ? captcha_passed(context.captcha_token) && self_registration_enabled(resource) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PortalRedeemInvitation" ? invitation_valid(context.invitation, principal.email) && !invitation_expired(context.invitation) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PortalSubmitForm" ? captcha_when_required(resource.form, context.captcha_token) && file_size_within_limit(context.attachments) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"PortalCallWebApi" ? webapi_operation_allowed(resource.webapi_config, context.http_verb) && requested_fields_subset_of(resource.webapi_config.allowed_fields, context.fields) : true) &&
    (resource.is_public_facing ? context.pack.contains("WCAG-2.2-AA") && a11y_audit_passed(resource) && cookie_consent_recorded(principal) : true) &&
    (resource.collects_minor_data ? context.pack.contains("COPPA") && parental_consent_present(principal) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    rate_limit_per_principal(principal, context.endpoint, context.window) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Portal_Site` → `Oyatie::Community::portal_site` (with IDP-bindings + custom-domain + theme + language).
  - `Web_Page` → `Oyatie::Community::portal_page` (with partial-URL + template + web-role-binding + localized-content).
  - `Web_Template` → `Oyatie::Community::liquid_template` (with Liquid source + MIME + includes).
  - `Page_Template` → `Oyatie::Community::page_template` (with layout + region binding).
  - `Entity_Form` → `Oyatie::Community::entity_form` (with Dataverse table-binding + mode + captcha + file-upload).
  - `Multi_Step_Form` → `Oyatie::Community::multi_step_form` (with step-list + conditional-branching + resume-state).
  - `Entity_List` → `Oyatie::Community::entity_list` (with view-binding + filter-schema + action-bar).
  - `Web_Role` → `Oyatie::Cedar::portal_web_role` (with anonymous + authenticated flags).
  - `Web_Role_Member` → `Oyatie::Cedar::portal_web_role_member`.
  - `Table_Permission` → `Oyatie::Cedar::portal_table_permission` (with scope + privileges + role-binding + parent-permission).
  - `Portal_User` → `Oyatie::Identity::portal_user` (with IDP + external-identity + account-binding).
  - `Web_Link_Set` → `Oyatie::Community::web_link_set` (with link-list + order).
  - `Content_Snippet` → `Oyatie::Community::content_snippet` (with localized-value).
  - `Site_Setting` → `Oyatie::Community::site_setting`.
  - `Portal_Web_API_Config` → `Oyatie::ApiGw::portal_webapi_config` (with table-binding + allowed-ops + allowed-fields).
  - `Theme` → `Oyatie::Community::theme` (with stylesheets + palette + font-stack).
  - `Custom_Domain_Binding` → `Oyatie::CloudCdn::custom_domain` (with TLS-cert + CDN + redirect-policy).
  - `Invitation` → `Oyatie::Identity::portal_invitation` (with email + expiration + role-assignment).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Power Pages displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant per-environment site inventory; per-site theme + custom-domain + IDP + Web-Roles + Table-Permissions + Web-Templates + Entity-Forms + Entity-Lists + Multi-Step-Forms + Content-Snippets + Site-Settings + Portal-Web-API-Configs + Invitations.
  2. **Site solution export**: per-site `pac paportal download` → `.zip` with all metadata; per-solution `.zip` with embedded site config.
  3. **Page tree extraction**: per-page parent-page + display-order + partial-URL + page-template + web-role-binding + localized-content.
  4. **Web Template extraction**: per-template Liquid source + MIME + includes.
  5. **Entity Form / Multi-Step Form extraction**: per-form Dataverse-table binding + mode + steps + conditional-branching + validation-rules + captcha + file-upload-storage.
  6. **Entity List extraction**: per-list bound view + filter-schema + action-bar + page-size + map/calendar-view.
  7. **Web Role / Table Permission extraction**: per-role per-permission scope + privileges + member-list.
  8. **IDP configuration extraction**: per-IDP SAML / OIDC / OAuth metadata + claim-mapping.
  9. **Custom Domain + TLS + CDN extraction**: per-domain TLS-cert + CDN-endpoint + redirect-policy.
  10. **Theme + Bootstrap-asset extraction**: per-theme color-palette + font-stack + logo + custom-CSS + per-asset bundle.
  11. **Invitation extraction**: per-invitation email + expiration + role-assignment + redemption-state.
  12. **Portal-user (Contact) extraction**: per-D040 Contact subset with `Portal_User` extension fields.
  13. **Portal Web-API config extraction**: per-config table-binding + allowed-ops + allowed-fields + role-binding.
  14. **Liquid template migration**: per-template AST-parse + per-tag compatibility-mapping (`entity_view` / `entitylist` / `editable` / `searchindex` / `redirect`) + per-built-in-object preserved.
  15. **Per-site destination shell**: portal-site → `community` portal site; pages → community pages; forms → workflow-studio + community form-render; Web-Roles + Table-Permissions → Cedar policy.
  16. **Custom-domain DNS staged cut-over**: per-site DNS TTL-shorten → cut-over → 301-redirect (24-month minimum) → monitor.
  17. **Parallel run**: 30-day shadow with sample of users on shadow domain + per-page render parity + per-form-submit parity + per-Web-API-call parity ≥ 99.9% + per-IDP sign-in parity 100% + WCAG-2.2-AA audit pass.
  18. **Cutover**: per-site DNS cut-over with 24-month URL-redirect; per-IDP re-bind + per-invitation re-issue; per-custom-domain TLS-cert re-issue; per-CDN cache-purge.
  19. **Sunset**: Power Pages license sunset; per-site content retention per tenant policy (typically indefinite for permit/license sites; 7 years for SOX-bound forms).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Table-permission scope-leak** (web-role sees more than scoped, e.g., Global vs Contact scope misapplied): per-permission Cedar-scope check + per-record-access audit + golden-test on per-role per-record visibility.
  - **Multi-step-form resume-state-loss** (user closes browser mid-wizard, state lost): per-form resume-token with TTL + per-session local-storage backup + per-form server-side draft.
  - **DNS cut-over downtime** (TTL not pre-shortened): per-site staged DNS-cutover with 301-redirect + monitor + automated TTL-shorten 48hr before cut.
  - **WCAG-AA accessibility regression** (theme update breaks contrast ratio): per-publish a11y-audit gate + per-component contrast-check + manual review for HIGH-impact pages.
  - **Per-portal user-spam** (bot-driven registrations): per-portal CAPTCHA + rate-limit + abuse-detect + email-verify-before-activate.
  - **Liquid template SSRF** (Liquid `include` with user-controlled URL): per-template `include` source-whitelist + sandboxed-runtime + audit.
  - **Liquid template XSS via `{{ raw }}`** (user-input rendered without escape): per-template HTML-escape-default + explicit `| escape: false` audit.
  - **IDP claim-mapping drift** (claim renamed by IDP, breaks login): per-IDP claim-validate + alert + fallback-prompt.
  - **Invitation-code phishing** (invitation URL forwarded to wrong recipient): per-invitation email-binding + single-use enforcement + signed-token.
  - **Custom-domain TLS-cert auto-renewal failure**: per-cert renewal-cadence + 14-day pre-expire alert + auto-cutover to fallback-cert.
  - **CDN cache-poisoning** (per-user content cached with wrong cache-key): per-route cache-key validation + per-user content `private` cache-control.
  - **Per-Dataverse-record field-visibility leak via Web-API** (Web-API returns fields not in allowed-fields list): per-config field-projection enforce + per-response audit.
  - **Per-portal language-fallback broken** (localized content missing in EU language, falls back to en-US silently): per-language coverage-report + per-page missing-translation alert.
  - **Bootstrap-bundle minification break** (custom JS minified incorrectly): per-bundle source-map + per-bundle smoke-test + rollback-on-error.
  - **Multi-step-form auto-save-collision** (two browser tabs editing same draft): per-draft tab-lock + last-write-wins with diff.
  - **Page-publishing-state ambiguity** (page marked Published in dev but draft in prod after solution import): per-page state-pin + per-solution state-override.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — `pac paportal download/upload` + Power Platform CLI + Power Pages Studio REST + Liquid template AST-parser + Custom-Domain DNS records; format — `.zip` site-package + Dataverse XML / JSON + Liquid source + CSS + JS + binary assets; duration — ~1-3 weeks per tenant depending on site count and customization; bandwidth — moderate.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — per-site IDP + custom-domain + theme preserved; per-page Liquid templates with per-tag compatibility-mapping + per-built-in-object preserved; per-Web-Role + Table-Permission to Cedar policy with scope-translation; per-Entity-Form / Multi-Step-Form preserved with Dataverse-binding per D-040; per-Portal-Web-API to apigw config; lossy — some advanced Liquid tags require Oyatie native template-engine extension (gap-list with feature-loss-disclosure); some Bootstrap-bundler features rebuilt with Oyatie asset-pipeline.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-site DNS cut-over with 24-month URL-redirect; per-IDP re-bind + per-invitation re-issue; per-custom-domain TLS-cert re-issue; per-CDN cache-purge; per-Web-API endpoint re-bind; per-portal-user notification of new site URL + cookie-consent re-prompt.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 30-day shadow with sample of users on shadow domain + per-page render parity + per-form-submit parity + per-Web-API-call parity ≥ 99.9% + per-IDP sign-in parity 100% + WCAG-2.2-AA audit pass + per-page bounce-rate + conversion-rate parity ± 2%; sunset — Power Pages license sunset; per-site content retention per tenant policy.

- Workflow template library: `portal.publish-with-validation`; `portal.entity-form-submit-with-cedar-check`; `portal.multi-step-form-with-resume`; `portal.web-role-assignment-orchestrate`; `portal.b2b-invitation-flow`; `portal.liquid-template-sandbox-execute`; `portal.custom-domain-staged-cutover`; `portal.captcha-and-rate-limit-enforce`; `portal.a11y-audit-on-publish`.
- UX shell adaptation: B2C consumer + B2B partner + employee; mobile-primary + desktop-secondary; per-site theming with brand asset; accessibility WCAG 2.2 AA mandatory for public sites; per-site language-detection + per-locale fallback.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + COPPA (minor-user portals) + ADA Title-III + EU Web Accessibility Directive (EN 301 549) + Section 508 (US Gov); cookie-consent (ePrivacy); HIPAA (per-form PHI-collection); per-tenant retention; FedRAMP for Gov portals.
- Naming justification: `community` + `workflow-studio` are canonical; `microsoft-power-pages` is benchmark alias.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-045 - Microsoft 365
- Vendor name and category: Microsoft 365 (Office 365 + Teams + Exchange Online + SharePoint Online + OneDrive for Business + Outlook + Planner + To Do + Forms + Loop + Whiteboard + Stream + Bookings + Visio + Project / Project for the Web + Sway + Yammer/Viva-Engage + Lists + Word + Excel + PowerPoint + Clipchamp + Designer + OneNote + Delve + MyAnalytics/Viva-Insights bridge) / Microsoft ecosystem / productivity + collaboration suite + tenant-scoped Microsoft Graph cross-product mesh.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `email` + `messenger` + `drive` + `wiki` + `productivity` + `cloud-cdn` + capability tier on `workflow-engine`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: M365 Apps for Business → **Bronze**; M365 Business Standard (with Teams + SharePoint + Exchange + OneDrive) → **Silver**; M365 E3 / Business Premium (with Intune + Entra ID Plan 1 + Defender + Purview baseline) → **Gold**; M365 E5 / GCC-High / Frontline F5 (with Defender XDR + Sentinel + Purview-Advanced + Entra ID P2 + Copilot for M365) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: per-product — Outlook + Exchange Online → `email` (mailbox + folder + rule + signature + calendar); Teams → `messenger` (channels + chats + DMs) + `meetings` (video + recording + transcript) + `productivity` (Teams-embedded apps); SharePoint Online → `wiki` + `drive` (hybrid: structured pages + lists + document libraries + sites); OneDrive for Business → `drive`; Planner / To Do / Project → `workflow-studio` + `workflow-engine`; Forms → `workflow-studio` (survey + quiz); Loop → `wiki` + `whiteboard` (live-component); Whiteboard → `whiteboard`; Stream → `drive` (video) + `meetings` (recording); Bookings → `workflow-engine`; Word/Excel/PowerPoint/OneNote → `productivity` (collaborative document editing + co-authoring); Visio + Designer + Clipchamp + Sway → `productivity`; Lists → `wiki` (list-mode); Yammer/Viva-Engage → `community`; Delve → `intelligence` (Graph-derived insights).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Microsoft Graph unified model + per-product extensions):
  - `Tenant` (Tenant_ID, Display_Name, Default_Domain, Verified_Domains[], Country, Preferred_Language, Service_Plans_Bound[], Default_Usage_Location, Tenant_Type {Microsoft / GCC / GCC-High / DoD / China-21Vianet}).
  - `User` / `Person` (User_ID, User_Principal_Name, Display_Name, Mail, Job_Title, Department, Office_Location, Mobile_Phone, Business_Phones[], Manager_Reference, Direct_Reports[], On-Prem-Sync-Source-Anchor, Assigned_Licenses[], Assigned_Plans[], Account_Enabled: bool, Sign-In-Activity, Identities[External-IDPs]).
  - `Group` (Group_ID, Display_Name, Mail, Group_Types[Unified / Security / DistributionList / MSTeams-backed], Owners[], Members[], Visibility {Public / Private / HiddenMembership}, Associated_Team_Reference, Associated_SharePoint_Site_Reference, Associated_Planner_Plan_Reference).
  - `Mailbox` (Mailbox_ID, User_Reference, Type {UserMailbox / SharedMailbox / Resource / Public-Folder / Group-Mailbox}, Folders[Inbox / Sent / Drafts / Junk / Custom], Quotas {Issue-Warning / Prohibit-Send / Prohibit-Send-Receive}, Retention_Policy_Reference, Litigation_Hold_State, Archive_Mailbox_Reference).
  - `Message` (Message_ID, Mailbox_Reference, Conversation_Reference, From, To[], Cc[], Bcc[], Subject, Body (HTML / Plain), Importance {Low / Normal / High}, Categories[], Internet_Message_Id, In_Reply_To, Received_DateTime, Sent_DateTime, Has_Attachments: bool, Attachments[], Read_Receipt_Requested: bool, Sensitivity_Label_Reference, Retention_Label_Reference).
  - `Event` (Event_ID, Calendar_Reference, Subject, Body, Start, End, Recurrence, Location, Attendees[Email + Type {Required / Optional / Resource} + Response_Status], Show_As {Free / Tentative / Busy / OOF}, Online_Meeting_Provider, Online_Meeting_URL, Sensitivity {Normal / Private / Personal / Confidential}, Categories[]).
  - `Team` (Team_ID, Display_Name, Description, Visibility, Mail_Nickname, Owners[], Members[], Guests[], Channels[Channel_ID → Name + Type {Standard / Private / Shared} + Tabs + Apps], Messaging_Settings {Mentions / Reply-To-Message / Edit-Message / Delete-Message}, Member_Settings {Add-Member / Update-Channel / Delete-Channel}, Guest_Settings, Fun_Settings).
  - `Channel_Message` (Message_ID, Team_Reference, Channel_Reference, From_User_Reference, Body (HTML), Replies[], Mentions[], Reactions[], Attachments[], Created_DateTime, Last_Modified_DateTime, Importance, Is_Pinned: bool).
  - `Chat` (Chat_ID, Type {OneOnOne / Group / Meeting}, Members[], Topic, Last_Updated_DateTime, Online_Meeting_Reference).
  - `Drive_Item` (Item_ID, Drive_Reference, Name, Folder_Reference, File_MIME_Type, Size, Created_DateTime, Last_Modified_DateTime, Last_Modified_By, Created_By, Web_URL, Parent_Reference, Children[], Sharing_Permissions[], Versions[], Sensitivity_Label_Reference, Retention_Label_Reference, eTag, cTag).
  - `Drive` (Drive_ID, Drive_Type {Personal / Business / DocumentLibrary}, Owner, Quota {Total / Used / Remaining / Deleted}, Root_Folder_Reference).
  - `SharePoint_Site` (Site_ID, Display_Name, Web_URL, Created_DateTime, Description, Site_Collection_Reference, Lists[], Pages[], Drives[], Members, Group_Reference (Microsoft-365-Group-Linked), Hub_Site_Reference, Sharing_Settings, Sensitivity_Label_Reference).
  - `SharePoint_List` (List_ID, Site_Reference, Display_Name, Template_Type {GenericList / DocumentLibrary / Events / Tasks / Announcements / Custom}, Columns[Column → Type], Items[], Content_Types_Bound[]).
  - `SharePoint_Page` (Page_ID, Site_Reference, Title, Layout {Article / Home / Single-Part-App / Repost / Spaces}, Web_Parts[], Promote_State {NotPromoted / PromoteOnPublish / Promoted / NewsPost}).

  - `Whiteboard` (Whiteboard_ID, Title, Owners[], Co-Editors[], Strokes[], Sticky_Notes[], Templates_Applied[], Embedded_In_Meeting_Reference).
  - `Form` (Form_ID, Title, Type {Survey / Quiz}, Questions[Q-Type {Choice / Text / Rating / Date / Ranking / Likert / Net-Promoter-Score / File-Upload / Section-Header / Branching} + Required + Choices], Responses[], Settings {Multiple-Responses-Allowed / Identity-Recorded / Date-Window / Branching-Logic / Response-Receipt}).
  - `Booking_Service` (Service_ID, Business_Reference, Display_Name, Default_Duration, Default_Price, Staff_Members_Bound[], Customer_Form_Custom_Questions[]).
  - `Stream_Video` (Video_ID, Channel_Reference, Title, Description, Upload_Source {Manual / Teams-Meeting-Recording / Webinar-Recording}, Transcript_Reference, Captions[Language → SRT], Permissions, Live_Event_Reference).
  - `Sensitivity_Label` / `Retention_Label` (Label_ID, Display_Name, Description, Sublabels[], Encryption_Policy, Marking_Policy, Apply-Conditions, Justification-On-Lower).
  - `Retention_Policy` (Policy_ID, Display_Name, Scope {Teams-Chats / Teams-Channels / Exchange / SharePoint / OneDrive / Yammer / Skype}, Retain_Days, Then {Do-Nothing / Delete}, Locations_Included[], Locations_Excluded[]).
  - `eDiscovery_Case` (Case_ID, Title, Holds[], Searches[], Reviewers[], Status, Exports[]).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Microsoft Graph REST: `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/{me|users|groups|sites|drives|teams|chats|planner|me/messages|me/events}/...` — unified cross-product API.
  - Microsoft Graph Beta: `https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/...` for pre-release endpoints (Loop / Bookings advanced / etc.).
  - Exchange Web Services (EWS) + EWS Managed API: legacy mailbox access (deprecated for new but used in migrations).
  - PowerShell modules: `ExchangeOnlineManagement`, `Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell`, `MicrosoftTeams`, `Microsoft.Graph`.
  - SharePoint REST + CSOM: `/_api/web/...` per-site OData + Client-Side-Object-Model.
  - Office Add-ins / Office.js SDK: per-product add-in surface.
  - Microsoft Graph Toolkit: pre-built reusable web-components.
  - Microsoft Graph Webhooks (Change Notifications): per-resource per-event subscription.
  - SharePoint Migration Tool (SPMT): bulk content migration.
  - Migration Manager (M365 admin): cross-product staged migration.
  - SCIM 2.0 + SAML / OIDC via Entra ID; Audit log via Purview Audit; Compliance via Purview Compliance Portal.
  - Microsoft Stream API + Live-Events API.
  - Booking API + Forms REST + Planner REST + Loop REST.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Microsoft 365 Home (office.com)" — app-launcher with all installed M365 apps + recent docs + recommended.
  - "Outlook on the Web" — folder-tree + inbox-list + reading-pane + calendar + people + To-Do.
  - "Teams Client" — left-rail (Activity / Chat / Teams / Calendar / Calls / Files / Apps) + per-team channel-list + per-channel posts-files-wiki-tabs.
  - "Teams Meeting Stage" — video-grid + chat-panel + share-screen + breakout-rooms + transcript + recording + together-mode + presenter-mode + companion-mode.
  - "SharePoint Home" — followed-sites + frequent-sites + suggested-sites + recent-news.
  - "SharePoint Site Home" — hero web-part + news-feed + activity + documents + lists + pages.
  - "OneDrive Web" — files + shared-with-me + recent + recycle-bin + photos + sync-status.
  - "Word / Excel / PowerPoint co-authoring" — live-cursor + author-color + presence + suggest-mode + comments + version-history + auto-save.
  - "Planner Board" — bucket-columns with task-cards + drag-drop + filter by-assignee/label/due.
  - "Forms Designer" — question-list + theme + branching-logic + preview + analytics.
