- **Cedar permit shape** (cross-product M365 composed permit):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<m365-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"M365MailSend", Oyatie::Action::"M365MailRead",
      Oyatie::Action::"M365CalendarCreate", Oyatie::Action::"M365CalendarShare",
      Oyatie::Action::"M365TeamsSendMessage", Oyatie::Action::"M365TeamsStartMeeting",
      Oyatie::Action::"M365TeamsRecordMeeting", Oyatie::Action::"M365TeamsCreateChannel",
      Oyatie::Action::"M365TeamsAddGuest", Oyatie::Action::"M365SharePointCreateSite",
      Oyatie::Action::"M365SharePointPublishPage", Oyatie::Action::"M365SharePointShareDocument",
      Oyatie::Action::"M365OneDriveUpload", Oyatie::Action::"M365OneDriveShareExternal",
      Oyatie::Action::"M365PlannerCreateTask", Oyatie::Action::"M365FormsCollectResponse",
      Oyatie::Action::"M365LoopEmbedComponent", Oyatie::Action::"M365StreamPublishVideo",
      Oyatie::Action::"M365PurviewApplyLabel", Oyatie::Action::"M365PurviewEDiscoveryHold",
      Oyatie::Action::"M365GraphSubscribeChangeNotification", Oyatie::Action::"M365CopilotInvoke"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::Mailbox::"<mbx-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Team::"<team-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SharePointSite::"<site-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Drive::"<drive-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Planner::"<plan-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    per_product_permission_grants(principal, action, resource) &&
    sensitivity_label_allows_action(principal, resource.sensitivity_label, action) &&
    retention_label_blocks_destructive_action(resource.retention_label, action) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"M365OneDriveShareExternal" ? external_sharing_policy_allows(resource.site_or_drive, context.recipient_domain) && !sensitivity_blocks_external(resource.sensitivity_label) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"M365TeamsAddGuest" ? guest_access_policy_allows(resource.team) && context.dual_admin_approval : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"M365TeamsRecordMeeting" ? recording_consent_collected(context.meeting.attendees) && context.pack.allows_recording(resource.classification) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"M365CopilotInvoke" ? context.pack.allows_ai_processing(resource.classification) && ai_consent_recorded(principal, resource) && copilot_data_does_not_leave_tenant : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"M365PurviewEDiscoveryHold" ? principal.has_role("eDiscovery-Manager") && case_authorized(context.case) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"M365GraphSubscribeChangeNotification" ? subscription_within_quota(principal) && resource_subscription_supported(resource) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.environment_type == "GCC-High" ? context.pack.contains("FedRAMP-High") && data_pinned_to_us_gov_region(resource) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    (resource.contains_phi ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && phi_minimum_necessary_check(principal, action) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Tenant` → `Oyatie::Identity::tenant` (per ADR-0244 tenant-scoping primitive).
  - `User` / `Person` → `Oyatie::Identity::user` (with UPN + on-prem-sync-anchor + assigned-licenses).
  - `Group` → `Oyatie::Identity::group` (with Unified vs Security vs DL classification + team / SharePoint / Planner backlinks).
  - `Mailbox` → `Oyatie::Email::mailbox` (with type + folders + quotas + litigation-hold + retention).
  - `Message` → `Oyatie::Email::message` (with conversation-thread + sensitivity-label + retention-label).
  - `Event` → `Oyatie::Email::calendar_event` (with attendees + online-meeting + recurrence + sensitivity).
  - `Team` → `Oyatie::Messenger::team` (with channels + members + guests + settings).
  - `Channel_Message` → `Oyatie::Messenger::channel_message` (with replies + mentions + reactions + pinned).
  - `Chat` → `Oyatie::Messenger::chat` (with type + members + topic + meeting-binding).
  - `Drive_Item` → `Oyatie::Drive::file` or `Oyatie::Drive::folder` (with versions + sharing-permissions + sensitivity-label).
  - `Drive` → `Oyatie::Drive::drive` (with type + owner + quota).
  - `SharePoint_Site` → `Oyatie::Wiki::site` + `Oyatie::Drive::site_storage` (hybrid binding).
  - `SharePoint_List` → `Oyatie::Wiki::list` (with template-type + columns + content-types).
  - `SharePoint_Page` → `Oyatie::Wiki::page` (with layout + web-parts + promote-state).
  - `Planner_Plan` / `Planner_Task` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::plan` / `task` (with buckets + assignments + priority + checklist).
  - `Loop_Component` → `Oyatie::Wiki::loop_component` (with container-reference + type + Fluid-Framework body).
  - `Loop_Workspace` → `Oyatie::Wiki::loop_workspace` (with pages + sharing).
  - `Whiteboard` → `Oyatie::Whiteboard::canvas` (with strokes + sticky-notes + templates).
  - `Form` → `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::survey` (with questions + branching + responses).
  - `Booking_Service` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::booking_service`.
  - `Stream_Video` → `Oyatie::Drive::video` + `Oyatie::Meetings::recording` (with transcript + captions).
  - `Sensitivity_Label` / `Retention_Label` → `Oyatie::Compliance::sensitivity_label` / `retention_label` (per ADR-0251 compliance-pack).
  - `Retention_Policy` → `Oyatie::Compliance::retention_policy`.
  - `eDiscovery_Case` → `Oyatie::EvidenceStore::ediscovery_case` (with holds + searches + reviewers + exports).

- **Specific workflow steps** (M365 displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant per-service-plan inventory; per-user assigned-licenses; per-product (Outlook / Teams / SharePoint / OneDrive / Planner / Forms / Loop / Whiteboard / Stream / Bookings / etc.) artifact-count; per-tenant Purview labels + retention-policies + DLP-policies + eDiscovery-cases.
  2. **Microsoft Graph cross-product snapshot**: per-tenant graph-traversal across Person + Group + Site + Drive + DriveItem + Channel + Chat + Mail + Event + Task + Planner-Plan + Loop with cross-product link preservation.
  3. **Exchange Online migration**: per-mailbox PST + EWS / Graph export with all folders + messages + categories + rules + signatures + automapping + delegated-access; per-mailbox archive + litigation-hold preserved.
  4. **SharePoint Online migration**: per-site SPMT export with all pages + lists + libraries + content-types + workflows + hub-site relationship + sharing-permissions + sensitivity-labels.
  5. **OneDrive for Business migration**: per-user OneDrive content with versions + sharing + sync-state via SPMT.
  6. **Teams migration**: per-Team + per-Channel + per-Channel-Message + per-Chat + per-Meeting-Recording + per-Tab + per-installed-App + per-Channel-File-Tab-binding (Channel files actually stored in SharePoint backed library).
  7. **Planner / To-Do / Project migration**: per-plan + per-task + per-bucket + per-assignment + per-Reference-Item; To-Do per-list + per-task.
  8. **Forms migration**: per-form questions + branching + responses + theme + sharing.
  9. **Loop migration**: per-component master-content + per-embed-target rebind; per-workspace + per-page + per-component-version.
  10. **Whiteboard migration**: per-whiteboard strokes + sticky-notes + templates + meeting-binding.
  11. **Stream migration**: per-video + transcript + captions + permissions + live-event recording.
  12. **Purview migration**: per-sensitivity-label + retention-label + DLP-policy + eDiscovery-case + legal-hold + records-management policy.
  13. **DNS + identity migration**: per-tenant MX + SPF + DKIM + DMARC + ATP-policy + Entra ID config + SCIM + SAML / OIDC bindings (per D-051 Entra ID dossier).
  14. **Per-product destination shell**: per oyatie µservice routing (Outlook → email; Teams → messenger; SharePoint → wiki+drive; etc.).
  15. **Cross-product link rebind**: per-Outlook-event referencing Teams channel; per-Word document referencing SharePoint list; per-Loop component embedded across mail + Teams + Word; per-Planner-task referencing Channel-Message.
  16. **Audit log + activity migration**: per-tenant Purview Audit log export → Oyatie audit-substrate.
  17. **Parallel run**: 60-90 day shadow with sample tenant + per-mailbox parity + per-Teams-meeting parity + per-SharePoint-site render parity + per-OneDrive sync parity + per-Planner-task parity ≥ 99.9%.
  18. **Cutover**: per-tenant MX + SPF + DKIM + DMARC cut-over; per-product URL redirects 24-month minimum; per-Teams-meeting-URL re-bind; per-SharePoint-site-URL re-bind; per-OneDrive-Personal-URL re-bind.
  19. **Sunset**: M365 license sunset per tenant; per-product retention per tenant policy (regulated tenants 7-10 years; legal-hold indefinite).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Cross-product link-rot** (Outlook calendar event referencing archived Teams channel): per-link periodic-validate + soft-rebind + UI degraded-card.
  - **Microsoft Graph cross-product query-API gap** (Graph endpoint missing for new product): per-query projection to canonical with fallback + per-product fallback API.
  - **PST-to-modern-email migration loss** (read-receipt + voting-button + categorized-folder + flagged-state): per-feature mapping + loss-disclosure + UI-shim.
  - **SharePoint-list-to-wiki conversion ambiguity** (one list could be wiki-page-content vs structured-list vs library): per-list type-detect + per-template heuristic + manual-review queue.
  - **Loop-component cross-document embed** (one Loop used in mail + Teams + Word): per-Loop master-content + sync to embeds + dual-write window.
  - **Teams Channel-file actually in SharePoint binding break** (Teams renames channel, SharePoint library URL rot): per-channel SharePoint-binding preserved + URL-redirect.
  - **OneDrive sync-engine conflict** (offline edits collide on cutover): per-file conflict-resolver + version-history-preserve.
  - **Sensitivity-label policy-skew on cross-product apply** (label applied in Outlook differs from SharePoint policy): per-label cross-product enforcement + per-policy unified-state.
  - **Litigation-hold leak on user-deletion** (GDPR-erasure attempt while hold active): per-user erasure-gate + legal-review-queue + hold-preserve.
  - **Exchange Online external-recipient block** (per-tenant DLP blocks email to migration vendor): per-DLP-policy migration-mode + per-recipient allowlist.
  - **Teams-meeting-recording transcript-leakage** (transcript contains PII not stripped): per-recording transcript-redact-on-ingest + per-attendee consent-check.
  - **SharePoint-permission-inheritance break** (per-item unique-permissions on migrated library): per-permission inheritance-graph preserve + per-item exception-list.
  - **Planner-task assignment-loss on user-deletion** (assignee deleted, task orphaned): per-task soft-orphan + reassign-prompt.
  - **Forms-response anonymity-break** (anonymous form, but user-agent + IP enough to identify): per-response IP-truncate + UA-strip + per-tenant policy.
  - **Stream-video-permission cascade-loss** (video shared via meeting-record link, but link not migrated): per-video sharing-history preserve + per-link redirect.
  - **Multi-geo tenant residency violation** (M365 multi-geo moves user to wrong region): per-user residency-pin + per-action region-check.
  - **Copilot for M365 grounding-leak** (Copilot retrieves data user shouldn't see via cross-product Graph): per-Copilot request Cedar-check on grounding-source + per-source sensitivity-label-respect.
  - **Yammer/Viva-Engage migration ambiguity** (community-post vs community-question vs storyline): per-type detect + per-feature mapping + lossy-disclosure.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Microsoft Graph REST + EWS Managed API + SharePoint REST/CSOM + SPMT + Migration Manager + PowerShell modules + Purview compliance APIs + Office.js SDK; format — JSON / XML / OData / PST / MBOX / `.docx`-`.xlsx`-`.pptx` / SRT (captions); duration — ~2-12 weeks per tenant depending on user count and content volume; bandwidth — VERY heavy on mailbox + OneDrive + SharePoint + Stream-video content.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — per Microsoft Graph cross-product entity preserved with per-product µservice mapping; per-Loop master-content preserved with per-embed sync; per-Sensitivity-Label / Retention-Label / DLP-Policy preserved as Compliance entities (per ADR-0251); per-eDiscovery-Case preserved as Evidence-Store entity; per-Stream-video preserved with transcript + captions; lossy — some Office Add-ins require Oyatie native re-implementation (gap-list); some Microsoft-Search ranking-models rebuilt natively; Copilot-for-M365 grounding-models rebuilt on Oyatie intelligence with same Graph-grounding pattern.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-tenant MX + SPF + DKIM + DMARC cut-over (with 48hr TTL-shorten beforehand); per-product URL redirects 24-month minimum; per-Teams-meeting-URL re-bind + per-SharePoint-site-URL re-bind + per-OneDrive-Personal-URL re-bind; per-Loop component master-content cut-over with per-embed rebind; per-Forms response-collection URL re-bind; per-Stream-video URL re-bind.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-90 day shadow with sample tenant + per-mailbox parity (per-folder per-message count + per-property fidelity) + per-Teams-meeting recording + transcript parity + per-SharePoint-site render parity + per-OneDrive sync parity + per-Planner-task parity ≥ 99.9% + per-Forms-response parity 100% + per-Stream-video playback parity + per-Loop component sync parity + per-Purview-label apply parity 100%; sunset — M365 license sunset; per-product retention per tenant policy.

- Workflow template library: `m365.tenant-migration-orchestration` (cross-product); `m365.unified-search-projection`; `m365.cross-product-mention-resolution`; `m365.compliance-and-eDiscovery-bridge`; `m365.purview-classification-import` (per Microsoft Purview labels); `m365.loop-master-content-sync`; `m365.teams-recording-transcript-redact-on-ingest`; `m365.copilot-grounding-with-cedar-source-check`; `m365.mx-spf-dkim-dmarc-staged-cutover`; `m365.sharepoint-site-permission-inheritance-preserve`.
- UX shell adaptation: per-product shell per oyatie µservice; cross-product unified-search + cross-product mention; per-tenant theming; mobile-primary for Outlook + Teams + OneDrive; desktop-primary for SharePoint Admin + Purview.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + HIPAA + FedRAMP-High / DoD-IL5 (per Government cloud GCC / GCC-High / DoD) + ITAR + CJIS + IRS-1075 + SOX + GLBA + FINRA / SEC-17a-4 + per-tenant retention-policy + per-tenant DLP + per-tenant sensitivity-classification (Purview); EU AI Act for Copilot for M365.
- Naming justification: `email` + `messenger` + `drive` + `wiki` + `productivity` + `whiteboard` + `meetings` are canonical; `microsoft-365` and `office-365` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-046 - Azure DevOps
- Vendor name and category: Microsoft Azure DevOps Services (formerly Visual Studio Team Services / VSTS / Team Foundation Server) — Azure Boards + Azure Repos (Git + TFVC) + Azure Pipelines (Classic UI + YAML) + Azure Test Plans + Azure Artifacts (NuGet / npm / Maven / PyPI / Cargo / Universal) + Service Connections + Service Hooks + Wiki + Dashboards + Analytics + Marketplace + Extensions / Microsoft ecosystem / DevOps platform.
- Coverage tier: B (partial: capability tier on `developer-sdk` + `foundry` + `workflow-engine`; possible new µservice for Artifacts in Wave-3-H — `artifact-registry`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Basic (5 free users) → **Bronze**; Basic + Test Plans → **Silver**; Basic + Test Plans + Visual Studio Subscriber + advanced security → **Gold**; Enterprise (advanced security + GitHub-Advanced-Security for ADO + multi-stage YAML + Audit log + per-org compliance) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: per-product — Boards → `workflow-engine` (work-item state-machine + custom process); Repos (Git) → `developer-sdk` (git); Repos (TFVC) → `developer-sdk` (legacy centralized version control bridge); Pipelines → `foundry` (build + release; classic + YAML); Test Plans → `developer-sdk` (test-runs); Artifacts → `developer-sdk` (per-package-feed) or new `artifact-registry`; Service Connections → `apigw` (credential-binding) + `compliance` (per-connection vault); Wiki → `wiki`; Dashboards + Analytics → `analytics`; `cloud-iac` (pipeline-agent fleet provisioning); `intelligence` (Copilot for Azure DevOps); `marketplace` (Azure DevOps Marketplace extensions per ADR-0249).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Azure DevOps platform model):
  - `Organization` (Org_ID, Name, URL `dev.azure.com/{org}`, Owner_Account, Region, Billing_Setup, Connected_Entra_Tenant).
  - `Project` (Project_ID, Org_Reference, Name, Description, Visibility {Private / Public-Open-Source}, Process_Template {Agile / Scrum / CMMI / Basic / Custom-Inherited}, State {Created / WellFormed / Deleting / Deleted}, Capabilities {Boards / Repos / Pipelines / Test-Plans / Artifacts}).
  - `Process` (Process_ID, Name, Parent_Process_Reference, Work_Item_Types[], Backlog_Configuration, Inheritance_Type {System / Inherited}, Customization_Bindings).
  - `Work_Item_Type` (Type_ID, Name {User-Story / Bug / Task / Epic / Feature / Issue / Test-Case / Custom}, Fields[], Workflow_States[], State_Transitions[], Rules[], Form_Layout).
  - `Work_Item` (Work_Item_ID, Project_Reference, Type_Reference, Title, State, Reason, Assigned_To, Iteration_Path, Area_Path, Description, History[], Discussion[Comment_ID], Links[Link_Type → Related_Work_Item], Tags[], Custom_Fields[], Created_By, Created_Date, Changed_By, Changed_Date, Watcher_List, Mention_List).
  - `Iteration` (Iteration_ID, Project_Reference, Name, Path, Start_Date, Finish_Date, Time_Frame {Past / Current / Future}, Parent_Iteration).
  - `Area` (Area_ID, Project_Reference, Name, Path, Parent_Area).
  - `Team` (Team_ID, Project_Reference, Name, Members[], Backlog_Visibilities, Default_Iteration, Default_Area, Working_Days, Capacity[Per-Team-Member-Per-Iteration]).
  - `Repository` (Repo_ID, Project_Reference, Name, Default_Branch, Type {Git / TFVC}, Size, Web_URL, Permissions[], Policies[Branch_Policy_ID → Type {RequireMin / RequireWorkItem / CommentResolution / Build / Status / RequireMergeStrategy / Path-Scope}]).
  - `Pull_Request` (PR_ID, Repo_Reference, Title, Source_Branch, Target_Branch, Source_Commit, Status {Active / Abandoned / Completed}, Creator, Reviewers[Reviewer + Vote {Approved / ApprovedWithSuggestions / WaitingForAuthor / Rejected / NoVote}], Required_Reviewers, Work_Items_Linked[], Iterations[], Threads[Comment_Thread]).
  - `Pipeline_Definition` (Definition_ID, Project_Reference, Name, Path, Type {Build / Release / YAML-Build / Multi-Stage-YAML}, YAML_File_Path (for YAML), Classic_Phases (for Classic), Triggers[CI / PR / Scheduled / Manual / Resource-Trigger], Variables, Variable_Groups[], Resources {Repos / Pipelines / Containers / Packages / Webhooks}, Stages_or_Jobs).
  - `Pipeline_Run` (Run_ID, Definition_Reference, State {InProgress / Completed / Canceled}, Result {Succeeded / Failed / Canceled / SucceededWithIssues}, Source_Branch, Source_Commit, Reason {Manual / IndividualCI / BatchedCI / Schedule / PullRequest / ResourceTrigger}, Queue_Time, Start_Time, Finish_Time, Logs).
  - `Test_Plan` (Plan_ID, Project_Reference, Name, Iteration, Owner, Test_Suites[Suite_ID → Type {Static / Dynamic-Query / Requirement-Based} + Test_Cases[]]).
  - `Test_Case` (Test_Case_ID, Test_Plan_Reference, Title, Steps[Step_Number → Action + Expected-Result], Priority, Owner, Automated_Test_Reference (linked to a build-runnable test method).
  - `Test_Run` (Run_ID, Test_Plan_Reference, Run_Status {InProgress / Completed / Aborted}, Test_Results[Test_Case → Outcome {Passed / Failed / Blocked / Not-Executed / Inconclusive} + Comment + Failure-Details + Attachments]).
  - `Artifact_Feed` (Feed_ID, Project_Reference (or Org-Scoped), Name, Permissions[], Views[@Local / @Prerelease / @Release / Custom], Upstreams[Upstream_Source]).
  - `Package` (Package_ID, Feed_Reference, Name, Protocol {NuGet / npm / Maven / PyPI / Cargo / Universal / Symbol}, Versions[Version_ID → State {Listed / Unlisted / Deleted} + Files[] + Hash + License-Expression + Vulnerability-Scan-Result]).
  - `Release_Definition` (Definition_ID, Project_Reference, Name, Artifacts[Artifact_Source_Type {Build / Github / Jenkins / Azure-Artifacts / TFVC / Containers / Custom}], Stages[Stage_ID → Pre-Approvers + Tasks + Post-Approvers + Trigger + Variables], Variables, Variable_Groups[]).
  - `Environment` (Environment_ID, Project_Reference, Name, Resources[VirtualMachine / Kubernetes-Namespace], Approvals[], Checks[Branch-Control / Required-Template / Business-Hours / Invoke-Function-or-REST]).
  - `Service_Connection` (Connection_ID, Project_Reference, Name, Type {Azure-RM / Azure-Classic / Bitbucket / Docker-Registry / GitHub / Generic / Jenkins / Kubernetes / Maven / npm / NuGet / SVN / TFVC / Visual-Studio-App-Center / etc.}, Auth_Scheme {Username-Password / Token / OAuth / Service-Principal / Managed-Identity / Workload-Identity-Federation / Certificate}, Authorization_State).
  - `Variable_Group` (Group_ID, Name, Variables[Var_Name → Value + IsSecret], Project_References[], Linked_KeyVault).
  - `Service_Hook_Subscription` (Subscription_ID, Project_Reference, Event {Work-Item-Updated / Code-Pushed / Build-Completed / Release-Created / etc.}, Consumer {WebHook / Slack / Teams / Trello / Jenkins / Jira / Zendesk / Azure-Service-Bus / Azure-Storage / Hipchat}, Action_Config).
  - `Wiki` (Wiki_ID, Project_Reference, Type {Project / Code}, Repo_Reference (for Code), Pages[Page_ID → Path + Order + Content (Markdown)]).
  - `Dashboard` / `Widget` (Dashboard_ID, Team_Reference, Widgets[Widget_Type {Chart-For-Work-Items / Sprint-Burndown / Velocity / Cumulative-Flow / Pull-Request / Build-Health / Release-Pipeline / Markdown / Embed-Webpage}]).
  - `Audit_Event` (Event_ID, Actor, Action, Timestamp, Source_IP, Project_Reference, Details).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Azure DevOps REST API: `https://dev.azure.com/{org}/_apis/{area}/...` (api-version > 7.0) — Work Items + Git + Pipelines + Test + Artifacts + Service Connections.
  - WIQL (Work Item Query Language): SQL-like query language for work items.
  - Azure DevOps CLI (`az devops`): per-resource CRUD.
  - Pipeline YAML schema: `azure-pipelines.yml` with stages + jobs + steps + templates + parameters + variables + resources + triggers.
  - Classic Pipeline Definition (JSON): legacy pipeline-definition format.
  - Service Hooks: per-subscription per-event outbound POST.
  - Azure Artifacts Package Protocols: per-protocol REST/HTTP per-package version push/pull.
  - Azure DevOps Extension SDK (`azure-devops-extension-sdk` / `azure-devops-extension-api`): for marketplace extensions.
  - Azure Pipelines Agent: per-agent self-hosted or Microsoft-hosted (Windows / Linux / macOS).
  - Audit Streaming: per-org audit-event streaming to webhook or storage.
  - REST API for GitHub-Advanced-Security for ADO: per-repo secret-scanning + dependency-scanning + code-scanning.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Project Hub" — per-project landing page with Recent Activity + Pinned Work + Quick Stats.
  - "Boards" — Kanban board + Backlog + Sprints + Queries + Plans (Delivery Plan).
  - "Repos Files" — file-browser with branch-selector + diff + history + Blame.
  - "Repos Pull Requests" — PR-list + per-PR overview + files + commits + checks + reviewers + threads + iterations.
  - "Pipelines Runs" — pipeline-list with per-run status + logs + artifacts + stages + duration.
  - "Pipelines Editor" — per-pipeline YAML or Classic editor + Variables + Variable Groups + Approvals + Templates.
  - "Releases Definitions" — Classic Release UI with stages + pre/post approvals + gates + retention.
  - "Test Plans" — per-plan set-tree + test-cases + per-run results + traceability matrix.
  - "Artifacts Feeds" — per-feed package-list + per-package versions + per-version details + Upstream sources.
  - "Project Settings" — Teams + Areas + Iterations + Processes + Permissions + Notifications + Boards configuration.
  - "Organization Settings" — Billing + Users + Groups + OAuth + Audit log + Extensions + Policies.
  - "Marketplace" — Extensions catalog + installed + purchased.
  - "Wiki" — Project wiki + Code wiki + per-page Markdown editor with TOC.
  - "Dashboards" — Per-team configurable widget canvas.
  - "Service Connections" — per-org credential-management.
  - "Branch Policies" — per-branch policy editor (build validation / status / required reviewers / work item linking / comment resolution / squash-merge).

- **Cedar permit shape** (composed per-product, ADO-cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<ado-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoBoardsCreateWorkItem", Oyatie::Action::"AdoBoardsTransitionState",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoBoardsRunWiqlQuery", Oyatie::Action::"AdoBoardsCustomizeProcess",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoReposPushBranch", Oyatie::Action::"AdoReposCreatePR",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoReposApprovePR", Oyatie::Action::"AdoReposBypassBranchPolicy",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoPipelinesEditYaml", Oyatie::Action::"AdoPipelinesRun",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoPipelinesApproveStage", Oyatie::Action::"AdoPipelinesConfigureEnvironment",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoReleasesEdit", Oyatie::Action::"AdoReleasesDeployStage",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoTestPlansExecute", Oyatie::Action::"AdoTestPlansEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoArtifactsPushPackage", Oyatie::Action::"AdoArtifactsConfigureFeed",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoArtifactsConfigureUpstream", Oyatie::Action::"AdoServiceConnectionCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoServiceConnectionRotateCredential", Oyatie::Action::"AdoServiceHookConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"AdoExtensionInstall", Oyatie::Action::"AdoAuditStreamConfigure"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::WorkItem::"<wi-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Repository::"<repo-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Pipeline::"<pipeline-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ArtifactFeed::"<feed-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ServiceConnection::"<connection-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    project_permission_grants(principal, action, resource.project) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AdoReposBypassBranchPolicy" ? principal.has_role("RepoAdmin") && context.bypass_reason_documented : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AdoPipelinesApproveStage" ? approver_listed_for(context.environment, principal) && !principal.is_originator_of_run(context.run) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AdoServiceConnectionCreate" || action == Oyatie::Action::"AdoServiceConnectionRotateCredential" ? principal.has_role("ProjectAdmin") && credential_stored_in_vault(context.credential) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AdoArtifactsPushPackage" ? package_signed(context.package) && vulnerability_scan_passed(context.package) && license_compliant(context.package) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AdoExtensionInstall" ? principal.has_role("OrgAdmin") && extension_security_reviewed(context.extension) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AdoAuditStreamConfigure" ? principal.has_role("OrgAdmin") : true) &&
    (resource.requires_slsa ? context.pack.contains("SLSA-L3") && provenance_attestation_present(context.run) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.environment == "Azure-Gov" ? context.pack.contains("FedRAMP-High") && data_pinned_to_us_gov_region(resource) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

  - `Iteration` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::iteration` (with start + finish + time-frame).

  - `Pull_Request` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::pull_request` (with reviewers + votes + threads + iterations + work-item-links).
  - `Pipeline_Definition` → `Oyatie::Foundry::pipeline_definition` (with YAML or Classic + triggers + stages + variables + resources).
  - `Pipeline_Run` → `Oyatie::Foundry::pipeline_run` (with state + result + logs + source-binding).

  - `Artifact_Feed` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::artifact_feed` (or new `Oyatie::ArtifactRegistry::feed` in Wave-3-H) (with permissions + views + upstreams).

  - `Dashboard` / `Widget` → `Oyatie::Analytics::dashboard` / `widget`.
  - `Audit_Event` → `Oyatie::Audit::event`.

- **Specific workflow steps** (Azure DevOps displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-org per-project inventory; per-project capability inventory (Boards / Repos / Pipelines / Test Plans / Artifacts) + customizations (process-template) + Service Connections + Service Hooks + Marketplace extensions + Variable Groups + Environments.
  2. **Boards extraction**: per-project process-template + work-item-types + states + transitions + rules + form-layout + custom-fields; per-Work_Item (with history + discussion + links + tags + iteration + area); per-WIQL saved-query.
  3. **Repos extraction**: per-repo Git clone (mirror) with all branches + tags + LFS + sub-modules + per-branch policies + per-PR (with reviewers + votes + threads + iterations + work-item-links); per-TFVC repo migrate via `git-tfs` or shadow-bridge.
  4. **Pipelines extraction**: per-pipeline YAML (`azure-pipelines.yml`) + per-Classic-definition JSON; per-template + per-resource + per-trigger + per-variable + per-variable-group; per-Pipeline_Run (with logs + artifacts).
  5. **Releases extraction**: per-Release_Definition Classic JSON + per-stage approvals + gates + variables + retention.
  6. **Test Plans extraction**: per-Test_Plan + per-Test_Suite (Static / Dynamic-Query / Requirement-Based) + per-Test_Case (with steps + expected-result + automated-test-link) + per-Test_Run (with results + attachments + screenshots + traceability).
  7. **Artifacts extraction**: per-Feed (with views + permissions + upstreams) + per-Package (per-protocol with versions + hash + license + vuln-scan); package-symbol-server data.
  8. **Service Connections extraction**: per-Connection (with type + auth-scheme); per-credential → OpenBao vault binding; per-Workload-Identity-Federation re-bind.
  9. **Variable Groups + KeyVault links extraction**: per-Group with secret-flag preserved; per-KeyVault-linkage re-bind.
  10. **Service Hooks extraction**: per-subscription event-type + consumer + filter + action-config.
  11. **Wiki extraction**: per-Project_Wiki + per-Code_Wiki Markdown + page-tree + attachments.
  12. **Dashboards extraction**: per-Team dashboards + widgets + queries + data-bindings.
  13. **Extensions (Marketplace) extraction**: per-installed-extension manifest + per-tenant config; per-extension replacement-mapping to plugin-app-store; gap-list.
  14. **Audit log extraction**: per-org audit-event stream → Oyatie audit-substrate.
  15. **Per-product destination shell**: Boards → workflow-engine; Repos → developer-sdk; Pipelines → foundry; Test Plans → developer-sdk; Artifacts → developer-sdk or artifact-registry; Wiki → wiki; Dashboards → analytics; Service Connections → apigw + compliance.
  16. **YAML pipeline transformation**: per-pipeline YAML AST-parse + per-task compatibility-mapping + per-template re-bind + per-variable re-bind + per-resource (repo / pipeline / container / package / webhook) re-bind to Oyatie Foundry DSL.
  17. **Classic pipeline transformation**: per-Classic-definition convert-to-YAML-equivalent + per-gated-release-task semantic-mapping + manual-review queue.
  18. **Work-item link rebind**: per-Boards-to-Repos commit-link / PR-link / build-link rebind; per-Test-Case-to-Build automated-test-binding re-resolve.
  19. **Parallel run**: 60-day shadow with per-Pipeline run-parity + per-PR review-flow parity + per-Test-Plan execute-parity + per-Artifact-Feed package-push/pull-parity ≥ 99.9% + per-Service-Hook fire-parity 100%.
  20. **Cutover**: per-org cut-over with URL-redirect for 24 months; per-pipeline agent-fleet cut-over; per-Service-Connection re-bind; per-Artifact-Feed package-protocol endpoint re-bind (NuGet / npm / Maven / PyPI / Cargo); per-Wiki + Dashboard URL re-bind.
  21. **Sunset**: Azure DevOps license sunset; per-project retention per tenant policy (typically 7 years for regulated; indefinite for legal-hold).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Work-item-link cross-project break on project-rename**: per-link historical-redirect with single-hop guarantee + cycle-detection.
  - **Classic-pipeline to YAML-pipeline conversion-loss** (gated-release-task / approver-fan-out / environment-pre-deploy semantics): per-pipeline conversion-report + per-task gap + manual-review queue.
  - **Test-plan associated-automation regression** (linked test-script not in new repo path): per-test re-bind with manual-mapping + golden-test parity.
  - **Artifact-feed package-deduplication across projects** (org-scoped vs project-scoped feed namespace conflict): per-feed namespace + per-package version-collision detect.
  - **Per-org service-connection credential migration** (Service-Principal / Managed-Identity / Workload-Identity-Federation re-bind drift): per-connection vault-binding + audit + dual-credential window.
  - **TFVC-to-Git migration history-loss** (TFVC branch-merge-graph ≠ Git DAG): per-TFVC `git-tfs` import with shelveset preservation + commit-message-pin.
  - **Branch-policy interpretation drift** (RequireMin reviewer count + path-scope + work-item-required mixed): per-policy golden-test on synthetic PRs.
  - **Pipeline-agent fleet migration outage** (self-hosted agents pool re-bind): per-agent staged-cutover + agent-pool dual-attach.
  - **Variable Group / KeyVault link break** (KeyVault reference re-bind during pipeline run): per-VG referrer-validate + alert on missing.
  - **Test-Case automated-test-binding "Reference to deleted method"**: per-test-case method-reference validate-on-publish + on-run alert.
  - **Audit stream gap during cutover** (per-org audit log discontinuity): per-tenant dual-stream window + per-period reconciliation.
  - **Artifact-feed Upstream-source-credential leak** (upstream uses public PAT in URL): per-upstream credential-vault + audit.
  - **Service Hook fan-out storm** (one work-item-update fires 50 subscriptions): per-subscription fan-out-cap + idempotency + dedup.
  - **GHAS-for-ADO secret-scanning gap on cutover** (Github-Advanced-Security secret-scanning history loss): per-finding migration + per-secret revocation status preserve.
  - **WIQL → OQL transformation drift**: per-saved-query parse + transform + golden-test on row-set.
  - **Wiki cross-link drift**: per-Wiki-page MD-link rewrite + per-attachment URL-rewrite.
  - **Marketplace extension permission-elevation** (extension installed with broad org-scope): per-extension permission-scope-review + per-install audit.
  - **Pipeline-template repository drift** (shared template repo moved): per-template `extends:` path-rewrite + dual-binding window.
  - **Manual-approval-loop deadlock** (approver out-of-office, no fallback): per-environment approval-timeout + fallback-approver chain.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Azure DevOps REST API + Azure DevOps CLI + `git clone --mirror` + `git-tfs` (for TFVC) + Azure Artifacts package-protocol clients + Audit Streaming API + Extension SDK; format — JSON + YAML + Git pack files + per-package protocol-specific (`.nupkg` / `.tgz` / `.jar`/.pom / `.whl` / `.crate` / Universal); duration — ~2-6 weeks per org depending on project count + repo size + pipeline complexity + artifact volume; bandwidth — heavy on Git LFS + Artifacts + Test attachments.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — per-process-template preserved with custom-field mapping; per-work-item-link preserved with cross-product URL-redirect; per-pipeline YAML preserved with per-task compatibility-mapping; per-Classic pipeline converted-to-YAML with manual-review queue; per-Artifact-Feed preserved with views + upstreams; per-Service-Connection vault-binding; lossy — some Azure-RM-specific Classic Release tasks rebuilt natively on Foundry; some Marketplace extensions no replacement (gap-list); GHAS-for-ADO findings migrated as-is with revocation-status preserve.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-org cut-over with URL-redirect for 24 months; per-pipeline agent-fleet cut-over; per-Service-Connection re-bind with dual-credential window; per-Artifact-Feed package-protocol endpoint re-bind (NuGet / npm / Maven / PyPI / Cargo) with Upstream-source preservation; per-Wiki + Dashboard URL re-bind; per-Service-Hook re-register.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 60-day shadow with per-Pipeline run-parity (per-stage per-task result + duration) + per-PR review-flow parity (per-vote per-thread) + per-Test-Plan execute-parity + per-Artifact-Feed package-push/pull-parity ≥ 99.9% + per-Service-Hook fire-parity 100% + per-Audit-event parity 100% + per-Branch-Policy enforcement parity 100%; sunset — Azure DevOps license sunset; per-project retention per tenant policy (7 years regulated; indefinite legal-hold).

- Workflow template library: `ado.work-item-with-release-link`; `ado.classic-yaml-pipeline-import`; `ado.test-plan-execute-with-traceability`; `ado.artifact-feed-promote`; `ado.release-pipeline-with-approval-gate`; `ado.service-connection-vault-bind`; `ado.tfvc-to-git-migrate`; `ado.wiql-to-oql-transform`; `ado.audit-stream-bind`; `ado.branch-policy-golden-test`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar developer + EM + tester + release-manager; desktop-primary work-item + repo + pipeline + release + test-plan; mobile work-item view + approval-respond.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + SLSA-L3 + supply-chain attestation + SBOM generation; FedRAMP-Mod/High for Azure-Gov tenants; DoD-IL5 for DoD; ITAR for defense projects; per-tenant data-residency; per-tenant audit-stream retention.
- Naming justification: `developer-sdk` + `foundry` + `workflow-engine` + `wiki` + `analytics` are canonical; `azure-devops` is benchmark alias.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-047 - Microsoft Defender XDR
- Vendor name and category: Microsoft Defender XDR (formerly Microsoft 365 Defender) — Defender for Endpoint (MDE) + Defender for Identity (MDI) + Defender for Office 365 (MDO) + Defender for Cloud Apps (MDCA / formerly MCAS) + Defender for IoT + Defender Vulnerability Management (MDVM) + Defender External Attack Surface Management (Defender EASM) + Defender Threat Intelligence (Defender TI) + Defender for Cloud (cross-cloud XDR side) + Copilot for Security integration / Microsoft ecosystem / extended detection + response.
- Coverage tier: A (capability tier on `security-substrate` + `siem` (D-086) + `secops` from ServiceNow D-022). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: MDE Plan 1 → **Bronze**; MDE Plan 2 + MDO Plan 1 + MDI → **Silver**; full Defender XDR (MDE P2 + MDI + MDO P2 + MDCA + MDVM) → **Gold**; Defender XDR + Defender for IoT + Defender EASM + Defender TI + Copilot for Security + cross-tenant XDR + ASR-with-deep-tuning → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `security-substrate` (endpoint + identity + email + cloud-app + IoT threat-signal source); `data-pipeline` (alert ingest at high TPS + per-product schema-validate); `itsm` (SecOps tier from D-022 — alert-to-SIR auto-create); `incident-management` (paging on HIGH+); `intelligence` (auto-investigation + Copilot for Security correlation); `compliance` (per-action audit + chain-of-custody); `identity` (per-user containment + risk-based-conditional-access signal-emission per D-051).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Defender XDR unified incident model):
  - `Incident` (Incident_ID, Display_Name, Severity {Informational / Low / Medium / High}, Status {Active / Resolved / InProgress / Redirected}, Classification {Unknown / FalsePositive / TruePositive_MaliciousActivity / TruePositive_SecurityTesting / TruePositive_UnwantedSoftware / InformationalExpectedActivity}, Determination {NotAvailable / Apt / Malware / SecurityPersonnel / SecurityTesting / UnwantedSoftware / Other / Multistaged / Phishing / MaliciousUserActivity / Compromised / Persistence / CryptoMining / Espionage / etc.}, Tags[], Assigned_To, Alerts[Alert_ID], Devices[Device_ID], Users[User_ID], Mailboxes[Mailbox_ID], Apps[Cloud-App-ID], Created_DateTime, Last_Update_DateTime, Resolved_DateTime, MTRP_or_Action_Center_Reference).
  - `Alert` (Alert_ID, Incident_Reference, Title, Description, Severity, Product_Source {MicrosoftDefenderForEndpoint / MicrosoftDefenderForIdentity / MicrosoftDefenderForOffice365 / MicrosoftDefenderForCloudApps / MicrosoftThreatIntelligence / MicrosoftDataLossPrevention / MicrosoftDefenderForCloud / MicrosoftPurview / AzureAdIdentityProtection}, Detection_Source, Detection_Technology, Category, MITRE_Techniques[], Detector_ID, Service_Source, First_Activity_DateTime, Last_Activity_DateTime, Evidence[Entity_Reference], Status, Investigation_State).
  - `Entity` (Entity_ID, Entity_Type {User / Device / Mailbox / MailMessage / Url / File / Process / RegistryKey / RegistryValue / IPAddress / DomainName / NetworkConnection / Sas / CloudApplication / OAuthApplication / SecurityGroup / CloudLogon / GovernanceAction / GoogleCloudResource / AwsResource / AzureResource / DnsRecord / ContainerRegistry / ContainerImage / Container / PodKubernetes / Hashes}, Properties (per-type variable schema)).
  - `Investigation` (Investigation_ID, Alert_Reference / Incident_Reference, State {Running / Pending / SuccessfullyRemediated / Failed / PartiallyRemediated / TerminatedByUser / TerminatedBySystem / Queued / InnerFailure / UnsupportedAlertType / PendingApproval}, Created_DateTime, Triggered_Alert_ID, Status_Details).
  - `MDE_Device` (Device_ID, Computer_DNS_Name, First_Seen, Last_Seen, OS_Platform, OS_Version, OS_Processor, Version, Last_IP_Address, Last_External_IP_Address, Health_Status {Active / Inactive / ImpairedCommunications / NoSensorData / NoSensorDataImpairedCommunications}, RBAC_Group, Risk_Score, Exposure_Level {None / Low / Medium / High}, AAD_Device_ID, Machine_Tags[], IoT_Device_Category).
  - `MDE_Vulnerability` (CVE_ID, Description, CVSS_Score, Severity, Has_Active_Exploit: bool, Last_Modified, Published_On, Vendor_Recommended_Mitigation, Affected_Software[]).
  - `MDE_Recommendation` (Recommendation_ID, Product_Name, Category, Sub_Category, Severity, Public_Exploit: bool, Active_Alert: bool, Associated_Threats[], Remediation_Type, Configuration_Score_Impact, Exposure_Score_Impact).
  - `MDO_Mailbox` (Mailbox_ID, User_Reference, Quarantine_Settings, Anti_Phish_Policy_Bound, Safe_Attachments_Policy_Bound, Safe_Links_Policy_Bound, Sender_Authentication_State).
  - `MDO_Submission` (Submission_ID, Submitted_By, Submitted_Item_Type {Email / EmailUrl / EmailAttachment / Url / File}, Result {Phish / Spam / Malware / NotJunk / NoThreatFound}, Reviewed_By, Reviewed_DateTime, Notes).
  - `MDI_Activity` (Activity_ID, Activity_Type {InteractiveLogon / Kerberos / NTLM / SMB / LDAP / DNS / DCSync / etc.}, Source_Entity, Destination_Entity, Timestamp, Anomaly_Score).
  - `MDI_Sensor` (Sensor_ID, Domain_Controller_Reference, Status {Healthy / Disabled / Unhealthy}, Version, Last_Heartbeat).
  - `MDCA_App` (App_ID, App_Name, App_Category, App_Risk_Score, Sanction_State {Sanctioned / Unsanctioned / Custom / Not-Tagged}, App_Tags[]).
  - `MDCA_Policy` (Policy_ID, Type {Access / Session / Cloud-Discovery / File / Activity / Anomaly-Detection / OAuth-App / Malware / Cloud-DLP}, Risk_Threshold, Governance_Actions[]).
  - `MDCA_Session_Action` (Action_ID, Type {Block-Download / Block-Upload / Protect-Download / Block-Print / Watermark / Block-Cut-Copy-Paste / Block-Custom-Activity}, Trigger_Condition).
  - `Advanced_Hunting_Query` (Query_ID, Name, KQL_Source, Saved_By, Schedule {OnDemand / Hourly / Daily}, Tables_Used[DeviceEvents / DeviceProcessEvents / DeviceFileEvents / DeviceImageLoadEvents / DeviceLogonEvents / DeviceNetworkEvents / DeviceRegistryEvents / IdentityLogonEvents / EmailEvents / EmailUrlInfo / EmailAttachmentInfo / CloudAppEvents / AlertInfo / AlertEvidence / IdentityInfo / DeviceInfo / AADSignInEventsBeta / etc.]).
  - `Custom_Detection_Rule` (Rule_ID, Name, KQL_Query, Frequency {Continuous / Every5Min / Every10Min / EveryHour / Every3Hours / Every12Hours / EveryDay}, Detection_Mode {Aggregated / Disaggregated}, Alert_Generation_Settings, Actions {Isolate-Machine / Collect-Investigation-Package / Run-AV-Scan / Initiate-Investigation / Restrict-App-Execution / Quarantine-File / Disable-User / Force-Password-Reset / Mark-User-As-Compromised / Notify-User}, Impacted_Entity).
  - `Threat_Intel_Indicator` (IOC_ID, Type {FileSha1 / FileSha256 / FileMD5 / IpAddress / Url / DomainName / CertificateThumbprint}, Action {Allow / Audit / Block / BlockAndRemediate / Warn}, Generate_Alert: bool, Severity, Expiration_DateTime, Title, Description, Recommended_Actions, RBAC_Group).
  - `Action` (Action_ID, Type {IsolateMachine / RestrictExecution / RunAntivirusScan / CollectInvestigationPackage / StopAndQuarantineFile / DisableUser / ForcePasswordReset / MarkUserAsCompromised / RevokeUserSessions / SuspendUser / QuarantineEmail / SoftDeleteEmail / HardDeleteEmail / MoveEmailToInbox / MoveEmailToJunk / MoveEmailToDeletedItems / DisableAppExecution / SuspendCloudApp / RemoveOAuthAppPermissions / etc.}, Status {Pending / InProgress / Completed / Failed / Cancelled}, Created_By, Created_DateTime, Approver, Approval_DateTime, Target_Entity_Reference).
  - `Live_Response_Session` (Session_ID, Device_Reference, Started_By, Started_DateTime, Commands_Executed[Command + Result], Files_Collected[]).
  - `Defender_Roles` (Role_ID, Name {Security-Administrator / Security-Reader / Security-Operator / Global-Administrator / Global-Reader}, RBAC_Group_Scopes[]).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Microsoft Graph Security API: `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/security/{incidents | alerts_v2 | cases | informationProtection | secureScores | secureScoreControlProfiles | tiIndicators | runHuntingQuery}`.
  - Microsoft Defender for Endpoint API: `https://api.securitycenter.microsoft.com/api/{machines | alerts | files | ips | urls | vulnerabilities | recommendations | indicators | machineactions | investigations | huntingQuery}`.
  - Microsoft Defender for Identity REST: `https://atp-instance.atp.azure.com/...`.
  - Microsoft Defender for Office 365 REST: per-policy + per-quarantine + per-submission + per-attack-simulation.
  - Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps REST: `https://your-tenant.us.portal.cloudappsecurity.com/api/v1/...` (per-region URL).
  - Defender Threat Intelligence API: per-IOC + per-Article + per-Profile.
  - Defender EASM API: per-Discovery-Group + per-Asset + per-Inventory.
  - Live Response API: per-device interactive shell-session.
  - Custom Detection Rules API + Advanced Hunting API (KQL): per-rule + per-query.
  - Streaming API (event-hub / storage): per-tenant raw-event egress.
  - Audit log via Microsoft Purview Audit.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Microsoft Defender Portal Home" — unified XDR landing with active-incident count + alert-trend + secure-score + recommended-actions + recent-investigations.
  - "Incidents queue" — incident-list with filter (severity + status + assigned-to + classification) + bulk-actions.
  - "Incident view" — overview + alerts + assets (devices / users / mailboxes / apps) + investigations + evidence + summary + similar-incidents.
  - "Incident Attack-Story" — graph visualization of entities + relationships + timeline-of-techniques (MITRE-ATT&CK overlay).
  - "Alerts queue" — per-product source filter + severity + status.
  - "Action Center" — pending + history of automated and manual actions awaiting approval / completed.
  - "Advanced Hunting (KQL editor)" — schema browser + KQL query-editor + saved-queries + scheduled-runs.
  - "Threat Analytics" — per-active-threat-actor + per-malware-family report + per-tenant exposure.
  - "Device inventory" (MDE) — device-list + per-device timeline + recommendations + collected investigation-package + Live Response.
  - "User inventory" (MDI + Entra-bridge) — per-user activity + risk + recent-alerts + recommended-actions.
  - "Email entity page" (MDO) — per-email header + URL + attachment + delivery-action + remediation.
  - "Cloud app catalog" (MDCA) — per-app risk-score + sanction-state + tags + activities.
  - "Vulnerability management" (MDVM) — per-CVE + per-recommendation + per-software-inventory + per-weakness.
  - "Attack Surface Management" (EASM) — per-asset inventory + per-asset risk + per-asset attribution.
  - "Threat Intelligence" (Defender TI) — per-IOC + per-actor + per-article + pivot-graph.
  - "Custom Detection Rules" — rule-list + per-rule KQL + frequency + actions + impacted-entity + history.
  - "Submissions" — admin + user-reported phish/spam/malware queue.
  - "Settings" — per-tenant device-config + email-policy + cloud-app-policy + RBAC + Streaming + Notifications.
  - "Copilot for Security pane (cross-Defender)" — natural-language incident-summarize + script-decode + IOC-analyze + KQL-generate.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<soc-analyst-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"XdrIngestAlert", Oyatie::Action::"XdrRunInvestigation",
      Oyatie::Action::"XdrIsolateEndpoint", Oyatie::Action::"XdrContainUser",
      Oyatie::Action::"XdrBlockUrl", Oyatie::Action::"XdrBlockIP",
      Oyatie::Action::"XdrQuarantineEmail", Oyatie::Action::"XdrSuspendCloudAppUser",
      Oyatie::Action::"XdrRunAutomatedInvestigation", Oyatie::Action::"XdrApproveAction",
      Oyatie::Action::"XdrRejectAction", Oyatie::Action::"XdrHuntWithKQL",
      Oyatie::Action::"XdrRunAdvancedHuntingQuery", Oyatie::Action::"XdrExportThreatEvidence",
      Oyatie::Action::"XdrCreateCustomDetectionRule", Oyatie::Action::"XdrUploadThreatIntelIndicator",
      Oyatie::Action::"XdrLiveResponseConnect", Oyatie::Action::"XdrLiveResponseRunScript",
      Oyatie::Action::"XdrInvokeCopilot"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::ThreatAlert::"<alert-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Incident::"<incident-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Device::"<device-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CustomDetectionRule::"<rule-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    defender_rbac_role_grants(principal, action, resource.rbac_scope) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"XdrIsolateEndpoint" ? resource.device.criticality_class == "Production" ? context.dual_admin_approval : true : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"XdrLiveResponseRunScript" ? script_signed_and_reviewed(context.script) && context.dual_admin_approval : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"XdrContainUser" || action == Oyatie::Action::"XdrSuspendCloudAppUser" ? !resource.user.has_role("BreakGlassAdmin") && context.justification_documented : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"XdrUploadThreatIntelIndicator" ? principal.has_role("Security-Administrator") && indicator_validated(context.indicator) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"XdrCreateCustomDetectionRule" ? principal.has_role("Security-Administrator") && kql_validated(context.rule.kql) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"XdrInvokeCopilot" ? context.pack.allows_ai_processing(resource.classification) && copilot_data_does_not_leave_tenant : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"XdrExportThreatEvidence" ? principal.has_role("Security-Investigator") && evidence_chain_of_custody_logged(context.export, principal) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.environment == "GCC-High" ? context.pack.contains("FedRAMP-High") && data_pinned_to_us_gov_region(resource) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    (resource.contains_phi ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && phi_breach_notify_path_active(principal, resource) : true) &&
    rate_limit_per_action(principal, action, context.window) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific workflow steps** (Defender XDR displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant per-product Defender plan inventory (MDE P1/P2 / MDI / MDO P1/P2 / MDCA / MDVM / MDIoT / Defender-EASM / Defender-TI) + per-tenant licensed user count + per-tenant device count + per-tenant managed mailbox count + per-tenant cloud-app inventory.
  2. **Incident + Alert + Entity extraction**: per-Graph Security API export of all open + 90-day-historical incidents + alerts + entities + investigations with full evidence chain.
  3. **Per-MDE device extraction**: per-Device device-attributes + tags + RBAC-group + risk + exposure + last-IP + AAD-binding; per-device collected investigation-packages; per-device timeline (historical events bounded by retention).
  4. **Per-MDE policy extraction**: per-ASR-rule + per-tamper-protection + per-EDR-block-mode + per-controlled-folder-access + per-network-protection + per-attack-surface-reduction state.
  5. **Per-MDI sensor + activity extraction**: per-Sensor health + version + heartbeat + per-Activity historical (bounded).
  6. **Per-MDO policy extraction**: per-Anti-Phish + Anti-Spam + Anti-Malware + Safe-Attachments + Safe-Links policies + per-Quarantine release-history + per-Submission history + per-Attack-Simulation campaign history.
  7. **Per-MDCA app + policy extraction**: per-App risk + sanction-state + per-Policy (Access / Session / Cloud-Discovery / File / Activity / Anomaly-Detection / OAuth-App / Malware / Cloud-DLP) + per-Session-Action (Block-Download / Watermark / etc.) + per-OAuth-App-Permission audit.
  8. **Per-MDVM extraction**: per-CVE + per-Recommendation + per-Software-Inventory + per-Weakness + per-Configuration-Score history.
  9. **Defender TI extraction**: per-IOC + per-Article + per-Profile + per-Actor with sources.
  10. **Defender EASM extraction**: per-Discovery-Group + per-Asset-Inventory + per-Risk + per-Attribution.
  11. **Advanced Hunting + Custom Detection Rules extraction**: per-saved-Query KQL source + per-Custom-Detection-Rule KQL + frequency + actions + impacted-entity + 90-day result-history.
  12. **Threat Intel Indicators (IOCs) extraction**: per-Indicator type + action + expiration + severity + RBAC-group.
  13. **Actions + Live Response history extraction**: per-Action type + status + approver + chain-of-custody; per-Live-Response session commands + files-collected.
  14. **RBAC + Roles extraction**: per-Role + per-Group + per-Scope-binding.
  15. **Streaming API binding**: per-tenant Event-Hub / Storage destination → Oyatie data-pipeline ingest endpoint.
  16. **Per-product destination shell**: alerts/incidents → security-substrate; investigations → security-substrate; SOC analyst UI → security-substrate dashboards; ITSM SIR → itsm per D-022.
  17. **KQL → Oyatie-Hunting-Query-Dialect transformation**: per-saved-query + per-custom-detection-rule AST-parse + per-built-in-function compatibility + per-table-schema mapping + per-aggregation semantics-preserve.
  18. **Per-action chain-of-custody migration**: per-action audit-trail + approver-signature + before/after-state preserved.
  19. **Per-evidence migration**: per-Evidence-blob (binary + metadata) + per-hash-pin + chain-of-custody dual-write.
  20. **Per-Streaming-API event-stream cut-over**: dual-stream window + per-event reconcile.
  21. **Parallel run**: 90-day shadow with sample tenant + per-alert detect-parity + per-incident correlate-parity + per-investigation outcome-parity + per-KQL query-result parity ≥ 99.9% + per-action outcome-parity 100% + per-evidence chain-of-custody parity 100%.
  22. **Cutover**: per-tenant cut-over per-product staggered (MDE first, then MDI, MDO, MDCA, MDVM); per-Streaming-API endpoint rebind; per-Custom-Detection-Rule re-enable; per-IOC re-publish; per-Live-Response endpoint rebind.
  23. **Sunset**: Defender XDR license sunset; per-tenant evidence + investigation retention per breach-notification mandates (typically 6 years for HIPAA breach; 7 years for SOC-2 audit; 10+ years for SOX-bound; indefinite for active legal-hold).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Auto-investigation false-action** (auto-isolation of legitimate production endpoint): per-action approval-gate for production-class assets + per-classification dual-admin + rollback API.
  - **KQL-query semantics drift** (KQL vs target query language built-in functions): per-saved-query golden-test on historical event-sample + per-function compatibility-mapping registry.
  - **Cross-Defender-product correlation-loss** (MDE signal + MDI signal + MDO signal must correlate into single incident): per-entity cross-product correlation engine + per-correlation-rule golden-test.
  - **Alert-flood under wide-spread incident** (ransomware on 10k devices floods queue): per-source rate-limit + priority-aware queueing + per-incident-grouping + UI bulk-action.
  - **Evidence chain-of-custody break on migration**: per-evidence dual-write + verifier + per-hash-pin + per-action approver-signature preserved.
  - **MDCA-session-policy enforcement gap** (Reverse-Proxy mode + session-policy lag): per-policy real-time-enforcement + golden-test on session-action.
  - **MDI-sensor coverage gap** (Domain-Controller missed sensor install → no MDI signal): per-DC sensor-health monitor + alert on missing.
  - **MDE-EDR-block-mode bypass** (custom-binary signed-by-vendor bypasses EDR): per-binary hash-pin + per-process attribution + manual review queue.
  - **MDO Safe-Links URL-rewrite leak** (URL rewrite breaks user-bookmark): per-link rewrite-policy + per-recipient consent + UI banner.
  - **MDVM CVSS-score drift** (NVD score differs from vendor adjusted-score): per-CVE dual-score display + per-tenant prioritization-override.
  - **Defender-TI IOC-staleness** (IOC published, then refuted by vendor): per-IOC source-attribution + freshness-floor + auto-expire.
  - **Defender-EASM attribution-error** (asset attributed to wrong tenant): per-asset attribution-evidence + per-tenant manual-confirm.
  - **Streaming API event-loss** (Event-Hub throttle): per-tenant per-event guaranteed-delivery + retry + dead-letter.
  - **Live-Response script destructive-action mis-fire** (script deletes wrong files): per-script signed-and-reviewed + dry-run mode + dual-admin approval.
  - **Custom-Detection-Rule frequency-storm** (every-5-min rule with high-cardinality joins on 100k devices): per-rule cost-estimate + reject-above-budget + auto-suggest aggregation.
  - **RBAC scope-bleed** (Security-Operator sees data from RBAC-group not in their scope): per-action RBAC-scope check + per-access audit.
  - **MDE-isolated-device communication-restore gap** (device isolated, then needed for legit work): per-isolation justified-bypass + audit + alert.
  - **OAuth-App-revoke cascade** (revoking permissive OAuth app breaks downstream services): per-app dependency-graph + impact-analyze + staged-revoke.
  - **Copilot for Security hallucination** (Copilot fabricates IOC origin): per-Copilot output validate-against-source + per-suggestion human-review.
  - **Investigation auto-remediation outside business-hours** (auto-remediate fires at 3AM, no review): per-classification business-hours-policy + per-action delayed-execute window.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Microsoft Graph Security API + Defender REST APIs (per-product) + Streaming API (Event-Hub / Storage) + Defender CLI + KQL Advanced Hunting API; format — JSON + KQL + binary evidence-blobs + chain-of-custody audit-trail JSON; duration — ~3-8 weeks per tenant depending on user/device count + retention window + custom-rule count; bandwidth — heavy on raw-event stream + evidence-blobs.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — per-Incident + Alert + Entity + Investigation preserved with full evidence + chain-of-custody; per-MDE-device tag + RBAC-group + risk-score preserved; per-MDO-policy preserved with per-policy-rule compatibility-mapping; per-MDCA-policy preserved; per-MDVM CVE + recommendation preserved; per-Advanced-Hunting / Custom-Detection KQL preserved with per-function compatibility + golden-test; per-IOC preserved with TTL; per-RBAC role preserved with per-scope-binding; lossy — some Copilot-for-Security models rebuilt natively; some Defender-EASM attribution-models rebuilt.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-tenant staggered cut-over (MDE first → MDI → MDO → MDCA → MDVM → MDIoT → EASM → TI); per-Streaming-API endpoint rebind; per-Custom-Detection-Rule re-enable; per-IOC re-publish; per-Live-Response endpoint rebind; per-MDE-EDR sensor re-install (per-device cut-over).
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run — 90-day shadow with sample tenant + per-alert detect-parity + per-incident correlate-parity + per-investigation outcome-parity + per-KQL query-result parity ≥ 99.9% + per-action outcome-parity 100% + per-evidence chain-of-custody parity 100% + per-IOC-block actual-prevention-parity + per-Streaming-API event-delivery parity 100%; sunset — Defender XDR license sunset; per-tenant evidence + investigation retention per breach-notification mandates.

- Workflow template library: `xdr.alert-ingest-and-correlate`; `xdr.auto-investigation-with-approval-gate`; `xdr.containment-action-with-rollback`; `xdr.advanced-hunting-cross-source-query`; `xdr.evidence-collection-with-chain-of-custody`; `xdr.kql-query-golden-test-on-historical-events`; `xdr.live-response-script-with-dual-admin`; `xdr.streaming-api-dual-stream-cutover`; `xdr.cross-product-correlation-with-mitre-attck-overlay`.
- UX shell adaptation: SOC-analyst desktop-primary; incident-graph with entity-pivot; KQL-editor + saved-query; mobile alert-triage + approve/reject pending action.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + NIST 800-53 + FedRAMP-High + DoD-IL5; HIPAA breach-detection + breach-notification path; GDPR breach-72hr-notification path; KR-PIPA breach-notification; per-tenant data-residency for threat-evidence; ITAR for defense-tenant; CJIS for law-enforcement; per-tenant evidence-retention per mandate (6-10 years regulated; indefinite legal-hold).
- Naming justification: `security-substrate` is canonical; `microsoft-defender-xdr` and `microsoft-365-defender` are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-048 - Microsoft Sentinel
- Vendor name and category: Microsoft Sentinel (built atop Log Analytics + Azure Monitor + integrated with Defender XDR per D-047) — Data Connectors + Analytics Rules (Scheduled-Query / NRT / Fusion / ML-Behavioral / Microsoft-Security / Anomaly) + Incidents + Investigation Graph + Hunting Queries + Bookmarks + Watchlists + UEBA (User and Entity Behavior Analytics) + Threat Intelligence (TI Indicators + TAXII Feeds) + Automation Rules + SOAR Playbooks (Logic Apps) + Workbooks + Content Hub (Solutions) + Notebooks (Jupyter) / Microsoft ecosystem / cloud-native SIEM + SOAR.
- Coverage tier: D (microservice composition: `siem` (D-086 anchor) + `data-pipeline` (high-TPS ingest) + `workflow-engine` (SOAR playbook)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: basic Log Analytics + Scheduled-Query rules → **Bronze**; full Analytics-rule types + Hunting + Bookmarks + Watchlists → **Silver**; SOAR Playbooks + UEBA + Fusion-ML + Workbooks + TI Indicators → **Gold**; cross-workspace + cross-tenant MSSP + Anomaly Detection + Auxiliary Logs + Customer-Managed-Keys + Copilot-for-Security + multi-region + Anomalies-with-tunable-thresholds → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `siem` (log ingest + analytics-rule + investigation + workbooks); `data-pipeline` (data-connector + high-TPS ingest + table-transformation + Auxiliary Logs); `workflow-engine` (SOAR playbook = Logic Apps analog); `intelligence` (UEBA + Fusion-ML + Anomaly Detection); `compliance` (per-table retention + customer-managed-keys + per-tenant residency); `cloud-iac` (per-workspace per-capacity sizing); `developer-sdk` (Notebooks integration); `evidence-store` (per-incident evidence chain).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Sentinel + Log Analytics model):
  - `Workspace` (Workspace_ID, Name, Resource_Group_Reference, Subscription_Reference, Region, SKU {PerGB2018 / CapacityReservation-100-200-300-400-500-1000-2000-5000-10000GB}, Retention_Days {default 30; up to 730 daily; archive up to 7 years}, Daily_Cap_GB, Workspace_Capping_State, Public_Network_Access_For_Ingestion, Public_Network_Access_For_Query, Customer_Managed_Key_Reference, Tags).
  - `Data_Connector` (Connector_ID, Workspace_Reference, Kind {AzureActiveDirectory / AzureSecurityCenter / MicrosoftDefenderAdvancedThreatProtection / Office365 / AmazonWebServicesCloudTrail / AmazonWebServicesS3 / GenericUI / APIPolling / Office365Project / OfficePowerBI / OfficeATP / OfficeIRM / MicrosoftThreatIntelligence / MicrosoftThreatProtection / Dynamics365 / IoT / etc.}, Data_Types_Bound[], Status {Connected / Disconnected / Updating}, Polling_Cadence, Authentication_Method).
  - `Log_Analytics_Table` (Table_Name, Workspace_Reference, Schema[Column_Name → Type + Description], Plan {Analytics / Basic / Auxiliary}, Retention_Days, Total_Retention_Days, Ingestion_Time_Transformation_Reference).
  - `Data_Collection_Rule` (DCR_ID, Workspace_Reference, Stream_Declarations[], Destinations[], Data_Flows[Streams → Destinations + KQL-Transformation], Data_Collection_Endpoint_Reference).
  - `Analytics_Rule` (Rule_ID, Display_Name, Description, Severity {Informational / Low / Medium / High}, Kind {Scheduled / Fusion / MicrosoftSecurityIncidentCreation / NRT / MLBehaviorAnalytics / ThreatIntelligence / Anomaly}, KQL_Query (for Scheduled / NRT / TI), Query_Frequency (PT5M-PT24H), Query_Period (PT5M-PT14D), Trigger_Operator {GreaterThan / LessThan / Equal / NotEqual}, Trigger_Threshold, Suppression_Duration, Suppression_Enabled: bool, Tactics[MITRE ATT&CK], Techniques[MITRE ATT&CK], Entity_Mappings[Entity_Type → Field_Mappings[Identifier → Column]], Custom_Details[], Incident_Configuration (Create-Incident: bool + Grouping_Configuration {GroupByEntities / GroupByAlertDetails / GroupByCustomDetails / Lookback / ReopenClosedIncident}), Alert_Details_Override, Event_Grouping {SingleAlert / AlertPerResult}, Enabled: bool, Last_Modified_UTC, Version).
  - `Incident` (Incident_ID, Title, Severity, Status {New / Active / Closed}, Classification {Undetermined / TruePositive / BenignPositive / FalsePositive}, Classification_Reason, Classification_Comment, Owner, Labels[], Alerts[Alert_ID], Bookmarks[Bookmark_ID], Entities[Entity_ID], First_Activity_UTC, Last_Activity_UTC, Created_UTC, Last_Modified_UTC, Provider_Incident_ID, Related_Analytics_Rule_Reference, Tasks[], Comments[]).
  - `Bookmark` (Bookmark_ID, Display_Name, Query, Query_Result, Notes, Tags[], Created_By, Updated_By, Created_UTC, Updated_UTC, Incident_Reference (optional), Entities[]).
  - `Watchlist` (Watchlist_ID, Display_Name, Description, Provider, Source_File, Items_Search_Key, Items[], Default_Duration, Number_Of_Lines_To_Skip, Raw_Content, Content_Type, Tenant_ID, Item_Count).
  - `Hunting_Query` (Query_ID, Display_Name, Query, Description, Tactics[], Techniques[], Required_Data_Connectors[], Version, Solution_Reference).
  - `Threat_Intel_Indicator` (Indicator_ID, Type {file / url / domain-name / ipv4-addr / ipv6-addr / email-addr}, Value, Confidence (0-100), Pattern (STIX pattern), Pattern_Type, Threat_Types[], Kill_Chain_Phases[], Valid_From, Valid_Until, External_References[], Labels[], Source, TLP_Level {white / green / amber / red}, Indicator_Types[], Created_By, Modified_By).

  - `Solution` / `Content_Hub_Item` (Solution_ID, Display_Name, Publisher, Version, Categories[], Provided_Content[Connectors / Analytics-Rules / Workbooks / Playbooks / Hunting-Queries / Watchlists / Parsers / etc.]).
  - `UEBA_Profile` (Profile_ID, Entity_Type {User / Host / IP / etc.}, Baseline_Activity[], Anomaly_Scores[Anomaly_Type → Score]).
  - `Anomaly_Rule` (Anomaly_ID, Name, Anomaly_Version, Frequency, Threshold, ML_Source).
  - `Notebook` (Notebook_ID, Name, Jupyter_Source, Kernel {Python / PySpark}, Last_Run, Saved_In_AML_Workspace_Reference).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Sentinel REST: `https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/{sub}/resourceGroups/{rg}/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/{ws}/providers/Microsoft.SecurityInsights/{alertRules | incidents | bookmarks | watchlists | dataConnectors | automationRules | onboardingStates | settings | entities}` API-version 2024+.
  - Log Analytics Query API: `https://api.loganalytics.io/v1/workspaces/{workspace-id}/query` for KQL queries.
  - Log Analytics Data Collector API (legacy) and Logs Ingestion API (modern): per-table ingestion endpoint.
  - Microsoft Graph Security API (TI Indicators): `/security/tiIndicators` for indicators (per D-047).
  - Logic Apps REST: per-playbook (since playbooks are Logic Apps).
  - ARM Templates / Bicep: per-Sentinel-component IaC (workspace + DCR + Analytics-Rule + Watchlist + etc.).
  - Sentinel-as-Code (`sentinel-as-code` Github Action / Azure DevOps Task): per-rule version-control with `.yaml` definitions.
  - Notebooks via Azure Machine Learning workspace or Jupyter.
  - TAXII 2.x client for TI feeds.
  - Sentinel Repositories: per-tenant Git-backed content management.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<soc-analyst-or-content-author-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"SiemIngestLog", Oyatie::Action::"SiemRunKqlQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"SiemCreateAnalyticsRule", Oyatie::Action::"SiemEditAnalyticsRule",
      Oyatie::Action::"SiemFireIncident", Oyatie::Action::"SiemRunSoarPlaybook",
      Oyatie::Action::"SiemApproveSoarAction", Oyatie::Action::"SiemRunUebaBaseline",
      Oyatie::Action::"SiemCreateWatchlist", Oyatie::Action::"SiemIngestThreatIntelFeed",
      Oyatie::Action::"SiemHuntWithBookmark", Oyatie::Action::"SiemExportIncidentEvidence",
      Oyatie::Action::"SiemConfigureDataConnector", Oyatie::Action::"SiemConfigureRetention",
      Oyatie::Action::"SiemInstallSolution", Oyatie::Action::"SiemRunNotebook",
      Oyatie::Action::"SiemConfigureAutomationRule", Oyatie::Action::"SiemInvokeCopilot"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::SiemWorkspace::"<ws-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AnalyticsRule::"<rule-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Incident::"<incident-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Playbook::"<playbook-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    sentinel_rbac_role_grants(principal, action, resource) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SiemConfigureDataConnector" ? principal.has_role("Sentinel-Contributor") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SiemInstallSolution" ? principal.has_role("Sentinel-Contributor") && solution_security_reviewed(context.solution) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SiemRunSoarPlaybook" ? playbook_permission_grants(principal, context.playbook) && playbook_dry_run_passed(context.playbook) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SiemApproveSoarAction" ? approver_distinct_from_originator(principal, context.action) && context.action.destructive ? context.dual_admin_approval : true : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SiemCreateAnalyticsRule" || action == Oyatie::Action::"SiemEditAnalyticsRule" ? kql_validated(context.rule.kql) && cost_estimate_within_budget(context.rule) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SiemRunKqlQuery" ? query_cost_within_budget(principal, context.query) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SiemExportIncidentEvidence" ? principal.has_role("Sentinel-Investigator") && evidence_chain_of_custody_logged(context.export, principal) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SiemInvokeCopilot" ? context.pack.allows_ai_processing(resource.classification) && copilot_data_does_not_leave_tenant : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"SiemIngestLog" ? per_table_classification_compatible(context.table, context.events) && per_table_residency_compatible(context.table, resource.region) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.environment == "Azure-Gov" ? context.pack.contains("FedRAMP-High") && data_pinned_to_us_gov_region(resource) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource) : true) &&
    (resource.contains_phi ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && phi_minimum_necessary_check(principal, context.query) : true) &&
    (resource.contains_pci_card_data ? context.pack.contains("PCI-DSS") && pci_tokenize_before_ingest(context.events) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```
