  - `Cross_Tenant_Access_Setting` → `Oyatie::Identity::cross_tenant_setting` (B2B-collab + B2B-direct-connect + sync).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Entra ID displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant user count + group count + per-app count (Enterprise-App + App-Registration) + per-managed-identity count + per-CA-policy count + per-PIM-eligible assignment count + per-Access-Review history + per-Access-Package count + per-Verified-ID issuer config + per-Risk-Detection history retention + per-Cross-Tenant-Setting per-partner.
  2. **User extraction**: per-User via Graph (`/users`) with manager + employee-type + employee-hire/leave + assigned-licenses + on-prem-immutable-id + auth-methods + risk-level + risk-state + custom-security-attributes.
  3. **Group extraction**: per-Group with group-types + dynamic-membership-rule + processing-state + assigned-licenses + members + owners.
  4. **Role + Role-Assignment extraction**: per-Role with role-permissions + is-built-in + is-privileged; per-Role-Assignment with directory-scope + condition.
  5. **Application + Service-Principal extraction**: per-App registration + per-SP including OAuth2-permission-grants + App-Role-Assignments + KeyCredentials + PasswordCredentials + Federated-Identity-Credentials + SAML SSO settings + redirect-URIs + branding.
  6. **Managed-Identity extraction**: per-Identity system-assigned vs user-assigned + bound Azure-resources; per-resource credential-rotate plan.
  7. **Authentication-Method extraction**: per-User per-method type + display-name + AAGUID (FIDO2) + cert-CA-subject (CBA) + phone-number (Phone); per-passkey credential public-key (private key remains on device — re-registration required).
  8. **Conditional-Access-Policy extraction**: per-Policy state + conditions + grant-controls + session-controls + assigned-users/apps; per-policy What-If replay against last 30 days of sign-ins.
  9. **PIM extraction**: per-Eligible-Assignment + per-Activation-Request history with justification + ticket-system-reference + approver-references.
  10. **Access-Review extraction**: per-Review reviewers + scope + recurrence + auto-apply + decisions history; per-review pending-instances.
  11. **Entitlement-Package extraction**: per-Package catalog + resource-roles + assignment-policies + pending-requests.
  12. **Identity-Risk-Detection extraction**: per-Detection risk-type + level + state + detection-timing + activity-type + user + IP + location (retained per regulatory mandate).
  13. **Verified-ID extraction**: per-Issuer config + Credential-schema + Holder-Allow-List + Verifier-Allow-List + Revocation-Status-Endpoint.
  14. **Cross-Tenant-Sync extraction**: per-Partner-Tenant configuration + sync-cycle history + B2B-Direct-config.
  15. **Per-Federation-Cred re-issuance**: per-FIC re-issue with overlap window (GitHub Actions / AWS / GCP / Kubernetes external identity providers re-register).
  16. **Per-Passkey re-registration plan**: per-User re-prompt with grace-period + fallback-to-MFA-only window + per-device re-attest.
  17. **Per-Application token-issuer rotation**: per-App dual-issuer window (old + new authority URLs) with staged cut-over + sign-out + sign-in trigger.
  18. **Per-CA-policy golden-test**: per-policy replay against last-30-days sign-in-log → expected-outcome diff < 0.1% → cut-over enabled.
  19. **Per-PIM-eligibility migration**: per-Eligible-Assignment preserved with start/end + justification + member-type; activation-flow re-pointed to Oyatie PIM endpoint.
  20. **Per-Access-Review migration**: per-Review pending instances completed first; new-cycle scheduled in Oyatie Compliance.
  21. **Per-Entitlement-Package migration**: per-Package catalog migrated; assignment-policies preserved; pending-requests carried over.
  22. **Per-Risk-Detection signal-source**: per-detection-type ML-model retrained on Oyatie intelligence stack with parity test on labeled historical detections.
  23. **Per-Verified-ID-Issuer rebinding**: per-Issuer DID rebinding + per-credential-schema migration + per-revocation-endpoint cut-over.
  24. **Per-Cross-Tenant-Sync re-pair**: per-Partner-Tenant re-pair with mutual admin approval; per-historical-sync state preserved.
  25. **Parallel run**: 30-90 day shadow with sample tenant + per-user sign-in-parity 100% + per-CA-policy outcome-parity 99.9%+ + per-PIM activation-parity 100% + per-Access-Review decision-parity 100% + per-Risk-Detection signal-parity ≥ 99% + per-Verified-ID issuance/verification-parity 100%.
  26. **Cutover**: per-app staged with token-issuer-rotation; per-passkey re-registration grace; per-managed-identity dual-credential window; per-FIC re-issue; per-cross-tenant-sync re-pair.
  27. **Sunset**: Entra ID license sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate (audit-logs typically 1-year for P1, 30-day P2 risk-detections retained per HIPAA + FedRAMP requirements).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **SAML / OIDC issuer-change downtime** (apps still pointing to old Entra issuer): per-app dual-issuer window + Federation-metadata serve-both + automated SAML-endpoint update via SP-API where possible.
  - **Passkey re-registration cliff** (every user must re-register passkey because private key never leaves device): per-user staged-rollout + fallback-to-MFA-only with re-prompt + temporary-access-pass for break-glass.
  - **Conditional-Access policy semantics-drift on cut-over** (subtle predicate change locks out admin): per-policy What-If replay against last-30-days sign-in log + emergency-break-glass account exempt by design + cut-over with monitored watch-window.
  - **PIM-just-in-time race** (user activates role just as access-review revokes eligibility): per-activation eligibility-check at activation-time + revocation broadcasts to active sessions via Continuous Access Evaluation.
  - **Workload-identity (managed identity) credential-handoff** (Azure resource still using old MI token after tenant migration): per-managed-identity dual-credential window + per-resource token-issuer rotation + monitored failure.
  - **Federated-Identity-Credential issuer-pinning break** (GitHub Actions / AWS / GCP token-issuer pin stale): per-FIC dual-binding window + per-pipeline failure-alert.
  - **Cross-tenant-sync directional drift** (inbound vs outbound config mismatch silently filters users): per-direction explicit-config + per-sync result diff-report.
  - **Conditional-Access What-If false-confidence** (What-If based on simulated user, real user behavior diverges): per-policy parallel-monitored real-traffic shadow before enable.
  - **Risk-Detection ML-model retrain divergence** (Oyatie model labels different users as risky): per-labeled-detection golden-test + retrain until parity ≥ 99% + acceptance criteria reviewed by security.
  - **Verified-ID DID-rebinding break** (holder-stored credential references old issuer DID): per-credential issuer-rotation with grace + per-credential re-issue option.
  - **Privileged-Role activation MFA-context drift** (PIM required MFA at activation, Oyatie equivalent requires MFA at sign-in only): per-PIM-activation MFA-context explicit-pin + Cedar policy refuse-on-stale-MFA.
  - **Access-Package self-service request orphan** (Entra request pending at cut-over, Oyatie has no record): per-pending-request explicit-decision (apply or deny) before cut-over.
  - **App-secret rotation cliff** (apps using PasswordCredential expire all at once): per-app rotation-cadence + 30-day pre-expiry alert + KeyCredential migration where supported (certificates instead of secrets).
  - **Custom-Security-Attribute schema drift** (custom attributes used in CA-conditions silently lose semantics): per-attribute schema-pin + per-policy reference-validate.
  - **B2B-Guest invitation race** (guest accepts invitation after cut-over): per-pending-invite explicit-extension or revoke before cut-over.
  - **Multi-tenant org sync over-fetch** (MTO sync pulls more users than expected): per-sync scope-pin + per-cycle delta-cap + alert.
  - **Continuous-Access-Evaluation revocation lag** (revoked token still accepted by RP for up to 10 min): per-app CAE-support-pin + token-binding lifetime tuned.
  - **Service-Principal app-role-assignment-required false** (anonymous principal can call app): per-SP require-app-role explicit-default-true.
  - **Authentication-Strength policy upgrade-break** (FIDO2-required policy locks out users without FIDO2 device): per-strength-policy rollout with rollback + temporary-access-pass.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Microsoft Graph v1.0 + beta + Microsoft.Graph PowerShell SDK + AzureAD/AzureADPreview (legacy) + Federation-Metadata + OIDC Discovery + SCIM + Verified-ID Request Service API; format — JSON + XML (federation metadata) + JWT (federated credentials); duration — ~2-8 weeks for SMB tenant, ~3-9 months for enterprise tenant with hybrid AD + complex CA-policies + many app integrations + Verified ID + cross-tenant-sync; volume — per-tenant typically 1K-500K users + 10K-100K groups + 100-5000 apps + 50-500 CA-policies + 10-100 access-packages.
  - **Mapping phase**: Known field deltas — per-User UPN + employee-type + manager preserved; per-Group dynamic-rule preserved with rule-syntax-pin; per-Role permissions preserved; per-App OAuth permissions preserved with consent-history; per-SP federation-credentials preserved with rotation; per-Auth-Method FIDO2 / Passkey requires re-registration (private-key never leaves device); per-CA-policy preserved with What-If replay; per-PIM eligibility + activation preserved; per-Access-Review pending instances completed before cut-over; per-Entitlement-Package catalog preserved; per-Risk-Detection signal-source ML retrained; per-Verified-ID issuer DID re-bound; per-Cross-Tenant-Sync re-paired; lossy — Microsoft Authenticator number-matching specifics rebuilt; Identity Protection ML retrained (parity test).
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-app staged (low-risk apps first; high-criticality apps last); per-passkey re-registration grace-period (60-90 days) with TAP fallback; per-managed-identity dual-credential window; per-FIC re-issue with overlap; per-CA-policy What-If passes before enable; per-cross-tenant-sync re-pair with mutual admin approval; per-Verified-ID DID-rebind with grace; per-Application token-issuer rotation with dual-issuer window.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 30-90 days with sample tenant + per-user sign-in-parity 100% + per-CA-policy outcome-parity 99.9%+ + per-PIM activation-parity 100% + per-Access-Review decision-parity 100% + per-Risk-Detection signal-parity ≥ 99% + per-Verified-ID issuance/verification-parity 100% + per-cross-tenant-sync-cycle delta-parity 100%; sunset — Entra ID license sunset; audit-logs retained per regulatory mandate.

- Workflow template library: `identity.user-lifecycle-from-hcm-source` (Joiner-Mover-Leaver with HCM authority); `identity.access-review-quarterly-cadence` (with auto-apply + manager-reviewer); `identity.PIM-role-activation-with-MFA-and-justification` (eligibility-check + approval + CAE-broadcast); `identity.entitlement-package-self-service` (request + approve + provision + access-review); `identity.conditional-access-evaluate-on-each-request` (signals + conditions + grant + session); `identity.workload-federation-issuance` (FIC creation with issuer-allowlist); `identity.passkey-registration-with-attestation`; `identity.continuous-access-evaluation-revoke-on-risk`; `identity.verified-credential-issue-with-holder-consent`; `identity.cross-tenant-sync-bidirectional-with-scope-cap`.
- UX shell adaptation: IT-admin desktop-primary (admin-console + risky-users dashboard); end-user mobile-primary "My Apps" + Passkey-mgmt + Access-Package self-service; HR-admin lifecycle-workflow trigger; manager mobile for access-review approvals; auditor read-only with sign-in-logs + audit-logs export.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + HIPAA + FedRAMP-High + DoD-IL5 + IRS-1075 + CJIS + per-tenant identity-residency (Entra-Gov / Entra-China / Entra-Germany-equivalent); EU AI Act for any ML-driven Identity-Protection decisions; per-jurisdiction data-residency for verified-credentials.
- Naming justification: `identity` is canonical; `microsoft-entra-id`, `azure-active-directory`, `aad`, `entra-id`, and `entra` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-052 - Microsoft Viva
- Vendor name and category: Microsoft Viva (Viva Insights + Viva Engage [Yammer successor] + Viva Learning + Viva Topics [retired Feb 2025 but documented for migration] + Viva Goals + Viva Connections + Viva Glint + Viva Pulse + Viva Amplify + Viva Skills + Copilot Dashboard integration) / Microsoft ecosystem / Employee Experience Platform (EXP) — productivity analytics + community + learning + knowledge + OKRs + intranet-home + engagement-survey + manager-pulse + executive-communication + skills-graph.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across multiple Oyatie µservices). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Viva-Insights-Personal (personal-analytics only) → **Bronze**; Viva-Suite-with-Engage+Learning+Topics+Connections → **Silver**; Viva-Suite + Glint + Goals + Pulse + Amplify → **Gold**; Full Viva-Suite + Copilot-Dashboard + Skills-graph + Manager/Leader-Insights → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `intelligence` (Insights — productivity + collaboration analytics with privacy-floor); `community` (Engage = Yammer-class enterprise social); `learning-management` (Learning — LMS aggregation across LinkedIn Learning + Coursera + Pluralsight); `wiki` + `intelligence` (Topics — auto-topic from Microsoft Graph signals); `performance-management` (Goals OKR + Glint survey + Pulse + Skills + Amplify campaign); `community` (Connections — branded intranet home in Teams).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (per Viva-app):
  - `Insight_Metric` (Metric_ID, Metric_Type {Focus-Time / Collaboration-Hours / After-Hours-Work / Meeting-Hours / Email-Hours / Chat-Hours / Network-Size / Influencer-Score / Cross-Group-Collaboration / Manager-1on1-Time / External-Collaboration / Quiet-Hours-Adherence}, Scope {Personal / Team / Manager / Org-wide}, Time_Window, Aggregation_Cohort_Size (N≥5 mandatory for non-personal), Value, Confidence-Interval, Source {Graph-Calendar + Graph-Mail + Graph-Teams-Chat + Graph-Teams-Call}).
  - `Engage_Community` (Community_ID, Display_Name, Description, Privacy {Public / Private / External}, Type {Standard / All-Company / Storyline-Personal / Leadership-Corporate-Communications}, Members[], Admins[], Linked_M365_Group, Linked_SharePoint_Site, Tenant_Wide-Allowed-Reach, Network_Type {Internal / External-Network}, Created_DateTime).
  - `Engage_Post` (Post_ID, Community_Reference, Author, Body (rich-text + attachments + GIF + poll + question + announcement + praise-card + storyline-feed), Likes[], Replies[], Shares[], Views, Mentions[User_References], Pinned: bool, Announcement: bool, Topics_Tagged[], Engagement_Score, Translated_Variants[]).
  - `Engage_Storyline_Post` — same as Engage_Post but bound to user-Storyline (personal feed instead of community).
  - `Engage_Leadership_Corp_Communication` (LCC_ID, Sender (typically Exec), Audience[Adaptive-Audience-Definition], Body, Required_View: bool, Read-Receipts[], Sentiment-Roll-Up).
  - `Learning_Item` (Item_ID, Title, Source {LinkedIn-Learning / Coursera / edX / Pluralsight / Skillsoft / Udemy-Business / Skillsoft-Percipio / SharePoint / Custom-Provider / Microsoft-Learn / Books-OReilly}, Type {Course / Video / Article / Path / Live-Event / Microlearning / Book}, Duration_Minutes, Skills_Tagged[], Audience_Targeting, Recommendation_Source {Manager-Assigned / Skills-Based / Trending / Required-Compliance}, Completion_Status, Bookmarked: bool).
  - `Learning_Path` (Path_ID, Title, Items[], Estimated_Hours, Skills_Earned[]).
  - `Topic_Card` (Topic_ID, Name, Description-AI-Generated, Alternate-Names[], Type {Project / Team / Product / Skill / Process / Concept / Location / Event}, Confidence-Score, Suggested-People[], Suggested-Files[], Suggested-Pages[], Confirmed-by-Knowledge-Manager: bool, Sensitivity {Public / Internal / Confidential / Highly-Confidential}, Pinned-Content[]).
  - `Goal` (Goal_ID, Title, Description, Owner_Reference, Type {Objective / Key-Result / Initiative / Project / Action-Item}, Parent_Goal, Progress_Type {Number / Percentage / Currency / Binary / Milestone}, Start_Value, Target_Value, Current_Value, Auto-Update-Source {ADO-Work-Item / Jira-Issue / Power-BI-Report / SQL-Query / Manual}, Status {On-Track / At-Risk / Off-Track / Completed / Postponed}, Confidence-Score, Cycle-Cadence {Annual / Quarterly / Monthly / Custom}, Aligned-Goals[]).
  - `Goal_Check_In` (Check-In_ID, Goal-Reference, Author, Date, Progress-Value, Status-Update, Confidence-Score, Comments).
  - `Connections_Dashboard_Card` (Card_ID, Card_Type {Tasks / Approvals / Shifts / News / People / Praise / Custom-API}, Audience_Targeting, Priority, Refresh_Cadence).
  - `Glint_Survey` (Survey_ID, Title, Type {Engagement-Pulse / Annual-Engagement / Lifecycle-Onboarding / Lifecycle-Exit / Manager-Effectiveness / Custom}, Questions[Question-Type {Rating / Likert / Open-Text / NPS / Demographic} + Required-Anonymity-Floor], Schedule, Population-Cohort, Distribution-Channel {Email / Teams / Mobile}, Confidentiality-Threshold (typically N≥5 per cohort)).
  - `Glint_Response` (Response_ID, Survey-Reference, Anonymized-Respondent-Hash (one-way), Demographic-Cohort-Reference, Per-Question-Answer[], Sentiment-Score, Open-Text-Themes[]).
  - `Pulse_Survey` (Pulse_ID, Manager-Reference, Question-Library[Pre-Configured-Templates], Cadence {Weekly / Bi-Weekly / Monthly / Ad-Hoc}, Pulse-Audience-Constraint {direct-reports-only + N≥3}).
  - `Amplify_Campaign` (Campaign_ID, Title, Channels[Email + Teams + Yammer + Mobile-Push], Audience, Schedule, Approval-Workflow-Reference, Performance-Metrics{Reach + Read-Rate + Engagement}).
  - `Skill_Graph_Node` (Skill_ID, Name, Parent-Skill, Related-Skills[], Detected-From-Source {LinkedIn-Profile / Self-Declared / Learning-Completion / Project-Assignment / Resume-Parsed}, Confidence-Score, Hot-Skill: bool, Org-Demand-Score).
  - `Copilot_Dashboard_Metric` (Metric_ID, Metric_Type {Active-Users / Retention / Per-App-Usage / Cost-Per-User / Productivity-Lift / Influence-Network}, Time_Window).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Microsoft Graph Viva endpoints (preview/beta): `https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/employeeExperience/{...}`.
  - Viva Insights — analyst workbench export via Workplace Analytics API (deprecated by Insights Backend Service / Advanced Insights API).
  - Yammer/Viva-Engage REST API: `https://www.yammer.com/api/v1/{...}` for communities + posts + storylines; per-tenant network-domain.
  - Viva Learning Connector API: per-provider partner connector (LinkedIn Learning + Coursera + Pluralsight + Skillsoft + Udemy-Business + custom-SCORM/xAPI).
  - Microsoft Search + Topic API for Viva Topics: per-tenant topic-card via Graph search vertical (now deprecated as standalone, content moved to SharePoint Premium / Syntex).
  - Goals API (preview): per-goal CRUD + auto-update connector.
  - Glint API: per-survey + per-response (anonymized) export.
  - Adaptive Cards extensibility for Viva Connections dashboard cards.
  - PowerShell: Viva-Insights-PowerShell community module + Microsoft.Graph.EmployeeExperience.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Viva Insights Home" (Teams personal-app) — Briefing + Focus-Plan + Praise + Quiet-Hours + Reflection prompts.
  - "Insights Personal Dashboard" — meeting-hours + focus-hours + after-hours + collaboration-graph + virtual-commute.
  - "Manager Insights" — team-collaboration-health + meeting-load + 1-on-1-cadence + risk-flags (N≥5 floor).
  - "Leader Insights" — org-wide collaboration patterns + culture-signals (N≥10+ floor).
  - "Engage Communities" — community discovery + storyline feed + leadership-corp-comm.
  - "Engage Storyline" — personal feed (Twitter-like, per-employee).
  - "Engage Mobile" — read/post/react/poll on mobile.
  - "Learning Home" — Featured + Recommended + From-Your-Manager + Required-Compliance + Trending + Tabs-by-Source.
  - "Learning Path Builder" — drag-drop curated paths.
  - "Topics Center" — topic-card-grid + Knowledge-Manager review queue.
  - "Topic Highlight" — auto-extracted topic-pop-up on hover in Outlook/Word/Teams.
  - "Goals Dashboard" — alignment-tree + status-roll-up + check-in cadence.
  - "Goals Detail" — OKR-cascade + auto-update from data-source + confidence + history.
  - "Connections Home" — branded company intranet in Teams (mobile + desktop).
  - "Glint Survey Mobile" — pulse + engagement + lifecycle surveys.
  - "Glint Manager Dashboard" — engagement scores + comments themes + N-floor enforced.
  - "Pulse Manager" — manager-led pulse with question library + Cadence.
  - "Amplify Campaign Designer" — comms-campaign editor + approval + multi-channel publish.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal,
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"VivaInsightsViewPersonal", Oyatie::Action::"VivaInsightsViewTeam",
      Oyatie::Action::"VivaInsightsViewOrg", Oyatie::Action::"VivaEngagePostCommunity",
      Oyatie::Action::"VivaEngagePostStoryline", Oyatie::Action::"VivaEngageLeaderComms",
      Oyatie::Action::"VivaLearningAssignContent", Oyatie::Action::"VivaLearningCompleteContent",
      Oyatie::Action::"VivaTopicsConfirm", Oyatie::Action::"VivaTopicsHide",
      Oyatie::Action::"VivaGoalsCreateOKR", Oyatie::Action::"VivaGoalsCheckIn",
      Oyatie::Action::"VivaGoalsAlignParent", Oyatie::Action::"VivaConnectionsConfigureDashboard",
      Oyatie::Action::"VivaConnectionsPostNews", Oyatie::Action::"VivaGlintLaunchSurvey",
      Oyatie::Action::"VivaGlintViewResponses", Oyatie::Action::"VivaPulseLaunchManagerPulse",
      Oyatie::Action::"VivaAmplifyLaunchCampaign", Oyatie::Action::"VivaSkillsEditSkillGraph"
    ],
    resource
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"VivaInsightsViewTeam" ? principal.is_manager_of(resource.team) && resource.cohort_size >= 5 : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"VivaInsightsViewOrg" ? principal.has_role("Insights-Analyst") && resource.cohort_size >= 10 && not(resource.metric.attributable_to_individual) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"VivaEngageLeaderComms" ? principal.has_role("Corp-Comms-Sender") && resource.audience.size >= leader_comms_floor : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"VivaTopicsConfirm" ? principal.has_role("Knowledge-Manager") && topic.confidence_score >= 0.7 : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"VivaTopicsHide" ? resource.sensitivity != "Public" || principal.has_role("Knowledge-Manager") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"VivaGoalsAlignParent" ? cycle_open(resource.cycle) && not(creates_cascade_cycle(resource.goal, resource.parent)) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"VivaGlintLaunchSurvey" ? resource.cohort_size >= survey.confidentiality_threshold && labor_council_notified_if_required(resource.cohort) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"VivaGlintViewResponses" ? resource.cohort_response_count >= survey.confidentiality_threshold : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"VivaPulseLaunchManagerPulse" ? principal.is_manager_of(resource.cohort) && resource.cohort.size >= 3 : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"VivaAmplifyLaunchCampaign" ? principal.has_role("Corp-Comms-Sender") && approval_workflow_complete(resource.campaign) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && labor_council_notified_for_org_metrics(context.cohort) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "DE" ? context.pack.contains("DE-Betriebsrat") && betriebsrat_signed_off(resource.metric) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "KR" ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Insight_Metric` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::workplace_metric` (with metric-type + scope + cohort-size + privacy-floor enforced at compute-time + N-floor enforced at query-time).
  - `Engage_Community` → `Oyatie::Community::community` (with privacy + type + linked-group + linked-site).
  - `Engage_Post` → `Oyatie::Community::post` (with body + likes + replies + shares + mentions + pinned + announcement + topics + engagement-score).
  - `Engage_Storyline_Post` → `Oyatie::Community::storyline_post` (personal-feed).
  - `Engage_Leadership_Corp_Comm` → `Oyatie::Community::leader_communication` (with adaptive-audience + required-view + read-receipts + sentiment-roll-up).
  - `Learning_Item` → `Oyatie::LearningManagement::learning_item` (with source + type + duration + skills-tagged + recommendation-source + completion-status; cross-link to D-031).
  - `Learning_Path` → `Oyatie::LearningManagement::learning_path` (with items + estimated-hours + skills-earned).
  - `Topic_Card` → `Oyatie::Wiki::topic_card` (with AI-generated-description + alternate-names + suggested-people/files/pages + sensitivity).
  - `Goal` → `Oyatie::PerformanceManagement::goal` (with type + parent-goal + progress-type + auto-update-source + status + confidence; cross-link to D-030).
  - `Goal_Check_In` → `Oyatie::PerformanceManagement::goal_check_in` (with progress + status + confidence + comments).
  - `Connections_Dashboard_Card` → `Oyatie::Community::dashboard_card` (with card-type + audience-targeting + priority + refresh-cadence).
  - `Glint_Survey` → `Oyatie::PerformanceManagement::engagement_survey` (with type + questions + schedule + cohort + confidentiality-threshold).
  - `Glint_Response` → `Oyatie::PerformanceManagement::engagement_response` (with one-way-hash + demographic-cohort + sentiment + themes; N-floor enforced).
  - `Pulse_Survey` → `Oyatie::PerformanceManagement::manager_pulse` (with question-library + cadence + audience-constraint).
  - `Amplify_Campaign` → `Oyatie::Community::corporate_campaign` (with channels + audience + schedule + approval-workflow).
  - `Skill_Graph_Node` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::skill_node` (with parent-skill + related-skills + detected-from-source + confidence + hot-skill + demand-score).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Viva displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant Viva-app enablement + per-Insights-license count (P1 / P2 / Analyst) + per-Engage community count + per-Learning content-provider list (LinkedIn Learning / Coursera / etc.) + per-Topic-Card count + per-Goal cycle count + per-Connections dashboard config + per-Glint survey history + per-Pulse manager-pulse count + per-Amplify campaign count + per-Skills-graph node count.
  2. **Per-Viva-app extraction**:
     - Insights — per-Metric type + cohort + time-window + privacy-floor + source-attribution; metric history retention per tenant.
     - Engage — per-Community + per-Post + per-Storyline + per-LCC export with read-receipts; per-translation variants.
     - Learning — per-Content-provider connector config + per-Item metadata + per-User-completion history + per-Path catalog.
     - Topics — per-Topic-Card + alternate-names + suggested-people/files/pages + sensitivity + Knowledge-Manager confirmation history.
     - Goals — per-Cycle + per-Goal + per-Check-In + alignment-tree + auto-update connectors (ADO / Jira / Power BI / SQL).
     - Connections — per-Dashboard-Card + audience-targeting + adaptive-card-JSON.
     - Glint — per-Survey + per-Response anonymized + demographic-cohort + sentiment-themes; one-way-hash preserved.
     - Pulse — per-Pulse-cadence + per-Question + per-Response with N≥3 floor.
     - Amplify — per-Campaign + multi-channel reach + approval-workflow history.
     - Skills — per-Skill-Graph + node + edges + confidence-score + detected-from-source.
  3. **Per-source signal-binding**: re-establish Graph-Calendar + Graph-Mail + Graph-Teams-Chat + Graph-Teams-Call signal feeds into Oyatie `intelligence` substrate (per ADR-0255) with per-signal privacy-floor enforced at compute.
  4. **Per-Engage-Community migration**: per-Community linked-M365-group + linked-SharePoint-site preserved (or migrated per D-045 M365); per-Post + Storyline-feed preserved with author + reactions + replies + mentions.
  5. **Per-Learning-content-provider re-bind**: per-provider connector OAuth + content-catalog re-fetch + completion-history preserved with per-Item ID mapping.
  6. **Per-Topic-Card migration**: per-Topic AI-generated description preserved + Knowledge-Manager confirmation status; new auto-topic generation re-trained on Oyatie Graph signals.
  7. **Per-Goal-cycle migration**: per-Cycle + per-Goal + per-Check-In + alignment-tree preserved; per-auto-update connector re-bound to ADO / Jira / Power BI / SQL endpoints.
  8. **Per-Connections-Dashboard re-bind**: per-Card adaptive-card-JSON migrated; per-Card data-source re-bound (Tasks / Approvals / Shifts / News / Custom-API).
  9. **Per-Glint-Survey migration**: per-Survey question-library + cohort + confidentiality-threshold preserved; per-Response one-way-hash preserved; sentiment + themes re-extracted with parity test.
  10. **Per-Pulse migration**: per-Manager pulse-cadence + question-library + audience preserved.
  11. **Per-Amplify-Campaign migration**: per-Campaign multi-channel + approval-workflow history preserved.
  12. **Per-Skill-Graph migration**: per-node + edge + confidence preserved; per-user skill-binding preserved + re-detected from Oyatie signals with parity test.
  13. **Per-Labor-council notification**: per-EU + per-DE Betriebsrat notification of new metrics-collection scope with consultation period (DE Works-Council Mitbestimmung typically 8-12 weeks).
  14. **Parallel run**: 60-90 day shadow with sample tenant + per-Insights metric-parity ± 2% (cohort-floor enforced) + per-Engage post-fidelity 100% + per-Learning-completion parity 100% + per-Topic-confidence parity ± 5% + per-Goal-status parity 100% + per-Glint-response one-way-hash parity 100% + per-Skill-detection parity ≥ 95%.
  15. **Cutover**: per-Viva-app routed to destination Oyatie µservice; per-Engage community-discovery redirect; per-Learning home redirect; per-Topics highlight in Office apps re-installed (or graceful disable); per-Connections home re-pointed; per-Glint cycle resumes from in-flight survey position.
  16. **Sunset**: Viva license sunset; per-tenant retention per HR data-retention mandate (typically 7 years for engagement-survey aggregate, 30 days for raw responses).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Insights privacy-floor violation** (small-N team metric attributable to one person): per-metric N≥5 floor enforced at compute-time + per-query N-check + redact + audit.
  - **Topics auto-topic mis-categorization** (sensitive doc surfaced inappropriately to wide audience): per-topic Cedar scope at projection + sensitivity-label respected + Knowledge-Manager confirm-or-hide workflow.
  - **Glint anonymity-break** (response from rare-demographic identifiable via intersection): per-question demographic-floor enforced (N≥5 per demographic-cohort intersection) + redact-when-floor-not-met.
  - **Goals cascade-circular** (child goal's parent is also a descendant): per-OKR DAG validation at align-time + cycle-detection.
  - **Cross-Viva-app metric divergence** (Insights vs Glint same employee differ): per-source metric-pin + reconciliation report + leader-dashboard explainability.
  - **Engage-community cross-tenant external-network confusion** (External-Network post visibility ambiguous): per-community network-type explicit-pin + per-post audience-confirmation.
  - **Learning-content-provider OAuth expiry** (connector token expires, content disappears): per-provider OAuth-refresh + alert ≥7 days pre-expire + fallback content-cache.
  - **Storyline-post moderation gap** (employee posts inappropriate content on personal-storyline visible org-wide): per-storyline moderation queue + community-standards Cedar gate.
  - **Topics highlight in Office apps over-fire** (every word highlighted as topic): per-document confidence-threshold tuning + user-disable option.
  - **Amplify campaign required-read coercion** (required-view violates labor-council norms): per-campaign labor-council notification + opt-out where legally required (DE / FR).
  - **Goals auto-update connector breakage** (Jira / Power BI / SQL endpoint changes schema): per-connector schema-pin + alert on drift + fallback to manual update.
  - **Skill-graph false-positive detection** (user has skill they don't have, leading to wrong assignment): per-skill confidence-threshold + self-verify + manager-confirm option.
  - **Pulse manager-pulse coercion concern** (employees feel obligated to respond): per-pulse opt-out option + anonymity-default.
  - **Connections dashboard custom-API failure** (Custom-Card data-source endpoint down): per-card health-check + graceful-degrade + alert.
  - **EU GDPR Article 22 automated-decision concern on Insights manager-flags** (manager-1on1-risk-flag triggers manager-action without human-review): per-flag human-in-the-loop default + opt-out + meaningful-explanation.
  - **DE Betriebsrat sign-off lag** (works-council consultation extends 8-12 weeks): per-tenant pre-consultation track + scoping doc + role-based partial-enable while consultation continues.
  - **Anonymization-reversal attack on Glint open-text** (writing style + demographic = identifiable): per-open-text k-anonymity check + stylometric-fingerprint suppression + truncation option.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Microsoft Graph beta employeeExperience endpoints + Yammer/Engage REST + Learning Connector API + Topics API (deprecated, snapshot-export) + Goals API + Glint API + Adaptive-Cards JSON; format — JSON + adaptive-card JSON + connector-secret-blob; duration — ~3-6 months per enterprise tenant due to labor-council consultation timeline + per-app extraction; volume — per-Insights metric-history up to 7 years; per-Engage community count typically 50-5000.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Insights metric preserved with privacy-floor enforced at compute; per-Engage community + post preserved with linked-M365-group + linked-SharePoint-site (or migrated per D-045); per-Learning item + completion-history preserved with provider-OAuth re-bind; per-Topic confidence + confirmation status preserved (re-trained on Oyatie Graph); per-Goal cycle + cascade preserved with auto-update connector re-bind; per-Glint response one-way-hash + sentiment + themes preserved with re-extraction parity; per-Skill-graph re-detected with parity; lossy — Microsoft Copilot Dashboard depth requires Oyatie native equivalent built in `intelligence` (gap-list); some Adaptive-Cards-Designer-only features rebuilt.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-Viva-app destination-µservice routed; per-Engage community-discovery redirect; per-Learning home redirect; per-Topics highlight in Office apps re-installed (or graceful disable); per-Connections home in Teams re-pointed; per-Glint cycle resumes from in-flight survey position; per-labor-council notification + consultation period observed before metrics-cohort changes; per-EU + per-DE residency-pinned datacenter route.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 60-90 days with per-Insights metric-parity ± 2% (cohort-floor enforced) + per-Engage post-fidelity 100% + per-Learning-completion parity 100% + per-Topic-confidence parity ± 5% + per-Goal-status parity 100% + per-Glint-response one-way-hash parity 100% + per-Skill-detection parity ≥ 95% + per-Connections dashboard-card-render parity 100%; sunset — Viva license sunset; per-tenant retention per HR data-retention mandate.

- Workflow template library: `viva.insights-compute-with-N-floor-cohort` (N≥5 default + N≥10 org-wide); `viva.engage-community-publish-with-moderation` (per-policy moderation queue); `viva.learning-recommendation-from-skill-graph` (with confidence-threshold + opt-out); `viva.topic-auto-generate-from-Graph-signals` (with sensitivity-label-respect + Knowledge-Manager confirm); `viva.goals-OKR-cascade-with-DAG-validation` (cycle-detect at align-time); `viva.glint-survey-emit-with-anonymity-floor` (per-demographic-intersection N-floor); `viva.pulse-launch-with-opt-out`; `viva.amplify-campaign-with-approval-workflow`; `viva.connections-dashboard-card-with-health-check`; `viva.skills-graph-detect-with-self-verify`.
- UX shell adaptation: per-Viva-app destination shell; employee mobile-primary for Connections + Engage + Learning + Glint-mobile-pulse; manager desktop for Insights + Goals + Pulse + Glint-dashboard; knowledge-manager desktop for Topics-review; Corp-Comms-sender desktop for Amplify + Leadership-Corp-Comms; analyst desktop for Insights-Analyst-Workbench + Glint-detailed-dashboard with N-floor enforced.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + per-country employee-data residency + per-country labor-council consultation (DE Betriebsrat + FR Comité-Social-et-Économique + EU Works-Council + JP labor-union); HIPAA when Insights touches healthcare-worker scheduling/collaboration; per-EU AI Act when Insights-ML drives manager-visible risk-flags (human-in-the-loop default + meaningful-explanation).
- Naming justification: `intelligence` + `community` + `learning-management` + `wiki` + `performance-management` are canonical; `microsoft-viva`, `viva-insights`, `viva-engage`, `yammer`, `viva-learning`, `viva-topics`, `viva-goals`, `viva-connections`, `viva-glint`, `viva-pulse`, `viva-amplify`, `viva-skills` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-053 - Adobe Marketo Engage
- Vendor name and category: Adobe Marketo Engage (formerly Marketo Lead Management, Marketo Engage post-Adobe-acquisition 2018) / Adobe Experience Cloud / B2B + B2B2C marketing-automation + Account-Based Marketing (ABM) + Revenue-Cycle-Analytics + Adobe-Sensei Predictive (Predictive Content + Predictive Audiences + Account-AI) + Marketo Sales + Marketo Measure (formerly Bizible — multi-touch attribution) + Bizible-AI + Adobe-Mix-Modeler.
- Coverage tier: D (microservice: `marketing-automation` per ADR-0299). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Marketo Select (basic email + nurture + scoring) → **Bronze**; Marketo Prime (Select + Smart-Lists + Engagement-Programs + Landing-Pages + Forms + basic-CRM-sync) → **Silver**; Marketo Ultimate (Prime + ABM + Predictive-Content + Predictive-Audiences + Revenue-Cycle-Explorer + advanced CRM-sync + Bizible-attribution) → **Gold**; Marketo Ultimate + Bizible-AI + Mix-Modeler + Account-AI + Adobe-Sensei-GenAI → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `marketing-automation` (Engagement Programs + Smart Campaigns + Smart Lists + Default Programs + Email Programs + Webinar Programs); `crm` (Lead + Account + Opportunity sync with Salesforce/Dynamics/HubSpot per D-001/D-040/D-062); `intelligence` (Adobe-Sensei Predictive-Content + ABM-scoring + Predictive-Audiences + Account-AI replacements); `data-pipeline` (Revenue-Cycle-Explorer model + Marketo-Measure attribution feed); `comms-email` + `comms-sms` + `comms-push` (delivery rails); `marketplace` (LaunchPoint partner ecosystem ↔ Oyatie plugin marketplace per ADR-0249); `consent-and-privacy` (Marketo Subscription Center + GDPR consent ledger).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Marketo lead + program + revenue-cycle model):
  - `Lead` (Lead_ID, Email, First_Name, Last_Name, Company, Title, Phone, Country, State, City, Postal_Code, Industry, Annual_Revenue, Employee_Count, Lead_Score (Behavioral + Demographic + Total), Lead_Status {New / Working / Marketing-Qualified / Sales-Accepted / Sales-Qualified / Opportunity / Disqualified / Recycled / Nurturing}, Revenue_Stage_Reference, Lead_Source, Original_Source_Type, Original_Source_Info, Original_Search_Engine, Original_Search_Phrase, SFDC_Account_ID, SFDC_Contact_ID, SFDC_Lead_ID, SFDC_Opty_ID, Marketing_Suspended: bool, Black_Listed: bool, Unsubscribed: bool, Unsubscribed_Reason, Email_Invalid: bool, Email_Invalid_Cause, Anonymous_IP, Inferred_Country, Inferred_City, Person_Score, Custom_Fields[100+]).
  - `Lead_Custom_Field` (Field_API_Name, Display_Name, Type {string / integer / float / boolean / datetime / email / phone / score / formula / reference}, Length, Default, Source_System {Marketo / SFDC / Custom-Object}).
  - `Account` (Account_ID, Account_Name, Domain, Industry, Annual_Revenue, Employee_Count, SFDC_Account_ID, Account_List_Memberships[], Account_Score, Engagement_Score, Buying_Stage {Awareness / Interest / Consideration / Intent / Evaluation / Purchase}, ICP_Match_Score).
  - `Account_List` (List_ID, List_Name, Target_Account_Members[], Created_By, Owner, Tier_Classification {Tier-1 / Tier-2 / Tier-3}, Sync_With_SFDC: bool).
  - `Program` (Program_ID, Name, Type {Default / Email / Engagement / Webinar / Event / Nurture / In-App / Multi-Channel}, Status {Draft / Live / Completed / Archived}, Channel, Tags[], Costs[Period + Amount + Description], Tokens[Token-Name → Token-Type {Text / Rich-Text / Number / Date / Email-Script / SFDC-Campaign / Form / Email / Landing-Page / Score / Boolean / Sales-Email / List}], Cost_Per_Lead, Members[], Member_Statuses[], Period_Costs[]).
  - `Engagement_Program` (Engagement_ID, Stream-Sequence[Stream-Name + Cadence {Daily / Weekly / Bi-Weekly / Monthly / Custom-Days} + Content-Pieces[Email-Reference + Send-Sequence] + Transition-Choice-Rules + Exhausted-Action]).
  - `Smart_Campaign` (Campaign_ID, Name, Smart_List_Rules[], Flow_Steps[Step-Type {Send-Email / Add-to-List / Remove-from-List / Change-Score / Change-Data-Value / Change-Status-in-Engagement-Program / Change-Revenue-Stage / Interesting-Moment / Sales-Notification / Sync-Lead-to-SFDC / Add-to-SFDC-Campaign / Wait / Send-Alert / Call-Webhook / Request-Campaign}], Schedule {Triggered / Batch + Recurrence}, Qualification {Once / Every-Time / Until-Time-Period}, Cumulative-Filter, Anti-Spam-Settings).
  - `Smart_List` (List_ID, Name, Rules[Constraint], Static-List: bool, Member-Count, Used-In-Smart-Campaigns[], Used-In-Engagement-Programs[]).
  - `Trigger_Smart_Campaign` — same as Smart_Campaign with at least one trigger rule (Filled-Out-Form / Visited-Web-Page / Clicked-Link-in-Email / Score-Reaches / Data-Value-Changes / etc.).
  - `Email_Template` (Template_ID, Name, HTML_Source, Module_Definitions[Editable-Module-Tags + Constraints], Variables[Variable-Name + Type + Default], Snippets-Referenced[], Tokens-Referenced[], Approved: bool).
  - `Email_Asset` (Email_ID, Subject_Line, Preheader, From_Name, From_Email, Reply_To_Email, Template_Reference, Variables-Overrides{}, A/B_Test_Variants[Subject / From / Content + Champion-Sample-Size + Winner-Criteria {Open-Rate / Click-Rate / Conversion}], Approved: bool, Email_Performance{Sent + Delivered + Open + Click + Unsubscribe + Bounce}).
  - `Landing_Page` (LP_ID, Name, URL, Template_Reference, Variables-Overrides{}, Form-Reference, Tracking-Code, SEO-Settings{Title + Meta-Description + Robots}, A/B-Test-Variants[], Mobile-Responsive-Variants).
  - `Form` (Form_ID, Name, Fields[Field-Reference + Validation + Visibility-Rules + Pre-Fill + Required], Thank-You-Action {URL / Page / Marketo-Page / Email-Confirmation}, Captcha-Settings, Progressive-Profiling-Rules, Visitor-Tracking-Cookie).
  - `Token` (Token_ID, Scope {Program / Folder / My-Tokens / Lead-Field / Company-Field / Campaign / System}, Token-Name (e.g., `{{my.eventDate}}`), Token-Type, Default-Value, Override-by-Program-Hierarchy).
  - `Snippet` (Snippet_ID, Name, HTML_Content, Modules-Referenced[], Localization-Variants[per-locale-HTML]).
  - `Revenue_Cycle_Model` (Model_ID, Name, Stages[Stage-Name + Description + Stage-Order + Stage-Type {Inventory / Operational / Success}], Transitions[Source-Stage + Target-Stage + Trigger-Rules]).
  - `Revenue_Stage_Transition` (Transition_ID, Lead_Reference, From_Stage, To_Stage, Trigger_Source {Smart-Campaign / Manual / SFDC-Sync}, Transitioned_DateTime, Reason).
  - `Lead_Scoring_Model` (Model_ID, Behavioral-Score-Rules[Behavior + Score-Delta + Aging], Demographic-Score-Rules[Field-Value + Score-Delta], Aging-Rules[Time-Window + Score-Delta]).
  - `Predictive_Content_Recommendation` (Recommendation_ID, Lead_Reference, Content_Reference, Confidence_Score, Reason_Code).
  - `Predictive_Audience` (Audience_ID, Goal {Likely-to-Convert / Likely-to-Engage / Likely-to-Churn}, Cohort-Size, Confidence-Threshold).
  - `Account_AI_Score` (Account_Reference, Engagement_Score, Buying_Stage_Predicted, Confidence, Top-Influencers[], Recommended-Next-Best-Action).
  - `Marketo_Measure_Touchpoint` (Touchpoint_ID, Lead/Account-Reference, Channel, Sub-Channel, Campaign-Reference, Form-Reference, URL, Date, Cost, Attribution-Models[First-Touch / Lead-Creation / Opportunity-Creation / Multi-Touch / W-Shaped / U-Shaped / Custom-Decay]).
  - `Bizible_AI_Account_Insight` (Insight_ID, Account_Reference, Insight_Type {Buying-Stage-Shift / Engagement-Anomaly / New-Stakeholder-Detected}, Confidence, Date).
  - `LaunchPoint_Service` (Service_ID, Partner_Name {ZoomInfo / 6sense / Demandbase / Drift / On24 / etc.}, OAuth_Config, Sync_Frequency, Mapping_Config).
  - `Workspace_and_Partition` (Workspace_ID, Workspace_Name, Lead_Partition_Reference) — multi-team isolation primitive in larger Marketo instances.

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Marketo REST API: `https://{munchkinId}.mktorest.com/rest/v1/{leads.json | leads/describe.json | activities.json | smartCampaigns.json | smartLists.json | programs.json | campaigns/{id}/trigger.json | email/{id}/content.json | etc.}`.
  - Marketo Bulk Extract APIs: per-Activity + per-Lead + per-Custom-Object + per-Program-Member with job-based async download.
  - Marketo Munchkin JavaScript tracking: per-website per-Munchkin-ID visitor-cookie + click + form-track.
  - Marketo Webhook (out): per-Smart-Campaign webhook flow-step.
  - Marketo Activities API: per-Lead activity-stream with retention (raw 25 months, summarized 7+ years).
  - Marketo Companion REST: per-Company / per-Opportunity / per-Custom-Object.
  - Marketo Live Event Connector: per-webinar provider (Zoom / Webex / GoToWebinar / On24 / BrightTALK / Adobe Connect).
  - SOAP API (legacy, deprecated 2024).
  - Marketo Sky UI (newer) + Marketo Classic UI (legacy authoring).
  - Marketo Measure REST: per-touchpoint + per-attribution-model.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Marketing Activities" tree — folders + programs + smart-campaigns + smart-lists + emails + landing-pages + forms (Classic UI).
  - "Smart-Campaign Flow Editor" — drag-drop step-builder (rule + flow + schedule + qualification).
  - "Smart-List Rule Builder" — boolean composer (AND / OR / Advanced) with constraint operators + advanced-filter.
  - "Engagement Program Streams" — stream-sequence editor with cadence + content + transition-rules.
  - "Email Editor" — module-based editor with variable overrides + token-resolution preview.
  - "Landing Page Editor" — same module/variable model as email editor + responsive preview.
  - "Form Editor" — drag-drop form-field designer + validation + visibility-rules + progressive-profiling.
  - "Revenue Cycle Modeler" — stage-and-transition visual editor.
  - "Revenue Cycle Explorer" — funnel analytics + stage-velocity + cohort-analysis.
  - "Lead Database" — searchable lead-grid + per-lead profile + activity-timeline + score + opportunities + sales-insight.
  - "Account Database" — account-grid + per-account profile + member-leads + engagement-score + buying-stage.
  - "Target Account Lists" — Tier-1/2/3 lists + heat-map + influencer-graph.
  - "ABM Dashboard" — Account-Engagement-Score + Buying-Stage-Predicted + Top-Accounts + Recommended-Actions.
  - "Predictive Content" — per-piece-engagement + recommendation-trail + opt-in.
  - "Design Studio" — global email-template + landing-page-template + form-template + snippet + image library.
  - "Admin" — workspaces + partitions + roles + users + integrations (SFDC + Microsoft + LaunchPoint) + SSO + webhook + smart-list-defaults + Munchkin + tracking.
  - "Marketo Measure" — touchpoint-attribution + multi-touch reports + spend-vs-pipeline.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<marketing-ops-or-marketer-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoPublishProgram", Oyatie::Action::"MktoActivateSmartCampaign",
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoChangeSmartListRule", Oyatie::Action::"MktoRunBatchCampaign",
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoRunTriggerCampaign", Oyatie::Action::"MktoCloneProgram",
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoChangeRevenueModel", Oyatie::Action::"MktoTransitionRevenueStage",
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoAddToEngagementStream", Oyatie::Action::"MktoSuspendFromStream",
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoChangeProgramStatus", Oyatie::Action::"MktoApproveEmail",
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoApproveLandingPage", Oyatie::Action::"MktoRunAccountScoring",
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoRunPredictiveContent", Oyatie::Action::"MktoSyncToCRM",
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoExportLeadList", Oyatie::Action::"MktoMergeLead",
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoChangeWorkspacePartition", Oyatie::Action::"MktoConfigureLaunchPoint",
      Oyatie::Action::"MktoRunBizibleAttribution", Oyatie::Action::"MktoChangeSubscriptionPreference"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::MarketingAsset::"<asset-id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    marketing_role_grants(principal, action, resource.workspace) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"MktoActivateSmartCampaign" ? campaign_qualification_safe(resource.campaign) && anti_spam_throttle_ok(resource.campaign) && smart_list_size <= mass_send_threshold || principal.has_role("Mass-Send-Approver") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"MktoExportLeadList" ? data_export_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && context.dual_admin_approval && export_scope_pii_scrubbed(context.fields) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"MktoMergeLead" ? lead_merge_consent_preserved(resource.lead_a, resource.lead_b) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"MktoChangeRevenueModel" ? model_change_approved(context.model) && historical_stage_data_preserved : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"MktoTransitionRevenueStage" ? not(already_in_target_stage(resource.lead, context.target_stage)) && transition_idempotency_key_unique : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"MktoRunBatchCampaign" ? smart_list_size <= 100000 || principal.has_role("Enterprise-Mass-Send") : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"MktoChangeSubscriptionPreference" ? subscription_change_logged(resource.lead, context.preference_delta) : true) &&
    (resource.lead.jurisdiction == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && lawful_basis_for_processing(resource.lead, context.purpose) && consent_record_present_if_required(resource.lead) : true) &&
    (resource.lead.jurisdiction == "CA" ? context.pack.contains("CASL") && express_or_implied_consent_present(resource.lead) : true) &&
    (resource.lead.jurisdiction == "US" ? context.pack.contains("CAN-SPAM") && physical_address_in_footer(context.email) && unsubscribe_link_present(context.email) : true) &&
    (resource.lead.jurisdiction == "KR" ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") && marketing_consent_explicit(resource.lead) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:

  - `Lead_Custom_Field` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::lead_custom_field` (field-API-name + type + length + source-system).
  - `Account` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::account` (with domain + industry + revenue + employees + ICP-match-score + engagement + buying-stage); cross-link to `crm` Account.
  - `Account_List` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::target_account_list` (with tier + members + sync-with-CRM).
  - `Program` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::program` (with type + status + channel + tags + costs + tokens).
  - `Engagement_Program` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::engagement_stream` (with stream-sequence + cadence + content + transition-rules + exhausted-action).
  - `Smart_Campaign` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::smart_campaign` (with rules + flow-steps + schedule + qualification + anti-spam-settings).
  - `Smart_List` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::smart_list` (with rules + static-flag + member-count + dependency-graph).
  - `Email_Template` + `Email_Asset` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::email_template` + `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::email` (with modules + variables + tokens + A/B-variants + approval).
  - `Landing_Page` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::landing_page` (with template + variables + form-reference + tracking-code + SEO-settings).
  - `Form` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::form` (with fields + validation + visibility + progressive-profiling + thank-you-action).
  - `Token` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::token` (scope + name + type + default + override-by-hierarchy).
  - `Snippet` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::snippet` (with localization-variants + module-bindings).
  - `Revenue_Cycle_Model` + `Revenue_Stage_Transition` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::revenue_model` + `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::stage_transition` (with stages + trigger-rules + idempotent transitions).
  - `Lead_Scoring_Model` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::scoring_model` (with behavioral + demographic + aging rules).
  - `Predictive_Content_Recommendation` + `Predictive_Audience` + `Account_AI_Score` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::marketing_recommendation` (with confidence + reason-code + cohort).

  - `Bizible_AI_Account_Insight` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::account_insight` (with insight-type + confidence + recommended-action).
  - `LaunchPoint_Service` → `Oyatie::Marketplace::partner_service` (with partner + OAuth + sync-frequency + mapping).
  - `Workspace_and_Partition` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::workspace` (with lead-partition + isolation rules).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Marketo displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant program count + smart-campaign count (active + triggered + batch) + smart-list count + lead count (often 1M-50M in enterprise) + custom-field count + account count + target-account-list count + email/landing-page/form count + token count + snippet count + revenue-cycle stage count + transition rule count + LaunchPoint partner integrations + workspace + partition count.
  2. **Lead extraction**: per-Lead via Bulk-Extract-Leads + Activities API; per-custom-field schema export via `leads/describe.json`; per-Activity history (open + click + form-fill + page-visit + score-change + revenue-stage-change + interesting-moment) up to 25 months raw + summarized history.
  3. **Account extraction**: per-Account via custom-object Bulk-Extract or per-CRM-bridge with SFDC-Account-ID mapping; per-Account-List Tier with member-leads.
  4. **Program + Smart-Campaign extraction**: per-Program with type + status + tokens + costs + period-costs + members; per-Smart-Campaign with rules + flow-steps + schedule + qualification + anti-spam-settings.
  5. **Engagement-Program extraction**: per-Engagement stream-sequence + cadence + content + transition-choice-rules + exhausted-action.
  6. **Smart-List extraction**: per-List with rules + static-flag + used-in-X dependency-graph (essential to detect smart-list cycle).
  7. **Email + Landing-Page + Form extraction**: per-Asset HTML + template-reference + variable-overrides + A/B-variants + approval-state; per-Snippet localization-variants; per-Token by scope + override-hierarchy.
  8. **Revenue-Cycle-Model extraction**: per-Model stages + transitions + per-Lead historical stage + transition log; preserve transition-idempotency.
  9. **Lead-Scoring-Model extraction**: per-Model behavioral + demographic + aging rules + per-Lead score history.
  10. **Predictive-Content + Predictive-Audiences extraction**: per-Recommendation + per-Audience cohort + confidence + reason-code; re-trained on Oyatie intelligence with parity test.
  11. **Account-AI extraction**: per-Account engagement-score + buying-stage-predicted + top-influencers + recommended-action; re-trained on Oyatie intelligence.
  12. **Marketo Measure extraction**: per-Touchpoint + multi-touch attribution model (FT / LC / OC / W-Shaped / U-Shaped / Custom-Decay); per-spend-vs-pipeline data.
  13. **LaunchPoint partner extraction**: per-Service (ZoomInfo / 6sense / Demandbase / Drift / On24 / etc.) OAuth + mapping; re-bind to Oyatie marketplace per ADR-0249.
  14. **Workspace + Partition extraction**: per-Workspace lead-partition isolation + per-team scope; preserve in Oyatie `marketing-automation` workspace primitive.
  15. **Subscription Center + Consent extraction**: per-Lead per-subscription-type (Newsletter / Promotional / Product-Update / etc.) + per-jurisdiction consent record + opt-in/opt-out history + double-opt-in confirmation.
  16. **Munchkin tracking-code migration**: per-website Munchkin-ID → Oyatie tracking-cookie + per-domain dual-fire window during cutover.
  17. **CRM-sync mapping migration**: per-field SFDC / Dynamics / HubSpot sync direction + transformation + sync-cadence; preserve historical sync log.
  18. **Per-engagement-stream cadence rebuild**: per-stream send-cadence + transition-choice-rules re-implemented in Oyatie `marketing-automation` engagement-cadence engine with sample-lead parallel-run.
  19. **Per-Smart-Campaign trigger re-implementation**: per-trigger (Filled-Form / Visited-Page / Clicked-Link / Score-Reaches / Data-Value-Changes) re-bound to Oyatie event-source with idempotency.
  20. **Per-Email approval gate migration**: per-Email approval-state + brand-review approval-history.
  21. **Per-jurisdiction-opt-in audit preservation**: per-Lead consent-history (timestamp + IP + form-reference + jurisdiction + opt-in-type) preserved with cryptographic chain.
  22. **Parallel run**: 60-90 day shadow with sample workspace + per-Lead score-parity ± 1% + per-Smart-Campaign trigger-parity 100% + per-Engagement-Program send-parity 100% + per-Revenue-Stage transition-parity 100% + per-Account-AI score-parity ± 5% + per-Touchpoint attribution-parity 100%.
  23. **Cutover**: per-workspace staged cutover (smallest first); per-Munchkin dual-fire window; per-CRM-sync re-direction; per-engagement-stream in-flight-lead-resume; per-Subscription-Center URL-redirect; per-LaunchPoint partner re-bind.
  24. **Sunset**: Marketo subscription sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate (consent-history typically retained 7-10 years; raw activity 25 months; summarized longer).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Revenue-cycle-stage-transition double-fire** (lead transitions twice due to retry): per-lead idempotent transition + audit + dedup-key.
  - **Account-scoring temporal-drift** (score-as-of-time inconsistent on report rerun): per-account score-history with snapshot timestamps + as-of-time queries.
  - **Smart-list rule-cycle** (List-A references List-B references List-A): per-list dependency-graph + cycle detection at save-time + load-time circuit-breaker.
  - **Email-template token unresolved** (e.g., `{{my.eventDate}}` blank because token scope mismatch): per-send token-resolution validation gate + pre-send dry-run + abort on unresolved-required.
  - **Per-jurisdiction-opt-in audit-trail loss on lead-merge** (when 2 leads merge, only 1 consent record survives): per-merge consent-history preservation with chain-of-custody + per-jurisdiction max-restrictive-wins rule.
  - **Smart-campaign mass-send mis-targeting** (smart-list rule change broadens audience 100x): per-campaign size-check + manual-approval-gate above threshold.
  - **CRM-sync field-mapping drift** (SFDC field renamed, Marketo sync silently fails): per-field schema-pin + alert on drift + dead-letter for failed syncs.
  - **Munchkin cross-domain cookie-leakage** (visitor tracked across unrelated brand sites): per-Munchkin domain-scope-pin.
  - **Engagement-stream cadence stampede** (10K leads scheduled same hour): per-stream throttle + smear-distribution.
  - **Revenue-cycle-model change rollout** (existing leads stuck in deprecated stages): per-model change-plan + per-lead migration-path + dual-model overlap window.
  - **LaunchPoint partner OAuth expiry** (ZoomInfo / 6sense token expires, account-data stale): per-partner OAuth-refresh + alert + cached-fallback.
  - **Subscription Center preference-center desync** (lead opts out in Marketo, still receives via CRM-direct): per-system preference reconcile + master-pin.
  - **Predictive-Content recommendation cold-start** (new leads have no engagement history): per-new-lead default-recommendation + grace-period.
  - **Bizible attribution cost-spike** (touchpoint cost data inaccurate): per-channel cost-attribution audit + reconciliation.
  - **Workspace + partition lead-leakage** (partition-A lead visible to workspace-B): per-partition Cedar default-deny + audit + visibility-test cohort.
  - **Form-progressive-profiling field-order drift** (form re-orders fields, user re-asked same question): per-form field-order-pin + per-lead progressive-profile-state.
  - **Email A/B-test premature-winner** (Statistical significance not reached): per-test sample-size validator + early-stop guard with statistical-power floor.
  - **Per-Lead double-unsubscribe paradox** (unsubscribe + opt-in collision in same hour): per-event timestamp-precision + last-wins rule + audit.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Marketo REST API (lead-describe + bulk-extract-leads + bulk-extract-activities + smart-campaigns + smart-lists + programs + assets API) + Marketo Sky + Marketo Classic for manual approval-state inspection + Marketo Measure REST + Marketo Bulk Activity Export + Munchkin tag inventory; format — JSON + HTML (email + landing-page) + CSV (bulk-extract) + REST-paginated; duration — ~3-6 months per enterprise tenant due to lead-volume + activity-history + workspace count; volume — typically 1M-50M leads + 25-month activity history (often 100M+ activities) + 1000-50000 assets + 100-5000 smart-campaigns.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Lead preserved with score + status + revenue-stage + SFDC-IDs + custom-fields + jurisdiction; per-Account preserved with ICP-match + engagement + buying-stage; per-Program + per-Smart-Campaign + per-Smart-List preserved with rules + flow + schedule + anti-spam; per-Email + per-LP + per-Form preserved with template + variables + tokens + A/B-variants; per-Token by scope + hierarchy preserved; per-Snippet + localization preserved; per-Revenue-Cycle stages + transitions preserved with historical lead-state; per-Lead-Scoring model preserved; per-Predictive-Content + Predictive-Audience re-trained on Oyatie intelligence with parity test; per-Account-AI re-trained; per-Marketo-Measure touchpoint preserved with multi-touch models; per-LaunchPoint partner re-bound; per-Workspace + partition isolation preserved; per-Subscription Center preference + consent preserved; lossy — Adobe-Sensei specific GenAI features rebuilt; some Sky UI authoring deep-customization rebuilt.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-workspace staged (smallest first); per-Munchkin dual-fire window (4-8 weeks); per-CRM-sync re-direction with field-map-pin + dry-run; per-Engagement-Program in-flight-lead-resume; per-Subscription-Center URL-redirect (12-24 months); per-LaunchPoint partner re-bind with OAuth-rotate; per-Email approval-state preserved; per-Token resolution validated; per-Smart-Campaign trigger re-bound to Oyatie events.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 60-90 days with per-Lead score-parity ± 1% + per-Smart-Campaign trigger-parity 100% + per-Engagement-Program send-parity 100% + per-Revenue-Stage transition-parity 100% + per-Account-AI score-parity ± 5% + per-Marketo-Measure attribution-parity 100% + per-Email approval-flow parity 100% + per-Form submission-parity 100%; sunset — Marketo subscription sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate.

- Workflow template library: `marketo.engagement-stream-cadence-with-smear` (throttle + smear-distribution + cadence-respect); `marketo.smart-campaign-trigger-with-flow-and-idempotency`; `marketo.account-based-targeting-with-ICP-score`; `marketo.revenue-cycle-stage-transition-idempotent` (per-lead dedup-key); `marketo.content-approval-with-brand-review` (multi-stage approval + brand-style-check); `marketo.predictive-content-recommend-with-cold-start-fallback`; `marketo.consent-aware-send-per-jurisdiction` (CAN-SPAM + CASL + GDPR + KR-PIPA + UK-PECR); `marketo.lead-merge-with-consent-preservation` (max-restrictive-wins); `marketo.workspace-partition-isolation` (Cedar default-deny + visibility-test); `marketo.crm-sync-with-field-map-pin-and-dead-letter`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (B2B marketer + marketing-ops + content-creator + revenue-ops + ABM-strategist); desktop-primary with smart-campaign flow-builder + smart-list rule-canvas + email/LP/form module-editor + token-resolution-preview + revenue-cycle-modeler + revenue-cycle-explorer dashboard; mobile lead-search + activity-timeline + sales-insight for sales-overlap.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + UK-GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + CPRA + EU ePrivacy + CAN-SPAM + CASL + UK-PECR + per-jurisdiction B2B-opt-in (DE double-opt-in + AT + FR + KR explicit-marketing-consent); HIPAA when leads include patient/care-context; B2B explicit-marketing-consent for KR-PIPA + JP APPI + IN DPDP.
- Naming justification: `marketing-automation` is canonical (per ADR-0299); `adobe-marketo-engage`, `marketo`, `marketo-engage`, `bizible`, `marketo-measure` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-054 - Adobe Experience Manager
- Vendor name and category: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) — Sites + Assets (DAM) + Forms + Guides (DITA / XML) + Screens (digital-signage) + Headless (Content-Fragment + GraphQL) + Edge-Delivery-Services (formerly Helix / Franklin) + AEM-as-a-Cloud-Service (AEMaaCS) / Adobe Experience Cloud / Digital Experience Platform (DXP) — enterprise WCM + DAM + adaptive-forms + structured-XML-authoring + digital-signage + headless-CMS + edge-fast-publish.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across multiple Oyatie µservices). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: AEM-Sites-Only or Assets-Only standalone → **Bronze**; AEM Sites + Assets + multi-locale + Translation-Connector → **Silver**; AEM Sites + Assets + Forms + Content-Fragment + Experience-Fragment + Adobe-Target + Adobe-Analytics integration → **Gold**; AEM-as-a-Cloud-Service + Edge-Delivery-Services + Headless-GraphQL + Adobe-Sensei Content-Intelligence + Adobe-Target Premium + Brand-Portal + Dynamic-Media-with-Smart-Crop → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `wiki` (Sites — content-authoring with hierarchical taxonomy + Page + Template + Component + Editable-Templates); `drive` (Assets — DAM with rendition + metadata-schema + smart-crop + dynamic-media); `workflow-studio` (Forms — adaptive form designer + rule-editor + Forms-Workflow); `cloud-cdn` (Edge-Delivery-Services + Dispatcher equivalent + invalidation); `intelligence` (Adobe-Target activity + audience + content-recommendation + Content-Intelligence); `learning-management` (Guides — DITA-based technical content + Adobe Document Server); `community` (personalization + audience-targeting surface); `marketplace` (Adobe-Exchange marketplace ↔ Oyatie plugin marketplace per ADR-0249).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (AEM JCR + content + asset model):
  - `Page` (jcr:path /content/<site>/<locale>/<...>, Page_Title, Template_Reference, Resource_Type, Modified_DateTime, Published_DateTime, Activation_State {Activated / Modified-Since-Activation / Deactivated / NeverActivated}, Page_Components[], Tags[], cq:lastReplicated, cq:lastReplicationAction, jcr:created, jcr:createdBy, sling:resourceType, Content_Property_Bag).
  - `Template` (Template_ID, Type {Static / Editable / Editable-with-Master / Page-Template}, Initial-Content, Structure, Policies (per-component policy), Allowed-Templates, Allowed-Parents).
  - `Component` (Component_ID, sling:resourceType, Group, Title, Description, Touch-UI-Dialog, HTL-Template, Sling-Model, Edit-Config, Allowed-Children[], Allowed-Parents[]).
  - `Content_Fragment` (CF_ID, Model_Reference (Content-Fragment Model), Field-Values{}, Variations[per-variation field-values], Tags[], Mixed-Media-Element-References[], Created-DateTime, Modified-DateTime, jcr:path).
  - `Content_Fragment_Model` (Model_ID, Title, Description, Field-Schema[Field-Name + Field-Type {single-line-text / multi-line-text / number / boolean / date / enum / tags / content-fragment-reference / fragment-reference / mixed-media-reference / json}, Validation-Rules], Group).
  - `Experience_Fragment` (XF_ID, Variant-References[per-locale + per-channel variation], Linked-Components[], Rendering-Channels {Web / Email / Mobile / Adobe-Target / Facebook / Pinterest}, Conversion-Strategy).
  - `Asset` (jcr:path /content/dam/<...>, dc:title, dc:description, dc:format, dc:identifier, MIME-Type, File-Size, Original-Rendition (binary), Renditions[Rendition-Name → Binary + Format + Dimensions], Metadata-Schema-Reference, Metadata-Properties{XMP + Dublin-Core + IPTC + Custom-Schema}, Tags[], Smart-Crop-Variants[per-platform aspect-ratio], Dynamic-Media-IPS-URL, Predicted-Tags[AI-confidence-score], Asset-Selectors[], Insights {View-Count + Download-Count + Channel-Performance}).
  - `Asset_Metadata_Schema` (Schema_ID, Schema_Name, Field-Definitions[Field-Name + Field-Type + Validation + Required + Default + Tag-Vocabulary], Form-Layout).
  - `Workflow_Model` (Model_ID, Title, Stages[Stage-Name + Steps[Step-Type {Participant-Step + Process-Step + Container-Step + Or-Split + And-Split + Goto-Step + Dialog-Participant-Step + Auto-Advancer + Set-Variable}, Step-Args, ECMA-Script-Reference, Implementation-Class]], Variables[]).
  - `Workflow_Instance` (Instance_ID, Model-Reference, Initiator, Started-DateTime, Status {Running / Suspended / Completed / Aborted}, Active-Work-Items[], Payload-Reference, History-Log).
  - `Work_Item` (Item_ID, Workflow-Instance, Step-Reference, Assignee {User / Group}, Started, Due-DateTime, Priority, Notes).
  - `Adaptive_Form` (Form_ID, Form-Container + Form-Models[XSD / JSON-Schema / FDM (Form Data Model)], Layout {Tabbed / Wizard / Accordion / Vertical / Custom}, Panels-Subpanels-Hierarchy, Fields[Field-Type + Bindings + Validation-Patterns + Visibility-Rules + Calculation-Rules + Pre-Fill-Rules + Submit-Actions], Themes, Languages, Document-of-Record-Template).
  - `Form_Data_Model` (FDM_ID, Source-Systems[REST / SOAP / DataSource], Data-Model-Schema, Services[Get / Post / Bulk-Update / Custom-Service]).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - AEM HTTP API (CRX): `http://<host>/api/{...}` REST + `/bin/...` Sling-Servlets + per-Sling-Selector custom-endpoint.
  - JCR API + Sling: `/content/<path>.json?depth={n}` or `.infinity.json`.
  - Assets HTTP API: `/api/assets/{path}.json` for create / update / delete / rendition / metadata.
  - GraphQL API (Headless, Content-Fragment): `/content/cq:graphql/{endpoint}` per-endpoint query / mutation.
  - Workflow API: `/etc/workflow/instances/<...>.json` or Sling-Servlet for start / advance / abort.
  - Replication API: `/bin/replicate?path={path}&action={Activate / Deactivate}`.
  - Adaptive Forms API: per-form submit endpoint with Form-Data-Model bindings.
  - Adobe Target REST API: per-Activity + Audience + Offer CRUD + per-Activity Performance.
  - AEM Edge-Delivery-Services / Franklin: per-site GitHub repo + `.docx` source + per-publish edge-cache flush.
  - AEM Package Manager: `/crx/packmgr/service.jsp` for package build / install / replicate.
  - AEM Cloud Manager (for AEMaaCS): pipeline / environment / dispatcher-config / branch deployment.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "AEM Sites Console" — site-tree navigator + page-grid with Properties + Activate / Deactivate / Edit Template buttons.
  - "AEM Page Editor (Touch UI)" — WYSIWYG with drag-drop components + per-component dialog + layout-mode + responsive-grid + emulator (mobile / tablet / desktop) + page-properties.
  - "AEM Assets UI" — asset-folder-grid + Card / Column / List view + per-asset Properties + Renditions + Versions + Insights + Comments + Reviews + Smart-Crop + Dynamic-Media-IPS-URL.
  - "AEM Asset Metadata Schema Editor" — drag-drop schema designer.
  - "AEM Content Fragment Editor" — per-Model field-form + per-Variation tab + Mixed-Media inline.
  - "AEM Experience Fragment Editor" — per-Variant + per-Channel + Linked-Components.
  - "AEM Workflow Console" — Workflow-Inbox + Active-Work-Items + per-instance history + Failures + Abort.
  - "AEM Workflow Models" — graphical model editor + Step-palette + per-step config.
  - "AEM Forms Designer" (Adaptive Forms) — drag-drop form-builder + Rule-Editor (visual + scripted) + Form-Data-Model + Theme-editor + Preview + Submit-Action config.
  - "AEM Forms Inbox" — submitted Forms + Document-of-Record + Approval-Action.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<aem-author-or-reviewer-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"AemAuthorPage", Oyatie::Action::"AemPublishPage",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemUnpublishPage", Oyatie::Action::"AemDeletePage",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigureTemplate", Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigurePolicy",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemUploadAsset", Oyatie::Action::"AemActivateAsset",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemDeactivateAsset", Oyatie::Action::"AemRunRendition",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigureMdmMetadata", Oyatie::Action::"AemCreateContentFragment",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemEditContentFragmentVariation", Oyatie::Action::"AemCreateExperienceFragment",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigureAdaptiveForm", Oyatie::Action::"AemSubmitForm",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemStartWorkflow", Oyatie::Action::"AemAdvanceWorkItem",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigureTargetActivity", Oyatie::Action::"AemActivateTargetExperience",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemRunReplicationAgent", Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigureDispatcherCacheRule",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemStartTranslationProject", Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigureBrandPortalShare",
      Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigureEdgeDelivery"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::AemAsset::"<path>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    aem_acl_grants(principal, action, resource.path) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AemPublishPage" ? approved_through_workflow(resource.page) && all_referenced_assets_published(resource.page) && all_referenced_content_fragments_published(resource.page) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigureTemplate" ? principal.has_role("Template-Author") && impact_assessment_completed(context.template_change) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AemActivateAsset" ? asset_metadata_complete(resource.asset) && asset_usage_rights_valid(resource.asset) && resource.asset.has_required_renditions : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AemSubmitForm" ? form_data_validates(context.submission, resource.form) && captcha_passed(context.captcha) && rate_limit_ok(principal, resource.form) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AemActivateTargetExperience" ? activity_audience_resolves(context.activity) && offer_content_approved(context.offer) && statistical_power_sufficient_if_test(context.activity) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigureDispatcherCacheRule" ? principal.has_role("Dispatcher-Operator") && cache_rule_validates(context.rule) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AemStartTranslationProject" ? target_locales_in_governance_scope(context.locales) && translation_provider_dpa_signed(context.provider) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AemConfigureBrandPortalShare" ? recipient_consent_or_business_contract_present(context.recipients) : true) &&
    (resource.regulated_content == "medical-device" ? context.pack.contains("FDA-21CFR-Part-11") && electronic_signature_present_on_publish(resource.page) : true) &&
    (resource.regulated_content == "GxP" ? context.pack.contains("GxP") && computer-system-validation-evidence-present(resource.page) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource.path) : true) &&
    (resource.accessibility_required ? context.pack.contains("WCAG-2.2-AA") && accessibility_check_passed(resource.page) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```
