  - `Brand_Portal_Share` → `Oyatie::Drive::asset_share` (with assets + recipients + expiry + watermark + download-allowed).

- **Specific workflow steps** (AEM displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant AEM-Sites count + AEM-Assets count + AEM-Forms count + AEM-Guides count + AEM-Screens count + AEMaaCS-Cloud-Manager pipeline count + Edge-Delivery-Services site count + per-Page count + per-Asset count (often 1M-10M binaries) + per-Template / per-Component count + per-Content-Fragment + per-Experience-Fragment + per-Workflow-Model + per-Workflow-Instance backlog + per-Target activity count + per-Translation-Project active + per-Replication-Agent + per-Dispatcher-config.
  2. **AEM Package Manager export**: per-site Package-build with content + assets + templates + components + workflow-models + policies + replication-agent-configs; per-package CRX-content + XML + binary references.
  3. **JCR + Sling extraction**: per-`/content/<site>` recursive export with property bag + Sling resource-type + jcr-properties; per-`/conf/<site>` editable-template + policy configuration.
  4. **Per-Asset rendition + metadata + DAM-taxonomy extraction**: per-Asset original-rendition + all renditions + metadata-schema + tags + smart-crop-variants + dynamic-media-IPS-URL + predicted-tags + insights.
  5. **Per-Content-Fragment + per-Experience-Fragment extraction**: per-Model + per-Fragment field-values + variations + mixed-media + tags.
  6. **Per-Adaptive-Form definition + Form-Data-Model extraction**: per-Form layout + panels + fields + bindings + validation + visibility + calculation + pre-fill + submit-actions; per-FDM source-systems + data-model + services.
  7. **Per-Workflow-Model extraction**: per-Model stages + steps + step-type + step-args + ECMA-script-reference; per-Instance state + Work-Items + payload; per-Failed-Instance dead-letter inspection.
  8. **Per-Target activity + audience + offer extraction**: per-Activity experiences + targeting-engine + goals + reporting-source; per-Audience rules; per-Offer content + library.
  9. **Per-Dispatcher cache-rule + invalidation-policy extraction**: per-Rule URL-pattern + cache-behavior + invalidation-pattern + TTL; per-Replication-Agent URL + transport + triggers + queue-state.
  10. **Per-Translation-Project extraction**: per-Project source + target-locales + provider + active workflows + history.
  11. **Per-Brand-Portal share extraction**: per-Share assets + recipients + expiry + watermark + download-allowed; per-share OAuth + DPA.
  12. **Per-Edge-Delivery-Services / Franklin site extraction**: per-site GitHub repo + `.docx` source + per-publish edge-cache config + per-fragment URL-routing.
  13. **AEMaaCS Cloud Manager pipeline extraction**: per-pipeline code-quality + production + per-environment + per-dispatcher-config + per-branch-deploy.
  14. **Per-Locale content-translation drift verification**: per-Fragment translation-equivalence validation suite.
  15. **Workflow-model orphan resolution**: per-legacy-ECMA-workflow migration-spike + manual-rewrite in Oyatie WorkflowStudio (gap-list per model).
  16. **Per-Asset re-rendition pipeline**: per-Asset re-render with Oyatie format + dimensions + smart-crop + dynamic-media equivalent + manifest checksum verification.
  17. **Per-Component → Oyatie wiki-component re-implementation**: per-AEM HTL-template + Sling-Model rewritten as Oyatie wiki component with golden-render comparison.
  18. **Per-Target activity → Oyatie intelligence-activity re-implementation**: per-Activity experience composer + audience-rules + offer-decisioning re-bound to Oyatie intelligence with parity test.
  19. **Per-Dispatcher cache-rule → Oyatie cloud-cdn cache-rule**: per-Rule URL-pattern preserved + invalidation hook re-bound to Oyatie publish-event.
  20. **Per-Adaptive-Form → Oyatie WorkflowStudio adaptive-form**: per-Form layout + fields + rules + FDM-bindings re-implemented.
  21. **Per-Replication-Agent → Oyatie publish-replication**: per-Agent URL + transport-user preserved + per-Queue pending + failed items drained.
  22. **Per-Translation-Project active migration**: per-Project source + target-locales + provider preserved + active workflow continues at current stage.
  23. **Parallel run**: 60-120 day shadow with sample site + per-Page render-parity (golden-image diff < 0.5%) + per-Component golden-render 100% + per-Asset rendition-parity 100% + per-Content-Fragment GraphQL-response-parity 100% + per-Adaptive-Form submit-parity 100% + per-Workflow-Instance state-parity 100% + per-Target activity outcome-parity ± 2% (statistical-power respected) + per-Dispatcher cache-hit/miss-parity ± 1% + per-Translation-Project workflow-parity 100%.
  24. **Cutover**: per-site staged with DNS + CDN switch; per-Brand-Portal share URL-redirect (24 months); per-Edge-Delivery-Services repo migrated to Oyatie-managed; per-Replication-Agent queue drained; per-Workflow-Instance active completed; per-Translation-Project in-flight resumes.
  25. **Sunset**: AEM license sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate (FDA-21CFR-Part-11 for medical-device labeling: typically until product-end-of-life + 10 years; GxP: per-CSV-policy; per-EU + per-KR locale residency).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Workflow-model orphan** (legacy ECMA-Script workflow with no Oyatie equivalent): per-model migration-spike + manual-rewrite to declarative workflow + golden-test on historical instances.
  - **Asset-rendition-set regeneration** (rendition formats / dimensions / smart-crop differ): per-asset re-rendition with manifest + dimension-parity test.
  - **Per-locale content-translation drift** (translated fragment subtly differs after re-import): per-fragment translation-equivalence validation + Translation-Memory preserved.
  - **Dispatcher-cache-invalidation gap on publish** (page published but cache stale): per-publish invalidation-event with verifier + per-rule TTL audit + invalidation-debug-trace.
  - **Target-activity-offer-personalization mis-fire** (wrong audience served wrong offer): per-activity audience-resolution validation suite + statistical-power-check before activate.
  - **Editable-Template policy collision** (policy at page-level overrides template-level unexpectedly): per-policy precedence-pin + audit on save + visualization in editor.
  - **Sling-Model dependency-injection failure** (component breaks because injected service missing): per-component dependency-manifest + import-validation.
  - **HTL-template Sightly syntax incompat** (older Sightly syntax not parsed by Oyatie wiki-engine): per-template syntax-version-pin + transpile.
  - **Adaptive-Form Rule-Editor visibility-cycle** (Field-A visible when Field-B value, Field-B visible when Field-A value — deadlock): per-form rule-graph cycle-detection + default-resolution.
  - **Content-Fragment GraphQL query-complexity DoS** (deep nested query exhausts service): per-query depth-cap + cost-budget + rate-limit per token.
  - **AEMaaCS Cloud Manager pipeline-state drift** (pipeline status not reflected post-migration): per-pipeline state-pin + parallel-run validation.
  - **Replication-Agent queue-stuck** (transport-user credential expired): per-agent credential-rotation + alert + dead-letter inspection.
  - **Smart-Crop AI-difference** (Oyatie smart-crop crops different region): per-asset smart-crop-parity-suite + manual-override fallback.
  - **Dynamic-Media-IPS-URL break** (asset URL with /is/image/ no longer resolves): per-asset URL-redirect with TTL.
  - **Brand-Portal expiry-share leak** (expired share still resolvable via cached CDN): per-share expiry-revoke broadcast + CDN purge.
  - **Edge-Delivery-Services GitHub-repo authentication break** (per-publish authoring `.docx` source un-fetched): per-site OAuth re-bind + alert.
  - **Per-jurisdiction-locale data-residency drift** (EU page data egressed to US-CDN edge): per-locale CDN region-pin + audit.
  - **WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility regression** (publish breaks contrast / focus / aria): per-publish a11y-check + fail-on-regression.
  - **FDA-21CFR-Part-11 electronic-signature mis-binding** (publish-action lacks electronic signature evidence): per-page e-signature evidence-bundle + audit.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — AEM Package Manager + JCR/Sling REST + Assets HTTP API + GraphQL API + Workflow API + Adaptive-Forms REST + Adobe Target REST + AEM Cloud Manager API + Edge-Delivery-Services GitHub source repo + Adobe Brand Portal API + Dynamic-Media-IPS API + per-Replication-Agent queue inspection; format — XML + JSON + binary (rendition) + `.docx` (Franklin); duration — ~4-12 months per enterprise tenant due to asset volume + page count + template / component depth + workflow complexity; volume — typically 100K-10M assets + 10K-1M pages + 100-5000 components + 50-500 templates + 50-500 workflow-models + 100-5000 target-activities.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Page preserved with template + components + activation-state; per-Template preserved with editable-template policy; per-Component preserved (HTL-template + Sling-Model rewritten); per-Content-Fragment + Model preserved with field-values + variations; per-Experience-Fragment preserved with variants + channels; per-Asset preserved with renditions + metadata + smart-crop + dynamic-media-URL; per-Workflow-Model rewritten + per-Instance state-preserved; per-Adaptive-Form layout + rules + FDM rewritten; per-Target-Activity audience + offer rewritten; per-Dispatcher cache-rule preserved with invalidation-hook re-bound; per-Replication-Agent queue drained; per-Brand-Portal share preserved with watermark + expiry; per-Translation-Project workflow continues; per-Edge-Delivery-Services repo migrated; lossy — some advanced Sling-Model dependency-injection rebuilt; Adobe-Sensei Content-Intelligence rebuilt; some Touch-UI-dialog deep customizations rebuilt.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-site staged with DNS + CDN switch; per-Brand-Portal share URL-redirect (24 months); per-Edge-Delivery-Services repo migrated; per-Replication-Agent queue drained before cutover; per-Workflow-Instance active completed before cutover; per-Translation-Project in-flight resumes; per-Target-Activity statistical-power preserved; per-Dispatcher invalidation re-bound; per-Adobe-Target activity rebound to Oyatie intelligence with parity test.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 60-120 days with per-Page render-parity (golden-image diff < 0.5%) + per-Component render 100% + per-Asset rendition-parity 100% + per-CF GraphQL-response-parity 100% + per-Adaptive-Form submit-parity 100% + per-Workflow-Instance state-parity 100% + per-Target-Activity outcome-parity ± 2% + per-Dispatcher cache-hit/miss-parity ± 1% + per-Translation-Project workflow-parity 100% + per-Edge-Delivery-Services per-publish-fan-out timing-parity ± 200ms; sunset — AEM license sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate.

- Workflow template library: `aem.author-to-publish-with-multi-stage-approval` (author → review → approve → publish → activate); `aem.asset-upload-with-auto-rendition-and-smart-crop`; `aem.content-fragment-localize-with-translation-memory`; `aem.adaptive-form-submit-with-cedar-check-and-fdm-binding`; `aem.target-activity-launch-with-statistical-power-check`; `aem.dispatcher-cache-invalidation-on-publish-fanout`; `aem.replication-agent-queue-drain-with-dead-letter`; `aem.brand-portal-share-with-watermark-and-expiry`; `aem.translation-project-multi-locale-with-tm-leverage`; `aem.edge-delivery-service-fast-publish-from-docx`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (author + reviewer + content-mgr + asset-curator + brand-mgr + translator + Forms-Designer + Workflow-Designer); desktop-primary with WYSIWYG editor + asset-finder + workflow-inbox + per-locale content view + preview-as-persona + adaptive-form-designer + workflow-model-editor + Target-activity-composer; mobile review + approval + workflow-inbox; per-brand customization.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + EU AI Act (when AI generates content or personalization); accessibility WCAG 2.2 AA + EU Web Accessibility Directive + ADA Title-III + Section 508; for regulated content — FDA-21CFR-Part-11 (medical-device labeling); GxP (life-sciences); per-locale content-residency; per-Brand-Portal recipient consent + DPA; per-Translation-Provider DPA + DPF.
- Naming justification: `wiki` + `drive` + `workflow-studio` + `cloud-cdn` + `intelligence` are canonical; `adobe-experience-manager`, `aem`, `aem-sites`, `aem-assets`, `aem-forms`, `aem-guides`, `aem-screens`, `aem-cloud-service`, `aemaacs`, `edge-delivery-services`, `franklin`, `helix` are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-055 - Adobe Campaign
- Vendor name and category: Adobe Campaign Classic v7/v8 + Adobe Campaign Standard + Adobe Campaign v8 (managed-cloud-services) / Adobe Experience Cloud / cross-channel campaign management — email + SMS + push + direct-mail + LINE + WhatsApp + transactional-message; Campaign Classic (on-prem / hosted, full power with XML-typology + complex-workflow) and Campaign Standard (cloud-native simplified).
- Coverage tier: D (microservice: `marketing-automation` per ADR-0299). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Campaign-Standard-Email-only → **Bronze**; Campaign-Standard-Cross-Channel (Email + SMS + Push) → **Silver**; Campaign-Classic-v7/v8 with multi-org + typology + direct-mail + audience-builder + predictive-send → **Gold**; Campaign-v8-Managed-Cloud + Sensei AI predictive-send-time + Send-Time-Optimization + multi-touch attribution + Adobe Journey Optimizer bridge → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `marketing-automation` (campaign + delivery + workflow + audience + typology + AB-test); `comms-email` + `comms-sms` + `comms-push` + `comms-line` + `comms-whatsapp` (channel rails); `comms-direct-mail` (print-vendor connector — Vistaprint / Mailchimp-Print / RR Donnelley / Lob); `data-pipeline` (audience-build from data-warehouse + delta-import); `intelligence` (predictive send-time + frequency-cap optimization + send-throttle ML); `consent-and-privacy` (per-channel consent ledger + suppression-list).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Adobe Campaign nms schema):
  - `Recipient` (nms:recipient — Id, Email, Mobile_Phone, Phone, Status {Quarantined / Hard-Bounce / Soft-Bounce / Active}, Email_Format {HTML / Text / MMS}, Origin, External_ID, Language, Country, First_Name, Last_Name, Address[Lines + City + State + Zip], Created_DateTime, Modified_DateTime, Last_Modified_By, Folder_Reference, Marketing_Segment_References[]).
  - `Subscription_Service` (nms:service — Id, Name, Label, Type {Newsletter / SMS-Service / Push-Service / RSS / Custom-Channel}, Confirmation-Required: bool, Notification-Type {Welcome / Unsubscribe / Reminder}, Linked-Delivery-Template).
  - `Subscription` (nms:subscription — Recipient-Reference, Service-Reference, Created-DateTime, Last-Modified, State {Subscribed / Unsubscribed / Pending-Confirmation}, Origin).
  - `Delivery` (nms:delivery — Delivery_ID, Name, Label, Channel {Email / SMS / Push / Direct-Mail / LINE / WhatsApp / IVR / Transactional}, State {Editing / Pending-Approval / Approved / Scheduled / Running / Paused / Completed / Failed / Cancelled}, Operator-Reference, Folder, Template-Reference, Target-Mapping, Recipient-Population-Query, Schedule {One-Shot / Recurring / Continuous + Cron-like-Expression}, Validation_State, Performance_Indicators {Sent + Delivered + Open + Click + Unsubscribe + Bounce + Complaint}).
  - `Workflow` (xtk:workflow — Workflow_ID, Name, Label, State {Editing / Running / Paused / Completed / Failed}, Operator, Folder, Activities[Activity-Type {Query / Read-List / Read-File / Read-XML / Read-DB / Union / Intersection / Exclusion / Split / Update-Data / Enrichment / SQL-Activity / JS-Code / Delivery / Subscription / Wait / Approval / Test / Or / And / Fork / Throttle / Schedule-Activity / End / Sub-Process}], Connections[Source-Activity → Target-Activity]).
  - `Audience_Query` (Targeting-Query — Schema-Reference, Predicates[Field + Operator + Value + AND-OR-NOT], Limit, Sort, Sample).
  - `Typology_Rule` (nms:typologyRule — Rule_ID, Label, Type {Filtering / Pressure / Capacity / Control}, Schema, JavaScript-Expression, Description, Folder, Used-In-Typology-References[]).
  - `Typology` (nms:typology — Typology_ID, Channel, Rules-Order[Typology-Rule-Reference], Applies-To-Deliveries-References[]).
  - `Template_Delivery` (nms:deliveryTemplate — Template_ID, Channel, Content {HTML-Email-Body + Text-Body + Subject + From + Reply-To / SMS-Body / Push-Title-Body / Direct-Mail-PDF-Reference / LINE-Message-Spec}, Linked-Personalization-Fields[], Linked-Conditional-Content[], Linked-Dynamic-Content[]).
  - `Personalization_Block` (Content_Block_ID, Name, Type {Text-Block / Image-Block / Conditional-Block / Loop-Block + Custom-Block}, Variables, Used-In-Template-References[]).
  - `Tracking_URL` (Tracking_ID, Original-URL, Tracked-URL, Delivery-Reference, Recipient-Reference, Click-Count, Last-Click-DateTime).
  - `AB_Test` (Test_ID, Delivery-Reference, Variants[Variant-Name + Sample-Size + Subject / Content / Template-Override + Performance], Winning-Criterion {Open-Rate / Click-Rate / Conversion / Click-To-Open / Bounce}, Test-Duration, Champion-Selection {Manual / Automatic}, Winner).
  - `Direct_Mail_Handover` (Handover_ID, Delivery-Reference, Print-Vendor {Vistaprint / Mailchimp-Print / RR-Donnelley / Lob / Local-Vendor}, File-Format {CSV / Excel / EDI / XML / vendor-specific}, Postal-Code-Sortation, Address-Validation, Output-File-References[], Status, Cost).
  - `Quarantine_List` (Email-or-Phone, Reason {Hard-Bounce / Soft-Bounce-Threshold / Complaint / Manual-Block / List-Wash}, Quarantine-DateTime, Last-Bounce-Description).
  - `Suppression_List` (Email-or-Phone, Reason, Suppression-DateTime, Origin {Manual / Imported / Compliance-Removal / User-Self-Unsubscribe}).
  - `IP_Pool_and_Warmup_Plan` (Pool_ID, IP_Addresses[], Warmup-Plan{Day → Volume + ISP-Breakdown}, Reputation-Score, Channel {Email / SMS}, Allowed-Domains[]).
  - `Send_Time_Optimization_Model` (Model_ID, Per-Recipient-Best-Send-Time + Confidence, Training-Source, Last-Refresh-DateTime).
  - `Predictive_Audience` (Audience_ID, Goal, Cohort-Size, Confidence).
  - `Multi_Org_Unit` (Org-Unit_ID, Name, Folder-Hierarchy, Visible-Operators, Data-Scope).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Adobe Campaign Classic SOAP API: `http(s)://<host>/nl/jsp/soaprouter.jsp` with per-`nms:` / per-`xtk:` schema query + queryDef + writer + collection-operations.
  - Adobe Campaign Standard REST API: `https://mc.adobe.io/{tenant}/campaign/{resource}/` with OAuth.
  - Adobe Campaign Workflow Scripting: per-`activity` JavaScript or SQL or JSSP.
  - Adobe Campaign Bulk-Import / Bulk-Export: per-schema CSV / XML.
  - Adobe Campaign Webhook / Web-Application: per-form + per-mobile-app deep-link.
  - Campaign Console Client (Windows desktop): legacy authoring + workflow design.
  - Adobe Campaign Cloud Manager: per-instance + per-environment management.
  - Direct-Mail Handover Connector: per-vendor (Vistaprint / Mailchimp-Print / RR-Donnelley / Lob).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Campaign Explorer" — left tree of schemas + folders + recipients + deliveries + workflows + typologies + templates (Classic desktop client).
  - "Workflow Designer" — drag-drop activity graph (Query → Split → Delivery → Wait → ...) — most powerful AC primitive.
  - "Delivery Wizard" — per-channel template selection + target population + content + personalization + tracking + approval + schedule.
  - "Audience Builder" — query-builder with schema-aware predicates + AND/OR/NOT grouping + sample-size preview.
  - "Typology Editor" — per-Rule JavaScript expression + per-Typology rule-order.
  - "Recipient Profile" — per-Recipient data + Subscriptions + Delivery-history + Tracking + Quarantine-state + Custom-fields.
  - "Reports & Dashboards" — Campaign-Performance + Channel-Performance + Reputation + Bounce-Reason + per-Operator activity.
  - "Tracking Console" — per-Delivery click-map + open-rate + per-URL clicks + per-Recipient interactions.
  - "IP Pool & Warmup" — per-Pool IP + reputation + warmup-curve.
  - "Direct-Mail Handover" — per-Delivery file-generation + vendor-handoff status + cost.
  - "Operator Console" — per-Operator + per-Group + per-Role + per-Folder permission + per-Schema permission.
  - "Multi-Org Unit Browser" — per-OU folder-hierarchy + data-scope + visible-operators.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<campaign-operator-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"AcCreateDelivery", Oyatie::Action::"AcApproveDelivery",
      Oyatie::Action::"AcRunDelivery", Oyatie::Action::"AcPauseDelivery",
      Oyatie::Action::"AcCancelDelivery", Oyatie::Action::"AcBuildAudience",
      Oyatie::Action::"AcSetFrequencyCap", Oyatie::Action::"AcChangeTypologyRule",
      Oyatie::Action::"AcApplyTypology", Oyatie::Action::"AcRunWorkflow",
      Oyatie::Action::"AcPauseWorkflow", Oyatie::Action::"AcEditTemplate",
      Oyatie::Action::"AcRunABTest", Oyatie::Action::"AcRunMultiArmTest",
      Oyatie::Action::"AcRunDirectMailHandover", Oyatie::Action::"AcConfigureIPPool",
      Oyatie::Action::"AcUpdateRecipient", Oyatie::Action::"AcManageSubscription",
      Oyatie::Action::"AcImportQuarantine", Oyatie::Action::"AcExportRecipientList",
      Oyatie::Action::"AcRunSendTimeOptimization", Oyatie::Action::"AcConfigureMultiOrgUnit"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::CampaignAsset::"<id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    campaign_role_grants(principal, action, resource.org_unit) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AcRunDelivery" ? approved_through_approval(resource.delivery) && typology_applied(resource.delivery) && ip_pool_capacity_sufficient(resource.delivery) && quarantine_list_applied(resource.delivery) && consent_resolved_per_channel(resource.delivery) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AcChangeTypologyRule" ? impact_simulation_complete(context.rule_change) && rule_precedence_explicit(context.rule) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AcRunDirectMailHandover" ? vendor_dpa_signed(context.vendor) && address_validation_passed(context.delivery) && file_format_dry_run_ok(context.vendor, context.delivery) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AcExportRecipientList" ? data_export_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && dual_admin_approval(context) && pii_scrubbed_per_export_policy(context.fields) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AcRunABTest" ? statistical_power_sufficient(context.test) && minimum_test_duration_respected(context.test) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AcRunSendTimeOptimization" ? model_governed_and_explainable(context.model) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AcManageSubscription" ? subscription_change_logged_per_jurisdiction(resource.recipient, context.service_change) : true) &&
    (resource.recipient.jurisdiction == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && lawful_basis_for_processing(resource.recipient, context.purpose) : true) &&
    (resource.recipient.jurisdiction == "CA" ? context.pack.contains("CASL") && express_or_implied_consent_present(resource.recipient) : true) &&
    (resource.delivery.channel == "Email" && resource.recipient.jurisdiction == "US" ? context.pack.contains("CAN-SPAM") && physical_address_in_footer(context.delivery) && unsubscribe_link_present(context.delivery) : true) &&
    (resource.delivery.channel == "SMS" ? context.pack.contains(jurisdiction_sms_pack(resource.recipient.jurisdiction)) && sms_opt_in_explicit(resource.recipient) : true) &&
    (resource.delivery.channel == "Direct-Mail" ? context.pack.contains(jurisdiction_direct_mail_pack(resource.recipient.jurisdiction)) && opt_out_status_checked(resource.recipient) : true) &&
    (resource.recipient.jurisdiction == "KR" ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") && marketing_consent_explicit(resource.recipient) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Recipient` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::recipient` (with email + mobile + status + format + origin + external-ID + address + folder + marketing-segments).
  - `Subscription_Service` + `Subscription` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::subscription_service` + `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::subscription` (with type + confirmation-required + state).
  - `Delivery` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::delivery` (with channel + state + template + target-mapping + recipient-population-query + schedule + performance-indicators).
  - `Workflow` + `Activities` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::workflow` + `Oyatie::WorkflowStudio::activity` (with activities + connections + workflow-state).
  - `Audience_Query` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::audience_query` (with schema-reference + predicates + sort + sample).
  - `Typology_Rule` + `Typology` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::typology_rule` + `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::typology` (with channel + rules-order + applies-to).
  - `Template_Delivery` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::delivery_template` (with channel + content + personalization-fields + conditional-blocks + dynamic-content).
  - `Personalization_Block` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::personalization_block` (with type + variables + bindings).
  - `Tracking_URL` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::tracking_url` (with original + tracked + delivery + recipient + clicks).
  - `AB_Test` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::ab_test` (with variants + winning-criterion + duration + champion-selection + winner).
  - `Direct_Mail_Handover` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::direct_mail_handover` (with vendor + format + sortation + address-validation + output-files + cost).
  - `Quarantine_List` + `Suppression_List` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::quarantine_list` + `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::suppression_list` (with reason + timestamp + origin).
  - `IP_Pool_and_Warmup_Plan` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::ip_pool` (with IPs + warmup-plan + reputation + channel + allowed-domains).
  - `Send_Time_Optimization_Model` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::send_time_model` (with per-recipient best-send-time + confidence).
  - `Predictive_Audience` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::predictive_audience` (with goal + cohort + confidence).
  - `Multi_Org_Unit` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::org_unit` (with folder-hierarchy + visible-operators + data-scope).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Adobe Campaign displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-instance (Classic vs Standard vs v8-managed) + per-org-unit + per-recipient count (often 10M-1B) + per-Delivery count + per-Workflow count + per-Typology + per-Template + per-Personalization-Block + per-Tracking-URL retention + per-Quarantine + per-Suppression list size + per-IP-Pool reputation + per-Direct-Mail-vendor active.
  2. **Recipient extraction**: per-Recipient via SOAP `queryDef` or REST bulk-extract; per-custom-field schema preserved; per-Subscription preserved with state + origin; per-Quarantine + per-Suppression preserved with reason + timestamp.
  3. **Delivery + Template extraction**: per-Delivery state + channel + schedule + performance; per-Template content (HTML/SMS/Push/Direct-Mail) + personalization-fields + conditional + dynamic content.
  4. **Workflow extraction**: per-Workflow XML definition + activities + connections + state + history; per-JS-activity script + per-SQL-activity SQL.
  5. **Typology + Typology-Rule extraction**: per-Rule JavaScript expression + per-Typology rule-order + applies-to deliveries.
  6. **Personalization-Block extraction**: per-Block type + variables + bindings + used-in-templates.
  7. **Tracking-URL extraction**: per-URL original + tracked + delivery-reference + per-recipient clicks + last-click history.
  8. **AB-Test extraction**: per-Test variants + winning-criterion + duration + champion + winner + performance-history.
  9. **Direct-Mail-Handover extraction**: per-Handover vendor + format + sortation + address-validation + output-files + status + cost; preserve per-vendor format-template for replay.
  10. **IP-Pool + Warmup extraction**: per-Pool IP + warmup-plan + reputation + allowed-domains; preserve per-ISP reputation history.
  11. **Send-Time-Optimization model extraction**: per-Recipient best-send-time + confidence + training-source + last-refresh; re-trained on Oyatie intelligence with parity test.
  12. **Predictive-Audience extraction**: per-Audience goal + cohort + confidence; re-trained on Oyatie intelligence.
  13. **Multi-Org-Unit extraction**: per-OU folder-hierarchy + visible-operators + data-scope; preserve in Oyatie `marketing-automation` workspace primitive.
  14. **Per-channel-consent ledger preservation**: per-Recipient per-channel (Email / SMS / Push / Direct-Mail / LINE / WhatsApp) consent + per-jurisdiction max-restrictive-wins; preserved into Oyatie `consent-and-privacy`.
  15. **Per-Tracking-URL domain migration**: per-tracking-domain CNAME re-point + per-link signing-key rotation + per-URL backward-compatible redirect (24-36 months for cold inbox stragglers).
  16. **Per-IP-Pool reputation transfer**: per-IP-Pool reputation-warmup-from-zero on new infrastructure + per-ISP postmaster handshake + gradual volume ramp (4-12 weeks).
  17. **Per-Workflow re-implementation**: per-Activity translated to Oyatie WorkflowStudio + JavaScript / SQL activities migrated; per-cycle detection at publish.
  18. **Per-Typology + Typology-Rule re-implementation**: per-Rule re-translated with explicit-precedence + apply-cycle audit.
  19. **Per-Direct-Mail-vendor file-format dry-run**: per-Vendor format-template dry-run + handover-mishap prevention.
  20. **Per-AB-test statistical-power validation**: per-Test sample-size validator + early-stop guard + minimum-duration respected.
  21. **Parallel run**: 60-120 day shadow with sample campaign + per-Delivery send-parity 100% + per-Tracking click-parity ± 0.5% + per-Typology suppress-parity 100% + per-Workflow execution-parity 100% + per-AB-test statistical-equivalence + per-Predictive send-time-parity ± 30 min + per-Direct-Mail file-format match-parity 100%.
  22. **Cutover**: per-channel + per-region staged cutover; per-IP-Pool reputation-warmup gradual ramp; per-Tracking-URL domain redirect (24-36 months); per-Direct-Mail-vendor handoff dual-route window; per-Subscription-Center URL-redirect.
  23. **Sunset**: Adobe Campaign license sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate (consent-history 7-10 years; raw tracking 25 months; summarized longer).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Workflow-cycle on cross-channel orchestration** (Workflow-A invokes Workflow-B invokes Workflow-A): per-workflow cycle detection at publish + circuit-breaker at runtime + audit.
  - **Per-channel-consent leak** (email-consent used for SMS): per-consent channel-pin enforced at delivery-time + cross-channel-consent ledger + audit.
  - **Direct-mail-handover mishap** (file format mismatch with print-vendor causes 100K wrong addresses): per-vendor format-template + dry-run handover + line-item parity check pre-handoff.
  - **AB-test statistical-power overestimate** (winner declared with insufficient sample): per-test sample-size validator + early-stop guard + minimum-duration floor.
  - **Typology-rule-precedence ambiguity** (two rules conflict, outcome undefined): per-rule explicit-precedence + audit on apply + per-rule applies-to scope-pin.
  - **IP-Pool reputation cliff on cutover** (new infrastructure cold IPs throttled by ISPs): per-IP-Pool reputation-warmup gradual + per-ISP handshake + dual-pool window.
  - **Quarantine-list misimport** (active recipients accidentally quarantined): per-import dry-run + per-row audit + reversible.
  - **Per-Recipient mass-update race** (workflow updates recipient while delivery is fetching): per-recipient row-lock + serializable isolation + dead-letter retry.
  - **Workflow long-running orphan** (workflow stuck for days, never completes): per-workflow TTL + dead-letter + manual-resume-or-abort.
  - **Direct-mail postal-sortation-error** (CASS / NCOA address-validation gap): per-vendor validation-suite + per-delivery address-error report.
  - **Personalization-block conditional-render leak** (wrong recipient sees wrong content): per-template conditional-resolution test-set + per-recipient render-preview.
  - **Tracking-URL signing-key rotation break** (old links 404): per-key dual-sign window + URL-redirect.
  - **Multi-Org-Unit data-scope leak** (OU-A delivery accidentally sends to OU-B recipients): per-OU Cedar default-deny + audit + visibility-test cohort.
  - **Send-Time-Optimization model staleness** (model trained on old data, suggests bad send-time): per-model TTL + retrain cadence + freshness-floor.
  - **Subscription-Service confirmation-required gap** (double-opt-in skipped for EU GDPR): per-jurisdiction confirmation-required-enforce + audit.
  - **Direct-Mail-vendor DPA expiry** (DPA expired, sending continues without legal basis): per-vendor DPA-tracking + alert ≥60 days pre-expiry + suspend-on-expire.
  - **Bounce-rate threshold breach** (high bounce-rate triggers ISP block): per-delivery pre-send bounce-risk-score + abort if above threshold.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Adobe Campaign Classic SOAP API (queryDef + writer + collection) + Campaign Standard REST API + Bulk Import/Export (CSV/XML) + per-Workflow XML export + per-Typology XML export + per-Template (HTML / vendor-specific) + per-IP-Pool config + per-Direct-Mail-vendor connector inventory + per-Tracking-URL domain inventory + per-Subscription-Service inventory; format — XML + JSON + CSV + binary (PDF for direct-mail); duration — ~4-9 months per enterprise tenant due to recipient volume + workflow count + typology complexity; volume — typically 10M-1B recipients + 1K-50K deliveries/month + 100-5000 workflows + 100-1000 typology-rules + 100-5000 templates.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Recipient + Subscription preserved with state + origin + jurisdiction; per-Delivery + Template preserved with channel + state + content + personalization; per-Workflow re-implemented as Oyatie WorkflowStudio with activities + connections + state-preserved; per-Typology-Rule re-implemented with explicit-precedence; per-Personalization-Block + conditional + dynamic preserved with render-test; per-Tracking-URL domain + signing-key migrated with dual-sign window; per-AB-Test + variants + winner preserved with statistical-equivalence test; per-Direct-Mail-Handover vendor + format preserved with dry-run; per-IP-Pool reputation-warmup transferred + ISP-handshake gradual; per-Predictive-Audience + Send-Time-Optimization re-trained on Oyatie intelligence with parity test; per-Multi-Org-Unit isolation preserved; per-Quarantine + Suppression preserved with chain-of-custody; lossy — Campaign Console Client deep customization rebuilt; some Adobe-Sensei specifics rebuilt.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-channel + per-region staged (smallest first); per-IP-Pool reputation-warmup gradual ramp (4-12 weeks); per-Tracking-URL domain redirect (24-36 months); per-Direct-Mail-vendor dual-route window; per-Subscription-Center URL-redirect; per-Workflow in-flight resumes; per-Recipient mass-update freeze during cutover window; per-Typology-Rule applied at delivery-time validated.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 60-120 days with per-Delivery send-parity 100% + per-Tracking click-parity ± 0.5% + per-Typology suppress-parity 100% + per-Workflow execution-parity 100% + per-AB-test statistical-equivalence + per-Predictive send-time-parity ± 30 min + per-Direct-Mail file-format match-parity 100% + per-IP reputation-trend within ± 5 reputation-score; sunset — Adobe Campaign license sunset.

- Workflow template library: `campaign.audience-build-with-typology-check` (typology-applied at audience-time + at delivery-time); `campaign.cross-channel-orchestration-with-cycle-detect`; `campaign.ab-test-with-significance-gate` (early-stop + minimum-duration + statistical-power); `campaign.direct-mail-handover-to-print-vendor-with-dry-run` (per-vendor format-template + address-validation); `campaign.frequency-cap-with-global-suppression` (per-recipient cross-channel cap); `campaign.delivery-throttle-with-IP-warmup` (per-pool + per-ISP); `campaign.consent-aware-per-channel-send` (per-jurisdiction max-restrictive-wins); `campaign.workflow-with-dead-letter-retry`; `campaign.send-time-optimization-with-explainability`; `campaign.multi-org-unit-isolation` (Cedar default-deny + visibility-test).
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (campaign-mgr + analyst + workflow-designer + typology-mgr + IP-reputation-engineer + direct-mail-coordinator); desktop-primary with workflow-canvas (drag-drop activity-graph) + audience-builder + per-campaign delivery-monitor + tracking-console + reputation-dashboard; mobile delivery-monitor + approval; per-OU permission view.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + UK-GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + EU ePrivacy + CAN-SPAM + CASL + UK-PECR + per-jurisdiction direct-mail (US-DMA + UK-DMA + DE-EFCA + JP); per-channel-consent (email-opt-in ≠ SMS-opt-in ≠ direct-mail-opt-out); HIPAA when delivery-content includes PHI; per-vendor DPA + DPF.
- Naming justification: `marketing-automation` is canonical (per ADR-0299); `adobe-campaign`, `adobe-campaign-classic`, `adobe-campaign-standard`, `adobe-campaign-v8`, `campaign-managed-cloud` are benchmark aliases.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-056 - Adobe Analytics
- Vendor name and category: Adobe Analytics (formerly Omniture SiteCatalyst) — Analysis Workspace + Ad-Hoc Analysis (deprecated successor to Discover) + Reports & Analytics (legacy) + Activity Map + Mobile-Services + Customer-Journey-Analytics (CJA — newer XDM-based bridge to Adobe Experience Platform) / Adobe Experience Cloud / web + mobile + offline cross-channel digital-experience analytics with eVar / prop / event taxonomy + Anomaly-Detection + Segment-IQ + Attribution-IQ.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across multiple Oyatie µservices). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Adobe Analytics Select (basic Workspace + Reports) → **Bronze**; Adobe Analytics Prime (Select + custom variables + segments + Analysis Workspace + virtual-report-suites) → **Silver**; Adobe Analytics Ultimate (Prime + Activity Map + Anomaly-Detection + Segment-IQ + Attribution-IQ + Data Feeds + Data Warehouse) → **Gold**; Adobe Analytics Ultimate + Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) + cross-device-stitching + AI-Assistant + Adobe Mix Modeler → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `analytics` (report-suite + workspace project + workspace-table + workspace-visualization + dashboard); `data-pipeline` (data-feed export to data-warehouse + Customer-Journey-Analytics XDM ingestion); `data-warehouse` (raw click-stream + data-feed historical); `intelligence` (Anomaly-Detection + Segment-IQ + Attribution-IQ + AI-Assistant); `consent-and-privacy` (per-purpose tracking-consent gate per EU ePrivacy + IAB TCF); `apigw` (Adobe Launch / Tags / Adobe-Experience-Platform-Web-SDK / Mobile-SDK ingestion endpoints).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Adobe Analytics dimension/metric model):
  - `Report_Suite` (RSID, Site_Title, Time_Zone, Default_Currency, Default_Page_Name, Visit_Timeout, Visitor_ID_Method {Marketing-Cloud-Visitor-ID / Custom / IP+Browser}, Cookie_Domain_Period, Industry_Vertical, Custom_Insights_Variables_Enabled[]).
  - `Virtual_Report_Suite` (VRS_ID, Parent_RSID, Segment_Definition (which subset of parent traffic), Curated_Components[eVar / prop / event subset visible to consumers], Inherits_Settings: bool).
  - `eVar` (eVar_ID 1-250+, Name, Allocation {Most-Recent / Original-Value / Linear}, Expiration {Visit / Visitor / Custom-Days / Page-View / On-Event}, Type {Text-String / Counter / Currency / Numeric}, Persistence-Override-Allowed: bool).
  - `Prop` (Prop_ID 1-75, Name, Description, Used-For-Pathing: bool, List-Variable: bool, List-Delimiter, Type {Text-String}).
  - `Success_Event` (Event_ID 1-1000+, Name, Description, Type {Counter / Currency / Numeric / Counter-No-Subrelations}, Polarity {Always-Record / Once-per-Visit / Once-per-Visitor}).
  - `Dimension` (Standard or Custom — Page-Name / Page-URL / Site-Section / Referrer / Search-Engine / Search-Keyword / Browser / OS / Country / State / City / Marketing-Channel / Campaign / etc.) — note: eVar/prop are dimensions in Workspace.
  - `Metric` (Standard or Calculated — Visits / Visitors / Page-Views / Bounce-Rate / Average-Time-Spent / Revenue / Orders / Cart-Adds / Conversion-Rate / etc. + per-Calculated-Metric formula with segment).
  - `Calculated_Metric` (CM_ID, Name, Description, Formula (component algebra), Polarity, Owner, Shared-With, Tags[], Used-In-Workspace-Projects[]).
  - `Segment` (Segment_ID, Name, Description, Container_Hierarchy {Hit / Visit / Visitor + Sequential-Segments + Logic-Groups}, Predicate-Tree, Compatibility {Workspace / Reports-Analytics / Target / etc.}, Owner, Shared-With, Tags[], Used-In-Workspace-Projects[]).
  - `Workspace_Project` (Project_ID, Title, Owner, Panels[Panel-Type {Free-Form / Cohort / Fallout / Flow / Attribution-IQ / Segment-IQ / Anomaly / Map / etc.}], Visualizations[Type {Table / Line / Bar / Bullet / Donut / Histogram / Map / Map-of-USA / Scatter / Treemap / Venn / Word-Cloud / Text / KPI / etc.}], Filters, Date-Range, Shared-With, Last-Modified).
  - `Processing_Rule` (Rule_ID, Order, Condition (variable + operator + value), Action (set-variable / append / clear / overwrite + target), Engineer-Lock).
  - `VISTA_Rule` (Visitor Identification Server Architecture — legacy preprocessing) — per-rule server-side data-transformation before data hits report-suite.
  - `Data_Feed` (Feed_ID, Schedule, Report-Suite, Destination {FTP / SFTP / S3 / Azure-Blob / Email}, Format {TSV / CSV / Hit-Data-Tab-Delimited}, Columns[], Manifest-Format, Compression {Gzip}, Encryption-Settings).
  - `Data_Warehouse` (legacy DWH report — Request_ID, Schedule, Report-Suite, Dimensions[], Metrics[], Segments[], Date-Range, Granularity, Destination, Format).
  - `Anomaly_Detection_Config` (Metric, Dimensions, Sensitivity, Granularity, Date-Range, Algorithm {Holt-Winters / Bayesian / Forecast}, Threshold).
  - `Marketing_Channel_Processing_Rule` (Channel-Name, Order, Lookback-Window, Channel-Definition-Rule).
  - `Activity_Map_Config` (Per-RSID activity-map-color-overlay configuration + per-region click-heatmap).
  - `Adobe_Launch_Property` (Property-ID, Name, Domains[], Library-Builds[], Extensions[Adobe-Analytics / Target / etc.], Rules[Event + Condition + Action], Data-Elements[]).
  - `Adobe_Web_SDK_Configuration` (EdgeConfigID, Per-Tenant-Datastream, Per-Identity-Map, Per-XDM-Field-Group).
  - `Mobile_SDK_Configuration` (App_ID, Identifier, Lifecycle-Metric-Collection: bool, Crash-Reporting: bool, In-App-Messaging: bool, Performance-Tracking: bool).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Adobe Analytics 2.0 API: `https://analytics.adobe.io/api/{company-id}/{reports / segments / calculatedmetrics / projects / dimensions / metrics / users / etc.}` (OAuth + JWT).
  - Adobe Analytics 1.4 API (legacy, deprecated): SOAP / REST per-endpoint.
  - Data-Feed S3 / SFTP / FTP destination drop with manifest + lookup-files.
  - Data Warehouse Request API: per-request scheduled-export.
  - Adobe Launch / Tags REST API for property + extension + rule + data-element.
  - Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK + Mobile SDK for per-event ingestion to AEP Edge Network + Adobe Analytics.
  - Postback API for advertising platforms (Facebook / Google / TikTok) reach-and-frequency.
  - Cross-Tenant Migration utility (legacy report-suite to CJA bridge).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Analysis Workspace" — main authoring canvas + drag-drop dimensions / metrics / segments / date-ranges + multi-panel + free-form table + visualization grid + cohort + fallout + flow + attribution-IQ + segment-IQ.
  - "Reports & Analytics" (legacy) — pre-built reports tree per-dimension.
  - "Segment Builder" — drag-drop predicate tree with Hit / Visit / Visitor containers + sequential-segments + logic groups + compatibility-check.
  - "Calculated Metrics Builder" — drag-drop formula composer + polarity + segment-bound.
  - "Admin Console" — Report-Suite Settings + eVar / prop / event configuration + Processing-Rules + VISTA-Rules + Marketing-Channel-Rules + Virtual-Report-Suite config + User-Management + Product-Profile.
  - "Data-Feed Manager" — per-feed schedule + destination + columns + manifest.
  - "Data Warehouse Request" — per-request dimensions + metrics + segments + date-range + delivery.
  - "Activity Map" — per-page click-overlay with per-region color + count.
  - "Anomaly Detection" — per-Metric per-Dimension auto-flag + drill-down.
  - "Attribution IQ" — multi-touch attribution model selector (First-Touch / Last-Touch / Linear / U-Shaped / J-Shaped / Inverse-J / Time-Decay / Same-Touch / Custom + per-model report).
  - "Segment IQ" — per-Segment-A vs Segment-B comparative analysis with statistical significance.
  - "Mobile Service" — per-App lifecycle + crash + performance + in-app-messaging config (deprecated, migrated to AEP Web SDK / Mobile SDK).
  - "Adobe Launch UI" — Property + Extension + Rule + Data-Element drag-drop builder + Library-Build pipeline.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<digital-analyst-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"AaCreateSegment", Oyatie::Action::"AaCreateCalculatedMetric",
      Oyatie::Action::"AaCreateWorkspaceProject", Oyatie::Action::"AaShareProject",
      Oyatie::Action::"AaRunAnalysisWorkspace", Oyatie::Action::"AaRunAttributionIQ",
      Oyatie::Action::"AaRunSegmentIQ", Oyatie::Action::"AaRunAnomalyDetection",
      Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureDataFeed", Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureVirtualReportSuite",
      Oyatie::Action::"AaRunCohortAnalysis", Oyatie::Action::"AaRunContributionAnalysis",
      Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureProcessingRule", Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureMarketingChannelRule",
      Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureeVar", Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureProp",
      Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureSuccessEvent", Oyatie::Action::"AaRequestDataWarehouse",
      Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureAdobeLaunch", Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureWebSDK",
      Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureMobileSDK", Oyatie::Action::"AaExportRawData"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::ReportSuite::"<rsid>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    digital_analytics_role_grants(principal, action, resource.rsid) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AaShareProject" ? recipient_in_governed_audience(context.recipients) && project_does_not_leak_pii(resource.project) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureProcessingRule" ? principal.has_role("Analytics-Engineer") && rule_change_simulation_complete(context.rule) && rule_order_pinned(context.rule) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureeVar" ? principal.has_role("Analytics-Engineer") && eVar_semantics_documented(context.eVar) && eVar_allocation_explicit(context.eVar) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureSuccessEvent" ? principal.has_role("Analytics-Engineer") && event_polarity_explicit(context.event) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureDataFeed" ? destination_dpa_signed(context.destination) && encryption_settings_meet_floor(context.destination) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AaRequestDataWarehouse" ? dwh_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && pii_scrubbed_per_export_policy(context.dimensions) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AaExportRawData" ? dual_admin_approval(context) && audit_logged(context.export) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureAdobeLaunch" ? principal.has_role("Tag-Engineer") && launch_property_passes_lint(context.property) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AaConfigureWebSDK" ? consent_gating_configured(context.edge_config) && xdm_schema_governed(context.edge_config) : true) &&
    (resource.rsid.has_eu_traffic ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && context.pack.contains("EU-ePrivacy") && cookie_consent_gating_enforced(resource.rsid) : true) &&
    (resource.rsid.has_kr_traffic ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") && consent_explicit_for_marketing(resource.rsid) : true) &&
    (resource.rsid.has_cn_traffic ? context.pack.contains("CN-PIPL") && data_pinned_to_cn_region(resource.rsid) : true) &&
    (resource.rsid.has_us_minor_traffic ? context.pack.contains("COPPA") && parental_consent_present(resource.rsid) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Report_Suite` → `Oyatie::Analytics::report_suite` (with time-zone + currency + visit-timeout + visitor-ID-method + cookie-domain-period).
  - `Virtual_Report_Suite` → `Oyatie::Analytics::virtual_report_suite` (with parent-RSID + segment-definition + curated-components + inherit-settings).
  - `eVar` → `Oyatie::Analytics::evar` (with allocation + expiration + type + persistence-override-allowed).
  - `Prop` → `Oyatie::Analytics::prop` (with description + pathing-enabled + list-variable + list-delimiter).
  - `Success_Event` → `Oyatie::Analytics::success_event` (with type + polarity).
  - `Dimension` + `Metric` → `Oyatie::Analytics::dimension` + `Oyatie::Analytics::metric`.
  - `Calculated_Metric` → `Oyatie::Analytics::calculated_metric` (with formula + polarity + owner + shared-with + tags).
  - `Segment` → `Oyatie::Analytics::segment` (with container-hierarchy + predicate-tree + compatibility + sequential-segments).
  - `Workspace_Project` → `Oyatie::Analytics::workspace_project` (with panels + visualizations + filters + date-range + shared-with).
  - `Processing_Rule` + `VISTA_Rule` → `Oyatie::Analytics::processing_rule` (with order + condition + action + engineer-lock).
  - `Data_Feed` → `Oyatie::DataPipeline::data_feed` (with schedule + destination + columns + manifest + format + compression + encryption).
  - `Data_Warehouse` → `Oyatie::DataWarehouse::dwh_request` (with dimensions + metrics + segments + granularity + destination).
  - `Anomaly_Detection_Config` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::anomaly_config` (with metric + dimensions + sensitivity + algorithm + threshold).
  - `Marketing_Channel_Processing_Rule` → `Oyatie::Analytics::marketing_channel_rule` (with order + lookback-window + definition-rule).
  - `Adobe_Launch_Property` → `Oyatie::Analytics::tag_property` (with domains + library-builds + extensions + rules + data-elements).
  - `Adobe_Web_SDK_Configuration` + `Mobile_SDK_Configuration` → `Oyatie::Analytics::edge_sdk_config` + `Oyatie::Analytics::mobile_sdk_config` (with EdgeConfigID + datastream + identity-map + XDM-field-group; per-App lifecycle + crash + performance).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Adobe Analytics displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant Report-Suite count + Virtual-Report-Suite count + per-RSID eVar/prop/event allocation (typically 200-1000+ used variables) + per-Segment count (often 1K-50K) + per-Calculated-Metric count + per-Workspace-Project count + per-Processing-Rule + per-VISTA-Rule + per-Marketing-Channel-Rule + per-Data-Feed config + per-DWH-Request + per-Anomaly-Detection-Config + per-Adobe-Launch property + per-Web-SDK config + per-Mobile-SDK config + per-data-retention policy (per-RSID typically 25-100 months raw + summarized longer).
  2. **Report-Suite + Virtual-Report-Suite extraction**: per-RSID settings + per-VRS segment-definition + curated-components + inheritance.
  3. **eVar / prop / event extraction**: per-eVar allocation + expiration + type; per-prop list-variable + delimiter; per-event polarity; preserve per-variable semantic documentation.
  4. **Dimension / Metric / Calculated-Metric extraction**: per-Standard + per-Custom + per-Calculated formula + polarity + owner + shared-with + tags + used-in dependencies.
  5. **Segment extraction**: per-Segment container-hierarchy + predicate-tree + compatibility + sequential-segments + used-in dependencies.
  6. **Workspace-Project extraction**: per-Project panels + visualizations + filters + date-range + shared-with + last-modified; preserve per-Project saved state including data-as-of timestamps where applicable.
  7. **Processing-Rule + VISTA-Rule + Marketing-Channel-Rule extraction**: per-Rule order + condition + action + engineer-lock; preserve explicit rule-order for replay.
  8. **Data-Feed + Data-Warehouse extraction**: per-Feed schedule + destination + columns + manifest + compression + encryption; per-DWH-Request scheduled-export config.
  9. **Anomaly-Detection-Config extraction**: per-Config metric + dimensions + sensitivity + algorithm + threshold; preserve labeled-anomaly history.
  10. **Adobe Launch / Tags extraction**: per-Property domains + library-builds + extensions + rules + data-elements; preserve library-build pipeline state.
  11. **Web-SDK / Mobile-SDK config extraction**: per-Edge-Config datastream + identity-map + XDM-field-group; per-App lifecycle + crash + performance.
  12. **Per-cookie + per-consent gating extraction**: per-RSID + per-purpose tracking-consent gate config (IAB TCF + per-jurisdiction overrides).
  13. **Historical raw-data extraction**: per-RSID Data-Feed bulk-export to data-warehouse with manifest + lookup-files; preserve retention per regulatory mandate (typically 25-100 months raw).
  14. **Per-RSID + Virtual-RSID nested-permission mapping**: per-RSID Cedar scope with computed effective-permission for VRS-derived access.
  15. **eVar-persistence semantics transform**: per-eVar allocation + expiration → Oyatie analytics-dimension lifecycle with semantics-pin + transform manifest.
  16. **Processing-rule order-replay**: per-Rule re-applied at import-time in same explicit-order; per-rule change-impact simulation.
  17. **Per-Data-Feed schema-version-pin**: per-Feed schema preserved with version-pin + transform on import to Oyatie DataPipeline.
  18. **Per-cookie-consent pre-event suppression**: per-purpose pre-consent suppression enforced at ingestion + per-jurisdiction default-deny until consent.
  19. **Adobe Launch / Tags → Oyatie tag-mgr rebuild**: per-Property re-implemented as Oyatie tag-property + per-extension equivalent + per-rule re-bound; per-library-build CI pipeline.
  20. **Per-Web-SDK / Mobile-SDK datastream redirect**: per-Edge-Config redirect to Oyatie edge with dual-fire window (8-12 weeks).
  21. **Per-CJA bridge migration**: per-RSID → CJA-Connection (XDM-based) → Oyatie data-warehouse with XDM schema preserved.
  22. **Parallel run**: 30-90 day shadow with sample RSID + per-Segment-IQ result-parity 100% + per-Calculated-Metric formula-parity 100% + per-Anomaly-Detection flag-parity ≥ 95% + per-Attribution-IQ model-parity 100% + per-Workspace-Project visual-parity (table values 100%) + per-Data-Feed manifest-parity 100%.
  23. **Cutover**: per-RSID staged with dual-fire window (Adobe + Oyatie ingestion concurrent for 12-24 weeks); per-Adobe-Launch / Tags rebuilt + library-build CI re-deployed; per-Web-SDK / Mobile-SDK datastream re-pointed; per-Data-Feed destination re-pointed; per-Workspace-Project URL-redirect (6-12 months).
  24. **Sunset**: Adobe Analytics license sunset; per-tenant raw-data retention per regulatory mandate (typically 25-100 months for raw click-stream, longer for audited / regulated industries).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **eVar-persistence semantics divergence** (eVar 5 with Visit-allocation vs Oyatie dimension lifetime differs): per-eVar semantics-pin + transform manifest + golden-test on historical data.
  - **Processing-rule order-of-execution drift** (Rule-A then Rule-B vs Rule-B then Rule-A produce different results): per-rule explicit-order + replay at import + per-rule change-impact simulation + audit.
  - **Data-feed schema-version drift** (Adobe added columns mid-month, schema-mismatch breaks import): per-feed schema-pin + transform + per-version backward-compat parser.
  - **Cookie-consent gating gap** (tracking event fired before consent obtained): per-purpose pre-consent suppression + per-jurisdiction default-deny + per-event audit + IAB TCF signal-respect.
  - **Per-RSID + Virtual-RSID nested-permission ambiguity** (user has VRS-A permission, parent RSID is hidden — but VRS-A inherits some parent settings): per-RSID Cedar scope with computed effective-permission + audit + UI explainability.
  - **Marketing-Channel-Rule lookback-window drift** (campaign attribution differs after re-process): per-rule lookback-window-pin + replay-determinism test.
  - **Calculated-Metric formula reference cycle** (Calculated-A references Calculated-B references Calculated-A): per-CM dependency-graph + cycle detection at save-time.
  - **Segment compatibility drift** (Segment built for Workspace breaks in legacy Reports-Analytics): per-segment compatibility-test + fallback definition.
  - **Sequential-segment performance cliff** (deeply nested sequential-segment exhausts query budget): per-segment depth-cap + cost-budget + alert.
  - **Activity-Map per-region click-overlay drift after design change** (page-layout changed, click coordinates misaligned): per-page coordinate-pin + design-change detection + manual re-align.
  - **Anomaly-Detection false-positive storm** (over-sensitive config alerts hundreds of false-anomalies): per-config sensitivity calibration + suppression-window + alert-fatigue mitigation.
  - **Adobe-Launch rule-extension dependency-break** (extension upgrade breaks rule): per-extension version-pin + per-library-build CI test + rollback.
  - **Web-SDK datastream identity-map collision** (two visitors merged due to identity-map mis-config): per-identity-map test-set + cross-device-stitching audit.
  - **DWH export PII leak** (export includes IP / device-ID without scrub): per-export PII-scrub + dual-admin approval + audit.
  - **VRS curation drift** (parent RSID adds new eVar; VRS curation auto-includes it without re-curation): per-VRS curation-pin + change-approval.
  - **Mobile SDK lifecycle event over-fire on app-cold-start** (lifecycle event fires multiple times): per-SDK lifecycle-state-machine + dedup + audit.
  - **Workspace-Project share-leak** (project shared with user-group that includes external contractor): per-share recipient-audit + scope-check.
  - **Data-feed historical-correction race** (Adobe retroactively corrects past-day data; Oyatie copy stale): per-feed manifest-recheck + delta-import.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Adobe Analytics 2.0 API (segments + calculated-metrics + projects + dimensions + metrics + users) + Data-Feed S3/SFTP/FTP destination + Data Warehouse Request API + Adobe Launch / Tags REST + Web-SDK Edge config + Mobile-SDK config + Marketing-Channel-Rule export + Processing-Rule + VISTA-Rule export + per-RSID + per-VRS config export; format — JSON + TSV / CSV (data-feed) + manifest files + lookup files; duration — ~3-9 months per enterprise tenant due to RSID count + historical raw-data volume + dependency-graph complexity; volume — typically 5-50 RSIDs + 10-100 VRSs + 1K-50K segments + 500-10K calculated-metrics + 5K-100K workspace-projects + 100M-1T+ historical hits per RSID.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-RSID + VRS preserved with settings + curation; per-eVar / prop / event preserved with allocation + expiration + polarity + semantic documentation; per-Calculated-Metric formula preserved with dependency-graph; per-Segment container-hierarchy + predicate-tree preserved with compatibility; per-Workspace-Project panels + visualizations + filters preserved; per-Processing-Rule + VISTA + Marketing-Channel order + condition + action preserved with explicit-order pin; per-Data-Feed schedule + destination + columns + manifest preserved with schema-version pin; per-Anomaly-Detection-Config preserved with retraining + parity test; per-Adobe-Launch property + extension + rule + data-element preserved with library-build pipeline; per-Web-SDK / Mobile-SDK datastream + identity-map + XDM-field-group preserved; per-cookie + per-consent gate preserved with per-jurisdiction enforcement; lossy — Adobe-Sensei AI-Assistant specifics rebuilt; some advanced sequential-segment patterns rebuilt; CJA cross-device-stitching ML retrained with parity test.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-RSID staged with dual-fire window 12-24 weeks; per-Adobe-Launch rebuilt with library-build CI re-deployed; per-Web-SDK / Mobile-SDK datastream re-pointed; per-Data-Feed destination re-pointed; per-Workspace-Project URL-redirect 6-12 months; per-Marketing-Channel-Rule lookback-window pinned for replay determinism; per-Processing-Rule order pinned for replay determinism; per-CJA bridge migration with XDM schema preserved.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 30-90 days with per-Segment-IQ result-parity 100% + per-Calculated-Metric formula-parity 100% + per-Anomaly-Detection flag-parity ≥ 95% + per-Attribution-IQ model-parity 100% + per-Workspace-Project visual-parity (table values 100%) + per-Data-Feed manifest-parity 100% + per-Adobe-Launch library-build deploy-parity 100% + per-DWH request-output parity 100%; sunset — Adobe Analytics license sunset; per-tenant raw-data retention per regulatory mandate (typically 25-100 months raw + longer summarized).

- Workflow template library: `digital_analytics.workspace-project-publish-with-share-audit` (recipient-audit + PII-scrub); `digital_analytics.data-feed-to-warehouse-orchestrate` (schema-pin + manifest-recheck + delta-import); `digital_analytics.segment-share-with-target` (compatibility-check + dependency-resolve); `digital_analytics.attribution-iq-multi-touch` (per-model lookback-window-pin); `digital_analytics.anomaly-detect-with-alert` (sensitivity-calibration + suppression-window); `digital_analytics.processing-rule-replay-determinism` (explicit-order + change-simulation); `digital_analytics.cookie-consent-gate-per-purpose` (IAB TCF + per-jurisdiction default-deny); `digital_analytics.cja-bridge-with-xdm-schema-preservation`; `digital_analytics.adobe-launch-library-build-CI` (per-extension version-pin + rollback); `digital_analytics.web-sdk-datastream-with-identity-map-audit`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (digital-analyst + product-analyst + marketer + analytics-engineer + tag-engineer); desktop-primary Analysis Workspace with drag-drop panel + project-share + segment-builder + calculated-metric-builder; mobile read-only dashboard; per-project share-with-role with audit; per-RSID admin console.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + UK-GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + CPRA + EU ePrivacy (cookie-consent gate on per-purpose tracking) + IAB TCF + CN PIPL (per-CN traffic data-residency) + COPPA (per-minor traffic parental-consent); HIPAA when traffic includes patient-portal interactions; per-RSID data-residency.
- Naming justification: `analytics` + `data-pipeline` + `data-warehouse` + `intelligence` are canonical; `adobe-analytics`, `omniture`, `sitecatalyst`, `customer-journey-analytics`, `cja`, `adobe-mobile-services`, `adobe-launch`, `adobe-tags`, `adobe-experience-platform-web-sdk` are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-057 - Adobe Real-Time CDP
- Vendor name and category: Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RT-CDP) built on Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) / Adobe Experience Cloud / unified-customer-profile + identity-resolution + edge-decisioning + segmentation (batch + streaming + edge) + activation + consent-and-privacy + B2B-CDP-edition (Account + Opportunity + Marketing-List XDM extension) — XDM (Experience Data Model) is the canonical schema framework.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across multiple Oyatie µservices). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: RT-CDP Foundation (B2C only, batch segmentation, basic activation) → **Bronze**; RT-CDP Prime (Foundation + streaming-segmentation + edge-segmentation + IAB-TCF consent + Customer-AI) → **Silver**; RT-CDP Ultimate (Prime + B2B-CDP + Account-IQ + Lookalike-Audiences + Privacy-Service + Federated-Audience-Composition) → **Gold**; RT-CDP Ultimate + Mix Modeler + Content-Analytics + AI-Assistant + cross-tenant Data-Collaboration → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `data-pipeline` (source-ingest via Streaming + Batch connectors + per-XDM-schema mapping); `data-warehouse` (unified profile-store + per-Profile Identity-Map + Behavior-Store); `intelligence` (identity-resolution + segment-IQ + Customer-AI + Attribution-AI + Lookalike + Account-IQ); `marketing-automation` (activation to email + SMS + push + ad-platforms + CRM); `consent-and-privacy` (per-purpose consent ledger + IAB-TCF + Privacy-Service GDPR-Article-15-17 fulfillment); `apigw` (Edge-Network endpoint for real-time decisioning).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (AEP XDM-based):
  - `XDM_Schema` (Schema_ID, Title, Description, Class {XDM-IndividualProfile / XDM-ExperienceEvent / XDM-Business-Profile / XDM-Business-Account / XDM-Business-Opportunity / Custom}, Field-Groups[Field-Group-Reference], Identity-Descriptors[Identity-Field + Namespace + Primary], Relationship-Descriptors[Source-Field → Target-Schema + Cardinality]).
  - `XDM_Field_Group` (Group_ID, Title, Field-Schema[Field-Name + Field-Type + Multi-Cardinality + Required + Description + Tags]).
  - `XDM_Class` (Class_ID, Behavior-Type {Record / Time-Series}, Field-Groups-Required[], Field-Groups-Optional[]).
  - `Dataset` (Dataset_ID, Name, Schema-Reference, Source-Connection, Sample-Profile-Path, Enabled-for-Profile: bool, Enabled-for-Identity-Graph: bool).
  - `Source_Connection` (Connection_ID, Source-Type {Streaming-HTTP / Web-SDK / Mobile-SDK / Server-API / Cloud-Storage-S3 / Azure-Blob / Google-Cloud-Storage / Salesforce / Marketo / SAP-Hana / Snowflake / Databricks / Google-BigQuery / Adobe-Analytics / Adobe-Audience-Manager / Custom-API}, Authentication, Schedule, Mapping-Rule, Pause / Resume, Last-Sync-Status).
  - `Individual_Profile` (Profile_ID, Identity-Map{Namespace → [IdentityValues + Primary + Authenticated-State {Authenticated / Ambiguous / Logged-Out / Unknown}]}, Profile-Attributes{XDM-IndividualProfile fields}, Last-Modified-DateTime, Segment-Memberships[]).
  - `Experience_Event` (Event_ID, Profile-Reference, Event-Type, Timestamp, Identity-Map, Payload{XDM-ExperienceEvent fields}, Source-Dataset-Reference).
  - `Identity_Graph_Node_Edge` (Identity-Value, Namespace, Linked-To-Identity-Values[], Confidence-Score, Last-Updated, Merge-Policy {Active / Stitched / Deleted}).
  - `Merge_Policy` (Policy_ID, Identity-Graph-Reference, Schema-Class, Attribute-Merge-Rule {Latest-Value / First-Value / Specific-Dataset-Wins}, Identity-Stitching {Private-Graph / Default}).
  - `Segment_Definition` (Segment_ID, Name, Description, PQL-Query (Profile-Query-Language: SELECT FROM ... WHERE ... TIMEFRAME ...), Evaluation-Method {Batch / Streaming / Edge}, Merge-Policy-Reference, Profile-Class, Activation-Status, Tags[], Owner).
  - `Audience` (Audience_ID, Source {RT-CDP-Native / External-Imported / Federated-Audience-Composition / Custom-Upload}, Segment-Definition-Reference, Profile-Count, Origin).
  - `Destination` (Destination_ID, Name, Category {Email-Marketing / Advertising-Cloud / Storage / Customer-Success / Live-Chat / Personalization / Survey / Tag-Manager / Custom-API / Streaming / Edge}, Connector-Type {Adobe-Campaign / Adobe-Target / Salesforce / Facebook-Custom-Audience / Google-DV360 / TikTok-Ads / The-Trade-Desk / Snowflake / Amazon-S3 / Email-Marketing-Native / etc.}, Authentication, Mapping-Rule, Identity-Namespace-Requirements, Activation-Schedule {Streaming / Batch-Daily / Batch-Hourly}, Suppression-List-Configuration).
  - `Activation_Mapping` (Mapping_ID, Source-Field (XDM) → Target-Field (Destination) + Transformation).
  - `Purpose` (Purpose_ID, Name, Description, Lawful-Basis {Consent / Contract / Legal-Obligation / Vital-Interest / Public-Task / Legitimate-Interest}, Used-For-Activation-Categories[]).
  - `Consent_Record` (Profile-Reference, Purpose-Reference, Decision {Granted / Denied / Withdrawn / Pending}, Captured-DateTime, Source {IAB-TCF / OneTrust / Custom-Form / Imported}, Jurisdiction).
  - `Consent_Policy` (Policy_ID, Conditions {Purpose-Combinations + Jurisdiction + Authenticated-State}, Action {Allow / Deny / Allow-Partial}).
  - `Data_Usage_Label` (Label_ID, Label-Code (C1-C9, S1-S2, I1-I2, etc.), Description, Restrictions[Restricted-Destinations + Restricted-Purposes + Restricted-Identity-Namespaces]).
  - `Data_Hygiene` (Per-Dataset retention-policy + delete-request fulfillment + identity-delete fulfillment).
  - `Customer_AI_Model` (Model_ID, Type {Propensity-to-Convert / Churn-Risk / Likelihood-to-Engage / Custom}, Training-Dataset, Confidence-Threshold, Last-Refresh).
  - `Attribution_AI_Model` (Model_ID, Multi-Touch + Algorithmic + Time-Decay + Custom + Per-Touchpoint-Influence).
  - `Edge_Decisioning_Configuration` (Edge_ID, Datastream-Reference, Per-Region edge-config + per-decision strategy + per-fallback offer).
  - `Federated_Audience_Composition` (Composition_ID, Federated-Source {Snowflake / Databricks / BigQuery} — no profile data moved, query federates on demand).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Adobe Experience Platform API: `https://platform.adobe.io/data/foundation/{schemas | datasets | segmentation/segments | segmentation/jobs | profile/entities | identity/identities | flowservice/flows | destinations/dataflows | consent/policies | privacy/jobs | etc.}` (OAuth + JWT + IMS).
  - Profile API: `https://platform.adobe.io/data/core/ups/access/entities?entityId=<id>&entityIdNS=<ns>`.
  - Identity Service API: per-namespace identity-cluster + identity-graph lookup.
  - Segmentation API: per-Segment definition + job + scheduling + streaming-rule.
  - Edge Network: `https://edge.adobedc.net/ee/v2/...` for real-time event-collection + decisioning + audience-qualification.
  - Data Collection / Edge Server-side configuration: per-Datastream identity-map + XDM-field-group + per-destination-routing.
  - Privacy Service API: per-DSR (Data Subject Request) for GDPR Art. 15 (access) + Art. 17 (deletion) + per-CCPA opt-out.
  - Query Service: ANSI-SQL over data-lake datasets.
  - Data Distiller (license-tier): derive-attribute + computed-attribute via batch SQL.

  - "Data Hygiene" — per-Dataset retention + delete-request status + identity-delete fulfillment.
