- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<cdp-architect-or-marketer-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpIngestSource", Oyatie::Action::"CdpConfigureSchema",
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpEnableDatasetForProfile", Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunIdentityResolution",
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpConfigureMergePolicy", Oyatie::Action::"CdpDefineSegment",
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpQualifyProfile", Oyatie::Action::"CdpActivateToDestination",
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpSuppressFromDestination", Oyatie::Action::"CdpConfigurePurpose",
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunConsentPolicy", Oyatie::Action::"CdpConfigureDataGovernanceLabel",
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunDataPrep", Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunStreamingSegmentation",
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpConfigureDestination", Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunPrivacyDSR",
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunSqlQuery", Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunCustomerAI",
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunAttributionAI", Oyatie::Action::"CdpConfigureEdgeDecisioning",
      Oyatie::Action::"CdpComposeFederatedAudience", Oyatie::Action::"CdpExportProfileData"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::CdpEntity::"<id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    consent.scope_includes(context.purpose) &&
    cdp_role_grants(principal, action, resource.scope) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CdpActivateToDestination" ? destination_authorized_for_audience(resource.audience, context.destination) && data_usage_label_compatible(resource.audience, context.destination) && suppression_list_applied(context.destination) && all_consent_records_resolved(resource.audience) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CdpConfigureMergePolicy" ? principal.has_role("CDP-Architect") && policy_change_impact_simulated(context.merge_policy) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunIdentityResolution" ? identity_namespace_authorized(context.namespaces) && confidence_threshold_set(context.config) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunPrivacyDSR" ? dsr_authenticated_or_verified(context.requestor) && per_jurisdiction_sla_respected(context.jurisdiction) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CdpExportProfileData" ? data_export_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && dual_admin_approval(context) && pii_scrubbed_per_export_policy(context.fields) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CdpRunSqlQuery" ? query_does_not_violate_data_governance(context.query, context.user_labels) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CdpConfigureEdgeDecisioning" ? edge_decision_latency_budget_respected(context.config) && fallback_offer_present(context.config) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CdpComposeFederatedAudience" ? federated_source_dpa_signed(context.source) && data_not_moved_outside_source(context.source) : true) &&
    (resource.profile.jurisdiction == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && lawful_basis_for_processing(resource.profile, context.purpose) && consent_record_present_if_required(resource.profile) : true) &&
    (resource.profile.jurisdiction == "US-CA" ? context.pack.contains("CCPA") && opt_out_status_respected(resource.profile) : true) &&
    (resource.profile.jurisdiction == "KR" ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") : true) &&
    (resource.profile.jurisdiction == "BR" ? context.pack.contains("LGPD") : true) &&
    (resource.profile.contains_phi ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && phi_safeguard(resource.profile) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `XDM_Schema` + `XDM_Field_Group` + `XDM_Class` → `Oyatie::DataPipeline::xdm_schema` + `Oyatie::DataPipeline::xdm_field_group` (preserve schema-class + identity-descriptors + relationship-descriptors).
  - `Dataset` → `Oyatie::DataWarehouse::dataset` (with schema + source-connection + enabled-for-profile + enabled-for-identity-graph).
  - `Source_Connection` → `Oyatie::DataPipeline::source_connection` (with source-type + auth + schedule + mapping-rule + last-sync).
  - `Individual_Profile` → `Oyatie::DataWarehouse::profile` (with identity-map + attributes + segment-memberships + consent-records).
  - `Experience_Event` → `Oyatie::DataWarehouse::event` (with event-type + timestamp + identity-map + payload + source-dataset).
  - `Identity_Graph_Node_Edge` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::identity_node` + `Oyatie::Intelligence::identity_edge` (with namespace + linked-identities + confidence + last-updated).
  - `Merge_Policy` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::merge_policy` (with attribute-merge-rule + identity-stitching).
  - `Segment_Definition` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::segment` (with PQL-query + evaluation-method + merge-policy + class + activation-status).
  - `Audience` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::audience` (with source + segment + profile-count + origin).
  - `Destination` + `Activation_Mapping` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::destination` + `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::activation_mapping` (with connector + auth + mapping + activation-schedule + suppression-config).
  - `Purpose` + `Consent_Record` + `Consent_Policy` → `Oyatie::ConsentAndPrivacy::purpose` + `Oyatie::ConsentAndPrivacy::consent_record` + `Oyatie::ConsentAndPrivacy::consent_policy` (with lawful-basis + decision + jurisdiction).
  - `Data_Usage_Label` → `Oyatie::DataPipeline::data_usage_label` (with restrictions).
  - `Data_Hygiene` → `Oyatie::DataPipeline::retention_policy` + `Oyatie::ConsentAndPrivacy::deletion_fulfillment`.
  - `Customer_AI_Model` + `Attribution_AI_Model` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::customer_ai_model` + `Oyatie::Intelligence::attribution_ai_model` (with training-dataset + threshold + last-refresh).
  - `Edge_Decisioning_Configuration` → `Oyatie::ApiGw::edge_decision_config` (with datastream + region + strategy + fallback).
  - `Federated_Audience_Composition` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::federated_audience` (with federated-source — no profile data moved).

- **Specific workflow steps** (RT-CDP displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant XDM schema count + field-group count + dataset count + source-connection count + identity-namespace count + identity-graph node-count + merge-policy count + segment-definition count + audience count + destination count + purpose count + consent-record count + data-usage-label count + DSR backlog + Customer-AI / Attribution-AI model count + edge-decisioning config count + federated-audience-composition count.
  2. **XDM schema + field-group + class extraction**: per-Schema preserved with field-groups + identity-descriptors + relationship-descriptors; per-class behavior-type preserved.
  3. **Dataset + source-connection extraction**: per-Dataset schema + enabled flags + sample profile; per-Source authentication + schedule + mapping-rule + last-sync.
  4. **Individual-Profile extraction**: per-Profile identity-map + attributes + last-modified + segment-memberships; per-Profile event-history per retention policy.
  5. **Experience-Event extraction**: per-Event type + timestamp + identity-map + payload + source-dataset.
  6. **Identity-graph + merge-policy extraction**: per-Identity-Node namespace + linked-identities + confidence + last-updated; per-Merge-Policy attribute-merge-rule + identity-stitching.
  7. **Segment-Definition extraction**: per-Segment PQL-query + evaluation-method + merge-policy + class + activation-status + tags.
  8. **Audience + Destination + Activation-Mapping extraction**: per-Audience source + profile-count; per-Destination connector + auth + mapping + activation-schedule + suppression-config.
  9. **Purpose + Consent-Record + Consent-Policy extraction**: per-Purpose lawful-basis + activation-categories; per-Consent-Record profile + purpose + decision + jurisdiction; per-Policy condition + action.
  10. **Data-Usage-Label extraction**: per-Label code + description + restrictions; per-field-label mapping.
  11. **Customer-AI + Attribution-AI model extraction**: per-Model type + training-dataset + threshold + last-refresh; re-trained on Oyatie intelligence with parity test.
  12. **Edge-Decisioning extraction**: per-Edge datastream + region + strategy + fallback; preserve latency-budget.
  13. **Federated-Audience-Composition extraction**: per-Composition federated-source + query-definition; preserve no-data-move semantic.
  14. **Per-PQL-to-Oyatie segment-language transform**: per-Segment PQL re-translated to Oyatie segment-language with golden-test on historical qualifications.
  15. **Per-identity-graph migration**: per-Node + Edge + confidence preserved; per-Merge-Policy re-applied; per-namespace-confidence threshold-pin.
  16. **Per-consent-policy re-evaluation**: per-Policy migrated to Oyatie ConsentAndPrivacy + per-jurisdiction default-deny + per-purpose scope-pin.
  17. **Per-destination connection-secret migration**: per-Destination OAuth / API-key re-bound + per-suppression-list re-populated + per-activation-schedule preserved.
  18. **Per-DSR backlog continuity**: per-pending DSR (GDPR Art. 15 / Art. 17 / CCPA opt-out) completed before cut-over.
  19. **Parallel run**: 30-90 day shadow with sample dataset + per-Profile identity-resolution-parity ≥ 99% + per-Segment qualification-parity 100% + per-Activation send-parity 100% + per-Consent-Policy evaluation-parity 100% + per-Customer-AI score-parity ± 5% + per-Edge-Decisioning latency-parity ≤ vendor + per-Federated-Audience composition-parity 100%.
  20. **Cutover**: per-Source-Connection staged with dual-fire window 8-16 weeks; per-Identity-Graph dual-graph window; per-Destination dual-activation window; per-Edge-Decisioning datastream re-pointed; per-DSR queue continuity; per-Federated-Audience source-binding migrated.
  21. **Sunset**: RT-CDP / AEP license sunset; per-tenant profile retention per regulatory mandate + per-purpose; per-DSR fulfillment SLA preserved.

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Identity-graph false-merge** (two distinct customers merged via shared email or shared device): per-merge confidence-score + manual-split UI + merge-audit + per-namespace confidence-threshold tunable.
  - **Consent-policy-evaluation race** (consent revoked but in-flight activation already fired): per-activation idempotent consent-check + retract-action + audit + suppression-list update.
  - **Per-purpose-scope leak** (consent for "marketing" used for "analytics"): per-purpose scope enforced at every profile read + per-purpose audit + visualization.
  - **Streaming-segmentation latency-spike under burst** (sudden 100x event burst from web traffic): per-source burst-throttle + priority-queue + dead-letter + back-pressure.
  - **Destination-activation suppression-list desync** (user opt-out at destination, RT-CDP still sends): per-destination suppression-list TTL + refresh + bidirectional sync.
  - **Edge-Decisioning fallback-offer absence** (when real-time decision fails, no offer served): per-config fallback-offer mandatory + per-region cached-offer.
  - **Federated-Audience query result-staleness** (federated source data stale at composition time): per-composition source-freshness-check + alert.
  - **XDM schema-evolution break** (field added to schema, existing segments break): per-schema-change impact-simulation + per-segment dependency-graph + governance gate.
  - **Data-Usage-Label restriction-leak** (label C2 forbids destination X, activation slipped through): per-activation label-check + audit + block on violation.
  - **DSR fulfillment SLA breach** (GDPR Art. 15 30-day deadline missed): per-DSR queue priority + automated-fulfillment + alert ≥7 days pre-deadline.
  - **Profile-export PII leak** (export includes attributes labeled S1/S2 sensitive): per-export label-aware-scrub + dual-admin + audit.
  - **Merge-Policy attribute-merge race** (Latest-Value vs First-Value race on near-simultaneous writes): per-policy explicit-tiebreaker + audit.
  - **Customer-AI model staleness** (model trained on data from 6 months ago): per-model retrain cadence + freshness-floor + alert.
  - **Attribution-AI multi-touch model conflict** (two models give different attribution): per-model explicit-selection + comparison UI + audit.
  - **IAB-TCF signal-mismatch** (TCF string says "yes", per-purpose record says "no"): per-signal reconcile + max-restrictive-wins + audit.
  - **Federated-Audience-Composition data-leakage** (federated query accidentally exfiltrates rows beyond audience size): per-query result-size-cap + audit + DPA-check.
  - **Identity-namespace-confusion** (CRMID and ECID mistakenly cross-linked): per-namespace explicit-config + cross-namespace permission + audit.
  - **PQL query performance cliff** (deeply nested PQL exhausts compute budget): per-query cost-budget + alert + auto-optimize.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — AEP API (schemas + datasets + sources + segmentation + profile + identity + flowservice + destinations + consent + privacy + queries + sandboxes) + Profile API + Identity Service API + Edge Network + Privacy Service API + Query Service + Data Distiller + per-XDM-schema export with field-group inheritance + per-Source connector config + per-Destination connector config; format — JSON + Parquet (data-lake) + XDM-JSON-schema; duration — ~4-12 months per enterprise tenant due to XDM schema depth + profile volume + identity-graph complexity + consent-record retention; volume — typically 10M-1B individual-profiles + 10B-1T+ experience-events + 1K-100K identity-graph edges per profile + 100-5000 segments + 50-500 destinations + per-DSR backlog.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-XDM-Schema preserved with field-groups + identity-descriptors + relationship-descriptors; per-Dataset preserved with enabled-flags; per-Source-Connection re-bound with auth + schedule + mapping-rule; per-Profile preserved with identity-map + attributes + segment-memberships + consent-records; per-Identity-Graph preserved with merge-policy + confidence; per-Segment PQL translated to Oyatie segment-language with golden-test; per-Audience + Destination + Activation-Mapping preserved with connector + auth + mapping + activation-schedule; per-Purpose + Consent-Record + Consent-Policy preserved with lawful-basis + decision + jurisdiction; per-Data-Usage-Label preserved with restrictions; per-Customer-AI / Attribution-AI retrained with parity test; per-Edge-Decisioning preserved with latency-budget + fallback; per-Federated-Audience preserved with no-data-move semantic; lossy — Adobe-Sensei AI specifics rebuilt; some Mix Modeler + Content Analytics specifics rebuilt with parity test.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-Source-Connection staged with dual-fire window 8-16 weeks; per-Identity-Graph dual-graph window with confidence threshold-pin; per-Destination dual-activation window with suppression bidirectional sync; per-Edge-Decisioning datastream re-pointed with latency budget; per-DSR queue continuity; per-Federated-Audience source-binding migrated; per-Consent-Policy + IAB-TCF reconcile; per-Data-Usage-Label restrictions preserved.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 30-90 days with per-Profile identity-resolution-parity ≥ 99% + per-Segment qualification-parity 100% + per-Activation send-parity 100% + per-Consent-Policy evaluation-parity 100% + per-Customer-AI score-parity ± 5% + per-Edge-Decisioning latency-parity ≤ vendor + per-Federated-Audience composition-parity 100% + per-DSR fulfillment SLA-parity 100% + per-Data-Usage-Label enforcement-parity 100%; sunset — RT-CDP / AEP license sunset.

- Workflow template library: `cdp.source-ingest-with-XDM-mapping-and-governance-check`; `cdp.identity-resolution-with-graph-merge-and-confidence-threshold`; `cdp.streaming-segmentation-with-edge-decisioning-and-latency-budget`; `cdp.consent-policy-evaluate-on-activation-with-max-restrictive-wins`; `cdp.destination-activation-with-suppression-bidirectional-sync` (TTL + refresh); `cdp.privacy-dsr-fulfillment-with-SLA-tracking` (GDPR Art. 15 + Art. 17 + CCPA opt-out); `cdp.federated-audience-composition-with-no-data-move`; `cdp.customer-ai-retrain-with-freshness-floor`; `cdp.data-usage-label-aware-activation` (label-check + audit + block on violation); `cdp.identity-namespace-cross-link-with-explicit-permission`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (data-architect + marketer + privacy-officer + CDP-engineer + activation-mgr); desktop-primary segment-builder (PQL) + profile-viewer + identity-graph visualizer + per-purpose consent-canvas + governance-label dashboard + destination-mapping editor + Privacy-Service queue; mobile read-only profile + segment + audience views.
- Pack overlay applicable: GDPR Art. 6 + Art. 9 + UK-GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + CPRA + LGPD + state CMP + EU ePrivacy + IAB TCF (Transparency-and-Consent Framework) integration; per-purpose consent with per-jurisdiction scope; HIPAA + Privacy-Rule when CDP touches PHI; FCRA when CDP touches credit-eligibility data; per-tenant CDP-data-residency (EU / US / CN / KR / JP / IN).
- Naming justification: `data-pipeline` + `data-warehouse` + `intelligence` + `marketing-automation` + `consent-and-privacy` are canonical; `adobe-real-time-cdp`, `rt-cdp`, `adobe-experience-platform`, `aep`, `xdm`, `customer-ai`, `attribution-ai`, `data-distiller`, `federated-audience-composition` are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-058 - Adobe Journey Optimizer
- Vendor name and category: Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) — built on Adobe Experience Platform (AEP); includes AJO Prime (journey orchestration) + AJO Ultimate (with Offer Decisioning + Content Cards + Web in-app) + AJO B2B Edition (with account-based journeys) + AJO Content Decisioning Engine + Adobe Sensei real-time-decisioning / Adobe Experience Cloud / real-time and batch cross-channel journey orchestration with event-trigger + audience-qualifier + AI-decisioning + offer-personalization (replaces legacy Adobe Campaign for real-time use-cases).
- Coverage tier: D (microservice: `marketing-automation` real-time-journey capability tier per ADR-0299). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: AJO-Prime (basic journey + email + SMS + push) → **Bronze**; AJO Ultimate (Prime + Offer-Decisioning + Content-Cards + Web in-app + adaptive-audiences) → **Silver**; AJO Ultimate + Adobe Sensei AI + Frequency-Capping + Cross-Channel + Business-Event-triggers + Action-Center → **Gold**; AJO Ultimate + B2B Edition + Account-Based Journeys + Engagement-Score + AI-Assistant + Content Analytics → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `marketing-automation` (real-time journey canvas + activity + offer-decisioning); `intelligence` (Adobe Sensei AI decisioning + offer-ranking + content-personalization + send-time-optimization); `comms-email` + `comms-sms` + `comms-push` + `comms-in-app` + `comms-line` + `comms-whatsapp` + `comms-webhook` (channel rails); `data-pipeline` (event-source from RT-CDP per D-057 + Streaming-Source); `apigw` (Edge-Network real-time decisioning endpoint).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (AJO journey + decisioning model):
  - `Journey` (Journey_ID, Name, Description, Type {Unitary / Batch / Read-Audience}, Status {Draft / Live / Stopped / Closed}, Version, Properties {Time-Zone + Re-Entrance-Mode {Always / Once-per-Person / Once-per-Person-per-Day / etc.} + Maximum-Entries-per-Person + Boundary-Limit + Capping-Rules}, Activities[Activity-Type {Event + Condition + Action + Wait + End + Jump + Audience + Read-Audience + Business-Event + Reaction-Event + Subscriber-Status-Change-Event + Custom-Action}, Activity-Configuration], Transitions[From-Activity → To-Activity + Path-Label + Probability]).
  - `Event` (Event_ID, Name, Schema-Reference (XDM ExperienceEvent), Trigger-Type {Streaming-XDM / Reaction-Event / Business-Event / Subscriber-Status-Change / Webhook}, Identifier-Field, Constraints, Sample-Payload).
  - `Business_Event_Trigger` (Trigger_ID, Source-Dataset / Segment / API-Call, Filter, Frequency, Last-Triggered-DateTime).
  - `Audience_Qualifier` (Qualifier_ID, Source-Segment-Reference, Re-Qualification-Period {Real-Time / Hourly / Daily}, Audience-Size, Qualification-State).
  - `Action` (Action_ID, Type {Send-Email / Send-SMS / Send-Push / Send-In-App / Send-Content-Card / Show-Web-Banner / Custom-Action-via-Webhook / Update-XDM-Profile / Decisioning-Activity / Wait / Jump-to-Activity}, Channel, Message-Reference, Configuration).
  - `Message` (Message_ID, Channel, Subject (email), From-Name, From-Email, Reply-To, Body, Templates-Referenced, Personalization-Tokens[], Conditional-Content[], Dynamic-Content[], A/B-Test-Variants[], Approval-State {Draft / In-Review / Approved / Published}).
  - `Message_Fragment` (Fragment_ID, Name, Channel, Content, Variables[], Used-In-Messages[]).
  - `Content_Card` (Card_ID, Layout {Hero / Banner / List-Item / Custom}, Content-Variant{}, Decisioning-Rule-Reference, Per-Surface-Configuration).
  - `Offer` (Offer_ID, Name, Type {Personalized / Fallback / Custom}, Content (per-channel variant), Eligibility-Rules[Profile-Field-Predicate + Custom-Constraint], Priority, Constraints {Frequency-Cap + Capping-Period + Inventory + Calendar / Date-Window}, Placement-Reference, Tags[]).
  - `Offer_Decisioning_Activity` (Activity_ID, Placement-Reference, Eligible-Offer-Collection, Ranking-Strategy {AI / Rule-Based / Manual / Hybrid + Score-Formula}, Fallback-Offer, Constraint-Solver-Configuration).
  - `Placement` (Placement_ID, Name, Surface {Email / SMS / Push / Web / Mobile-App / Other}, Content-Type {Image / Text / HTML / Video / Custom-JSON}, Format).
  - `Offer_Collection` (Collection_ID, Name, Member-Offers[], Static-or-Rule-Based).
  - `Frequency_Capping_Rule` (Rule_ID, Name, Scope {Per-Profile / Per-Account / Per-Identity}, Channel-Scope {Email / SMS / Push / In-App / All-Channels}, Cap-Count + Cap-Period {Hour / Day / Week / Month}, Tagged-Communications-Only: bool).
  - `Suppression_List` (List_ID, Name, Identifier-Type {Email / Phone / Device-Token}, Members[], Source {Manual / Imported / Computed / DSR-Triggered}, Reason).
  - `Business_Rule` (Rule_ID, Name, Channel-Specific, Pre-Send-Rule {Frequency-Cap / Quiet-Hours / Channel-Blackout / Custom}, Apply-To-Journeys[]).
  - `Channel_Configuration` (Channel_ID, Type {Email / SMS / Push / In-App / Web / LINE / WhatsApp / Other}, Subdomain / Phone-Number / Push-Cert / App-ID, IP-Pool, Postal-Address (for CAN-SPAM), Unsubscribe-Link, Reply-To, Header-Configuration).
  - `Subscription_List` (List_ID, Channel, Name, Members[], Confirmation-Required: bool).
  - `Decisioning_Engine_Configuration` (Engine_ID, Strategy {Real-Time / Batch / Hybrid}, Latency-Budget-Ms, Fallback-Behavior, Logging-Level).
  - `Action_Center` (Action_ID, Type {Manual-Trigger / Approval-Action / Compensating-Action}, Routing, SLA).
  - `Account_Based_Journey` (Journey_ID, Account-Audience-Reference, Stakeholder-Roles[], Account-Engagement-Score-Threshold).
  - `Engagement_Score` (Profile / Account-Reference, Score, Trend, Top-Drivers[]).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - AJO REST API: `https://platform.adobe.io/journey/{authoring | runtime | events | decisioning}/{...}` (OAuth + JWT + IMS).
  - Journey Authoring API: per-Journey CRUD + per-Activity CRUD + per-Event registration.
  - Journey Runtime: per-event ingestion + per-profile journey-state lookup + per-decision execution.
  - Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network: real-time decisioning endpoint.
  - Decisioning API: per-Placement evaluate + per-Offer-Collection rank + per-Constraint solve.
  - Channel-specific APIs: per-email DKIM/SPF + IP-Pool + Subdomain config; per-SMS short-code + sender-ID; per-push APNS / FCM cert; per-in-app SDK integration.
  - Business-Event API: per-trigger registration + per-event ingestion + filter.
  - Action-Center API: per-Action CRUD + routing + SLA tracking.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<journey-strategist-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"AjoPublishJourney", Oyatie::Action::"AjoPauseJourney",
      Oyatie::Action::"AjoCloseJourney", Oyatie::Action::"AjoSetTrigger",
      Oyatie::Action::"AjoAddDecisioningActivity", Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureOffer",
      Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureOfferDecisioning", Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigurePlacement",
      Oyatie::Action::"AjoRunABTestOnJourney", Oyatie::Action::"AjoChangeSendChannel",
      Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureDataSource", Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureMessageFragment",
      Oyatie::Action::"AjoRegisterBusinessEvent", Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureFrequencyCap",
      Oyatie::Action::"AjoManageSuppressionList", Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureChannel",
      Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureSubscriptionList", Oyatie::Action::"AjoRunActionCenter",
      Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureB2BAccountJourney", Oyatie::Action::"AjoExportJourneyData"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::JourneyDefinition::"<journey-id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    journey_role_grants(principal, action, resource.scope) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AjoPublishJourney" ? journey_validates(resource.journey) && approved_through_workflow(resource.journey) && frequency_cap_applied(resource.journey) && consent_resolved_per_channel(resource.journey) && fallback_offer_present_for_decisioning(resource.journey) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AjoAddDecisioningActivity" ? placement_governance_check(context.placement) && ranking_strategy_governed(context.strategy) && constraint_solver_explainable(context.solver_config) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureOffer" ? offer_content_approved(context.offer) && eligibility_rules_governed(context.offer.eligibility_rules) && constraints_within_inventory(context.offer) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureFrequencyCap" ? cap_does_not_violate_global_atomic_check(context.rule) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AjoChangeSendChannel" ? channel_governance_check(context.channel) && consent_aware_send_per_jurisdiction(context.channel, resource.audience) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AjoRegisterBusinessEvent" ? event_source_authorized(context.event_source) && event_schema_governed(context.schema) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AjoManageSuppressionList" ? suppression_change_logged(resource.list, context.delta) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AjoConfigureB2BAccountJourney" ? b2b_audience_governance_check(context.audience) && account_engagement_score_threshold_explainable(context.threshold) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"AjoExportJourneyData" ? data_export_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && dual_admin_approval(context) && pii_scrubbed_per_export_policy(context.fields) : true) &&
    (resource.audience.jurisdiction == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && lawful_basis_for_processing(resource.audience, context.purpose) && (uses_ai_decisioning(resource.journey) ? context.pack.contains("EU-AI-Act") && human_in_the_loop_default(resource.journey) && decision_traceability_evidence_bundle_present(resource.journey) : true) : true) &&
    (resource.audience.jurisdiction == "KR" ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") && marketing_consent_explicit(resource.audience) : true) &&
    (resource.audience.jurisdiction == "US" && resource.journey.uses_email ? context.pack.contains("CAN-SPAM") && physical_address_in_footer(context.message) && unsubscribe_link_present(context.message) : true) &&
    (resource.audience.jurisdiction == "CA" && resource.journey.uses_email ? context.pack.contains("CASL") && express_or_implied_consent_present(resource.audience) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific workflow steps** (AJO displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant AJO sandbox count + Journey count + Event count + Audience-Qualifier count + Message count + Message-Fragment count + Offer count + Offer-Decisioning-Activity count + Placement count + Frequency-Capping-Rule count + Suppression-List count + Business-Rule count + Channel-Configuration count + Subscription-List count + Action-Center backlog + B2B-Account-Journey count.
  2. **Journey extraction**: per-Journey + activities + transitions + properties (re-entrance + max-entries + boundary + cap-rules) + status + version.
  3. **Event + Business-Event-Trigger extraction**: per-Event schema + trigger-type + identifier-field + sample-payload + constraints; per-Business-Event source + filter + frequency + last-triggered.
  4. **Audience-Qualifier extraction**: per-Qualifier source-segment + re-qualification-period + audience-size + qualification-state.
  5. **Action + Message + Message-Fragment + Content-Card extraction**: per-Action type + channel + message; per-Message channel + content + personalization + conditional + dynamic + A/B-variants + approval-state; per-Fragment content + variables + used-in-messages; per-Card layout + variant.
  6. **Offer + Decisioning-Activity + Placement + Offer-Collection extraction**: per-Offer eligibility + priority + constraints + per-placement variant; per-Decisioning placement + collection + ranking + fallback + constraint-solver; per-Placement surface + content-type + format; per-Collection members + static-or-rule-based.
  7. **Frequency-Capping + Business-Rule extraction**: per-Cap-Rule scope + channel + cap-count + cap-period + tagged-only; per-Business-Rule pre-send-rule + apply-to-journeys.
  8. **Suppression-List + Subscription-List extraction**: per-Suppression identifier-type + members + reason; per-Subscription channel + members + confirmation-required.
  9. **Channel-Configuration extraction**: per-Channel type + subdomain + phone + push-cert + IP-pool + postal-address + unsubscribe-link + reply-to + header-config.
  10. **Decisioning-Engine + Action-Center + B2B extraction**: per-Engine strategy + latency-budget + fallback + logging; per-Action-Center type + routing + SLA; per-B2B account-audience + stakeholder-roles + engagement-score threshold.
  11. **Per-Journey shadow re-build**: per-Journey re-implemented in Oyatie marketing-automation with activity-graph parity + transition-probability preserved.
  12. **Per-Decisioning re-implementation**: per-Decisioning re-built on Oyatie intelligence with ranking-strategy + fallback + constraint-solver + per-decision SLA preserved.
  13. **Per-Offer eligibility re-implementation**: per-Offer rules re-translated + per-priority preserved + per-constraint (frequency-cap + inventory + calendar) preserved.
  14. **Per-channel-configuration migration**: per-Channel subdomain CNAME + phone-number port + push-cert re-issue + IP-Pool warmup-from-scratch + postal-address preserved + unsubscribe-URL redirect.
  15. **Per-Frequency-Cap global atomic-check re-implementation**: per-rule cross-channel global cap with atomic-counter at decisioning-time.
  16. **Per-EU-AI-Act decision-traceability evidence-bundle**: per-Decisioning per-decision evidence-bundle (model-card + input-vector + output + ranking-explanation + fallback-reason) generated and retained for regulatory inspection.
  17. **Per-Suppression-List bidirectional sync**: per-Channel suppression bidirectional sync between AJO and Oyatie with TTL + refresh.
  18. **Parallel run**: 30-90 day shadow with sample journey + per-Activity execution-parity 100% + per-Decisioning offer-selection-parity ≥ 95% + per-Frequency-Cap enforcement-parity 100% + per-Suppression-List enforcement-parity 100% + per-Channel-Send delivery-parity 100% + per-EU-AI-Act evidence-bundle parity 100%.
  19. **Cutover**: per-Journey staged with dual-publish window 4-12 weeks; per-Channel-Config IP-Pool warmup gradual ramp (4-12 weeks); per-Offer-Decisioning re-pointed; per-Suppression-List bidirectional sync; per-Subscription-Center URL-redirect 24 months; per-B2B-Account-Journey re-pointed.
  20. **Sunset**: AJO license sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate (per-decision evidence-bundle for EU AI Act typically retained 5-10 years; per-journey activity-log per consent-pack).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Real-time-decision latency-budget breach** (decisioning takes 300ms, journey expects 50ms): per-decision SLO + fallback-to-default-offer + alert + audit + per-decisioning-engine performance-budget pin.
  - **Offer-eligibility-rule conflict** (Rule-A permits, Rule-B forbids same offer for same profile): per-rule explicit-precedence + conflict-detection at save-time + audit + per-decision rule-evaluation log.
  - **Cross-channel frequency-cap race** (email + push send concurrently, both pass cap-check, cap exceeded): per-customer global-cap atomic-check (distributed-lock + counter) + per-channel cap reconcile.
  - **Event-trigger storm under spike** (web event spike triggers 100x journey entries): per-source rate-limit + drop-with-replay + dead-letter + back-pressure.
  - **Decision-traceability gap for EU AI Act** (decision made, no evidence-bundle generated): per-decision evidence-bundle mandatory + retention-policy + audit + abort-on-evidence-fail.
  - **Re-entrance-mode confusion** (Once-per-Person + max-entries-per-day mis-configured, person re-enters loop): per-Journey re-entrance-config validation + per-person state-machine + audit.
  - **Constraint-solver infeasibility** (offer constraints + inventory + capping all conflict, no offer eligible): per-decisioning fallback-to-default + per-solver explain-infeasibility log.
  - **Subscription-confirmation-required gap on EU** (double-opt-in skipped): per-jurisdiction confirmation-required enforce + audit.
  - **B2B account-engagement-score threshold drift** (threshold change triggers mass re-qualification): per-threshold-change impact-simulation + per-account re-qualification audit.
  - **Channel-Config IP-Pool reputation cliff on cutover** (cold IPs throttled): per-pool reputation-warmup gradual + per-ISP handshake.
  - **Per-Message conditional-content leakage** (wrong content variant sent to wrong audience): per-message conditional-resolution test + per-variant render-preview.
  - **Action-Center SLA breach** (manual action SLA missed): per-action SLA-clock + escalation + alert.
  - **Decisioning AI-model drift** (model trained on stale data gives wrong offer): per-model drift-detection + retrain-cadence + freshness-floor.
  - **Per-Journey-State inconsistency on hot-update** (journey published while persons in mid-flight): per-Journey version-pinning + in-flight-state preservation + per-version drain.
  - **Per-Suppression-List cross-tenant bleed** (tenant-A suppression accidentally applied to tenant-B): per-list tenant-scope explicit + Cedar default-deny + audit.
  - **Per-Offer inventory race** (offer with 100-inventory used by 110 concurrent decisions): per-Offer inventory atomic-decrement + reserve + release-on-failure.
  - **Per-B2B-Account stakeholder-role mis-identification** (wrong stakeholder targeted): per-role-detection ML retrain + manual-override.
  - **Per-Channel quiet-hours violation** (cross-time-zone push at 3am local): per-recipient time-zone-pin + quiet-hours respect.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — AJO REST API (authoring + runtime + events + decisioning) + Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network + Decisioning API + per-Journey + Event + Audience-Qualifier + Message + Offer + Placement + Frequency-Cap + Suppression-List + Channel-Configuration export + Business-Event-Trigger + Action-Center + B2B-Account-Journey export + Engagement-Score export; format — JSON + XDM-schema-JSON + adaptive-card-JSON (content-cards) + per-channel templates; duration — ~3-9 months per enterprise tenant due to journey count + decisioning complexity + B2B + channel-config + EU-AI-Act evidence-bundle requirements; volume — typically 10-1000 active journeys + 100-10K events + 100-5000 offers + 50-500 placements + 10-100 frequency-cap-rules + 10-200 suppression-lists + per-channel-config inventory.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Journey + activities + transitions preserved with re-entrance + max-entries + boundary + cap-rules; per-Event + Business-Event-Trigger preserved with schema + trigger-type + filter; per-Audience-Qualifier preserved with re-qualification-period + qualification-state; per-Action + Message + Fragment + Content-Card preserved with channel + content + personalization + A/B-variants + approval; per-Offer + Decisioning + Placement + Collection re-implemented on Oyatie intelligence with ranking-strategy + fallback + constraint-solver preserved; per-Frequency-Cap + Business-Rule preserved with scope + cap-count + cap-period; per-Suppression + Subscription preserved with bidirectional-sync; per-Channel-Config preserved with subdomain + phone + push-cert + IP-pool + postal-address; per-Decisioning-Engine preserved with strategy + latency-budget + fallback + logging; per-Action-Center preserved with routing + SLA; per-B2B-Account-Journey preserved with stakeholder-roles + threshold; per-Engagement-Score retrained with parity test; per-EU-AI-Act decision-traceability evidence-bundle generated; lossy — Adobe-Sensei specifics rebuilt; some content-decisioning-engine specifics rebuilt with parity test.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-Journey staged with dual-publish window 4-12 weeks; per-Channel-Config IP-Pool warmup gradual ramp; per-Offer-Decisioning re-pointed with fallback + constraint-solver; per-Suppression-List bidirectional sync; per-Subscription-Center URL-redirect 24 months; per-B2B-Account-Journey re-pointed; per-EU-AI-Act evidence-bundle generation activated; per-Frequency-Cap global atomic-check pinned.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 30-90 days with per-Activity execution-parity 100% + per-Decisioning offer-selection-parity ≥ 95% + per-Frequency-Cap enforcement-parity 100% + per-Suppression-List enforcement-parity 100% + per-Channel-Send delivery-parity 100% + per-EU-AI-Act evidence-bundle parity 100% + per-Action-Center SLA-parity 100% + per-B2B-engagement-score parity ± 5%; sunset — AJO license sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate.

- Workflow template library: `ajo.real-time-journey-publish-with-shadow-cohort`; `ajo.event-trigger-with-decisioning-and-latency-budget`; `ajo.offer-decisioning-with-constraint-solver-and-fallback`; `ajo.cross-channel-orchestration-with-frequency-cap-atomic-check`; `ajo.business-event-from-RT-CDP-streaming-segment` (per D-057 bridge); `ajo.subscription-confirmation-required-per-jurisdiction`; `ajo.eu-ai-act-decision-traceability-evidence-bundle` (model-card + input + output + explanation); `ajo.b2b-account-journey-with-stakeholder-roles`; `ajo.channel-config-ip-pool-warmup-gradual`; `ajo.suppression-list-bidirectional-sync` (TTL + refresh).
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (journey-strategist + decision-strategist + marketer + content-designer + B2B-strategist); desktop-primary canvas with event + condition + action nodes + per-offer eligibility + ranking visualization + per-decisioning explainability + per-EU-AI-Act evidence-bundle viewer + Action-Center queue + B2B Account-Journey + Engagement-Score dashboard; mobile read-only journey-monitor.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + UK-GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + CPRA + LGPD + EU ePrivacy + CAN-SPAM + CASL + UK-PECR + per-jurisdiction direct-marketing; per-jurisdiction real-time-decision auditability per EU AI Act (with human-in-the-loop default + meaningful-explanation + evidence-bundle retention 5-10 years); HIPAA when journey touches PHI; per-tenant per-region channel-config residency.
- Naming justification: `marketing-automation` (real-time tier) + `intelligence` (decisioning) are canonical; `adobe-journey-optimizer`, `ajo`, `journey-optimizer`, `offer-decisioning`, `content-decisioning-engine`, `ajo-b2b` are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-059 - Adobe Sign
- Vendor name and category: Adobe Acrobat Sign (formerly Adobe Sign / EchoSign — acquired 2011) / Adobe Document Cloud / e-signature + agreement workflow — supports Electronic Signature (eIDAS Simple) + Advanced Electronic Signature (AdES) + Qualified Electronic Signature (QES, with eIDAS-Qualified Trust Service Provider — QTSP partners like InfoCert / Intesi / D-Trust / Buypass) + In-Person Signing + Digital-ID with Smart-Card + Document-Cloud-Integration + Acrobat Pro PDF-Sign + Workflow Designer + Liquid Mode + Sensei AI-FieldMagic + Send-in-Bulk + Mega-Sign + Forms Authoring.
- Coverage tier: B (partial — capability tier on `contract-lifecycle-management` + `identity` + `evidence-store`; possible new `e-signature` µservice in Wave-3-H if scale + regulatory complexity demands). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Acrobat Sign Solo / Small Business → **Bronze**; Acrobat Sign Business (with Bulk-Send + Workflow Designer + reusable-templates) → **Silver**; Acrobat Sign Enterprise (with REST API + Webhook + KBA + Phone-OTP + Signer-Identity-Verification + In-Person-Signing) → **Gold**; Acrobat Sign Enterprise + Government Cloud + AdES + QES with QTSP integration + Digital-ID + Notarize-Integration + SOC2-Type-II + FedRAMP + 21CFR-Part-11-Compliance + HIPAA-BAA-eligible → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `contract-lifecycle-management` (Agreement primary — Pre-Signature + In-Signature + Post-Signature + Archive; per contract-lifecycle-management doctrine); `identity` (Signer-Identity verification — passkey + KBA + Phone-OTP + Government-ID + Smart-Card + Digital-ID + QES-cert federation); `drive` (Document storage with version + retention); `workflow-engine` (Signing routing + reminder cadence + signing-order + parallel-vs-serial); `evidence-store` (Audit-trail with hash-chain + LTV evidence + timestamp-anchor per EU eIDAS); `apigw` (Webhook + REST + SOAP for downstream-system signing integration); `compliance` (per-vertical regulatory pack — FDA-21CFR-Part-11 + HIPAA-BAA + SOX).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Acrobat Sign agreement model):
  - `Agreement` (Agreement_ID, Name, Status {Draft / Authoring / Out-for-Signature / Out-for-Approval / Out-for-Acceptance / Out-for-Form-Filling / Signed / Approved / Accepted / Form-Filled / Cancelled / Expired / Archived / Document-Library / Widget-Disabled}, Type {Agreement / Mega-Sign-Child / Mega-Sign-Parent / Library-Template / Web-Form / Acceptance / Notary}, Send_Date, Last_Event_Date, Expiration_Date, External_ID, Creator_Reference, Workflow_ID, Documents_Reference[Document-Reference + Page-Count + Hash], Signer_Reference[Signer-Detail-Reference + Order + Role {Signer / Approver / Acceptor / Form-Filler / Certified-Recipient / Delegator-Recipient / Witness} + Authentication-Method {Email / KBA / Phone-OTP / Adobe-Sign-Identity / Government-ID / Smart-Card / Knowledge-Based / Web-Identity {Facebook / Google / LinkedIn / Microsoft / Apple} / Single-Sign-On / Password}, Reminder-Setting, Signing-Order], Locale, Cc_Recipients[], External-Reference, Group-Reference, Megasign-Parent-Reference, Notarize-Reference).
  - `Document` (Document_ID, Original_PDF_Reference, Page_Count, Hash {SHA-256 + Optional-SHA-512}, MIME_Type, OCR_Status, Form-Field-Mapping-Reference, Library-Document: bool).
  - `Signer_Detail` (Signer_ID, Email, Name, Role, Authentication-Method, Signing-Order, Status {Out-for-Signature / Signed / Approved / Declined / Cancelled / Delegated / Expired / Waiting-for-Pre-Fill}, Sign_Date, IP_Address, Geo_Location, Device-Type, User-Agent, Identity_Verification_Reference, Reminder-History[], Delegated-To-Reference, Comments[]).
  - `Signing_Event` (Event_ID, Agreement-Reference, Signer-Reference, Event_Type {Created / Sent / Viewed / Signed / Approved / Declined / Delegated / Cancelled / Expired / Reminder-Sent / Document-Modified / Auth-Challenge-Sent / Auth-Challenge-Passed / Auth-Challenge-Failed / Notarized-Begin / Notarized-Complete / Comment-Added / Form-Field-Filled}, Timestamp, Actor, IP_Address, Geo_Location, Event_Hash, Previous_Event_Hash).
  - `Signature` (Signature_ID, Type {Electronic-Signature / AdES-Advanced / QES-Qualified-per-eIDAS / Adobe-Sign-Digital-Signature / PAdES / Acrobat-Digital-ID}, Method {Drawn-with-Stylus / Typed-Font-Render / Image-Upload / Sign-with-Cert / Phone-Signature / Tap-to-Sign / Voice-Approval}, Image-PNG-Reference, Date-Time-Signed, IP, Geo, X-Y-Coordinates-on-Document, Certificate-Reference (for AdES/QES), Timestamp-Authority-Reference, OCSP-CRL-Status-at-Sign-Time, Signature-Reason, Signature-Location).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Acrobat Sign REST API: `https://<region>.api.adobesign.com/api/rest/v6/{agreements | libraryDocuments | users | groups | workflows | search | reports | webhooks | etc.}` (OAuth + JWT).
  - Acrobat Sign Webhook: per-Agreement / per-Library-Document / per-Workflow events delivered to per-tenant URL with HMAC-SHA-256 signature.
  - Acrobat Sign SOAP API (deprecated 2024).
  - Acrobat-DC Pro SDK: per-PDF sign via Smart-Card / Digital-ID / Sign-with-Cert.
  - Adobe Sign Mobile SDK: per-app embed-signing.
  - QES Connector: per-QTSP (InfoCert / Intesi / D-Trust / Buypass / Cert-Sign / etc.) per-eIDAS qualified-certificate issuance + verification.
  - PAdES-Validation Library: PDF Advanced Electronic Signature validation per ETSI EN 319 142.
  - Adobe Sign for Salesforce / for SAP / for Workday / for ServiceNow / for Box / for Dropbox / for OneDrive: native connectors.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<sender-or-signer-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignCreateAgreement", Oyatie::Action::"EsignSendForSignature",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignSendForApproval", Oyatie::Action::"EsignBulkSend",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignSignElectronic", Oyatie::Action::"EsignSignAdES",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignSignQES", Oyatie::Action::"EsignSignWithSmartCard",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignDecline", Oyatie::Action::"EsignDelegate",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignRecallAgreement", Oyatie::Action::"EsignCancelAgreement",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignVoidSignedAgreement", Oyatie::Action::"EsignArchive",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignRunKBA", Oyatie::Action::"EsignRunIDVerification",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignRunNotarization", Oyatie::Action::"EsignConfigureSigningOrder",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignAddFormField", Oyatie::Action::"EsignCreateTemplate",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignCreateWorkflow", Oyatie::Action::"EsignCreateWebForm",
      Oyatie::Action::"EsignExportAuditTrail", Oyatie::Action::"EsignRotateQEScert"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::Agreement::"<agreement-id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    signer_identity_verified(principal, context.assurance_level) &&
    esign_role_grants(principal, action, resource.group) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"EsignSignQES" ? qes_cert_chain_valid_at_sign_time(context.cert) && qtsp_in_eu_trust_list(context.qtsp) && timestamp_authority_certified(context.tsa) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"EsignSignAdES" ? cert_chain_valid_at_sign_time(context.cert) && timestamp_authority_certified(context.tsa) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"EsignSignWithSmartCard" ? smart_card_present(principal) && pin_entered(principal) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"EsignSendForSignature" ? per_signer_auth_method_valid(resource.signers) && all_required_form_fields_assigned(resource.documents) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"EsignRunNotarization" ? notary_certified_per_jurisdiction(context.notary) && session_recording_consent_obtained(context.signers) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"EsignVoidSignedAgreement" ? principal.has_role("Agreement-Voider") && void_reason_documented(context.reason) && voided_copy_revocation_broadcast(resource.agreement) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"EsignExportAuditTrail" ? data_export_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && audit_log_record_immutability_preserved(resource.audit_trail) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"EsignRotateQEScert" ? qtsp_authorized_for_rotation(context.qtsp) && rotation_grace_window_observed(context.window) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"EsignRunIDVerification" ? id_verification_provider_dpa_signed(context.provider) && id_doc_residency_pinned(context.signer.jurisdiction, context.provider) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.regulated_vertical == "life-sciences" ? context.pack.contains("FDA-21CFR-Part-11") && electronic_signature_meaning_attested(context.signature) && audit_record_immutability(resource.audit_trail) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.regulated_vertical == "healthcare" ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && phi_safeguard(resource.documents) : true) &&
    (resource.signer.jurisdiction == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("eIDAS") && (context.assurance_level >= "AdES" ? cert_chain_valid_at_sign_time(context.cert) : true) : true) &&
    (resource.signer.jurisdiction == "US" ? context.pack.contains("ESIGN-Act") && context.pack.contains("UETA") && intent_to_sign_documented(context.signer) : true) &&
    (resource.signer.jurisdiction == "JP" ? context.pack.contains("JP-eSignature-Act") : true) &&
    (resource.signer.jurisdiction == "KR" ? context.pack.contains("KR-eSignature-Act") : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Agreement` → `Oyatie::ContractLifecycleManagement::agreement` (with status + type + send-date + expiration + workflow + documents + signers + locale + external-reference).
  - `Document` → `Oyatie::Drive::document` (with original-PDF + page-count + hash + OCR-status + form-field-mapping + library-flag).
  - `Signer_Detail` → `Oyatie::ContractLifecycleManagement::signer` (with email + role + auth-method + signing-order + status + sign-date + IP + geo + device + identity-verification).
  - `Signing_Event` → `Oyatie::EvidenceStore::signing_event` (with event-type + timestamp + actor + IP + geo + event-hash + previous-event-hash).
  - `Signature` → `Oyatie::ContractLifecycleManagement::signature` (with type {electronic / AdES / QES / PAdES / Adobe-Digital-ID} + method + image + timestamp + cert + OCSP/CRL + reason + location).
  - `Audit_Trail` → `Oyatie::EvidenceStore::audit_trail` (with hash-chain + final-audit-PDF + tamper-detection + LTV-validation).
  - `Form_Field` → `Oyatie::ContractLifecycleManagement::form_field` (with page + position + type + assigned-signer + required + default + validation + conditional-visibility).
  - `Template` → `Oyatie::ContractLifecycleManagement::template` (with type + documents + form-field-map + workflow + sharing-mode).
  - `Workflow_Definition` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::esign_workflow` (with stages + signers + roles + conditional-routing + cadence + escalation).
  - `Identity_Verification_Record` → `Oyatie::Identity::id_verification_record` (with method + verification-date + document-type + provider + confidence-score + stored-region).
  - `Long_Term_Validation_Evidence` → `Oyatie::EvidenceStore::ltv_evidence` (with timestamp-authority + cert-chain + CRL + OCSP + embedded-PDF/A).

  - `Notary_Session` → `Oyatie::ContractLifecycleManagement::notary_session` (with notary + session-recording + Notary-Seal + in-person-vs-remote).
  - `Group` → `Oyatie::ContractLifecycleManagement::group` (with members + default-workflow + default-branding).

- **Specific workflow steps** (Acrobat Sign displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant Agreement count (often 10K-10M over lifetime) + active Agreement count + Library-Document/Template count + Workflow count + Web-Form widget count + User + Group count + QES-cert active + Identity-Verification records + LTV-evidence retained + Notary-Session log + Acrobat-DC Pro Sign-with-Cert integrations + Native connectors (Salesforce / SAP / Workday / ServiceNow / Box / Dropbox / OneDrive).
  2. **Agreement extraction**: per-Agreement status + type + send-date + expiration + creator + workflow + documents + signers + locale + external-reference; per-Agreement Audit-Trail Hash-Chain + Final-Audit-PDF + LTV-evidence.
  3. **Document extraction**: per-Document original-PDF binary + page-count + hash + form-field-mapping; preserve PDF-byte-exact (essential for signature verification).
  4. **Signer-Detail + Signing-Event extraction**: per-Signer email + role + auth-method + signing-order + status + sign-date + IP + geo + device + identity-verification; per-Event timestamp + actor + event-hash + previous-event-hash (preserve hash-chain integrity).
  5. **Signature extraction**: per-Signature type + method + image-PNG + date-time + IP + geo + X-Y-coordinates + cert + timestamp-authority + OCSP/CRL-snapshot-at-sign-time + reason + location.
  6. **Form-Field extraction**: per-Field document + page + position + type + assigned-signer + required + default + validation + conditional-visibility.
  7. **Template + Workflow-Definition extraction**: per-Template type + documents + form-field-map + workflow + sharing-mode; per-Workflow stages + signers + roles + conditional-routing + cadence + escalation.
  8. **Identity-Verification-Record extraction**: per-Verification method + date + document-type + document-number-hash + issuer + expiry + confidence + provider + stored-region; preserve residency-pin.
  9. **LTV-Evidence extraction**: per-Agreement timestamp-authority + cert-chain + CRL + OCSP + embedded-PDF/A; preserve cryptographic-algorithms used.
  10. **Megasign-Parent + Web-Form + Notary-Session extraction**: per-Parent child-references + status-roll-up; per-Widget URL + iframe + auth + submission-notifications; per-Notary-Session notary + recording + seal.
  11. **Group + User-Management extraction**: per-Group members + default-workflow + default-branding; per-User role + group-membership + signing-settings.
  12. **Per-QES-cert + QTSP-binding migration**: per-Cert re-bound to Oyatie-Identity QTSP-federation + per-eIDAS qualified-cert validation re-run against current EU Trust-List.
  13. **Per-Identity-Verification-provider migration**: per-Provider (Persona / OneSpan / Mitek / Onfido / IDology / Equifax-KBA / LexisNexis-KBA / Acuant / Jumio / Sumsub / Veriff) re-bound to Oyatie Identity + DPA preserved.
  14. **Per-Audit-Trail hash-chain verification**: per-Trail hash-chain validated at import + tamper-detection alarm + per-Event hash-recomputed and compared.
  15. **Per-Signature LTV-validation re-run**: per-Signature current-trust-list re-check + OCSP/CRL freshness + flag stale or invalid + manual review for QES expiry edge.
  16. **Per-PAdES PDF embedding preserve**: per-PDF byte-exact preservation; LTV info embedded in PDF preserved.
  17. **Per-Web-Form URL-redirect**: per-Widget URL preserved with redirect window (typically 24-36 months for external integrations).
  18. **Per-Native-connector re-bind**: per-Connector (Salesforce / SAP / Workday / ServiceNow / Box / Dropbox / OneDrive) re-bound to Oyatie equivalent + OAuth refresh.
  19. **Per-Notary-Session migration**: per-Session notary-cert + recording-storage + Notary-Seal preserved; per-jurisdiction notary-certification verified.
  20. **Per-Megasign Parent/Child cohesion**: per-Parent + Child child-references preserved; per-child status-roll-up recomputed.
  21. **Parallel run**: 30-90 day shadow with sample agreement-cohort + per-Hash-Chain verification 100% + per-Signature LTV-validation parity 100% + per-Identity-Verification parity 100% + per-QES-cert chain-validation 100% + per-Notary-Session recording + seal-parity 100% + per-Web-Form submission-parity 100%.
  22. **Cutover**: per-Group staged with dual-send window 4-12 weeks; per-Web-Form URL-redirect; per-Native-connector re-bound; per-QES-cert rotation grace; per-Identity-Verification-Provider DPA-renewal; per-Notary-Session in-flight resume.
  23. **Sunset**: Acrobat Sign license sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate (typically 7-10 years for contracts; eIDAS-QES LTV-evidence retained per signer-cert validity ≥ 10 years; FDA-21CFR-Part-11 typically until product-end-of-life + 10 years; HIPAA-BAA typically 6 years post-creation; per-locality archive-residency preserved).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **QES-cert-chain validation failure post-migration** (eIDAS QES cert no longer recognized after trust-list change): per-Agreement timestamp-pin + re-validation via current trust-list + per-cert grace-window + manual-review queue.
  - **Signing-order race** (two signers sign concurrently when order required): per-order serialize + distributed-lock + audit + retry-with-back-off.
  - **Audit-trail tamper-detection on import** (hash-chain validation flags tampered event): per-Agreement hash-chain verifier + flag on mismatch + quarantine + manual review.
  - **Identity-verification record-residency leak** (EU signer's KBA stored in US in violation of GDPR): per-signer residency-pin at intake + per-provider data-residency-config + audit.
  - **Voided-agreement signed-copy lingering** (after void, signed copy still exists with old signers' authority): per-void revocation-notice + retention policy + per-recipient broadcast.
  - **PDF-byte-mutation on import** (PDF re-rendered, signature invalidates): per-PDF byte-exact preservation + checksum + signature-re-validation.
  - **OCSP/CRL freshness drift** (cert was valid at sign-time, now CRL says revoked): per-Signature OCSP/CRL-snapshot-at-sign-time preserved + freshness-pin + audit.
  - **Signer-delegation race** (signer delegates to person who declines): per-delegation chain-of-custody + per-delegate audit + escalation-back-to-original-signer.
  - **In-Person-Notarization cert-mismatch** (notary-cert expired or jurisdiction-mismatch): per-notary per-jurisdiction validation + cert-expiry-check + audit.
  - **Bulk-send (Megasign) child-failure cascade** (1 child fails, parent rolls up wrong): per-child failure-isolation + parent status-roll-up + retry-individual.
  - **Form-field assignment drift** (field assigned to signer-2 but signer-2 already signed and left blank): per-field assignment-validation pre-send + per-signer field-completeness check.
  - **Time-zone confusion on expiration-date** (agreement expires earlier than expected due to TZ): per-Agreement TZ-pin + explicit display + audit.
  - **Per-jurisdiction signature-validity drift** (signature accepted in US-ESIGN, rejected in EU-QES): per-jurisdiction signature-tier requirement-pin + abort-on-mismatch.
  - **Per-Workflow conditional-routing infinite-loop** (router routes back to same signer): per-Workflow cycle-detection at publish + runtime circuit-breaker.
  - **Reminder-cadence spam** (signer gets 20 reminders): per-cadence cap + per-signer opt-out + per-Agreement throttle.
  - **HIPAA-BAA missing for healthcare-agreement** (PHI-bearing agreement sent without BAA-signed Acrobat Sign tenant config): per-tenant BAA-flag pre-send check + abort-on-missing.
  - **FDA-21CFR-Part-11 electronic-signature meaning attestation gap** (signer attestation of meaning of signature absent): per-Signer meaning-attestation step + audit.
  - **QTSP outage during QES-sign** (QTSP unreachable, sign-fails mid-flow): per-QTSP fallback-QTSP + retry + audit + offline-recovery.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Acrobat Sign REST API v6 (agreements + library-documents + users + groups + workflows + search + reports + webhooks) + per-Agreement Document (PDF binary) + per-Audit-Trail Hash-Chain + per-Signature LTV-evidence + per-Identity-Verification-Record + per-QES-cert + per-Megasign-Parent + per-Web-Form widget + per-Notary-Session + per-Native-connector inventory; format — JSON + PDF binary + cert binary (.cer / .p12 / .pfx) + OCSP/CRL snapshot blob + identity-verification-record (jurisdiction-pinned residency); duration — ~3-9 months per enterprise tenant due to lifetime agreement volume + LTV-evidence per agreement + identity-verification-residency + QES-cert chain + Notary-Session evidence + native-connector count; volume — typically 10K-10M lifetime agreements + 10-100 active workflows + 100-5000 templates + 10-500 web-forms + 50-1000 QES-certs + 5-50 native connectors.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Agreement preserved with status + type + send-date + expiration + creator + workflow + documents + signers + locale; per-Document byte-exact PDF + page-count + hash; per-Signer + Signing-Event preserved with hash-chain integrity; per-Signature preserved with type + method + cert + timestamp + OCSP/CRL-snapshot + reason + location; per-Audit-Trail hash-chain verified at import; per-Form-Field preserved with position + type + assignment + validation; per-Template + Workflow preserved with stages + cadence + escalation; per-Identity-Verification-Record preserved with residency-pin; per-LTV-Evidence preserved with timestamp-authority + cert-chain + CRL + OCSP + embedded-PDF/A; per-QES-cert preserved with QTSP-binding; per-Megasign + Web-Form + Notary-Session preserved; per-Group + User-Management preserved; per-Native-connector re-bound; lossy — Adobe Document Cloud-specific Sensei AI-FieldMagic rebuilt with parity test; some Acrobat Pro Sign-with-Cert deep customization rebuilt.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-Group staged with dual-send window 4-12 weeks; per-Web-Form URL-redirect 24-36 months; per-Native-connector re-bound with OAuth refresh; per-QES-cert rotation with grace + dual-cert window; per-Identity-Verification-Provider DPA-renewal + per-residency-pin; per-Notary-Session in-flight resume; per-Megasign in-flight-children completed before cutover; per-Hash-Chain integrity verified at every step; per-LTV-validation re-run on current trust-list.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 30-90 days with per-Hash-Chain verification 100% + per-Signature LTV-validation parity 100% + per-Identity-Verification parity 100% + per-QES-cert chain-validation 100% + per-Notary-Session recording + seal-parity 100% + per-Web-Form submission-parity 100% + per-Workflow execution-parity 100% + per-FDA-21CFR-Part-11 audit-immutability 100% + per-Native-connector send-parity 100%; sunset — Acrobat Sign license sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate.

- Workflow template library: `esign.send-with-signing-order-and-distributed-lock`; `esign.knowledge-based-auth-challenge` (per-jurisdiction KBA provider); `esign.QES-signature-with-eIDAS-cert-and-current-trust-list` (validity-at-sign-time pin); `esign.AdES-signature-with-cert-chain`; `esign.bulk-send-with-template-and-megasign-rollup`; `esign.reminder-cadence-with-throttle` (anti-spam); `esign.archive-with-LTV-evidence-and-PDF-A-embed`; `esign.in-person-or-remote-notarization-with-recording`; `esign.fda-21cfr-part-11-electronic-signature-with-meaning-attestation`; `esign.hipaa-baa-eligible-agreement-pre-send-check`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (sender + reviewer + administrator + workflow-designer + template-designer); mobile-primary signer experience with touch-signature + tap-to-sign + auto-scroll + camera-snap-and-sign + voice-approval; desktop sender + template-designer + workflow-designer + Acrobat-DC Pro Sign-with-Cert; per-locale + per-vertical branding.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + UK-GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + ESIGN Act (US federal) + UETA (US state) + eIDAS (EU electronic + advanced + qualified) + per-EU member-state implementing-regulation + Japan e-Signature Act + Korea e-Signature Act + Brazil-MP-2200-2 + India-IT-Act + Singapore-ETA + Australia-ETA + UK-eIDAS; per-vertical FDA-21CFR-Part-11 (life-sciences electronic signature + meaning-attestation + audit-trail immutability) + HIPAA-BAA-eligible (healthcare PHI) + SOX (financial reporting); per-vertical compliance pack required for QES + Notarization.
- Naming justification: `contract-lifecycle-management` (per contract-lifecycle-management doctrine) + `identity` + `drive` + `workflow-engine` + `evidence-store` are canonical; `adobe-sign`, `acrobat-sign`, `adobe-acrobat-sign`, `echosign` are benchmark aliases; possible new `e-signature` µservice if scale + regulatory demands (Wave-3-H decision).

### Section D-060 - Adobe Creative Cloud
- Vendor name and category: Adobe Creative Cloud — Photoshop + Illustrator + InDesign + Premiere Pro + After Effects + XD + Acrobat Pro + Lightroom + Lightroom Classic + Audition + Animate + Character Animator + Dreamweaver + Substance 3D Suite (Painter / Designer / Sampler / Stager / Modeler / Assets) + Express + Firefly + Frame.io (collaboration) + Behance + Adobe Stock + Adobe Fonts + Creative Cloud Libraries + Creative Cloud Assets + Creative Cloud Marketplace (Adobe Exchange) + Adobe ID for organizations + per-seat License Management / Adobe Creative Cloud / creative production suite for design + photo + video + audio + 3D + web + GenAI.
- Coverage tier: D (microservice: `design-collaboration` for assets + version + review + brand-system + collaboration; future Wave-3-H may carve out `media-production` for video / audio if scale demands). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: CC Photography (Lightroom + Photoshop) → **Bronze**; CC All-Apps (full platform + 100GB-1TB cloud) → **Silver**; CC for Teams (admin console + per-seat license + asset-library sharing) → **Gold**; CC for Enterprise (Federated-ID + SSO + bulk-license + sandbox-isolation + Frame.io + Substance-3D + Firefly Enterprise + commercial-use rights) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `design-collaboration` (Asset + Version + Review + Comment + Brand-Asset + Library + Linked-Asset graph); `drive` (file storage with rendition + version + retention); `intelligence` (Firefly generative + Sensei content-aware + auto-tagging + content-credentials); `marketplace` (Creative Cloud Marketplace / Adobe-Exchange third-party plugins ↔ Oyatie plugin marketplace per ADR-0249); `identity` (Adobe-ID + Federated-ID + SSO + per-seat license-management); `community` (Behance public-portfolio + creative-community); `consent-and-privacy` (per-asset rights-attestation + per-Firefly commercial-use-eligibility); `payments` (Adobe Stock licensing + Marketplace plugin purchases).

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<designer-or-creative-director-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CcOpenAsset", Oyatie::Action::"CcEditAsset",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcSaveVersion", Oyatie::Action::"CcShareForReview",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcRunComment", Oyatie::Action::"CcResolveComment",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcExportRendition", Oyatie::Action::"CcPublishToBehance",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcPublishToAdobeStock", Oyatie::Action::"CcLicenseAdobeStock",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcRunFireflyGeneration", Oyatie::Action::"CcRunSenseiAction",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcInstallPlugin", Oyatie::Action::"CcConfigureBrandSystem",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcShareLibrary", Oyatie::Action::"CcImportLinkedAsset",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcUpdateLinkedAssetGraph", Oyatie::Action::"CcSignContentCredentials",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcRotateAssetVersion", Oyatie::Action::"CcDeleteAsset",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcRunFrameIOReview", Oyatie::Action::"CcConfigureFederatedID",
      Oyatie::Action::"CcAssignLicenseSeat", Oyatie::Action::"CcExportAssetForExternal"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::CreativeAsset::"<asset-id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    license_seat_assigned(principal, context.app) &&
    creative_role_grants(principal, action, resource.project) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CcEditAsset" ? asset_not_checked_out_by_other(resource.asset, principal) || locked_by_self : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CcRunFireflyGeneration" ? firefly_commercial_use_pack_enabled(context.tenant) && prompt_does_not_violate_governance(context.prompt) && training_data_attribution_logged(context.generation) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CcSignContentCredentials" ? content_credentials_cert_valid(principal) && signing_intent_attested(principal) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CcPublishToBehance" ? per_asset_publication_rights_attested(resource.asset) && nda_status_resolved(resource.asset) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CcLicenseAdobeStock" ? license_budget_available(context.team) && licensee_seat_count_within_plan_limit(context.team) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CcInstallPlugin" ? plugin_governance_check(context.plugin) && plugin_permissions_minimum_necessary(context.plugin) && plugin_publisher_allowlisted(context.plugin) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CcShareLibrary" ? library_share_recipient_governed(context.recipients) && per_element_license_compatible(context.library) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CcAssignLicenseSeat" ? principal.has_role("Adobe-Admin") && seat_count_within_plan_limit(context.org) && federated_id_bound_if_required(context.user) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CcExportAssetForExternal" ? data_export_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && per_asset_external_use_rights_attested(resource.asset) && watermark_applied_for_external(context.export) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CcRunFrameIOReview" ? frame_io_project_governance_check(context.project) : true) &&
    (resource.asset.contains_third_party_content ? content_credentials_signed(resource.asset) && license_attribution_present(resource.asset) : true) &&
    (resource.asset.nda_bound ? context.pack.contains("NDA-Asset-Boundary") && external_share_blocked(context.action) : true) &&
    (resource.asset.contains_phi ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && phi_safeguard(resource.asset) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && data_pinned_to_eu_region(resource.asset.storage_region) : true) &&
    (resource.tenant.data_residency == "KR" ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```
