- **Specific workflow steps** (Creative Cloud displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-tenant License-Seat count per-plan + Active-User count + per-app usage + Creative-Cloud-Library count + Creative-Cloud-Asset (cloud-document) count + Adobe-Stock license count + Adobe-Fonts active subscription + Adobe-Exchange plugin inventory + Federated-ID Org config + Frame.io Project count + per-Asset native-file inventory (local + cloud) + per-Linked-Asset graph + per-Firefly-Generation history + per-Sensei-Action history + per-Brand-System library + per-tenant data-residency.
  2. **Asset extraction**: per-Asset native-file + version-history + linked-asset graph + embedded-smart-objects + Adobe-Stock references + Adobe-Fonts used + color-palette + predicted-tags + content-credentials manifest; preserve byte-exact native files.
  3. **Asset-Version extraction**: per-Version saved-by + save-comment + linked-asset-delta + tag.
  4. **Linked-Asset graph extraction**: per-Edge reference-type + updated-timestamp; build dependency-graph for migration order.
  5. **Review-Session + Comment + Annotation extraction**: per-Review assets + reviewers + status + sharing-link + allowed-actions; per-Comment pin-position + status + replies + mentions + attachments + sentiment.
  6. **Rendition extraction**: per-Rendition format + dimensions + bit-depth + color-profile + compression + file-reference + auto-generated flag.
  7. **Brand-System extraction**: per-Brand logo-variants + color-palette (Pantone + Hex + RGB + CMYK + Spot) + type-spec + spacing + voice-tone + version + approved-by.
  8. **Library extraction**: per-Library type + members + shared-with + permission + last-synced; preserve per-element license-compatibility.
  9. **Cloud-Document extraction**: per-Cloud-Document path + version-stream + storage-region + co-edit history.
  10. **Firefly-Generation extraction**: per-Generation prompt + model + output + seed + style-reference + training-data-attribution + commercial-use-eligible + content-credentials.
  11. **Sensei-Action history extraction**: per-Action type + result + confidence + time-saved-estimate.
  12. **Adobe-Stock + Adobe-Fonts extraction**: per-Stock license + per-Font subscription + per-document use-tracking.
  13. **Adobe-Exchange plugin extraction**: per-Plugin type + publisher + license-type + permissions + license-seat; map to Oyatie marketplace equivalent per ADR-0249.
  14. **License-Seat + Federated-ID extraction**: per-Seat user + plan + devices-bound + last-activated; per-Org trust-IdP + domains + auto-provision + default-license-plan.
  15. **Frame.io Project extraction**: per-Project assets + reviewers + status + comments + approvals; preserve timecode-pins.
  16. **Per-native-file format compatibility plan**: per-format Photoshop/Illustrator/InDesign/Premiere/After-Effects/XD/Substance file-format-version-pin + downgrade-converter where Oyatie tools can't open newest; per-app native-app retention via license-co-existence window during migration.
  17. **Per-Linked-Asset graph reconnection**: per-Edge re-bound at new asset-path; per-historical-redirect for moved assets; per-broken-link manual queue.
  18. **Per-Firefly commercial-use validation**: per-Generation rights-attestation + commercial-eligible flag preserved; per-prompt governance gate (no infringing content).
  19. **Per-Content-Credentials signature preservation**: per-Asset content-credentials manifest preserved with cryptographic-signature-chain.
  20. **Per-Brand-System publication migration**: per-Brand library re-published with version-pin + per-app library-sync.
  21. **Per-Adobe-Exchange plugin → Oyatie marketplace transition**: per-Plugin either migrated (if Oyatie equivalent exists) or feature-gap documented + per-plugin replacement-plan.
  22. **Per-Federated-ID + SSO migration**: per-Org Federated-ID re-bound to Oyatie Identity per D-051; per-User SSO re-bound.
  23. **Per-Frame.io review-session migration**: per-Project + Asset + Review + Comment + Timecode-Pin preserved; per-Approval state preserved.
  24. **Parallel run**: 60-120 day shadow with sample project + per-Asset open + edit + save-parity 100% (native-app compat) + per-Linked-Asset graph-resolve parity 100% + per-Rendition pixel-parity 100% (golden-image diff < 0.5%) + per-Comment pin-position parity 100% + per-Brand-System render-parity 100% + per-Firefly-Generation commercial-use-eligible parity 100% + per-Content-Credentials signature parity 100% + per-Library shared-access parity 100% + per-Frame.io review-parity 100%.
  25. **Cutover**: per-team staged with native-app license co-existence window 6-12 weeks; per-Asset linked-graph re-bound; per-Library re-published; per-Federated-ID re-bound; per-Frame.io review continued; per-Adobe-Stock license seat-migration; per-Adobe-Fonts subscription-migration; per-Adobe-Exchange plugin migration or gap-list.
  26. **Sunset**: Creative Cloud subscription sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate (typically 2-7 years for active project assets; per-Brand 10+ years; per-Firefly-Generation commercial-use-eligible logged longer; per-NDA-bound asset per contract terms; per-DMCA takedown response per-jurisdiction).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Linked-asset-graph break** (asset references another asset that was moved or deleted): per-link historical-redirect + per-broken-link manual queue + audit.
  - **Native-file version-incompat** (PSD saved in newer Photoshop, can't open in older or in Oyatie): per-file version-pin + downgrade-converter where possible + manual-rewrite-list for unsupported.
  - **Firefly commercial-rights ambiguity** (generation includes training-data-derived elements that may be third-party-restricted): per-generation rights-attestation + commercial-eligible flag + per-prompt governance review.
  - **Review-comment pin-position drift on layout-change** (asset re-flowed, comment-pin no longer points at intended element): per-comment anchor-on-layer + auto-rebind heuristic + manual-fixup queue.
  - **Per-app-license seat-bleed** (one user logged in on >2 devices simultaneously): per-seat device-binding + Cedar audit + force-logoff-other-device.
  - **Adobe-Stock license-tier mismatch** (asset licensed as Standard, used in Extended-use context): per-asset license-tier check at use + audit + alert.
  - **Adobe-Fonts subscription lapse mid-design** (font deactivated, document missing font): per-font use-tracking + per-document font-embed where possible + downgrade-warning.
  - **Adobe-Exchange plugin malicious-permission** (plugin requests excessive permissions): per-plugin permission-minimum-necessary check + publisher-allowlist + audit.
  - **Federated-ID provisioning race** (user created in IdP, not yet provisioned to Adobe-Org): per-provision retry + alert + dead-letter.
  - **Content-Credentials chain-break** (manifest signature broken on migration): per-manifest signature-re-validate at import + flag + manual re-sign with new key.
  - **Frame.io timecode-pin precision drift** (NTSC-vs-PAL frame-rate, pin off-by-1-frame): per-pin frame-rate-pin + display-tolerance.
  - **Lightroom-Catalog migration challenge** (Lightroom Classic stores catalog locally with proprietary database): per-Catalog export to XMP + DNG + manual-rewrite for advanced metadata.
  - **Substance-3D material-graph dependency** (graph references local file-system material): per-Material graph dependency-resolve + asset-redirect.
  - **Brand-System library version-fork** (designer modifies brand-library locally, conflicts with central): per-library lock-on-edit + merge-tool + conflict-resolution.
  - **Behance public-portfolio takedown** (NDA-bound asset accidentally published): per-asset NDA-flag check at publish + audit + takedown.
  - **Cloud-Document co-edit conflict** (two users edit same PSDC simultaneously): per-document operational-transform or CRDT or last-writer-wins + audit.
  - **Per-asset color-profile mismatch on rendition** (sRGB asset rendered as Adobe-RGB): per-rendition color-profile preserve + ICC-profile pin + delta check.
  - **DMCA takedown notice handling** (third party claims asset infringement): per-asset DMCA-process + counter-notice option + audit.
  - **Per-tenant data-residency-leak** (EU asset stored in US cloud-document region): per-tenant data-residency-pin + per-asset region-check + audit.
  - **Native-app launch-failure post-migration** (app dependency on Adobe-ID service, fails when Adobe-ID disabled): per-app license-rebind window + dual-license window.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — Adobe IO REST API + Creative Cloud Asset API + Libraries API + Adobe Stock API + Adobe Fonts API + Firefly API + Sensei API (limited) + Frame.io API + Adobe Exchange Marketplace API + Admin Console REST (License-Seat + Federated-ID + SSO config) + per-native-app file-format export + per-Brand-System library export + per-Linked-Asset graph traversal; format — native binary (PSD / AI / INDD / PRPROJ / AEP / XD / SBS / etc.) + JSON (API responses) + content-credentials manifest (JSON-LD) + DNG (Lightroom) + XMP (metadata sidecar); duration — ~6-18 months per enterprise tenant due to asset volume (often 100M+ files) + native-format compatibility + Brand-System migration + Federated-ID + native-app license co-existence; volume — typically 100K-100M creative-assets + 1K-50K cloud-documents + 100-5000 libraries + 100-5000 Adobe-Stock licenses + 1K-50K Adobe-Fonts subscriptions + 50-500 Adobe-Exchange plugins + 100-10K Frame.io projects.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Asset preserved with byte-exact native-file + version-history + linked-asset graph + embedded-smart-objects + Adobe-Stock references + Adobe-Fonts used + color-palette + predicted-tags + content-credentials; per-Asset-Version preserved with saved-by + save-comment + tag; per-Linked-Asset graph re-bound; per-Review-Session + Comment + Annotation preserved with pin-position; per-Rendition preserved with format + dimensions + color-profile + compression; per-Brand-System preserved with logo + palette + type-spec + spacing + voice-tone; per-Library preserved with type + members + sharing + permission; per-Cloud-Document preserved with path + version-stream + storage-region; per-Firefly-Generation preserved with commercial-use-eligible + content-credentials; per-Sensei-Action history preserved; per-Adobe-Stock + Adobe-Fonts preserved with license + use-tracking; per-Adobe-Exchange plugin migrated to Oyatie marketplace or gap-list; per-License-Seat + Federated-ID preserved with plan + devices + IdP-binding; per-Frame.io preserved with project + asset + review + comment + approval; lossy — Adobe-Sensei specific AI rebuilt with parity test; some Adobe-Express templates rebuilt; some Substance-3D material specifics rebuilt.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-team staged with native-app license co-existence window 6-12 weeks (Adobe + Oyatie tools concurrent); per-Asset linked-graph re-bound; per-Library re-published; per-Federated-ID re-bound to Oyatie Identity per D-051; per-Frame.io review continued; per-Adobe-Stock license seat-migration; per-Adobe-Fonts subscription-migration; per-Adobe-Exchange plugin migration or gap-list with feature-loss-disclosure; per-Brand-System version-pin; per-Content-Credentials signature chain preserved; per-Cloud-Document co-edit preserved.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 60-120 days with per-Asset open + edit + save-parity 100% + per-Linked-Asset graph-resolve parity 100% + per-Rendition pixel-parity 100% (golden-image diff < 0.5%) + per-Comment pin-position parity 100% + per-Brand-System render-parity 100% + per-Firefly-Generation commercial-use-eligible parity 100% + per-Content-Credentials signature parity 100% + per-Library shared-access parity 100% + per-Frame.io review-parity 100% + per-Federated-ID provision-parity 100% + per-License-Seat assignment-parity 100%; sunset — Creative Cloud subscription sunset; per-tenant retention per regulatory mandate.

- Workflow template library: `creative.share-for-review-with-comment-cycle-and-pin-rebind`; `creative.brand-system-publish-with-version-pin`; `creative.rendition-pipeline-pixel-parity` (PSD → PNG + JPG + WebP + AVIF + HEIC per breakpoint, color-profile preserved); `creative.firefly-generation-with-rights-clearance-and-content-credentials`; `creative.plugin-install-with-license-check-and-publisher-allowlist`; `creative.linked-asset-graph-resolve-with-historical-redirect`; `creative.content-credentials-sign-on-publish`; `creative.adobe-stock-license-tier-aware-use`; `creative.federated-id-provisioning-with-retry-and-dead-letter`; `creative.cloud-document-co-edit-with-conflict-resolution`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (designer + creative-director + brand-mgr + asset-curator + production-coordinator); desktop-primary native-app (Photoshop / Illustrator / InDesign / Premiere / etc.) + cloud-web for review + cloud-document + library-sync; mobile per-review pin-anchored-comments + asset-snap + Adobe-Express simplified-design; per-license seat-management for admins via Admin Console equivalent.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + UK-GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + DMCA / WIPO copyright takedown + per-jurisdiction copyright (EU CDSM + UK + JP + KR); per-asset usage-rights metadata (CC license / commercial-use / NDA-bound); per-Firefly-generation training-data + commercial-use disclosure + Content Authenticity Initiative (CAI) / C2PA Content-Credentials; per-tenant data-residency; HIPAA when asset contains PHI; per-DMCA takedown SLA per-jurisdiction.
- Naming justification: `design-collaboration` + `drive` + `intelligence` + `marketplace` + `identity` are canonical; `adobe-creative-cloud`, `creative-cloud`, `photoshop`, `illustrator`, `indesign`, `premiere`, `after-effects`, `xd`, `lightroom`, `acrobat`, `firefly`, `frame-io`, `substance-3d`, `adobe-express`, `adobe-stock`, `adobe-fonts`, `behance`, `adobe-exchange` are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-061 - HubSpot Marketing Hub
- Vendor name and category: HubSpot Marketing Hub — Workflows + Lists (active + static) + Forms + Landing-Pages + Email + Blog + SEO-Topic-Clusters + CTAs (Calls-to-Action) + Ads-Sync (Facebook / Google / LinkedIn) + Smart-Content + ABM-Tools + Predictive-Lead-Scoring + Social-Inbox + Campaigns + Marketing-Events + Marketing-SMS / WhatsApp + AI-Content-Assistant + Breeze AI / HubSpot ecosystem / B2B + SMB + B2C inbound-marketing automation built atop HubSpot CRM substrate.
- Coverage tier: D (microservice: `marketing-automation` per ADR-0299). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Marketing Hub Starter (basic email + forms + landing pages + simple-automation + ads) → **Bronze**; Marketing Hub Professional (Starter + workflows + lists + predictive-lead-scoring + ABM + campaigns + smart-content + AB-testing) → **Silver**; Marketing Hub Enterprise (Pro + multi-touch revenue-attribution + adaptive-testing + hierarchical-teams + advanced-permissions + custom-reporting + content-partitioning) → **Gold**; Enterprise + Breeze AI + AI-Content-Assistant + Marketing-SMS + WhatsApp + Sales-AI bridge → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `marketing-automation` (Workflow + List + Form + Landing-Page + Email + Blog + SEO + CTA + Smart-Content + Ads-Sync + ABM + Campaign + Marketing-Event); `crm` (HubSpot CRM Contact + Company + Deal + Ticket sync per D-062); `community` (Blog + Social-Inbox); `intelligence` (Predictive-Lead-Scoring + AI-Content-Assistant + Breeze AI); `cloud-cdn` (HubSpot CMS Hub for hosted pages, per D-064 if also in scope); `comms-email` + `comms-sms` + `comms-whatsapp` (channel rails); `consent-and-privacy` (GDPR Subscription Preferences + Marketing Contacts model + Subscription Center).

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<hubspot-marketer-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktPublishWorkflow", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktEnrollInWorkflow",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktUnenrollFromWorkflow", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktCreateList",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktAddToList", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktRemoveFromList",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktPublishForm", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktPublishLandingPage",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktSendMarketingEmail", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktScheduleBlogPost",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktRunSEORecommendation", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktChangeLifecycleStage",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktRunLeadScoreRecompute", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktConfigureRevenueAttribution",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktRunABTest", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktConfigureSmartContent",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktSyncAdsAudience", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktConfigureMarketingEvent",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktConfigureCampaign", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktConfigureSubscriptionType",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsMktExportContactList", Oyatie::Action::"HsMktConfigurePortalSettings"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::MarketingAsset::"<id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    hubspot_marketing_role_grants(principal, action, resource.team_partition) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktSendMarketingEmail" ? recipient_population_governed(resource.recipient_filter) && suppression_lists_applied(context.email) && marketing_contact_count_within_plan_limit(context.tenant) && consent_resolved_per_jurisdiction(resource.recipient_filter, context.subscription_type) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktChangeLifecycleStage" ? transition_governed(context.contact, context.from_stage, context.to_stage) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktRunLeadScoreRecompute" ? deterministic_replay_required(context.cohort) && score_history_snapshot_preserved(context.cohort) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktConfigureSubscriptionType" ? subscription_change_logged_per_jurisdiction(resource.subscription_type, context.delta) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktSyncAdsAudience" ? ad_platform_dpa_signed(context.platform) && consent_explicit_for_ads_use(resource.audience) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktExportContactList" ? data_export_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && dual_admin_approval(context) && pii_scrubbed_per_export_policy(context.fields) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktConfigureRevenueAttribution" ? attribution_model_explainable(context.model) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktRunABTest" ? statistical_power_sufficient(context.test) && minimum_test_duration_respected(context.test) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktPublishLandingPage" ? gdpr_consent_checkbox_present_if_eu_traffic(context.page) && accessibility_check_passed(context.page) : true) &&
    (resource.contact.jurisdiction == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && lawful_basis_for_processing(resource.contact, context.purpose) && (resource.subscription_type.gdpr_consent_required ? consent_explicit_double_opt_in(resource.contact) : true) : true) &&
    (resource.contact.jurisdiction == "US" && action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktSendMarketingEmail" ? context.pack.contains("CAN-SPAM") && physical_address_in_footer(context.email) && unsubscribe_link_present(context.email) : true) &&
    (resource.contact.jurisdiction == "CA" && action == Oyatie::Action::"HsMktSendMarketingEmail" ? context.pack.contains("CASL") && express_or_implied_consent_present(resource.contact) : true) &&
    (resource.contact.jurisdiction == "KR" ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") && marketing_consent_explicit(resource.contact) : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Workflow` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::workflow` (with type + status + triggers + actions + goals + suppression + settings).
  - `List` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::list` (with type (active/static) + object-type + filter-branches + member-count + dependencies).
  - `Marketing_Contact` → `Oyatie::Crm::contact` + `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::marketing_contact_state` (with lifecycle-stage + scores + marketing-contact-status + subscription-preferences + lifecycle-stage-timestamps + original-source + custom-properties).
  - `Form` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::form` (with type + fields + progressive-profiling-rules + submit-action + captcha + GDPR-consent + cookies-settings).
  - `Landing_Page` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::landing_page` (with template + modules + smart-content-rules + AB-variants + CTAs + forms + SEO + domain + translation-versions).
  - `Marketing_Email` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::email` (with subject + preview + from + body + variables + subscription-type + send-type + recipient-filter + suppression + smart-content + AB-variants + performance).

  - `CTA` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::cta` (with type + variants + audience-filter + tracking-token + used-on-pages + used-in-emails).
  - `Smart_Content_Rule` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::smart_content_rule` (with asset-reference + conditions + variants + default).
  - `Topic_Cluster` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::topic_cluster` (with pillar-page + subtopics + SEO-recommendations).
  - `Lead_Score_Rule` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::lead_score_rule` (with type (standard/predictive) + rule-definition + score-property + audience-filter + weight + decay).

  - `Ads_Audience` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::ads_audience` (with source-list + platform + lookalike + cost-tracking).

- **Specific workflow steps** (HubSpot Marketing Hub displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-portal Marketing-Contact count (often 100K-10M) + Marketing-vs-Non-Marketing breakdown + Workflow count + List count (active + static) + Form + Landing-Page + Marketing-Email + Blog-Post + CTA + Smart-Content-Rule + Topic-Cluster + Lead-Score-Rule + Lifecycle-Stage-Transition history + Subscription-Type + Campaign + Marketing-Event + Ads-Audience + Revenue-Attribution-Report + AB-Test + Adaptive-Test + per-portal Operations-Hub Custom-Code + per-team partition.
  2. **Marketing-Contact extraction**: per-Contact email + lifecycle-stage + scores + marketing-contact-status + subscription-preferences + lifecycle-stage-timestamps + original-source + custom-properties + form-submissions history + page-views + email-engagements.
  3. **Workflow extraction**: per-Workflow type + status + enrollment-triggers + actions + branches + goals + suppression-lists + settings; per-Workflow enrollment-history.
  4. **List extraction**: per-List type (active/static) + object-type + filter-branches + member-count + dependencies; per-Active-List rebuild-semantics preserved.
  5. **Form + Progressive-Profiling extraction**: per-Form type + fields + progressive-profiling-rules + submit-action + captcha + GDPR-consent + cookies; preserve per-form field-order-pin.
  6. **Landing-Page + Smart-Content extraction**: per-Page template + modules + smart-content-rules + AB-variants + CTAs + forms + SEO + domain + translation-versions.
  7. **Marketing-Email extraction**: per-Email subject + preview + from + body + variables + subscription-type + send-type + recipient-filter + suppression + smart-content + AB-variants + performance.
  8. **Blog + SEO + Topic-Cluster extraction**: per-Post URL-slug + body + author + publish-date + tags + topic-cluster + SEO + meta-description + featured-image + translation-versions; per-Cluster pillar-page + subtopics + keyword-difficulty + search-volume.
  9. **CTA + Tracking-Token extraction**: per-CTA type + variants + audience-filter + tracking-token + used-on-pages + used-in-emails.
  10. **Lead-Score-Rule extraction**: per-Rule standard (manual) vs predictive (ML) + rule-definition + score-property + audience-filter + weight + decay; per-Contact score-history.
  11. **Lifecycle-Stage-Transition extraction**: per-Contact transition history with from-stage + to-stage + trigger-source + timestamp + reason.
  12. **Subscription-Type extraction**: per-Type GDPR-consent-required + default-opt-in-state + confirmation-email + per-jurisdiction-behavior; per-Contact opt-in/opt-out history.
  13. **Campaign + Marketing-Event extraction**: per-Campaign goal + linked-assets + cost + performance; per-Event type + registration + reminder + attendance + linked-workflow.
  14. **Ads-Audience extraction**: per-Audience source-list + platform + lookalike + cost + sync-history.
  15. **Revenue-Attribution-Report extraction**: per-Report model + touchpoint-hierarchy + pipeline-influence + won-deal-influence.
  16. **AB-Test + Adaptive-Test extraction**: per-Test variants + winning-criterion + statistical-significance + auto-allocation-strategy.
  17. **Operations-Hub Custom-Code extraction**: per-Workflow JavaScript/Python action code preserved + execution-context.
  18. **Per-Active-List rule + rebuild-semantics-pin**: per-List rule preserved + rebuild-trigger preserved + dependency-graph preserved.
  19. **Per-CTA tracking-URL redirect**: per-CTA URL preserved with redirect window (typically 24 months for external sites) + 410-Gone after sunset.
  20. **Per-Progressive-Profiling field-order preservation**: per-Form field-order-pin + per-Contact progressive-profile-state preserved.
  21. **Per-Lead-Score recompute deterministic-replay**: per-Cohort score-history with timestamps preserved + per-recompute deterministic replay validated.
  22. **Per-Predictive-Lead-Score model retrain**: per-Model retrained on Oyatie intelligence with parity test ≥ 95%.
  23. **Per-Subscription-Type GDPR / CAN-SPAM / CASL preservation**: per-Type + per-Contact consent-state preserved with jurisdiction-pin.
  24. **Per-Tracking-Code domain migration**: per-Portal tracking-domain CNAME + per-cookie consent + per-event dual-fire window.
  25. **Per-Ads-Audience re-bind**: per-Audience platform (Facebook / Google / LinkedIn / TikTok / Microsoft-Ads) re-bound; per-Audience consent-explicit-for-ads-use validated.
  26. **Parallel run**: 60-90 day shadow with sample portal + per-Workflow enrollment-parity 100% + per-List membership-parity 100% + per-Email send-parity 100% + per-CTA click-parity ± 0.5% + per-Lead-Score recompute-parity 100% + per-Predictive-Score parity ≥ 95% + per-Lifecycle-Stage transition-parity 100% + per-Subscription preference-parity 100% + per-Attribution-Report value-parity 100%.
  27. **Cutover**: per-portal staged with dual-fire window 8-12 weeks; per-Tracking-Code domain redirect (24 months); per-CTA URL-redirect (24 months + 410-Gone); per-Subscription-Center URL-redirect; per-Ads-Audience re-bind; per-Custom-Code re-deployed.
  28. **Sunset**: HubSpot Marketing Hub subscription sunset; per-portal retention per regulatory mandate (consent-history 7-10 years; raw engagement 25 months; summarized longer).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Active-list-rebuild storm** (rule change triggers re-evaluation of 10M+ contacts): per-rebuild backpressure + priority-queue + scheduled-window + alert.
  - **Workflow re-enrollment-rule drift** (contact re-enrolls unexpectedly due to misconfig): per-Workflow re-enrollment-rule explicit-pin + audit + impact-simulation.
  - **CTA-tracking-URL persistence** (legacy CTAs on external sites generate 404 post-migration): per-CTA URL-redirect + 410-Gone-after-sunset + per-site comm.
  - **Progressive-profiling form-field-reorder loss** (form re-ordered, user re-asked same question): per-form field-order-pin + per-contact progressive-profile-state pin + audit.
  - **Lead-score recompute deterministic-replay drift** (recompute produces different scores): per-Cohort score-history with snapshot timestamps + per-recompute deterministic replay validation.
  - **Predictive-Lead-Score model retrain drift** (Oyatie model labels different contacts as MQL): per-labeled-MQL parity test + retrain until ≥ 95% parity.
  - **Marketing-vs-Non-Marketing Contact billing surprise** (mass-marketing send to non-marketing contacts incurs charges): per-send marketing-contact-count check + alert + abort if exceeded.
  - **Subscription Preferences leak across portals** (one portal opt-out, another portal still sends): per-portal subscription-scope + cross-portal reconcile + audit.
  - **GDPR-Consent checkbox absence on EU traffic** (form lacks consent checkbox): per-form jurisdiction-detect + enforce GDPR-consent + audit.
  - **Smart-Content audience-mismatch** (visitor sees wrong variant): per-rule audience-resolution validation suite + render-preview.
  - **Topic-Cluster pillar-page broken-link** (pillar moved, subtopics 404): per-cluster link-graph + redirect + alert.
  - **AB-test statistical-power overestimate** (winner declared with insufficient sample): per-test sample-size validator + early-stop guard + minimum-duration floor.
  - **Adaptive-test bandit cold-start exploitation** (multi-armed bandit gets stuck on early winner): per-bandit exploration-floor + minimum-allocation per variant + retest cadence.
  - **Lifecycle-Stage-Transition cycle** (Contact loops Lead → MQL → Lead → MQL): per-Transition cycle-detection + audit + manual review.
  - **Workflow Custom-Code execution failure** (JS error in custom action): per-action error-handling + dead-letter + alert + manual retry.
  - **Ads-Audience consent leak** (audience sync to Facebook includes opted-out contacts): per-audience consent-check + per-platform DPA + audit.
  - **Marketing-Event registration-attendance sync drift** (registered-but-not-attended status mis-sync): per-event sync-state-machine + audit.
  - **Revenue-Attribution-Report multi-touch model selection ambiguity** (W-shaped vs Time-Decay give different revenue): per-Report explicit-model-pin + comparison UI + audit.
  - **Per-portal teams partition leak** (Team-A workflow accidentally enrolls Team-B contacts): per-team Cedar default-deny + audit + visibility-test.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — HubSpot CRM v3 API (Contacts + Companies + Deals + Tickets + Custom-Objects) + Marketing v3 API (Emails + Forms + Transactional + Workflows + Lists) + CMS v3 (Blogs + Pages) + Analytics v4 + Conversations API + Reporting API + Files API + Operations Hub Custom-Code export + Webhook Subscriptions inventory + Tracking-Code inventory + Subscription Preferences Center export; format — JSON + HTML (email + landing-page) + REST-paginated; duration — ~2-6 months per enterprise portal due to Marketing-Contact volume + workflow count + dependency-graph + per-team partition; volume — typically 100K-10M contacts + 100-5000 workflows + 100-50000 lists + 100-5000 forms + 100-5000 landing-pages + 100-50000 emails + 100-10000 blog-posts + 1K-100K CTAs + 10-1000 campaigns.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Marketing-Contact preserved with lifecycle-stage + scores + subscription-preferences + lifecycle-stage-timestamps + custom-properties + form-submissions history; per-Workflow preserved with triggers + actions + branches + goals + suppression + re-enrollment-rule pinned; per-List preserved with type + filter-branches + rebuild-semantics; per-Form preserved with progressive-profiling-rules + field-order-pin; per-Landing-Page + Smart-Content + AB-variants preserved; per-Email preserved with subject + body + variables + subscription-type + recipient-filter + suppression + smart-content + AB-variants + performance; per-Blog + SEO + Topic-Cluster preserved; per-CTA + Tracking-Token preserved with URL-redirect; per-Lead-Score-Rule preserved with type + rule-definition; per-Lifecycle-Stage-Transition preserved with timestamps; per-Subscription-Type preserved with consent-state per-jurisdiction; per-Campaign + Marketing-Event preserved; per-Ads-Audience preserved with platform + consent; per-Revenue-Attribution-Report preserved with model + hierarchy; per-AB-Test + Adaptive-Test preserved with variants + statistical-significance; per-Operations-Hub Custom-Code preserved; lossy — Breeze AI + AI-Content-Assistant specifics rebuilt with parity test; some HubSpot-native template patterns rebuilt; some Operations Hub-specific data-quality-automation rebuilt.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-portal staged with dual-fire window 8-12 weeks; per-Tracking-Code domain redirect 24 months; per-CTA URL-redirect 24 months + 410-Gone after sunset; per-Subscription-Center URL-redirect; per-Ads-Audience re-bind with platform DPA + consent-explicit-for-ads; per-Custom-Code re-deployed; per-Active-List rule preserved with rebuild-semantics-pin; per-Predictive-Score model retrained with parity test.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 60-90 days with per-Workflow enrollment-parity 100% + per-List membership-parity 100% + per-Email send-parity 100% + per-CTA click-parity ± 0.5% + per-Lead-Score recompute-parity 100% + per-Predictive-Score parity ≥ 95% + per-Lifecycle-Stage transition-parity 100% + per-Subscription preference-parity 100% + per-Attribution-Report value-parity 100% + per-AB-test statistical-equivalence + per-Form submission-parity 100% + per-Blog-Post SEO-rank-parity preserved; sunset — HubSpot Marketing Hub subscription sunset.

- Workflow template library: `hubspot_marketing.workflow-enrollment-with-re-enrollment-rule-pinned`; `hubspot_marketing.active-list-recompute-on-property-change-with-backpressure`; `hubspot_marketing.form-submission-with-progressive-profiling-field-order-pin`; `hubspot_marketing.blog-post-with-SEO-topic-cluster-and-pillar-link-check`; `hubspot_marketing.AB-test-with-significance-gate-and-minimum-duration`; `hubspot_marketing.adaptive-test-bandit-with-exploration-floor`; `hubspot_marketing.lifecycle-stage-transition-with-cycle-detect`; `hubspot_marketing.subscription-aware-send-per-jurisdiction` (CAN-SPAM + CASL + GDPR + KR-PIPA); `hubspot_marketing.ads-audience-sync-with-consent-explicit-check`; `hubspot_marketing.revenue-attribution-with-explicit-model-pin`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (B2B marketer + content-creator + marketing-ops + SEO-strategist + campaign-mgr); desktop-primary workflow + content-editor + smart-content + AB-test + smart-list + lead-scoring + subscription-preferences; per-asset preview + mobile-preview; mobile read-only campaign-monitor; per-team partition view.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + UK-GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + EU ePrivacy + CAN-SPAM + CASL + UK-PECR + per-jurisdiction marketing-consent (DE double-opt-in + AT + FR + KR + JP APPI + IN DPDP + BR LGPD); HIPAA when contacts include patient-context; per-portal data-residency (US-only + EU + APAC for some plans).
- Naming justification: `marketing-automation` is canonical (per ADR-0299); `hubspot-marketing-hub`, `hubspot`, `marketing-hub`, `hubspot-cms`, `hubspot-cms-hub`, `breeze-ai` (cross-link to D-064 CMS-Hub) are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-062 - HubSpot Sales Hub
- Vendor name and category: HubSpot Sales Hub — Sales-CRM (Contact + Company + Deal + Ticket + Custom-Object) + Sales-Sequences + Snippets + Templates + Documents (with view-tracking) + Meetings (booking-page) + Quotes (with eSignature) + Products + Line-Items + Playbooks + Conversation-Intelligence + Forecasting + Deal-Rotation + Lead-Routing + Predictive-Lead-Scoring + Sales-Hub-AI + Breeze AI + Account-Based-Selling + Sales-Analytics + per-currency multi-currency / HubSpot ecosystem / B2B + SMB + B2C sales-engagement and CRM built atop the HubSpot CRM substrate.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `crm` + `workflow-engine` + `intelligence`). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Sales Hub Starter (basic CRM + Snippets + Templates + Documents + Meetings) → **Bronze**; Sales Hub Professional (Starter + Sequences + Playbooks + Forecasting + Quotes + multi-currency + Custom-Objects + Predictive-Lead-Scoring + Deal-Stage-Properties) → **Silver**; Sales Hub Enterprise (Pro + Hierarchical-Teams + Custom-Permissions + Sales-Analytics + Conversation-Intelligence + Lead-Routing + Deal-Rotation + Account-Based-Selling + Custom-Reporting) → **Gold**; Enterprise + Breeze AI + Sales-Hub-AI + WhatsApp-Sales + Cross-Object Custom-Reporting + Advanced Forecasting → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `crm` (Contact + Company + Deal + Ticket + Custom-Object — primary); `workflow-engine` (Sequences + Tasks + Playbook-steps + Lead-Routing + Deal-Rotation); `intelligence` (Conversation-Intelligence + call-recording-transcription + sentiment + topic-extraction + Breeze AI / Sales-Hub-AI); `comms-email` (Sequence + 1:1 email delivery rail with throttling per send-from-Gmail / Outlook / O365 / Exchange); `marketplace` (Quote-to-cash with DealSet per ADR-0249); `payments` (HubSpot Payments / Stripe integration for Quote-to-Pay); `apigw` (Meetings booking iframe + Quote acceptance link).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (HubSpot Sales Hub model):
  - `Contact` (Contact_ID, Email, First/Last_Name, Phone, Company_Reference, Job_Title, Lifecycle_Stage, Lead_Status, Owner_Reference (HubSpot User), HubSpot_Score, Predictive_Lead_Score, Last-Modified, Last-Activity-Date, Form_Submissions[], Custom_Properties{}).
  - `Company` (Company_ID, Name, Domain, Industry, Annual_Revenue, Employee_Count, City, State, Country, Owner-Reference, Lifecycle-Stage, Custom-Properties{}, Associated-Contacts[], Associated-Deals[]).
  - `Deal` (Deal_ID, Deal_Name, Pipeline-Reference, Deal_Stage-Reference, Amount, Currency, Close_Date, Owner-Reference, Deal_Type {New-Business / Existing-Business}, Priority {Low / Medium / High}, Associated-Contacts[], Associated-Companies[], Associated-Line-Items[], Forecast_Category {Pipeline / Best-Case / Commit / Closed / Omitted}, Probability, Weighted_Amount, Custom-Properties{}).

  - `Pipeline` (Pipeline_ID, Display-Name, Object-Type {Deal / Ticket / Custom-Object}, Stages[Deal-Stage-Reference], Default-Owner).
  - `Ticket` (Ticket_ID, Subject, Description, Pipeline-Reference, Ticket-Status-Reference, Priority, Owner-Reference, Source {Email / Form / Chat / Phone / API / Custom}, Associated-Contact / Company / Deal / Conversation, SLA-Reference, Created-DateTime, Closed-DateTime).
  - `Sequence` (Sequence_ID, Name, Steps[Step-Type {Email / Task / LinkedIn-/ LinkedIn-InMail / Call-Task / Manual-Task / Custom}, Delay-After-Previous, Day-of-Week-Constraints], Default-Time-of-Day, Default-Time-Zone, Throttling (per-day-per-rep cap), Branding, Active-Enrollment-Count).
  - `Sequence_Enrollment` (Enrollment_ID, Sequence-Reference, Contact-Reference, Enrolled-By, Current-Step, Status {Active / Paused / Completed / Cancelled / Unenrolled-by-Reply / Unenrolled-by-Meeting-Booked / Unenrolled-Manual}, Started-DateTime, Unenrolled-Reason).
  - `Task` (Task_ID, Subject, Type {Email / Call / To-Do / Linked-In / Custom}, Owner-Reference, Associated-Object-Reference, Due-DateTime, Status {Not-Started / In-Progress / Waiting / Completed / Deferred}, Priority, Reminder-Lead-Time, Auto-Created-by-Sequence: bool).

  - `Quote` (Quote_ID, Deal-Reference, Status {Draft / Sent / Approved / Rejected / Signed / Expired}, Title, Currency, Line-Items[Line-Item-Reference + Quantity + Unit-Price + Discount + Term-Length + Recurring-Settings], Subtotal, Tax, Total, Validity-Window, Signer-Configuration, Approval-Workflow-Reference, Payment-Settings (HubSpot-Payments / Stripe / Manual), Quote-Template-Reference, Generated-PDF-Reference, Signed-PDF-Reference, Sign-Audit-Trail).

  - `Line_Item` (Line-Item_ID, Product-Reference, Deal-Reference, Quote-Reference, Quantity, Unit-Price-Override, Discount-Type {Percentage / Amount}, Discount-Value, Term-Length, Recurring-Settings).

  - `Conversation_Intelligence_Record` (CI_ID, Call-Reference, Transcript, Speaker-Diarization, Talk-to-Listen-Ratio, Topics-Detected[], Coaching-Moments-Flagged[], Sentiment-Per-Speaker, Action-Items, Linked-Object).
  - `Forecast` (Forecast_ID, Period {Month / Quarter / Year}, Forecast-Category-Roll-Up {Pipeline + Best-Case + Commit + Closed}, Manager-Adjusted-Value, Snapshot-DateTime, Linked-Deals).
  - `Lead_Routing_Rule` (Rule_ID, Trigger {New-Lead-Created / Form-Submission / List-Membership}, Conditions[Property-Filter], Assignment-Algorithm {Round-Robin / Weighted-Round-Robin / Highest-Available / Specific-User / By-Territory / By-Account-Owner}, Fallback-Assignee).
  - `Deal_Rotation_Rule` (Rule_ID, Trigger, Conditions, Assignment-Algorithm, Fallback).
  - `Quote_Template` (Template_ID, Name, Branding, Layout, Fields-Displayed[], eSignature-Configuration, Payment-Link-Display, Custom-Sections[]).
  - `Snippet` (Snippet_ID, Name, Content, Shortcut, Per-Team-Visibility).
  - `Email_Template` (Template_ID, Name, Subject, Body, Variables{Personalization-Tokens}, Per-Team-Visibility, Used-In-Sequences[]).
  - `Document` (Doc_ID, Name, File-Reference, View-Tracking-Enabled: bool, View-Events[Viewer + DateTime + Duration + Pages-Viewed], Per-Document-Sharing-Permission).
  - `Team_and_User_Hierarchy` (User_ID, Email, Display_Name, Role-References[], Team-References (Hierarchical), Region-Assignment, License-Status).

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<sdr-or-ae-or-sales-mgr-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesEnrollInSequence", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesUnenrollFromSequence",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesLogCall", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesLogMeeting",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesLogEmail", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesLogNote",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesBookMeeting", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesGenerateQuote",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesSendQuote", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesAcceptQuote",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesSignQuote", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesAcceptPayment",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesRunPlaybook", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesChangeDealStage",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesChangeDealOwner", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesRunDealRotationRule",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesRunLeadRoutingRule", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesConfigureForecast",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesAccessConvIntelligence", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesCreateSequenceTemplate",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesCreateEmailTemplate", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesExportRecordList",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesConfigureCustomObject", Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesConfigureTeamHierarchy"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::CrmRecord::"<id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    sales_role_grants(principal, action, resource.team_partition) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesLogCall" ? call_recording_consent_per_jurisdiction(resource.linked_contact, context.recording) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesAccessConvIntelligence" ? principal.has_role("CI-Access") && recording_consent_verified(context.recording) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesGenerateQuote" ? deal_currency_pinned(resource.deal) && line_items_governance_check(context.line_items) && per_jurisdiction_tax_calculated(context.quote) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesSendQuote" ? quote_validates(context.quote) && approval_workflow_complete_if_required(context.quote) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesAcceptPayment" ? payment_processor_dpa_signed(context.processor) && payment_currency_matches_quote(context.quote, context.payment) && pci_dss_compliance_pack_active(context.tenant) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesChangeDealStage" ? required_properties_complete(resource.deal, context.target_stage) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesEnrollInSequence" ? not(already_enrolled(resource.contact, context.sequence)) && contact_marketing_consent_or_business_relationship(resource.contact) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesRunDealRotationRule" ? rule_no_team_partition_leak(context.rule) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesExportRecordList" ? data_export_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && dual_admin_approval(context) && pii_scrubbed_per_export_policy(context.fields) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesConfigureCustomObject" ? principal.has_role("HubSpot-Admin") && custom_object_governance_check(context.object) : true) &&
    (resource.contact.jurisdiction == "EU" && action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesLogCall" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && context.pack.contains("EU-Recording-Consent") && recording_consent_explicit(resource.contact, context.recording) : true) &&
    (resource.contact.jurisdiction == "US-CA" && action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesLogCall" ? context.pack.contains("CA-Two-Party-Recording-Consent") : true) &&
    (resource.contact.jurisdiction == "KR" ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") && (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesLogCall" ? recording_consent_explicit(resource.contact) : true) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsSalesAcceptPayment" && context.payment.method == "card" ? context.pack.contains("PCI-DSS") : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Contact` + `Company` + `Deal` + `Ticket` + `Custom-Object` → `Oyatie::Crm::contact` + `Oyatie::Crm::company` + `Oyatie::Crm::deal` + `Oyatie::Itsm::ticket` + `Oyatie::Crm::custom_object` (with properties + associations + custom-properties + owner).
  - `Deal_Stage` + `Pipeline` → `Oyatie::Crm::deal_stage` + `Oyatie::Crm::pipeline` (with object-type + stages + probability + required-properties).
  - `Sequence` + `Sequence_Enrollment` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::sequence` + `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::sequence_enrollment` (with steps + delay + day-of-week + throttling + current-step + status + unenrolled-reason).
  - `Task` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::task` (with type + owner + associated-object + due + status + priority + reminder + auto-created-by-sequence).
  - `Call` → `Oyatie::Crm::call` (with direction + status + duration + disposition + numbers + linked-object + recording + transcript).
  - `Meeting` + `Meeting_Booking_Page` → `Oyatie::Crm::meeting` + `Oyatie::Crm::booking_page` (with start + end + TZ + attendees + booking-source + status; booking-page with availability + buffer + lead-time).
  - `Quote` + `Quote_Template` → `Oyatie::Marketplace::quote` + `Oyatie::Marketplace::quote_template` (with status + line-items + signer + approval + payment-link + branding).
  - `Product` + `Line_Item` → `Oyatie::Marketplace::product` + `Oyatie::Marketplace::line_item` (with SKU + unit-price + currency + term-length + recurring-frequency + tax).
  - `Playbook` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::playbook` (with questions + embed-locations + required-on-stage).
  - `Conversation_Intelligence_Record` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::conversation_intelligence` (with transcript + speaker-diarization + sentiment + topics + coaching-moments + action-items).
  - `Forecast` → `Oyatie::Crm::forecast` (with period + forecast-category-roll-up + manager-adjusted + snapshot).
  - `Lead_Routing_Rule` + `Deal_Rotation_Rule` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::routing_rule` (with trigger + conditions + assignment-algorithm + fallback).
  - `Snippet` + `Email_Template` + `Document` → `Oyatie::Crm::snippet` + `Oyatie::Crm::email_template` + `Oyatie::Drive::document` (with shortcut + visibility + view-tracking).
  - `Team_and_User_Hierarchy` → `Oyatie::Identity::team_hierarchy` (with role + team + region + license-status).

- **Specific workflow steps** (HubSpot Sales Hub displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-portal Contact + Company + Deal + Ticket + Custom-Object count + per-Pipeline + Deal-Stage + per-Sequence count (often 50-500 active) + Sequence-Enrollment count + Task backlog + Call recording-history + Meeting + Booking-Page + Quote + Product + Line-Item + Playbook + Conversation-Intelligence retention + Forecast snapshots + Lead-Routing-Rule + Deal-Rotation-Rule + Snippet + Email-Template + Document + per-Team hierarchy + per-User license-status + per-Custom-Object count.
  2. **Per-object extraction**: per-Contact + Company + Deal + Ticket + Custom-Object via CRM v3 API with associations + custom-properties + owner; per-Engagement (call + meeting + task + email + note) preserved with linked-objects + history.
  3. **Per-Pipeline + Deal-Stage extraction**: per-Pipeline display + object-type + stages; per-Stage required-properties + probability + order.
  4. **Per-Sequence + Sequence-Enrollment extraction**: per-Sequence steps + delay + day-of-week + throttling + branding; per-Enrollment current-step + status + unenrolled-reason.
  5. **Per-Task extraction**: per-Task subject + type + owner + due + status + priority + reminder + auto-created-by-sequence.
  6. **Per-Call extraction**: per-Call direction + status + duration + disposition + numbers + linked-object + recording-reference + transcript + notes + owner.
  7. **Per-Meeting + Booking-Page extraction**: per-Meeting title + start + end + TZ + attendees + location + booking-source + status + notes; per-Page booking-type + availability + buffer + form-fields + URL.
  8. **Per-Quote + Quote-Template + Product + Line-Item extraction**: per-Quote status + currency + line-items + subtotal + tax + total + validity + signer + approval + payment-settings + generated-PDF + signed-PDF + audit-trail; per-Product SKU + unit-price + currency + term-length + recurring + tax; per-Line-Item product + quantity + unit-price-override + discount + term + recurring.
  9. **Per-Playbook extraction**: per-Playbook questions + save-answer-to-property + embed-locations + required-on-stage.
  10. **Per-Conversation-Intelligence extraction**: per-CI-Record transcript + speaker-diarization + sentiment + topics + coaching-moments + action-items; preserve per-recording consent-pin.
  11. **Per-Forecast snapshot extraction**: per-Period roll-up + manager-adjusted + best-case + commit + closed.
  12. **Per-Lead-Routing + Deal-Rotation-Rule extraction**: per-Rule trigger + conditions + assignment-algorithm + fallback.
  13. **Per-Snippet + Email-Template extraction**: per-Snippet content + shortcut + per-team-visibility; per-Template subject + body + variables + per-team-visibility.
  14. **Per-Document extraction**: per-Doc name + file + view-tracking + view-events + sharing-permission.
  15. **Per-Team-Hierarchy extraction**: per-User role + team + region + license-status; preserve hierarchical-team structure.
  16. **Per-Custom-Object schema + record extraction**: per-Custom-Object schema + properties + associations + records.
  17. **Per-Custom-Code (Operations Hub) extraction**: per-workflow JavaScript / Python action preserved.
  18. **Per-Call recording-consent jurisdiction preservation**: per-Recording jurisdiction-pin + consent-record + retention-pin (typically 30-90 days for non-recorded states; 7 years for consent-recorded with audit-trail).
  19. **Per-Quote eSignature transition**: per-Quote → Oyatie ContractLifecycleManagement (per D-059 pattern); preserve signed-PDF + audit-trail + LTV-evidence.
  20. **Per-Quote payment-link transition**: per-payment-link re-issued via Oyatie payments (Stripe / HubSpot-Payments equivalent); per-quote currency-pin preserved.
  21. **Per-Sequence-Enrollment idempotency**: per-Contact dedup-key + per-Sequence one-active-enrollment rule preserved.
  22. **Per-Meeting time-zone explicit display**: per-Meeting TZ-pin + booking-confirmation + per-recipient TZ-display.
  23. **Per-Conversation-Intelligence model retrain**: per-coaching-model retrained on Oyatie intelligence with parity ≥ 95% + per-reviewer-gate for false-positive risk.
  24. **Per-Forecast snapshot deterministic-replay**: per-Period snapshot preserved + replay-determinism validated.
  25. **Per-Lead-Routing + Deal-Rotation team-partition isolation**: per-Rule per-team scope + Cedar default-deny + visibility-test cohort.
  26. **Parallel run**: 30-90 day shadow with sample portal + per-Contact + Company + Deal sync-parity 100% + per-Sequence enrollment-parity 100% + per-Task + Call + Meeting log-parity 100% + per-Quote + Line-Item value-parity 100% + per-Conversation-Intelligence coaching-parity ≥ 95% + per-Forecast snapshot-parity 100% + per-Routing-Rule assignment-parity 100%.
  27. **Cutover**: per-team staged with dual-engagement window 4-8 weeks; per-Sequence active-enrollments resume; per-Booking-Page URL-redirect (12-24 months); per-Quote signed/payable links re-issued; per-Conversation-Intelligence consent-pin preserved; per-Custom-Object schema migrated.
  28. **Sunset**: HubSpot Sales Hub subscription sunset; per-portal retention per regulatory mandate (recordings 7 years if consent-state; deals 7 years for SOX-bound; per-jurisdiction per-PII).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Sequence-enrollment double-fire on import** (contact enrolled twice in same sequence): per-contact + per-sequence idempotent dedup-key + audit.
  - **Call-recording-consent jurisdiction drift** (record where consent required, no consent obtained): per-recording jurisdiction-pin + consent-record retention + abort-on-missing.
  - **Quote-product-line currency mismatch on cross-pipeline deals** (USD product on EUR deal): per-deal currency-pin + per-line-item revalue + audit.
  - **Meeting-booking time-zone confusion** (cross-TZ booking off by hours): per-booking explicit-TZ display + confirmation + per-attendee TZ-pin.
  - **Conversation-intelligence-coaching false-positive** (innocent rep flagged for "interrupting"): per-coaching-event reviewer-gate + override option + audit.
  - **Quote eSignature LTV-evidence loss** (signed PDF stored without LTV bundle): per-quote LTV-evidence bundle + cert-chain + OCSP + timestamp preserved.
  - **Deal-stage-change required-property bypass** (deal advances without required properties filled): per-stage transition required-property check + abort + audit.
  - **Lead-Routing round-robin team-bleed** (Rule-A round-robins across Team-B reps unexpectedly): per-rule team-scope + Cedar default-deny + audit.
  - **Per-rep email send-throttle bypass** (rep exceeds gmail send-cap, account suspended): per-rep send-throttle + alert + abort.
  - **Quote-payment race** (payment captured for already-cancelled quote): per-quote state-machine + payment-pre-check + refund-on-conflict.
  - **Conversation-Intelligence PII leakage** (transcript surfaces credit-card numbers spoken on call): per-transcript PII-scrub + masking + audit.
  - **Forecast snapshot mutation** (historical forecast value changes retroactively): per-snapshot immutable-pin + audit on any drift.
  - **Playbook required-question skip** (rep marks deal advanced without playbook complete): per-playbook required-on-stage enforcement + audit.
  - **Custom-Object schema-evolution break** (field added, existing automation breaks): per-schema impact-simulation + governance gate.
  - **Sequence-step day-of-week constraint drift** (step scheduled on weekend due to TZ): per-step day-of-week-pin + per-TZ adjust + audit.
  - **Document view-tracking false-positive** (bot scraper counts as view): per-document view bot-filter + audit.
  - **Per-Team-Hierarchy permission cascade** (parent-team permission unexpectedly grants to child-team): per-team Cedar explicit-grant + audit + visualization.
  - **Quote-template branding leak** (Team-A template used by Team-B with wrong branding): per-template team-scope + audit.
  - **Booking-Page double-booking race** (two attendees book same slot concurrently): per-slot atomic-lock + reservation + release-on-failure.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — HubSpot CRM v3 API (all objects + associations + custom-objects) + Engagement API (calls + meetings + tasks + emails + notes) + Conversations API + Sequences API + Playbooks API + Quotes API + Meetings API + Webhook Subscriptions inventory + Conversation-Intelligence transcript export + Forecast snapshot export + Lead-Routing + Deal-Rotation rule export + Snippet + Email-Template + Document export + Team-Hierarchy export + Custom-Code (Operations Hub) export; format — JSON + audio recording binary (per-call) + PDF (quote + document) + REST-paginated; duration — ~2-6 months per enterprise portal due to engagement volume + sequence + conversation-intelligence depth + custom-object complexity; volume — typically 100K-10M contacts + 50K-5M companies + 100K-5M deals + 100K-50M engagements (calls + meetings + tasks + emails + notes) + 100-5000 sequences + 100-50000 active sequence-enrollments + 100-5000 quotes + 10-100 booking-pages + 10-500 playbooks + 10-100 routing-rules + per-team partition.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Contact + Company + Deal + Ticket + Custom-Object preserved with custom-properties + associations + owner + lifecycle-stage; per-Pipeline + Deal-Stage preserved with required-properties + probability; per-Sequence + Enrollment preserved with steps + throttling + status; per-Task preserved with type + owner + due + auto-created-by-sequence; per-Call preserved with recording + transcript + consent-pin; per-Meeting + Booking-Page preserved with TZ-pin + booking-source; per-Quote + Quote-Template + Product + Line-Item preserved with line-items + signer + approval + payment-settings + audit-trail; per-Playbook preserved with questions + embed-locations + required-on-stage; per-Conversation-Intelligence preserved with transcript + sentiment + topics + coaching-moments (retrained with parity test); per-Forecast snapshot immutable; per-Lead-Routing + Deal-Rotation rule preserved with team-scope + assignment-algorithm; per-Snippet + Email-Template + Document preserved with view-tracking; per-Team-Hierarchy preserved with role + team + region; per-Custom-Object schema preserved; per-Custom-Code preserved; lossy — Breeze AI + Sales-Hub-AI specifics rebuilt with parity test; some Conversation-Intelligence coaching ML retrained; some HubSpot-specific multi-currency conversion rebuilt.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-team staged with dual-engagement window 4-8 weeks; per-Sequence active-enrollments resume from current-step; per-Booking-Page URL-redirect 12-24 months; per-Quote signed/payable links re-issued; per-Conversation-Intelligence consent-pin preserved + ML retrained with parity test; per-Custom-Object schema migrated; per-Lead-Routing + Deal-Rotation rule re-bound to Oyatie WorkflowEngine; per-Email-from-CRM integration (Gmail / Outlook / O365 / Exchange) re-bound.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 30-90 days with per-Contact + Company + Deal sync-parity 100% + per-Sequence enrollment-parity 100% + per-Task + Call + Meeting log-parity 100% + per-Quote + Line-Item value-parity 100% + per-Conversation-Intelligence coaching-parity ≥ 95% + per-Forecast snapshot-parity 100% + per-Routing-Rule assignment-parity 100% + per-Booking-Page availability-parity 100% + per-Playbook question-recording parity 100%; sunset — HubSpot Sales Hub subscription sunset; per-portal retention per regulatory mandate.

- Workflow template library: `hubspot_sales.sequence-enrollment-with-task-cadence-and-throttling`; `hubspot_sales.quote-generation-with-product-line-item-currency-pin`; `hubspot_sales.meeting-booking-with-availability-and-TZ-pin`; `hubspot_sales.deal-stage-progression-with-required-property-check`; `hubspot_sales.conversation-intelligence-call-coaching-with-reviewer-gate`; `hubspot_sales.lead-routing-with-team-partition-isolation`; `hubspot_sales.deal-rotation-with-fallback-assignee`; `hubspot_sales.forecast-snapshot-with-immutability`; `hubspot_sales.playbook-required-on-stage-enforcement`; `hubspot_sales.call-recording-with-jurisdiction-consent-pin`.
- UX shell adaptation: white-collar back-office (SDR + AE + sales-mgr + sales-ops + CRO); desktop-primary CRM with deal-board + activity-stream + sequence + playbook + quote-builder + forecast; mobile log-call + log-meeting + read-deal + sequence-task + voice-memo + booking-confirmation; per-team partition view.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + UK-GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + LGPD + per-jurisdiction call-recording-consent (US Two-Party-Consent states {CA + FL + IL + MD + MA + MT + NH + PA + WA} + One-Party-Consent states + EU GDPR-recording-consent + KR-PIPA + JP per-prefecture); HIPAA when contacts include PHI; PCI-DSS when Quote-to-Pay accepts cards; per-locale data-residency.
- Naming justification: `crm` + `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` are canonical; `hubspot-sales-hub`, `hubspot-sales`, `sales-hub`, `hubspot-crm` are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-063 - HubSpot Service Hub
- Vendor name and category: HubSpot Service Hub — Tickets + Help-Desk + Inbox (unified inbox: Email + Chat + Bot + Forms + Calls + WhatsApp + Facebook-Messenger + Instagram-DM) + Knowledge-Base + Customer-Portal + Chatbots (rule-based + AI-powered) + Surveys (NPS / CSAT / CES / Custom) + Customer-Health-Scoring + SLA-Policies + Skill-Based-Routing + Service-Analytics + Voice-of-the-Customer + Service-Hub-AI + Breeze AI for service / HubSpot ecosystem / B2B + SMB + B2C customer-support + customer-success built atop HubSpot CRM substrate.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `itsm` + `community` + `messenger` (chat) + `intelligence` (chatbot)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Service Hub Starter (basic ticket + email inbox + simple chatbot + KB) → **Bronze**; Service Hub Professional (Starter + ticket-pipelines + SLA + customer-portal + AI-chatbot + NPS / CSAT / CES surveys + custom-feedback + service-analytics + multi-language KB) → **Silver**; Service Hub Enterprise (Pro + hierarchical-teams + custom-permissions + skill-based-routing + customer-health-scoring + advanced reporting + voice-of-the-customer + playbooks) → **Gold**; Enterprise + Breeze AI + Service-Hub-AI + WhatsApp + per-region data-residency + advanced AI-routing → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `itsm` (Ticket + SLA + Queue + Skill-based-routing + Customer-Health-Scoring — primary); `community` (Customer-Portal + Knowledge-Base — branded self-service); `messenger` (Live-Chat + Inbox + WhatsApp + Facebook-Messenger + Instagram-DM channels); `intelligence` (Chatbot + AI-routing + auto-categorization + sentiment + Service-Hub-AI + Breeze AI); `crm` (Customer-360 binding per D-062 Sales-Hub Contact / Company / Deal); `workflow-engine` (Playbook + Routing-Rule); `survey-and-feedback` (NPS / CSAT / CES / Custom-Feedback).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (HubSpot Service Hub model):
  - `Ticket` (Ticket_ID, Subject, Description (HTML), Pipeline-Reference, Ticket-Status-Reference, Priority {Low / Medium / High / Urgent}, Owner-Reference, Created-By, Source {Email / Live-Chat / Bot / Form / Phone / WhatsApp / Facebook-Messenger / Instagram-DM / API / Custom}, Associated-Conversation, Associated-Contact, Associated-Company, Associated-Deal, SLA-Reference, SLA-Status {On-Track / Approaching-Breach / Breached}, First-Response-DateTime, Time-to-First-Response, Time-to-Close, Created-DateTime, Closed-DateTime, Resolution-Notes, Custom-Properties{}, Tags[], Linked-KB-Articles[]).
  - `Ticket_Pipeline` (Pipeline_ID, Display-Name, Statuses[Status-Reference + Order + Color + Stage-Type {Open / In-Progress / Waiting-for-Customer / Waiting-for-Support / Closed}], Default-Owner-Routing, Custom-Properties-Required-by-Status{}).
  - `Ticket_Status` (Status_ID, Display-Name, Order, Color, Stage-Type, Probability-of-Close, Required-Properties-to-Enter[], SLA-Pause-Applies: bool).
  - `Inbox_and_Conversation` (Conversation_ID, Inbox-Reference, Channel {Email / Live-Chat / Bot / Form / Phone / WhatsApp / Facebook-Messenger / Instagram-DM}, Sender (Contact or External-Email), Subject, Status {Open / In-Progress / Waiting / Closed / Reopened}, Assigned-To-Reference, Linked-Ticket-Reference, Messages[Message-Reference], Created-DateTime, Last-Activity-DateTime).
  - `Inbox_Message` (Message_ID, Conversation-Reference, Sender-Type {Customer / Agent / Bot / System}, Sender-Reference, Body (HTML / plain), Attachments[], Sent-DateTime, Read-DateTime, Channel-Specific-Metadata{}).
  - `Inbox` (Inbox_ID, Name, Channels[], Per-Channel-Configuration{Email-Address + Domain + IMAP / SMTP / OAuth / WhatsApp-Number + Business-Account + Webhook-URL / Facebook-Page + Instagram-Account}, Team-Reference, Auto-Routing-Rules[]).
  - `Knowledge_Base_Article` (Article_ID, Title, URL, Body (HTML), Category-Reference, Sub-Category-Reference, Author-Reference, Published: bool, Last-Updated, Translations[Per-Locale-Reference], Permissions {Public / Member-Only / Customer-Portal-Only / Team-Only}, Tags[], Related-Articles[], View-Count, Helpful-Vote-Count, Not-Helpful-Vote-Count, Linked-Tickets[]).
  - `Knowledge_Base` (KB_ID, Name, Domain, Branding, Categories[Category-Reference], Languages[], Search-Configuration, Approval-Workflow).
  - `Chatbot_Flow` (Bot_ID, Name, Type {Rule-Based / AI-Powered / Hybrid}, Entry-Triggers[Trigger-Type {Page-URL-Match / Time-on-Page / Exit-Intent / Manual-Launch / Inbox-Channel}], Nodes[Node-Type {Send-Message / Ask-Question / Branch-Logic / Get-Property / Set-Property / Run-Action {Create-Ticket / Notify-Team / Send-Email / Schedule-Meeting} / Transfer-to-Human / End}], Variables{}, Intents[for-AI-powered], Entities[for-AI-powered], Fallback-Strategy).
  - `Customer_Portal_Configuration` (Portal_ID, Domain, Branding, Login-Method {Email / SSO}, Visible-Object-Types[Tickets / Knowledge-Base / Surveys / Custom-Object], Custom-CSS, Customer-Tickets-Visibility {Own-Only / Company / Team-Member-of-Company}).
  - `Survey` (Survey_ID, Name, Type {NPS / CSAT / CES / Custom-Feedback}, Trigger {Ticket-Close / Manual-Send / Email-Sequence / API-Trigger}, Frequency-Cap, Channel {Email / Chat / Web-Form / In-App / Mobile}, Questions[Question-Type {NPS-0-to-10 / CSAT-1-to-5-or-Smiley / CES-7-Likert / Open-Text / Multi-Choice / Rating}], Follow-Up-Workflows[Detractor / Passive / Promoter], Confidentiality-Threshold (N≥5 default)).
  - `Survey_Response` (Response_ID, Survey-Reference, Respondent-Reference (or Anonymous-Hash), Per-Question-Answer[], Per-Question-Score, Computed-NPS-Score (Promoter / Passive / Detractor), Sentiment-of-Open-Text, Submission-DateTime, Channel, Linked-Ticket-Reference).
  - `Customer_Health_Score` (Score_ID, Contact-or-Company-Reference, Score-Value, Score-Tier {Healthy / At-Risk / Critical}, Score-Components[Component-Name + Weight + Contribution], Trend, Last-Computed, Top-Negative-Drivers[], Top-Positive-Drivers[]).
  - `SLA_Policy` (SLA_ID, Name, Target {First-Response-Time / Time-to-Close / Custom-Property-Time}, Time-Target-Hours, Business-Hours-Reference, Pause-on-Status[Status-References], Escalation-Rules[Threshold + Action {Notify-Team / Reassign / Change-Priority}]).
  - `Business_Hours` (Hours_ID, Name, Timezone, Per-Day-of-Week-Open-Close, Holidays[Date + Description]).
  - `Skill_and_Routing_Rule` (Rule_ID, Skills[Skill-Name + Per-Agent-Skill-Level], Routing-Algorithm {Skill-Match / Round-Robin / Weighted / Longest-Idle / Custom}, Fallback-Assignee, Per-Channel-Override).
  - `Team` (Team_ID, Name, Members[User-Reference], Parent-Team-Reference (hierarchical), Per-Team-Inbox + Permissions).
  - `Playbook` (Playbook_ID, Type {Customer-Onboarding / Customer-Success / Renewal / Win-Back / Custom}, Questions[], Embed-Locations[]).
  - `Voice_of_Customer_Insight` (Insight_ID, Source {Survey / Conversation / Ticket / Open-Text-Aggregate}, Topic, Sentiment, Volume, Trend, Linked-Records[]).
  - `Service_Analytics_Report` (Report_ID, Type {Ticket-Volume / Resolution-Time / NPS-Trend / Agent-Productivity / Channel-Performance / Custom}, Filter, Date-Range, Visualization).
