  - "SLA + Business Hours" — per-Policy target + pause + escalation; per-Business-Hours timezone + days + holidays.
  - "Skill-Based Routing" — per-Agent-Skill + Routing-Algorithm + Fallback.
  - "Teams" — hierarchical team-tree + per-Team Inbox + permissions.
  - "Voice of the Customer" — topic-extraction + sentiment + trend + linked-records.
  - "Service Analytics" — per-Channel + per-Agent + per-Ticket-Volume + Resolution-Time + NPS-Trend dashboards.
  - "Playbooks" (Service variant) — Onboarding / Customer-Success / Renewal / Win-Back playbook-runner.
  - "Service-Hub-AI / Breeze AI" — AI-summary + AI-reply-suggestions + AI-categorization + AI-translation.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<csr-or-cs-manager-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceCreateTicket", Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceTransitionStatus",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceAssignToTeam", Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceEscalate",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceLinkToConversation", Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceAttachKBArticle",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceRunChatbotFlow", Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceTransferToHuman",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceRunNPSSurvey", Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceRunCSATSurvey",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceRunCESSurvey", Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceRunFeedbackTrigger",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceConfigureSLAPolicy", Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceConfigureBusinessHours",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceConfigureSkillRouting", Oyatie::Action::"HsServicePublishKBArticle",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceConfigureCustomerPortal", Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceConfigureChannel",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceViewCustomerHealthScore", Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceRunVoCAnalysis",
      Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceConfigurePlaybook", Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceExportTicketData"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::ServiceRecord::"<id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    service_role_grants(principal, action, resource.team_partition) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceTransferToHuman" ? context.handoff_context_present && context.handoff_context.ttl_seconds <= max_handoff_ttl : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceRunNPSSurvey" ? resource.cohort_size >= survey.confidentiality_threshold && labor_council_notified_if_required(resource.cohort) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsServicePublishKBArticle" ? article_review_complete(context.article) && per_locale_translation_complete_if_required(context.article) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceConfigureSLAPolicy" ? business_hours_per_jurisdiction_pinned(context.policy) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceAssignToTeam" ? rule_no_team_partition_leak(context.assignment) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceConfigureCustomerPortal" ? portal_visibility_governance_check(context.portal) && customer_data_residency_pinned(context.portal) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceConfigureChannel" ? channel_dpa_signed(context.channel) && per_channel_consent_pinned(context.channel) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceViewCustomerHealthScore" ? principal.has_role("CS-Manager") || principal.is_owner_of(resource.contact) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceRunVoCAnalysis" ? anonymity_floor_per_response_cohort(context.analysis) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"HsServiceExportTicketData" ? data_export_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && dual_admin_approval(context) && pii_scrubbed_per_export_policy(context.fields) : true) &&
    (resource.ticket.contact.jurisdiction == "EU" ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && (resource.ticket.is_consumer_complaint ? context.pack.contains("EU-DSA") && consumer_complaint_sla_per_dsa(resource.ticket) : true) : true) &&
    (resource.ticket.contains_phi ? context.pack.contains("HIPAA") && phi_safeguard(resource.ticket) : true) &&
    (resource.ticket.contact.jurisdiction == "KR" ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") : true) &&
    (resource.ticket.contact.jurisdiction == "BR" ? context.pack.contains("LGPD") : true) &&
    (resource.ticket.contact.jurisdiction == "US-CA" ? context.pack.contains("CCPA") : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Ticket` → `Oyatie::Itsm::ticket` (with subject + description + pipeline + status + priority + owner + source + SLA + associated-objects + custom-properties).
  - `Ticket_Pipeline` + `Ticket_Status` → `Oyatie::Itsm::pipeline` + `Oyatie::Itsm::status` (with stage-type + probability + required-properties + SLA-pause).
  - `Inbox_and_Conversation` + `Inbox_Message` + `Inbox` → `Oyatie::Messenger::conversation` + `Oyatie::Messenger::message` + `Oyatie::Messenger::inbox` (with channel + per-channel-config + sender-type + body + attachments + linked-ticket).
  - `Knowledge_Base_Article` + `Knowledge_Base` → `Oyatie::Community::kb_article` + `Oyatie::Community::knowledge_base` (with translations + permissions + tags + view-helpful-count + linked-tickets).
  - `Chatbot_Flow` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::chatbot_flow` (with type + triggers + nodes + variables + intents + entities + fallback).
  - `Customer_Portal_Configuration` → `Oyatie::Community::customer_portal` (with domain + branding + login-method + visible-objects + customer-tickets-visibility).
  - `Survey` + `Survey_Response` → `Oyatie::SurveyAndFeedback::survey` + `Oyatie::SurveyAndFeedback::survey_response` (with type + trigger + frequency-cap + channel + questions + follow-up + confidentiality-threshold + sentiment + linked-ticket).
  - `Customer_Health_Score` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::customer_health_score` (with score-tier + components + trend + drivers).
  - `SLA_Policy` + `Business_Hours` → `Oyatie::Itsm::sla_policy` + `Oyatie::Itsm::business_hours` (with target + business-hours + pause-on-status + escalation; timezone + per-day + holidays).
  - `Skill_and_Routing_Rule` → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::skill_routing` (with skills + routing-algorithm + fallback + per-channel-override).
  - `Team` → `Oyatie::Identity::service_team` (with members + parent-team + per-team-inbox + permissions).
  - `Playbook` (Service variant) → `Oyatie::WorkflowEngine::service_playbook` (with type + questions + embed-locations).
  - `Voice_of_Customer_Insight` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::voc_insight` (with source + topic + sentiment + volume + trend + linked-records).
  - `Service_Analytics_Report` → `Oyatie::Analytics::service_report` (with type + filter + date-range + visualization).

- **Specific workflow steps** (HubSpot Service Hub displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-portal Ticket count + Pipeline + Status + Inbox + Conversation + Message volume + Knowledge-Base + Article (per-locale) + Chatbot-Flow + Customer-Portal config + Survey + Response history + Customer-Health-Score config + SLA-Policy + Business-Hours + Skill-Routing-Rule + Team-Hierarchy + Playbook (service) + per-Channel inventory (Email + WhatsApp + Facebook-Messenger + Instagram-DM + Phone) + Voice-of-Customer config + Service-Analytics dashboards.
  2. **Ticket extraction**: per-Ticket subject + description + pipeline + status + priority + owner + source + associated-conversation + associated-contact / company / deal + SLA + first-response + close + resolution + custom-properties + tags + linked-KB-articles.
  3. **Pipeline + Status extraction**: per-Pipeline display + statuses + default-owner-routing + custom-properties-required; per-Status order + color + stage-type + probability + required-properties + SLA-pause.
  4. **Inbox + Conversation + Message extraction**: per-Inbox channels + per-channel-config + team + auto-routing-rules; per-Conversation channel + sender + status + assigned-to + linked-ticket + messages; per-Message sender-type + body + attachments + sent + read.
  5. **Knowledge-Base extraction**: per-KB name + domain + branding + categories + languages + search-config + approval-workflow; per-Article title + URL + body + category + author + published + last-updated + translations + permissions + tags + related-articles + view + helpful + linked-tickets.
  6. **Chatbot-Flow extraction**: per-Bot type + entry-triggers + nodes + variables + intents + entities + fallback.
  7. **Customer-Portal extraction**: per-Portal domain + branding + login-method + visible-object-types + custom-CSS + customer-tickets-visibility.
  8. **Survey + Survey-Response extraction**: per-Survey type + trigger + frequency-cap + channel + questions + follow-up-workflows + confidentiality-threshold; per-Response per-question-answer + score + computed-NPS + sentiment + submission + channel + linked-ticket.
  9. **Customer-Health-Score extraction**: per-Contact/Company score-value + score-tier + components + trend + drivers + last-computed.
  10. **SLA + Business-Hours extraction**: per-SLA target + time-target + business-hours + pause-on-status + escalation; per-Business-Hours timezone + per-day + holidays.
  11. **Skill-Routing + Team extraction**: per-Rule skills + routing-algorithm + fallback + per-channel-override; per-Team members + parent-team + per-team-inbox + permissions.
  12. **Playbook (Service) extraction**: per-Playbook type + questions + embed-locations.
  13. **Voice-of-Customer extraction**: per-Insight source + topic + sentiment + volume + trend + linked-records.
  14. **Service-Analytics-Report extraction**: per-Report type + filter + date-range + visualization.
  15. **Per-Chatbot-Flow → Oyatie intelligence-chatbot rebuild**: per-Bot rule-based + AI-powered flow re-implemented in Oyatie intelligence chatbot with intent / entity retrained on parity.
  16. **Per-Knowledge-Base translation preservation**: per-locale article preserved with translation-equivalence test; per-search-config rebuilt.
  17. **Per-Customer-Portal SSO migration**: per-Portal login-method re-bound to Oyatie identity (with B2C customer-IdP per ADR-0244 tenant-scoping).
  18. **Per-Survey N-floor enforcement**: per-Survey per-cohort N≥5 floor at response-view; per-Open-text anonymity-suppression + stylometric-fingerprint suppression.
  19. **Per-SLA business-hours per-jurisdiction**: per-SLA business-hours calendar-pin + holiday-calendar per region; per-SLA pause-on-status preserved.
  20. **Per-Skill-Routing → Oyatie WorkflowEngine routing**: per-Rule skills + algorithm + fallback re-bound; per-team-partition isolation preserved.
  21. **Per-Channel re-binding**: per-Email + WhatsApp + Facebook-Messenger + Instagram-DM + Phone re-bound to Oyatie messenger channel with OAuth + DPA + per-channel consent.
  22. **Per-Customer-Health-Score model retrain**: per-Model retrained on Oyatie intelligence with parity ≥ 95%.
  23. **Per-Voice-of-Customer NLP retrain**: per-Topic-extraction + sentiment re-trained with parity test.
  24. **Per-Ticket multi-team-route idempotent assignment**: per-route dedup-key + per-team explicit-scope.
  25. **Per-Customer-Portal ticket-visibility scope migration**: per-portal own-only vs company vs team-member-of-company preserved with audit.
  26. **Parallel run**: 30-90 day shadow with sample portal + per-Ticket sync-parity 100% + per-Conversation thread-parity 100% + per-Chatbot dialog-parity 100% + per-KB-Article render-parity 100% + per-Survey N-floor parity 100% + per-Customer-Health-Score parity ≥ 95% + per-SLA-clock parity 100% + per-Skill-Routing assignment-parity 100% + per-VoC topic-extraction parity ≥ 95%.
  27. **Cutover**: per-portal staged with dual-channel window 4-8 weeks; per-Channel re-bound; per-Customer-Portal URL-redirect (24-36 months); per-KB article-URL redirect; per-Survey active-cycle resume; per-Chatbot re-published; per-SLA-clock continuity.
  28. **Sunset**: HubSpot Service Hub subscription sunset; per-portal retention per regulatory mandate (Tickets typically 7 years; Surveys per consent + 3-7 years; per-EU-DSA consumer-complaint per legal retention).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **Chatbot-to-human handoff context-loss** (human-agent gets no context): per-handoff context-bag with TTL + audit + replay.
  - **Survey-response anonymity-leak** (cohort too small, demographic intersection identifies respondent): per-survey N-floor + anonymity-suppression at cohort-display + redact + audit.
  - **Knowledge-base-article version-drift on cross-portal share** (article updated in one portal, stale in another): per-article version-pin + cross-portal sync + audit.
  - **SLA business-hours per-jurisdiction drift** (US-based SLA applied to EU ticket with different business-hours): per-SLA jurisdiction-calendar-pin + per-jurisdiction holiday + audit.
  - **Per-team queue-balance race on multi-team route** (two teams race to claim same ticket): per-route idempotent dedup + assignment + audit.
  - **Chatbot intent classification false-positive** (bot misroutes important issue to wrong queue): per-intent confidence-threshold + fallback to human + audit.
  - **Customer-Portal ticket-visibility leak** (Customer-A sees Customer-B ticket): per-Portal visibility-scope explicit + Cedar default-deny + visibility-test cohort.
  - **WhatsApp 24-hour-window expiry** (cannot send template-message after 24h since last customer-msg): per-conversation window-tracker + template-fallback.
  - **Facebook Messenger 24-hour-rule** (similar window-rule): per-conversation tracker + template-fallback.
  - **Instagram DM Story-mention race** (story expires, mention orphaned): per-mention TTL-pin + audit.
  - **Customer-Health-Score model drift** (score retrains, customer suddenly at-risk without behavior change): per-retrain impact-simulation + per-customer score-change alert.
  - **SLA-clock pause-on-status confusion** (status changed without pausing SLA appropriately): per-status SLA-pause explicit-pin + audit.
  - **Knowledge-Base translation drift** (English article updated, EU-locale not retranslated): per-article translation-status-pin + alert on update + governance gate.
  - **Skill-routing fallback storm** (no agent matches skills, all tickets route to fallback): per-fallback capacity + alert + reshuffle.
  - **NPS detractor follow-up coercion** (detractor feels obligated to follow up): per-follow-up opt-out + voluntary.
  - **Per-survey trigger over-fire** (customer gets survey after every ticket close, fatigue): per-customer survey-frequency-cap.
  - **VoC topic-extraction false-attribution** (topic incorrectly tagged on customer feedback): per-topic confidence-threshold + manual-review + audit.
  - **Customer-Portal authentication bypass** (URL-guess accesses ticket): per-portal authentication-required + ticket-URL token-signed + audit.
  - **Per-EU-DSA consumer-complaint SLA breach** (response missed 14-day window): per-complaint SLA-clock + alert + escalation + audit.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — HubSpot CRM v3 API (tickets + feedback-submissions) + Conversations API + Chatbot API + Help-Desk API + Knowledge-Base API + Feedback API + SLA + Business-Hours API + Webhook Subscriptions + WhatsApp Business Cloud API + Facebook Messenger Platform API + Instagram Messaging API + Customer-Portal config export + Customer-Health-Score config + Skill-Routing rule + Team-Hierarchy + Playbook + Voice-of-Customer + Service-Analytics export; format — JSON + HTML (KB-article) + per-message attachments + REST-paginated; duration — ~2-4 months per enterprise portal due to ticket-volume + per-channel + KB translations + chatbot complexity + customer-portal scope; volume — typically 10K-10M tickets + 10K-50M conversations + 100K-100M messages + 100-5000 KB-articles + 10-100 chatbot-flows + 1-10 customer-portals + 10-100 surveys + 100K-10M survey-responses + 10-100 SLA-policies + 10-50 skill-routing rules.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Ticket preserved with pipeline + status + priority + owner + source + SLA + associations + custom-properties + tags + linked-KB; per-Pipeline + Status preserved with stage-type + required-properties + SLA-pause; per-Inbox + Conversation + Message preserved with per-channel-config + sender + status + linked-ticket; per-KB preserved with translations + permissions + view-counts + linked-tickets; per-Chatbot preserved with type + nodes + intents + entities + fallback (AI retrained with parity test); per-Customer-Portal preserved with login + visible-objects + visibility-scope; per-Survey preserved with type + trigger + cap + questions + follow-up + N-floor; per-Survey-Response preserved with anonymity-hash + sentiment + linked-ticket; per-Customer-Health-Score retrained with parity test; per-SLA + Business-Hours preserved with calendar-pin + escalation; per-Skill-Routing preserved with skills + algorithm + fallback + per-channel-override; per-Team-Hierarchy preserved with members + parent + permissions; per-Playbook preserved with questions + embed-locations; per-Voice-of-Customer retrained with parity test; per-Service-Analytics rebuilt; lossy — Service-Hub-AI + Breeze AI specifics rebuilt; some HubSpot-native chatbot templates rebuilt.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-portal staged with dual-channel window 4-8 weeks; per-Channel re-bound with OAuth + DPA + consent; per-Customer-Portal URL-redirect 24-36 months; per-KB article-URL redirect; per-Survey active-cycle resume; per-Chatbot re-published; per-SLA-clock continuity + business-hours pinned; per-Skill-Routing re-bound to Oyatie WorkflowEngine; per-Customer-Health-Score model retrained + parity-test passed; per-Voice-of-Customer NLP retrained.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 30-90 days with per-Ticket sync-parity 100% + per-Conversation thread-parity 100% + per-Chatbot dialog-parity 100% + per-KB-Article render-parity 100% + per-Survey N-floor parity 100% + per-Customer-Health-Score parity ≥ 95% + per-SLA-clock parity 100% + per-Skill-Routing assignment-parity 100% + per-VoC topic-extraction parity ≥ 95% + per-Customer-Portal authentication-parity 100% + per-Channel send-receive parity 100%; sunset — HubSpot Service Hub subscription sunset; per-portal retention per regulatory mandate.

- Workflow template library: `hubspot_service.ticket-routing-with-skill-match-and-fallback`; `hubspot_service.chatbot-to-human-handoff-with-context-bag-and-TTL`; `hubspot_service.knowledge-base-article-suggest-with-version-pin`; `hubspot_service.NPS-with-detractor-followup-and-opt-out`; `hubspot_service.SLA-with-business-hours-per-jurisdiction-pin`; `hubspot_service.survey-with-N-floor-anonymity`; `hubspot_service.customer-portal-with-visibility-scope-default-deny`; `hubspot_service.whatsapp-24-hour-window-template-fallback`; `hubspot_service.customer-health-score-with-retrain-parity`; `hubspot_service.eu-dsa-consumer-complaint-sla-tracking`.
- UX shell adaptation: pink-collar (CSR + customer-success-mgr + team-lead); desktop-primary ticket-and-conversation console + Inbox + Help-Desk + Customer-Health dashboard + SLA-clock; B2C customer-portal mobile-primary with KB + tickets + surveys; survey mobile-responsive; mobile agent log-call + assign-ticket + read-conversation; per-team partition view.
- Pack overlay applicable: SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + UK-GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + CPRA + LGPD + EU DSA for consumer-complaint cases + per-jurisdiction consumer-complaint SLA; HIPAA when tickets touch PHI; per-locale data-residency; per-channel DPA + consent (WhatsApp + Facebook + Instagram); per-language KB-translation per jurisdiction language-requirement.
- Naming justification: `itsm` + `community` + `messenger` + `intelligence` + `survey-and-feedback` are canonical; `hubspot-service-hub`, `hubspot-service`, `service-hub`, `hubspot-help-desk`, `hubspot-chatbot` are benchmark aliases.

### Section D-064 - HubSpot CMS Hub
- Vendor name and category: HubSpot CMS Hub (formerly HubSpot COS — Content Optimization System) — Website + Blog + Landing-Page + Theme + Module + Template + HubL (HubSpot Markup Language, Jinja2-derived) + HubDB (structured-content database) + Smart-Content + Membership-Gate (B2C login-required) + AB-Test + Adaptive-Test + Content-Staging + Multi-Language + Brand-Domains + Serverless-Functions (Operations Hub) + Mobile-Optimization + Page-Performance + Asset-CDN + Marketplace (Themes + Modules) + Breeze AI for content / HubSpot ecosystem / website + content-management built atop HubSpot CRM substrate.
- Coverage tier: B (partial — capability tier on `community` + `wiki` + `cloud-cdn`; possible `cms` µservice in Wave-3-H if scale + custom-module + HubDB-heavy demand). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: CMS Hub Starter (basic site + blog + landing-page + 1 domain) → **Bronze**; CMS Hub Professional (Starter + SEO + AB-test + multi-language + membership + advanced reporting + premium templates) → **Silver**; CMS Hub Enterprise (Pro + multi-brand domains + serverless-functions + content-staging + activity-logging + custom-CDN-config + adaptive-test + content-partitioning + hierarchical-permissions) → **Gold**; Enterprise + Breeze AI content + AI-content-generation + advanced edge-caching + per-region CDN-pop → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `community` (external-facing site — branded landing + blog + content); `wiki` (content-authoring + per-Page module + version); `cloud-cdn` (delivery + edge-personalization + asset-cache); `intelligence` (smart-content for personalization + AB-test ML + content-recommendations); `marketplace` (HubSpot Marketplace themes + modules ↔ Oyatie plugin marketplace per ADR-0249); `developer-sdk` (HubL templating + Serverless-Functions); `consent-and-privacy` (cookie-banner + GDPR + IAB TCF for visitor-tracking).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (HubSpot CMS model):
  - `Site` (Site_ID, Name, Primary-Domain, Additional-Domains[], Brand-Settings {Logo + Color-Palette + Typography}, Default-Theme-Reference, Default-Language, Multilingual-Settings, Tracking-Code-Snippet, Cookie-Banner-Config, Robots-Txt, Sitemap-XML-Config, SSL-Settings, Per-Page-Activity-Logging: bool, Content-Staging-Enabled: bool).
  - `Page` (Page_ID, Title, URL_Slug, Domain-Reference, Template-Reference, Modules[Module-Instance-Reference + Per-Module-Config{} + Variables{} + Smart-Content-Rules[]], SEO-Settings{Title + Meta-Description + Robots + Canonical-URL + Schema-Org + Open-Graph + Twitter-Card}, Body-Class, Custom-CSS, Custom-Header-HTML, Custom-Footer-HTML, A/B-Test-Variants[], Smart-Content-Variants[], Translations[Per-Locale-Reference], Published: bool, Publish-Date, Last-Updated-Date, Author-Reference, Membership-Required-Reference, HubDB-Driven-Dynamic-Page-Reference, Performance-Score, Activity-Log[]).
  - `Blog_Post` (Post_ID, Site-Reference, Title, URL_Slug, Body (Module-Based), Author-Reference, Publish-Date, Tags[], Featured-Image, Meta-Description, RSS-Feed-Settings, Linked-Pillar-Page, Topic-Cluster-Reference, Smart-Content-Variants[], Translations[]).
  - `Template` (Template_ID, Name, Type {Page / Blog-Listing / Blog-Post / Email / System / Quote / Custom}, HubL-Source, Modules-Referenced[], Variables{Editable-Fields}, Group-Block-Configuration, Required-Modules[], Allowed-Modules[]).
  - `Module` (Module_ID, Name, Type {Default / Custom / Marketplace / Global}, HubL-Template, JavaScript-Module, CSS-Module, Module-Fields[Field-Name + Type {Text / Rich-Text / Image / URL / CTA / Form / Date / Color / Choice / Linked-Object} + Required + Default + Placeholder + Help-Text], Versions[], Marketplace-Reference, Used-In-Templates[], Used-In-Pages[]).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - HubSpot CMS API v3: `https://api.hubapi.com/cms/v3/{pages | blogs/posts | blogs | hubdb/tables | hubdb/rows | url-redirects | source-code | site-search | etc.}` (OAuth + Private-App).
  - HubL Templating Language: Jinja2-derived per-template syntax.
  - HubDB API: per-table + per-row CRUD + import-from-CSV + dynamic-page-binding.
  - HubSpot CLI: `hs upload` / `hs fetch` / `hs watch` / `hs project` for theme + module + serverless deployment.
  - HubSpot Project Framework (newer): per-project bundle theme + module + serverless + extension.
  - Serverless Functions API: per-function deploy + invoke + log.
  - URL-Redirect API: per-redirect create + list + delete.
  - Site-Search API: per-query result + filter.
  - Marketplace API: per-theme + per-module install + license-check.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Site Pages" — page-grid with filter (Draft / Published / Scheduled) + bulk-actions + dependencies-map.
  - "Blog" — blog-post-grid per-blog + topic-cluster overlay.
  - "Page Editor (Drag-Drop)" — module-palette + drag-drop layout + per-Module config-panel + Smart-Content rule-editor + A/B-variant + content-staging + Preview.
  - "Design Manager" — folder-tree of templates + modules + global-modules + CSS + JS + images + custom code; HubL syntax-highlight editor.
  - "Module Editor" — HubL-template + JS + CSS + Module-Fields drag-drop schema.
  - "Theme Manager" — theme-folder + included templates + modules + theme-fields + localization + marketplace-publish.
  - "HubDB Manager" — table-grid + per-Table column-schema + row-edit + import-CSV + dynamic-page-binding + per-locale rows.
  - "URL Redirects" — redirect-grid + match-type + bulk-import.
  - "Memberships" — gated-pages config + allowed-lists + login/logout-redirect + SSO config.
  - "Content Staging" — staged-vs-published comparison + publish-workflow.
  - "Multi-Language Settings" — per-locale URL-pattern + translation status.
  - "Brand Domains" — per-domain SSL + per-domain default-language + per-domain branding.
  - "Serverless Functions" — function-list + code-editor + env-vars + secrets + invoke-log.
  - "SEO" — per-page recommendations + sitemap + robots.txt + canonical-URL + schema.org.
  - "Tracking Code" — JavaScript-snippet + custom-events + consent-gating.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<cms-author-or-developer-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubPublishPage", Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubPublishBlogPost",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureTheme", Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubInstallModule",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubCreateModule", Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubEditTemplate",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubRunSmartContent", Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubRunABTestOnPage",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubRunAdaptiveTest", Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureMembershipGate",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureContentStaging", Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubManageHubDBTable",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubManageHubDBRow", Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubDeployServerlessFunction",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureURLRedirect", Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureBrandDomain",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureTracking", Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubExportSiteData",
      Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubInstallMarketplaceTheme", Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubManageMemberUser"
    ],
    resource in Oyatie::Resource::CmsAsset::"<id>"
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    cms_role_grants(principal, action, resource.team_partition) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubPublishPage" ? page_passes_lint(resource.page) && accessibility_check_passed(resource.page) && all_referenced_modules_published(resource.page) && all_referenced_hubdb_tables_published(resource.page) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubPublishBlogPost" ? content_review_complete(resource.post) && featured_image_present_if_required(resource.post) && SEO_settings_validate(resource.post) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureTheme" ? principal.has_role("Theme-Designer") && theme_passes_brand_check(context.theme) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubInstallModule" ? module_publisher_allowlisted(context.module) && module_permissions_minimum_necessary(context.module) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubRunSmartContent" ? audience_resolution_validated(context.rule) && consent_resolved_for_personalization(resource.visitor) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubRunABTestOnPage" ? statistical_power_sufficient(context.test) && minimum_test_duration_respected(context.test) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureMembershipGate" ? login_redirect_secure(context.gate) && cedar_default_deny_for_unauthenticated(context.gate) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubManageHubDBTable" ? schema_change_impact_simulated(context.delta) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubDeployServerlessFunction" ? principal.has_role("Developer") && function_passes_security_lint(context.function) && secrets_in_secrets-manager(context.function) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureURLRedirect" ? redirect_loop_check(context.redirect, context.existing_redirects) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureBrandDomain" ? domain_ownership_verified(context.domain) && ssl_certificate_valid(context.domain) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubConfigureTracking" ? consent_gating_configured(context.tracking) && per_purpose_signal_pinned(context.tracking) : true) &&
    (action == Oyatie::Action::"CmsHubExportSiteData" ? data_export_purpose_approved(context.purpose) && dual_admin_approval(context) : true) &&
    (resource.site.has_eu_traffic ? context.pack.contains("GDPR") && context.pack.contains("EU-ePrivacy") && cookie_banner_configured(resource.site) && consent_gating_for_tracking(resource.site) : true) &&
    (resource.site.has_us_minor_traffic ? context.pack.contains("COPPA") && parental_consent_or_minor_exclusion(resource.site) : true) &&
    (resource.site.public_facing ? context.pack.contains("WCAG-2.2-AA") && accessibility_check_passed(resource.page) : true) &&
    (resource.site.has_kr_traffic ? context.pack.contains("KR-PIPA") : true) &&
    context.pack.allows(context.purpose)
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Site` → `Oyatie::Community::site` (with primary-domain + additional-domains + brand-settings + default-theme + tracking-code + cookie-banner + SSL + activity-logging + content-staging).
  - `Page` → `Oyatie::Wiki::page` + `Oyatie::Community::landing_page` (with template + modules + SEO + AB-variants + smart-content-variants + translations + published + membership + HubDB-driven).
  - `Blog_Post` → `Oyatie::Community::blog_post` (with site + body + author + publish-date + tags + featured-image + meta + topic-cluster + translations).
  - `Template` → `Oyatie::Wiki::template` (with type + HubL-source + modules-referenced + variables + required + allowed-modules).
  - `Module` + `Global_Module` → `Oyatie::Wiki::module` + `Oyatie::Wiki::global_module` (with HubL + JS + CSS + module-fields + versions + marketplace-reference + used-in-templates/pages).
  - `Theme` → `Oyatie::Wiki::theme` (with templates + modules + CSS + JS + images + theme-fields + localization + marketplace-reference).
  - `Smart_Content_Rule` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::smart_content_rule` (with conditions + variants + default + tracking).
  - `AB_Test` + `Adaptive_Test` → `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::ab_test` + `Oyatie::MarketingAutomation::adaptive_test` (with variants + criterion + statistical-significance + auto-allocation).
  - `Membership_Gate` + `Membership_User` → `Oyatie::Community::membership_gate` + `Oyatie::Identity::member_user` (with allowed-lists + lifecycle-stages + login-redirect + SSO; member-email + password-hash + contact-binding + status + last-login).
  - `HubDB_Table` + `HubDB_Row` → `Oyatie::Wiki::structured_content_table` + `Oyatie::Wiki::structured_content_row` (with columns + rows + dynamic-page-binding + per-locale).
  - `Brand_Domain` → `Oyatie::Community::brand_domain` (with hostname + SSL + default-language + branding + staging-domain).
  - `Content_Staging` → `Oyatie::Wiki::content_staging` (with staged-version + publish-workflow + status).
  - `Serverless_Function` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSdk::serverless_function` (with runtime + code + env-vars + endpoints + secrets).
  - `URL_Redirect` → `Oyatie::CloudCdn::url_redirect` (with source-pattern + target + type + match-type).
  - `Tracking_Code_Configuration` → `Oyatie::Analytics::tracking_code` (with snippet + custom-events + consent-gating).

- **Specific workflow steps** (HubSpot CMS Hub displacement journey):
  1. **Inventory**: per-portal Site count + Page count (often 100-10K) + Blog count + Blog-Post count + Template + Module (default + custom + marketplace) + Theme (default + custom + marketplace) + Global-Module + Smart-Content-Rule + AB-Test + Adaptive-Test + Membership-Gate + Membership-User count + HubDB-Table + HubDB-Row count + Brand-Domain + Content-Staging config + Serverless-Function + URL-Redirect + Tracking-Code config + Marketplace plugin inventory.
  2. **Site + Page + Blog-Post extraction**: per-Site primary-domain + additional-domains + brand-settings + default-theme; per-Page title + URL-slug + template + modules + SEO + A/B-variants + smart-content + translations + membership + HubDB-driven; per-Blog-Post body + author + publish-date + tags + featured-image + meta + topic-cluster + translations.
  3. **Template + Module + Theme + Global-Module extraction**: per-Template HubL-source + modules-referenced + variables + required + allowed; per-Module HubL + JS + CSS + module-fields + versions + marketplace-reference; per-Theme templates + modules + CSS + JS + images + theme-fields + localization + marketplace-reference; per-Global-Module instance + used-in-pages.
  4. **HubDB + HubDB-Row extraction**: per-Table columns + rows + dynamic-page-binding + per-locale-versions; preserve Foreign-Key references.
  5. **Smart-Content + AB-Test + Adaptive-Test extraction**: per-Smart-Rule conditions + variants + default + tracking; per-AB-Test variants + criterion + statistical-significance + winner; per-Adaptive-Test variants + auto-allocation.
  6. **Membership-Gate + Membership-User extraction**: per-Gate allowed-lists + lifecycle-stages + login-redirect + logout-redirect + SSO; per-User email + password-hash (with rehash on import) + contact-binding + status + last-login.
  7. **Brand-Domain + Content-Staging extraction**: per-Domain hostname + SSL + default-language + branding + staging-domain; per-Staging page-or-blog + staged-version + publish-workflow + status.
  8. **Serverless-Function extraction**: per-Function runtime + code + env-vars + endpoints + secrets; preserve dependencies.
  9. **URL-Redirect + Tracking-Code extraction**: per-Redirect source-pattern + target + type + match-type; per-Tracking-Code snippet + custom-events + consent-gating.
  10. **Per-HubL-template → Oyatie wiki-engine transpile**: per-Template HubL re-translated to Oyatie templating with golden-render comparison + per-Module behavior parity test.
  11. **Per-Module → Oyatie wiki-module re-implementation**: per-Custom-Module HubL + JS + CSS rewritten + per-field schema preserved + per-version retained.
  12. **Per-Marketplace-module replacement plan**: per-Marketplace plugin either migrated (if Oyatie equivalent exists) or feature-loss-disclosure documented; per-plugin replacement-list.
  13. **Per-HubDB-table → Oyatie structured-content-table migration**: per-Table schema + rows + dynamic-page-binding + per-locale preserved; per-foreign-key re-resolved.
  14. **Per-Membership-User password rehash**: per-User password rehashed via bcrypt or Argon2 with secure-storage; per-User force-reset-on-first-login flow.
  15. **Per-Membership-Gate Cedar default-deny**: per-Page Cedar default-deny for unauthenticated + redirect-to-login enforced.
  16. **Per-Serverless-Function → Oyatie developer-sdk function migration**: per-Function runtime + code + endpoints + env-vars + secrets re-deployed; per-secret rotated.
  17. **Per-URL-Redirect → Oyatie cloud-cdn redirect**: per-Redirect preserved + loop-check + per-redirect-type preserved.
  18. **Per-Brand-Domain DNS + SSL migration**: per-Domain DNS-records updated + SSL-cert re-issued or migrated + per-domain default-language preserved.
  19. **Per-Tracking-Code dual-fire window**: per-Site tracking-snippet dual-fire (HubSpot + Oyatie tracker) 4-8 weeks + per-event consent-gating preserved.
  20. **Per-Content-Staging migration**: per-Staging in-flight items completed before cutover or carried to Oyatie content-staging workflow.
  21. **Per-Smart-Content audience-resolution validation**: per-Rule per-condition resolution-test + per-variant render-preview.
  22. **Per-AB-Test statistical-power preservation**: per-Test variants + significance + sample-size preserved; per-Adaptive-Test bandit-allocation continuity.
  23. **Per-SEO settings migration**: per-Page SEO + sitemap + robots.txt + canonical-URL + schema.org preserved; per-301-redirect for changed URLs.
  24. **Per-WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility check**: per-Page automated a11y check + manual review for critical pages.
  25. **Parallel run**: 60-120 day shadow with sample site + per-Page render-parity (golden-image diff < 0.5%) + per-Module behavior-parity 100% + per-HubDB-driven dynamic-page parity 100% + per-Smart-Content audience-resolution parity 100% + per-AB-Test outcome-parity ± 2% (statistical-power respected) + per-Membership-Gate auth-parity 100% + per-Serverless-Function invoke-parity 100% + per-URL-Redirect resolution-parity 100% + per-Tracking-Code event-parity 100% + per-Multi-Language per-locale parity 100% + per-SEO ranking pre/post comparison.
  26. **Cutover**: per-domain staged with DNS + CDN cutover; per-Tracking-Code dual-fire window (4-8 weeks); per-URL-Redirect preserved; per-Membership-User force-reset-on-first-login; per-Serverless-Function re-deployed; per-Content-Staging migrated; per-Brand-Domain SSL re-issued.
  27. **Sunset**: HubSpot CMS Hub subscription sunset; per-portal retention per regulatory mandate (typically per-Site content retained 7+ years; per-Member-User data per retention policy; per-Submission per consent + per-jurisdiction).

- **Vendor-specific failure modes**:
  - **HubL-template semantic drift on rewrite to oyatie templating** (subtle Jinja2-vs-oyatie syntax difference): per-template golden-render comparison + per-Module behavior parity test + manual-fixup queue.
  - **HubDB-table dynamic-page URL-routing break** (dynamic-page URL pattern not preserved): per-route URL-pin + 301-redirect for changed patterns + per-row dynamic-page accessibility check.
  - **Smart-content-rule personalization-leak** (visitor sees wrong variant due to audience-resolution failure): per-rule audience-resolution validation suite + per-condition test cohort + render-preview.
  - **Membership-gate auth-bypass via direct-URL** (URL-guess accesses gated content): per-page Cedar default-deny + redirect-to-login enforced + URL-pattern signed + audit.
  - **Per-Marketplace-module replacement-gap** (Marketplace plugin no Oyatie equivalent): per-module feature-loss-disclosure + per-page replacement-plan + manual rewrite.
  - **HubDB-foreign-key broken on row-import** (row references missing parent row): per-FK validation at import + dead-letter + manual fixup.
  - **Per-Membership-User password-rehash failure** (hash incompatibility, users locked out): per-User force-reset-on-first-login + reset-email + audit.
  - **Per-Brand-Domain SSL-cert expiry** (cert lapses, site 404 / TLS error): per-cert renewal + alert ≥30 days pre-expire + auto-renewal where possible.
  - **Per-URL-Redirect loop** (redirect-A → redirect-B → redirect-A): per-redirect loop-check at create + runtime circuit-breaker.
  - **Per-Serverless-Function secrets-leak in code** (API-key hardcoded): per-function code-lint + secrets-detect + abort-on-leak.
  - **Per-Tracking-Code consent-gating gap** (event fires before consent): per-event consent-check + per-purpose suppression + audit.
  - **AB-test premature winner** (statistical significance not reached): per-test sample-size validator + early-stop guard + minimum-duration.
  - **Adaptive-test bandit cold-start exploitation** (bandit stuck on early winner): per-bandit exploration-floor + minimum-allocation per variant + retest cadence.
  - **Per-Page WCAG-2.2-AA accessibility regression** (publish breaks contrast / focus / aria): per-publish a11y-check + fail-on-regression + alert.
  - **Per-Multi-Language locale-translation drift** (English page updated, EU-locale not retranslated): per-page translation-status-pin + alert on update.
  - **Per-Content-Staging publish-race** (staged-version + production-version diverge after concurrent edits): per-staging version-pin + lock-on-edit + merge-tool.
  - **Per-SEO sitemap-stale** (page deleted, sitemap still includes): per-publish sitemap-rebuild + per-deletion sitemap-purge.
  - **Per-Module field-schema breaking change** (field removed, existing modules break): per-module schema-evolution governance gate + dependency-check.
  - **Per-Global-Module change-storm** (edit global module affects 1000s of pages): per-global-module impact-simulation + change-approval.
  - **Per-Domain DNS-cutover error** (DNS propagation lag causes downtime): per-domain DNS TTL low + staged cutover + dual-host window.

- **Migration playbook outline**:
  - **Extract phase**: Tooling — HubSpot CMS API v3 (pages + blogs + posts + hubdb/tables + hubdb/rows + url-redirects + source-code + site-search) + HubSpot CLI (`hs upload` / `hs fetch` / `hs watch` / `hs project`) + Project Framework export + Serverless Functions API + per-Membership-User export (with consent for password-rehash) + per-Brand-Domain DNS + SSL config + per-Tracking-Code inventory + per-Marketplace-plugin inventory; format — HTML + HubL + JSON + CSS + JS + per-image binary + per-row CSV + per-config JSON; duration — ~3-6 months per enterprise portal due to template complexity + module count + HubDB depth + membership user count + multi-language + brand-domain count; volume — typically 100-10K pages + 100-50K blog-posts + 100-5000 modules + 10-500 themes + 10-100 brand-domains + 10K-100M HubDB-rows + 1K-1M membership-users + 100-10K URL-redirects + 10-200 serverless-functions.
  - **Mapping phase**: Per-Site + Page + Blog-Post preserved with template + modules + SEO + AB-variants + smart-content + translations + membership + HubDB-driven; per-Template HubL re-translated with golden-render; per-Module + Global-Module preserved with HubL + JS + CSS + module-fields + versions; per-Theme preserved with templates + modules + CSS + JS + images + theme-fields + localization; per-HubDB-Table + Row preserved with schema + rows + dynamic-page-binding + per-locale; per-Smart-Content + AB-Test + Adaptive-Test preserved with variants + criterion + statistical-significance; per-Membership-Gate + Member-User preserved with allowed-lists + login-redirect + password-rehashed + force-reset-on-first-login; per-Brand-Domain + Content-Staging preserved with SSL + DNS + staging-domain + publish-workflow; per-Serverless-Function preserved with runtime + code + endpoints + env-vars + secrets-rotated; per-URL-Redirect preserved with loop-check; per-Tracking-Code preserved with consent-gating; per-Marketplace plugin migrated or gap-list with feature-loss-disclosure; lossy — Breeze AI content specifics rebuilt; some HubSpot-native template patterns rebuilt; some adaptive-bandit specifics rebuilt with parity test.
  - **Cutover phase**: Per-domain staged with DNS + CDN cutover (low DNS-TTL pre-cutover); per-Tracking-Code dual-fire window 4-8 weeks; per-URL-Redirect preserved with loop-check; per-Membership-User force-reset-on-first-login + reset-email; per-Serverless-Function re-deployed with secrets-rotated; per-Content-Staging migrated; per-Brand-Domain SSL re-issued; per-HubL-template transpiled with golden-render; per-Marketplace plugin migrated or gap-list; per-Multi-Language per-locale preserved.
  - **Verification phase**: Parallel run 60-120 days with per-Page render-parity (golden-image diff < 0.5%) + per-Module behavior-parity 100% + per-HubDB-driven dynamic-page parity 100% + per-Smart-Content audience-resolution parity 100% + per-AB-Test outcome-parity ± 2% + per-Membership-Gate auth-parity 100% + per-Serverless-Function invoke-parity 100% + per-URL-Redirect resolution-parity 100% + per-Tracking-Code event-parity 100% + per-Multi-Language per-locale parity 100% + per-SEO ranking pre/post comparison (per-page ranking-stability ≥ 95%) + per-WCAG a11y-check pass; sunset — HubSpot CMS Hub subscription sunset; per-portal retention per regulatory mandate.

### Section D-065 - HubSpot Operations Hub

**Vendor identity and category.** HubSpot Operations Hub is the RevOps-control plane in the HubSpot ecosystem — separate-tier add-on to CRM Hub (D-051) / Marketing Hub (D-053) / Sales Hub (D-054) / Service Hub (D-055) covering: bidirectional data-sync between HubSpot and 90+ external systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Stripe, Shopify, BigCommerce, Mailchimp, etc.); data-quality automation (deduplication, format-fix, property-validation, fuzzy-match); programmable automation (custom-code workflow actions in Node.js + Python); enterprise data-pipeline (Snowflake data-share, BigQuery sync, Amazon Redshift sync, AWS S3 export); webhook orchestration; conditional formula fields; activity-feed enrichment. Operations Hub is **substrate-class** within HubSpot — every other Hub depends on its sync + quality infrastructure.

**Vendor data model — 14 top objects.** `data-sync` (bidirectional sync-pair definition; HubSpot side + external side + field-mappings + frequency); `field-mapping` (per-sync, per-pair, per-direction; HubSpot property ↔ external field; transformation function); `data-quality-action` (one of: deduplicate-contacts, deduplicate-companies, format-fix-phone, format-fix-email, format-fix-name, property-cleanup, fuzzy-match-merge); `programmable-action` (custom-code action available in CRM Workflows; Node 20 runtime; can call npm packages, fetch HubSpot API, return outputs); `snowflake-data-share` (per-tenant Snowflake share; HubSpot pushes mirror of objects + activities + properties); `bigquery-sync` (per-tenant BQ dataset sync); `redshift-sync` (per-tenant Redshift schema sync); `s3-export` (S3 export of objects on schedule); `webhook` (outbound webhook with HMAC-signature + retry); `conditional-formula-field` (calculated property with conditional logic); `activity-enrichment` (third-party enrichment of contact/company on creation); `dataset` (Operations-Hub dataset for cross-object analysis); `data-quality-recommendation` (AI-suggested dedup/format-fix); `sync-rule` (per-sync filtering rule).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** REST: `v3/crm/imports`, `v3/automation/v4/custom-code-actions`, `v3/properties`, `v3/object-mappings` (data-sync), `v3/webhooks/subscriptions`, `v3/datasets`, `v3/data-sync` (Operations Hub specific). Webhooks: `hubspot.contact.creation`, `hubspot.contact.propertyChange`, `hubspot.deal.creation`, `hubspot.object.merge`, `hubspot.workflow.step.execution`. SDK: `@hubspot/api-client` (Node), `hubspot-api-client` (Python). CLI: HubSpot CLI v6 (`hs project deploy`, `hs serverless logs`, `hs workflow run`). Custom-code action runtime exposes `hubspot.client`, `getInputs()`, `outputFields`, `await secret.OPENBAO_TOKEN` patterns.

**15 distinctive UX surfaces.** Operations Hub home; Data Sync home; Sync mapping editor (drag-line field-pairs UI); Sync history (per-sync run-log with row-counts + error-detail); Data Quality home; Deduplication queue (review-merge UI showing fuzzy-matched pairs); Format Fix queue; Property Cleanup tool; Custom Code editor (Monaco IDE inside HubSpot with npm-import autocomplete); Programmable Workflow Step palette; Snowflake Data Share config; BigQuery Sync config; Webhook Settings; Activity Enrichment selector; Dataset Builder + Conditional Formula Field builder.

**Cedar permit block — 22 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in OperationsHubAction::"<verb>", resource in DataSync::"<sync-id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && resource.source_of_truth_pin.satisfied(context.field_path)
  && (context.action != "deploy-custom-code" || context.code_review_approved == true)
  && context.region == resource.tenant.residency_region
  && cross_pack_compatible(resource.data_class, principal.pack_set);
// Verbs: create-data-sync, configure-field-mapping, configure-conflict-resolution-rule, run-data-sync,
// pause-data-sync, run-data-quality-action-deduplicate, run-data-quality-action-format-fix,
// run-data-quality-action-property-cleanup, deploy-custom-code-action, execute-custom-code-action,
// configure-snowflake-data-share, configure-bigquery-sync, configure-redshift-sync, configure-s3-export,
// configure-webhook, run-webhook-replay, create-conditional-formula-field, configure-activity-enrichment,
// create-dataset, query-dataset, accept-data-quality-recommendation, configure-sync-rule.
```
KR-PIPA pack adds `data_class.cross_border_egress_consent_satisfied`. EU-AI-Act pack adds `risk_classification_assigned` for AI-recommended data-quality actions. GDPR pack adds `lawful_basis_recorded` per outbound-sync row.

**Ontology projection (vendor obj → oyatie entity, field-level deltas).** `operations.data_sync_config` ← `data-sync` (field rename: `sync_frequency` → `cadence_iso8601`); `operations.field_mapping` ← `field-mapping` (adds `transformation_lang_pin ∈ {none, javascript_v20, python_v311}` per ADR-0247 supply-chain pin); `operations.data_quality_action` ← `data-quality-action` (adds `confidence_floor` for AI-suggested actions per EU-AI-Act); `operations.programmable_action` ← `programmable-action` (collapses HubSpot's Node-only runtime onto oyatie's polyglot Function-Connector runtime); `operations.snowflake_sync_share` ← `snowflake-data-share` (binds to oyatie `data-warehouse` µservice with per-tenant credit-monitor cap); `operations.bigquery_sync_dataset` ← `bigquery-sync` (adds `residency_pin` field per ADR-0244 tenant-scoping); `operations.redshift_sync_schema` ← `redshift-sync` (adds `sortkey_pin` + `distkey_pin`); `operations.s3_export_target` ← `s3-export` (adds `kms_key_pin` + `encryption_mode` per ADR-0251); `operations.webhook_definition` ← `webhook` (adds `replay_window_hours` + `idempotency_key_strategy`); `operations.conditional_formula_field` ← `conditional-formula-field` (transpiles HubSpot formula DSL to oyatie expression-eval DSL); `operations.dataset` ← `dataset` (joins with `analytics` µservice).

**Workflow template library — 8 templates with steps.** `operations.bidirectional-sync-with-conflict-resolution` (24 steps: load-pair-def → resolve-credentials-from-OpenBao → fetch-source-delta → fetch-target-delta → diff-merge → detect-conflict → apply-source-of-truth-rule → audit-decision → push-to-source → push-to-target → confirm-receipt → re-fetch-confirm → publish-cdc-event → emit-metric → checkpoint-state); `operations.data-quality-deduplication-fuzzy-match` (19 steps: select-cohort → compute-fingerprint → fuzzy-match → score → confidence-gate → manual-review-queue → reviewer-approve-or-reject → audit-merge-decision → merge-objects → propagate-merge-to-related → emit-merge-event); `operations.custom-code-action-execute-with-pinned-runtime` (16 steps: load-action → fetch-input-bindings → resolve-secrets → spin-isolate → run-with-timeout → capture-output → enforce-output-schema → emit-metric → cleanup-isolate); `operations.snowflake-data-share-publish` (14 steps including consumer-account-attest); `operations.bigquery-sync-emit-with-residency-pin`; `operations.webhook-emit-with-hmac-and-replay-safe-id`; `operations.conditional-formula-field-evaluate-on-property-change`; `operations.data-quality-recommendation-explain` (with EU-AI-Act provenance attribution).

**UX shell adaptation.** White-collar (RevOps + data-engineer + analytics-engineer); desktop-primary sync-config builder + field-map UI + sync-history grid; per-sync error-detail drawer; per-deduplication review-queue with side-by-side comparison; embedded Monaco IDE for custom-code (with HubSpot autocomplete replaced by oyatie SDK autocomplete). Mobile read-only sync-status overview for on-call RevOps.

**Pack overlay applicable.** SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + HIPAA-eligible (BAA tenants — for healthcare RevOps); per-tenant data-egress audit; EU-AI-Act for AI-driven data-quality recommendations; per-jurisdiction residency-pin on Snowflake/BQ/Redshift sync targets.

**Capability-tier mapping (ADR-0316).** **Gold** on `data-pipeline` (bidirectional-sync + CDC + warehouse-publish); **Silver** on `workflow-engine` (programmable action only — not full DAG); **Silver** on `intelligence` (data-quality recommendations only); **Bronze** on `compliance` (basic audit; full data-class tagging is Snowflake/Catalog responsibility).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: `GET /v3/data-sync/listings` + `GET /v3/automation/v4/custom-code-actions` + `GET /v3/webhooks/subscriptions` + Snowflake/BQ/Redshift sync configs. (2) Schema mapping: per-sync field-pair extracted into oyatie ontology field-mapping rows. (3) Custom-code rewrite: Node-20 HubSpot runtime → oyatie polyglot Function-Connector with explicit runtime-pin per ADR-0247; npm packages pinned by lockfile + sigstore-attestation per ADR-0293. (4) Conflict resolution: source-of-truth rule extracted into per-field policy row. (5) Webhook re-target: HMAC secret rotation + replay-window-pin. (6) Snowflake share: producer-side share + consumer-tenant accept (per ADR-0249). (7) Cutover: dual-run window with checksum + delta-comparison; per-pair switchover with CDC-watermark pin. (8) Sunset: HubSpot Operations Hub deactivated; audit-log retained per regulatory mandate.

**Failure-mode coverage — 18 failures.**
- bidirectional-sync-loop (A→B→A→B change cycle): per-sync field-source-of-truth pin + cycle-detection via change-token-attribution.
- data-quality-dedup false-merge (two distinct people merged): per-merge confidence-floor + manual-split window + reversibility-guarantee.
- custom-code-action timeout > 20s: per-action TTL + retry budget + back-off jitter.
- custom-code-action npm supply-chain compromise: per-package sigstore-attestation gate per ADR-0293.
- field-mapping schema-drift (HubSpot adds property; external system has none): per-sync schema-drift detector + alert.
- Snowflake/BQ cost-spike on uncapped query: per-query cost-projection + reservation-cap.
- webhook replay-storm on retry-during-outage: per-webhook circuit-breaker + idempotency-key dedup.
- conditional-formula-field stale-cache (formula re-eval missed): per-field event-listener completeness check.
- bidirectional-sync credential-rotation downtime: dual-credentials window + canary-test.
- activity-enrichment third-party API quota-cliff: per-enricher quota-monitor + back-off.
- programmable-action secret-leak in logs: per-execution secret-scrub + redact-pattern.
- Snowflake share consumer-region mismatch: per-share residency-pin + accept-gate.
- BigQuery sync schema-evolution incompatibility: per-table schema-validate + reject-or-relax-policy.
- Redshift sync sortkey/distkey suboptimal-choice on target: post-sync re-optimize step.
- S3-export object-versioning collision: per-export bucket-versioning enforce.
- dataset cross-object join cardinality-blowup: per-dataset row-cap + sampling.
- conflict-resolution rule ambiguity (no rule for new field): per-sync default-policy with explicit-fallback.
- programmable-action runtime-EOL (Node 20 → Node 22 forced upgrade): per-action runtime-pin + advance-deprecation notice.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-066 - Zendesk Support

**Vendor identity and category.** Zendesk Support is the flagship ticket-routing + agent-workspace platform in the Zendesk Suite (formerly "Zendesk Classic"). It is the industry archetype for B2B + B2C support: multi-channel ticket ingest (email, web-form, API, messaging, voice via Talk = D-068, chat via Chat = D-067, social via Sunshine Conversations); ticket lifecycle with status state-machine (New → Open → Pending → Hold → Solved → Closed); macro library; view system (filtered ticket queues); trigger engine (event-driven); automation engine (time-based); SLA policies; business-hour schedules; multi-brand support; multi-product help-center (Guide); side-conversations (parallel internal threads on a parent ticket); light-agent (read-mostly) seats; collaboration tier; AI features (Advanced AI add-on, Answer Bot, Auto Resolve, Macro Suggestions).

**Vendor data model — 22 top objects.** `ticket` (id, status, priority, type ∈ {question, incident, problem, task}, requester, submitter, assignee, group, brand, ticket-form, custom-fields-map, tags, satisfaction-rating, due-at); `ticket-form` (per-brand or shared, with field-display ordering + conditions); `ticket-field` (system + custom; types: text, integer, decimal, date, dropdown, multiselect, regexp, checkbox, partial-credit-card, tagger); `comment` (public vs internal, attachments, author, html-body, voice-comment); `macro` (action-list + categories + restrictions per-group/user); `view` (filtered + sorted + grouped ticket-list, personal vs shared); `trigger` (condition-set + action-set, event-driven, ordered); `automation` (condition-set + action-set, time-based, hour-resolution); `sla-policy` (target, escalation-policy, per-priority); `schedule` (business hours per timezone, holidays); `group` (agent collection, routing target); `organization` (company-of-requesters); `user` (end-user vs agent vs admin, custom-roles, light-agent, contributor); `brand` (multi-brand: branding + help-center + support address); `side-conversation` (parent-ticket-id + child-conversation, channel ∈ {email, slack, msteams, child-ticket}); `target` (external HTTP endpoint as trigger-action); `webhook` (typed webhook v2 with HMAC + retry); `help-center.category` / `help-center.section` / `help-center.article` / `help-center.article-translation` / `help-center.community-topic` / `help-center.community-post`; `ticket-audit` (immutable per-ticket event log); `attachment` (with token-based URL + virus-scan).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** REST v2: `tickets`, `ticket_audits`, `users`, `organizations`, `macros`, `views`, `triggers`, `automations`, `sla_policies`, `schedules`, `groups`, `brands`, `ticket_fields`, `ticket_forms`, `dynamic_content` (i18n template variables), `side_conversations`, `webhooks`, `apps` (Zendesk App Framework / ZAF). Apps SDK: ZAF Client v2 (`client.invoke('ticket.update')`). CLI: ZCLI (`zcli apps:server`, `zcli themes:push`). Webhooks: ticket.created, ticket.updated, ticket.solved, comment.added, side_conversation.created. Streaming: Sunshine Events. Bulk export: incremental export endpoints `incremental/tickets`, `incremental/users` (5-minute cursor-based).

**16 distinctive UX surfaces.** Agent Workspace (single unified inbox with multi-channel rendering); Conversation panel; Apps sidebar; Macros menu; Views list; Ticket dialog; Side Conversation drawer; Schedule editor; SLA Policies editor; Triggers editor (with "if any/all" condition-builder); Automations editor; Macro Suggestions panel (AI); Answer Bot panel; Skills-based Routing config (Advanced AI); Light-Agent simplified view; Help Center theme editor + article composer; multi-brand switcher; Explore dashboard (BI = covered in D-Explore dossier separately). Mobile Agent app (iOS + Android) with reduced field-coverage.

**Cedar permit block — 23 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in ZendeskSupportAction::"<verb>", resource in Ticket::"<id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "merge-tickets" || resource.brand == context.target.brand)
  && (context.action != "view-ticket" || principal.role != "light-agent" || principal.group_membership.contains(resource.group_id))
  && resource.data_class.satisfies(principal.pack_set)
  && (context.action != "update-after-solved" || principal.role in ["admin", "support-admin"]);
// Verbs: create-ticket, view-ticket, update-ticket, transition-status, apply-macro, assign-to-group,
// assign-to-agent, escalate-to-sla-tier, merge-tickets, split-ticket, create-side-conversation,
// send-side-conversation-reply, run-trigger, run-automation, configure-business-hour, create-view,
// publish-help-center-article, translate-help-center-article, configure-multi-brand,
// add-internal-note, public-reply, configure-customer-satisfaction-survey, configure-skill-routing.
```
HIPAA pack adds `phi_redaction_satisfied(comment.body)`. EU-DSA pack adds `complaint_jurisdiction_recorded`. KR-PIPA pack adds `sensitive_info_consent_recorded(requester)`. FedRAMP pack restricts attachments to `kms_pin == "fips-140-2-validated"`.

**Ontology projection (vendor obj → oyatie entity, field-level deltas).** `itsm.ticket` ← `zendesk.ticket` (Zendesk's `status` 6-state collapses onto oyatie's 8-state with explicit `Hold` + `WaitingOnRequester` decomposition); `itsm.ticket_field` ← `ticket-field` (Zendesk's `tagger` field-type maps to oyatie's `taxonomy_ref`); `itsm.macro` ← `macro` (action-list serialized as expression-eval DSL with per-action audit); `itsm.view` ← `view` (filter-condition serialized as oyatie query DSL); `itsm.trigger` ← `trigger` (explicit `order` field added; Zendesk's implicit-order ambiguity resolved per ADR-0247 deterministic-eval); `itsm.automation` ← `automation` (cron-pin replaces Zendesk's hourly-resolution opaque scheduler); `itsm.sla_policy` ← `sla-policy` (multi-target per-priority preserved; adds `pause_condition_explicit` per oyatie clarity bar); `itsm.schedule` ← `schedule` (per-timezone + holiday-list preserved); `itsm.brand` ← `brand` (collapses onto oyatie multi-tenant `sub-tenant` per ADR-0244); `community.article` ← `help-center.article` (translation-tree preserved with explicit `master_locale_pin`); `community.community_post` ← `help-center.community-post`; `messenger.side_conversation` ← `side-conversation` (channel-pin explicit); `itsm.target` ← `target` (re-shaped into `apigw.outbound-webhook` per ADR-0245 substrate consolidation).

**Workflow template library — 9 templates with steps.** `zendesk.trigger-on-ticket-create-or-update` (21 steps: receive-event → resolve-tenant → load-trigger-set → evaluate-condition-set → resolve-order → execute-action-list → audit-each-action → handle-failure → emit-cdc → metric-publish); `zendesk.automation-on-business-hour-elapsed` (19 steps with timezone-aware schedule + holiday-skip); `zendesk.macro-application-with-audit` (15 steps including per-action reversibility-record); `zendesk.side-conversation-to-internal-team` (17 steps with channel-fanout); `zendesk.help-center-multi-brand-publication` (22 steps including translation-fanout); `zendesk.sla-policy-tracker-with-pause-resume` (18 steps); `zendesk.skill-based-routing-with-fallback` (16 steps); `zendesk.csat-survey-emit-after-solved` (14 steps); `zendesk.macro-suggestion-with-explainability` (Advanced AI; EU-AI-Act provenance attribution; 18 steps).

**UX shell adaptation.** Pink-collar (agent + light-agent) primary; desktop-primary agent workspace with multi-channel renderer; mobile-secondary for on-call + light-agent; white-collar (admin + support-ops + KB-author) desktop-primary admin console; B2C end-user help-center mobile-primary + community-portal mobile-primary; supervisor desktop-primary monitor + escalation queue.

**Pack overlay applicable.** SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + HIPAA-eligible (BAA tenants — for healthcare support); FedRAMP-Moderate (Zendesk-Gov tier); EU-DSA for consumer-complaints; per-jurisdiction record-retention; PCI-DSS for payment-touching tickets (with attachment-redaction).

**Capability-tier mapping (ADR-0316).** **Platinum** on `itsm` (full ticket lifecycle, SLA, multi-brand, multi-channel ingest); **Gold** on `community` (multi-brand Help Center + community-posts + translation-tree); **Silver** on `messenger` (side-conversations only — full messenger is D-067 Chat); **Silver** on `intelligence` (Answer Bot + macro-suggest with EU-AI-Act provenance); **Bronze** on `crm` (requester customer-360 binding only — full CRM is D-051).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: incremental `tickets`/`users`/`organizations` export + `triggers`/`automations`/`views`/`macros`/`sla_policies`/`schedules`/`brands`/`ticket_forms`/`ticket_fields`/`help_center.*` JSON snapshots. (2) Brand mapping: each Zendesk brand → oyatie sub-tenant per ADR-0244. (3) Trigger normalization: implicit-order resolved into explicit ordering; condition-set transpiled to oyatie expression-eval DSL with golden-test on replay-corpus. (4) Macro reversibility: each action assigned reversibility-record (some Zendesk macro-actions are not reversible). (5) Help-Center translation-tree: master-locale-pin per-article; translation-graph imported. (6) Side-conversation channel migration: per-channel credential rotation (Slack/MSTeams app-install + email-routing). (7) SLA policy validation: per-priority golden-test against historical-corpus to detect calculation drift. (8) Cutover: dual-write window with per-ticket id-map; canary-brand first, then per-brand rollout; CSAT-survey suppression during dual-run to avoid duplicate sends. (9) Sunset: Zendesk subscription deactivation with audit-log retention per regulatory mandate.

**Failure-mode coverage — 19 failures.**
- trigger-firing-order ambiguity (multiple triggers match same event): per-trigger explicit `order` field + deterministic eval + replay-corpus validate.
- macro-side-effect non-reversibility on cross-brand-merge: per-macro reversibility-record + brand-scope-pin.
- light-agent permission-bleed (light-agent sees ticket they shouldn't): per-user group-membership scope + Cedar audit on every read.
- Help-Center article translation-version desync (English updated but Korean stale): per-article master-translation pin + downstream-translation-flag.
- multi-brand SLA-policy ambiguity: per-brand SLA-policy-pin + fallback-document.
- ticket-merge data-loss (custom-field collision): per-merge field-merge-policy + audit-each-decision.
- side-conversation Slack-app permission expiry: per-app token-refresh schedule + alert on near-expiry.
- ZAF v1 → v2 app-framework drift: per-app version-pin + deprecation-window.
- incremental-export cursor-skip on rate-limit: per-export cursor-checkpoint + replay-from-last-known-good.
- Answer-Bot hallucination on stale-KB: per-bot KB-version-pin + confidence-floor + grounded-attribution.
- CSAT-survey duplicate-send during dual-run: per-ticket survey-emit dedup.
- macro-suggestion bias (suggests deflection on PII tickets): per-suggestion EU-AI-Act explainability gate.
- multi-brand attachment-leak (attachment URL leaks across brand): per-attachment brand-scope-token.
- skills-based-routing dead-letter (no agent has skill): per-route fallback-group + escalation-policy.
- automation-firing-storm on backfill (1M old tickets pass condition at once): per-automation rate-limit + replay-throttle.
- webhook-v1 → v2 cutover with payload-shape change: per-target webhook-version-pin + dual-emit during cutover.
- ticket-form conditional-field dependency loop: per-form dependency-graph cycle-detection.
- end-user end-of-life (user deleted) referenced-by trigger: per-trigger null-guard + skip-or-fallback policy.
- explore-dashboard stale-aggregation on bulk-import: per-dashboard cache-invalidate post-import.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-067 - Zendesk Chat

**Vendor identity and category.** Zendesk Chat (acquired from Zopim 2014, integrated into Zendesk Suite 2018, repositioned as "Zendesk Messaging" 2021) is the live-chat + bot + multi-channel messaging-inbox layer of the Zendesk ecosystem. It covers: synchronous live-chat sessions over WebSocket on web + mobile (iOS + Android SDK); persistent messaging (conversation continues across sessions); social-channel ingest (WhatsApp Business API, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DM, Twitter DM, X DM, WeChat, LINE, KakaoTalk, Apple Business Chat / Apple Messages for Business); SMS via Twilio (D-Twilio dossier); bot-build via Flow Builder; deflection via Suunto Conversations (acquired Smooch.io); proactive messaging; in-app messaging.

**Vendor data model — 19 top objects.** `conversation` (persistent session container, multi-channel); `chat-session` (synchronous active session within conversation); `message` (text, image, file, location, postback, carousel, form, signal); `participant` (end-user, agent, bot, light-agent); `agent-workspace-conversation` (the agent-side conversation panel state); `bot` (Flow Builder bot with intents + entities); `bot-flow` (visual graph of bot-conversation steps); `intent` (NLU classification); `entity` (NLU slot-filling); `pre-defined-response` (canned-response with shortcut-trigger); `skill` (per-agent skill tag for routing); `routing-rule` (skills-based + load-balanced); `proactive-trigger` (web-only: page-dwell-time, scroll-depth, exit-intent); `proactive-message` (the pushed message); `widget-config` (per-website customization); `mobile-sdk-config` (per-app customization); `channel-integration` (per-social-channel; WhatsApp Business / FB / IG / WeChat / KakaoTalk / etc); `business-hours` (when chat is available); `csat-survey-template` (post-chat survey).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** REST: Chat-API v2 (`chats`, `agents`, `departments`, `shortcuts`, `triggers`, `bans`, `goals`, `roles`); Conversations API (Sunshine Conversations: `apps`, `users`, `conversations`, `messages`, `clients`, `integrations`); Real-time Streaming API (WebSocket for agent-workspace); Bot REST (`flows`, `intents`, `entities`, `connections`). SDK: Web Widget v2 (Snippet), Mobile Chat SDK v2 for iOS (Swift) + Android (Kotlin), Unity SDK. Channel adapter: WhatsApp Business Platform v2.x (via Sunshine Conversations or direct Cloud API); Apple Messages for Business; Google Business Messages. Webhooks: `conversation:create`, `conversation:message`, `conversation:postback`, `bot:handoff-requested`. Bot-build: Flow Builder no-code visual editor + Bot Studio (advanced).

**15 distinctive UX surfaces.** Agent Workspace Conversation panel (concurrent multi-session tabs); Conversation queue (skills-routed); Visitor list (web-active, with click-stream traces); Flow Builder canvas (drag-node bot-builder with intent + carousel + form nodes); Intent training UI; Pre-defined Response editor with shortcut-trigger; Skills config; Department config; Proactive Triggers editor; Widget Appearance editor (web + mobile SDK preview); Mobile SDK config; Channel Integration setup (WhatsApp template manager, FB page-bind, IG account-bind, WeChat OA-bind, KakaoTalk bizboard-bind); Business Hours scheduler; CSAT Survey designer; Real-time Dashboard (active visitors, agent-load, queue-depth); Mobile Agent app for on-the-go chat.

**Cedar permit block — 22 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in ChatAction::"<verb>", resource in ChatSession::"<session-id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "open-WhatsApp-session" || context.business_window.within_24h || context.template.approved)
  && (context.action != "record-session" || context.consent.recording_satisfied(context.jurisdiction))
  && (context.action != "send-message" || principal.role in ["agent", "bot", "supervisor"] || principal == resource.requester)
  && resource.data_class.satisfies(principal.pack_set);
// Verbs: open-session, accept-session, transfer-session, end-session, send-message, send-pre-canned-response,
// send-carousel, send-form, run-bot-handoff, configure-bot-flow, train-intent, deploy-bot, escalate-to-supervisor,
// run-skill-match, configure-chat-widget, configure-mobile-sdk, run-proactive-message,
// configure-channel-integration-whatsapp, configure-channel-integration-facebook, configure-channel-integration-instagram,
// configure-channel-integration-wechat, configure-business-hour, send-csat-survey, configure-record-session.
```
GDPR pack adds `cookie_consent_satisfied(widget_purpose)` + `record_consent_explicit`. KR-PIPA pack adds `sensitive_info_redaction_satisfied`. Two-party-recording jurisdictions (CA, IL, etc.) gate `record-session` on dual-consent. WhatsApp Business 24-hour rule enforced at Cedar layer: outside 24-hour window, only `approved_template` may be sent.

**Ontology projection (vendor obj → oyatie entity, field-level deltas).** `messenger.conversation` ← `conversation` (multi-channel preserved with explicit `channel_id_pin`); `messenger.session` ← `chat-session` (synchronous burst within persistent conversation); `messenger.message` ← `message` (oyatie `message_type` enum closed-set per ADR-0247: text/image/file/location/postback/carousel/form/signal; Zendesk's `signal` opaque-type rejected — must classify); `intelligence.bot` ← `bot` (collapses onto oyatie AI substrate per ADR-0255 KS#14); `intelligence.bot_flow` ← `bot-flow` (visual graph transpiled to oyatie expression-eval workflow DSL); `intelligence.intent` ← `intent` (NLU classifier with EU-AI-Act risk classification); `intelligence.entity` ← `entity` (slot-filling NLU); `messenger.canned_response` ← `pre-defined-response`; `messenger.skill` ← `skill`; `messenger.routing_rule` ← `routing-rule`; `messenger.proactive_trigger` ← `proactive-trigger` (with mandatory frequency-cap per oyatie spam-mitigation); `messenger.widget_config` ← `widget-config` (with cookie-consent-purpose-mapping mandatory per GDPR); `comms-whatsapp.template` ← `whatsapp-template` (per ADR business-init template with approval-state pin); per-channel integration → `comms-sms` / `comms-whatsapp` / `comms-facebook` / `comms-instagram` / `comms-wechat` / `comms-kakaotalk` rails per ADR-0255.

**Workflow template library — 9 templates with steps.** `chat.bot-first-then-human-handoff` (24 steps: receive-msg → classify-intent → confidence-gate → bot-respond OR queue-for-human → context-bag-pin → handoff-with-history → agent-accept → render-context → respond-conversational); `chat.proactive-message-on-page-dwell-time` (17 steps with frequency-cap + opt-out + cookie-consent gate); `chat.skill-based-routing-with-load-balance` (19 steps); `chat.session-end-with-CSAT` (13 steps); `chat.multi-channel-merge-into-single-conversation` (21 steps with identity-resolution + manual-confirm); `chat.whatsapp-template-emit-outside-24h-window` (16 steps with approval-state + delivery-confirmation); `chat.bot-fallback-to-agent-on-confidence-floor` (14 steps); `chat.proactive-trigger-with-frequency-cap` (12 steps); `chat.csat-survey-emit-conditional-on-resolution` (11 steps).

**UX shell adaptation.** Pink-collar agent desktop-primary with concurrent-session tab panel (typical agent handles 3-5 chats simultaneously); supervisor desktop-primary monitor dashboard + queue-depth; bot-builder white-collar desktop-primary Flow Builder; B2C end-user web-widget + mobile-SDK + native social-channel rendering (no oyatie UX on third-party messaging surfaces).

**Pack overlay applicable.** SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + per-jurisdiction chat-recording-consent (US one-party vs two-party state law; EU GDPR explicit-consent; CA PIPEDA); HIPAA-eligible (BAA tenants); per-jurisdiction social-channel data-residency (e.g., WeChat must reside in China, KakaoTalk requires KR-PIPA, LINE varies by region); EU-DSA for consumer messaging; EU-AI-Act for bot deployment.

**Capability-tier mapping (ADR-0316).** **Platinum** on `messenger` (full multi-channel conversation + bot + proactive); **Gold** on `intelligence` (bot-flow + intent + entity NLU + handoff); **Silver** on `community` (chat-widget on portal embed only); **Bronze** on `comms-sms` + `comms-whatsapp` (per-channel rail integration only — full SMS/WhatsApp rail is D-Twilio).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: Chat-API + Conversations-API export of all conversations + messages + bots + flows + intents + entities + skills + routing-rules + widget-configs + channel-integrations. (2) Channel-integration credential migration: per-WhatsApp BSP credential rotation (Sunshine → oyatie BSP), per-FB page-token, per-IG account-bind, per-WeChat OA-bind, per-KakaoTalk bizboard, per-LINE OA. (3) Bot-flow transpile: Flow Builder visual graph → oyatie workflow DSL with golden-test on N representative conversations. (4) Intent retrain: NLU classifier retraining on oyatie intelligence substrate with EU-AI-Act risk-classification per intent. (5) Widget snippet swap: per-website widget script-tag updated to oyatie messenger SDK; mobile SDK app-update with backwards-compat shim during dual-run. (6) Identity-resolution: per-conversation user-id mapping with manual-confirm queue for ambiguous matches. (7) Proactive triggers: re-deploy with frequency-cap default (Zendesk did not enforce; oyatie does). (8) Cutover: per-channel staged migration; WhatsApp first (highest-friction credential rotation), then web-widget, then mobile-SDK. (9) Sunset: Zendesk Chat subscription deactivation with conversation-history retention per regulatory mandate.

**Failure-mode coverage — 19 failures.**
- WhatsApp Business API 24-hour session-window expiry: per-window business-message-template fallback + approval-state-pin + delivery-confirmation.
- bot-to-human handoff context-loss: per-session context-bag with full conversation history + intent-trail + entity-slot-state.
- multi-channel-merge identity-mismatch (WhatsApp number vs email vs FB ID): per-session identity-resolution + confidence-floor + manual-confirm queue.
- proactive-message spam-perception: per-trigger frequency-cap + opt-out signal-respect + per-user global-cap.
- chat-widget GDPR cookie-consent gating: per-widget per-purpose pre-consent suppression; widget refuses to load until consent satisfied.
- WhatsApp template-approval revocation by Meta: per-template approval-state monitor + alert.
- bot-NLU training-data PII-leak: per-utterance PII-redaction before training.
- channel-integration credential expiry (FB page-token 60-day rotation): per-credential rotation-schedule + alert on near-expiry.
- mobile-SDK forced app-update during cutover: per-SDK backwards-compat shim during dual-run window.
- agent-workspace concurrent-session overload (agent assigned 20 sessions): per-agent concurrency-cap.
- bot-flow infinite-loop (cycle in graph): per-flow cycle-detection at deploy-time.
- Apple Business Chat / Apple Messages for Business signed-payload mismatch: per-app key-rotation schedule.
- WeChat OA message-quota cliff (1M template/day): per-OA quota-monitor.
- KakaoTalk bizboard message-type restriction (free-form only within 24h): per-conversation window-tracker.
- session-recording two-party-consent jurisdiction-mismatch: per-call jurisdiction-resolve at session-start.
- bot-deflection false-positive (resolves issue but customer not actually satisfied): per-resolution CSAT-survey post-bot-only-resolution + escalation-loop on low CSAT.
- proactive-trigger storm on traffic-spike: per-trigger rate-limit + global tenant-cap.
- mobile push-notification consent revocation: per-user notification-consent state-tracking + opt-out respect.
- agent-workspace WebSocket reconnect-storm on tenant restart: per-tenant connection-throttle + exponential-back-off.
