### Section D-068 - Zendesk Talk

**Vendor identity and category.** Zendesk Talk is the cloud-PBX + contact-center voice layer of the Zendesk ecosystem (launched 2014, OEM-built on Twilio Voice infrastructure). It covers: cloud-telephony (inbound + outbound + transfer + conference); DID (Direct Inward Dialing) provisioning + number-porting (LNP) across 70+ countries; IVR (Interactive Voice Response) tree-builder; ACD (Automatic Call Distribution) skills-based routing; call-recording with per-jurisdiction consent-prompt; voicemail with transcription; queue-management with overflow; callback-from-queue (position-preserved); softphone embedded in Agent Workspace; supervisor monitor/whisper/barge; real-time + historical analytics (Talk Analytics); CSAT post-call; voice-to-text transcription (via partnership with Voxpopme or AssemblyAI); sentiment-analysis (Advanced AI add-on); SIP-trunk option (Talk Partner Edition for BYO carrier); embedded voice (in-browser via WebRTC).

**Vendor data model — 18 top objects.** `call` (id, direction, status ∈ {created, ringing, in_progress, completed, missed, voicemail}, duration, recording-url, from, to, agent, group, transferred_from); `queue` (per-skills-route container with overflow + max-wait); `ivr-tree` (root-node + branch-nodes; each node has prompt + key-press-action + speech-recognition-action); `ivr-node` (greeting / menu / capture-digits / route-to-queue / route-to-agent / route-to-voicemail / business-hours-switch / time-of-day-switch); `agent-session` (per-shift, with status ∈ {available, away, transfers_only, offline}, skills-bound); `recording` (audio + url + duration + consent-state); `transcript` (text + word-level-timing + speaker-diarization + confidence); `DID` (E.164 phone number with country + region + capability-set {voice, sms, mms}); `SIP-trunk` (BYO carrier with TLS + SRTP); `voicemail` (audio + transcript + email-notification + ticket-link); `callback-request` (queued callback with position-preservation + retry-policy); `business-hours-config` (per-line, per-tz, with holiday-overrides); `skill` (per-agent skill tag for routing); `transfer-target` (warm vs cold transfer destination); `whisper-message` (supervisor-to-agent private side-channel); `barge-event` (supervisor joining call); `outbound-campaign` (preview + progressive + predictive dialer) — Advanced edition only; `wallboard` (real-time supervisor display).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** REST: Talk-API v1 (`calls`, `agents/availabilities`, `agents/calls/<id>`, `legs`, `recordings`, `voicemails`, `callbacks`, `phone_numbers`, `addresses`, `lines`, `groups/<id>/availability`). Voice API (programmable, via Twilio under-the-hood): TwiML-compatible verbs (`<Dial>`, `<Gather>`, `<Record>`, `<Say>`, `<Play>`, `<Hangup>`); WebRTC SDK (browser softphone JS SDK); Mobile SDK (iOS + Android voice). Real-time: WebSocket events (`agent.available`, `call.connected`, `call.completed`, `call.transferred`). Webhooks: call.created, call.completed, voicemail.created, recording.ready, transcript.ready. Carrier admin: Bandwidth + Twilio number-pool + LNP port-request via vendor portal (no API for some carrier operations).

**14 distinctive UX surfaces.** Softphone embedded panel (in-browser WebRTC dialer with mute/hold/transfer/conference buttons); Screen-pop (incoming-call CTI with customer-360 from CRM); Agent state-switcher (available/away/transfers_only/offline); IVR Tree Designer (drag-node visual builder); Queue config; Skill config; Number management (per-DID assignment + capability config); Voicemail inbox; Recording playback with waveform + transcript-overlay + speaker-diarization; Wallboard (real-time supervisor display with queue-depth + agent-state + service-level); Talk Analytics dashboard; Outbound Campaign builder (Advanced); Callback Queue with position display; Business Hours editor; Mobile Agent app voice-pickup.

**Cedar permit block — 25 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in ContactCenterAction::"<verb>", resource in Call::"<call-id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "record-call" || two_party_consent_satisfied_if_required(call.from_jurisdiction, call.to_jurisdiction))
  && (context.action != "outbound-call" || tcpa_consent_satisfied(call.to, call.calling_window))
  && (context.action != "monitor-call" || principal.role in ["supervisor", "compliance-officer"])
  && (context.action != "port-DID" || lnp_evidence.signed && number.no_active_lock)
  && context.region == resource.tenant.residency_region;
// Verbs: accept-call, initiate-outbound-call, transfer-call-warm, transfer-call-cold, hold-call, resume-call,
// conference, record-call, pause-recording, resume-recording, retrieve-recording, retrieve-transcript,
// monitor-call, barge-call, whisper-to-agent, configure-IVR-tree, modify-IVR-node, configure-queue,
// configure-skill, route-callback-from-queue, configure-DID, port-DID-LNP, release-DID, configure-SIP-trunk,
// retrieve-voicemail.
```
HIPAA pack adds `phi_redaction_satisfied(transcript)`. PCI-DSS pack adds `pause_recording_on_payment_capture` (auto-pause during card-collection IVR step). TCPA pack adds `dnc_list_check_passed` + `time_of_day_consent_window`. E911 / Kari's Law gates emergency-routing on `extension.no_prefix_required`. EU-AI-Act gates sentiment-analysis on `risk_classification_assigned`.

**Ontology projection (vendor obj → oyatie entity, field-level deltas).** `contact_center.call` ← `call` (Zendesk's status enum extended with explicit `quarantined_for_compliance_review` state per oyatie compliance bar); `contact_center.queue` ← `queue` (adds explicit `overflow_policy` enum: {fallback-group, voicemail, callback, busy-tone}); `contact_center.ivr_tree` ← `ivr-tree` (transpiles to oyatie workflow DSL with explicit timeout-fallback per node); `contact_center.ivr_node` ← `ivr-node` (closed-type enum per oyatie clarity bar); `contact_center.agent_session` ← `agent-session`; `contact_center.recording` ← `recording` (adds `consent_state_pin` field with jurisdiction-resolution-trail; KMS-encrypted with per-tenant key); `contact_center.transcript` ← `transcript` (adds EU-AI-Act provenance per word-confidence); `contact_center.DID` ← `DID` (E.164 + capability-set + per-country-regulatory-binding); `contact_center.SIP_trunk` ← `SIP-trunk` (TLS + SRTP mandatory per oyatie security bar; SIP-over-UDP refused); `contact_center.voicemail` ← `voicemail` (transcript + ticket-link via `itsm` µservice binding); `contact_center.callback_request` ← `callback-request` (position-preservation + retry-policy explicit-pin); `contact_center.business_hours` ← `business-hours-config` (timezone + holiday-list); `contact_center.outbound_campaign` ← `outbound-campaign` (preview/progressive/predictive + TCPA-DNC-check mandatory).

**Workflow template library — 9 templates with steps.** `contact_center.IVR-tree-route-with-skills-and-fallback` (24 steps: receive-call → play-greeting → capture-digits → branch-on-input → resolve-skill → check-queue-availability → route-to-best-agent → on-timeout-route-to-fallback-queue → on-overflow-route-to-voicemail → log-decision); `contact_center.queue-overflow-with-fallback` (17 steps); `contact_center.callback-from-queue-with-position-preservation` (19 steps); `contact_center.call-recording-with-consent-prompt` (16 steps: detect-jurisdiction → resolve-consent-policy → play-consent-prompt → capture-consent → start-recording-only-if-consented → mid-call-pause-on-payment-IVR → stop-recording-on-end → archive-with-consent-pin); `contact_center.supervisor-monitor-barge-whisper` (14 steps); `contact_center.DID-port-with-LNP-evidence` (21 steps with carrier-side coordination + dual-routing); `contact_center.outbound-tcpa-compliant-campaign` (23 steps with DNC-check + time-of-day-gate + consent-record); `contact_center.E911-emergency-routing` (15 steps with location-pin + multi-line-callback); `contact_center.voicemail-to-ticket-with-transcript` (12 steps).

**UX shell adaptation.** Pink-collar agent desktop-primary with embedded softphone + screen-pop CTI; supervisor desktop-primary wallboard with multi-agent monitor + barge/whisper controls; admin desktop-primary IVR tree-designer + number-management console; mobile agent app for on-the-go voice-pickup (limited feature-set); B2C end-user phone-call (no UX — native dialer on customer device).

**Pack overlay applicable.** SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + per-jurisdiction call-recording-consent (US one-party vs two-party state law: CA, FL, IL, MD, MA, MT, NV, NH, PA, WA; EU GDPR explicit-consent; CA PIPEDA); TCPA (US consumer-calling restrictions: time-of-day + DNC-list + opt-out); E911 / Kari's Law (mandatory direct 911 dialing + on-site notification + dispatchable address); Ray Baum's Act (dispatchable location); HIPAA-eligible (BAA tenants); PCI-DSS for payment-collection IVR (auto-pause recording during card-capture); FedRAMP-Moderate (Talk-Gov tier); per-jurisdiction lawful-intercept (CALEA for US carriers).

**Capability-tier mapping (ADR-0316).** **Platinum** on `contact-center` (full voice + IVR + ACD + recording + LNP + supervisor); **Gold** on `intelligence` (transcription + sentiment-analysis with EU-AI-Act provenance); **Silver** on `itsm` (Talk-to-ticket bridge with screen-pop); **Bronze** on `cloud-iac` (per-tenant SIP-trunk + DID provisioning).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: Talk-API + carrier-portal extraction of all calls + recordings + transcripts + IVR-trees + queues + skills + agent-sessions + DID-pool + SIP-trunks + business-hours + voicemails + callbacks. (2) DID + LNP preparation: per-number LNP-request submission to carrier (10-30 day window per country); CSR (Customer Service Record) generation; losing-carrier authorization. (3) IVR-tree transpile: Zendesk visual tree → oyatie workflow DSL with golden-test on representative call-corpus + timeout-fallback per node mandatory. (4) Skills + queue migration: per-skill agent-binding + queue-config + overflow-policy. (5) Recording migration: per-recording consent-state-pin extracted from call-metadata + jurisdiction-resolve audit; KMS re-encrypt with per-tenant oyatie key; archive-retention per regulatory mandate. (6) Per-jurisdiction consent-policy table seeded at oyatie compliance layer. (7) SIP-trunk migration: BYO-carrier credential rotation with TLS+SRTP enforcement; legacy UDP-trunk refused per oyatie security bar. (8) Cutover: per-DID staged-port with parallel-route window (both Zendesk Talk and oyatie route the number simultaneously during port-completion); 911-availability guarantee during port (carrier-side bridge); per-IVR-tree dual-deploy + canary; per-queue staged-migration. (9) Sunset: Zendesk Talk subscription deactivation; recording + transcript retention transferred to oyatie storage per regulatory mandate (US: 7 years for PCI-touching; HIPAA: 6 years; GDPR: per lawful-basis).

**Failure-mode coverage — 20 failures.**
- DID-port downtime (number unreachable during port window): per-DID staged-port with parallel-route + 911-availability guarantee from both source + target carriers.
- call-recording-consent jurisdiction-mismatch (caller in two-party state + callee in one-party state): per-call jurisdiction-resolve at start-of-call with stricter-jurisdiction-wins policy.
- E911 / Kari's Law dialing-restriction bypass (4-digit dial not routed to 911): per-extension prefix-routing rule + automated test on deploy.
- Ray Baum's Act dispatchable-address miss: per-line address-binding validation at deploy + on agent-relocation.
- SIP-trunk capacity-cliff (peak load > provisioned capacity): per-trunk capacity-monitor + auto-scale + overflow-trunk failover.
- IVR-tree timeout-loop (caller stuck in IVR > 5 minutes): per-tree global-timeout-fallback to live-agent.
- TCPA DNC-list staleness (user removed from DNC but cached): per-campaign DNC-refresh cadence + check-at-dial-time.
- TCPA time-of-day violation (auto-dialer fires at 7am local time): per-call timezone-resolve + window-check at dial-time.
- PCI-DSS payment-capture recording-leak (recording not paused during card-collection IVR step): per-IVR-step pause-recording-marker + auto-redaction on transcript.
- transcript PHI-leak (HIPAA tenants): per-transcript PHI-pattern-redaction + manual-review-queue on confidence-floor.
- recording KMS-key-rotation orphan (old key rotated away; recording undecryptable): per-recording key-version-pin + dual-key-window during rotation.
- callback-from-queue position-loss on tenant-restart: per-queue callback-state durable-store + replay.
- supervisor-barge consent-mismatch (caller not informed of supervisor join): per-jurisdiction barge-disclosure-policy + audio-tone-marker.
- voicemail-transcription-error on accented-English: per-transcript confidence-floor + fallback-to-listen-link.
- SIP-trunk TLS-cert expiry: per-trunk cert-expiry-monitor + auto-renew + 30-day-alert.
- WebRTC browser-version drift (Chrome update breaks softphone): per-SDK version-test + back-pressure on regression.
- outbound-campaign predictive-dialer over-dial-rate (TCPA 3% abandon-rate cap exceeded): per-campaign real-time abandon-monitor + auto-throttle.
- per-country DID-regulatory binding-failure (e.g., German DIDs require local-address): per-country regulatory-checklist + provision-blocker until satisfied.
- carrier-side LNP rejection (CSR mismatch): per-port automated CSR-validation + correction-loop.
- cross-tenant DID-leak (one tenant's number routes to another tenant): per-DID tenant-binding-immutable + Cedar-gated routing.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-069 - Intercom

**Vendor identity and category.** Intercom is the customer-messaging + in-app-engagement + AI-agent platform pioneered for product-led-growth SaaS (founded 2011). It spans: live-chat + in-app-messenger; outbound product-tour + announcement + banner + tooltip + checklist; help-center (Articles); Fin AI Agent (LLM-grounded chatbot launched 2023, refactor of Resolution Bot); Workflows (visual automation builder, formerly "Custom Bots"); Surveys; News (in-app newsfeed); Series (multi-step outbound campaigns); Inbox (agent workspace); Reports + Custom Reports; mobile push + carousels; CRM-light (Lead + User + Company); third-party integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, Shopify, Slack, MS Teams). Intercom is positioned as the "customer service platform built for AI" since 2023.

**Vendor data model — 22 top objects.** `conversation` (open vs closed, channel ∈ {in-app, email, sms, fb-messenger, instagram-dm, whatsapp}, parts: each message-or-event); `conversation-part` (the atomic message + author + delivered-as); `user` (signed-in end-user with user_id + email + custom-attributes + tags); `lead` (anonymous-or-pre-signup with cookie-id, can upgrade to user); `company` (B2B account containing users, with size + industry + plan + custom-attributes); `contact` (unified user-or-lead in newer API); `teammate` (Intercom-side agent with role + permissions); `team` (group of teammates); `workflow` (visual automation graph, formerly Bots; nodes: send-message, branch-condition, ask-question, route-to-team, hand-off-to-fin); `fin-ai-agent` (LLM agent grounded on Help Center + custom-answer + retrieval-source); `custom-answer` (override-response for high-intent queries); `product-tour` (multi-step in-app guided tour with hotspots + tooltips + modals); `checklist` (progress-tracker for onboarding); `tooltip` (single contextual UI hint); `banner` (top/bottom in-app notice); `news-item` (in-app newsfeed entry); `survey` (in-product or email survey with NPS + CSAT + rating + multi-question); `series` (multi-step outbound campaign with cohort-target + step-graph); `help-center-collection` / `help-center-article`; `tag` / `segment` (filter-bound user cohort); `outbound-message` (single email/push/in-app blast); `event` (custom-tracked user event for triggering).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** REST v2.x: `contacts`, `conversations`, `companies`, `events`, `data_attributes`, `tags`, `segments`, `articles`, `news_items`, `notes`, `teams`, `teammates`, `subscription_types`, `workflows`, `phone_call_redirects`. Messenger SDK: Web (`intercomSettings` + boot script), iOS (Swift framework), Android (Kotlin/Java SDK), React Native, Flutter. Webhooks: `conversation.user.created`, `conversation.admin.replied`, `conversation.admin.assigned`, `user.created`, `user.tag.created`. Operator (workflow runtime), Fin AI Agent (LLM with retrieval over Help Center). Streaming: real-time WebSocket for inbox. App-build: Canvas Kit for embedded inbox apps (declarative JSON for UI cards).

**16 distinctive UX surfaces.** Intercom Inbox (agent-workspace with conversation-list + active-conversation + customer-context-sidebar); Workflow builder canvas (no-code drag-node graph); Fin AI Agent setup with KB-source selector + custom-answers; Product Tour builder (preview-mode within target product); Survey builder; News composer; Banner config; Tooltip targeting; Checklist editor; Series multi-step campaign builder; Audience/Segment builder with filter-DSL; Tag manager; Custom Attribute manager; Subscription Type manager; Help Center theme + article editor with reader-analytics; Reports + Custom Reports dashboard; Intercom Switch (Intercom + Phone for inbound voice call-redirects, paid add-on).

**Cedar permit block — 22 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in IntercomAction::"<verb>", resource in Conversation::"<conv-id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "send-outbound-message" || frequency_cap_satisfied(resource.recipient, context.global_cap))
  && (context.action != "launch-product-tour" || cookie_consent_satisfied(context.purpose))
  && (context.action != "deploy-fin-ai-agent" || risk_classification_assigned && kb_version_pinned)
  && (context.action != "tag-pii-attribute" || data_class_satisfies(principal.pack_set))
  && context.region == resource.tenant.residency_region;
// Verbs: send-message, create-conversation, assign-to-teammate, assign-to-team, route-conversation,
// run-workflow, deploy-workflow, train-fin-ai-agent, deploy-fin-ai-agent, configure-custom-answer,
// configure-product-tour, launch-product-tour, configure-banner, configure-survey, send-survey,
// configure-checklist, configure-tooltip, publish-news-item, send-outbound-message, send-series-campaign,
// create-segment, create-help-center-article.
```
GDPR pack adds `cookie_consent_satisfied(messenger_purpose)` + `lawful_basis_recorded` per outbound. KR-PIPA pack adds `marketing_consent_explicit`. CCPA pack adds `opt_out_signal_respected`. EU-AI-Act pack adds `risk_classification_assigned` for Fin AI Agent + `provenance_attribution_on_response`. EU-DSA pack adds `complaint_route_visible_on_messenger`.

**Ontology projection (vendor obj → oyatie entity, field-level deltas).** `messenger.conversation` ← `conversation` (channel-pin explicit per oyatie clarity bar; `conversation-part` array preserved with author-attribution); `messenger.message` ← `conversation-part` (closed-type enum per oyatie); `crm.lead` ← `lead` (cookie-id + upgrade-path to user); `crm.contact` ← `user` (signed-in with stable user_id); `crm.company` ← `company` (B2B account container); `intelligence.workflow` ← `workflow` (visual graph transpiled to oyatie workflow DSL with explicit re-enrollment-policy per ADR-0247 deterministic-eval); `intelligence.ai_agent` ← `fin-ai-agent` (collapses onto oyatie AI substrate per ADR-0255 with mandatory KB-version-pin + grounded-attribution + EU-AI-Act risk-classification); `intelligence.custom_answer` ← `custom-answer` (override-pattern with confidence-bypass); `community.product_tour` ← `product-tour` (cookie-consent-purpose-binding mandatory); `community.checklist` ← `checklist`; `community.banner` ← `banner`; `community.tooltip` ← `tooltip`; `community.news_item` ← `news-item`; `community.help_center_article` ← `help-center-article`; `marketing-automation.survey` ← `survey` (with anonymous-mode preserve + lawful-basis-pin); `marketing-automation.series` ← `series` (multi-step with cohort-target + opt-out-respect); `marketing-automation.outbound_message` ← `outbound-message` (frequency-cap atomic-check).

**Workflow template library — 9 templates with steps.** `intercom.workflow-orchestration-with-re-enrollment-policy` (22 steps: ingest-event → resolve-cohort → check-re-enrollment-rule → enter-flow → branch-on-condition → send-message-or-task → handoff-on-bot-confidence-floor → audit-step); `intercom.fin-ai-agent-with-handoff` (24 steps with KB-retrieval + confidence-gate + grounded-attribution + handoff-with-context); `intercom.product-tour-launch-with-cookie-consent` (16 steps with consent-purpose-check); `intercom.survey-emit-with-anonymity-preserve` (14 steps); `intercom.outbound-message-throttle-by-segment-and-global-cap` (18 steps with per-user atomic-check); `intercom.checklist-progress-track-with-incentive-trigger` (15 steps); `intercom.banner-target-with-frequency-cap` (12 steps); `intercom.series-multi-step-campaign-with-opt-out-respect` (20 steps); `intercom.help-center-article-publish-with-search-reindex` (13 steps).

**UX shell adaptation.** Pink-collar agent + white-collar PM (product-manager + growth-marketer); desktop-primary Inbox + workflow-builder + product-tour-preview; mobile-SDK embedded in customer apps; web-snippet embedded on customer-site; B2C end-user in-app messenger + email + push surface; admin desktop-primary settings + analytics dashboard.

**Pack overlay applicable.** SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + CCPA + EU ePrivacy (cookie-consent on in-app messenger); EU-AI-Act for Fin AI Agent (high-risk: customer-service decisions); EU-DSA for consumer messaging; HIPAA-eligible (BAA tenants); per-jurisdiction data-residency (Intercom hosted EU vs US — must pin per-tenant).

**Capability-tier mapping (ADR-0316).** **Gold** on `messenger` (multi-channel in-app + email + SMS); **Gold** on `intelligence` (Fin AI Agent with KB-grounding + custom-answer); **Gold** on `community` (product-tour + checklist + banner + tooltip + news + help-center); **Silver** on `marketing-automation` (outbound + series — full marketing-automation is HubSpot Marketing Hub D-053 / Marketo); **Bronze** on `crm` (Lead + User + Company tracking only).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: Contacts API + Conversations API + Companies API + Events API + Workflows + Fin training-data + Articles + News + Surveys + Series + Product-Tours + Checklists + Tooltips + Banners + Tags + Segments + Subscription-Types + Custom-Data-Attributes. (2) Identity-resolution: Lead-cookie-id mapping + user_id-binding + email-fallback resolution. (3) Fin AI Agent training-data export: KB-source registry + custom-answer corpus + intent-train-set + retrieval-source pin per ADR-0247 supply-chain-attestation. (4) Workflow transpile: visual graph → oyatie workflow DSL with re-enrollment-policy explicit + replay on representative trigger-corpus. (5) Product-Tour migration: per-tour targeting-rule + step-sequence + DOM-selector-anchor; cookie-consent-purpose-binding added. (6) Outbound campaign migration: per-series cohort + step-graph + opt-out-list; frequency-cap default applied. (7) Help Center: article + collection + translation-tree with master-locale-pin; SEO redirect-301 from intercom.help domain to oyatie-hosted domain. (8) Messenger SDK swap: per-platform SDK (web, iOS, Android, RN, Flutter) script-tag + native-module replacement; dual-run shim for 30-day backwards-compat. (9) Cutover: per-workspace staged migration; canary-workspace first; per-channel cutover for outbound. (10) Sunset: Intercom subscription deactivation; conversation-history + Fin-training-data retained per regulatory mandate.

**Failure-mode coverage — 19 failures.**
- Fin-AI-Agent hallucination on KB-out-of-date: per-agent KB-version-pin + confidence-threshold gate + grounded-attribution mandatory + EU-AI-Act explainability log.
- Fin-AI-Agent PII-leak in training-data: per-utterance PII-redaction before training + corpus-audit.
- product-tour audience-targeting drift (audience cohort changes; tour fires for wrong users): per-tour audience-rule validation at trigger-time + cohort-version-pin.
- in-app-messenger cookie-consent leak (messenger loads before consent banner): per-widget per-purpose pre-consent suppression; widget refuses to boot until consent satisfied.
- workflow re-trigger-loop on user-property-update (user-attr changes; user re-enters workflow; attr changes again): per-workflow re-enrollment-rule explicit-pin + cycle-detection.
- outbound-message frequency-cap bypass (campaign-A and campaign-B both fire; per-user-day cap exceeded): per-user global-cap atomic-check across all campaigns.
- series-campaign opt-out desync (user opts out; mid-series step still fires): per-series opt-out-respect at each step + dead-letter-on-opt-out.
- product-tour DOM-selector-anchor breakage (target app updates UI; selector no longer matches): per-tour selector-validity-check + alert + graceful-fallback.
- survey response anonymity-bypass (admin can re-identify): per-survey anonymous-flag with explicit re-identification-prohibition + audit.
- mobile-SDK forced app-update during cutover: per-SDK backwards-compat shim during 30-day dual-run.
- workflow step-execution non-determinism on parallel branches: per-step explicit-order + idempotency-key.
- Fin-AI-Agent custom-answer collision (two custom-answers match same intent): per-answer priority + golden-test on validation-set.
- Lead-to-User upgrade identity-merge conflict (user signs in; cookie-Lead and existing User conflict): per-merge confidence + manual-resolve queue.
- in-app-messenger CSP / iframe-policy violation on customer-site: per-customer-site CSP-template + deploy-validate.
- per-tenant data-residency drift (Intercom EU vs US; oyatie residency-pin not synced): per-tenant residency-binding-immutable.
- News-item TTL expiry not respected (stale news shown): per-item expire-at + UI-suppress on expiry.
- workflow workflow-canvas-version drift (old workflow uses deprecated node): per-canvas version-pin + auto-migrate or block.
- Canvas-Kit app deployed with embedded-secret in JSON: per-app secret-scan + vault-binding.
- Segment definition drift (segment evolves but campaign-targeting cached): per-segment cache-invalidate on definition-change.

### Section D-070 - Snowflake

**Vendor identity and category.** Snowflake Data Cloud is the multi-cloud cloud-native OLAP data warehouse + data-sharing + data-marketplace + Snowpark (Python/Java/Scala UDF & procedure runtime) + Cortex (managed LLM + ML) + Streamlit-on-Snowflake (data-app hosting) + Snowflake Native App Framework + Iceberg-table support + Snowpipe (continuous ingest) + Search Optimization Service + Materialized Views + Time Travel + Fail-safe. It separates storage (cloud-object-store) from compute (virtual-warehouses) with per-warehouse multi-cluster auto-scale. Multi-cloud (AWS + Azure + GCP) with cross-region + cross-cloud replication. Snowflake is the archetype of "data cloud" — both pure-warehouse and data-marketplace + AI-substrate.

**Vendor data model — 25 top objects.** `account` (per-org Snowflake account; cloud + region pinned); `organization` (cross-account container); `virtual-warehouse` (compute cluster: X-Small, Small, Medium, Large, X-Large ... 6X-Large; multi-cluster auto-scale; with resource-monitor); `database` (top-level container); `schema` (within database); `table` (permanent / transient / temporary; native vs Iceberg); `external-table` (over S3/GCS/Azure-blob); `materialized-view`; `view` / `secure-view`; `row-access-policy` (per-table, attribute-based, expression-language); `masking-policy` (per-column, role-based mask); `tag` (per-object metadata, for governance + access); `network-policy` (IP-allowlist); `network-rule`; `stage` (internal vs external; for file ingest/egress); `pipe` (Snowpipe continuous ingest); `task` (scheduled or chained, runs SQL or stored proc); `stream` (CDC over table); `snowpark-function` (UDF in Python/Java/Scala); `snowpark-procedure` (with owner-rights vs caller-rights); `cortex-ml-model` (forecasting, classification, anomaly-detection); `cortex-llm-function` (`COMPLETE`, `SUMMARIZE`, `TRANSLATE`, `SENTIMENT`, `EXTRACT_ANSWER`); `cortex-search-service` (vector + lexical hybrid search); `streamlit-app` (data-app hosted in Snowflake); `native-app` (Snowflake Native App = Snowflake Marketplace distributable); `data-share` (provider-side outbound + consumer-side inbound); `marketplace-listing` (Snowflake Marketplace); `data-clean-room` (cross-tenant private compute); `time-travel-retention` (1-90 day undelete window); `fail-safe-retention` (additional 7-day disaster-recovery).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** SQL via Snowflake JDBC/ODBC + Python connector + Node.js driver + Go driver + .NET driver. Snowpark SDK (Python/Java/Scala) for dataframe + UDF/UDTF + procedure. SQL REST API (statement-execution). Snowsight UI. SnowCLI (`snow`) for project-deploy. Snowflake Native App Framework with `setup_script.sql` + manifest.yml + app-package. Snowpipe Streaming for low-latency ingest. Cortex SQL functions inline in SQL. Cross-cloud replication via SHOW REPLICATION. INFORMATION_SCHEMA + ACCOUNT_USAGE views for metadata. ENV_VAR mechanism via session-variables. Roles: SYSADMIN, SECURITYADMIN, ACCOUNTADMIN, USERADMIN, ORGADMIN, PUBLIC.

**17 distinctive UX surfaces.** Snowsight Worksheet (SQL editor + result-grid + chart-builder); Worksheet Multi-Tab; Database Explorer (left-rail hierarchical tree: DB → schema → table → column); Account Admin console; Warehouse Manager (with credit-usage graph); Resource Monitor config; Role + Grant Explorer (with effective-permission view); Tag Manager (with governance-tag hierarchy); Marketplace listing browser; Native Apps Manager; Streamlit App Editor; Cortex Studio (LLM playground); Cortex Search config; Snowpark IDE for Python; Task Graph visualizer; Query History (with per-query profile + plan + credits-consumed); Data Sharing Manager (provider + consumer side); Clean Rooms UI; Account Usage dashboard (cost + usage breakdown); Trust Center (per-account governance overview).

**Cedar permit block — 24 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in WarehouseAction::"<verb>", resource in SnowflakeResource::"<id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "query-table" || row_access_policy_satisfied(resource, principal))
  && (context.action != "share-data-cross-region" || residency_pin_compatible(provider.region, consumer.region))
  && (context.action != "invoke-cortex-llm" || data_class.permits_llm_egress && grounded_context_provided)
  && (context.action != "run-snowpark-procedure" || procedure.secret_scan_passed && procedure.runtime_pin_satisfied)
  && (context.action != "drop-table" || resource.retention.fail_safe_compatible_with_request)
  && cost_cap_satisfied(context.warehouse_size, context.estimated_credits);
// Verbs: create-warehouse, resize-warehouse, suspend-warehouse, resume-warehouse, create-database, create-schema,
// create-table, create-iceberg-table, create-external-table, run-query, share-data-provider, accept-share-consumer,
// create-secure-view, create-row-access-policy, create-masking-policy, run-time-travel-query, undrop,
// clone-zero-copy, run-snowpark-procedure, deploy-snowpark-function, invoke-cortex-llm, deploy-cortex-ml-model,
// publish-native-app, install-native-app-from-marketplace, configure-clean-room.
```
HIPAA pack adds `phi_redaction_in_view_or_masking_policy_attached`. PCI pack adds `card_data_tokenization_enforced`. FedRAMP-High pack adds `kms_pin == "fips-140-2-validated"` + `network_rule.govcloud_only`. KR-PIPA pack adds `personal_info_egress_consent_recorded`. EU-AI-Act pack adds `risk_classification_assigned` for Cortex-ML-model deployment + `provenance_attribution_on_cortex_llm`.

**Ontology projection (vendor obj → oyatie entity, field-level deltas).** `warehouse.warehouse_compute` ← `virtual-warehouse` (T-shirt-size enum + multi-cluster-policy explicit + resource-monitor-mandatory per oyatie cost-bar); `warehouse.database` ← `database`; `warehouse.schema` ← `schema`; `warehouse.table_permanent` ← `table` (permanent); `warehouse.table_iceberg` ← Iceberg-table (per ADR-0245 open-format-by-default — Iceberg preferred); `warehouse.external_table` ← `external-table`; `warehouse.materialized_view` ← `materialized-view`; `warehouse.secure_view` ← `secure-view`; `warehouse.row_access_policy` ← `row-access-policy` (expression-language transpiled to oyatie expression-eval DSL with golden-test on validation cohort); `warehouse.masking_policy` ← `masking-policy`; `warehouse.tag` ← `tag` (governance-tag hierarchy preserved); `warehouse.network_policy` ← `network-policy`; `warehouse.stage` ← `stage` (internal stage maps to oyatie object-storage; external stage maps to S3/GCS/Azure-blob with credential migration to OpenBao); `warehouse.pipe_snowpipe` ← `pipe`; `warehouse.task` ← `task`; `warehouse.stream` ← `stream` (CDC); `warehouse.snowpark_function` ← `snowpark-function` (runtime-pin per ADR-0247: python_v311 vs python_v312 vs java_v21 vs scala_v213 explicit); `warehouse.snowpark_procedure` ← `snowpark-procedure` (owner-rights vs caller-rights preserved); `intelligence.cortex_ml_model` ← `cortex-ml-model` (collapses onto oyatie AI substrate per ADR-0255 with EU-AI-Act risk-classification); `intelligence.cortex_llm_function` ← `cortex-llm-function` (provenance-attribution mandatory); `intelligence.cortex_search_service` ← `cortex-search-service`; `marketplace.snowflake_data_share` ← `data-share` (per ADR-0249 multi-category marketplace); `marketplace.snowflake_native_app` ← `native-app`; `compliance.clean_room` ← `data-clean-room` (cross-tenant private-compute per ADR-0244).

**Workflow template library — 9 templates with steps.** `warehouse.workload-isolated-query` (18 steps: receive-query → resolve-tenant-warehouse → check-resource-monitor → estimate-credits → cost-cap-gate → run-query → emit-credits-consumed → audit-data-class-access → return-result); `warehouse.zero-copy-clone-for-test` (12 steps with parent-DB-version-pin + storage-monitor on heavy-edits); `warehouse.time-travel-undelete-on-N-day-window` (10 steps); `warehouse.data-share-with-consumer-tenant` (21 steps with residency-pin + consumer-account-attest + per ADR-0249 marketplace-listing-publish); `warehouse.row-access-policy-with-tag-based-condition` (17 steps); `warehouse.snowpark-procedure-with-secure-handler` (16 steps with secret-scan + vault-binding + runtime-pin); `warehouse.cortex-llm-invocation-with-grounded-context-and-provenance` (19 steps); `warehouse.snowpipe-continuous-ingest-with-CDC-emit` (15 steps); `warehouse.iceberg-table-write-with-catalog-publish` (14 steps).

**UX shell adaptation.** White-collar (data-engineer + analyst + analytics-engineer + ML-engineer); desktop-primary Snowsight Worksheet equivalent with multi-tab + query-editor + result-grid + plan-profile-viewer; admin desktop-primary warehouse-monitor + cost-dashboard + role-grant-explorer; per-Marketplace listing browser white-collar + per-Native-App installer; executive read-only data-app via Streamlit-equivalent.

**Pack overlay applicable.** SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + KR-PIPA + HIPAA + PCI + FedRAMP-High + ITAR (Snowflake-Gov region); per-tenant data-residency (per-region + per-cloud); per-data-class tagging + auto-masking via tag-based-policy; EU-AI-Act for Cortex-ML-model + Cortex-LLM; CCPA for opt-out + data-deletion; per-jurisdiction data-localization (China cloud requires PRC-only region).

**Capability-tier mapping (ADR-0316).** **Platinum** on `data-warehouse` (full OLAP with per-tenant workload-isolation + Iceberg-open-format + time-travel + replication); **Gold** on `intelligence` (Cortex-LLM + Cortex-ML + Cortex-Search; embedded inline in SQL); **Gold** on `marketplace` (data-share + native-app per ADR-0249); **Silver** on `data-pipeline` (Snowpipe + Streams + Tasks); **Silver** on `compliance` (tag-based governance + masking-policy + clean-rooms); **Bronze** on `developer-sdk` (Snowpark UDF/procedure + Streamlit-app hosting).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: `SHOW DATABASES` + `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.*` + `SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.*` extraction; per-database + per-schema + per-table DDL via `GET_DDL`; per-secure-view + per-row-access-policy + per-masking-policy via `SHOW POLICIES`; per-tag hierarchy via `SHOW TAGS`; per-warehouse + per-resource-monitor config; per-network-policy + per-network-rule; per-stage external-stage credential; per-pipe + per-task + per-stream config; per-snowpark-function + per-snowpark-procedure source-code; per-Cortex-ML-model + per-Cortex-Search-service; per-data-share inbound + outbound with consumer-tenant mapping; per-Native-App package + setup-script; per-Streamlit-app source-code; per-marketplace-listing + per-clean-room config. (2) Iceberg conversion: native Snowflake tables converted to Iceberg-tables where open-format-by-default per ADR-0245 applies (preserving Iceberg as the canonical open table format). (3) Snowpark runtime pinning: per-function + per-procedure runtime version pinned per ADR-0247 supply-chain attestation. (4) Cortex retraining: Cortex-ML-models re-trained on oyatie AI substrate; Cortex-LLM functions re-mapped to oyatie intelligence µservice with provenance-attribution mandatory. (5) Cross-region/cross-cloud replication: residency-pin per ADR-0244 + per-tenant region-binding-immutable. (6) Data-share consumer-account-attest: per-share consumer-account verification + acceptance window. (7) Cutover: per-database staged migration with zero-copy-clone validation against parent; canary-database first; per-warehouse credit-budget pre-allocated; per-data-share dual-publish (Snowflake + oyatie) during cutover window. (8) Sunset: Snowflake account deactivation; audit-log + ACCOUNT_USAGE retained per regulatory mandate.

**Failure-mode coverage — 19 failures.**
- per-tenant credit-burn on uncapped query: per-warehouse resource-monitor + cost-cap + estimated-credits-pre-check.
- cross-region-share data-residency violation: per-share residency-pin + consumer-region check at accept-time.
- row-access-policy mis-fire (one role sees data they shouldn't): per-policy golden-test on validation cohort + replay on policy-change.
- zero-copy-clone storage-cost-explosion on heavy edits (clone diverges; storage doubles): per-clone storage-monitor + alert + age-out policy.
- Cortex-LLM hallucination on grounded-context query: per-query confidence-score + provenance-attribution + EU-AI-Act explainability log.
- Snowpark-procedure with embedded-secret: per-procedure secret-scan + vault-binding mandatory.
- Snowpark runtime EOL (Python 3.10 deprecated; procedure breaks): per-procedure runtime-pin + advance-deprecation notice.
- materialized-view refresh-lag during heavy-write: per-MV refresh-policy explicit + freshness-SLO.
- Time-Travel retention-cliff (90-day max; old undelete lost): per-table retention-policy with extended-retention via FAIL-SAFE or external-backup.
- network-policy IP-allowlist misconfiguration locking out admin: per-policy break-glass-account + dual-control on change.
- Iceberg-table catalog drift (Snowflake catalog vs external Glue/Polaris): per-table catalog-pin + drift-alert.
- per-account Cortex quota-cliff (LLM token-budget exhausted): per-account quota-monitor + back-off.
- data-share consumer-side query-amplification (consumer runs heavy queries on provider's data; provider pays): per-share consumer-credit-attribution explicit.
- clean-room compute-leak (one tenant's algorithm leaks data of another): per-clean-room differential-privacy + audit + algorithm-attestation.
- native-app supply-chain compromise (marketplace app contains malicious code): per-app sigstore-attestation + tenant-install-gate per ADR-0247.
- tag-based-policy inheritance ambiguity (tag inherited from multiple parents): per-tag effective-policy compute + precedence-rule.
- Snowpipe ingest-lag during burst: per-pipe back-pressure + dead-letter quarantine.
- stream CDC-checkpoint-loss on tenant restart: per-stream durable checkpoint + replay-from-LSN.
- masking-policy bypass via JSON-extract on VARIANT column: per-policy semi-structured-aware + JSON-path coverage test.

### Section D-071 - Databricks

**Vendor identity and category.** Databricks is the Lakehouse Platform (data + analytics + AI) built on Delta Lake (open-format storage), Unity Catalog (multi-cloud governance + lineage), MLflow (experiment tracking + model registry), Mosaic AI (foundation-model fine-tune + agent + RAG + Vector Search + Inference Tables), Delta Live Tables / Lakeflow (declarative ETL), Databricks SQL / DBSQL (BI warehouse with Photon engine), Databricks Workflows (orchestration), Genie (text-to-SQL AI assistant), Databricks Apps (custom data apps hosted in workspace), Lakehouse Federation (query across other warehouses), Cleanrooms (cross-tenant private compute), AI/BI Dashboards. Founded by Spark creators (2013). Multi-cloud (AWS + Azure + GCP). Open-source-first foundation (Spark, Delta, MLflow, Unity Catalog OSS).

**Vendor data model — 24 top objects.** `account` (per-cloud account container); `workspace` (per-region per-cloud Databricks workspace); `metastore` (Unity Catalog root, one per region per account); `catalog` (UC top-level container, three-level namespace: catalog.schema.table); `schema` (within catalog); `delta-table` (managed vs external; Delta-Lake format with transaction-log); `iceberg-table` (UniForm support); `view`; `materialized-view`; `streaming-table`; `external-location` (S3/ADLS/GCS path with credential); `storage-credential`; `volume` (governed file storage, replaces DBFS); `function` (UDF); `model` (registered MLflow model in UC, with versions); `model-serving-endpoint` (REST endpoint with provisioned-throughput or pay-per-token); `mlflow-experiment` (run-tracker container); `mlflow-run` (single training run with params + metrics + artifacts); `cluster` (interactive vs job; Photon-enabled SQL warehouse separate); `sql-warehouse` (DBSQL compute: Classic / Pro / Serverless); `dlt-pipeline` (declarative ETL with @dlt.table decorator); `job` (Databricks Workflows orchestration unit); `notebook` (multi-language: Python + SQL + R + Scala); `repo` (git-backed code repo); `dashboard` (AI/BI Dashboards with auto-chart); `genie-space` (text-to-SQL workspace); `vector-search-index` (Mosaic AI hybrid vector + lexical); `inference-table` (auto-captured request/response of model endpoint); `agent-evaluation` (Mosaic AI Agent Evaluation framework); `lineage-edge` (UC table-to-table or notebook-to-table); `tag` (governance); `secret-scope` + `secret`; `cleanroom`; `app` (Databricks App: data-app hosted in workspace).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** REST API 2.0 / 2.1 (`workspace`, `clusters`, `jobs`, `unity-catalog`, `serving-endpoints`, `mlflow`, `sql-warehouses`, `dbsql/queries`, `permissions`, `secrets`, `repos`, `volumes`, `dashboards`, `pipelines`, `vector-search`). Databricks CLI (`databricks` v0.x with bundle deploy). Databricks SDK for Python, Java, Go, R. Databricks for IDE integration. JDBC/ODBC drivers for DBSQL. Asset Bundles (`databricks.yml`) for IaC. Spark SQL + Spark DataFrame API + Spark Structured Streaming. Delta Sharing (open-protocol for cross-org data share). dbt-databricks adapter. PySpark + Pandas-on-Spark. mlflow.* Python API for experiment + registry + deploy. UC system tables (`system.access.audit`, `system.billing.usage`).

**18 distinctive UX surfaces.** Databricks Workspace home; Notebook IDE (Jupyter-shape with cell-execution + magic-commands + visualization-inline); SQL Editor with auto-complete + query-history + saved-queries; Unity Catalog Explorer (catalog → schema → table → column hierarchical browser + lineage-tab + tag-tab); Cluster Manager; SQL Warehouse Manager (with Photon-enabled toggle + Serverless option); Jobs UI (with task-graph + run-history + retry-policy); DLT Pipeline editor; Workflows builder (job-task DAG); MLflow Experiments UI (with run-comparison + parallel-coordinates); Model Registry UI; Mosaic AI Model Serving config; Mosaic AI Vector Search index browser; Mosaic AI Agent Studio; Genie text-to-SQL workspace; AI/BI Dashboards designer; Databricks Apps catalog + deployment; Databricks Marketplace browser; Delta Sharing recipient + provider UI; Cleanrooms config; Account Console + audit-log viewer.

**Cedar permit block — 24 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in LakehouseAction::"<verb>", resource in CatalogObject::"<obj-id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "query-table" || uc_grant_satisfies(principal, resource, "SELECT"))
```

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: UC metastore export via `SHOW CATALOGS` + `SHOW SCHEMAS` + `SHOW TABLES` + `system.access.audit`; per-Delta-table DDL + path + version-history; per-Iceberg-UniForm table metadata; per-DLT-pipeline definition + expectation-set; per-Workflows job + task-graph; per-MLflow experiment + model + registry-tag + run-history; per-Mosaic-AI-finetuning checkpoint + base-model-pin; per-Vector-Search-index config + embeddings + embedding-model-pin; per-Inference-Table schema + retention; per-Agent-Evaluation harness + criteria; per-notebook source + runtime-pin; per-cluster + per-SQL-warehouse config; per-secret-scope + per-credential migration; per-Delta-Sharing share + recipient; per-Databricks-App package; per-Cleanroom config; per-Repo git-binding; per-UC-grant + per-tag hierarchy; per-AI/BI-Dashboard + per-Genie-space. (3) Notebook runtime pinning: per-notebook DBR-version-pin + Python/Spark/Scala/R version explicit per ADR-0247. (4) MLflow re-baseline: experiments + runs imported onto oyatie intelligence substrate; model-registry rebound with explicit version-pin + evaluation-pass-pin + EU-AI-Act risk-classification. (5) Mosaic AI re-train: fine-tuning runs re-executed on oyatie substrate with EU-AI-Act compliant evaluation. (6) Vector Search rebuild: embedding-model-pin enforced; index rebuilt against pinned embedding model. (7) Cleanrooms re-establishment: cross-tenant cleanroom re-attested with differential-privacy + algorithm-attestation. **Failure-mode coverage — 19 failures.**

- UC tag-based-policy inheritance ambiguity: per-tag effective-policy compute + precedence-rule.
- Mosaic Agent Evaluation criteria-drift (eval-harness changes; old models look worse): per-evaluation harness-version-pin.
- Genie text-to-SQL leaks data via SELECT * with unauthorized columns: per-query UC-grant-enforce + column-masking-policy applied.
- secret-scope ACL bypass via notebook-context manipulation: per-scope ACL with notebook-attribution audit.
- DLT-pipeline schema-evolution incompatibility on streaming: per-pipeline schema-validate + reject-or-relax-policy + retry-checkpoint.
- Databricks App embedded-secret in source: per-app secret-scan + vault-binding.
- Delta Sharing recipient-side query-amplification: per-share consumer-credit-attribution + back-pressure.
- per-account DBU quota-cliff: per-account quota-monitor + back-off + budget-alert.
- cleanroom compute-leak (joint-compute reveals one party's row): per-cleanroom differential-privacy + algorithm-attestation + audit.
- Asset Bundle deploy with environment-drift (dev → prod config mismatch): per-bundle environment-pin + diff-validate at deploy.

### Section D-072 - Google BigQuery

**Vendor identity and category.** Google BigQuery is the GCP-native serverless cloud data warehouse + analytics + ML platform: serverless on-demand pricing (per-byte-scanned) + slot-reservation (capacity-based) + Editions (Standard / Enterprise / Enterprise Plus); BigQuery ML (BQML — SQL-language ML for linear/logistic/k-means/AutoML/TensorFlow imported); Gemini in BigQuery (text-to-SQL + auto-analysis + data-canvas); BI Engine (in-memory acceleration for Looker / Looker Studio); Dataform (open-source SQLX-based transformation, dbt-like); Analytics Hub (data-sharing marketplace); BigLake (unified open-format access across BQ + GCS + Iceberg + Hudi + Delta); BigQuery Omni (cross-cloud analytics over AWS/Azure data); Datastream (CDC ingest); Dataplex (data fabric + governance + lineage); Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP) integration; Object Tables (over GCS); Vertex AI integration. Multi-region (US-multi / EU-multi / regional) + per-region pin.

**Vendor data model — 23 top objects.** `project` (GCP project, billing + IAM container); `dataset` (within project; region-pinned + access-control-list + labels); `table` (native + external + Iceberg + Object Table + Materialized View + Snapshot); `external-table` (over GCS / Bigtable / Drive / Cloud SQL federated); `materialized-view` (with smart-refresh + base-table partition-pin); `snapshot` (point-in-time table copy with low storage cost); `table-clone` (writeable copy with deferred storage); `routine` (UDF / Table-Valued-Function / Stored-Procedure / Remote-Function); `bqml-model` (model type ∈ {linear_reg, logistic_reg, kmeans, matrix_factorization, dnn_classifier, automl_classifier, boosted_tree, arima_plus, tensorflow_imported, pca, autoencoder, random_forest_classifier, gemini_*}); `bqml-evaluation` (auto-generated eval-metrics per model); `policy-tag` (per-column governance tag with taxonomy hierarchy); `data-policy` (column-masking-policy via policy-tag); `row-access-policy` (per-row filter via SQL expression); `data-share-listing` (Analytics Hub listing — publisher + subscriber side); `slot-reservation` (capacity allocation, with autoscaler + idle-slots); `bi-engine-reservation` (in-memory cache reservation for BI); `dataform-repository` (Git-backed SQLX repo); `dataform-workflow` (compilation + execution); `dataform-release-config` (target environment); `connection` (external connection for federation / Cloud-Run remote-function / Spanner / BigLake); `query-job` (immutable query execution record); `scheduled-query` (cron-like scheduled SQL); `transfer` (BigQuery Data Transfer Service from SaaS sources); `dataplex-lake` + `dataplex-zone` + `dataplex-asset` (data-fabric grouping).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** REST API v2 (`projects`, `datasets`, `tables`, `jobs`, `routines`, `models`, `rowAccessPolicies`, `policyTags`, `reservations`, `assignments`, `bi-engine-reservations`, `dataExchanges`, `listings`, `connections`). Storage Read API + Storage Write API (gRPC for high-throughput). BigQuery DataFrames (Pandas-compatible Python API). Client libraries: Python, Java, Go, Node.js, Ruby, PHP, C#. `bq` CLI. SQL dialects: GoogleSQL (default) + Legacy SQL (deprecated). Information Schema (`INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_*`, `.TABLES`, `.COLUMNS`, `.PARTITIONS`, `.ROUTINES`). Audit Logs via Cloud Logging. Pub/Sub-to-BigQuery subscription. Dataform CLI (`dataform compile`, `dataform run`). Gemini-in-BigQuery via `ML.GENERATE_TEXT`.

**16 distinctive UX surfaces.** BigQuery Studio (unified workspace combining SQL editor + notebook + Dataform + ML); SQL Editor with query-validator + dry-run estimate + result-grid + chart-builder; Explorer panel (project → dataset → table → schema hierarchical browser); Query History; Schedule Manager; Materialized View Manager; BQML model browser with auto-generated evaluation-page; Analytics Hub catalog (listing browser + subscribe); Slot Reservation manager with autoscaler config + idle-slot config; BI Engine reservation manager; Dataform Studio (SQLX editor + dependency graph + release-config); Policy Tag taxonomy editor; Row Access Policy editor; Dataplex Explorer (lake + zone + asset hierarchy); Gemini Data Canvas (text-to-SQL + auto-analysis); Object Tables browser; Connection Manager (federation + remote-function endpoints); Audit Log + Information Schema dashboard.

**Cedar permit block — 24 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in BigQueryAction::"<verb>", resource in BqResource::"<id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "run-query" || cost_projection_within_cap(context.estimated_bytes, context.cost_cap))
  && (context.action != "query-column-tagged" || policy_tag_grant_satisfied(principal, resource.policy_tag))
  && (context.action != "publish-analytics-hub-listing" || consumer_region_residency_compatible)
  && (context.action != "deploy-bqml-model" || risk_classification_assigned && training_data_pii_classified)
  && (context.action != "run-remote-function" || connection.attested && function.runtime_pinned)
  && context.region == resource.tenant.residency_region;
// Verbs: create-dataset, create-native-table, create-external-table-biglake, create-iceberg-table, create-object-table,
// run-query, run-dry-run-estimate, create-materialized-view, create-routine, create-remote-function,
// run-stored-procedure, create-bqml-model, evaluate-bqml-model, predict-bqml, create-data-sharing-listing,
// accept-data-sharing-listing, configure-slot-reservation, configure-autoscaler, configure-bi-engine-reservation,
// run-dataform-execution, configure-policy-tag-taxonomy, configure-row-level-security-policy,
// configure-column-masking-policy, configure-connection-biglake.
```
HIPAA pack adds `phi_redaction_in_masking_policy_attached` + `kms_pin.cmek_required`. PCI pack adds `card_data_tokenization_enforced`. FedRAMP-High pack adds `assured_workloads_pin` + `vpc_sc_perimeter_enforced`. KR-PIPA pack adds `cross_border_egress_explicit_consent`. ITAR pack adds `us_persons_only_access_enforced`. EU-AI-Act pack adds `risk_classification_assigned` per BQML model + `gemini_function_provenance_attribution`.

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.*` + `bq ls` + REST API extraction; per-dataset + per-table DDL + partition + clustering + labels + ACL; per-materialized-view + per-routine source-code + per-remote-function connection; per-BQML model + per-evaluation + per-feature-set + per-training-data-class-tag; per-Analytics-Hub listing + subscriber; per-Slot-Reservation + per-Autoscaler + per-Idle-Slot + per-BI-Engine-Reservation; per-Dataform repo + workflow + release-config; per-Policy-Tag taxonomy hierarchy + per-Data-Policy mask + per-Row-Level-Security-Policy SQL; per-Cloud-Storage external-table + per-BigLake-Iceberg + per-Object-Table reference; per-Scheduled-Query + per-Transfer-Service config; per-Dataplex lake + zone + asset; per-Connection (federation + remote-function endpoints). ### Section D-073 - AWS Redshift

**Vendor identity and category.** Amazon Redshift is AWS's cloud data-warehouse (launched 2012, the first cloud-native MPP DW). Two compute models: provisioned Redshift clusters (dc2 / ra3 node types with managed storage on RMS) + Redshift Serverless (capacity in RPUs / Redshift Processing Units, auto-scale per-workgroup). Engine: PostgreSQL-derived SQL (with Redshift extensions: SORTKEY, DISTKEY, DISTSTYLE, ENCODE, AUTO REFRESH). Spectrum (federated query against S3 with Glue Catalog). Data Sharing (cross-cluster + cross-account + cross-region). Redshift ML (`CREATE MODEL` SQL with SageMaker AutoPilot or BYO model). Materialized Views (incremental + auto-refresh). Federated Query (Aurora PostgreSQL/MySQL + RDS). Streaming Ingestion from Kinesis + MSK. Concurrency Scaling (auto-burst compute on read). Workload Management (WLM) — manual + auto-WLM queue config. AQUA (Advanced Query Accelerator, deprecated 2024 in favor of native ra3 perf). Zero-ETL Aurora→Redshift integration. Lake Formation tag-based access control integration. Multi-AZ deployment (Q3 2024 GA).

**Vendor data model — 22 top objects.** `cluster` (provisioned: nodes ∈ dc2.large, dc2.8xlarge, ra3.xlplus, ra3.4xlarge, ra3.16xlarge; managed-storage with RMS); `workgroup-serverless` (capacity = base-RPU + max-RPU); `namespace-serverless` (database container for serverless); `database` (within cluster/namespace); `schema` (within database); `table` (with DISTKEY + SORTKEY + DISTSTYLE ∈ {AUTO, ALL, EVEN, KEY} + ENCODE per-column + interleaved-sortkey option); `materialized-view` (with AUTO REFRESH option); `late-binding-view` (decoupled from base-table schema); `external-schema-spectrum` (over S3 + Glue Catalog); `external-table-spectrum` (Iceberg + Parquet + ORC + Avro + JSON); `datashare` (producer-side share + consumer-side accept; can grant to namespace, account, region); `datashare-association` (per-consumer attach); `row-level-security-policy` (`CREATE RLS POLICY` with USING expression); `column-level-access` (via GRANT SELECT on column); `redshift-ml-model` (SQL-defined ML via SageMaker AutoPilot or BYO); `wlm-queue` (priority + memory% + concurrency + query-monitoring-rule); `query-monitoring-rule` (QMR with action ∈ {log, hop, abort}); `snapshot` (manual + auto + cross-region); `parameter-group` (configuration template); `subnet-group` (VPC subnet binding); `iam-role` (for COPY/UNLOAD/Spectrum/ML); `glue-catalog-binding` (for Spectrum + zero-ETL); `kinesis-stream` + `msk-cluster` (streaming-ingestion source).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** AWS API v2: `RedshiftClient` (clusters / parameter-groups / snapshots / endpoints), `RedshiftServerlessClient` (workgroups / namespaces / endpoints), `RedshiftDataClient` (statement execution via Data API). SQL via JDBC/ODBC + Python (`redshift_connector` + `psycopg2`) + Go + Node.js. AWS CLI (`aws redshift`, `aws redshift-serverless`, `aws redshift-data`). System tables: `STV_*` (real-time), `STL_*` (log/history), `SVV_*` (visible views), `SVL_*` (log views), `PG_CATALOG.*` (PG-compatible). Pseudo-tables: `STV_RECENTS`, `STL_QUERYTEXT`. Data Sharing: `CREATE DATASHARE`, `GRANT USAGE ON DATASHARE`, `CREATE DATABASE FROM DATASHARE`. RDS-Spectrum + zero-ETL via AWS console + REST. Federated Query via PostgreSQL FDW. Glue Catalog API + Lake Formation API for tag-based access.

**16 distinctive UX surfaces.** Redshift Query Editor v2 (browser-based SQL IDE with notebook + visualizer + saved-queries + share-query); Workgroup/Namespace Manager (Serverless); Cluster Manager (Provisioned); Snapshot Manager + Cross-Region Snapshot config; Concurrency Scaling config; WLM Queue editor (with manual + auto-WLM + QMR); Materialized View Manager (with auto-refresh config); Datashare Manager (producer + consumer perspectives + grant-to-namespace/account/region); External Schema (Spectrum) config + Glue Catalog binding; RLS Policy editor; Redshift ML model browser + auto-trained model evaluation; Streaming Ingestion config (Kinesis + MSK); Zero-ETL Integration setup (Aurora→Redshift); Performance Insights dashboard; Audit Logging config (STL_* + CloudWatch); IAM Role assignment to cluster/workgroup.

**Cedar permit block — 23 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in RedshiftAction::"<verb>", resource in RedshiftResource::"<id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "run-query" || wlm_queue_admission_satisfied(principal, context.query_complexity))
  && (context.action != "run-spectrum-query" || glue_catalog_grant_satisfied && s3_iam_role_attached)
  && (context.action != "grant-datashare-cross-region" || consumer_region_residency_compatible)
  && (context.action != "deploy-redshift-ml-model" || risk_classification_assigned && training_data_residency_pinned)
  && (context.action != "alter-rls-policy" || principal.role in ["security-admin"])
  && context.region == resource.tenant.residency_region;
// Verbs: create-cluster, resize-cluster-elastic, resize-cluster-classic, create-workgroup-serverless,
// create-namespace-serverless, create-database, create-schema, create-table-with-sortkey-distkey, run-query,
// run-copy, run-unload, create-materialized-view, configure-auto-refresh, create-external-schema-spectrum,
// run-spectrum-query, create-datashare, grant-datashare-to-namespace-account-region, accept-datashare,
// create-rls-policy, create-redshift-ml-model, predict-redshift-ml-inference, configure-wlm-queue,
// configure-query-monitoring-rule.
```
HIPAA pack adds `cmk_kms_pinned` + `audit_logging_to_cloudwatch_enforced`. PCI pack adds `card_data_encrypted_at_rest` + `network_isolation_vpc_only`. FedRAMP-High pack adds `govcloud_region_only` + `fips_140_2_validated_endpoint`. ITAR pack adds `us_persons_only_iam_role`. KR-PIPA pack adds `cross_border_egress_consent`. ### Section D-074 - dbt

**Vendor identity and category.** dbt (data build tool) by dbt Labs is the analytics-engineering archetype: SQL + Jinja-based transformation framework that compiles models into warehouse-native SQL, runs DAG-ordered transformations, applies tests, and generates lineage docs. Open-source dbt Core (Apache-2.0) is the runtime; dbt Cloud is the hosted SaaS providing IDE + scheduler + observability + semantic-layer + Discovery API + Explorer + Mesh (cross-project lineage) + AI-assisted-development (dbt Copilot). Foundational primitives: source declaration, model (materialization ∈ {view, table, incremental, materialized_view, ephemeral}), test (generic + singular + custom-generic), snapshot (Type-2 SCD over source), seed (CSV-as-table), macro (Jinja function), package (reusable cross-project lib), exposure (downstream artifact reference), analysis, hook (run-hook + post-hook), metric (semantic-layer), semantic-model + entity + dimension + measure (MetricFlow). dbt supports 30+ adapter targets (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, Postgres, Spark, Trino, DuckDB, etc.). dbt Mesh enables cross-project model contracts + groups + access.

**Vendor data model — 21 top objects.** `project` (root with `dbt_project.yml`); `profile` (per-target connection: warehouse-credential + database + schema + threads); `target` (per-environment: dev / ci / prod); `model` (SQL or Python file in `models/`; materialization ∈ {view, table, incremental, ephemeral, materialized_view, dynamic_table on Snowflake}); `model-contract` (enforce columns + types + nullable + tests); `test` (generic ∈ {unique, not_null, accepted_values, relationships, custom-generic} + singular); `snapshot` (Type-2 SCD with strategy ∈ {timestamp, check}); `seed` (CSV-as-table); `source` (external table with freshness + loaded_at_field); `macro` (Jinja function — global vs scoped); `package` (cross-project dependency via `packages.yml`); `exposure` (dashboard/notebook/ML/application reference); `analysis` (ad-hoc SQL, not materialized); `hook` (on-run-start / on-run-end / pre-hook / post-hook); `metric` (semantic-layer aggregate); `semantic-model` (logical entity + dimensions + measures + entities); `entity` (primary/foreign/natural identifier); `dimension` (categorical + time); `measure` (aggregate-function over column); `saved-query` (named query in semantic-layer); `group` (model collection with access); `dbt-job` (dbt Cloud scheduled run with commands sequence + cron + webhook); `environment` (dbt Cloud per-target environment); `manifest` (compiled artifact: `manifest.json`); `run-results` (per-run artifact); `catalog` (`catalog.json` for docs).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** dbt Core CLI (`dbt run`, `dbt test`, `dbt snapshot`, `dbt seed`, `dbt compile`, `dbt docs generate`, `dbt build`, `dbt source freshness`, `dbt deps`, `dbt ls`, `dbt parse`, `dbt clone`). dbt Cloud API v2 + v3: Administrative API (accounts, projects, environments, jobs, runs, credentials, repositories) + Discovery API (GraphQL — manifest + lineage + nodes + sources + exposures) + Semantic Layer API (GraphQL + JDBC for BI tools). Configuration: `dbt_project.yml` + `profiles.yml` + `packages.yml` + `selectors.yml` + `dependencies.yml` (Mesh). Jinja templating with `{{ ref() }}`, `{{ source() }}`, `{{ var() }}`, `{{ config() }}`, `{{ this }}`, `{{ target }}`. Adapter SDKs (`dbt-core` + `dbt-snowflake`, `dbt-bigquery`, `dbt-redshift`, `dbt-databricks`, `dbt-postgres`, etc.). Hooks: pre-hook, post-hook, on-run-start, on-run-end. State management: `--state` flag with `--defer` for partial-runs against prod-manifest.

**16 distinctive UX surfaces.** dbt Cloud IDE (browser-based with Git integration + SQL preview + lineage graph in-pane); dbt Cloud Explorer (Discovery UI with model lineage + column-level lineage + test results + freshness state); dbt Cloud Jobs UI (cron + manual + CI + webhook trigger); dbt Cloud Run UI (per-step logs + artifact downloads); dbt Cloud Environment Manager (dev/CI/prod targets); dbt Cloud Repositories config (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Azure DevOps); Semantic Layer UI (metric browser + saved-query + dimensional filters); dbt Mesh dependencies + contracts; dbt Copilot AI assistant (Cloud only); dbt Docs site (`dbt docs serve` for self-host); CLI output (run-summary + log-level + json-formatter); Lineage graph (DAG) with model-detail tooltips; Test result browser; Source freshness dashboard; Exposure detail page; Manifest + run-results JSON artifacts (for downstream pipelines).

**Cedar permit block — 21 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in DbtAction::"<verb>", resource in DbtProject::"<project-id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "deploy-environment-prod" || principal.role in ["analytics-engineer-lead", "platform-admin"])
  && (context.action != "run-model" || warehouse_credential_attested(context.target))
  && (context.action != "alter-model-contract" || principal.role in ["analytics-engineer-lead"])
  && (context.action != "query-semantic-layer" || metric_access_grant_satisfied(principal, context.metric_id))
  && context.region == resource.tenant.residency_region;
// Verbs: run-model, test-model, run-snapshot, run-seed, build-dag, deploy-environment, run-job-on-schedule,
// trigger-job-manually, configure-source, configure-source-freshness, configure-exposure, query-semantic-layer,
// publish-semantic-layer-metric, alter-model-contract, run-clone, run-compile, run-docs-generate,
// install-package, configure-dbt-mesh-dependency, run-copilot-assisted-generation, configure-job-webhook.
```
SOC-2 pack adds `git_repo_access_audited` + `warehouse_credential_rotation_policy_satisfied`. EU-AI-Act pack adds `risk_classification_assigned` for dbt-Copilot suggestions + `provenance_attribution_on_generated_sql`. GDPR pack adds `lawful_basis_recorded` per source-table + `right_to_be_forgotten_propagatable` via snapshot/incremental-models.

**Workflow template library — 9 templates with steps.** `dbt.run-with-state-defer-and-incremental` (20 steps: load-manifest → resolve-state → select-deferred-nodes → compile → execute-DAG-topological-order → run-tests-after-each-model → emit-run-results → audit-warehouse-cost); `dbt.test-with-severity-classification-and-fail-fast` (16 steps); `dbt.snapshot-on-source-history-with-strategy-pin` (14 steps); `dbt.semantic-layer-query-with-metric-access-grant` (18 steps); `dbt.exposure-with-downstream-impact-analysis-and-notification` (15 steps); `dbt.docs-generate-with-lineage-and-column-level` (13 steps); `dbt.mesh-dependency-publish-and-consume-with-contract-enforce` (19 steps); `dbt.copilot-generated-sql-with-provenance-and-explainability` (17 steps); `dbt.package-install-with-sigstore-attestation-gate` (12 steps).

**Capability-tier mapping (ADR-0316).** **Gold** on `data-pipeline` (transform-DAG runner with model + test + snapshot + seed + macro + package + exposure); **Gold** on `data-warehouse` (semantic-layer via MetricFlow; metric + semantic-model + entity + dimension + measure); **Silver** on `developer-sdk` (dbt-project git repo + dbt-CLI analog + Jinja templating); **Silver** on `intelligence` (semantic-layer for AI grounding + dbt-Copilot equivalent with EU-AI-Act); **Bronze** on `compliance` (model-contract + source-freshness + test-severity).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: per-project git-repo clone with `dbt_project.yml` + `models/` + `tests/` + `macros/` + `seeds/` + `snapshots/` + `analyses/` + `exposures/` + `metrics/` + `semantic_models/` + `packages.yml` + `selectors.yml` + `dependencies.yml`; dbt Cloud Admin API export of accounts + projects + environments + jobs + credentials + repositories; per-Discovery-API manifest + lineage + column-level + tests + freshness; per-Semantic-Layer metric + saved-query export; per-job schedule + webhook + commands-sequence; per-Mesh-dependency contract. (2) Adapter normalization: per-model dialect (Snowflake / BQ / Redshift / Databricks / Postgres SQL) validated; oyatie engine handles dialect-pin or transpiles to canonical dialect per target. (3) Macro namespace pin: per-package macro-namespace explicit to avoid conflict per oyatie naming-justification. (4) Test severity pin: per-test severity ∈ {error, warn} explicit (dbt historically ambiguous; oyatie deterministic-eval mandatory). (6) Semantic-layer transpile: MetricFlow → oyatie semantic-model DSL with golden-test on representative metric-query corpus across BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex, etc.). (7) Warehouse credential migration: per-target credential → OpenBao + per-environment binding; dual-credential window during cutover. (8) Cutover: per-environment staged migration; dev → CI → prod; canary-environment first; parallel-run on shadow warehouse with checksum + delta-comparison; per-job dual-run with output-diff. (9) Sunset: dbt Cloud subscription deactivation; git-repo retained; manifest + run-results history retained per regulatory mandate.

**Failure-mode coverage — 18 failures.**
- macro-namespace conflict across packages (two packages export same macro-name): per-package namespace-pin + reject-on-conflict at compile.
- state-defer race on parallel runs (two runs both defer to same prod-state; one stale): per-run state-lock + serialize-on-conflict.
- semantic-metric drift between dbt and downstream BI (Looker shows different number): per-metric golden-test + cross-tool validation + cache-invalidate.
- test-severity threshold inconsistency (error vs warn drift across environments): per-test severity-pin mandatory + propagation-validate.
- per-adapter (Snowflake / BQ / Redshift / Databricks) SQL-dialect drift: per-model dialect-validate + transpile if needed + per-adapter golden-test.
- incremental-model `is_incremental()` mis-fire (full-refresh forgotten; partial data): per-model build-strategy-pin + dry-run output-diff.
- snapshot strategy-change data-loss (timestamp → check strategy mid-life): per-snapshot strategy-pin + history-preserve on migration.
- source-freshness false-stale (timezone confusion on `loaded_at_field`): per-source timezone-pin + freshness-check at multiple-grains.
- model-contract enforced too-late (deploy passes; CI runs reveal drift): per-contract enforce-at-PR + fail-fast.
- Mesh-dependency cycle: per-project dependency-graph cycle-detection.
- dbt-Copilot generated-SQL hallucination (references non-existent column): per-Copilot-output validate-against-manifest + reject-on-miss + EU-AI-Act explainability.
- package-install supply-chain compromise: per-package sigstore-attestation gate + reject-on-unsigned per ADR-0293.
- warehouse-credential leak in dbt-Cloud-IDE logs: per-log secret-scrub + redact-pattern.
- per-job webhook-secret rotation orphan: per-job secret-rotate schedule + dual-secret window.
- Discovery-API manifest stale (lineage shows old model): per-environment manifest-refresh policy + cache-invalidate.
- snapshot SCD2 surrogate-key collision on multi-run: per-snapshot SK-strategy-pin + collision-detect.
- exposure downstream-impact analysis incomplete (BI dashboard not registered as exposure): per-project exposure-coverage-audit + alert.
- model-build cost-spike on uncapped warehouse: per-target cost-cap + alert.

### Section D-075 - Fivetran

**Vendor identity and category.** Fivetran is the leading managed-ELT (Extract-Load-Transform) vendor — 400+ pre-built source connectors that automatically extract from SaaS + databases + files into cloud warehouses, with full schema-management + CDC (Change Data Capture) + monitoring + transformation orchestration (post-sync dbt-compatible). Connectors include: SaaS (Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, Zendesk, Stripe, Shopify, Marketo, Pardot, Jira, Asana, Notion, ServiceNow, Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle Fusion, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, Ariba), databases (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB, Cassandra), files (S3, GCS, Azure Blob, SFTP), event-streams (Kafka, Kinesis), advertising (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest), product analytics (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Heap). Targets: Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, Postgres, Synapse, Azure Data Lake, S3 data-lake. Free Tier (MAR-based), Standard, Enterprise, Business Critical (HIPAA + private-link). Quickstart Data Models = pre-built dbt-style transformations per source. Local Data Processing (HVR-acquired) for hybrid + on-premise. Recent: Hybrid Deployment (on-customer-cloud control-plane); Fivetran for Apps (embedded white-label).

**Vendor data model — 18 top objects.** `group` (Fivetran logical workspace containing connectors + destinations); `destination` (warehouse: Snowflake / BQ / Redshift / Databricks / Postgres / Synapse / S3-data-lake; credential + region + service); `connector` (per-source instance with sync_frequency ∈ 1m..24h + schema_config + start_state); `source` (the upstream SaaS/DB; per-source-type with vendor-specific config); `connector-schema` (auto-discovered + user-editable: table allow/block, column allow/block, column hashing); `connector-table` (per-table sync config); `connector-column` (per-column with action ∈ {sync, block, hash}); `cdc-checkpoint` (LSN / SCN / change-token / cursor for incremental); `connector-run` (immutable sync execution with status + rows-synced + bytes + duration); `historical-resync` (full-refresh request with throttle); `quickstart-data-model` (pre-built dbt package per source: e.g., `salesforce-source-quickstart`); `transformation` (post-sync dbt orchestration via Fivetran Transformations); `transformation-job` (scheduled dbt-run with environment + integration); `user` + `role` + `team` (RBAC); `webhook-event` (notification: sync-success, sync-failure, schema-change); `notification` (Slack / email / PagerDuty); `private-link` (PrivateLink / VPC peering for source/destination); `agent` (Local Data Processing for hybrid); `column-hashing-config` (sha256 + salt for PII); `metadata-catalog` (Fivetran-side metadata + lineage to downstream).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** REST API v1: `/groups`, `/destinations`, `/connectors`, `/connectors/{id}/schemas`, `/connectors/{id}/schemas/{schema}/tables`, `/connectors/{id}/sync` (trigger), `/connectors/{id}/resync` (historical), `/connectors/{id}/columns`, `/users`, `/roles`, `/teams`, `/webhooks`, `/transformations`, `/transformations/dbt-projects`, `/log-service`. Connector SDK (Beta — open-source Python SDK for custom connectors). Webhooks: sync_succeeded, sync_failed, sync_completed, schema_change_request, connection_status_change. Terraform provider (`fivetran_connector`, `fivetran_destination`, `fivetran_group`, `fivetran_webhook`). Local Data Processing agent runtime (HVR-derived). Functions Connector (run custom Lambda/Cloud-Run/Azure-Function as source). Account/usage API for billing (MAR = Monthly Active Rows).

**14 distinctive UX surfaces.** Connector list (per-group with health + last-sync + next-sync); Add Connector flow (350+ source picker with vendor-logos); Connector Setup form (OAuth + credential + region + initial-sync-options); Schema config (per-table allow/block + per-column allow/block/hash UI); Sync History (per-connector per-run with row-counts + error-detail); Logs viewer (per-run with structured log + warning + error breakdown); Destination Manager; User + Team + Role manager; Webhook config; Notification config (Slack/Email/PagerDuty); Quickstart Data Models browser + auto-install; Transformations dashboard (dbt-run scheduling); MAR Usage Dashboard; Private-Link config; Local Data Processing Agent install + status; Account Settings + Billing.

**Cedar permit block — 21 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in FivetranAction::"<verb>", resource in Connector::"<conn-id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "create-connector" || source.credential_attested && destination.residency_compatible)
  && (context.action != "configure-column-block" || data_class.permits_egress(resource.column))
  && (context.action != "run-historical-resync" || mar_budget_within_cap(context.estimated_rows))
  && (context.action != "configure-private-link" || principal.role in ["platform-admin"])
  && (context.action != "deploy-custom-connector-sdk" || sigstore_attestation_passed)
  && context.region == resource.tenant.residency_region;
// Verbs: create-connector, start-sync, pause-sync, resume-sync, run-historical-resync,
// configure-schema-change-handling, configure-table-allow-block, configure-column-block,
// configure-column-hash, run-transformation-after-sync, run-quickstart-data-model, install-quickstart-data-model,
// configure-pii-detection, configure-webhook, configure-notification, configure-private-link,
// install-local-data-processing-agent, deploy-custom-connector-sdk, configure-function-connector,
// rotate-source-credential, retrieve-sync-logs.
```
HIPAA pack adds `business_critical_tier_pinned` + `kms_pin.cmek_required`. KR-PIPA pack adds `cross_border_egress_consent` + `personal_info_encryption_at_rest`. GDPR pack adds `lawful_basis_per_source_table_recorded` + `right_to_be_forgotten_propagatable`. PCI pack adds `card_data_tokenization_in_connector`. EU-AI-Act pack adds `risk_classification_assigned` for AI-driven schema-change-handling.
