**Capability-tier mapping (ADR-0316).** **Platinum** on `data-pipeline` (managed-ELT with 400+ connectors + CDC + schema-management + transformation orchestration); **Silver** on `data-warehouse` (target sink — Snowflake/BQ/Redshift/Databricks managed); **Silver** on `compliance` (per-connector data-class + residency + column-hashing); **Silver** on `apigw` (custom-connector via Function-Connector + Connector SDK); **Bronze** on `marketplace` (Quickstart Data Models as pre-built packs per ADR-0249).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: REST API export of all groups + destinations + connectors + schemas + tables + columns + cdc-checkpoints + runs (sample) + transformations + quickstart-data-models + users + roles + teams + webhooks + notifications + private-links + agents + custom-connector-SDK source. (2) Per-connector credential migration: per-source OAuth refresh-token / API-key / DB-credential rotated to OpenBao per ADR-0247; dual-credential window during cutover. (3) CDC-watermark pin: per-connector LSN/SCN/cursor pinned at cutover-instant; replay-from-last-known-good policy mandatory. (4) Schema-config preserve: per-table allow/block + per-column allow/block/hash preserved verbatim; column-hash salt-pin migrated to OpenBao per ADR-0251. (5) Quickstart Data Model rebind to D-074 (dbt µservice): per-package import + adapter-validate against target warehouse. (6) Transformation orchestration: dbt-job binding rebound to D-074. (7) Function Connector / Custom Connector SDK: per-function runtime-pin + sigstore-attestation per ADR-0293 + secret-scan. (8) Local Data Processing Agent migration: per-agent re-install on oyatie hybrid-runtime; on-prem source-extract path validated. (9) Cutover: per-connector staged migration; canary-connector first; parallel-run on shadow target with row-checksum + delta-comparison; per-connector dual-write window; webhook re-target with HMAC-secret rotation. (10) Sunset: Fivetran subscription deactivation; per-connector audit-log + run-history retained per regulatory mandate.

**Failure-mode coverage — 18 failures.**
- CDC-watermark loss on cut-over (gap in sync resulting in missing rows): per-connector watermark-pin + resync-from-last-known-good + delta-checksum validation.
- schema-change auto-propagate breaking-change (source adds column; downstream contract breaks): per-change opt-in vs opt-out + alert + manual-review window.
- PII-detection false-negative (sensitive column not detected; leaks to target unmasked): per-detection confidence-floor + manual-confirm + DLP-secondary-scan.
- PII-detection false-positive (non-sensitive column hashed; data unusable): per-column override + audit.
- connector-credential rotation downtime: per-credential dual-creds-window + canary-sync-test.
- per-connector source-API quota-cliff (source rate-limits Fivetran): per-source quota-monitor + back-off + multiple-credential rotation.
- historical-resync MAR-budget overrun: per-resync estimated-MAR + cap + alert.
- column-hashing salt-rotation breaks cross-sync join: per-salt pin + dual-salt-window during rotation.
- destination-side schema-evolution incompatibility (target warehouse strict-mode rejects null column): per-target schema-validate + reject-or-relax-policy.
- Function-Connector cold-start timeout > sync-window: per-function min-instance + warm-pool.
- Local Data Processing Agent on-prem network drop: per-agent buffer + replay-from-buffer on reconnect.
- private-link DNS-resolution drift: per-link DNS-pin + alert on resolution-change.
- webhook delivery-failure cascade (downstream consumer down; webhook queue grows): per-webhook back-off + dead-letter + alert.
- per-connector source schema-discovery non-deterministic (different runs produce different schemas): per-connector schema-snapshot + diff-validate.
- Custom Connector SDK runtime EOL: per-connector runtime-pin + advance-deprecation notice.
- Quickstart Data Model breaking-upgrade: per-package version-pin + advance-deprecation.
- per-source NetSuite SuiteScript-quota exhaustion: per-source quota-monitor + cron-shift.
- destination CMK key-rotation orphan (CMK rotated; old data undecryptable): per-destination dual-key-window during rotation.

### Section D-076 - Airbyte

**Vendor identity and category.** Airbyte is the open-source ELT alternative to Fivetran (D-075), founded 2020 under MIT (now Elv2 license for some components). Architecture: open-source Airbyte Core (self-host on Docker / Kubernetes / Helm) + Airbyte Cloud (managed SaaS) + Airbyte Self-Managed Enterprise (commercial); 600+ pre-built source/destination connectors (largest catalog in industry); Connector Development Kit (CDK) in Python + Low-Code (YAML-based connector spec) + Java; Connector Builder UI (no-code in-browser connector creation); Airbyte Marketplace (community-published + certified connectors); pyAirbyte (Python library for embedded ELT); octavia-cli (deprecated 2024 in favor of API/Terraform). Compared to Fivetran: more transparent connector code (open-source), self-host option (data sovereignty), Connector Builder for citizen-data-engineers, community-extensible. PyAirbyte enables LangChain/LLM integration as data-loader. Multi-engine support (Sync mode ∈ {full_refresh_overwrite, full_refresh_append, incremental_append, incremental_dedup, incremental_dedup_history}).

**Vendor data model — 19 top objects.** `workspace` (logical container, multi-tenant in cloud, single in core); `source` (per-source-vendor instance: source-type + spec + credential); `destination` (per-destination-vendor instance: destination-type + spec + credential); `source-definition` (versioned connector image with `Dockerfile` + `manifest.yaml` + JSON-schema spec); `destination-definition`; `connection` (source + destination + schedule + sync_mode + namespace + prefix + status); `connection-schema` (auto-discovered + user-modified); `connection-stream` (per-stream config: enabled + sync_mode + cursor_field + primary_key); `connection-stream-state` (per-stream cursor-state for incremental); `sync-job` (job-id + per-attempt with status); `job-attempt` (single sync execution); `cdk-custom-connector` (Python or Low-Code YAML); `connector-builder-project` (in-browser-built connector); `transformation-operation` (legacy: dbt-via-Normalization removed 2024; now Direct-Load + Typed-Streams); `webhook-notification` (slack / email / custom HTTP); `oauth-credentials` (managed OAuth refresh-token); `secret-manager-binding` (Vault / Azure-Key-Vault / GCP-Secret-Manager / AWS-Secrets-Manager); `permission` (RBAC: org-admin, workspace-admin, workspace-editor, workspace-reader); `geography` (region-pin: US / EU / Auto); `tag` (workspace-level tags).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** Public REST API v1 (`/sources`, `/destinations`, `/connections`, `/connections/{id}/sync`, `/jobs`, `/source_definitions`, `/destination_definitions`, `/workspaces`, `/permissions`, `/oauth/source/get_consent_url`, `/notifications`). Configuration API v1 (internal, used by UI). PyAirbyte Python library (`airbyte` package) for embedded ELT in Python. Connector Builder UI (no-code). Connector Development Kit (Python `airbyte-cdk` + Java `airbyte-cdk-java`); Low-Code Connector spec in YAML using declarative-source pattern (CSV / JSON / GraphQL / REST sources can often be built fully in YAML without code). Octavia-CLI deprecated 2024. Terraform provider (`airbyte_source`, `airbyte_destination`, `airbyte_connection`, `airbyte_workspace`). Helm chart for K8s self-host. Webhook notifications for sync_succeeded / sync_failed / connection_disabled. Datadog / Prometheus / OTLP metrics integration.

**14 distinctive UX surfaces.** Workspace home with sources + destinations + connections + sync-history; Source catalog (600+ with logos + certification-tier); Source setup form (OAuth + credential + advanced-config); Destination catalog; Connection builder (source → destination + schedule + sync_mode + namespace_definition + prefix); Schema editor (per-stream enable + sync_mode + cursor_field + primary_key); Sync History (per-job per-attempt with status + rows + bytes + duration + logs); Job Logs viewer with structured + raw output; Connector Builder UI (no-code in-browser source-creation with HTTP-stream + transformation + pagination + auth wizards); Marketplace (community-published + certified connectors); Settings + Permissions + Notifications + Geographies; Org Console (multi-workspace admin); CDK template (for code-based connector); Cloud Console with usage billing.

**Cedar permit block — 22 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in AirbyteAction::"<verb>", resource in Connection::"<conn-id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "install-marketplace-connector" || certification_tier in ["certified", "verified"] || sigstore_attestation_passed)
  && (context.action != "create-connection" || source.credential_attested && destination.residency_compatible)
  && (context.action != "deploy-cdk-custom-connector" || sigstore_attestation_passed && runtime_pinned)
  && (context.action != "configure-geography-eu" || data_class.permits_eu_residency)
  && context.region == resource.tenant.residency_region;
// Verbs: create-source, create-destination, create-connection, configure-connection-schema-per-stream,
// configure-sync-mode, configure-cursor-field, configure-primary-key, trigger-sync, run-historical-resync,
// configure-schedule, configure-namespace-prefix, install-marketplace-connector, publish-to-marketplace,
// build-connector-via-builder, deploy-cdk-custom-connector, configure-low-code-yaml-connector,
// configure-oauth-source, configure-webhook-notification, configure-secret-manager-binding,
// configure-geography, configure-permission-rbac, retrieve-job-logs.
```

**Capability-tier mapping (ADR-0316).** **Platinum** on `data-pipeline` (600+ connector catalog with managed + community + custom via CDK + Low-Code + Connector Builder); **Gold** on `marketplace` (Airbyte Marketplace per ADR-0249 with cert-tier + sigstore); **Gold** on `developer-sdk` (CDK Python + Java + Low-Code YAML + Connector Builder UI + pyAirbyte embedded library); **Silver** on `data-warehouse` (destination); **Silver** on `compliance` (geography-pin + secret-manager-binding + per-stream cursor-state).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: Public REST API export of all workspaces + sources + destinations + connections + connector-definitions + connection-schemas + connection-streams + connection-stream-states + sync-jobs (sample history) + job-attempts (sample logs) + webhooks + permissions + notifications + geographies + tags + custom-CDK-connector source-code + connector-builder-project YAML. (2) Per-source credential migration: per-source OAuth refresh-token / API-key / DB-credential rotated to OpenBao per ADR-0247; per-secret-manager-binding rebound to oyatie Vault. (3) Per-connection cursor-state pin: per-stream cursor pinned at cutover-instant; replay-from-last-known-good policy mandatory. (4) Per-CDK custom-connector: source-code reviewed for license-compliance + sigstore-attestation per ADR-0293; runtime-pin (Python 3.11 / Java 21) per ADR-0247; secret-scan; sandbox-test before deploy. (5) Per-Connector-Builder project: Low-Code YAML imported + validated; pagination + auth + transformation patterns re-validated. (6) Per-marketplace-connector inventory + replacement-mapping: cert-tier checked; sigstore validated; license-compatibility (AGPL connectors may be incompatible with commercial use). (7) Typed-Streams / Direct-Load migration: legacy Normalization (dbt-via-Airbyte) was removed in 2024; per-connection re-migrated to Typed-Streams + Direct-Load if still on legacy. (8) Cutover: per-connection staged migration with row-checksum + delta-comparison against shadow target; canary-connection first; per-connection dual-write window; webhook re-target. (9) Sunset: Airbyte Cloud subscription deactivation OR Self-Managed Airbyte instance shutdown; per-job audit-log + sync-history retained per regulatory mandate.

**Failure-mode coverage — 18 failures.**

- CDK-connector schema-discovery drift (different runs produce different schemas): per-connector schema-snapshot + change-policy + diff-validate.

- marketplace-connector license-incompatibility (AGPL/Elv2 vs commercial): per-connector license-scan + reject + replacement-mapping.
- Connector Builder Low-Code YAML pagination-spec mis-config (infinite-loop on next-page): per-connector pagination-validate + max-page cap.
- CDK Python runtime EOL (Python 3.10 deprecated): per-connector runtime-pin + advance-deprecation notice.
- per-source rate-limit cliff (community-connector lacks back-off): per-source rate-limit-monitor + back-off-injection + cert-tier escalation.
- Self-Managed K8s scaling unstable (community Helm chart): per-deployment validated-Helm-version-pin + back-out plan.
- pyAirbyte embedded ELT secret-leak in LangChain log: per-pyAirbyte secret-scrub + redact-pattern.
- per-connection schema-change incompatibility (source adds non-null column; target rejects): per-change opt-in vs opt-out + reject-or-relax-policy + alert.
- Marketplace-published connector PII-handling improper (no column-hashing): per-connector PII-pattern-scan + reject-on-publish.
- per-connection namespace-prefix collision (two connections write to same namespace.prefix.table): per-connection namespace-uniqueness-validate.
- geography-pin mismatch (source in EU; destination geography US; data egress): per-connection residency-pin + EU-egress block per GDPR.

- Connector Builder full_refresh sync without dedup-key (duplicates on resume): per-connector sync_mode validate + force-dedup-key on full_refresh.
- CDK custom-connector embedded-secret in source-code: per-connector secret-scan + vault-binding mandatory.
- Self-Managed Enterprise CMK key-rotation orphan: per-deployment dual-key-window during rotation.

### Section D-077 - Segment

**Vendor identity and category.** Twilio Segment (acquired 2020 for $3.2B) is the leading Customer Data Platform (CDP), pioneered the "single API for all customer events" pattern (Spec: track / identify / group / page / screen / alias) which became the de-facto industry standard. Provides: event-collection from web + mobile + server + offline; identity-resolution into single-customer-profile (Personas / Unify); destination-fanout to 400+ marketing + analytics + warehouse tools; tracking-plans for schema-governance (Protocols); functions for custom transformation; audiences for cohort-building; computed-traits + SQL-traits for derived attributes; engage for outbound activation (email/SMS/push); profiles API for real-time identity-lookup; reverse-ETL for warehouse-back-to-tools; data-graph for cross-org schema; data-lake for raw event archive; privacy-portal for consent + DSAR (right-to-be-forgotten) propagation.

**Vendor data model — 23 top objects.** `workspace` (org-level container); `source` (event-collection endpoint: JS / iOS / Android / Server / Mobile-SDKs / Cloud-Apps); `destination` (downstream tool: Google Analytics / Mixpanel / Amplitude / Salesforce / HubSpot / Marketo / Iterable / Braze / Customer.io / Snowflake / BigQuery / Redshift / etc.); `event` (track / identify / group / page / screen / alias — per Segment Spec); `user` (signed-in with stable user_id); `anonymous-user` (with anonymous_id cookie / device_id); `group` (account container for B2B); `function` (source-function — modifies inbound; destination-function — modifies outbound; insert-function — runs between source and destination); `audience` (cohort defined by filter + funnel + behavior); `computed-trait` (derived attribute: e.g., `lifetime_order_count`); `sql-trait` (derived via warehouse SQL); `tracking-plan` (Protocols: per-event JSON-schema with required/optional properties + types + violations); `protocols-violation` (event that failed tracking-plan); `replay` (re-send historical events to new destination); `unify-space` (identity-resolution workspace within Personas); `identity-graph` (merge-rule + identity-resolution map); `profile` (unified customer with identifiers + traits + events); `journey` (multi-step orchestration in Engage); `data-graph` (cross-org schema definition); `data-lake-destination` (raw-event archive to S3 / GCS / Azure-Data-Lake); `reverse-etl-model` (warehouse-back-to-tool sync); `consent-category` (privacy-portal classification); `dsar-request` (right-to-be-forgotten or right-of-access request).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** Public REST API v1 (`/workspaces`, `/sources`, `/destinations`, `/tracking-plans`, `/audiences`, `/functions`, `/integrations`); HTTP Tracking API (`/v1/track`, `/v1/identify`, `/v1/group`, `/v1/page`, `/v1/screen`, `/v1/alias`); Object API for record-of-truth ingestion; Profiles API (`/profiles/{user_id}/traits`, `/profiles/{user_id}/events`). Client SDKs: analytics.js (web), analytics-iOS (Swift), analytics-Android (Kotlin/Java), analytics-react-native, analytics-flutter, analytics-php, analytics-python, analytics-node, analytics-ruby, analytics-go, analytics-java, analytics-.net. Server SDKs in 12+ languages. Mobile SDKs with Bluetooth + offline-buffering + battery-aware. Functions runtime: Node 16/18/20 with `eventHandler`, `globalContext`, `webhookHandler`. Webhooks: source-event-debugger, destination-delivery-status, tracking-plan-violation. CDP CLI (`segment-cli`). Engage API for journey-orchestration.

**16 distinctive UX surfaces.** Workspace home; Source catalog with library-of-libraries (analytics.js / iOS / Android / Cloud sources); Destination catalog (400+ with logos + filters); Tracking Plan editor (per-event JSON-schema with required-properties + types + violations + auto-generate from source-code); Function editor (Monaco IDE with Node-runtime + secrets-binding + test-event-runner); Audience Builder (visual cohort with `users who have done X within N days` style); Computed Trait builder; SQL Trait builder (warehouse-SQL); Personas/Unify workspace with identity-graph + merge-rules; Profile Explorer (per-user profile-view with identifiers + traits + event-timeline); Engage Journey designer (drag-node multi-step orchestration); Privacy Portal (consent-categories + DSAR queue + data-mapping); Source Debugger (real-time event-stream with raw JSON); Destination delivery status (per-destination success/fail + retry); Reverse ETL config; Data Graph schema-browser.

**Cedar permit block — 23 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in SegmentAction::"<verb>", resource in SegmentResource::"<id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "send-track-event" || tracking_plan.validation_satisfied || tenant.allow_violation == true)
  && (context.action != "configure-destination" || consent_category.permits_destination(resource.destination_id))
  && (context.action != "deploy-function" || sigstore_attestation_passed && secret_scan_passed)
  && (context.action != "run-replay" || mar_budget_within_cap(context.estimated_events))
  && (context.action != "deploy-engage-journey" || risk_classification_assigned)
  && context.region == resource.tenant.residency_region;
// Verbs: create-source, create-destination, send-track-event, send-identify-event, send-group-event,
// send-page-event, send-screen-event, send-alias-event, create-function (source/destination/insert),
// deploy-function, create-audience, create-computed-trait, create-sql-trait, configure-identity-resolution-merge-rule,
// run-replay, configure-protocols-tracking-plan, suppress-event-with-tracking-plan-violation,
// configure-consent-category, process-dsar-request, configure-reverse-etl-model, configure-data-lake-destination,
// configure-engage-journey, retrieve-profile.
```
GDPR pack adds `lawful_basis_per_event_recorded` + `right_to_be_forgotten_propagatable_to_destinations`. KR-PIPA pack adds `cross_border_egress_consent` + `personal_info_encryption`. CCPA pack adds `opt_out_signal_respected` + `do_not_sell_propagated`. EU ePrivacy + IAB TCF pack adds `tcf_consent_string_validated_per_destination` + `iab_vendor_consent_scope`. EU-AI-Act pack adds `risk_classification_assigned` for Engage AI-driven journey-decisions.

**Ontology projection (vendor obj → oyatie entity, field-level deltas).** `data-pipeline.segment_workspace` ← `workspace` (collapses onto oyatie tenant per ADR-0244); `data-pipeline.segment_source` ← `source` (closed-enum source-type per oyatie clarity bar; per-source consent-category-binding mandatory); `data-pipeline.segment_destination` ← `destination` (with consent-category-respect per IAB TCF); `data-pipeline.segment_event` ← `event` (closed-enum: track / identify / group / page / screen / alias per Segment Spec; preserved verbatim — Segment Spec is the de-facto industry standard); `crm.contact_unified` ← `user` + `anonymous-user` (with identity-graph + merge-rules); `crm.account_unified` ← `group`; `data-pipeline.segment_function_source` + `segment_function_destination` + `segment_function_insert` ← `function` (runtime-pin per ADR-0247 + sigstore-attestation per ADR-0293 + secret-scan + vault-binding); `data-pipeline.audience` ← `audience` (cohort definition transpiled to oyatie expression-eval DSL); `data-pipeline.computed_trait` ← `computed-trait`; `data-pipeline.sql_trait` ← `sql-trait` (with warehouse-credential binding); `data-pipeline.tracking_plan` ← `tracking-plan` (JSON-schema per-event with required + types + violations); `data-pipeline.protocols_violation` ← `protocols-violation`; `data-pipeline.replay` ← `replay` (MAR-budget-cap enforced); `intelligence.identity_graph` ← `identity-graph` (merge-rules with confidence-threshold + manual-resolve queue for ambiguous matches); `crm.unified_profile` ← `profile`; `marketing-automation.engage_journey` ← `journey` (multi-step orchestration with frequency-cap + opt-out + EU-AI-Act risk-classification); `compliance.consent_category` ← `consent-category` (per IAB TCF + per-purpose); `compliance.dsar_request` ← `dsar-request` (right-to-be-forgotten + right-of-access with downstream-propagation to destinations).

**Workflow template library — 9 templates with steps.** `segment.event-ingest-with-tracking-plan-validation-and-dead-letter` (22 steps: receive-event → resolve-source → validate-against-tracking-plan → on-violation-quarantine-or-allow-per-policy → resolve-consent-category → fanout-to-eligible-destinations → audit-per-destination-decision → emit-cdc → checkpoint-watermark); `segment.identity-resolution-with-merge-rule-and-confidence` (18 steps with manual-resolve queue); `segment.audience-activation-with-suppression-list-and-frequency-cap` (20 steps); `segment.function-execute-with-vault-credential-and-secret-scrub` (16 steps); `segment.replay-with-backfill-and-MAR-cap` (17 steps); `segment.reverse-etl-from-warehouse-back-to-tool` (19 steps); `segment.dsar-right-to-be-forgotten-propagate-to-all-destinations` (24 steps with per-destination delete-confirmation + audit-trail per GDPR Art-17); `segment.engage-journey-orchestrate-with-opt-out-respect` (21 steps); `segment.consent-category-gated-fanout-per-tcf` (15 steps with IAB TCF v2.2 string-validate).

**UX shell adaptation.** White-collar (analytics-engineer + marketer + data-engineer + privacy-officer); desktop-primary debugger + workspace-explorer + audience-builder + tracking-plan editor; per-Function editor with Monaco IDE; per-Engage-Journey designer; per-Profile-Explorer with event-timeline; per-Privacy-Portal for DSAR queue + consent-mapping; mobile read-only debugger; embedded analytics.js / mobile-SDK in customer apps + sites (no oyatie UX on customer-property surface).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: Public REST API export of all workspaces + sources + destinations + tracking-plans + audiences + computed-traits + SQL-traits + functions + Engage-journeys + consent-categories + DSAR-requests + reverse-ETL-models + data-lake-destinations + identity-graphs + merge-rules + unify-spaces. (2) Per-source SDK swap: per-platform SDK (analytics.js / iOS / Android / RN / Flutter / server SDKs) script-tag + native-module replacement; dual-emit window for 30-90 days (events go to both Segment and oyatie); per-source consent-category-binding preserved. (3) Per-destination credential migration: per-destination credential rotated to OpenBao per ADR-0247; per-destination consent-category-respect re-validated. (4) Tracking Plan migration: per-event JSON-schema imported verbatim; Segment Spec preserved (track / identify / group / page / screen / alias) — these are de-facto industry standard. (5) Function migration: per-function Node runtime-pin per ADR-0247 + sigstore + secret-scan + vault-binding; rewritten where Segment-specific globalContext doesn't translate. (6) Audience + Computed-Trait + SQL-Trait transpile: filter-DSL → oyatie expression-eval DSL with golden-test on historical-cohort-snapshot. (7) Identity-graph rebuild: merge-rules + confidence-threshold preserved; identity-graph rebuilt on oyatie intelligence substrate with EU-AI-Act risk-classification. (8) Engage journey transpile: visual graph → oyatie marketing-automation workflow DSL with frequency-cap + opt-out + EU-AI-Act provenance. (9) Privacy Portal migration: consent-categories + DSAR-queue + data-mapping migrated; downstream destination-propagation for DSAR per GDPR Art-17. (10) Cutover: per-source dual-emit window (30-90 days) with row-checksum + delta-comparison; per-destination canary delivery; per-audience parallel-eval; consent-category respect at every step. (11) Sunset: Segment subscription deactivation; tracking-plan + audit-log + identity-graph retained per regulatory mandate.

**Failure-mode coverage — 18 failures.**
- tracking-plan-validation rejection-cascade (one malformed event blocks downstream): per-event validation-fallback + dead-letter quarantine + tenant-policy gate (allow-violation vs strict).
- identity-resolution merge-rule conflict (two profiles claim same user_id with different traits): per-merge confidence-floor + manual-resolve queue + audit.
- destination-throughput-throttle cascade (one destination slow; back-pressure to source): per-destination back-pressure + circuit-breaker.
- function-execute secret-leak in logs: per-function secret-scrub + redact-pattern + vault-binding mandatory.
- per-destination consent-suppression desync (user opts out; destination still receives event): per-destination suppression-list TTL + cache-invalidate-on-opt-out + dual-check at fanout.
- replay MAR-budget overrun: per-replay estimated-event-count + cap + alert.
- analytics.js page-context inconsistency (SPA vs MPA): per-source SPA-detection + auto-page-event-handling.
- mobile-SDK offline-buffer overflow on long-offline: per-SDK buffer-cap + LRU-evict + alert.
- per-event PII in event-properties leaks to destination not approved for PII: per-event PII-pattern-scan + redact-or-block per consent-category.
- tracking-plan version-drift between dev + prod (dev has new event; prod tracking-plan doesn't): per-environment tracking-plan-version-pin + sync-policy.
- Engage journey infinite-loop on re-enrollment: per-journey re-enrollment-policy explicit + cycle-detection.
- DSAR right-to-be-forgotten propagation incomplete (destination doesn't confirm delete): per-DSAR per-destination delete-confirmation + retry + escalation per GDPR Art-17.
- per-source SDK version-EOL (analytics.js v1 deprecated): per-SDK version-pin + advance-deprecation notice + migration-guide.
- reverse-ETL warehouse-credential rotation orphan: per-model dual-credential-window during rotation.
- audience-eval staleness on real-time event (audience refreshes hourly; user expects immediate): per-audience eval-cadence-pin + real-time-flag option.
- Personas identity-graph drift on rapid identify-event burst: per-burst back-pressure + serialize-merge.
- IAB TCF consent-string-validation per-destination (each destination's vendor-IDs in TCF string differ): per-destination TCF-vendor-ID-list pin + validate-at-fanout.
- per-function Node runtime EOL (Node 16 deprecated): per-function runtime-pin + advance-deprecation.

### Section D-078 - RudderStack

**Vendor identity and category.** RudderStack (founded 2019) is the open-source warehouse-first Customer Data Platform — the leading open-source alternative to Segment (D-077). Key differentiation: warehouse-first design (events stored in customer's own warehouse first, then fanned out — vs Segment's vendor-hosted-first); transformation-as-code (JavaScript + Python transformations in user's git repo); single-tenant deployment option (run inside customer VPC); data-stays-in-customer-cloud architecture; Reverse ETL (Profiles → Warehouse → Destinations); RudderStack Profiles (open-source identity-resolution as SQL-based dbt-compatible models); event-stream + Cloud Extract (D-Fivetran-style ETL) + Reverse ETL + Audiences + Profiles + Transformations + Live Events + Trackers. License: Elv2 (similar to Elastic License). Deployment models: RudderStack Cloud (managed SaaS), RudderStack Hosted (single-tenant on-customer-cloud), RudderStack Self-Hosted (Helm/Docker). Compared to Segment: more transparent code (open-source), data-sovereignty by default, transformation-as-code (vs Segment's GUI-bound Functions), warehouse-first economics (avoid Segment MTU pricing for warehouse loads).

**Vendor data model — 19 top objects.** `workspace`; `source` (event-collection endpoint: web / mobile / server SDKs + Cloud Extract sources); `destination` (downstream tool — 200+ destinations); `connection` (source ↔ destination pair with filter + transformation); `transformation` (JavaScript or Python code in git repo, applied per-connection); `transformation-library` (reusable shared code referenced by transformations); `event` (per Segment Spec: track / identify / group / page / screen / alias); `event-filter` (per-event allow/deny per destination); `cloud-extract-source` (Fivetran-style ETL source: SaaS app); `audience` (cohort built on warehouse data); `profile` (warehouse-resident unified profile via RudderStack Profiles); `profile-model` (dbt-compatible SQL model defining identity-graph + traits); `tracking-plan` (Data Catalog + Tracking Plans for schema-governance); `reverse-etl-model` (warehouse-to-tool sync via SQL); `live-event-debugger` (real-time stream view); `git-repo-binding` (transformations + profiles in git); `webhook-source`; `js-sdk` + `mobile-sdk` (web + iOS/Android SDKs).

**Vendor APIs and named SDKs.** Public REST API v2 (`/sources`, `/destinations`, `/connections`, `/transformations`, `/transformation-libraries`, `/tracking-plans`, `/profiles`, `/audiences`, `/reverse-etl-models`, `/cloud-extract-sources`, `/workspaces`, `/users`). Tracking API: HTTP `/v1/track`, `/v1/identify`, `/v1/page`, `/v1/screen`, `/v1/group`, `/v1/alias` (Segment-Spec compatible). Client SDKs: rudder-sdk-js (web), rudder-sdk-android (Kotlin/Java), rudder-sdk-ios (Swift), rudder-sdk-react-native, rudder-sdk-flutter, rudder-sdk-unity. Server SDKs: Python, Node, Ruby, Go, Java, PHP, .NET. Transformations runtime: Node 18/20 + Python 3.9/3.10/3.11 with full git-versioning. RudderStack CLI (`rudderctl`). Helm charts for K8s self-host. RudderStack Cloud webhook + slack notifications. RudderStack Profiles uses dbt-style SQL models in git (`profiles.yml` + `models/`). Terraform provider for source/destination/connection/transformation. SQL Models API for Profiles management.

**14 distinctive UX surfaces.** Workspace home; Source catalog + setup (web/mobile/server/Cloud-Extract sources); Destination catalog (200+); Connection builder (source → destination with per-connection transformation + event-filter + sample-event tester); Transformation editor (Monaco IDE with JS/Python + git-integration + test-event-runner); Transformation Library editor (shared modules); Tracking Plan editor (Data Catalog with per-event schema + violations); Audience builder (warehouse-data-driven cohort); Profiles workspace (dbt-style SQL models with identity-graph + traits + lineage); Live Events Debugger (real-time event stream with raw JSON + per-destination delivery state); Reverse ETL config (warehouse SQL → destination mapping); Cloud Extract source config; Trackers / Source Templates; Webhook + notification config; Git Repo binding settings.

**Cedar permit block — 22 verbs.**
```cedar
permit(principal, action in RudderStackAction::"<verb>", resource in RudderStackResource::"<id>") when
  resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  && (context.action != "deploy-transformation" || git_repo_signed && runtime_pinned && secret_scan_passed)
  && (context.action != "configure-warehouse-destination" || destination.residency_compatible && credential_in_vault)
  && (context.action != "deploy-profiles-model" || sql_model_validated && lineage_recorded)
  && (context.action != "configure-cloud-extract-source" || consent_category.permits_extract)
  && (context.action != "configure-hosted-deployment" || vpc_isolation_attested && key_management_attested)
  && context.region == resource.tenant.residency_region;
// Verbs: create-source, create-destination, create-connection, configure-event-filter,
// deploy-transformation (JS/Python), run-transformation-locally, configure-transformation-library,
// configure-warehouse-destination, configure-event-replay, configure-cloud-extract-source,
// configure-reverse-etl-model, deploy-profiles-model, configure-audience, configure-tracking-plan,
// suppress-event-with-tracking-plan-violation, configure-git-repo-binding, configure-hosted-deployment,
// configure-self-host-helm, configure-webhook-notification, send-track/identify/page/screen/group/alias-event,
// retrieve-live-event-debugger, configure-trackers.
```
SOC-2 pack adds `audit_logging_to_central_store_enforced`. HIPAA pack adds `hosted_or_self_hosted_required` + `cmk_kms_pinned` + `phi_redaction_in_transformation`. GDPR pack adds `lawful_basis_per_event_recorded` + `right_to_be_forgotten_propagatable_via_profiles_model`. KR-PIPA pack adds `data_stays_in_customer_cloud_attested`. EU ePrivacy + IAB TCF pack adds `tcf_consent_string_validated_per_destination`. EU-AI-Act pack adds `risk_classification_assigned` for AI-assisted transformation suggestions.

**Workflow template library — 9 templates with steps.** `rudderstack.event-ingest-warehouse-first-with-transformation-as-code` (24 steps: receive-event → resolve-source → load-tracking-plan → validate → load-transformation-from-git → execute-transformation-with-runtime-pin → emit-to-warehouse-first → fanout-to-eligible-destinations → audit-per-destination → checkpoint); `rudderstack.transformation-as-code-deploy-with-git-attestation` (19 steps with sigstore + secret-scan + runtime-pin per ADR-0247); `rudderstack.warehouse-first-ingest-flow-with-cost-cap` (16 steps); `rudderstack.profiles-model-sql-deploy-with-lineage` (18 steps integrating with D-074); `rudderstack.reverse-etl-from-warehouse-with-credential-vault` (17 steps); `rudderstack.cloud-extract-source-with-cdc-watermark` (20 steps — Fivetran-style; integrates with D-075 patterns); `rudderstack.hosted-deployment-single-tenant-vpc` (22 steps with vpc-isolation-attest + key-management); `rudderstack.audience-warehouse-driven-with-activation` (15 steps); `rudderstack.dsar-right-to-be-forgotten-via-profiles-model` (21 steps with downstream destination-propagation per GDPR Art-17).

**Capability-tier mapping (ADR-0316).** **Platinum** on `data-pipeline` (event-stream warehouse-first + 200+ destinations + Cloud Extract + Reverse ETL + transformation-as-code); **Gold** on `developer-sdk` (transformation-as-code in JS/Python in customer git repo; SQL Profiles models in dbt-style); **Gold** on `data-warehouse` (warehouse-first orientation; warehouse is the source-of-truth, not vendor-hosted store); **Silver** on `intelligence` (RudderStack Profiles with identity-graph + traits in dbt-style SQL); **Silver** on `compliance` (Data Catalog + Tracking Plans + DSAR via Profiles); **Silver** on `marketing-automation` (Audiences + activation — less developed than Segment Engage); **Silver** on `crm` (warehouse-resident unified profile).

**Migration playbook outline.** (1) Inventory: Public REST API export of all workspaces + sources + destinations + connections + transformations + transformation-libraries + tracking-plans + profiles-models + audiences + reverse-etl-models + cloud-extract-sources + git-repo-bindings + hosted-deployments + webhook-notifications. (2) Per-source SDK swap: per-platform SDK (rudder-sdk-js / iOS / Android / RN / Flutter / server SDKs) script-tag + native-module replacement; dual-emit window for 30-90 days; Segment Spec-compatible API endpoints reduce migration friction. (7) Cloud Extract source migration: per-source treated as Fivetran-style ETL (see D-075 migration patterns). (8) Reverse ETL migration: per-model warehouse-credential-binding + SQL preserved. (9) Hosted/Self-Hosted deployment migration: per-deployment Helm-config or VPC-isolation-attest re-validated on oyatie hybrid runtime; data-stays-in-customer-cloud architecture preserved. - transformation Node 16 → Node 20 runtime-EOL: per-transformation runtime-pin + advance-deprecation notice.

- per-event PII in event-properties leaks to destination via transformation (transformation accidentally exposes PII): per-transformation PII-pattern-scan + redact-or-block; per-destination consent-category enforcement.
- tracking-plan-validation rejection-cascade: per-event validation-fallback + dead-letter quarantine + tenant-policy gate.
- destination-throughput-throttle cascade: per-destination back-pressure + circuit-breaker.
- Hosted/Self-Hosted Helm chart version-drift: per-deployment validated-Helm-version-pin + back-out plan.
- per-Profiles model dbt-style breaking-upgrade: per-model version-pin + advance-deprecation.

- audience-eval staleness on real-time event: per-audience eval-cadence-pin + real-time-flag option.

### Section D-079 - Looker
- Vendor name and category: Google Looker (Google Cloud) — Looker (Original / Core) + Looker Studio (formerly Data Studio) + Looker Studio Pro + Looker Modeler + Looker Gemini conversational analytics / Google Cloud ecosystem / governed BI + semantic-layer (LookML) + embedded analytics + data-application platform.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `analytics` (looks + dashboards + explores) + `data-warehouse` (semantic-layer via LookML + persistent-derived-tables) + `intelligence` (Looker Gemini conversational + Smart-Subjects + Explore-Assistant) + `developer-sdk` (Looker SDK + LookML + embed JS-SDK) + `apigw` (embed sessions + signed URLs)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Looker (Original) Standard (single instance) → **Bronze**; Looker Enterprise (clustered + Customer-Managed-Encryption + audit-export) → **Silver**; Looker + Embed + LookML Models-as-Service + Looker Action Hub → **Gold**; Looker + Gemini-in-Looker + Cross-Cloud-Federation + Hosted-on-customer-VPC + Looker-Modeler-publishing-to-BigQuery-as-Universal-Semantic-Layer → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `analytics` (look + dashboard + explore + alert); `data-warehouse` (semantic-layer = LookML project / model / view / explore + PDT lifecycle); `intelligence` (Looker Gemini conversational + Explore-Assistant + Smart-Subjects + Insights); `developer-sdk` (Looker API SDK + LookML + Embed JS-SDK + Action Hub integration); `apigw` (embed sessions + signed URLs + private embed); `compliance` (per-tenant data-residency + CMEK + audit-log streaming); `marketplace` (Looker Blocks / Marketplace per ADR-0249); `workflow-engine` (scheduled deliveries + data-actions + Action Hub).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Looker platform model):
  - `Instance` (Instance_ID, URL `{slug}.cloud.looker.com` or customer-hosted, Region {US / EU / Asia / Customer-Hosted}, Tier {Standard / Enterprise / Embed}, Looker-Version, Hosted-On {Google-Cloud / Customer-VPC}).
  - `User` (User_ID, Email, Display_Name, SSO_Provider_ID, Groups[], Roles[], User_Attributes[Attribute_Name → Value], Embed-Externally-Provisioned-Flag, Is-Disabled, Created-At, Last-Login).
  - `Group` (Group_ID, Name, Members[User_ID + Sub-Group_ID], External-Group-Provider-ID, Can-Add-To-Content-Metadata).
  - `Role` (Role_ID, Name, Permission_Set_Reference, Model_Set_Reference, Description).
  - `Permission_Set` (Permission_Set_ID, Name, Permissions[]; for example: access_data, see_lookml, see_lookml_dashboards, save_content, embed_browse_spaces, manage_models, develop, deploy, see_logs, see_users, see_pdts, see_datagroups, see_schedules, see_system_activity).
  - `Model_Set` (Model_Set_ID, Name, Models[Model_Name]).

  - `Look` (Look_ID, Title, Description, User_ID, Query_Reference, Public_Slug, Folder_Reference, Embed_Visualization-Config-Override, Created-At, Updated-At, Favorites-Count).
  - `Dashboard` (Dashboard_ID, Title, Description, Folder_Reference, Filters[Filter_Name → Type + Default-Value + Allow-Multiple-Values + Required-Flag], Layout, Tiles[Tile_ID → Type {Look-Linked / Query / Markdown / Button} + Look-Reference + Filter-Bindings], Refresh-Interval-Setting, Embed-URL-Token).
  - `Query` (Query_ID, Model_Reference, Explore_Reference, Fields[], Filters{}, Pivots[], Sorts[], Limit, Row_Total, Visualization_Config, Query_Timezone).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Looker API 4.0 REST (`/api/4.0/`): per-resource CRUD over `users`, `groups`, `roles`, `looks`, `dashboards`, `queries`, `lookml_models`, `projects`, `folders`, `schedules`, `embed_sso_url`, `system_activity`. Auth: API3 client_id + client_secret → bearer token.
  - Looker SDK: official SDKs for Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Kotlin, Swift, Go (`looker-sdk-python`, `@looker/sdk`); auto-generated from Swagger spec.
  - LookML (declarative file-based modeling language): `.model.lkml`, `.view.lkml`, `.explore.lkml`, `.dashboard.lkml`, `manifest.lkml`; deployed via git push + webhook.
  - Embed JS API (`embed.js` / `looker-embed-sdk`): per-iframe embed with `LookerEmbedSDK.init` + signed URL + cookieless embed; postMessage event bus.
  - Action Hub Protocol: per-integration HTTPS endpoint exposing `/actions/{action-id}/list`, `/actions/{action-id}/execute`, `/actions/{action-id}/form`; OAuth flow for per-user action authorization.
  - Webhooks: per-schedule per-event POST to customer webhook destination.
  - Looker Gemini API (private preview): conversational + `ask` endpoint over LookML semantic context.
  - Looker Studio Pro API + Looker Studio Reporting API: per-report-and-data-source CRUD; per-embed config.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Explore" — interactive field-picker + filters + pivot + visualization-builder per Explore object.
  - "Look" — saved query (single visualization).
  - "Dashboard" — multi-tile mosaic with cross-filtering + filter-bar + drill-down.
  - "LookML IDE" — in-browser code editor for LookML files with auto-validation + Project Health.
  - "LookML Validator" — pre-deploy validator catching content / data-test / SQL / LookML errors.
  - "Project Configuration" — git remote + webhook deploy + persistent-dev-mode-branch.
  - "Manage > Connections" — warehouse-connection configuration with PDT-and-Datagroup-Maintenance scheduling + temp DB.
  - "Admin Panel" — Users + Groups + Roles + Permission Sets + Model Sets + User Attributes + Access Grants.
  - "Schedules" — list of scheduled deliveries with last-run status.
  - "Activity (System Activity)" — usage dashboards on i_history + i_user + i_query + i_pdt_event.
  - "Action Hub" — per-integration enabled-actions list + token configuration.
  - "Marketplace" — Looker Blocks (pre-built LookML packages) + Visualizations + Plug-ins.
  - "Embed Playground" — generate-and-test embed signed URLs.
  - "Folders" — hierarchical content folders with per-group permissions.
  - "Personal Folder" / "Shared Folder" — per-user vs shared content surfaces.

- **Cedar permit shape** (analytics + data-warehouse cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<looker-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerExploreRunQuery", Oyatie::Action::"LookerLookCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerLookShare", Oyatie::Action::"LookerDashboardCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerDashboardEditFilter", Oyatie::Action::"LookerSchedulePlanCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerSchedulePlanEditDestination", Oyatie::Action::"LookerLookMLProjectDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerLookMLProjectValidate", Oyatie::Action::"LookerLookMLModelEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerLookMLViewEdit", Oyatie::Action::"LookerLookMLExploreEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerPDTRebuild", Oyatie::Action::"LookerPDTConfigurePersistence",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerDatagroupTrigger", Oyatie::Action::"LookerAccessGrantConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerUserAttributeEdit", Oyatie::Action::"LookerEmbedSSOIssueURL",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerActionHubConfigureIntegration", Oyatie::Action::"LookerActionExecute",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerAlertConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"LookerFolderConfigurePermissions",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerGeminiAsk", Oyatie::Action::"LookerSystemActivityRead",
      Oyatie::Action::"LookerAuditLogStreamConfigure"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::Look::"<look-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Dashboard::"<dashboard-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::LookMLProject::"<project-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Folder::"<folder-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EmbedSession::"<embed-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    context.warehouse_region == resource.data_residency_pack &&
    (resource.kind != "pdt_rebuild" || context.warehouse_credits_remaining > resource.estimated_credits) &&
    (resource.kind != "embed_sso_issue" || context.embed_signature_verified == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "lookml_project_deploy" || context.lookml_validator_passed == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "access_grant_configure" || principal.role in ["admin", "lookml_developer"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "gemini_ask" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true)
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-Looker (BAA + CMEK + audit-streaming to immutable store + per-tenant model isolation); GDPR + KR-PIPA (data-residency per LookML connection + audit-export + DSAR via `system_activity` event filtering); FedRAMP-Mod (Looker on Government-Cloud single-tenant; GCP-Assured-Workloads-aligned); SOC-2 (audit log + access-review export); EU-AI-Act (Gemini-in-Looker conformance ledger if used in production-decisions); ISO-27001 (CMEK + access-review).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `looker.user` → `oya-iam-user` (extra: `looker_user_attributes` JSON map mirrored as Cedar attributes; `embed_externally_provisioned_flag` becomes `principal_kind ∈ {internal, embed-external}`).
  - `looker.lookml_project` → `oya-data-warehouse-semantic-project` (extra: `git_remote_url` retained; `deploy_secret` migrated to vault).
  - `looker.lookml_model` / `view` / `explore` → `oya-data-warehouse-semantic-{model|view|explore}` with `connection_reference → oya-data-warehouse-connection-id` and `included_files → oya-data-warehouse-semantic-include-set`.
  - `looker.dimension` / `measure` → `oya-data-warehouse-field` (preserves type + sql expression + access_grants); enriched with `lineage_upstream[]` from `oya-data-warehouse-column`.
  - `looker.pdt` → `oya-data-warehouse-materialized-view` with `materialization_strategy` mapped to canonical {trigger-sql, trigger-datagroup, persist-for-ttl, incremental-window, native-mv}.
  - `looker.look` → `oya-analytics-saved-query`; `looker.dashboard` → `oya-analytics-dashboard` with `tiles[] → oya-analytics-dashboard-tile`.
  - `looker.schedule_plan` → `oya-workflow-engine-schedule` with destination normalized to `{kind, target_ref}` and `format` preserved.
  - `looker.access_grant` → Cedar `permit ... when principal.user_attribute[grant.attribute] in resource.allowed_values` rule (in-band ontology rule, not stored as separate entity).
  - `looker.action_hub_integration` → `oya-marketplace-integration` + `oya-workflow-engine-action-binding`.
  - `looker.embed_sso_url` → `oya-apigw-embed-session` with signature normalized to HMAC-SHA256 + per-tenant nonce store.
  - `looker.alert` → `oya-analytics-alert` linked to `oya-workflow-engine-notification`.
  - `looker.system_activity_schema` → `oya-observability-usage-fact-table` (canonical i_history + i_query + i_pdt_event normalized into otel-compatible spans).

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (15 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `data-warehouse` + `analytics` + `intelligence` µservices with Looker-feature-parity matrix (LookML + PDT + Datagroup + Access-Grant + Embed + Action-Hub + Gemini).
  2. Stand up parallel `oya-data-warehouse-semantic-engine` on the customer's existing warehouse (BigQuery / Snowflake / Redshift / Databricks / Postgres) using the warehouse connection extracted from Looker.
  3. Export Looker artifacts via API: users + groups + roles + permission-sets + model-sets + user-attributes + folders + content (Looks + Dashboards) + schedules + alerts + LookML-project git-remote + connections + datagroups + access-grants + embed-config + action-hub-integrations.
  4. Mirror Git LookML repo into Oyatie's developer-sdk git server; convert manifest.lkml + per-project `localizations` if present.
  5. Re-validate LookML against the Oyatie semantic engine (LookML-compatible dialect or transpiled to Oyatie semantic-DSL with golden-test parity).
  6. Mirror PDTs: per-PDT materialization strategy migrated; first-build run in shadow schema; row-count + checksum match against Looker production.
  7. Migrate Datagroups (cache-trigger SQL); calibrate `max_cache_age` against Oyatie cache invalidation cadence.
  8. Mirror Access Grants as Cedar rules with per-User-Attribute conditional binding.
  9. Migrate Looks + Dashboards: per-Look query JSON imported; per-Dashboard tile + filter + layout mirrored; visualization-config translated to Oyatie viz library (Vega-Lite + ECharts).
  10. Migrate Schedules: per-schedule destination + cron + recipients + format imported; first delivery shadow-run.
  11. Migrate Embed SSO: per-embed-secret rotated to per-tenant signing key in OpenBao; iframe-host CSP updated; signature algorithm upgraded HMAC-SHA1 → HMAC-SHA256.
  12. Migrate Action Hub integrations: per-integration OAuth re-bound to Oyatie's `apigw` + Cedar; per-action form-definition imported.
  13. Migrate Alerts: per-alert threshold + frequency + channels imported; first eval shadow-run; cutover when 3 consecutive shadow-evals match Looker.
  14. Cut over: per-folder + per-user content + per-embed-host iframe-URL redirected; Looker instance kept read-only for 90 days for audit + appeal.
  15. Sunset: Looker instance deactivated; SLA-grace-period log retention closed; tenant ledger entry per ADR-0247.

- **Failure modes** (15 specific failures):
  - LookML semantic drift on cross-warehouse migration (BigQuery STRUCT vs Snowflake VARIANT vs Postgres JSONB): per-dialect transpile + golden test on row-checksum.
  - PDT rebuild storm on schema-change: per-PDT priority queue + concurrency cap + back-pressure.
  - Datagroup trigger-SQL false-positive (over-invalidates cache; warehouse load spike): per-datagroup trigger SQL golden-test before promote.
  - Access Grant cache staleness (user attribute changes; cached grant still in-effect): per-grant cache TTL ≤ 60s + invalidate-on-attribute-change webhook.
  - Embed signed-URL replay (intercepted URL re-used): per-URL nonce + tight TTL (≤5 min) + IP-binding optional.
  - Embed cookieless on Safari ITP (third-party cookies blocked): cookieless embed path mandatory; storage-access API fallback.
  - LookML deploy without validator green: validator-passed Cedar guard + branch protection.
  - Gemini-in-Looker hallucination on under-specified LookML: per-query semantic-grounding check + confidence threshold + clarifier UI.
  - Action-Hub OAuth-token leak (per-user token in plain-text in custom-action storage): per-action vault-binding + zero-trust posture.
  - System-Activity schema sprawl (i_history grows unbounded): per-tenant retention policy + tiered storage.
  - Folder permission inheritance ambiguity (child folder explicit-grant overrides parent): per-folder effective-permission computation + drift audit.
  - Schedule storm on cron coincidence: per-tenant scheduler-fair-share + jitter.
  - User-attribute injection (attribute value not escaped in LookML SQL filter): per-user-attribute sql-injection-pattern scan + safe-templating.
  - Cross-warehouse connection-credential leak in LookML (credentials in connection config visible to LookML developers with `see_lookml` perm): per-connection vault-binding + redact-in-LookML-IDE.
  - Looker version pinning vs evolving LookML grammar (deprecations across versions): per-project LookML-grammar-version pin + advance-deprecation notice.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Looker API 4.0 export: users + groups + roles + permission-sets + model-sets + user-attributes + folders + content + schedules + alerts + LookML-project + connections + datagroups + access-grants + embed-config + action-hub.
  2. Mirror LookML git-repo with branch protection + validator-on-PR.
  3. Stand up Oyatie semantic engine + run LookML-compatibility test on shadow tenant.
  4. Provision PDTs in shadow warehouse schema; parallel-build + checksum vs Looker production for 7-30 days.
  5. Migrate Access Grants → Cedar rules with per-User-Attribute conditional binding.
  6. Migrate Looks + Dashboards + Schedules + Alerts; per-content render-diff vs Looker.
  7. Migrate Embed SSO: rotate signing key to OpenBao + upgrade HMAC-SHA256.
  8. Migrate Action Hub integrations: OAuth re-binding to Oyatie apigw.
  9. Cutover wave-by-wave per folder + per-embed-host; Looker read-only for 90-day audit grace.
  10. Sunset Looker subscription; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 (audit retention).

- **Naming justification**: `analytics` + `data-warehouse` + `intelligence` + `apigw` + `developer-sdk` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `google-looker` and `looker` and `looker-studio` are benchmark aliases-only; per `feedback_naming_justification` no new µservice names introduced.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-080 - Hex
- Vendor name and category: Hex Technologies / standalone / collaborative data-science notebooks + Magic-AI + interactive app publishing + scheduled-execution + data-app platform-as-product.

Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Hex Community (free, 5 projects) → **Bronze**; Hex Team (collaboration + scheduled-runs) → **Silver**; Hex Enterprise (SSO + SCIM + audit log + private deploy + advanced governance) → **Gold**; Hex Enterprise + Hex-Hosted-in-Customer-VPC + Magic-AI-with-customer-LLM-grounding + encryption-key BYOK (ADR-0251 §D-10) + region-locked storage → **Platinum**.

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `hex.project` → `oya-intelligence-notebook-project` (extra: `app_layout_json` mapped to `oya-analytics-app-layout`; `git_sync_repo` retained).
  - `hex.cell` → `oya-intelligence-notebook-cell` polymorphic with type-tag; `dependencies[]` mirrored to `oya-intelligence-cell-dag-edge`.
  - `hex.sql_cell` / `python_cell` / `chart_cell` / `input_cell` → kind-specific subtypes with kernel-tier + connection-ref + materialization preserved.
  - `hex.magic_ai_invocation` → `oya-intelligence-ai-invocation` (extra: `grounding_data_context_hash` stored; `confidence_score` retained; `model_byok_flag` added).
  - `hex.data_connection` → `oya-data-warehouse-connection` (extra: `auth_scheme` normalized to canonical {password, oauth, workload-identity, iam-assume-role}).
  - `hex.secret_reference` → `oya-secret-binding` rooted in OpenBao path.
  - `hex.app_publication` → `oya-analytics-published-app` + `oya-apigw-embed-host` for embed-allowed apps.
  - `hex.schedule` → `oya-workflow-engine-schedule` with notification channels normalized.
  - `hex.run_history` → `oya-observability-execution-trace` with span-per-cell.
  - `hex.comment_thread` → `oya-collaboration-thread` linked to project + cell.
  - `hex.audit_event` → `oya-compliance-audit-event` with canonical Cedar-evaluated principal + action + resource.
  - `hex.app_layout` → `oya-analytics-app-layout` with responsive grid normalized.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (14 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `intelligence` + `analytics` + `data-warehouse` + `developer-sdk` µservices with notebook-feature-parity matrix (cells + Magic-AI + scheduled-run + app-publish + git-sync + SSO/SCIM).
  2. Export Hex workspace via API v1: users + groups + projects + cells + connections + secrets-refs + schedules + run-history + audit-log + app-publications.
  3. Mirror Git-Sync repos (if used); convert `.hex/` directory format to Oyatie notebook serialization.
  4. Per-connection: rotate credentials to OpenBao + bind to `oya-data-warehouse-connection`; verify connectivity in shadow mode.
  5. Per-secret: migrate to OpenBao with per-cell scope binding.
  6. Per-cell: re-validate cell-DAG dependency-graph; transpile SQL dialect deltas; pin Python kernel version + requirements; pin chart library (Vega-Lite compat).
  7. Per-Magic-AI invocation: re-bind to Oyatie's `intelligence` LLM endpoint (provider-credential BYOK or oyatie-default per `provider_credential_mode` per ADR-0255 §D-4); re-ground on data-context with audit trail.
  8. Per-app-publication: import app-layout + responsive-grid; rotate embed-signing-key; update embed-host CSP + origin-allowlist.
  9. Per-schedule: import cron + notification-channels + input-parameter-overrides; first run shadow-execute and diff outputs.
  10. Per-comment-thread: import comments + @-mentions + resolved-state.
  11. Audit-log replay: per-event ingested into `oya-compliance-audit-event` for retention continuity.
  12. SSO/SCIM cutover: re-bind IdP to Oyatie iam; provision users; deactivate Hex IdP binding.
  13. Cutover wave-by-wave per project + per-embed-host; Hex workspace kept read-only for 60 days.
  14. Sunset: Hex subscription deactivated; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250.

- **Failure modes** (14 specific failures):
  - Cell-DAG re-execution-order ambiguity on import (Hex implicit dataframe-deps vs Oyatie explicit): per-project DAG re-validate + golden-test output-diff.
  - Magic-AI ungrounded hallucination on under-specified prompt: per-cell grounding-evidence requirement + confidence threshold + clarifier UI.
  - Collaborative-edit conflict on concurrent cell-edit during migration cutover: per-cell operational-transform or vector-clock + read-only-window during cutover.
  - Scheduled-app credential staleness on rotation: per-schedule pre-run credential-refresh check + back-pressure.
  - App-publication URL persistence (external sites link to Hex-hosted URL): per-app URL-redirect map + DNS-CNAME for embed continuity.
  - Python kernel version drift (Hex pinned 3.10 → Oyatie 3.11): per-project requirements-pin + dual-kernel-period.
  - SQL dialect drift on connection re-bind: per-cell dialect transpile + golden-test.
  - Per-cell kernel-tier mis-classification (XL needed but S-imported): per-cell resource-fingerprint + auto-tier-suggest.
  - Secret leak on cell-export (secret literal in code rather than reference): per-cell secret-pattern scan pre-import + reject-or-redact.
  - Magic-AI provider-credential BYOK opt-in confusion (B2C-defaults to oyatie creds per [[byok-everywhere-credentials]], ADR-0255 §D-4): per-tenant `provider_credential_mode` clarification + cell-banner.
  - App-layout responsive-grid drift (Hex 12-col → Oyatie 24-col): per-app re-layout + visual-diff regression.
  - Audit-log retention gap (Hex 1-yr → Oyatie 7-yr per pack): per-event back-fill from Hex + supplement with Oyatie post-cutover.
  - Git-sync binary-file ambiguity (large chart-output committed): per-repo .gitignore + LFS rules + migration filter.
  - Run-history orphan (run started on Hex; cutover mid-run): per-run-in-flight wait-then-replay protocol.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Hex API v1: workspace + users + groups + projects + cells + connections + secrets-refs + schedules + audit + app-publications + git-sync-repos.
  2. Mirror git-sync repos with branch protection.
  3. Migrate connections + secrets to OpenBao; shadow-test connectivity.
  4. Re-validate cell-DAG + transpile SQL dialect + pin Python kernel; golden-test outputs.
  5. Re-bind Magic-AI to Oyatie LLM endpoint per ADR-0255 §D-4 provider-credential BYOK mode.
  6. Migrate app-publications + rotate embed-signing-key + update CSP.
  7. Migrate schedules + first shadow-run + diff vs Hex.
  8. Replay audit-log; SSO/SCIM cutover.
  9. Wave-by-wave cutover per project + per-embed-host; Hex read-only 60-day grace.
  10. Sunset Hex; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247.

- **Naming justification**: `analytics` + `intelligence` + `sheets` + `data-warehouse` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `workflow-engine` + `compliance` are canonical per ADR-0105; `hex` is benchmark alias-only.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-081 - Mode
- Vendor name and category: Mode Analytics (acquired by ThoughtSpot in 2023) / ThoughtSpot ecosystem / collaborative SQL notebooks + Python notebooks + dashboards + reports + Visual Explorer + Helix in-memory analytic engine + Datasets-as-semantic-layer + scheduled-report delivery.
- Coverage tier: B (partial: capability tier on `analytics` (Report + Dashboard + Visual Explorer) + `sheets` (analyst ad-hoc) + `data-warehouse` (Datasets semantic-layer + Helix in-memory engine) + `intelligence` (Mode AI assistant)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Mode Studio Free → **Bronze**; Mode Business (collaboration + schedules + alerts) → **Silver**; Mode Enterprise (SSO + audit + Datasets + Visual Explorer Pro + multi-region) → **Gold**; Mode-via-ThoughtSpot (post-acquisition Helix + SpotIQ + cross-product Liveboard handoff + Customer-VPC) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `analytics` (dashboard + report + Visual Explorer); `sheets` (analyst report); `data-warehouse` (warehouse query + Datasets semantic-layer + Helix-compatible in-memory engine); `intelligence` (Mode AI helpbot + SpotIQ-like insight); `workflow-engine` (schedules + alerts); `apigw` (embed + signed-URL); `compliance` (audit-log + data-residency); `developer-sdk` (Mode API + R Notebooks + Python Notebooks).

- **Vendor data model and top objects**:
  - `Organization` (Org_ID, Slug, Plan {Studio / Business / Enterprise / ThoughtSpot-Integrated}, Region, SSO_Provider, SCIM_Endpoint).
  - `Workspace` (Workspace_ID, Org_Reference, Name, Members[], Default_Schedule_Timezone).
  - `User` (User_ID, Email, Display_Name, Org_Reference, Roles[], Last_Login).
  - `Group` (Group_ID, Name, Members[]).
  - `Space` (Space_ID, Org_Reference, Name, Type {Private / Group / Public}, Members[], Reports[]; pre-Workspace concept retained for legacy).
  - `Report` (Report_ID, Space_or_Workspace_Reference, Title, Description, Status {Draft / Published / Archived}, Queries[], Charts[], Python_Notebook (optional), R_Notebook (optional), Layout, Filters[], Published_Snapshot, View_Count, Last_Successful_Run).
  - `Query` (Query_ID, Report_Reference, SQL_Source, Data_Source_Reference, Run_Status, Result_Set_Cache_Ref, Parameters[Param → Type + Default + Allow-Multi]).
  - `Dataset` (Dataset_ID, Org_Reference, Name, Definition_SQL, Data_Source_Reference, Refresh_Schedule, Cached_In_Helix-Flag, Owner, Lineage[Upstream_Source]).
  - `Visualization` / `Chart` (Chart_ID, Report_Reference, Source_Query_or_Dataset, Chart_Type {Bar / Line / Scatter / Pivot / Big-Number / Heatmap / Map / Funnel / Box / etc.}, Encoding, Visual_Explorer_Config (drag-and-drop visual editor state)).
  - `Dashboard` (Dashboard_ID, Report_Reference, Layout, Tiles[Tile → Chart-Reference + Position + Filter-Bindings]).
  - `Python_Notebook` (Notebook_ID, Report_Reference, Source, Imports[], Output_Cells[Cell → Stdout + Plot-PNG], Kernel-Pin).
  - `R_Notebook` (similar).
  - `Data_Source` (Data_Source_ID, Org_Reference, Name, Type {Snowflake / BigQuery / Redshift / Databricks / Postgres / MySQL / Athena / Presto / SQL-Server / etc.}, Connection_String, Auth_Scheme, Secret_Reference, Is-Default-Flag).
  - `Definition` (Definition_ID, Org_Reference, Name, SQL_Body, Used-In-Queries[], Marked-As-Semantic-Layer-Flag — Mode's lightweight semantic layer concept).
  - `Schedule` (Schedule_ID, Report_Reference, Cron_Expression, Run_Type {Refresh / Send-Report-Email / Send-To-Slack / Send-To-Webhook}, Recipients[], Format {HTML / PDF / CSV / Embed-Link}).
  - `Alert` (Alert_ID, Report_or_Chart_Reference, Threshold_Expression, Frequency, Notification_Channels[]).
  - `Embed_Token` (Token_ID, Report_Reference, External_User_ID, Parameters_Bound{}, Expires_At, Signature).
  - `Audit_Event` (Event_ID, Actor, Action, Timestamp, Resource_Reference, Source_IP).
  - `Helix_Cache_Entry` (Cache_ID, Dataset_or_Query_Reference, Size_Bytes, Last_Accessed, TTL).
  - `Visual_Explorer_Session` (Session_ID, Dataset_Reference, Drag-and-Drop-State, Saved-As-Chart-Reference (optional)).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Mode API (`https://app.mode.com/api/{account-name}/`): reports + queries + datasets + spaces + schedules + alerts + users + groups; OAuth + API token auth.
  - Mode CLI (`mode-cli`): per-report pull + push for git-style workflows.
  - Embed API: per-report signed embed URL with parameter-binding.
  - White-label Embed: per-org branded embed host.
  - Webhook ingress + egress: per-schedule + per-alert.
  - SQL Editor REST: per-query run + cancel.
  - Python/R Notebook Runner: per-notebook execute with kernel-pin.
  - ThoughtSpot Integration API (post-2023): per-Mode-Dataset → ThoughtSpot Worksheet bridge.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "SQL Editor" — multi-tab query editor with autocomplete + result-set preview.
  - "Visual Explorer" — drag-and-drop chart builder (Mode's Tableau-alternative).
  - "Notebook (Python + R)" — Jupyter-style cells alongside SQL.
  - "Report Builder" — drag-and-drop layout with charts + text + filters + parameters.
  - "Dashboard" — multi-chart canvas with filter bar.
  - "Datasets" — per-Dataset configuration with refresh-schedule + Helix-caching toggle.
  - "Definitions" — saved SQL snippets reused across queries.
  - "Spaces" — folder-style organization (legacy).
  - "Workspaces" — newer org-organization with member roles.
  - "Schedules + Alerts" — cron-based delivery configuration.
  - "Mode AI Assistant" — chat-style helper in SQL editor.
  - "Embed Configuration" — per-report embed-URL generator with parameter-binding UI.
  - "Activity Feed" — per-org recent-edits + comments.
  - "Data Sources Admin" — per-Data-Source credential management.
  - "ThoughtSpot Bridge" — per-Dataset Worksheet-handoff (post-acquisition).

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<mode-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeReportCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ModeReportPublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeReportEdit", Oyatie::Action::"ModeReportShareToSpace",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeQueryRunSQL", Oyatie::Action::"ModeQueryEditParameters",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeDatasetCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ModeDatasetConfigureRefresh",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeDatasetEnableHelixCache", Oyatie::Action::"ModeVisualExplorerRun",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeChartCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ModeDashboardCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModePythonNotebookRun", Oyatie::Action::"ModeRNotebookRun",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeDataSourceCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ModeDataSourceRotateCredential",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeDefinitionPublish", Oyatie::Action::"ModeScheduleCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeAlertConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"ModeEmbedTokenIssue",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeWhiteLabelEmbedConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"ModeAuditLogExport",
      Oyatie::Action::"ModeAIAssistantInvoke", Oyatie::Action::"ModeThoughtSpotBridgeConfigure"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::ModeReport::"<report-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ModeDataset::"<dataset-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ModeDataSource::"<source-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ModeEmbedSession::"<embed-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    (resource.kind != "publish_report" || context.report_validator_passed == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "embed_issue" || context.embed_origin in resource.allowed_origins) &&
    (resource.kind != "rotate_credential" || principal.role == "admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "ai_assistant" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "helix_cache_enable" || context.tenant_compute_budget_remaining > resource.estimated_cost)
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-Mode (BAA + audit-export + per-query PHI-redaction rule); GDPR + KR-PIPA (data-residency per Data-Source + DSAR via per-user query-history export); SOC-2 (audit + access-review); EU-AI-Act (Mode AI Assistant conformance ledger); ISO-27001 (CMEK if Customer-VPC); FedRAMP-Mod (Mode-Gov tier — limited availability).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `mode.organization` → `oya-tenant-organization`.
  - `mode.workspace` / `mode.space` → `oya-analytics-workspace` (legacy "space" folded as `kind: legacy_space`).
  - `mode.report` → `oya-analytics-report` with `queries[] + charts[] + python_notebook + r_notebook + layout` preserved.
  - `mode.query` → `oya-analytics-query` (extra: `parameters[]` normalized to canonical parameter schema).
  - `mode.dataset` → `oya-data-warehouse-dataset` with `helix_cached_flag` mapped to `oya-data-warehouse-in-memory-cache-enabled`.
  - `mode.visualization` → `oya-analytics-chart` with chart-type normalized.
  - `mode.dashboard` → `oya-analytics-dashboard`.
  - `mode.python_notebook` / `r_notebook` → `oya-intelligence-notebook-{python|r}-cells[]`.
  - `mode.data_source` → `oya-data-warehouse-connection`.
  - `mode.definition` → `oya-data-warehouse-semantic-snippet`.
  - `mode.schedule` → `oya-workflow-engine-schedule`.
  - `mode.alert` → `oya-analytics-alert`.
  - `mode.embed_token` → `oya-apigw-embed-session`.
  - `mode.helix_cache_entry` → `oya-data-warehouse-cache-entry`.
  - `mode.visual_explorer_session` → `oya-analytics-visual-builder-session`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (14 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `analytics` + `sheets` + `data-warehouse` + `intelligence` µservices.
  2. Export Mode org via API: workspaces + spaces + users + groups + reports + queries + datasets + data-sources + definitions + schedules + alerts + embed-tokens + audit-log.
  3. Per-Data-Source: credentials rotated to OpenBao + connectivity shadow-test.
  4. Per-Definition (semantic snippets): import + golden-test against representative query usage.
  5. Per-Dataset: import + replicate Helix-caching to Oyatie in-memory-cache; refresh-schedule retained.
  6. Per-Query: SQL dialect transpile + parameter-binding migration; golden-test row-checksum.
  7. Per-Report: import layout + charts + Python/R notebook cells; visualization-config translated to Oyatie viz library.
  8. Per-Dashboard: import tiles + filter-bindings.
  9. Per-Schedule: import cron + recipients + format; first delivery shadow-run.
  10. Per-Alert: import threshold + frequency + channels; shadow-eval for 7 days.
  11. Per-Embed-Token: rotate signing-key + update embed-host CSP + origin-allowlist.
  12. Replay audit-log into `oya-compliance-audit-event` for retention continuity.
  13. SSO/SCIM cutover; deactivate Mode IdP binding.
  14. Sunset: Mode subscription deactivated; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250.

- **Failure modes** (14 specific failures):
  - SQL dialect drift across heterogeneous Data Sources (Snowflake → Postgres on cutover): per-query dialect-pin + golden-test.
  - Python/R notebook library-version drift (Mode pip-cache vs Oyatie pinned env): per-notebook requirements-pin + dual-kernel-period.
  - Definition (semantic snippet) consistency across reports (snippet edited; downstream reports out-of-date): per-definition golden-test + change-broadcast.
  - Helix cache invalidation lag on dataset-source-change: per-dataset trigger-SQL + cache-TTL-revalidate.
  - Schedule-execution slot-contention on cron coincidence: per-tenant scheduler-fair-share + jitter.
  - Alert-threshold drift on metric-redefinition: per-alert metric-version-pin + advance-deprecation.
  - Embed signed-URL replay: per-URL nonce + TTL.
  - White-label embed CSS drift: per-org branding extracted + golden-screenshot regression.
  - Visual Explorer state import (proprietary drag-drop JSON): per-session re-author into Oyatie viz-builder + golden-screenshot.
  - Mode AI Assistant grounding-context absence on migration (Mode AI had context Oyatie doesn't): per-tenant grounding-corpus rebuild.
  - ThoughtSpot Bridge dataset-handoff orphan (Mode→ThoughtSpot link breaks at cutover): per-bridge re-route or sunset coordination.
  - Per-Data-Source credential-rotation orphan (key rotated; cached query plan fails): per-source pre-rotate dual-credential-window.
  - Per-report dashboard-tile layout drift (Mode 12-col → Oyatie 24-col): per-dashboard re-layout + visual-diff regression.
  - Embed cross-origin cookieless on Safari ITP: cookieless embed path mandatory.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Mode API: org + workspaces + spaces + users + reports + queries + datasets + data-sources + definitions + schedules + alerts + embed-tokens + audit-log.
  2. Migrate data-sources + secrets to OpenBao; shadow-test.
  3. Migrate Definitions + Datasets; configure Helix-equivalent caching.
  4. Migrate Reports (queries + charts + notebooks); golden-test SQL + visual diff.
  5. Migrate Dashboards + Schedules + Alerts; shadow-run.
  6. Migrate Embed-Tokens + White-label Embed + CSP.
  7. Replay audit-log; SSO/SCIM cutover.
  8. Wave-by-wave cutover per Workspace + per-embed-host; Mode read-only 60-day grace.
  9. Coordinate ThoughtSpot Bridge sunset or migrate to Oyatie + ThoughtSpot direct (per D-083).
  10. Sunset Mode; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247.

- **Naming justification**: `analytics` + `sheets` + `data-warehouse` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `apigw` + `compliance` + `developer-sdk` are canonical per ADR-0105; `mode` and `mode-analytics` are benchmark aliases-only.

### Section D-082 - Sigma
- Vendor name and category: Sigma Computing — Sigma platform + Sigma AI + Sigma Embedded + Sigma Input Tables + Sigma Workbooks + Sigma Element-Library + warehouse-native cloud BI on Snowflake / BigQuery / Databricks / Redshift / Postgres / Trino / MySQL / Amazon Athena / Azure SQL / cloud-native spreadsheet-style BI with database push-down.
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `sheets` (spreadsheet-style live-data workbook) + `analytics` (dashboard + chart + pivot) + `data-warehouse` (warehouse push-down query layer + Input-Table writeback) + `intelligence` (Sigma AI + Ask Sigma) + `developer-sdk` (Sigma API + Embed JS SDK) + `apigw` (embed sessions + secure-embed JWT) + `workflow-engine` (Scheduled Exports + Actions) + `compliance` (per-tenant data-residency + audit log + CMEK)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Sigma Cloud single-org (workbook + chart + pivot only) → **Bronze**; Sigma + Input-Tables (warehouse-writeback) + Scheduled-Exports + Actions → **Silver**; Sigma + Embedded + Row-Level-Security + Sigma-AI + Bookmarks + Scenario-Modeling → **Gold**; Sigma + Customer-Managed-Encryption + Customer-Hosted-VPC + Compliance-Pack (HIPAA / FedRAMP) + Cross-Org-Federation + Embed-with-Public-Embed → **Platinum**.

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Sigma platform model):

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
