- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Workbook Canvas" — page-grid with element-library palette and drag-resize.
  - "Element Library" — Visualization / Pivot / Input-Table / Control / Text / Container palette.
  - "Formula Bar" — Excel-like formula with auto-complete + database push-down.
  - "Input Table Editor" — cell-grid with row-add / column-add / paste-from-CSV / formula-cell / lookup-column.
  - "Page Filter Bar" — per-page filter-control with cross-element filtering.
  - "Lineage View" — per-element source-trace to warehouse table + intermediate dataset.
  - "Live-Data Spreadsheet Mode" — Excel-compatible toolbar over warehouse-pushed-down query.
  - "Connections Admin" — warehouse-connection list + permission-mode + writeback-target.
  - "Row-Level-Security Builder" — per-tag predicate-builder with team/attribute binding.
  - "Embed-URL Generator" — per-workbook embed-token with TTL + user-attribute override.
  - "Bookmark + Scenario Modeling" — bookmark snapshot + fork-as-scenario + diff-vs-baseline.
  - "Sigma AI Pane" — chat for ask-and-build over current workbook context.
  - "Scheduled Exports" — list of cron schedules with destinations + last-run status.
  - "Audit Log Export" — per-org event-stream download / SIEM-stream.
  - "Materialization Settings" — per-dataset Live / Cached / Warehouse-MV toggle.

- **Cedar permit shape** (analytics + sheets + data-warehouse cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<sigma-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaWorkbookCreate", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaWorkbookPublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaWorkbookShare", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaWorkbookArchive",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaElementAdd", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaElementEditConfig",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaDatasetCreate", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaDatasetMaterializeAsMV",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaInputTableCreate", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaInputTableWriteback",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaConnectionCreate", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaConnectionRotateCredential",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaConnectionConfigurePermissionMode", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaRowLevelSecurityConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaColumnLevelSecurityConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaScheduleCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaScheduleEditDestination", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaActionConfigureWebhook",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaEmbedTokenIssue", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaEmbedConfigureSecureEmbed",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaScenarioFork", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaScenarioCommit",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaAIAsk", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaAuditLogStreamConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"SigmaSSOConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"SigmaSCIMConfigure"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::SigmaWorkbook::"<workbook-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SigmaInputTable::"<input-table-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SigmaConnection::"<connection-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SigmaEmbedSession::"<embed-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "input_table_writeback" || context.warehouse_writeback_grants_verified == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "rls_configure" || principal.role in ["admin", "data_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "embed_token_issue" || context.embed_origin in resource.allowed_origins) &&
    (resource.kind != "embed_configure_secure_embed" || context.jwt_signing_key_in_vault == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "ai_ask" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "connection_rotate_credential" || principal.role in ["admin", "connection_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "scenario_commit" || context.workbook_review_passed == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "schedule_destination_s3_or_sftp" || resource.destination_allowlist_verified == true)
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-Sigma (BAA + CMEK + Customer-VPC deploy + audit-streaming + per-tenant warehouse isolation); GDPR + KR-PIPA (data-residency per Connection + audit-export + DSAR via audit-log filtering); FedRAMP-Mod (Sigma on GovCloud-aligned VPC; single-tenant); SOC-2 (audit + access-review export); EU-AI-Act (Sigma-AI conformance ledger when production-decisions involve AI cells); ISO-27001 (CMEK + access review); PCI-DSS (when input-tables capture payment-context — Cedar `pci_scope=true` guard + masking policies).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `sigma.organization` → `oya-tenant-organization` (region + plan + SSO mirror).
  - `sigma.user` → `oya-iam-user` (account_type mapped to `principal_capability_tier ∈ {build, explore, view, embed-external, lite}`).
  - `sigma.team` → `oya-iam-team` with `default_connection_permissions` → Cedar `permit ... when principal.team in resource.allowed_teams` rules.
  - `sigma.workbook` → `oya-sheets-workbook` (composite with `oya-analytics-dashboard` projection for embed-published variant).
  - `sigma.page` / `element` → `oya-sheets-page` + `oya-sheets-element` polymorphic.
  - `sigma.dataset` → `oya-data-warehouse-dataset-view` (materialization normalized to {live, cached, warehouse-mv}).
  - `sigma.input_table` → `oya-data-warehouse-writeback-table` + `oya-sheets-input-table` linked pair (preserves PK + validation rules).
  - `sigma.connection` → `oya-data-warehouse-connection` (auth_scheme normalized).
  - `sigma.row_level_security_policy` → Cedar rule with `user_attribute_source` → principal attribute binding.
  - `sigma.column_level_security_policy` → `oya-data-warehouse-column-mask` rule.
  - `sigma.schedule` → `oya-workflow-engine-schedule` (destination normalized to canonical {kind, target_ref}).
  - `sigma.action` → `oya-workflow-engine-trigger` + `oya-apigw-webhook` for HTTP-out targets.
  - `sigma.embed_session` → `oya-apigw-embed-session` (JWT signing normalized to HMAC-SHA256 with vault-rooted key).
  - `sigma.bookmark` / `scenario` → `oya-sheets-bookmark` + `oya-sheets-scenario-fork` linked pair.
  - `sigma.audit_event` → `oya-compliance-audit-event`.
  - `sigma.sigma_ai_invocation` → `oya-intelligence-ai-invocation` (model_byok_flag added per ADR-0255 §D-4).

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (16 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `sheets` + `analytics` + `data-warehouse` + `intelligence` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `workflow-engine` + `compliance` µservices with Sigma-feature-parity matrix (workbook + input-table + RLS + embed + AI + actions + scenarios).
  2. Stand up parallel `oya-data-warehouse` connection to the customer's existing warehouse using extracted Sigma connection config (same Snowflake / BigQuery / Databricks / Redshift / Postgres / Trino instance).
  3. Export Sigma org via REST API v2: members + teams + workbooks (with pages + elements + datasets + input-tables) + connections + RLS + CLS policies + schedules + actions + bookmarks + scenarios + embed-tokens + audit-log + AI-invocations.
  4. Per-connection: rotate credentials to OpenBao + bind to `oya-data-warehouse-connection`; verify writeback grants for Input-Tables; shadow-test connectivity.
  5. Per-Input-Table: migrate writeback-target schema + table to Oyatie-managed warehouse-writeback path; preserve PK + validation; run shadow writeback for 7 days with audit diff.
  6. Per-Dataset: re-validate SQL dialect (transpile if cross-dialect); preserve formula columns + lineage; re-bind materialization mode.
  7. Per-Workbook: import page + element configurations; transpile chart configs to Oyatie viz library; preserve formula bar + filter bar.
  8. Per-RLS / CLS policy: emit as Cedar rules with per-user-attribute predicate binding; golden-test against Sigma's effective predicates on 100+ user×row samples.
  9. Per-Action: re-bind webhook URLs to Oyatie `apigw` + Cedar; preserve trigger + conditional logic.
  10. Per-Schedule: import cron + destination + format; rotate any SFTP / S3 / webhook secrets to vault; first delivery shadow-run.
  11. Per-Embed-Session: rotate JWT signing key to OpenBao; upgrade signature to HMAC-SHA256; update embed-host CSP + origin allowlist.
  12. Per-Bookmark + Scenario: import bookmark filter-snapshots + scenario forks with diff-tracking.
  13. Per-Sigma-AI invocation: re-bind to Oyatie `intelligence` LLM endpoint (BYOK opt-in per `provider_credential_mode` per ADR-0255 §D-4); replay history for tenant audit.
  14. Audit-log replay: per-event ingested into `oya-compliance-audit-event` for retention continuity.
  15. SSO/SCIM cutover: re-bind IdP to Oyatie `iam`; provision users; deactivate Sigma IdP binding.
  16. Cutover wave-by-wave per Folder + per-Embed-Host; Sigma kept read-only for 60 days; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247.

- **Failure modes** (15 specific failures):
  - Input-Table writeback permission-leak (caller-mode workbook elevates beyond intended scope): per-Input-Table Cedar guard + warehouse grant intersect-validate + dual-control on PROD writebacks.
  - Row-Level-Security drift on warehouse tag rename: per-policy golden-test pinned to user×row samples; auto-detect tag rename via warehouse INFORMATION_SCHEMA.
  - Column-Level-Security mask-mode mismatch (hash vs tokenize incompatible across products): per-column mask-canonicalization with reversible-vs-irreversible flag.
  - Scenario-modeling fork-explosion (uncontrolled scenario branching consumes warehouse credits): per-workbook scenario-cap + warehouse-credit pre-check.
  - Embed-JWT replay-attack (intercepted token re-used cross-origin): per-JWT nonce + TTL ≤ 5min + origin-binding via `aud` claim.
  - Embed-secure-embed signing-key rotation gap (old key still accepted during cutover): per-tenant signing-key generation cycle with overlap window + revocation list.
  - Workbook-share inheritance ambiguity (folder grant vs explicit grant conflict): per-share effective-permission compute + drift audit per ADR-0316.
  - Action-webhook payload-leak (sensitive cell values in webhook body): per-action payload-template review + masking rules + Cedar guard on payload-fields-allowed.
  - Sigma-AI hallucination on under-specified workbook context: per-invocation grounding-evidence requirement + confidence threshold + clarifier UI.
  - Live-data push-down cost-explosion (open-ended formula triggers full-scan): per-element push-down-cost estimator + warehouse-credit budget guard.
  - Input-Table validation-rule bypass (CSV upload bypasses cell-level validation): per-Input-Table server-side validation on writeback + reject-with-diff.
  - Cross-warehouse dialect drift on connection re-bind: per-dataset dialect transpile golden-test + dual-run window.
  - Sigma-AI provider-credential BYOK confusion (B2C defaults to oyatie creds per ADR-0255 §D-4): per-tenant `provider_credential_mode` banner + audit on first AI invocation post-cutover.
  - Audit-log retention gap (Sigma 1-yr → Oyatie 7-yr per HIPAA pack): per-event back-fill + Oyatie supplement post-cutover.
  - Scenario-commit race (two analysts commit conflicting scenario edits): per-workbook scenario-merge protocol with CRDT or vector-clock arbitration.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Sigma REST API v2: org + teams + members + workbooks + datasets + connections + input-tables + RLS + CLS + schedules + actions + bookmarks + scenarios + embed + audit.
  2. Stand up Oyatie warehouse connections; rotate credentials to OpenBao; shadow-test.
  3. Migrate Input-Tables (writeback-target schema/table + PK + validation); 7-day shadow writeback diff.
  4. Migrate Datasets (transpile SQL dialect; re-bind materialization).
  5. Migrate Workbooks (pages + elements + formula + filter bar); chart-viz golden-render diff.
  6. Migrate RLS + CLS as Cedar rules; golden-test on 100+ user×row samples.
  7. Migrate Schedules + Actions; rotate webhook secrets + S3/SFTP keys.
  8. Migrate Embed sessions; rotate JWT key + upgrade HMAC-SHA256; CSP update.
  9. Migrate Sigma-AI history; bind to Oyatie `intelligence` LLM endpoint per ADR-0255 §D-4.
  10. Wave-by-wave cutover per Folder + per-Embed-Host; Sigma read-only 60-day grace; ledger entry per ADR-0247.

- **Naming justification**: `sheets` + `analytics` + `data-warehouse` + `intelligence` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `workflow-engine` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `sigma-computing` and `sigma` are benchmark aliases-only; per `feedback_naming_justification` no new µservice names introduced.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-083 - ThoughtSpot
- Vendor name and category: ThoughtSpot — ThoughtSpot Cloud + ThoughtSpot Enterprise + ThoughtSpot Embedded + ThoughtSpot Mode (post-2023 acquisition) + Spotter (formerly SpotIQ) AI insights + SearchIQ natural-language search + Liveboard + Worksheets + Sage AI / ThoughtSpot ecosystem / search-driven analytics + AI-driven insights + embedded analytics + warehouse-native query layer on Snowflake / BigQuery / Databricks / Redshift / SAP HANA / Synapse / Falcon (legacy).
- Coverage tier: C (composed across `analytics` (Liveboard + Answer + Pinboard) + `intelligence` (Spotter / SpotIQ AI + Sage AI + SearchIQ NL-query) + `sheets` (ad-hoc analyst exploration) + `data-warehouse` (warehouse query layer + Worksheet semantic layer + Falcon engine) + `developer-sdk` (Visual Embed SDK + REST APIs + TML) + `apigw` (embed sessions + signed-URL embed) + `workflow-engine` (Monitor alerts + Scheduled deliveries) + `compliance` (audit log + per-tenant data-residency)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: ThoughtSpot Cloud Standard (Liveboard + Answer only) → **Bronze**; ThoughtSpot + Worksheets + SearchIQ + Monitor-Alerts + Scheduled-Pinboards → **Silver**; ThoughtSpot + Spotter-AI + Sage-AI + Embedded + Row-Level-Security + Visual-Embed-SDK + TML-source-of-truth → **Gold**; ThoughtSpot + Customer-Managed-Keys + GovCloud-tenant + Federation across multiple warehouses + Compliance-Pack (HIPAA / FedRAMP) + Cross-Tenant-Embed → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `analytics` (Liveboard + Answer + Pinboard + dashboard); `intelligence` (Spotter / SpotIQ + Sage AI + SearchIQ NL-query + grounded RAG); `sheets` (analyst ad-hoc query); `data-warehouse` (warehouse query + Worksheet semantic layer); `developer-sdk` (Visual Embed SDK + REST API + TML + GraphQL); `apigw` (embed sessions + signed-URL embed); `workflow-engine` (Monitor alerts + Scheduled deliveries + Triggers); `compliance` (audit-log + per-tenant data-residency + CMEK).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (ThoughtSpot platform model):
  - `Cluster` (Cluster_ID, URL `{cluster}.thoughtspot.cloud`, Region {US / EU / Asia / GovCloud}, Tier {Cloud-Essentials / Cloud-Standard / Embedded / Enterprise-Self-Managed}).
  - `Org` (Org_ID, Name, Cluster_Reference, Parent-Org-Reference (multi-tenancy), Resource_Quota, Default_Embed_Allowed-Origins[]).
  - `User` (User_ID, Email, Display_Name, Org_Reference, Groups[], Roles[], SSO_Provider_ID, External_Provider_User_ID, Is-Embed-User-Flag, Has-Service-Account-Flag, Last_Login).
  - `Group` (Group_ID, Name, Members[User_ID + Sub-Group_ID], Privileges[], External-Provider-ID).
  - `Role` (Role_ID, Name, Privileges[]; for example: ADMINISTRATION, DEVELOPER, DATAMANAGEMENT, A3ANALYSIS, USERDATAUPLOADING, EXPERIMENTALFEATUREPRIVILEGE, JOBSCHEDULING, R_ANALYSIS, BYPASSRLS).
  - `Data_Connection` (Connection_ID, Org_Reference, Name, Type {Snowflake / BigQuery / Databricks / Redshift / SAP-HANA / Synapse / Falcon-Legacy / Postgres}, Auth_Scheme {Password / OAuth / Workload-Identity / IAM-Role-Assumed}, Connection_Properties_JSON, Secret_Reference, Default_Warehouse + Default_Database + Default_Schema).
  - `Table` (Table_ID, Connection_Reference, Schema + Table_Name, Columns[Column_Name → Data_Type + Description + Synonyms[] + Display_Format], Joins[Join_Name → Type + Right-Table + Predicate], Row-Level-Security-Applied[], Indexes[]).
  - `Worksheet` (Worksheet_ID, Org_Reference, Tables[Table_ID with formula columns + grouping + parameters], Joins[], Synonyms[Field → [aliases]], Formulas[], RLS_Policies[], Description, Tags[]).
  - `View` (View_ID, Definition_SQL or Definition_Search_String, Persistence {Materialized / Virtual}).
  - `Answer` (Answer_ID, Title, Owner, Source_Worksheet, Search_Tokens (SearchIQ tokens), Visualization_Config, Custom_Calendar, Drill_Context, Tags[], Folders[]).
  - `Liveboard` (Liveboard_ID, Title, Owner, Org_Reference, Tabs[Tab_ID → Title], Visualizations[Visualization_ID → Answer-Reference + Layout-Position], Filters[Filter_Name → Type + Default-Value], Sharing_Setting {Private / Shared / Public / Embed-Allowed}, Embed_URL_Token, Schedules[], Monitor_Alerts[]).
  - `Pinboard` (Legacy alias for Liveboard; old API still uses).
  - `Spotter_Invocation` (Invocation_ID, User_Reference, Worksheet_Reference, Prompt, Grounding_Schema_Context, LLM_Model {ts-default / customer-byok}, Generated_TML, Response, Confidence, User_Feedback).
  - `SpotIQ_Insight` (Insight_ID, Answer_or_Liveboard_Reference, Insight_Type {Outlier / Trend / Anomaly / Cluster / Driver-Analysis}, Generated_Narrative, Confidence_Score, Schedule_Reference).
  - `Sage_AI_Invocation` (Invocation_ID, Worksheet_Reference, Natural_Language_Prompt, Generated_Search_Tokens, LLM_Model, Response).
  - `Row_Level_Security_Policy` (Policy_ID, Worksheet_or_Table_Reference, Group_Reference, Sql_Predicate (parameterized), User_Attribute_Source).
  - `Schedule` (Schedule_ID, Liveboard_or_Answer_Reference, Cron_Expression, Destination {Email / Slack / S3 / SFTP / Webhook}, Format {csv / xlsx / pdf}, Filters_Override, Enabled-Flag).
  - `Monitor_Alert` (Alert_ID, Liveboard-Visualization-Reference, Threshold_Expression, Frequency, Notification_Channels[], Last_Triggered_Time).
  - `Embed_Session` (Embed_ID, Liveboard_or_Answer_Reference, External_User_ID, Group_Memberships[], User_Attributes_Override, Session_TTL, JWT_or_OAuth_Token, Allowed_Origins[]).
  - `TML_Object` (TML_ID, Type {worksheet / table / view / liveboard / answer / connection}, Definition_YAML, Version, Git_Sync_Reference).
  - `Audit_Event` (Event_ID, Actor, Action, Timestamp, Resource_Reference, Source_IP).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - ThoughtSpot REST API v2 (`https://{cluster}/api/rest/2.0/`): per-resource CRUD over `auth`, `users`, `groups`, `roles`, `connections`, `worksheets`, `tables`, `liveboards`, `answers`, `monitors`, `schedules`, `embed-tokens`, `tml`, `audit-log`; bearer-token + OAuth2.
  - GraphQL Endpoint (`/prism/`): per-Liveboard + Answer query with field selection.
  - Visual Embed SDK (`@thoughtspot/visual-embed-sdk`): `LiveboardEmbed`, `SearchEmbed`, `AppEmbed`, `SpotterEmbed`; per-iframe with auth-token / trusted-auth / cookieless embed.
  - TML (ThoughtSpot Modeling Language): YAML-serialized worksheet + table + view + liveboard + answer; deployable via git push + REST API.
  - SearchIQ API: per-query natural-language token translation.
  - Sage AI API: per-prompt query generation.
  - Spotter API (private preview): conversational AI + insight generation over worksheet context.
  - Webhook Egress: per-Monitor-Alert per-schedule POST.
  - Trusted-Auth Endpoint: customer-hosted auth-token issuance for embed.

  2. Stand up parallel `oya-data-warehouse` connection to the customer's existing warehouse using extracted ThoughtSpot connection config.
  3. Export ThoughtSpot Org via REST API v2: users + groups + roles + connections + tables + worksheets + views + answers + liveboards + monitors + schedules + embed-config + RLS + TML + audit-log.
  4. Mirror TML git-sync repos with branch protection + validator-on-PR; per-Org `manifest.tml` if present.
  5. Re-validate TML against Oyatie semantic engine (TML-compatibility transpiler or shadow-import with diff).
  6. Per-connection: rotate credentials to OpenBao + bind to `oya-data-warehouse-connection`; verify access on test query + golden-test schema.
  7. Per-Worksheet: import tables + joins + formulas + synonyms + RLS + parameters; re-bind to Oyatie semantic engine; shadow-execute 100+ representative queries with row-count + checksum diff.
  8. Per-Answer + Liveboard: import search-tokens + visualization-config + tab-layout + filters; viz golden-render diff vs ThoughtSpot.
  9. Per-Spotter / Sage-AI invocation: re-bind to Oyatie `intelligence` LLM endpoint (BYOK opt-in per ADR-0255 §D-4); replay history for tenant audit.
  10. Per-SpotIQ insight: re-bind to Oyatie insight-emission engine; calibrate confidence-threshold + analyst-feedback loop.
  11. Per-RLS policy: emit as Cedar rule with user-attribute predicate binding; golden-test on 100+ user×row samples.
  12. Per-Schedule + Monitor-Alert: import cron + threshold + channels; rotate webhook secrets; first run shadow-execute.
  13. Per-Embed session: rotate signing key to OpenBao; upgrade trusted-auth to HMAC-SHA256; CSP + origin allowlist update.
  14. Audit-log replay + SSO/SCIM cutover; re-bind IdP to Oyatie `iam`.
  15. Cutover wave-by-wave per Folder + per-Embed-Host; ThoughtSpot kept read-only for 90 days; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247.

- **Failure modes** (16 specific failures):
  - SearchIQ NL-query mis-interpretation (token resolution differs from Oyatie's interpretation): per-query confidence-score + clarifier UI + side-by-side TML preview.
  - Spotter / Sage-AI hallucination on under-specified worksheet schema: per-invocation grounding-evidence requirement + confidence threshold + human-review for production-decisions.
  - RLS-policy jit-evaluation lag (cached predicate stale after attribute change): per-evaluation cache TTL ≤ 60s + invalidate-on-attribute-change webhook.
  - Liveboard-embed cross-origin leak (intercepted token re-used cross-domain): per-embed CSP + origin allowlist + nonce binding.
  - SpotIQ-insight false-positive (insight not meaningful): per-insight confidence threshold + analyst-feedback loop + suppression list.
  - Worksheet-column rename break (downstream Answer / Liveboard reference dangling): per-column historical-alias + lazy-resolve + alert.
  - TML deploy without validator green (broken TML enters production): TML-validator-passed Cedar guard + branch protection.
  - Trusted-auth signing-key rotation gap: per-tenant signing-key generation cycle with overlap window + revocation.
  - Cross-warehouse dialect drift (Snowflake STRUCT vs BigQuery RECORD vs Databricks): per-Worksheet dialect transpile + golden-test.
  - Spotter generated-TML hallucination + un-validated import: per-generated-TML auto-validator pass required before import.
  - Federation cross-source join performance collapse: per-Worksheet join-plan estimator + warehouse-credit budget guard.
  - Bypass-RLS privilege escalation (admin accidentally inherits BYPASSRLS): per-role least-privilege audit + Cedar `bypass_rls` requires explicit principal role.
  - Monitor-Alert storm on cron coincidence: per-tenant scheduler-fair-share + jitter.
  - Embed-token replay (token intercepted, replayed cross-session): per-token nonce + TTL ≤ 5min + IP-binding optional.
  - Audit-log retention gap (ThoughtSpot 90-day default → HIPAA 7-yr): per-event back-fill + Oyatie supplement post-cutover.
  - TML git-sync conflict on concurrent edit: per-repo branch-protection + PR-validator + CRDT-or-vector-clock arbitration.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via ThoughtSpot REST API v2: org + users + groups + roles + connections + tables + worksheets + views + answers + liveboards + monitors + schedules + embed + RLS + TML + audit.
  2. Mirror TML git-repo with branch protection + validator-on-PR.
  3. Stand up Oyatie warehouse connections; rotate credentials to OpenBao; shadow-test.
  4. Migrate Worksheets (tables + joins + formulas + synonyms + RLS); shadow-execute 100+ queries with diff.
  5. Migrate Answers + Liveboards; viz golden-render diff.
  6. Migrate RLS as Cedar rules; golden-test on 100+ user×row samples.
  7. Migrate Schedules + Monitor-Alerts; rotate webhook secrets.
  8. Migrate Embed sessions; rotate signing key + upgrade HMAC-SHA256.
  9. Migrate Spotter / Sage-AI history; bind to Oyatie `intelligence` per ADR-0255 §D-4.
  10. Wave-by-wave cutover per Folder + per-Embed-Host; ThoughtSpot read-only 90-day grace; ledger entry per ADR-0247.

- **Naming justification**: `analytics` + `intelligence` + `sheets` + `data-warehouse` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `workflow-engine` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `thoughtspot` is benchmark alias-only; per `feedback_naming_justification` no new µservice names introduced.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-084 - PagerDuty
- Vendor name and category: PagerDuty — PagerDuty Operations Cloud + PagerDuty Incident Response + PagerDuty AIOps (formerly Event Intelligence) + PagerDuty Runbook Automation (formerly Rundeck) + PagerDuty Process Automation + PagerDuty Status Pages + PagerDuty Business Visibility + PagerDuty Advance / PagerDuty ecosystem / on-call + paging + incident-response + AIOps event-correlation + SRE automation + postmortem + status communication + IT business visibility.
- Coverage tier: D (microservice composition: `incident-management` (incident + on-call + escalation + paging anchor) + `intelligence` (AIOps event-correlation + intelligent triage + PagerDuty Advance LLM-suggestions) + `comms-sms` + `comms-voice` + `comms-push` (paging rails) + `itsm` (incident-to-postmortem bridge + Jira / ServiceNow link) + `workflow-engine` (Process Automation + Runbook Automation) + `community` (Status Page) + `compliance` (audit-log + per-tenant data-residency) + `developer-sdk` (PagerDuty API + Event API v2 + SDKs) + `apigw` (Integration webhooks)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: PagerDuty Free / Professional (basic services + escalation + on-call) → **Bronze**; Business (Event Rules + Event Orchestrations + Runbook Automation Lite + Status Pages) → **Silver**; Digital Operations (full AIOps + Process Automation + Business Visibility + advanced incident workflows) → **Gold**; Digital Operations + Customer-Managed-Keys + GovCloud + Compliance-Pack (HIPAA / FedRAMP-Mod) + Cross-Region-Failover + PagerDuty-Advance-with-customer-LLM → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `incident-management` (incident + on-call + escalation + paging + service); `intelligence` (AIOps event-correlation + Advance LLM-suggestions + intelligent triage); `comms-sms` + `comms-voice` + `comms-push` + `comms-email` (paging rails); `itsm` (postmortem + Jira / ServiceNow bridge); `workflow-engine` (Process Automation + Runbook Automation + Workflows); `community` (Status Page); `compliance` (audit-log + per-tenant data-residency); `developer-sdk` (REST API + Event API v2 + SDKs); `apigw` (integration webhooks + signed-URL embed).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (PagerDuty platform model):
  - `Account` (Account_ID, Name, Region {US / EU / FedRAMP}, Plan {Free / Professional / Business / Digital-Operations / Industry-Specific}, SSO_Provider, SCIM_Endpoint).
  - `User` (User_ID, Email, Name, Role {limited_user / observer / responder / user / restricted_access / manager / admin / read_only_user / global_admin / owner}, Teams[], Contact_Methods[Contact_ID → Type {email / sms / voice / push} + Address + Push-Device], Notification_Rules[Rule_ID → Urgency-Filter + Contact_Reference + Delay-Minutes], Time_Zone, License-Type).
  - `Team` (Team_ID, Name, Members[User_ID], Default_Service_Reference, Parent_Team).
  - `Service` (Service_ID, Name, Description, Status {active / warning / critical / maintenance / disabled}, Escalation_Policy_Reference, Auto_Resolve_Timeout_Seconds, Acknowledgement_Timeout_Seconds, Alert_Creation_Mode {create_incidents / create_alerts_and_incidents}, Alert_Grouping {time / intelligent / content_based / off}, Integrations[Integration_ID], Incident_Urgency_Rule, Support_Hours, Scheduled_Actions[], Service_Dependencies[Dependency-Service-Reference + Relationship-Type], Status_Pages[]).
  - `Integration` (Integration_ID, Service_Reference, Type {events-api-v2 / email / generic-events-api-v1 / cloudwatch / datadog / splunk / newrelic / prometheus / nagios / etc.}, Integration_Key (routing-key), Vendor_Name, Created-At).
  - `Escalation_Policy` (Policy_ID, Name, Description, Num_Loops, Escalation_Rules[Rule_Order → {Escalation_Delay_Minutes + Targets[Target_Reference {Schedule / User}]}], Teams[]).
  - `Schedule` (Schedule_ID, Name, Description, Time_Zone, Schedule_Layers[Layer → {Users[] + Start + End + Rotation_Virtual_Start + Rotation_Turn_Length_Seconds + Restrictions[Day-Of-Week + Start-Time-Of-Day + Duration]}], Overrides[Override_ID → {User_Reference + Start + End}]).
  - `Incident` (Incident_ID, Title, Description, Status {triggered / acknowledged / resolved}, Urgency {high / low}, Priority_Reference (optional), Service_Reference, Created-At, First_Trigger_Log_Entry, Acknowledgements[User + Time], Assigned_Users[], Resolved-At, Resolve_Reason, Alerts[Alert_ID], Conference_Bridge {Type + URL + Phone}, Custom_Fields, Linked_Incidents[], Linked_Postmortem, Linked_Jira_Issue_or_ServiceNow_Ticket).
  - `Alert` (Alert_ID, Incident_Reference, Severity {critical / error / warning / info}, Status {triggered / resolved}, Created-At, Body, Integration_Reference, Suppressed-Flag).
  - `Event_Rule` (Rule_ID, Service_Reference, Conditions[Expression-Tree], Actions {Suppress / Annotate / Route-to-Service / Set-Severity / Set-Priority / Suspend / Add-Note / Extract-Field-Value}, Variables[], Position).
  - `Event_Orchestration` (Orchestration_ID, Name, Routes[Route_ID → Conditions + Service-Reference + Catch-All], Global_Rules[], Cached_Routes_TTL).
  - `Runbook_Automation_Job` (Job_ID, Project_Reference, Name, Steps[Step_ID → Type {Script / Node-Step / HTTP / Plugin} + Configuration], Schedule, Node-Filter, Options-Schema, Permission_ACL).
  - `Process_Automation_Workflow` (Workflow_ID, Trigger_Type {Incident-Created / Manual / Scheduled / Webhook}, Steps[Step_ID → Type + Configuration], Linked_Service_Reference).
  - `Postmortem` (Postmortem_ID, Incident_Reference, Template_Reference, Sections[Section_Name → Markdown_Content], Action_Items[Action_ID → {Owner + Due-Date + Description + Status}], Status {draft / published}, Published-At).
  - `Maintenance_Window` (Window_ID, Service_References[], Start-Time, End-Time, Description, Teams[]).
  - `Status_Page` (Page_ID, Name, Subdomain, Custom_Domain, Plan {Public / Customer / Hybrid}, Components[Component_ID → Name + Status + Group], Component_Groups[], Subscribers[Subscriber_ID → Channel {email / sms / webhook} + Address + Component-Subscription], Incident-Updates[]).
  - `Business_Service` (BService_ID, Name, Description, Linked_Technical_Services[], Linked_Teams[], Business_Impact_Status {operational / impacted / outage}).
  - `Webhook_Subscription` (Subscription_ID, Type {webhook_subscription}, Events[incident.triggered / incident.acknowledged / incident.resolved / incident.reassigned / etc.], Delivery_Method {URL + Custom-Headers + Secret_Reference}, Filter {service / team / scope}).
  - `Audit_Event` (Event_ID, Actor, Action_Type, Timestamp, Resource_Reference, Self_URL).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - PagerDuty REST API v2 (`https://api.pagerduty.com/`): per-resource CRUD over `incidents`, `services`, `escalation_policies`, `schedules`, `users`, `teams`, `integrations`, `event_rules`, `event_orchestrations`, `webhook_subscriptions`, `postmortems`, `maintenance_windows`, `business_services`, `audit-records`; OAuth2 + API token (Account-level + User-level).
  - Events API v2 (`https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue`): integration-key-rooted event submission with `routing_key`, `event_action {trigger / acknowledge / resolve}`, `dedup_key`, `payload {summary, severity, source, custom_details, timestamp, component, group, class}`.
  - PagerDuty Status API: per-status-page incidents + components + subscribers CRUD.
  - PagerDuty SDKs: official Python (`pdpyras`), Go (`go-pagerduty`), Ruby, JavaScript (`pagerduty-js`).
  - PagerDuty CLI (`pd`): per-incident + per-schedule shell wrappers.
  - Webhooks v3: per-subscription HTTPS POST with signature header (HMAC-SHA256 with shared secret).
  - Runbook Automation API: per-Job execution + step + node + log streaming.
  - Process Automation API: per-Workflow trigger + step.
  - PagerDuty Advance API (preview): per-incident LLM-suggested-resolution + summary + postmortem-draft generation.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Incident Dashboard" — open incidents list with severity + urgency + service + time-since-triggered.
  - "Incident Detail" — timeline + alerts + acknowledgements + responders + conference-bridge + linked-Jira + actions {acknowledge / resolve / escalate / reassign / postmortem}.
  - "Mobile Push-Acknowledge" — iOS / Android push notification with one-tap ack + escalate.
  - "On-Call Schedule Calendar" — multi-layer rotation visualization with overrides + holidays.
  - "Escalation Policy Builder" — drag-drop multi-rule policy with delay + targets.
  - "Service Directory" — service-graph with dependencies + integrations + alerts-mode + escalation policy.
  - "Event Orchestration Designer" — route-tree builder with conditions + variable-extraction + global rules.
  - "Event Rule Builder" — per-service condition-action rules with priority + suppression.
  - "Runbook Automation Project" — Rundeck-style job + node + step + scheduled run + permissions ACL.
  - "Process Automation Workflow Canvas" — drag-drop workflow with trigger + steps.
  - "Postmortem Editor" — template-based section editor with action-items + publish flow.
  - "Status Page Admin" — components + groups + subscribers + incident-broadcast + custom-domain + theme.
  - "Business Visibility Service Graph" — business-service to technical-service mapping with impact rollup.
  - "Live Call Routing (LCR)" — per-team phone number with routing + voicemail.
  - "Incident Workflows (Custom Actions)" — per-event automation triggers.
  - "Analytics" — incident metrics + MTTR + responder load + service health.
  - "PagerDuty Advance Pane" — LLM-assisted runbook suggestion + postmortem draft + similar-incidents.

- **Cedar permit shape** (incident-management + intelligence + workflow cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<pagerduty-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyIncidentTrigger", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyIncidentAcknowledge",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyIncidentResolve", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyIncidentReassign",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyIncidentEscalate", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyIncidentSnooze",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyIncidentMerge", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyIncidentLinkPostmortem",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyServiceCreate", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyServiceConfigureIntegration",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyServiceConfigureGrouping", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyEscalationPolicyConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyScheduleCreate", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyScheduleConfigureOverride",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyEventRuleCreate", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyEventOrchestrationConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyRunbookAutomationJobExecute", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyProcessAutomationWorkflowExecute",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyPostmortemEdit", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyPostmortemPublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyStatusPageBroadcast", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyStatusPageComponentUpdate",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyWebhookSubscriptionCreate", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyBusinessServiceConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyAdvanceAskSuggestion", Oyatie::Action::"PagerDutyAuditLogStreamConfigure"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::PagerDutyIncident::"<incident-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PagerDutyService::"<service-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PagerDutyEscalationPolicy::"<policy-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PagerDutySchedule::"<schedule-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PagerDutyRunbookJob::"<job-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PagerDutyStatusPage::"<page-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "runbook_job_execute" || principal.runbook_acl_grants in resource.required_grants) &&
    (resource.kind != "runbook_destructive_action" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "status_page_broadcast_public" || principal.role in ["admin", "comms_lead"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "escalation_policy_configure" || principal.role in ["admin", "responder", "manager"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "advance_ask_suggestion" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "webhook_subscription_create" || context.webhook_url_in_egress_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "incident_merge" || context.merge_invariants_validated == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_log_stream" || principal.role == "compliance_admin")
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-PagerDuty (BAA + PHI-bearing-service-tag + restricted paging-channel allowlist + audit-streaming); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region data-residency + audit-export + DSAR via audit-records filtering); FedRAMP-Mod (PagerDuty GovCloud account + cross-region isolation); SOC-2 (audit + access-review); EU-AI-Act (PagerDuty Advance conformance ledger when LLM-suggestions feed into production incident response — human-in-loop required); ISO-27001 (CMEK if available); PCI-DSS (incident-payload masking when payment systems trigger).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `pagerduty.account` → `oya-tenant-account`.
  - `pagerduty.user` → `oya-iam-user` (license-type mirrored; notification-rules projected to `oya-comms-notification-policy`).
  - `pagerduty.team` → `oya-iam-team`.
  - `pagerduty.service` → `oya-incident-management-service` (alert-grouping normalized to canonical {time, intelligent, content, off}).
  - `pagerduty.integration` → `oya-apigw-integration-key` (vendor-type preserved as alias).
  - `pagerduty.escalation_policy` → `oya-incident-management-escalation-policy` (rules + targets preserved).
  - `pagerduty.schedule` → `oya-incident-management-on-call-schedule` (layers + overrides + restrictions preserved).
  - `pagerduty.incident` → `oya-incident-management-incident` (status + urgency + priority + linked-Jira/ServiceNow preserved).
  - `pagerduty.alert` → `oya-incident-management-alert` linked to incident.
  - `pagerduty.event_rule` / `event_orchestration` → `oya-workflow-engine-event-rule` polymorphic with route-tree.
  - `pagerduty.runbook_automation_job` → `oya-workflow-engine-runbook-job` (Rundeck-compatible serialization preserved).
  - `pagerduty.process_automation_workflow` → `oya-workflow-engine-workflow`.
  - `pagerduty.postmortem` → `oya-itsm-postmortem` with action-items linked to `oya-itsm-task`.
  - `pagerduty.maintenance_window` → `oya-incident-management-maintenance-window`.
  - `pagerduty.status_page` → `oya-community-status-page` with components + subscribers normalized.
  - `pagerduty.business_service` → `oya-itsm-business-service` with linked-technical-services preserved.
  - `pagerduty.webhook_subscription` → `oya-apigw-webhook-subscription` (HMAC-SHA256 signature normalized).
  - `pagerduty.audit_event` → `oya-compliance-audit-event`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (17 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `incident-management` + `intelligence` + `comms-*` + `itsm` + `workflow-engine` + `community` + `compliance` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` µservices with PagerDuty-feature-parity matrix (Incident + Service + Escalation + Schedule + Event-Rule + Orchestration + Runbook + Process-Automation + Postmortem + Status-Page + AIOps + Advance).
  2. Export PagerDuty account via REST API v2: users + teams + services + integrations + escalation-policies + schedules + event-rules + event-orchestrations + runbook-automation-jobs + process-automation-workflows + incidents (last 90d) + postmortems + maintenance-windows + status-pages + business-services + webhook-subscriptions + audit-records.
  3. Per-User: import contact methods + notification rules + license type; map to Oyatie `iam` users.
  4. Per-Team: import membership + parent-team hierarchy + default-service.
  5. Per-Service: import service config (auto-resolve, ack-timeout, alert-grouping, urgency-rule, support-hours) + dependencies; recreate in Oyatie `incident-management`.
  6. Per-Integration: rotate Events-API-v2 routing-keys to Oyatie integration-keys; dual-route from upstream vendor (Datadog / Splunk / New Relic / Prometheus / etc.) for parallel-run window.
  7. Per-Escalation-Policy: import rules + targets + loops; preserve schedule + user targets.
  8. Per-Schedule: import layers + rotations + restrictions + overrides + holiday coverage; gap-detection golden-test.
  9. Per-Event-Rule + Event-Orchestration: import condition-tree + actions; transpile to Oyatie `workflow-engine` event-rule format; shadow-evaluate against last 30 days of events with output diff.
  10. Per-Runbook-Automation-Job: import job + steps + node-filter + ACL; transpile to Oyatie `workflow-engine` runbook format (Rundeck-compatible YAML preserved); shadow-execute non-destructive jobs.
  11. Per-Process-Automation-Workflow: import trigger + steps; transpile to Oyatie `workflow-engine`.
  12. Per-Postmortem: import template + sections + action-items + status; link to `oya-itsm-postmortem` + `oya-itsm-task`.
  13. Per-Status-Page: import components + groups + subscribers + custom-domain + theme; DNS-CNAME for subscriber URL continuity.
  14. Per-Business-Service: import linked-technical-services + business-impact rollup.
  15. Per-Webhook-Subscription: rotate shared-secret to OpenBao; upgrade HMAC-SHA256 verification; update event-filter.
  16. PagerDuty-Advance migration: re-bind LLM endpoint to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK opt-in per ADR-0255 §D-4); replay history for tenant audit.
  17. Parallel-run paging on shadow service for 14 days; per-service cut-over with integration-key dual-route; PagerDuty subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247.

- **Failure modes** (18 specific failures):
  - On-call-schedule rotation-gap (no responder during gap): per-schedule gap-detection algorithm + alert on import + continuous monitor.
  - Escalation-policy infinite-loop (escalates back to original): per-policy cycle detection on import + runtime guard.
  - Paging-channel SMS-throttling under storm: per-channel rate-limit + multi-channel fallback ordering (voice + push + email).
  - Mobile-push-acknowledge race (multi-device ack arrives stale): per-incident server-side dedup + last-writer-wins with audit.
  - Event-rule mis-classification (incident marked low-urgency when high): per-rule golden-test + shadow-evaluation diff vs PagerDuty.
  - Event-orchestration route-explosion (deep nested conditions consume CPU): per-orchestration depth-cap + node-cap + complexity budget.
  - Runbook-automation destructive-action mis-fire: per-action approval-gate Cedar guard + dry-run-first option.
  - Runbook-Automation node-credential leak (job stores plaintext SSH key): per-job vault-binding + Cedar guard on secret-read.
  - Process-Automation workflow stuck-step (external HTTP timeout): per-step retry-with-backoff + circuit-breaker + dead-letter.
  - Postmortem-action-item orphan: per-action owner + due-date + tracking + auto-reminder.
  - Postmortem-publish without action-items defined: per-postmortem `requires_action_items=true` Cedar guard.
  - Status-page incident-broadcast cross-tenant leak: per-status-page tenant-scope Cedar guard + audit on broadcast.
  - Status-page subscriber-list leak (DSAR risk): per-subscriber-list access Cedar guard + per-jurisdiction encryption.
  - Webhook-subscription replay-attack (intercepted signed webhook re-played): per-event nonce + timestamp window ≤ 5 min + replay-cache.
  - Business-service impact-rollup mis-calculation (transitive dependency cycle): per-service dependency-graph cycle detection.
  - PagerDuty-Advance LLM-suggestion mis-action (analyst acts on hallucination): per-suggestion confidence threshold + human-in-loop required for production change.
  - Integration-key rotation gap (old key still in dual-route during cutover): per-integration overlap window + telemetry on which key received which event.
  - Audit-record retention gap (PagerDuty default vs HIPAA 7-yr): per-event back-fill + Oyatie supplement post-cutover.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via PagerDuty REST API v2: users + teams + services + integrations + escalation-policies + schedules + event-rules + orchestrations + runbook-jobs + process-workflows + incidents + postmortems + maintenance + status-pages + business-services + webhooks + audit.
  2. Rotate integration-keys to Oyatie; dual-route from upstream vendors (Datadog / Splunk / Prometheus / etc.) for 14-day parallel-run.
  3. Migrate services + escalation + schedules + event-rules + orchestrations; golden-test on last-30-day event replay.
  4. Migrate runbook-jobs + process-workflows; vault-bind credentials; shadow-execute non-destructive.
  5. Migrate postmortems + maintenance + business-services.
  6. Migrate status-pages + subscriber-lists + custom-domain (DNS-CNAME).
  7. Rotate webhook-secrets; upgrade HMAC-SHA256.
  8. Migrate PagerDuty-Advance history; bind to Oyatie `intelligence` per ADR-0255 §D-4.
  9. Parallel-run 14 days; per-service cut-over with integration-key dual-route → single-route on Oyatie.
  10. PagerDuty sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 (audit retention).

- **Naming justification**: `incident-management` + `intelligence` + `comms-sms` + `comms-voice` + `comms-push` + `comms-email` + `itsm` + `workflow-engine` + `community` + `compliance` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `pagerduty` is benchmark alias-only; per `feedback_naming_justification` no new µservice names introduced.

### Section D-085 - OpsGenie
- Vendor name and category: Atlassian Opsgenie — Opsgenie Free / Essentials / Standard / Enterprise + Opsgenie Edge Connector (OEC) + Opsgenie Incident Investigation + Opsgenie Heartbeat Monitoring + Opsgenie Atlassian-Stack-Bridge / Atlassian ecosystem / alerting + on-call + escalation + paging + heartbeat-monitoring + Jira-Software-link + Jira-Service-Management-link + Confluence-postmortem-link + Statuspage-component-link + Compass-service-link + Bitbucket-deployment-context.
- Coverage tier: D (microservice composition: `incident-management` (alert + on-call + escalation + paging anchor with D-084 PagerDuty superset) + `itsm` (Jira / Jira-Service-Management postmortem + ticket bridge) + `community` (Statuspage component bridge) + `comms-sms` + `comms-voice` + `comms-push` + `comms-email` (paging rails) + `workflow-engine` (alert-policies + automation-rules + OEC remote action) + `intelligence` (alert-correlation + noise-reduction + Investigator) + `developer-sdk` (Opsgenie REST API + SDKs) + `apigw` (heartbeat + integration ingestion) + `compliance` (audit + per-tenant data-residency)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Opsgenie Free / Essentials (basic alert routing + on-call schedule + escalation) → **Bronze**; Standard (full alert-policies + automation-rules + heartbeat + service-status + reports) → **Silver**; Enterprise (Incident Investigation + Stakeholder-Comms + advanced ChatOps + cross-team visibility + advanced reporting) → **Gold**; Enterprise + Atlassian-Cloud-Premium / Enterprise data-residency (EU / FedRAMP / Govt) + Customer-Managed-Keys via Atlassian + cross-region failover + audit-event-stream + EU-AI-Act-conformance-for-Investigator + compliance pack (HIPAA / SOC2 / GDPR / KR-PIPA) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `incident-management` (alert + incident + on-call + escalation + paging + service anchor; overlap with D-084 PagerDuty); `itsm` (Jira-bridge + Jira-Service-Management-bridge + Confluence-postmortem link); `community` (Statuspage component-status + subscriber-feed bridge); `comms-sms` + `comms-voice` + `comms-push` + `comms-email` (paging rails); `workflow-engine` (alert-policies + automation-rules + OEC remote-action execution); `intelligence` (alert-correlation + noise-reduction + Investigator post-incident analysis); `developer-sdk` (Opsgenie REST API v2 + heartbeat + integration SDKs); `apigw` (integration-key + heartbeat ingestion + webhook); `compliance` (audit-stream + per-tenant data-residency + Atlassian-Trust pack).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Opsgenie platform model):
  - `Account` (Account_ID, Subdomain, Plan {Free / Essentials / Standard / Enterprise}, Region {US / EU / AU / Govt}, Atlassian_Cloud_Org_ID, SSO_Provider, SCIM_Endpoint, License_Quota).
  - `User` (User_ID, Username (email), Full_Name, Role {owner / admin / user / observer / stakeholder / custom-role}, Time_Zone, Locale, Contact_Methods[Method_ID → Type {email / sms / voice / mobile-app} + Address + Enabled], Notification_Rules[Rule_ID → {Notification-Type + Steps[Delay-Minutes + Method-Reference + Send-After]}], Skills[], Tags[]).
  - `Team` (Team_ID, Name, Description, Members[User_ID + Role-In-Team], Routing_Rules[Rule_ID → Conditions + Notify-Target], Escalations[Escalation_ID], Schedules[Schedule_ID], Services[Service_ID], Linked_Atlassian_Site).
  - `Integration` (Integration_ID, Name, Type {API / Email / SDK / Datadog / Prometheus / CloudWatch / Jira / Statuspage / Slack / Microsoft-Teams / OEC / etc.}, API_Key (routing-key), Owner_Team_Reference, Enabled, Suppression_Rules[], Allow_Configuration_Access, Webhook_Secret).
  - `Alert` (Alert_ID, Tiny_ID, Message, Description, Source, Entity, Alias (dedup-key), Priority {P1 / P2 / P3 / P4 / P5}, Status {open / acked / closed}, Acknowledged-By + Time, Closed-By + Time, Owner-Team, Responders[Type {user / team / escalation / schedule} + Reference], Tags[], Details {custom-key-value-pairs}, Actions[Action-Name], Linked_Service, Snoozed-Until, Notes[Note_ID → Author + Text + Time], Last_Occurred_At, Count-Of-Occurrences).
  - `Escalation` (Escalation_ID, Name, Description, Owner-Team, Rules[Rule_Order → {Condition {if-not-acked / if-not-closed} + Delay-Minutes + Notify-Target {user / team / schedule / all-team-members}}], Repeat {Loop-After-Minutes, Count}).
  - `Schedule` (Schedule_ID, Name, Description, Time_Zone, Enabled, Owner-Team, Rotations[Rotation_ID → {Name + Start + End + Type {daily / weekly / hourly / custom} + Length + Participants[Type {user / group / team / none} + Reference + Order] + Time_Restriction {weekday-and-time-of-day} + Override-List[Override_ID → User + Start + End]}]).
  - `Service` (Service_ID, Name, Description, Owner-Team, Tags[], Visibility {team / public}, Status {operational / degraded / outage / maintenance}, Linked_Statuspage_Component, Service_Dependencies[]).
  - `Heartbeat` (Heartbeat_ID, Name, Description, Interval-Minutes, Interval-Unit, Enabled, Owner-Team, Alert_Message, Alert_Priority, Alert_Tags[], Expired-At).
  - `Policy_Alert` (Policy_ID, Name, Order, Filter (expression-tree), Type {alert-suppress / alert-modify / alert-auto-close / alert-auto-restart / notification-suppress / notification-delay}, Time-Restriction, Enabled, Owner-Team).
  - `Policy_Notification` (Policy_ID, Name, Filter, Auto-Close-After, Auto-Restart, De-Duplication-Action, Owner-Team).
  - `Automation_Rule` (Rule_ID, Name, Trigger {alert-created / alert-closed / incident-created / etc.}, Conditions[Expression-Tree], Actions[Action-Type {add-note / add-responder / send-webhook / run-OEC-action / create-jira-issue / create-incident}], Order, Enabled).
  - `Incident` (Incident_ID, Message, Description, Priority {P1..P5}, Status {open / resolved / closed}, Service_Reference, Stakeholders[], Responders[], Created-At, Resolved-At, Closed-At, Owner-Team, Notes[], Linked_Alerts[], Linked_Postmortem, Affected_Services[], Linked_Statuspage_Incident).
  - `Stakeholder_Communication` (Comm_ID, Incident_Reference, Channel {email / sms / Slack / Teams / Statuspage / webhook}, Recipients[], Message, Sent-At, Sender).
  - `OEC_Configuration` (Config_ID, OEC_Host, Allowed_Integrations[], Allowed_Actions[], Whitelist_Networks[], Bash_Or_Powershell_Allowed, Last_Heartbeat).

  - `Audit_Log` (Log_ID, Actor, Action_Type, Resource_Reference, Timestamp, Source-IP, Outcome).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Opsgenie REST API v2 (`https://api.opsgenie.com/v2/`): per-resource CRUD over `alerts`, `incidents`, `users`, `teams`, `schedules`, `escalations`, `integrations`, `policies`, `services`, `heartbeats`, `maintenance`, `webhooks`, `automation-rules`; GenieKey + API-token + OAuth2 (Atlassian).
  - Heartbeat API (`/v2/heartbeats/{name}/ping`): per-heartbeat ping with optional payload.
  - Opsgenie Edge Connector (OEC) — on-prem connector for executing remote actions in firewalled networks; per-action whitelist + script execution via bash / PowerShell.
  - Webhooks: per-event POST with signature header (X-Opsgenie-Signature, HMAC-SHA256 with shared secret).
  - SDKs: official Python (`opsgenie-sdk-python`), Java (`opsgenie-java-sdk`), Go (`opsgenie-go-sdk-v2`), Ruby community SDK.
  - Atlassian Stack bridges: native Jira-Software issue-link, Jira-Service-Management ticket-link, Confluence postmortem template, Statuspage component-status sync, Compass service-link, Bitbucket deployment-context.
  - ChatOps integrations: native Slack + Microsoft-Teams bidirectional actions {acknowledge / close / assign / snooze}.
  - Reports API: per-team + per-service + per-time-window analytics with filter + export.
  - Investigator API (Enterprise-only): per-incident cause-analysis run + suggestions + confidence + audit.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Alert List" — filterable per-team alerts with priority + status + responder + tags + time-since-trigger.
  - "Alert Detail" — timeline + responders + notes + actions {ack / close / snooze / escalate / assign / add-responder / add-note / run-action / link-to-incident} + linked-Jira-issue + linked-Statuspage-component.
  - "Mobile App" — iOS / Android push with one-tap ack + close + escalate + on-call status + override.
  - "Who's On-Call Now" — per-team current responder view with hand-off countdown + override.
  - "On-Call Schedule Builder" — multi-rotation calendar with daily / weekly / hourly / custom + time-restriction + holiday + override.
  - "Escalation Editor" — multi-rule editor with delay + notify-target + loop count.
  - "Team Routing" — drag-drop rule editor mapping alert-attributes → responder team.
  - "Integration Wizard" — per-vendor (Datadog / Prometheus / CloudWatch / Jira / Statuspage / Slack / Teams / etc.) onboarding with API-key generation + field-mapping.
  - "Policy Builder" — alert-suppress / modify / auto-close / notification-delay rule editor with time-restriction.
  - "Automation Rule Builder" — trigger + condition + action workflow editor with OEC remote-action option.
  - "Service Page" — per-service health, dependent alerts, and Statuspage-component link.
  - "Incident Command Center" — incident timeline with stakeholders, responders, linked alerts, Statuspage broadcasts, and Confluence-postmortem link.
  - "Heartbeat Dashboard" — per-heartbeat last-ping status + expired-state alerting.
  - "Investigator Panel" (Enterprise) — LLM-suggested causes + recent-changes + related-alerts with confidence scores + human reviewer.
  - "Reports & Analytics" — MTTR + MTTA + on-call load + escalation-effectiveness + alert-noise per-team.
  - "Atlassian-Stack Cross-Surface" — Jira-Software issue auto-link, JSM ticket bridge, Confluence postmortem creation, Statuspage component sync.

- **Cedar permit shape** (incident-management + workflow + intelligence + Atlassian-bridge cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<opsgenie-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieAlertCreate", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieAlertAcknowledge",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieAlertClose", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieAlertSnooze",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieAlertEscalate", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieAlertAssign",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieAlertAddResponder", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieAlertExecuteAction",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieIncidentCreate", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieIncidentResolve",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieIncidentBroadcastStakeholder", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieScheduleConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieScheduleOverride", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieEscalationConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieRoutingRuleConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieIntegrationCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieIntegrationRotateKey", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgeniePolicyAlertConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieAutomationRuleConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieOECActionExecute",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieHeartbeatConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieMaintenanceSchedule",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieWebhookCreate", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieJiraIssueLink",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieConfluencePostmortemLink", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieStatuspageComponentUpdate",
      Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieInvestigatorRun", Oyatie::Action::"OpsgenieAuditLogStream"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::OpsgenieAlert::"<alert-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OpsgenieIncident::"<incident-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OpsgenieSchedule::"<schedule-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OpsgenieEscalation::"<escalation-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OpsgenieIntegration::"<integration-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OpsgenieOECAction::"<oec-action-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OpsgenieService::"<service-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "oec_action_execute" || principal.oec_action_grants in resource.required_grants) &&
    (resource.kind != "oec_destructive_action" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "stakeholder_broadcast_public" || principal.role in ["admin", "comms_lead"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "escalation_configure" || principal.role in ["admin", "team_manager"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "investigator_run" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "webhook_create" || context.webhook_url_in_egress_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "integration_rotate_key" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_log_stream" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "jira_issue_link" || context.linked_atlassian_site_in_tenant_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "confluence_postmortem_link" || context.confluence_space_in_tenant_allowlist == true)
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-Opsgenie (BAA with Atlassian + PHI-bearing-service-tag + restricted paging channel + audit-streaming + 7-yr retention); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region data-residency {EU / AU} + audit export + DSAR via audit-records filtering); FedRAMP-Mod (Opsgenie Govt or migrate to Oyatie GovCloud); SOC-2 (audit + access-review + Atlassian-Trust attestation); EU-AI-Act (Investigator conformance ledger when LLM-suggested-causes feed production response — human-in-loop required); ISO-27001 (CMEK if available); PCI-DSS (alert-payload masking when payment systems trigger alerts).

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (18 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `incident-management` + `itsm` + `community` + `comms-*` + `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `compliance` µservices with Opsgenie-feature-parity matrix (Alert + Incident + Escalation + Schedule + Routing + Integration + Policy + Automation + Heartbeat + Service + Maintenance + Webhook + Investigator + Atlassian-Stack-Bridge + Stakeholder-Communication + OEC).
  2. Export Opsgenie account via REST API v2: users + teams + integrations + schedules + escalations + alerts (last 90d) + incidents + policies + automation-rules + services + heartbeats + maintenance + webhooks + investigator-runs + audit-records + OEC-configurations.
  3. Per-User: import contact methods + notification rules + role + skills + team membership; map to Oyatie `iam` users.
  4. Per-Team: import routing-rules + escalations + schedules + services + integrations; preserve team-hierarchy.
  5. Per-Integration: rotate Opsgenie API-keys to Oyatie integration-keys; dual-route from upstream (Datadog / Prometheus / CloudWatch / Jira / Slack / Teams / etc.) for parallel-run window; preserve suppression-rules.
  6. Per-Schedule: import rotations + restrictions + overrides + holiday coverage; per-rotation gap-detection golden-test.
  7. Per-Escalation: import rules + delays + notify-targets + loop config; cycle-detection on import.
  8. Per-Routing-Rule: transpile to Oyatie `workflow-engine` event-rule; shadow-evaluate against last 30 days of alerts with output diff.
  9. Per-Alert-Policy + Notification-Policy: transpile to Oyatie `workflow-engine` (suppress / modify / auto-close / delay normalized to canonical actions).
  10. Per-Automation-Rule: transpile to Oyatie `workflow-engine`; OEC-action calls re-bound to Oyatie `runbook-job` references.
  11. Per-OEC-Configuration: deploy Oyatie Edge Connector with whitelist + allowed-actions + bash/PowerShell scope mirrored; shadow-execute non-destructive actions; vault-bind credentials to OpenBao.
  12. Per-Heartbeat: import interval + alert config; cut over heartbeat-sender to Oyatie heartbeat endpoint.
  13. Per-Service: import status + dependencies + Statuspage-component link; bridge to Oyatie `community` status component.
  14. Per-Incident: import recent (last 90d) incidents + stakeholders + linked-alerts + linked-postmortem + linked-Statuspage.
  15. Per-Atlassian-Stack-Link: rebind Jira-Software / JSM / Confluence / Statuspage / Compass / Bitbucket cross-links via Oyatie Atlassian-bridge adapter; preserve URL continuity.
  16. Per-Webhook: rotate shared-secret to OpenBao; upgrade HMAC-SHA256 verification; update event-filter.
  17. Investigator (Enterprise) migration: re-bind LLM endpoint to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK opt-in per ADR-0255 §D-4); replay history for tenant audit + EU-AI-Act conformance ledger.
  18. Parallel-run paging on shadow team for 14 days; per-team cut-over with integration-key dual-route; Opsgenie subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247.

- **Failure modes** (19 specific failures):
  - On-call-schedule rotation-gap during DST transition: per-schedule DST-aware test + gap-detection alarm.
  - Escalation cycle (rule loops back to original on-call): per-escalation cycle-detection on import + runtime guard.
  - Alert dedup-alias collision across teams: per-team alias-namespace enforcement on import.
  - Mobile push double-ack from two devices: server-side last-writer-wins with audit + per-incident dedup window.
  - Routing rule mis-classification (alert routed to wrong team): per-rule golden-test + shadow-evaluation diff vs Opsgenie.
  - Policy suppress mis-fire (real alert silenced): per-policy preview + last-30-day shadow + suppression-bypass-on-critical override.
  - Automation-rule OEC remote-action mis-fire (destructive script run on wrong host): per-action approval-gate Cedar guard + dry-run-first option + host-whitelist verification.
  - OEC bash/PowerShell credential leak (cleartext in OEC config): per-OEC vault-binding + Cedar guard on credential read + rotate-on-import.
  - Heartbeat ping-source migration gap (old endpoint live during cutover): per-heartbeat dual-ping window + telemetry on which endpoint received which ping.
  - Stakeholder broadcast cross-tenant leak: per-incident tenant-scope Cedar guard + audit on broadcast + recipient-list redaction.
  - Statuspage-component sync drift (Opsgenie service vs Statuspage component out-of-sync): per-link bidirectional sync test + drift-detection cron.
  - Jira-issue link orphan (Jira migrated separately, link dangling): per-link rewrite during Jira migration (cross-product migration ordering).
  - Confluence postmortem template version mismatch: per-template version-pin + auto-migration on first edit.
  - Integration-key rotation gap (old key still in dual-route during cutover): per-integration overlap window + telemetry on which key received which event.
  - Investigator LLM hallucination (suggests change that didn't exist): per-suggestion source-evidence-required + confidence threshold + human-in-loop required for production action.
  - Atlassian-Trust audit-event stream lag (compliance evidence latency >24h): per-stream SLO + lag-alarm + back-fill on cutover.
  - Maintenance-window timezone mis-interpretation (silent alerts during real outage): per-window TZ-explicit + dry-run audit on import.
  - Audit retention gap (Opsgenie default 1-yr vs HIPAA 7-yr): per-event back-fill + Oyatie supplement post-cutover.
  - Multi-account / multi-Atlassian-org migration: per-account separate import lane + cross-account user-deduplication via email + role-mapping.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Opsgenie REST API v2: users + teams + integrations + schedules + escalations + alerts + incidents + policies + automation-rules + services + heartbeats + maintenance + webhooks + audit + Investigator-runs + OEC-configs + Atlassian-stack cross-links.
  2. Rotate integration-keys to Oyatie; dual-route from upstream (Datadog / Prometheus / etc.) for 14-day parallel-run.
  3. Migrate users + teams + schedules + escalations + routing-rules; golden-test on last-30-day alert replay.
  4. Migrate policies + automation-rules + OEC-configs; vault-bind credentials; shadow-execute non-destructive.
  5. Migrate heartbeats; cut over heartbeat-sender clients with overlap window.
  6. Migrate services + incidents + maintenance windows.
  7. Migrate Atlassian-stack cross-links (Jira / JSM / Confluence / Statuspage / Compass / Bitbucket) via bridge adapter; preserve URL continuity.
  8. Rotate webhook secrets; upgrade HMAC-SHA256.
  9. Migrate Investigator history; bind to Oyatie `intelligence` per ADR-0255 §D-4 + EU-AI-Act ledger.
  10. Parallel-run 14 days; per-team cut-over with integration-key dual-route → single-route on Oyatie; Opsgenie sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 (audit retention).

- **Naming justification**: `incident-management` + `itsm` + `community` + `comms-sms` + `comms-voice` + `comms-push` + `comms-email` + `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `opsgenie` is benchmark alias-only; no new µservice names introduced per `feedback_naming_justification`. Atlassian-stack cross-link surfaces (`jira-link`, `confluence-postmortem`, `statuspage-component`) are bridge-pattern aliases that resolve to existing canonical entities (`oya-itsm-cross-reference`, `oya-itsm-postmortem-page-reference`, `oya-community-status-component-reference`).

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-086 - Splunk Enterprise / Splunk Cloud Platform
- Vendor name and category: Splunk Inc. (Cisco) — Splunk Enterprise + Splunk Cloud Platform + Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) + Splunk SOAR (formerly Phantom) + Splunk Observability Cloud (formerly SignalFx + Plumbr + Rigor + Omnition) + Splunk IT Service Intelligence (ITSI) + Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA) + Splunk Mission Control / SIEM + log-analytics + SOAR + APM + RUM + Synthetic + Log-Observer + Infrastructure-Monitoring + Network-Performance-Monitoring + IT-Service-Intelligence + ML-Toolkit + Federated-Search + Data-Stream-Processor + Edge-Processor.
- Coverage tier: A (capability anchor on `siem` (anchor µservice — Splunk pioneered the SIEM pattern) + `observability` (logs + metrics + traces + RUM + synthetic) + `secops` (SOAR + UEBA) + `intelligence` (ML-Toolkit + Anomaly-Detection) + `workflow-engine` (SOAR playbooks + adaptive-response actions) + `data-pipeline` (Splunk forwarders + HEC + Data-Stream-Processor + Edge-Processor) + `developer-sdk` (REST API + Splunk Cloud REST + SDKs)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Splunk Free / Splunk Enterprise indexer-only + basic search → **Bronze**; Splunk Enterprise + Enterprise Security app + ITSI basic + Observability Essentials → **Silver**; Splunk Cloud + Enterprise Security + SOAR + Observability Cloud (APM + IM + RUM + Synthetic + Log-Observer) + UBA + ML-Toolkit → **Gold**; Splunk Cloud + ES + SOAR + Observability Cloud + UBA + Federated-Search + Edge-Processor + GovCloud + Customer-Managed-Keys + cross-region failover + FedRAMP-High + Splunk-AI-Assistant + multi-tenant MSSP → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `siem` (index + search + alert + correlation-rule + notable-event + risk-based-alerting anchor); `observability` (metrics-store + trace-store + log-store + RUM + synthetic + infrastructure-monitoring with OpenTelemetry-native ingest); `secops` (SOAR playbook + adaptive-response + UEBA risk-score); `intelligence` (ML-Toolkit-compatible model serving + Anomaly-Detection + LLM-AI-Assistant); `workflow-engine` (playbook DAG + custom-action); `data-pipeline` (forwarder-protocol + HEC + DSP + Edge-Processor compatible ingest); `developer-sdk` (Splunk REST API v8/v9 superset + Splunk SDKs for Python/Java/JS/C#); `apigw` (HEC token + per-source authentication); `compliance` (audit + per-tenant data-residency + GovCloud overlay).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Splunk platform model):
  - `Index` (Index_Name, Index_Type {events / metrics / federated / summary}, Bucket-Policy {hot / warm / cold / frozen}, Retention-Days, Max-Size, Storage_Tier, Replication_Factor, Search_Factor, App_Owner, Tenant_Reference).
  - `Source` (Source_Path, Sourcetype, Host, Inputs.conf-binding, Ingest_Token, Last-Indexed-At, Time-Format, TZ).
  - `Sourcetype` (Sourcetype_Name, Linebreaker, Truncate, MAX_TIMESTAMP_LOOKAHEAD, TIME_PREFIX, EXTRACT-Rules[], KV_MODE).
  - `Event` (Index, Source, Sourcetype, Host, _time, _raw, _indextime, Fields {key-value}, Tags[], Punct, _bkt).
  - `Metric_Event` (Index, Metric_Name, Numeric_Value, Dimensions {key-value}, _time, Aggregation-Hint).
  - `Saved_Search` (Name, Search_String (SPL), Schedule (cron), Time_Range, Alert_Type {number-of-events / number-of-hosts / number-of-sources / custom / always}, Alert_Threshold, Alert_Throttle, Alert_Actions[{email / webhook / script / lookup / index / summary / risk / notable / adaptive-response-action}], App, Owner, Permissions, ACL, Tenant).
  - `Dashboard` (Dashboard_ID, XML_Definition (Simple-XML / Studio-JSON), Panels[Panel_ID → {Search-Reference, Visualization-Type, Drilldown}], Permissions, ACL).
  - `Lookup` (Lookup_Name, Type {file / KV-store / external}, Filename / Collection-Reference, Fields[], TTL, Access-Mode).
  - `Macro` (Macro_Name, Definition_SPL, Args[], Validation, IsEval).
  - `Eventtype` (Eventtype_Name, Search_String, Priority, Tags[]).
  - `Tag` (Tag_Name, Field=Value-Bindings[]).
  - `Field_Extraction` (Extract_Name, Regex, Source_Field, Destination_Fields[], Permissions).
  - `Notable_Event` (ES) (Notable_ID, Rule-Name (correlation-search), Severity {critical/high/medium/low/informational}, Urgency, Owner, Status {unassigned / new / in-progress / pending / resolved / closed}, Source_Events[], Description, Risk_Object, Threat_Object, Disposition_Code, Tags[], Tenant).
  - `Risk_Object` (ES) (Risk_Object_ID, Risk_Object_Type {user / system / IP / device / file-hash / domain}, Risk_Score (cumulative), Risk_Modifier_Events[], Risk_Annotations {MITRE-ATT&CK-technique-IDs}).
  - `SOAR_Playbook` (Playbook_ID, Blocks[Block_ID → {Function (action / decision / format / filter / utility / playbook / code), Inputs, Outputs}], Trigger {on-create / on-update / manual / scheduled}, Tenant_Scope, Approval_Required, Audit_Log).
  - `SOAR_Container` (Container_ID, Name, Label {event / incident / case}, Severity, Sensitivity, Status {new / open / closed / resolved}, Artifacts[Artifact_ID → {CEF-Fields + Source-Type + Data-Type}], Comments[], Tasks[], Tags[], Custom-Fields[]).
