- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Splunk REST API v8/v9 (`https://<splunk-host>:8089/services/...`): per-resource CRUD over `data/indexes`, `saved/searches`, `search/jobs`, `data/inputs/*`, `data/outputs/*`, `apps/local`, `authentication/users`, `authorization/roles`, `data/lookup-table-files`, `storage/collections/config`, `properties/conf-*`.
  - Search REST: `POST /services/search/jobs` (sync + async modes); `GET /services/search/jobs/<sid>/results` (JSON / CSV / XML); `POST /services/search/jobs/oneshot` (synchronous one-shot).
  - HEC (HTTP Event Collector): `POST /services/collector/event` + `POST /services/collector/raw` (per-event or batch ingest with token auth + sourcetype override).
  - Splunk Cloud REST (`https://api.<region>.splunk.com/2024-XX-XX/...`): per-resource CRUD with OAuth2 + Splunk-Cloud-Service-Account-Token.
  - SOAR REST (`https://<soar-host>/rest/...`): `containers`, `artifacts`, `playbooks`, `actions`, `assets`, `apps`, `audit`.
  - Observability Cloud API (SignalFx-lineage): `https://api.<realm>.signalfx.com/v2/...` for metrics + detectors + dashboards; APM ingestion via OpenTelemetry-OTLP-HTTP/gRPC + Zipkin + Jaeger.
  - Universal Forwarder protocol (`splunktcp` / `splunktcp-ssl`): port 9997 with token-based authentication.
  - Splunk SDKs: Python (`splunk-sdk`), Java (`splunk-sdk-java`), JavaScript (`splunk-sdk-javascript`), C# (`splunk-sdk-csharp`), Ruby (community).
  - Splunk CLI (`splunk` binary): per-resource CRUD with subcommand semantics.
  - Data Stream Processor (DSP) Pipeline API: stream-graph CRUD with source-processor-sink nodes.
  - Edge Processor (EP) API: per-edge-node policy + routing + masking + sampling rule deployment.
  - Splunk AI Assistant (`https://api.<region>.splunk.com/ai-assistant/v1/...`): NL-to-SPL + per-tenant LLM endpoint (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Search & Reporting" (SPL search bar + smart-mode + verbose-mode + statistics-tab + visualization-tab + timeline).
  - "Dashboards" (Simple-XML + Studio + Classic Dashboards with drill-down + token-binding + input-controls).
  - "Pivot" — no-code field-and-aggregation explorer over accelerated datamodels.
  - "Enterprise Security (ES) Incident Review" — per-notable-event triage with disposition + ownership + drill-down + adaptive-response.
  - "ES Risk Analysis" — per-risk-object cumulative score + risk-modifier event timeline + MITRE-ATT&CK technique mapping.
  - "SOAR Mission Control" — per-container playbook execution canvas + block-by-block telemetry + approval-gate UX.
  - "ITSI Service Analyzer" — service-tree topology + KPI-tile + episode-review + glass-table.
  - "Observability Cloud APM" — service-map + RED metrics + trace-explorer + tag-spotlight + tag-keys-correlation.
  - "Observability Cloud Log Observer" — live-tail + log-pattern detection + log-to-metric pipeline + log-search.
  - "Observability Cloud RUM" — session-replay + waterfall + Core-Web-Vitals + per-session journey.
  - "Observability Cloud Synthetics" — global-pop synthetic-monitor + Real-Browser-Test + uptime-SLO.
  - "ML Toolkit" — algorithm explorer + experiment + model-management with MLSPL syntax extension.
  - "Splunk AI Assistant" — NL→SPL + dashboard auto-build + anomaly-investigation summary.

- **Cedar permit shape** (siem + observability + secops + intelligence cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<splunk-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkIndexQuery", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkSavedSearchExecute",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkSavedSearchConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkDashboardView",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkDashboardEdit", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkHECTokenCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkHECTokenRotate", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkForwarderDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkNotableTriage", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkNotableClose",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkRiskAnnotationAdd", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkSOARPlaybookExecute",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkSOARActionExecute", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkSOARApprove",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkAdaptiveResponseTrigger", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkCorrelationSearchConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkLookupEdit", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkMacroEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkDatamodelAccelerate", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkFederatedQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkObservabilityAPMQuery", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkObservabilityRUMQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkObservabilitySyntheticConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkLogObserverPipeline",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkMLToolkitTrain", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkMLToolkitDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"SplunkAIAssistantInvoke", Oyatie::Action::"SplunkAuditExport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::SplunkIndex::"<index-name>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SplunkSavedSearch::"<search-name>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SplunkNotable::"<notable-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SplunkSOARPlaybook::"<playbook-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SplunkCorrelationSearch::"<correlation-name>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SplunkObservabilityService::"<service-name>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SplunkHECToken::"<token-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "index_query_pii_unmasked" || principal.role in ["security_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "saved_search_configure_alert_action_email_external" || context.external_email_in_egress_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "hec_token_create" || context.hec_quota_remaining > 0) &&
    (resource.kind != "soar_playbook_execute_destructive" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "adaptive_response_trigger_external" || context.adaptive_response_target_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "federated_query" || context.federated_provider_tenant_scope_verified == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "ai_assistant_invoke" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_export" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "rum_session_replay_unmasked" || principal.role == "rum_pii_authorized") &&
    (resource.kind != "datamodel_accelerate" || context.acceleration_quota_remaining > 0)
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-Splunk (BAA + PHI-bearing-index-tag + restricted-search + index-level CMEK + 7-yr retention via cold-to-frozen → tenant-S3); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region data-residency {US / EU / APAC} + DSAR via per-user-event-export + right-to-erasure via index-level retention-policy); FedRAMP-High (Splunk Cloud GovCloud or migrate to Oyatie GovCloud); SOC-2 (audit + access-review + index-permission audit); PCI-DSS (per-event PAN-masking at ingest + tokenization + restricted-search on PAN-bearing sourcetype); EU-AI-Act (AI-Assistant + ML-Toolkit conformance ledger when used in security-decisioning loops — human-in-loop required for production action).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `splunk.index` → `oya-siem-event-index` (bucket-policy preserved; retention normalized to ISO-8601 duration; CMEK rotated to OpenBao + per-tenant-KMS per ADR-0251 §D-10).
  - `splunk.event` → `oya-siem-event` (`_time` normalized to UTC RFC-3339; `_raw` preserved as opaque blob; field-extractions projected to `oya-siem-field-extraction`).
  - `splunk.metric_event` → `oya-observability-metric-point` (dimensions normalized to OpenTelemetry-resource attribute keys per ADR-0316 observability authoring).
  - `splunk.saved_search` → `oya-siem-saved-query` + `oya-workflow-engine-event-rule` (alert-actions transpiled to canonical actions).
  - `splunk.dashboard` → `oya-observability-dashboard` (Simple-XML + Studio normalized to Oyatie unified dashboard DSL with backward-compat renderer).
  - `splunk.lookup` → `oya-siem-reference-data` (file-lookups + KV-store-lookups normalized; TTL preserved).
  - `splunk.eventtype` + `splunk.tag` → `oya-siem-event-tag-rule`.
  - `splunk.notable_event` → `oya-siem-notable` + `oya-secops-case` reference.
  - `splunk.risk_object` → `oya-secops-risk-object` (MITRE-ATT&CK technique tags preserved as `oya-secops-mitre-annotation`).
  - `splunk.soar_playbook` → `oya-workflow-engine-playbook` (block-DAG preserved; per-block approval-gate elevated to Cedar guard).
  - `splunk.soar_container` → `oya-secops-case`.
  - `splunk.correlation_search` (ES) → `oya-siem-correlation-rule` (SPL transpiled to Oyatie SIEM query DSL; throttling preserved).
  - `splunk.datamodel` → `oya-siem-datamodel` (CIM-compatible field schema preserved; acceleration projected to `oya-siem-acceleration-summary`).
  - `splunk.universal_forwarder` → `oya-data-pipeline-forwarder-agent` (TLS-config preserved; ingest-token rotated to OpenBao).
  - `splunk.hec_token` → `oya-apigw-ingest-token` (sourcetype-override preserved; rate-limit projected to apigw quota).
  - `splunk.federated_provider` → `oya-siem-federated-source`.
  - `splunk.observability_apm_service` → `oya-observability-apm-service`.
  - `splunk.observability_rum_app` → `oya-observability-rum-application` (PII-scrubbing rules preserved as `oya-observability-rum-pii-policy`).

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (22 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `siem` + `observability` + `secops` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `data-pipeline` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `compliance` µservices with Splunk-feature-parity matrix (Indexes + Sourcetypes + Events + Metrics + Saved-Searches + Dashboards + Lookups + Macros + Eventtypes + Tags + Field-Extractions + Notables + Risk-Objects + SOAR-Playbooks + SOAR-Containers + Adaptive-Response + Correlation-Searches + Clustering + Universal-Forwarders + HEC + Datamodels + Federated-Search + Observability-APM/RUM/Synthetic/Log-Observer/Infra/Network + ML-Toolkit + AI-Assistant).
  2. Export Splunk deployment via REST API + DB + filesystem snapshot: indexes-list + indexes.conf + inputs.conf + outputs.conf + props.conf + transforms.conf + savedsearches.conf + macros.conf + tags.conf + eventtypes.conf + datamodels + lookups + dashboards + apps + roles + authentication-stanzas + SOAR-playbooks + ES-correlation-searches + ITSI-services + Observability-detectors + RUM-apps + Synthetic-monitors + audit-stream + AI-Assistant-history.
  3. Per-Index: re-create in Oyatie `siem` with bucket-policy mapped to Oyatie tiered-storage (hot=SSD, warm=SSD, cold=HDD/S3, frozen=tenant-cold-archive); preserve retention + CMEK.
  4. Per-Sourcetype: import linebreaker + timestamp-rules + KV_MODE + field-extractions; golden-test on representative event sample for parse-fidelity.
  5. Per-Field-Extraction: transpile regex + EXTRACT rules to Oyatie SIEM field-extraction DSL; per-extraction golden-test.
  6. Per-Lookup: import file-lookups + KV-store-lookups; per-lookup TTL + ACL preserved.
  7. Per-Macro: transpile to Oyatie SIEM macro DSL with argument-substitution + eval-mode preserved; per-macro round-trip test.
  8. Per-Eventtype + Tag: transpile to Oyatie SIEM event-tag rule; per-rule shadow-evaluation on 30-day sample.
  9. Per-Saved-Search: transpile SPL → Oyatie SIEM-query DSL with output-schema diff; per-search alert-action transpilation (email → comms-email; webhook → workflow-engine-event-rule; lookup → reference-data write; index → re-index; summary → acceleration-summary; risk → risk-modifier; notable → notable-event; adaptive-response → workflow-engine-action).
  10. Per-Dashboard: transpile Simple-XML + Studio → Oyatie unified-dashboard DSL; preserve panel-IDs + drill-downs + token-binding; per-dashboard rendering fidelity test.
  11. Per-Datamodel: import CIM-schema + acceleration-policy; per-datamodel CIM-compliance validation.
  12. Per-ES-Correlation-Search: transpile to Oyatie SIEM correlation-rule + risk-modifier annotation; MITRE-ATT&CK mapping preserved.
  13. Per-ES-Notable + Risk-Object: import last 90 days of notable-events + risk-object cumulative-scores + risk-modifier history.
  14. Per-SOAR-Playbook: transpile block-DAG to Oyatie `workflow-engine` playbook; per-block approval-gate elevated to Cedar guard.
  15. Per-SOAR-Container + Artifact: import last 90 days of containers + artifacts + comments + tasks.
  16. Per-Universal-Forwarder: re-deploy with Oyatie `data-pipeline` forwarder-agent (Splunk-protocol-compatible); dual-route from source for parallel-run window.
  17. Per-HEC-Token: rotate to Oyatie `apigw` ingest-token; dual-route from upstream for parallel-run.
  18. Per-Federated-Search: re-bind federated-provider endpoints to Oyatie SIEM federation layer.
  19. Per-Observability-APM-Service + RUM-App + Synthetic-Monitor + Log-Observer pipeline + Infra-Monitor + Network-Monitor: re-bind to Oyatie `observability` with OpenTelemetry-native ingest; preserve service-name + SLO + detector definitions.
  20. Per-ML-Toolkit-Model: re-train on Oyatie `intelligence` model-serving with MLSPL-compatibility shim or native re-implementation; per-model output diff.
  21. Per-AI-Assistant-History: archive + re-bind LLM endpoint to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK opt-in per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act conformance ledger.
  22. Parallel-run 30 days dual-index + dual-query; per-tenant cutover via index-router; Splunk Cloud subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 (audit retention).

- **Failure modes** (20 specific failures):
  - Bucket-policy mismatch on cold→frozen tier (events lost on freeze): per-index frozen-archive-path validation + dual-write archive during cutover.
  - Sourcetype linebreaker drift (multi-line events split incorrectly): per-sourcetype representative-event golden test + parse-fidelity score.
  - Timestamp-extraction TZ drift (events ingested with wrong TZ): per-sourcetype TIME_PREFIX + TIME_FORMAT validation + TZ-explicit override.
  - KV_MODE auto-extraction false-positive (random punctuation extracted as fields): per-sourcetype field-cardinality bound + warn-on-drift.
  - SPL → Oyatie-SIEM-DSL semantic gap (e.g., `streamstats`, `transaction`, `mvexpand`, sub-search depth): per-search semantic-fidelity test with output-diff + flagged-feature register.
  - Lookup KV-store TTL drift (stale lookups serving in correlation): per-lookup TTL + version + back-fill on import.
  - Macro recursion + argument-substitution edge case: per-macro depth-bound + arg-typecheck.
  - Eventtype-tag explosion (cardinality blowup post-import): per-eventtype cardinality cap + warn.
  - Saved-search alert-action external email mis-fire (alert fires to wrong DL): per-search alert-action audit + egress-allowlist Cedar guard.
  - Dashboard token-binding drift (drill-down loses scope): per-dashboard rendering fidelity test + drill-down chain validation.
  - Datamodel acceleration storage blowup (summary-index growth uncontrolled): per-datamodel acceleration-time-range bound + cost-alarm.
  - ES correlation-search throttle mis-tune (alert storm on import): per-correlation throttle + first-72h shadow + dual-route review.
  - ES risk-object MITRE-ATT&CK technique-mapping drift (technique-ID renamed in ATT&CK): per-mapping ATT&CK-version-pin + auto-migration on framework update.
  - SOAR playbook block-DAG approval-gate skip (destructive action runs without dual-control): per-block Cedar dual-control guard + audit on every approval.
  - SOAR action external-asset credential leak (cleartext in asset config): per-asset vault-binding + Cedar guard on credential read + rotate-on-import.
  - Universal-forwarder TLS-cert pinning during cutover (forwarder rejects new endpoint): per-forwarder cert-rotation playbook + dual-route window.
  - HEC token quota mis-set (ingestion throttled mid-cutover): per-token quota-pre-flight + dynamic-grow with alarm.
  - Federated-search latency-SLO breach (cross-realm query timeout): per-provider latency-SLO + circuit-breaker.
  - Observability metric-cardinality blowup (tag-key explosion → cost spike): per-stream cardinality-cap + tag-allowlist + cost-alarm.
  - RUM session-replay PII unmasked (sensitive form fields recorded): per-RUM-app PII-scrubbing-rule + recording-allowlist + Cedar guard on replay-view.

- **Migration playbook outline** (12 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Splunk REST + filesystem snapshot: indexes + sourcetypes + saved-searches + dashboards + lookups + macros + datamodels + ES-correlations + SOAR-playbooks + ITSI-services + Observability-detectors + Universal-Forwarders + HEC-tokens + roles + audit.
  2. Re-create indexes with Oyatie tiered-storage + CMEK preserved; back-fill via S3-replay or per-bucket export.
  3. Migrate sourcetypes + field-extractions + lookups + macros; golden-test parse-fidelity on representative samples.
  4. Migrate saved-searches + dashboards + datamodels; per-artifact semantic-fidelity diff against last-30-day output.
  5. Migrate ES correlation-searches + notables + risk-objects (last 90 days) + adaptive-response.
  6. Migrate SOAR playbooks + containers + assets; vault-bind credentials; per-playbook shadow-run on test container.
  7. Re-deploy Universal-Forwarders with Oyatie forwarder-agent (Splunk-protocol-compat); dual-route 30 days.
  8. Rotate HEC tokens; dual-route upstream 30 days.
  9. Re-bind federated-providers + Observability APM/RUM/Synthetic/Log-Observer/Infra/Network with OpenTelemetry-native ingest.
  10. Re-train ML-Toolkit models on Oyatie `intelligence`; per-model output-diff test.
  11. Re-bind AI-Assistant to Oyatie LLM endpoint (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act conformance ledger.
  12. Parallel-run 30 days dual-index + dual-query; per-tenant cutover via index-router; Splunk sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10 (CMEK + audit retention).

- **Naming justification**: `siem` + `observability` + `secops` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `data-pipeline` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `splunk` is benchmark alias-only; no new µservice names introduced per `feedback_naming_justification`. SPL is preserved only as a transpilation-source DSL; the canonical query language is Oyatie SIEM-query DSL.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-087 - Datadog
- Vendor name and category: Datadog Inc. — Datadog Infrastructure + APM + Log Management + RUM + Session Replay + Synthetic Monitoring + Database Monitoring + Network Performance Monitoring + Network Device Monitoring + Cloud SIEM + Cloud Security Management (CSM) + Cloud Workload Security (CWS) + Application Security Management (ASM) + Sensitive Data Scanner + Continuous Profiler + CI Visibility + CD Visibility + Test Visibility + Service Catalog + Software Delivery + Watchdog (AI) + Bits AI + Datadog Observability Pipelines (formerly Vector / Observability-Pipelines-Worker) + Datadog Cluster Agent + Datadog Agent (DogStatsD).
- Coverage tier: A (capability anchor on `observability` (logs + metrics + traces + RUM + synthetic + profiler + DBM + NPM anchor — Datadog set the modern unified-observability pattern) + `siem` (Cloud SIEM) + `secops` (CSM + CWS + ASM) + `intelligence` (Watchdog + Bits AI) + `workflow-engine` (Workflows + Service-Level-Objectives + Incidents Auto-Action) + `developer-sdk` (Datadog API + SDKs) + `apigw` (per-source intake-key + per-tag scope) + `data-pipeline` (Observability-Pipelines-Worker for in-transit transform/route) + `compliance` (audit + per-region data-residency)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Infrastructure-only (Pro) → **Bronze**; Infra + APM + Logs (Enterprise) → **Silver**; full unified observability (Infra + APM + Logs + RUM + Synthetic + DBM + NPM + CI/CD/Test Visibility) + Cloud SIEM + ASM + Profiler + Service Catalog + Watchdog → **Gold**; full stack + CSM + CWS + Sensitive Data Scanner + Bits AI + Observability Pipelines + DDR-Mode (data-residency) + Customer-Managed-Keys + FedRAMP-Moderate + Datadog-Government → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `observability` (metrics + traces + logs + RUM + synthetic + profiler + DBM + NPM + CI/CD/Test-Visibility + Service-Catalog anchor); `siem` (Cloud SIEM rules + signals + investigations); `secops` (CSM posture + CWS workload + ASM in-app protection); `intelligence` (Watchdog anomaly detection + Bits AI assistant — BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); `workflow-engine` (Workflows + SLO Burn-Rate monitor + Incident Auto-Action); `developer-sdk` (Datadog REST API v1/v2 superset + SDKs); `apigw` (intake-key + per-tag scope); `data-pipeline` (OPW-compatible OpenTelemetry-Collector-based in-transit transform); `compliance` (audit + per-region data-residency US1/US3/US5/EU1/AP1/Govt).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Datadog platform model):
  - `Organization` (Org_ID, Subdomain, Region {US1 / US3 / US5 / EU1 / AP1 / Govt}, Plan, Parent-Org_ID (multi-org), SSO-Provider, SCIM-Endpoint).
  - `Account` / `Sub-Organization` (Sub_Org_ID, Settings_Override, API-Keys[], App-Keys[]).
  - `Host` (Host_Name, Aliases[], Tags[{key:value}], Apps[], Sources[], Last-Seen, Metadata {OS / cloud-provider / instance-type}).
  - `Container` (Container_ID, Image, K8s-Pod-Reference, ECS-Task-Reference, Tags[], Resource-Limits).
  - `Service` (Service_Name, Environment, Type {web / db / cache / queue / custom}, Owners[], Repositories[], Dependencies[], Endpoints[], SLOs[]).
  - `Metric` (Metric_Name, Type {gauge / counter / rate / histogram / distribution / set}, Unit, Tags[], Submission-Rate, Retention-Tier {15m / 1h / 1d / custom}).
  - `Log_Event` (Log_ID, Source, Service, Host, Tags[], Status, Timestamp, Attributes {parsed JSON}, Message, Trace_ID-Link).
  - `Log_Pipeline` (Pipeline_ID, Name, Filter, Processors[Processor_ID → {Type {grok / parser / lookup / arithmetic / mask / category / status-remapper / service-remapper / date-remapper / trace-id-remapper / message-remapper / attribute-remapper / nested-pipeline}, Config}], Order, Enabled).
  - `Log_Index` (Index_Name, Filter, Exclusion-Filters[], Retention-Days, Daily-Quota, Disable-Daily-Limit, Storage-Tier {standard / flex / archive}).
  - `Log_Archive` (Archive_ID, Storage-Backend {S3 / Azure-Blob / GCS}, Path, Encryption-KMS-Key, Include-Tags, Exclude-Tags, Rehydration-Policy).
  - `Trace` (Trace_ID, Spans[Span_ID → {Service, Resource, Operation, Start, Duration, Parent-Span-ID, Tags, Metrics}], Sampling-Decision, Span-Count).
  - `RUM_Application` (App_ID, Type {web / mobile / electron / flutter}, Client-Token, RUM-Tier, Session-Replay-Rate, Privacy-Settings {allow / mask-user-input / mask}, View-Auto-Tracking, Error-Auto-Tracking).
  - `RUM_Session` (Session_ID, User-Reference, Views[], Actions[], Errors[], Long-Tasks[], Resources[], Replay-URL, Geo, Device).
  - `Synthetic_Test` (Test_ID, Type {api / browser / multistep-api / mobile}, Locations[], Frequency, Assertions[], Variables[], Tags[], Alert-Configuration).
  - `Profile` (Profile_ID, Service, Environment, Process-Type {cpu / wall-time / allocation / memory / lock / IO}, Sampling-Rate).
  - `Incident` (Incident_ID, Title, Severity, Status {active / stable / resolved}, Created-By, Commander, Responders[], Timeline[], Linked-Signals[], Linked-Monitors[], Postmortem-Reference, Notifications-Channels[]).
  - `Monitor` (Monitor_ID, Type {metric / log / process / network / service-check / event / synthetic / RUM / APM / SLO / CI / database-monitoring / audit / cloud / cost}, Query, Thresholds {warning / critical / OK / no-data}, Notification-Message, Tags[], Priority, Renotify-Interval, Re-Notify-Statuses, On-Missing-Data, Group-By).
  - `SLO` (SLO_ID, Type {metric-based / monitor-based}, Numerator/Denominator (metric) or Monitor-References (monitor), Time-Window {7d / 30d / 90d / custom}, Target-Threshold, Description, Tags[]).
  - `Notebook` (Notebook_ID, Name, Cells[Cell_ID → {Type {markdown / metrics / logs / traces / RUM / profiling / synthetic / heatmap / image / SLO}, Config}], Status {draft / published}).
  - `Dashboard` (Dashboard_ID, Type {ordered / free / screenboard / timeboard}, Widgets[Widget_ID → {Type, Config}], Template-Variables[], Tags[], URL-Sharing).
  - `Security_Rule` (Rule_ID, Type {log-detection / signal-correlation / threat-intel / posture}, Query, Cases[Case_ID → {Condition, Severity}], MITRE-Tags[], Compliance-Tags[]).
  - `Signal` (Signal_ID, Rule_ID, Severity, Status {open / under-review / archived / resolved}, Tags[], Triggered-Events[], Assignee, Timeline[]).
  - `Workflow` (Workflow_ID, Spec {steps[] + connectors[] + triggers[]}, Trigger {monitor / signal / schedule / manual / API}, Tags[], Audit-Log).
  - `Observability_Pipeline` (Pipeline_ID, Worker-Cluster, Sources[], Transforms[], Sinks[], Routing-Rules[]).
  - `Tag` (Tag_Key, Tag_Value, Cardinality, Cost-Impact, Owner-App).
  - `User` + `Role` + `Team` + `API-Key` + `App-Key` + `Audit-Event`.

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Datadog REST API v1 (`https://api.<region>.datadoghq.com/api/v1/...`): per-resource CRUD over `series`, `events`, `logs`, `monitors`, `dashboards`, `notebooks`, `slo`, `incidents`, `synthetics`, `users`, `roles`, `tags`, `service_definitions`, `service_dependencies`.
  - Datadog REST API v2 (`https://api.<region>.datadoghq.com/api/v2/...`): newer resources `logs/events`, `metrics`, `RUM`, `audit`, `security_monitoring`, `service_accounts`, `case_management`, `application_keys`, `workflows`.
  - Logs Intake (`https://http-intake.logs.<region>.datadoghq.com/api/v2/logs`): high-throughput log ingestion via DD-API-KEY header.
  - Metrics Intake (Series API + DogStatsD UDP/UDS protocol port 8125 via Datadog Agent).
  - Traces Intake (`/v0.4/traces` over Agent or OTLP via OpenTelemetry-Datadog-exporter).
  - RUM Intake (`https://browser-intake-<region>.datadoghq.com/api/v2/rum`): per-app client-token.
  - Synthetic API: per-test CRUD + on-demand-run + results.
  - SDKs: Python (`datadog`/`datadog-api-client`), Java (`datadog-api-client-java`), Go (`datadog-api-client-go`), Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Rust, .NET; browser RUM SDK + mobile RUM SDKs (iOS Swift / Android Kotlin / Flutter / React-Native).
  - CLI: `datadog-ci` for CI integration + synthetic-tests + RUM-sourcemaps + Test-Visibility upload.
  - Datadog Agent (open-source `datadog-agent`): metric + log + trace + process + network forwarding.
  - Cluster Agent: K8s in-cluster metric + autodiscovery + admission-webhook for APM injection.
  - Observability Pipelines Worker (OPW): Vector-derived in-transit transform; per-pipeline source-transform-sink topology.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Infrastructure Map" — per-host + per-container + per-cloud-resource topology with tag-filter.
  - "APM Service Map" — service dependency graph with health-color + latency-overlay.
  - "Trace Explorer" — span search with tag-filter + flame-graph + analytics-mode.
  - "Log Explorer" — pattern-detection + facet-filter + live-tail + log-correlation-to-trace.
  - "RUM Explorer" + "Session Replay" — per-session journey with DOM-replay + privacy-mask.
  - "Synthetic Test Editor" — browser-test recorder + API-multistep builder + assertion catalog.
  - "Service Catalog" — per-service ownership + tier + dependencies + scorecard + linked-incident.
  - "Watchdog" — auto-detected anomalies + auto-detected service-deviations + recommended-RCA.
  - "Bits AI" — NL-to-query + investigation-summary + dashboard-build assistant.
  - "Notebooks" — per-investigation + per-runbook narrative with embedded widgets.
  - "Dashboards" — ordered / free / screenboard / timeboard with template-variables + URL-sharing + viewer-mode.
  - "Monitors" — per-monitor with multi-alert + composite + recovery + auto-resolve + on-missing-data.
  - "Incidents" — per-incident command-center with timeline + responders + postmortem.
  - "Cloud SIEM Signals" — per-signal with detection-rule + linked-events + investigation-graph.
  - "Cloud Security Posture" — per-resource misconfiguration + compliance-score + remediation.

- **Cedar permit shape** (observability + siem + secops + intelligence + workflow cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<datadog-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogMetricQuery", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogMetricSubmit",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogLogQuery", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogLogIngest",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogLogPipelineEdit", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogLogIndexConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogLogArchiveConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogTraceQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogRUMQuery", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogRUMSessionReplayView",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogSyntheticTestCreate", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogSyntheticTestRun",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogMonitorCreate", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogMonitorMute",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogSLOConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogIncidentCommand",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogSecurityRuleConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogSignalTriage",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogWorkflowExecute", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogWorkflowApprove",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogCSMPolicyConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogCWSPolicyConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogASMPolicyConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogSensitiveDataScannerConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogProfilerQuery", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogDashboardEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogNotebookEdit", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogServiceCatalogEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogBitsAIInvoke", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogAPIKeyRotate",
      Oyatie::Action::"DatadogOPWPipelineDeploy", Oyatie::Action::"DatadogAuditExport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::DatadogService::"<service-name>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DatadogLogIndex::"<index-name>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DatadogMonitor::"<monitor-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DatadogSLO::"<slo-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DatadogSecurityRule::"<rule-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DatadogWorkflow::"<workflow-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DatadogRUMApplication::"<app-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DatadogSyntheticTest::"<test-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "log_query_pii_unmasked" || principal.role in ["security_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "log_ingest_high_cardinality" || context.cardinality_budget_remaining > 0) &&
    (resource.kind != "log_archive_external" || context.archive_bucket_in_egress_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "rum_session_replay_unmasked" || principal.role == "rum_pii_authorized") &&
    (resource.kind != "synthetic_test_run_destructive" || context.synthetic_destructive_scope_approved == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "workflow_execute_destructive" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "csm_policy_configure" || principal.role in ["security_admin", "cloud_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "cws_policy_configure_blocking" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "asm_policy_blocking_mode" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "bits_ai_invoke" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "api_key_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_export" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "opw_pipeline_deploy" || principal.role in ["observability_admin", "data_engineer"])
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-Datadog (BAA + PHI-bearing log-index-tag + PHI-bearing-RUM-app PII-mask-mode + Sensitive-Data-Scanner enforced + 7-yr archive); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region data-residency + DSAR via per-user-event-export + right-to-erasure via index-retention); FedRAMP-Mod (Datadog Government); SOC-2 (audit + access-review); PCI-DSS (Sensitive-Data-Scanner mandatory + PAN tokenization at intake + restricted log-index); EU-AI-Act (Watchdog + Bits AI conformance ledger).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `datadog.organization` → `oya-tenant-account` (region preserved as `data_residency_region`).
  - `datadog.host` + `datadog.container` → `oya-observability-resource` (tag-namespacing normalized; cloud-provider metadata projected to `oya-observability-cloud-resource`).
  - `datadog.service` → `oya-observability-service` + `oya-service-catalog-entry`.
  - `datadog.metric` → `oya-observability-metric` (OpenTelemetry semantic-convention compatible; type-mapping preserved).
  - `datadog.log_event` → `oya-observability-log-event` (attributes projected to OTel-log-record body + attributes).
  - `datadog.log_pipeline` → `oya-data-pipeline-log-transform` (processor-chain transpiled to canonical processors).
  - `datadog.log_index` → `oya-observability-log-index` (retention + quota + storage-tier preserved).
  - `datadog.log_archive` → `oya-observability-log-archive-target` (CMEK rotated to OpenBao per ADR-0251 §D-10).
  - `datadog.trace` → `oya-observability-trace` (span-tree projected to OTel-trace).
  - `datadog.rum_application` → `oya-observability-rum-application` (privacy-settings projected to RUM-PII policy).
  - `datadog.rum_session` → `oya-observability-rum-session`.
  - `datadog.synthetic_test` → `oya-observability-synthetic-test`.
  - `datadog.profile` → `oya-observability-profile`.
  - `datadog.monitor` → `oya-workflow-engine-event-rule` + `oya-observability-monitor-spec` (type-specific config preserved).
  - `datadog.slo` → `oya-observability-slo` (window + target preserved; OpenSLO-compatible per ADR-0130).
  - `datadog.incident` → `oya-incident-management-incident`.
  - `datadog.security_rule` → `oya-siem-detection-rule` (MITRE-ATT&CK tags preserved).
  - `datadog.signal` → `oya-siem-signal` + `oya-secops-investigation` reference.
  - `datadog.workflow` → `oya-workflow-engine-workflow` (connector-chain preserved).
  - `datadog.observability_pipeline` → `oya-data-pipeline-stream` (OPW topology → OTel-Collector + Vector compatible).
  - `datadog.notebook` → `oya-observability-notebook`.
  - `datadog.dashboard` → `oya-observability-dashboard`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (22 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `siem` + `secops` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` µservices with Datadog-feature-parity matrix (Hosts + Containers + Services + Metrics + Logs + Log-Pipelines + Log-Indexes + Log-Archives + Traces + RUM + Synthetic + Profiler + Incidents + Monitors + SLOs + Notebooks + Dashboards + Security-Rules + Signals + Workflows + CSM + CWS + ASM + Sensitive-Data-Scanner + Service-Catalog + Watchdog + Bits-AI + OPW).
  2. Export Datadog account via REST API v1/v2: hosts + services + metric-definitions + log-pipelines + log-indexes + log-archives + monitors + SLOs + dashboards + notebooks + synthetic-tests + RUM-apps + security-rules + workflows + service-catalog + audit + roles + API-keys + app-keys + OPW-pipelines + CSM-policies + CWS-policies + ASM-policies + Sensitive-Data-Scanner-rules.
  3. Per-Host + Container: re-tag with Oyatie tag-namespace; deploy Oyatie observability-agent (Datadog-Agent protocol-compatible); dual-route during cutover.
  4. Per-Service: import to Oyatie service-catalog; preserve owners + dependencies + SLOs.
  5. Per-Metric: re-submit via OTLP intake or DogStatsD-compatible shim; preserve metric-type + unit + retention-tier.
  6. Per-Log-Pipeline: transpile processor-chain to Oyatie data-pipeline transform; per-processor golden-test.
  7. Per-Log-Index: re-create in Oyatie observability log-index; preserve filter + exclusion-filters + retention + daily-quota + storage-tier.
  8. Per-Log-Archive: re-bind to Oyatie tenant archive target with CMEK preserved; rehydration-policy preserved.
  9. Per-Trace: re-bind APM ingest to Oyatie OTLP endpoint; sampling-decision normalized to OpenTelemetry sampler.
  10. Per-RUM-App: re-bind client-token to Oyatie RUM intake; preserve privacy-settings + session-replay-rate.
  11. Per-Synthetic-Test: import test-spec + locations + assertions; preserve frequency + alert-configuration.
  12. Per-Profiler: re-bind profiler-agent endpoint; preserve service+environment+process-type.
  13. Per-Monitor: transpile query + thresholds + notification-message to Oyatie workflow-engine event-rule; per-monitor shadow-evaluation on 30-day sample.
  14. Per-SLO: import metric/monitor refs + time-window + target; preserve OpenSLO compatibility per ADR-0130.
  15. Per-Incident: import last 90 days incidents + timeline + responders + postmortem.
  16. Per-Notebook + Dashboard: import widget-spec + template-variables; per-artifact rendering-fidelity test.
  17. Per-Security-Rule + Signal: import to Oyatie siem; preserve MITRE-ATT&CK tags + cases + severity.
  18. Per-Workflow: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine; per-step connector-binding to Oyatie native action with credential-rotation.
  19. Per-CSM + CWS + ASM policy: re-bind to Oyatie secops; per-policy golden-evaluation on representative resources.
  20. Per-Sensitive-Data-Scanner-rule: re-bind to Oyatie data-pipeline + observability scanner with per-rule mask/redact configuration.
  21. Per-OPW pipeline: re-deploy as Oyatie data-pipeline stream (OTel-Collector + Vector-based); source-transform-sink topology preserved.
  22. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-tenant cutover via tag-routed switch; Datadog subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (20 specific failures):
  - Tag-cardinality explosion (custom-metric tag-blowup → cost spike): per-metric cardinality cap + tag-allowlist + cost-alarm; per-tenant budget guard.
  - Log-pipeline processor-chain ordering drift (downstream remap depends on earlier remap): per-pipeline ordered-replay test on golden samples.
  - Log-index retention misalignment (PHI/PCI logs into wrong-retention index): per-index pack-rule enforcement + Sensitive-Data-Scanner cross-check.
  - Log-archive CMEK rotation lockout: per-archive key-version pin + dual-key-rotation window.
  - Trace sampling-rate drift (head-vs-tail sampler conflict): per-service sampling policy + observability budget.
  - RUM session-replay PII leak: per-app default-mask + Sensitive-Data-Scanner cross-check + Cedar guard on replay-view.
  - Synthetic test against production endpoint causes paging storm: per-test alert-suppression-on-known-maintenance + dry-run before activation.
  - Monitor renotify-interval mis-tune (alert storm): per-monitor renotify policy + first-72h shadow.
  - SLO time-window misalignment (rolling vs calendar): per-SLO window-type validation + back-fill on import.
  - Incident-Auto-Action runs destructive workflow on false-positive monitor: per-action approval-gate + Cedar dual-control guard.
  - Security-rule false-positive on Cloud SIEM (signal storm): per-rule precision-floor + auto-tune sandbox + reviewer-required-to-promote.
  - Workflow connector credential leak (cleartext in workflow-spec): per-workflow vault-binding + Cedar guard on credential-read.
  - CSM policy mis-fire on cloud-resource (compliance score drops on false positive): per-policy precision audit + exception-mechanism.
  - CWS blocking-mode kills production workload (eBPF rule too aggressive): per-policy staged rollout (audit → alert → block) + first-72h shadow.
  - ASM blocking-mode blocks legitimate user (false-positive WAF rule): per-policy precision + manual-review-queue.
  - Sensitive-Data-Scanner pattern mis-detect (false-positive on legitimate ID): per-pattern precision + exception-list + audit on detection.
  - Watchdog auto-anomaly false-positive (alert noise): per-service confidence floor + reviewer-feedback loop.
  - Bits AI hallucinated investigation summary: per-summary source-evidence-required + confidence threshold + human-in-loop for production action.
  - OPW pipeline mis-route (logs sent to wrong sink): per-pipeline routing-rule golden-test + first-72h shadow.
  - API-key over-permissive scope (single key for prod+stage): per-key narrow-scope enforcement + rotation policy.

- **Migration playbook outline** (12 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Datadog REST API v1/v2 + CLI + Datadog-CI: full account export (services + metrics + logs + traces + RUM + synthetic + monitors + SLOs + dashboards + notebooks + incidents + security-rules + signals + workflows + service-catalog + audit + keys + OPW-pipelines + CSM/CWS/ASM/SDS policies).
  2. Deploy Oyatie observability-agent on hosts + containers; dual-route metrics + logs + traces.
  3. Migrate log-pipelines + log-indexes + log-archives with CMEK preserved; golden-test on 30-day sample.
  4. Re-bind APM + RUM + Synthetic + Profiler to Oyatie OTLP endpoint; per-service trace + RUM fidelity test.
  5. Migrate monitors + SLOs + dashboards + notebooks + incidents + service-catalog.
  6. Migrate Cloud SIEM rules + signals + investigations.
  7. Migrate CSM + CWS + ASM + Sensitive-Data-Scanner policies with staged rollout (audit → alert → block).
  8. Migrate workflows with connector-credential rotation to OpenBao.
  9. Re-deploy OPW pipelines as Oyatie data-pipeline streams.
  10. Re-bind Watchdog + Bits AI to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act conformance ledger.
  11. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-tenant cutover via tag-routed switch.
  12. Datadog subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `siem` + `secops` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `data-pipeline` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `datadog` is benchmark alias-only; no new µservice names introduced per `feedback_naming_justification`. OTLP + OpenTelemetry + OpenSLO are inherited substrate standards (ADR-0130 + ADR-0316).

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-088 - New Relic
- Vendor name and category: New Relic Inc. — New Relic One platform + APM 360 + Infrastructure + Logs + Distributed Tracing + Browser Monitoring + Mobile Monitoring + Synthetics + Errors Inbox + Kubernetes Cluster Explorer + Network Performance Monitoring + Pixie (eBPF-based auto-instrumentation) + CodeStream (IDE telemetry) + Lookout (AI-driven anomaly detection) + Grok (NL-to-NRQL assistant) + New Relic AI + Service Maps + Service Levels (SLM) + Workloads + Change Tracking + Vulnerability Management + Database Monitoring + Model Performance Monitoring (MLOps) + AWS / Azure / GCP integrations + Quickstarts marketplace.
- Coverage tier: A (capability anchor on `observability` (APM + Infra + Logs + Traces + Browser + Mobile + Synthetic + Errors + Profiler + DBM + NPM) + `intelligence` (Lookout + Grok + New Relic AI + Model Performance Monitoring) + `secops` (Vulnerability Management) + `workflow-engine` (Workflows + Destinations + Alerts) + `developer-sdk` (NerdGraph GraphQL API + REST API + SDKs) + `data-pipeline` (Infinite-Tracing + Pipeline-Cloud-Streaming-Service) + `apigw` (License-Key + Insert-Key + User-API-Key) + `compliance` (audit + per-region data-residency US/EU/FedRAMP)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free tier (100GB ingest) → **Bronze**; Standard (full ingest + APM + Infra + Browser + Mobile + Synthetic + Logs) → **Silver**; Pro (full stack + Errors Inbox + Service Levels + Pixie + Kubernetes Cluster Explorer + CodeStream + Lookout + Grok + Change Tracking + Workloads) → **Gold**; Enterprise (full + Vulnerability Management + Model Performance Monitoring + Customer-Managed-Keys + EU-data-residency + FedRAMP-Moderate + HIPAA + dedicated VPC + cross-account export) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `observability` (NRDB-equivalent unified telemetry-store + APM + Infra + Logs + Traces + Browser + Mobile + Synthetic + Errors + Profiler + DBM + NPM + K8s-Cluster-Explorer); `intelligence` (Lookout-anomaly + Grok-NL-to-NRQL + Model Performance Monitoring — BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); `secops` (Vulnerability Management); `workflow-engine` (Workflows + Destinations + Alert-Conditions + Issue-Auto-Action); `developer-sdk` (NerdGraph GraphQL + REST v2 superset); `data-pipeline` (Infinite-Tracing-compatible tail-sampling + Pipeline-Cloud-Streaming-Service); `apigw` (License-Key + Insert-Key + User-API-Key); `compliance` (audit + per-region residency US/EU/Govt).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (New Relic platform model):
  - `Account` (Account_ID, Region {US / EU / Govt}, Plan {Free / Standard / Pro / Enterprise}, Parent-Account_ID, Master-Account_ID, License-Key, Insert-Key).
  - `Entity` (Entity_GUID, Type {APPLICATION / HOST / CONTAINER / SERVICE / DATABASE / WORKLOAD / SYNTHETIC-MONITOR / BROWSER-APPLICATION / MOBILE-APPLICATION / KUBERNETES-* / AWS-* / DASHBOARD / etc.}, Domain {APM / INFRA / BROWSER / MOBILE / SYNTH / VIZ / EXT}, Account_ID, Tags[{key:value}], Reporting, Alert-Severity, Last-Reporting-Change).
  - `Event` (event_type, timestamp, attributes {key-value}, account_id, entityGuid).
  - `Metric` (metric_name, type {count / gauge / summary / cumulativeCount / distribution}, attributes, timestamp, value, account_id).
  - `Log` (Log_ID, message, timestamp, attributes {parsed JSON}, entity-guid, account_id, hostname, level, trace.id-link).
  - `Span` (span.id, trace.id, parent.id, name, service.name, duration.ms, attributes, timestamp).
  - `Workload` (Workload_GUID, Name, Entity-Filter (NRQL or entity-search), Entities[Entity_GUID], Status-Config, Permalink).
  - `Dashboard` (Dashboard_GUID, Name, Pages[Page_ID → Widgets[Widget_ID → {Visualization, NRQL_Query, Configuration}]], Permissions).
  - `NRQL_Query` (`SELECT ... FROM <event_type> WHERE <filter> FACET <facet> SINCE <duration> TIMESERIES <interval>`).
  - `Alert_Policy` (Policy_ID, Name, Incident-Preference {per-condition / per-condition-and-target / per-policy}, Conditions[Condition_ID]).
  - `Alert_Condition` (Condition_ID, Type {NRQL / APM-Metric / Infrastructure-Metric / Synthetic / Browser-Metric / Mobile-Metric / Anomaly}, Query, Threshold {value, occurrences, time-function}, Critical-Threshold, Warning-Threshold, Aggregation-Window, Slide-By).
  - `Issue` (Issue_ID, Title, Priority, State {created / activated / acknowledged / closed}, Sources[], Created-At, Closed-At, Workflows[], Mute-State).
  - `Workflow` (Workflow_ID, Name, Issues-Filter (predicates), Destinations[], Notification-Triggers[], Enabled, Mute-Rules[]).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - NerdGraph GraphQL API (`https://api.<region>.newrelic.com/graphql`): unified API for account + entity + nrql + alerts + dashboards + workflows + workloads + cloud-integration + log-pipelines + synthetics + SLM + errors-inbox + vulnerability + change-tracking; auth via User-API-Key.
  - REST API v2 (legacy, still active for alerts + applications + servers + key-transactions + deployments + labels).
  - Insights Event API (`https://insights-collector.<region>.newrelic.com/v1/accounts/<accountId>/events`): per-event custom-attribute ingest via Insert-Key.
  - Metric API (`/metric/v1`): per-metric custom-metric ingest.
  - Log API (`https://log-api.<region>.newrelic.com/log/v1`): per-log ingest with License-Key.
  - Trace API (`/trace/v1`): OTLP-HTTP + Zipkin + Jaeger compatible.
  - Synthetics API: per-monitor + per-script CRUD; on-demand-run; results.
  - NerdGraph SDKs: JavaScript, Python, Java, Ruby, Go, .NET community.
  - APM Agents: Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, C SDK; auto-instrumentation + manual API.
  - Infrastructure Agent: per-host telemetry + log forwarder; OHI plugins (On-Host-Integrations) for MySQL/PostgreSQL/Redis/Kafka/etc.
  - Pixie (eBPF agent): in-cluster auto-instrumentation with Pxl-Lang scripts.
  - CLI: `newrelic-cli` for entity + dashboard + alerts + nrql + workflow management.

  ```
    (resource.kind != "mobile_crash_pii_unmasked" || principal.role == "mobile_pii_authorized")
  };
  ```

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (20 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `intelligence` + `secops` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` µservices with New-Relic-feature-parity matrix (Entities + Events + Metrics + Logs + Spans + Workloads + Dashboards + NRQL + Alert-Policy + Alert-Condition + Issues + Workflows + Destinations + Synthetics + Errors-Inbox + SLM + Change-Tracking + Vulnerability + Browser + Mobile + Pixie + Grok + Lookout + CodeStream).
  2. Export New Relic account via NerdGraph: entities + events + metrics + logs + spans + workloads + dashboards + alert-policies + alert-conditions + workflows + destinations + synthetics-monitors + errors-inbox + SLMs + change-events + vulnerability-findings + browser-apps + mobile-apps + accounts + roles + API-keys + audit-records.
  3. Deploy Oyatie observability-agent on hosts + containers; dual-route metrics + logs + traces from APM agents (Java/.NET/Node/Python/Ruby/PHP/Go/C SDK protocol-compatible).
  4. Per-Entity: re-tag with Oyatie tag-namespace; preserve entity-GUID-stable mapping.
  5. Per-Event-Type: register custom-event schema in Oyatie observability event-stream; preserve attribute schema.
  6. Per-Metric: re-submit via OTLP intake or NRMetric-API-compatible shim; preserve type + unit.
  7. Per-Log: re-bind log-API endpoint to Oyatie log-ingest; preserve parsing-rule configuration.
  8. Per-Span: re-bind trace ingest to Oyatie OTLP endpoint with W3C-traceparent.
  9. Per-Workload + Dashboard: import widget-spec + NRQL queries; transpile NRQL → Oyatie observability-query DSL; per-artifact rendering-fidelity test.
  10. Per-NRQL-Query: per-query semantic-fidelity test on 30-day output diff.
  11. Per-Alert-Policy + Alert-Condition: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine event-rule; per-condition shadow-evaluation on 30-day sample.
  12. Per-Issue: import last 90 days of issues + state + workflow-bindings + mute-state.
  13. Per-Workflow + Destination: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine; per-destination credential rotation to OpenBao.
  14. Per-Synthetic-Monitor: import test-spec + locations + period; per-monitor first-run validation.
  15. Per-Errors-Inbox-Group: import fingerprint + occurrence-history + assignee + state.
  16. Per-SLM: import SLI + objectives + window; OpenSLO-compat preserved.
  17. Per-Change-Event: import last 90 days deployments + feature-flag + config events.
  18. Per-Vulnerability-Finding: import CVE + severity + status + assignee; re-bind to Oyatie secops.
  19. Per-Browser-App + Mobile-App: re-bind loader/token to Oyatie RUM/Mobile-RUM intake; preserve privacy-settings.
  20. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-tenant cutover via NRDB→Oyatie router; New Relic subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (18 specific failures):
  - NRQL → Oyatie-observability-DSL semantic gap (e.g., `FACET ... LIMIT MAX`, `TIMESERIES AUTO`, `nrql-extended-funnel`): per-query semantic-fidelity test + flagged-feature register.
  - Entity-GUID instability on re-tag (entity-graph orphans): per-entity GUID-pin + dual-publish during cutover.
  - APM-agent protocol-shim version skew (e.g., Java agent 7 vs 8): per-language-runtime compat-test matrix.
  - Pixie Pxl-Lang script not portable to Oyatie eBPF runtime: per-script re-implementation in Oyatie eBPF DSL or community-tools shim.
  - Errors-Inbox fingerprint drift on stack-trace normalization: per-group fingerprint-pin + auto-merge on hash-collision.
  - SLM burn-rate alert-condition misalignment (rolling vs calendar): per-SLM window-type validation.
  - Change-Tracking auto-ingest rate-limit (deployment storm): per-source quota + de-dup window.
  - Vulnerability-Finding component-attribution drift (CVE-component renamed in NVD): per-finding NVD-version-pin + auto-migration.
  - Browser-app loader-type mis-match (lite vs pro vs spa): per-app loader-config preserved + per-page-view fidelity test.
  - Mobile-app crash-symbolication map missing (post-cutover crashes unsymbolicated): per-app dSYM/Proguard map dual-upload during cutover.
  - Synthetic scripted-browser step-timing drift (location latency variance): per-monitor location-baseline + drift-alarm.
  - Workflow destination credential leak (cleartext in destination-config): per-destination vault-binding + Cedar guard.
  - Grok hallucinated NRQL (suggests query that doesn't exist): per-suggestion source-evidence-required + dry-run-first.
  - Lookout false-positive anomaly (alert noise): per-entity confidence-floor + reviewer feedback.
  - Insert-key over-permissive scope (single key for all event-types): per-key narrow scope + rotation.
  - Multi-account / sub-account migration: per-sub-account import lane + cross-account entity-deduplication.
  - Log pipeline parsing-rule drift (parsing breaks on log-format change): per-rule version-pin + auto-detect-and-warn.
  - Distributed-tracing W3C-traceparent injection gap (services not propagating): per-service propagation-audit + fail-closed on missing.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via NerdGraph + REST + CLI: full account export (entities + events + metrics + logs + traces + workloads + dashboards + alerts + workflows + synthetics + errors-inbox + SLMs + change-events + vulnerabilities + browser + mobile + accounts + keys + audit).
  2. Deploy Oyatie observability-agents on hosts/containers/apps; dual-route APM + logs + traces.
  3. Migrate entities + workloads + dashboards + NRQL queries; per-artifact semantic-fidelity test.
  4. Migrate alert-policies + alert-conditions + issues + workflows + destinations with credential rotation.
  5. Migrate synthetics + errors-inbox + SLMs + change-tracking + vulnerability-findings.
  6. Re-bind browser-app + mobile-app loader/token to Oyatie RUM/Mobile-RUM intake; preserve privacy-settings.
  7. Re-bind Pixie/eBPF scripts (or re-implement on Oyatie eBPF runtime).
  8. Re-bind Grok + Lookout + Model Performance Monitoring to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger.
  9. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-tenant cutover via NRDB→Oyatie router.
  10. New Relic subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `intelligence` + `secops` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `newrelic` is benchmark alias-only; no new µservice names introduced per `feedback_naming_justification`.

  ```
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatracePurePathQuery", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceLogQuery",

      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceProblemAcknowledge", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceEventIngest",
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceSyntheticMonitorRun", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceSyntheticMonitorConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceSessionReplayView", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceSLOConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceAnomalyDetectorConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceAlertingProfileEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceManagementZoneConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceAutomationWorkflowExecute",
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceAutomationWorkflowApprove", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceCloudAutomationExecute",
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceVulnerabilityAccept", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceRASPConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceRASPBlockingMode", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceThreatTriage",
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceOneAgentDeploy", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceOpenPipelineConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceAppEngineDeploy", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceDavisCoPilotInvoke",
      Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceTokenRotate", Oyatie::Action::"DynatraceAuditExport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::DynatraceService::"<service-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DynatraceProblem::"<problem-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DynatraceSLO::"<slo-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DynatraceWorkflow::"<workflow-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DynatraceManagementZone::"<zone-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DynatraceVulnerabilityFinding::"<finding-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DynatraceOpenPipeline::"<pipeline-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DynatraceAppEngineApp::"<app-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "dql_query_pii_unmasked" || principal.role in ["security_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "log_ingest_high_volume" || context.volume_quota_remaining > 0) &&
    (resource.kind != "session_replay_unmasked" || principal.role == "rum_pii_authorized") &&
    (resource.kind != "automation_workflow_execute_destructive" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "rasp_blocking_mode" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "vulnerability_accept_risk" || principal.role == "security_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "davis_copilot_invoke" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "appengine_deploy" || principal.role in ["platform_engineer", "appengine_developer"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "token_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_export" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "openpipeline_configure_mask_rule" || principal.role in ["data_engineer", "compliance_admin"])
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-Dynatrace (BAA + HIPAA-eligible tenant + per-app PII-mask + 7-yr Grail retention); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region tenant residency US/EU/Govt + DSAR via DQL-export + right-to-erasure via Grail retention-policy); FedRAMP-Mod (Dynatrace Federal); SOC-2 (audit + access-review); PCI-DSS (PAN-masking via OpenPipeline at ingest); EU-AI-Act (Davis-AI + Davis-CoPilot conformance ledger + human-in-loop for production action).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):

  - `dynatrace.smartscape_topology_node` → `oya-observability-topology-node` + `oya-observability-topology-edge`.

  - `dynatrace.problem` → `oya-incident-management-problem` (Davis-confidence preserved as `oya-intelligence-causation-confidence`).
  - `dynatrace.event` → `oya-observability-event`.
  - `dynatrace.metric` → `oya-observability-metric`.
  - `dynatrace.log_record` → `oya-observability-log-event`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (18 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `intelligence` + `secops` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` µservices with Dynatrace-feature-parity matrix (Smartscape + PurePath + DEM + Logs + Infra + K8s + Grail + Davis + Davis-CoPilot + AppSec + Vulnerability + Threat + AutomationEngine + Cloud Automation + AppEngine + Notebooks + Dashboards + SLO + Synthetic + Session-Replay).
  2. Export Dynatrace tenant via API v2 + DQL: hosts + process-groups + services + applications + databases + smartscape-topology + purepaths + problems + events + metrics + logs + synthetic-monitors + session-replays + user-sessions + SLOs + anomaly-detectors + alerting-profiles + management-zones + automation-workflows + vulnerability-findings + threat-findings + openpipelines + appengine-apps + audit-stream.
  3. Deploy Oyatie observability-agent (OneAgent protocol-compatible) on hosts + processes + containers; dual-route telemetry during cutover.
  4. Per-Host + Process-Group + Service + Application + Database: re-tag with Oyatie tag-namespace; preserve entity-ID stable mapping.
  5. Per-Smartscape topology: import node + edge graph; per-relationship Cypher-style golden-test.
  6. Per-PurePath: re-bind APM ingest to Oyatie OTLP endpoint; code-level visibility preserved via Oyatie code-location annotation.
  7. Per-Problem: import last 90 days of problems + Davis attribution + affected-entities + impact-level.
  8. Per-Metric + Log + Event: re-bind ingest endpoints to Oyatie; dual-route 30 days.
  9. Per-Synthetic-Monitor: import test-spec + locations + step-definitions; preserve thresholds; per-monitor first-run validation.
  10. Per-Session-Replay-Recording: import last 30 days of recordings; preserve privacy-mask-mode.
  11. Per-SLO: import target + window + evaluation method; OpenSLO-compat preserved.
  12. Per-Davis-Anomaly-Detector: import configuration + sensitivity; per-detector shadow-evaluation on 30-day sample.
  13. Per-Alerting-Profile + Management-Zone: import severity-rules + propagation; preserve IAM scope-partitioning.
  14. Per-AutomationEngine-Workflow: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine; per-task credential-rotation to OpenBao; approval-gates elevated to Cedar guard.
  15. Per-Vulnerability + Threat Finding: import to Oyatie secops; preserve Davis-risk-score + MITRE-ATT&CK linkage.
  16. Per-OpenPipeline: re-deploy as Oyatie data-pipeline stream with source-transform-sink topology preserved.
  17. Per-AppEngine app: re-deploy as Oyatie developer-sdk extension-app; preserve Functions runtime contract.
  18. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-tenant cutover via tag-routed switch; Dynatrace subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (17 specific failures):
  - OneAgent auto-instrumentation byte-code-injection collision with another agent: per-process-group runtime test + agent-compat matrix + opt-out flag.
  - Smartscape topology drift on rename (entity-ID not stable): per-entity GUID-pin + dual-publish during cutover.
  - PurePath code-level visibility loss (Oyatie ingest doesn't capture line numbers): per-language agent code-location adapter + per-runtime test.
  - DQL → Oyatie-observability-DSL semantic gap (high-cardinality multi-record-type joins): per-query semantic-fidelity test + flagged-feature register.
  - Davis-AI causation drift (root-cause attribution diverges post-migration): per-problem RCA-diff + reviewer feedback loop.
  - Session-replay DOM-mask drift (PII unmasked in Oyatie replay): per-app mask-policy validation + Sensitive-Data-Scanner cross-check.
  - Synthetic clickpath step-timing drift (browser version variance): per-monitor browser-pin + step-baseline + drift-alarm.
  - SLO event-based evaluation gap (event-source rate-limit during cutover): per-SLO dual-evaluation window.
  - AutomationEngine workflow credential leak (cleartext in workflow-spec): per-workflow vault-binding.
  - Cloud Automation Keptn-derived pipeline incompatible with Oyatie automation: per-pipeline re-implementation or Keptn-compat shim.
  - Vulnerability Analytics CVE-component drift on NVD rename: per-finding NVD-version-pin + auto-migration.
  - RASP blocking-mode kills production (false-positive RASP rule): per-policy staged rollout (audit → alert → block).
  - Threat Analytics false-positive (attack-vector mis-classified): per-threat precision-floor + reviewer-required-to-promote.
  - OpenPipeline mask-rule mis-fire (real data masked): per-rule precision + dry-run + audit.
  - AppEngine app dependency on Dynatrace-specific resource (DT-only API): per-app re-implementation or compat-shim.
  - Davis-CoPilot hallucinated remediation (suggests action that breaks production): per-suggestion source-evidence + human-in-loop + dry-run-first.
  - Multi-environment / multi-tenant migration: per-environment lane + cross-tenant entity-deduplication.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Dynatrace API v2 + DQL + monaco: full tenant export.
  2. Deploy Oyatie observability-agents (OneAgent-compatible); dual-route telemetry.
  3. Migrate Smartscape topology + entity catalog with GUID-pin.
  4. Migrate PurePath + metrics + logs + events + problems (last 90d).
  5. Migrate synthetic-monitors + session-replays + user-sessions + SLOs.
  6. Migrate anomaly-detectors + alerting-profiles + management-zones.
  7. Migrate AutomationEngine workflows + Cloud Automation pipelines with credential rotation.
  8. Migrate Vulnerability + Threat findings + RASP policies with staged rollout.
  9. Re-deploy OpenPipelines + AppEngine apps on Oyatie equivalents.
  10. Re-bind Davis-AI + Davis-CoPilot to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4) + EU-AI-Act ledger; parallel-run 30 days; Dynatrace subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `intelligence` + `secops` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `dynatrace` is benchmark alias-only; DQL is preserved only as a transpilation-source DSL.

- Vendor name and category: Elastic NV — Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch + Logstash + Kibana + Beats + Elastic Agent + Fleet) + Elastic Observability (Logs + Metrics + APM + Synthetics + Profiling + Uptime + User Experience / RUM + Universal Profiling) + Elastic Security (SIEM + Endpoint + Cloud Security Posture + Cloud Workload Protection + Cases) + Elastic Search (Enterprise Search + App Search + Workplace Search + Connectors framework + ES|QL) + Elastic ML (Anomaly Detection + Data Frame Analytics + Inference / Trained Models + ELSER / E5 semantic search) + Elasticsearch Relevance Engine + Vector Search + Kibana Lens + Kibana Canvas + Kibana Dashboards + Kibana Maps + Watchers (alerting v1) + Kibana Alerting (v2) + Elasticsearch SQL + KQL + Cross-Cluster Search/Replication + Searchable Snapshots + Frozen Tier + AI Assistant (formerly ESRE/AI-Assistant-for-Observability/Security).
