  - `elastic.index_template` + `component_template` → `oya-observability-index-template`.
  - `elastic.ilm_policy` → `oya-observability-retention-policy`.
  - `elastic.document` → polymorphic per index-type: `oya-observability-log-event` / `oya-observability-metric-point` / `oya-observability-trace-span` / `oya-siem-event` / `oya-secops-finding`.
  - `elastic.ingest_pipeline` → `oya-data-pipeline-transform`.
  - `elastic.logstash_pipeline` → `oya-data-pipeline-stream` (Logstash-stanza transpiled to canonical source-transform-sink).
  - `elastic.elastic_agent_policy` → `oya-data-pipeline-agent-policy`.
  - `elastic.fleet_server` → `oya-data-pipeline-fleet-control-plane`.
  - `elastic.integration_package` → `oya-developer-sdk-extension-package`.
  - `elastic.kibana_saved_object` → polymorphic per type: `oya-observability-dashboard` / `oya-observability-visualization` / `oya-observability-search` / `oya-workflow-engine-event-rule` / `oya-secops-case`.
  - `elastic.apm_service` → `oya-observability-apm-service`.
  - `elastic.siem_rule` → `oya-siem-detection-rule` (MITRE-Threat-Mappings preserved).
  - `elastic.siem_detection_alert` → `oya-siem-signal`.
  - `elastic.endpoint_policy` → `oya-secops-endpoint-policy`.
  - `elastic.case` → `oya-secops-case`.
  - `elastic.ml_job` + `data_frame_analytics_job` + `trained_model` + `inference_endpoint` → `oya-intelligence-ml-job` / `oya-intelligence-trained-model` / `oya-intelligence-inference-endpoint`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (18 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `siem` + `secops` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` + `community` µservices with Elastic-feature-parity matrix.
  2. Export Elastic cluster via REST API + snapshot: indices + datastreams + templates + ILM-policies + ingest-pipelines + Logstash-pipelines + Elastic-Agent-policies + Fleet-servers + integration-packages + Kibana-saved-objects + APM-services + SIEM-rules + detection-alerts + endpoint-policies + cases + ML-jobs + DF-analytics + trained-models + inference-endpoints + audit-stream.
  3. Re-create indices with Oyatie index-templates (ECS-compat + OTel-semantic-convention) and ILM-policy tiered-storage.
  4. Deploy Oyatie data-pipeline agents (Elastic-Agent + Beats protocol-compat); dual-route via Fleet-equivalent control plane.
  5. Re-deploy Logstash pipelines or transpile to Oyatie data-pipeline stream DSL.
  6. Re-deploy ingest-pipelines as Oyatie data-pipeline transforms.
  7. Migrate Kibana saved-objects (dashboards + Lens + Canvas + Maps + searches + visualizations) to Oyatie observability UI; per-object rendering fidelity test.
  8. Migrate APM services + RUM apps + synthetic monitors + universal-profiling targets.
  9. Migrate SIEM rules + detection-alerts + cases; preserve MITRE-Threat-Mappings.
  10. Migrate endpoint-policies + CSPM + CWP rules with staged rollout (audit → alert → block).
  11. Migrate ML jobs + DF-analytics jobs + trained-models + inference-endpoints; re-bind to Oyatie `intelligence`.
  12. Migrate alerting v2 rules + connectors with credential rotation to OpenBao.
  13. Re-bind cross-cluster-search + cross-cluster-replication to Oyatie multi-cluster topology.
  14. Re-take searchable-snapshots in Oyatie tenant searchable-snapshot repository with CMEK preserved.
  15. Re-bind Workplace Search / Enterprise Search content to Oyatie `community` content collaboration adjacency.
  16. Re-bind AI Assistant to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act conformance ledger.
  17. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query.
  18. Per-tenant cutover via Fleet-router; Elastic Cloud subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (16 specific failures):
  - Mapping explosion (>1000 fields per index due to dynamic-mapping): per-index field-cap + strict-mode-on-PHI/PCI indexes.
  - ILM rollover during cutover (data lost on hot→warm phase transition): per-policy version-pin + dual-write 30 days.
  - Searchable-snapshot CMEK rotation lockout: per-snapshot key-version pin + dual-key window.
  - ES|QL → Oyatie observability DSL semantic gap (e.g., `LOOKUP`, `JOIN`, `SUM_OVER_TIME`): per-query semantic-fidelity test + flagged-feature register.
  - Ingest-pipeline grok-pattern drift (parse breaks on log-format change): per-pipeline version-pin + golden-test.
  - Logstash plugin ecosystem incompatibility (custom Ruby filter plugin): per-plugin re-implementation in Oyatie data-pipeline DSL.
  - Elastic-Agent integration-package version skew (package upgrade breaks ingest): per-package version-pin + canary rollout.
  - Kibana saved-object reference broken on import (index-pattern → datastream rename): per-object reference-rewrite + dry-run.
  - APM-agent OTel-vs-Elastic-mode collision: per-language agent mode-config + runtime test.
  - SIEM rule type ML-or-EQL not directly portable: per-rule re-implementation in Oyatie SIEM rule-engine.
  - Endpoint EDR host-isolation API broken on cutover: per-host isolation-fallback + dual-control gate.
  - Cases external-service-sync drift (Jira/ServiceNow link orphaned): per-case sync-rewrite on import.
  - ML inference-endpoint external-LLM credential leak: per-endpoint vault-binding + Cedar guard.
  - Cross-cluster-search latency spike (network topology change): per-cluster latency-SLO + circuit-breaker.
  - ESRE/Elasticsearch-Relevance-Engine semantic-search model migration (ELSER → Oyatie inference): per-model output-diff + reviewer.
  - Multi-tenant deployment via Spaces collision (cross-Space data access): per-Space scope Cedar guard + audit on cross-Space query.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Elasticsearch REST + Kibana export: full cluster manifest.
  2. Provision Oyatie cluster + index-templates + ILM-policies.
  3. Re-deploy ingest-pipelines + Logstash-pipelines + Elastic-Agents (Beats-protocol).
  4. Migrate documents via snapshot + restore + `_reindex` from remote.
  5. Migrate Kibana saved-objects with reference-rewrite.
  6. Migrate APM + RUM + synthetic + universal-profiling.
  7. Migrate SIEM + Endpoint + cases + CSPM + CWP rules with staged rollout.
  8. Migrate ML jobs + trained-models + inference-endpoints to Oyatie intelligence; BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4.
  9. Migrate alerting v2 + connectors with credential rotation.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest; per-tenant cutover via Fleet-router; Elastic sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `siem` + `secops` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` + `community` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `elastic` and `elasticsearch` are benchmark alias-only; ES|QL/KQL/ES-SQL preserved only as transpilation-source DSLs.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-091 - Honeycomb
- Vendor name and category: Honeycomb.io — Honeycomb Observability for Distributed Systems + Refinery (tail-based sampling proxy) + BubbleUp (statistical outlier finder) + Honeycomb Triggers + Service Level Objectives (SLOs) + Honeycomb Boards + Honeycomb Queries (with full-fidelity wide-event query engine) + Honeycomb Markers + Honeycomb Datasets + Honeycomb Environments + Honeycomb Classifier (anomaly classification) + Honeycomb Query Assistant (NL-to-query LLM) + Honeycomb for Frontend (RUM) + OpenTelemetry-native ingest (Honeycomb is OTel-first, contrarian to vendor-proprietary protocols).
- Coverage tier: B (capability fit on `observability` (wide-event + distributed-tracing anchor + RUM + SLO + tail-sampling) + `intelligence` (BubbleUp statistical-outlier + Classifier + Query-Assistant — BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4) + `workflow-engine` (Triggers + SLO Burn-Rate-Alert) + `developer-sdk` (Honeycomb API + OpenTelemetry-OTLP + Beelines libraries) + `data-pipeline` (Refinery tail-sampling proxy) + `apigw` (write-keys + API tokens) + `compliance` (audit + per-region residency)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free / Pro (basic wide-event + queries) → **Bronze**; Pro + BubbleUp + Triggers → **Silver**; Pro + SLOs + Boards + Refinery + Markers + Classifier → **Gold**; Enterprise (full + Query-Assistant + SSO/SAML + dedicated-region + EU-residency + multi-environment + audit-stream + CMEK) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `observability` (wide-event + trace anchor); `intelligence` (BubbleUp + Classifier + Query Assistant); `workflow-engine` (Triggers + SLO Burn-Rate); `developer-sdk` (OTLP-native + Beelines-compat); `data-pipeline` (Refinery-compat tail-sampling); `apigw` (write-key + API token); `compliance` (audit + EU/US/Govt residency).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Honeycomb model):
  - `Team` (Team_ID, Slug, Plan, Owner, Region {US / EU / Govt}, SSO_Provider, Allowed_Domains[]).
  - `Environment` (Environment_ID, Name, API-Keys[{Key_ID + Scope}], Classic-vs-E&S-Mode {Classic / Environments-and-Services}).
  - `Dataset` (Dataset_ID, Name, Slug, Last-Written-At, Column_Count, Schema_Inferred_Fields[Field_Name → {Type {string / int / float / bool / json}, Description, Hidden, Last-Seen}], Settings {description, default-time-range}).
  - `Event` (Wide event JSON: arbitrary key-value with `timestamp` + `duration_ms` + `trace.trace_id` + `trace.span_id` + `trace.parent_id` + `name` + service-name + service-version + custom-attributes; full-fidelity column-store, no pre-aggregation).
  - `Trace` (Trace_ID, Spans[Span_ID → {trace.parent_id, name, duration_ms, service.name, custom-attrs[]}], Root-Span, Trace-Duration, Span-Count).
  - `Query` (Query_ID, Dataset-Reference, Calculations[Op + Field], Filters[{Op, Field, Value}], Breakdowns[Field], Time-Range {start, end, granularity}, Orders[Field + Direction], Limit, Having[]).
  - `Query_Result_Cache` (Cache_ID, Query_Reference, Snapshot, Expires-At).
  - `Board` (Board_ID, Name, Description, Style {visual / list}, Queries[Query_ID + Annotation + Width-Hint], Tags[]).
  - `SLO` (SLO_ID, Name, Description, Dataset-Reference, Time-Period {1d / 7d / 30d / custom}, Target-Per-Million {0..1_000_000}, SLI {derived-column-with-boolean expression}).
  - `Derived_Column` (Column_Name, Expression (Honeycomb DSL: e.g., `IF(EQUALS($http.status_code, 500), "error", "ok")`, `RATE_PER_DAY($duration_ms)`, `BUCKET($duration_ms, 50)`), Description).
  - `Trigger` (Trigger_ID, Dataset-Reference, Query-Reference, Threshold {operator + value}, Frequency, Alert-Type {true-once-then-quiet / repeat}, Recipients[{Type {webhook / email / slack / pagerduty / opsgenie / msteams / etc.}, Target}], Disabled).
  - `Marker` (Marker_ID, Dataset-Reference, Message, Type, URL, Start-Time, End-Time, Color).
  - `BubbleUp_Run` (Run_ID, Query_Reference, Selection-Time-Range, Top-N-Anomalous-Attributes[{Attribute, Distinct-Value-Distribution, Anomaly-Score}]).
  - `Classifier_Run` (Run_ID, Trace-Reference, Predicted-Class, Confidence, Features[]).
  - `Query_Assistant_Session` (Session_ID, NL-Prompt-History[], Generated-Query-Suggestions[], LLM-Endpoint-Binding).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Honeycomb Events API (`https://api.honeycomb.io/1/events/<dataset>`): per-event POST with write-key; batched via `/1/batch/<dataset>`.
  - Honeycomb OTLP-HTTP/gRPC endpoint (`api.honeycomb.io:443`): standard OpenTelemetry ingest with `x-honeycomb-team` header.
  - Honeycomb Management API v1 (`/1/...`): CRUD for datasets, columns, derived-columns, queries, query-results, boards, triggers, markers, SLOs, burn-alerts.
  - Honeycomb Management API v2 (preview): same resources with cleaner schema.
  - Refinery: open-source tail-sampling proxy with rules-based sampling (e.g., keep 100% of error-traces, 10% of slow-traces, 1% of normal-traces).
  - Beelines (deprecated honeycomb-instrumented libraries) for Python / Ruby / Go / Node / .NET: superseded by OpenTelemetry-Honeycomb-distro.
  - Honeycomb Terraform Provider for managing datasets + triggers + SLOs + boards + derived-columns as code.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Query Builder" — Calculate + Where + Group-By + Order + Limit with auto-complete on dataset schema.
  - "Heatmap" — distribution-over-time view with click-to-zoom into outliers.
  - "BubbleUp" — click-and-drag selection over heatmap anomaly + auto-correlation against all other attributes.
  - "Trace Waterfall" — distributed-trace span-tree with timing + tags + status.
  - "Boards" — collection of saved queries with narrative annotations.
  - "SLO Burn-Rate Page" — per-SLO compliance + burn-rate + budget-remaining + linked alert.
  - "Triggers" — per-query threshold alert with frequency + recipient list.
  - "Markers" — deployment / feature-flag / event annotations overlaid on heatmap.
  - "Query Assistant" — NL prompt → generated Honeycomb-query with explanation.
  - "Environment Switcher" — per-environment scope (e.g., prod / staging / dev) with per-env API-key.

- **Cedar permit shape** (observability + intelligence + workflow cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<honeycomb-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombEventIngest", Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombDatasetCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombDatasetSchemaQuery", Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombQueryExecute",
      Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombDerivedColumnCreate", Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombDerivedColumnEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombBoardCreate", Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombBoardEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombTriggerCreate", Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombTriggerMute",
      Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombMarkerCreate", Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombSLOCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombSLOEdit", Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombBubbleUpRun",
      Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombClassifierRun", Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombQueryAssistantInvoke",
      Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombRefineryRuleDeploy", Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombAPIKeyRotate",
      Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombEnvironmentConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"HoneycombAuditExport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::HoneycombDataset::"<dataset-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HoneycombQuery::"<query-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HoneycombSLO::"<slo-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HoneycombTrigger::"<trigger-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HoneycombEnvironment::"<environment-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HoneycombAPIKey::"<key-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "event_ingest_high_cardinality" || context.cardinality_budget_remaining > 0) &&
    (resource.kind != "query_execute_pii_unmasked" || principal.role in ["security_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "trigger_create_destructive_action" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "query_assistant_invoke" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "refinery_rule_deploy" || principal.role in ["observability_admin", "platform_engineer"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "api_key_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_export" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "dataset_delete" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "slo_edit_target" || principal.role == "observability_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "marker_create_global_scope" || principal.role in ["release_manager", "platform_engineer"])
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA (BAA-eligible enterprise plan + PHI-mask via derived-column-redaction + 7-yr archive); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region team residency US/EU + DSAR via event-export with user-tag filter + retention-policy); FedRAMP-Mod (Honeycomb-for-Federal); SOC-2 (audit + access-review); PCI-DSS (PAN-masking via Refinery rule + restricted dataset); EU-AI-Act (Query-Assistant + Classifier conformance ledger).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `honeycomb.team` → `oya-tenant-account`.
  - `honeycomb.environment` → `oya-tenant-environment-scope`.
  - `honeycomb.dataset` → `oya-observability-wide-event-dataset` (column-schema preserved; inferred-field projection).
  - `honeycomb.event` → `oya-observability-wide-event` (OTel-semantic-convention attribute mapping; trace.* preserved as canonical trace IDs).
  - `honeycomb.trace` → `oya-observability-trace`.
  - `honeycomb.query` → `oya-observability-query` (Honeycomb-DSL transpiled to Oyatie observability query DSL).
  - `honeycomb.board` → `oya-observability-dashboard`.
  - `honeycomb.slo` → `oya-observability-slo` (OpenSLO-compat per ADR-0130; per-million target normalized).
  - `honeycomb.derived_column` → `oya-observability-derived-field` (Honeycomb-DSL expression transpiled).
  - `honeycomb.trigger` → `oya-workflow-engine-event-rule`.
  - `honeycomb.marker` → `oya-observability-marker`.
  - `honeycomb.bubbleup_run` → `oya-intelligence-statistical-outlier-run`.
  - `honeycomb.classifier_run` → `oya-intelligence-anomaly-classification-run`.
  - `honeycomb.query_assistant_session` → `oya-intelligence-nl-query-session` (LLM endpoint preserved; EU-AI-Act conformance).

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (15 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` µservices with Honeycomb-feature-parity matrix.
  2. Export Honeycomb team via Management API v1: datasets + columns + derived-columns + queries + boards + triggers + markers + SLOs + burn-alerts + audit-stream + environments + API-keys.
  3. Per-Dataset: re-create in Oyatie observability wide-event-dataset; preserve column schema.
  4. Per-Derived-Column: transpile Honeycomb-DSL → Oyatie derived-field DSL; per-column expression-fidelity test.
  5. Re-bind OTLP ingest from instrumented services to Oyatie OTLP endpoint; dual-route during cutover.
  6. Re-deploy Refinery tail-sampling rules on Oyatie data-pipeline Refinery-compatible sampler.
  7. Per-Query: transpile Honeycomb-DSL → Oyatie observability query DSL; per-query semantic-fidelity test.
  8. Per-Board: import widget + annotation + width-hint; rendering-fidelity test.
  9. Per-Trigger: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine event-rule; per-trigger shadow-evaluation.
  10. Per-Marker: import deployment / feature-flag / event annotations.
  11. Per-SLO: import target + window + SLI-expression; OpenSLO-compat preserved.
  12. Per-BubbleUp-Run + Classifier-Run history: archive as Oyatie intelligence run records.
  13. Per-Query-Assistant-Session: re-bind LLM endpoint to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger.
  14. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-team cutover via OTLP-router.
  15. Honeycomb subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (14 specific failures):
  - Cardinality explosion (custom-attribute key blowup → query slowdown): per-dataset cardinality cap + tag-allowlist + cost-alarm.
  - Schema-inference drift (new field type mismatch with existing column): per-dataset schema-pin + auto-coerce + warn.
  - Derived-column DSL semantic gap (e.g., `RATE_PER_DAY`, `BUCKET`, complex `IF`): per-column transpile fidelity test + flagged-feature register.
  - Query DSL semantic gap (e.g., `HAVING` with multi-calc, `BREAKDOWN` over high-cardinality): per-query semantic-fidelity test.
  - Trigger threshold mis-tune (false-positive alert storm): per-trigger first-72h shadow.
  - SLO per-million target rounding vs Oyatie 0..1 ratio: per-SLO normalization audit.
  - Refinery tail-sampling rule drift (different sample-rate post-migration): per-rule golden-test on traffic mirror.
  - Marker scope (per-environment vs global) misalignment: per-marker scope-explicit + audit.
  - BubbleUp anomaly-score drift (different statistical kernel): per-run baseline + reviewer comparison.
  - Query Assistant hallucinated query (suggests query that fails or returns wrong result): per-suggestion source-evidence-required + dry-run.
  - Multi-environment migration (Classic vs E&S mode): per-env mode-explicit on import.
  - OTLP-ingest header mis-routing (events to wrong dataset): per-API-key dataset-scope Cedar guard.
  - Frontend RUM PII unmasked in wide-events: per-app default-mask + Sensitive-Data-Scanner cross-check.
  - Audit-stream lag (compliance evidence latency >24h): per-stream SLO + back-fill on cutover.

- **Migration playbook outline** (9 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Management API + Terraform-export: datasets + columns + derived-columns + queries + boards + triggers + markers + SLOs + audit.
  2. Re-bind OTLP ingest to Oyatie endpoint; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate datasets + derived-columns + queries + boards + triggers + markers + SLOs.
  4. Re-deploy Refinery tail-sampling rules on Oyatie data-pipeline.
  5. Migrate BubbleUp + Classifier run history.
  6. Re-bind Query Assistant to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4).
  7. Migrate Frontend RUM apps with PII-mask preserved.
  8. Parallel-run 30 days; per-team cutover via OTLP-router.
  9. Honeycomb subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `honeycomb` is benchmark alias-only; Honeycomb-DSL preserved as transpilation-source.

### Section D-092 - Grafana Cloud (Grafana Labs)
- Vendor name and category: Grafana Labs — Grafana OSS + Grafana Cloud (managed) + Grafana Enterprise + Grafana Mimir (metrics) + Grafana Loki (logs) + Grafana Tempo (traces) + Grafana Pyroscope (continuous profiling) + Grafana Faro (frontend observability / RUM) + Grafana Beyla (eBPF auto-instrumentation) + Grafana k6 (load testing + synthetic) + Grafana Alloy (OpenTelemetry-collector distribution, successor to Grafana Agent) + Grafana OnCall (incident management) + Grafana Incident + Grafana SLO + Grafana Synthetic Monitoring + Grafana Machine Learning + Grafana Adaptive Telemetry + Grafana Asserts (AIOps) + Grafana Cloud Connections + Grafana Application Observability + Grafana Kubernetes Observability + Grafana Cloud Frontend Observability + Grafana Cloud LLM (LLM-Assistant features) + Grafana IRM (Incident Response Management).
- Coverage tier: A (capability anchor on `observability` (Mimir-metrics + Loki-logs + Tempo-traces + Pyroscope-profiling + Faro-RUM + k6-synthetic + Application/K8s Observability anchor — Grafana Labs is the OSS observability backbone) + `intelligence` (Asserts AIOps + Adaptive Telemetry + ML + LLM-Assistant — BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4) + `incident-management` (OnCall + Incident + IRM) + `workflow-engine` (Alerting + SLO Burn-Rate-Alert) + `developer-sdk` (Grafana API + Loki/Mimir/Tempo/Pyroscope APIs + Grafana SDKs + Alloy config) + `data-pipeline` (Alloy / OTel-Collector distribution) + `apigw` (per-stack API tokens + Cloud Access Policies) + `compliance` (audit + per-region residency US/EU + FedRAMP)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Grafana Cloud Free → **Bronze**; Pro (full Mimir + Loki + Tempo + alerting + IRM) → **Silver**; Advanced (full + Pyroscope + Faro + k6 + Application Observability + Asserts) → **Gold**; Enterprise (full + LLM-Assistant + Adaptive Telemetry + CMEK + EU-residency + FedRAMP + dedicated-region + SSO + audit-stream) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `observability` (Mimir-metrics + Loki-logs + Tempo-traces + Pyroscope-profiling + Faro-RUM + k6-synthetic anchor); `intelligence` (Asserts AIOps + Adaptive Telemetry + ML + LLM-Assistant); `incident-management` (OnCall + Incident + IRM); `workflow-engine` (Alerting + SLO); `developer-sdk` (Grafana API + per-store APIs + Alloy config); `data-pipeline` (Alloy OTel-Collector distribution); `apigw` (Cloud Access Policy + API token); `compliance` (audit + EU/US/Govt residency).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Grafana Cloud platform model):
  - `Organization` (Org_ID, Slug, Region {US / EU / Govt / Asia / etc.}, Plan, SSO_Provider, SCIM-Endpoint).
  - `Stack` (Stack_ID, Slug, URL, Region, Datasources[], Alerting-Provider, Authentication-Mode).
  - `Cloud_Access_Policy` (Policy_ID, Name, Scopes[], Realms[Realm_ID + Type {stack / org / global}], Token_TTL, Created-By).
  - `Datasource` (Datasource_ID, Type {prometheus / mimir / loki / tempo / pyroscope / faro / k6 / cloudwatch / azure-monitor / google-cloud-monitoring / influxdb / mssql / postgres / mysql / elasticsearch / opensearch / etc.}, URL, Access-Method {proxy / direct}, Auth-Config, Secure-Config).
  - `Dashboard` (Dashboard_UID, Title, Panels[Panel_ID → {Type {graph / stat / gauge / bar / table / heatmap / piechart / logs / traces / nodegraph / canvas / geomap / status-history / time-series / etc.}, Query, Visualization-Options, Threshold, Field-Override}], Variables[], Tags[], Time-Range, Refresh).
  - `Panel_Query` (Datasource-Reference, Expression {PromQL / LogQL / TraceQL / SQL / Flux / KQL / etc.}, Refid, Interval, Hide).
  - `Alert_Rule` (Rule_UID, Title, Folder-Reference, Conditions[Condition_ID → {Datasource, Query, Threshold, Evaluator}], For-Duration, No-Data-State, Exec-Err-State, Annotations[], Labels[], Routing-Tree-Match).
  - `Notification_Policy_Tree` (Routing-Tree: per-label-match → Contact-Point + Group-By + Group-Wait + Group-Interval + Repeat-Interval + Mute-Timings).
  - `Contact_Point` (CP_ID, Type {email / slack / pagerduty / opsgenie / msteams / webhook / discord / telegram / line / pushover / sns / sensu / threema / wecom / etc.}, Settings, Secure-Settings, Disable-Resolve-Message).
  - `Mute_Timing` (Name, Time-Intervals[{Times + Days + Months + Weekdays + Years}], Location).
  - `Folder` (Folder_UID, Title, Parent-Folder-UID, Permissions[]).
  - `Library_Panel` (Library_Panel_UID, Name, Model, Used-By-Dashboards[]).
  - `Service_Account` (Service_Account_ID, Name, Tokens[Token_ID + Scopes], Roles[]).
  - `Mimir_Tenant` + `Loki_Tenant` + `Tempo_Tenant` + `Pyroscope_Tenant` (Tenant_ID, Limits {ingest-rate, series-cardinality, query-rate}, Retention).
  - `Series` (Mimir) (Metric_Name + Label-Set, Sample-Stream, Storage-Tier, Compactor-Status).
  - `Log_Stream` (Loki) (Labels {key:value} → log-lines stream; Index by label-set; Filter by line-content (Loki's "log-stream" model with cheap-storage cardinality-cap).
  - `Trace` (Tempo) (Trace_ID, Span-Tree, Service-Graph-Edges).
  - `Profile` (Pyroscope) (Profile_Type {cpu / memory / lock / wall-clock / etc.}, Labels[], Sample-Pattern, FlameGraph).
  - `Faro_App` (App_ID, Receiver-Endpoint, RUM-Type {web / mobile}, Privacy-Settings, Allowed-Origins[], Trace-Header-Propagation).
  - `k6_Test` (Test_ID, Script-Reference, Schedule, VUs, Duration, Thresholds[]).
  - `OnCall_Schedule` + `Escalation_Chain` + `Integration` + `Route` + `Alert_Group` + `Webhook` (mirrors PagerDuty/Opsgenie semantics with OSS-implementation).
  - `Incident` (Incident_ID, Title, Severity, Status, Roles[], Tasks[], Timeline[], Postmortem).
  - `SLO` (SLO_ID, Name, Service, SLI {target + metric-query}, Window, Burn-Rate-Alerts[]).
  - `Asserts_Entity` + `Asserts_Assertion` + `Asserts_Workflow` (AIOps semantic-model + auto-attributed root-cause).
  - `Adaptive_Telemetry_Rule` (Rule_ID, Source-Filter, Action {drop / aggregate / sample}, Cost-Optimization).
  - `LLM_Assistant_Session` (Session_ID, Prompt-History[], Generated-Query-Suggestions[], LLM-Endpoint-Binding).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Grafana HTTP API (`https://<stack>.grafana.net/api/...`): dashboards, folders, datasources, alerting, library-panels, service-accounts, teams, users, plugins, annotations, snapshots, organization.
  - Mimir API (Prometheus-remote-write `/api/v1/push` + PromQL `/api/v1/query` + `/api/v1/query_range` + `/api/v1/labels` + `/api/v1/series`).
  - Loki API (LogQL `/loki/api/v1/query` + `/loki/api/v1/query_range` + push `/loki/api/v1/push`).
  - Tempo API (OTLP/Zipkin/Jaeger ingest + TraceQL `/api/search` + `/api/traces/<trace-id>`).
  - Pyroscope API (Push + Render flamegraph + `/render?query=...`).
  - Faro Receiver (HTTP `POST /collect` with browser SDK).
  - k6 Cloud API (test-runs + thresholds + outputs).
  - Cloud Access Policy API + Token API.
  - Grafana Alloy config (`config.alloy`): declarative OTel-Collector with discovery + processor + exporter components.
  - SDKs: `grafana-api` (Python community), `grafana_api_python_client`, Terraform Provider, OpenAPI-generated clients.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Dashboards" — panel-grid with templating-variables + drill-down + URL-sharing.
  - "Explore" — ad-hoc query across any datasource with split-pane multi-store query.
  - "Alerting v2" — multi-source rule + routing-tree + contact-point + mute-timing.
  - "Application Observability" — auto-discovered service-map + RED-signals + linked-logs/traces.
  - "Kubernetes Observability" — per-cluster pod-graph + workload-health + linked-logs.
  - "Profiles" (Pyroscope) — flame-graph compare + time-series view.
  - "Frontend Observability" (Faro) — per-app Core-Web-Vitals + JS errors + session view.
  - "Synthetic Monitoring" — per-check uptime + global-pop latency.
  - "k6 Cloud" — load-test results with VU + threshold + p95-latency.
  - "Incident" (Grafana IRM) — incident command-center with timeline + roles + Slack-bridge + postmortem.
  - "OnCall" — schedule + escalation + integration with PagerDuty-feature-parity.
  - "Asserts" — AIOps-attributed RCA + service-impact + auto-detected issues.
  - "Adaptive Telemetry" — per-source cost-optimization rules.
  - "LLM Assistant" — NL→PromQL/LogQL/TraceQL + dashboard-build.

- **Cedar permit shape** (observability + intelligence + incident-management + workflow + community cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<grafana-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaDashboardView", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaDashboardEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaPromQLQuery", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaLogQLQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaTraceQLQuery", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaPyroscopeQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaFaroIngest", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaK6TestRun",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaAlertRuleConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaNotificationPolicyEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaContactPointConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaMuteTimingConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaFolderManage", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaLibraryPanelEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaDatasourceCreate", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaDatasourceRotateAuth",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaMimirIngest", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaLokiIngest",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaTempoIngest", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaOnCallScheduleConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaIncidentCommand", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaSLOConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaAssertsRunAnalysis", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaAdaptiveTelemetryRuleDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaLLMAssistantInvoke", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaAlloyConfigDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaCloudAccessPolicyCreate", Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaServiceAccountTokenRotate",
      Oyatie::Action::"GrafanaAuditExport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::GrafanaStack::"<stack-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::GrafanaDashboard::"<dashboard-uid>",
      Oyatie::Resource::GrafanaAlertRule::"<rule-uid>",
      Oyatie::Resource::GrafanaContactPoint::"<cp-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::GrafanaDatasource::"<datasource-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::GrafanaOnCallSchedule::"<schedule-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::GrafanaSLO::"<slo-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::GrafanaAlloyConfig::"<config-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "datasource_create_external" || context.datasource_endpoint_in_egress_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "promql_query_high_cardinality" || context.cardinality_budget_remaining > 0) &&
    (resource.kind != "logql_query_pii_unmasked" || principal.role in ["security_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "tempo_trace_pii_unmasked" || principal.role in ["security_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "faro_session_replay_unmasked" || principal.role == "rum_pii_authorized") &&
    (resource.kind != "k6_test_run_destructive_target" || context.k6_destructive_scope_approved == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "alert_rule_destructive_action" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "contact_point_configure_external" || context.contact_point_target_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "incident_command_takeover" || principal.role == "incident_commander") &&
    (resource.kind != "asserts_run_analysis" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "llm_assistant_invoke" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "cloud_access_policy_create_global" || principal.role == "org_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "service_account_token_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_export" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "adaptive_telemetry_rule_deploy" || principal.role in ["observability_admin", "cost_admin"])
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-Grafana (BAA via Enterprise / Cloud Enterprise + HIPAA-eligible tenants + 7-yr retention via long-term object storage); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region stack residency US/EU + DSAR via per-tenant log/trace/metric export); FedRAMP-Mod (Grafana Cloud Government); SOC-2 (audit + access-review + Cloud-Access-Policy rotation); PCI-DSS (PAN-masking via Alloy processor + restricted dashboards); EU-AI-Act (Asserts + LLM-Assistant conformance ledger).

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (18 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `intelligence` + `incident-management` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` µservices with Grafana-Cloud-feature-parity matrix.
  2. Export Grafana stack via HTTP API + Terraform-export: organizations + stacks + access-policies + datasources + dashboards + folders + library-panels + alert-rules + notification-policies + contact-points + mute-timings + service-accounts + Mimir/Loki/Tempo/Pyroscope tenant limits + Faro apps + k6 tests + OnCall schedules + incidents + SLOs + Asserts entities + Adaptive-Telemetry rules + Alloy configs + audit-stream.
  3. Per-Datasource: re-create in Oyatie observability (per-type config + auth rotation to OpenBao).
  4. Per-Dashboard: import panel-spec + variables + queries; transpile PromQL/LogQL/TraceQL → Oyatie observability query DSL; per-dashboard rendering-fidelity test.
  5. Per-Alert-Rule + Notification-Policy + Contact-Point + Mute-Timing: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine event-rule + routing-tree; per-rule shadow-evaluation.
  6. Per-Mimir/Loki/Tempo/Pyroscope tenant: re-create in Oyatie observability store with limits + retention preserved.
  7. Re-bind metric / log / trace / profile ingest to Oyatie OTLP + remote-write + Loki-push + Tempo-push + Pyroscope-push endpoints.
  8. Per-Faro-App: re-bind receiver-endpoint to Oyatie RUM; preserve privacy-settings.
  9. Per-k6-Test: import script + schedule + thresholds; per-test first-run validation.
  10. Per-OnCall schedule + escalation + integration + route: transpile to Oyatie incident-management.
  11. Per-Incident: import last 90 days incidents + roles + tasks + postmortem.
  12. Per-SLO: import target + window + SLI; OpenSLO-compat preserved.
  13. Per-Asserts entity + assertion + workflow: import to Oyatie intelligence AIOps.
  14. Per-Adaptive-Telemetry rule: re-deploy as Oyatie observability cost-optimization rule.
  15. Per-Alloy config: re-deploy as Oyatie data-pipeline Alloy-compatible config.
  16. Per-Cloud-Access-Policy: re-create in Oyatie IAM access-policy + token rotation.
  17. Re-bind LLM-Assistant to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act conformance ledger.
  18. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-stack cutover via stack-router; Grafana Cloud sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (16 specific failures):
  - PromQL → Oyatie-observability-DSL semantic gap (e.g., `histogram_quantile`, `<aggr>_over_time`, `topk`, sub-queries): per-query semantic-fidelity test + flagged-feature register.
  - LogQL `unwrap` + `pattern` parser drift on cardinality: per-stream cardinality cap.
  - TraceQL semantic gap on multi-trace joins: per-query semantic-fidelity test.
  - Dashboard variable templating-fail (cross-datasource variable resolution): per-dashboard rendering-fidelity test.
  - Alert-rule multi-source query (Prom + Loki + Tempo merged): per-rule transpile fidelity + dual-store evaluation.
  - Notification-policy routing-tree-match drift (label-match miss): per-tree golden-test + shadow-evaluation.
  - Contact-point credential leak in webhook (secure-settings exfiltration): per-contact-point vault-binding + Cedar guard.
  - Mute-timing TZ misalignment: per-timing TZ-explicit + DST-aware test.
  - Mimir/Loki/Tempo/Pyroscope tenant limits drift (ingest throttled mid-cutover): per-tenant pre-flight + dynamic-grow.
  - Faro session-replay PII unmask: per-app PII-mask + Sensitive-Data-Scanner cross-check.
  - k6 test running against production target (paging storm): per-test target-allowlist + dry-run.
  - OnCall escalation-chain cycle on import: per-chain cycle-detection.
  - Asserts AIOps semantic-model drift: per-entity model-pin + reviewer feedback.
  - Adaptive Telemetry rule mis-drop (legitimate alerts silenced): per-rule precision audit + dry-run.
  - Alloy config breaking change (Grafana Agent → Alloy migration): per-config migration test.
  - LLM-Assistant hallucinated query: per-suggestion source-evidence + dry-run.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Grafana HTTP API + Terraform-export: full stack manifest.
  2. Re-create datasources + cloud-access-policies + service-accounts.
  3. Migrate dashboards + folders + library-panels with query-DSL transpilation.
  4. Migrate alert-rules + notification-policies + contact-points + mute-timings with shadow-eval.
  5. Migrate Mimir/Loki/Tempo/Pyroscope tenants with limits + retention.
  6. Re-bind metric/log/trace/profile ingest to Oyatie OTLP + remote-write + push endpoints.
  7. Migrate Faro + k6 + OnCall + Incident + SLO + Asserts + Adaptive Telemetry.
  8. Re-deploy Alloy config as Oyatie data-pipeline Alloy-compatible config.
  9. Re-bind LLM-Assistant to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days; per-stack cutover; Grafana Cloud sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `intelligence` + `incident-management` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `grafana` + `mimir` + `loki` + `tempo` + `pyroscope` + `faro` + `alloy` are benchmark alias-only.

### Section D-093 - AppDynamics (Cisco AppDynamics)
- Vendor name and category: Cisco AppDynamics — APM (Java / .NET / Node.js / PHP / Python / Go / C/C++ SDK) + Business iQ (business-transaction performance) + End User Monitoring (EUM: Browser RUM + Mobile RUM + IoT) + Infrastructure Visibility (server + container + Database Visibility) + Network Visibility (NetViz) + Cloud Monitoring + Cisco AppDynamics on Cisco Cloud Observability (formerly FSO Platform — multi-domain observability) + Cognition Engine (anomaly detection + business-transaction-tagged ML) + Secure Application (runtime application self-protection / RASP + vulnerability scanning) + Synthetic Monitoring + AppDynamics Mobile SDK + Database Visibility Agent + Server Visibility Agent + Machine Agent + Browser RUM Agent + Cisco Observability Platform (modules: APM + Infrastructure + RUM + Synthetic + Secure-App + Networking + Cost).
- Coverage tier: B (capability fit on `observability` (APM + EUM + Infrastructure + Database + Network + Synthetic + Cisco Cloud Observability) + `intelligence` (Cognition Engine + multi-signal anomaly detection — BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4) + `secops` (Secure Application RASP + vulnerability scanning) + `workflow-engine` (Policies + Actions + Health Rules) + `developer-sdk` (AppDynamics REST API + Controller API + Cisco-Cloud-Observability API + SDKs) + `data-pipeline` (Machine Agent + Application Agent + telemetry forwarding) + `apigw` (access-keys + OAuth tokens) + `compliance` (audit + per-region SaaS controller residency)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: APM-only → **Bronze**; APM + EUM + Infrastructure → **Silver**; full stack + Database + Network + Synthetic + Cognition + Business iQ → **Gold**; Cisco Cloud Observability (FSO) + Secure Application + Cost + Customer-Managed-Keys + EU-residency + FedRAMP-Mod + dedicated-controller → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `observability` (APM + EUM + Infrastructure + Database + Network + Synthetic + Cisco Cloud Observability anchor); `intelligence` (Cognition Engine + Business iQ ML); `secops` (Secure Application RASP + vulnerability); `workflow-engine` (Policies + Actions + Health Rules); `developer-sdk` (AppDynamics-API-compat); `data-pipeline` (Machine Agent + Application Agent forwarding); `apigw` (access-key + OAuth); `compliance` (audit + EU/US/Govt residency).

  - `Account` (Account_ID, Subdomain, Region, License-Type, Controller_Host, EUM_Account_Key, App_Key).
  - `Application` (App_ID, Name, Type {APM / EUM-Web / EUM-Mobile / DB / SIM (Server Infrastructure Monitoring) / NetViz / Synthetic / Custom}, Tier-Topology[], Owner_Group).
  - `Tier` (Tier_ID, Application-Reference, Name, Agent_Type {Java / .NET / Node / PHP / Python / Go / C++ / SDK / Browser-RUM / Mobile-RUM / DB / Machine / NetViz}, Nodes[Node_ID]).
  - `Node` (Node_ID, Name, Machine-Reference, Tier-Reference, Last-App-Server-Restart, Process-Identifier).
  - `Business_Transaction` (BT_ID, Name, Application-Reference, Tier-Reference, Entry-Point-Type {Servlet / Web-Service / EJB / JMS / etc.}, Rule {discovery / custom-match}, Performance-Baseline {dynamic / static}).
  - `Snapshot` (Snapshot_ID, BT-Reference, Start, Duration, Status {normal / slow / very-slow / stall / error}, Call-Graph, Errors[], HTTP-Request-Data, SQL-Calls[], Backend-Calls[]).

      Oyatie::Resource::AppDHealthRule::"<rule-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AppDPolicy::"<policy-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AppDAction::"<action-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AppDSecureAppVulnerability::"<vuln-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AppDSyntheticJob::"<job-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AppDAccessKey::"<key-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "snapshot_view_pii_unmasked" || principal.role in ["security_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "action_execute_destructive" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "eum_session_unmasked" || principal.role == "rum_pii_authorized") &&
    (resource.kind != "synthetic_job_run_destructive_target" || context.synthetic_destructive_scope_approved == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "cognition_engine_run" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "secure_app_rasp_blocking_mode" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "vulnerability_accept_risk" || principal.role == "security_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "access_key_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_export" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "uql_query_pii_unmasked" || principal.role in ["security_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "policy_configure_destructive_action" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "netviz_flow_view_sensitive_subnet" || principal.role == "network_admin")
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-AppDynamics (BAA via Cisco + HIPAA-eligible controller + PHI-mask via BT-rule + 7-yr retention); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region controller residency US/EU + DSAR + retention-policy); FedRAMP-Mod (Cisco AppDynamics Federal); SOC-2 (audit + access-review); PCI-DSS (PAN-masking at BT-capture + restricted snapshot); EU-AI-Act (Cognition Engine + Secure-App-ML conformance ledger).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `appd.account` → `oya-tenant-account`.
  - `appd.application` → `oya-observability-application`.
  - `appd.tier` + `appd.node` → `oya-observability-service` + `oya-observability-instance`.
  - `appd.business_transaction` → `oya-observability-business-transaction`.
  - `appd.snapshot` → `oya-observability-trace` (call-graph projected to OTel-trace; SQL + backend preserved).
  - `appd.backend` → `oya-observability-backend-dependency`.
  - `appd.health_rule` → `oya-workflow-engine-event-rule` + `oya-observability-monitor-spec`.
  - `appd.policy` + `appd.action` → `oya-workflow-engine-policy` + `oya-workflow-engine-action`.
  - `appd.eum_browser_page` → `oya-observability-rum-page-view`.
  - `appd.eum_mobile_crash` → `oya-observability-mobile-crash`.
  - `appd.database_statement` → `oya-observability-sql-statement`.
  - `appd.netviz_flow` → `oya-observability-network-flow`.
  - `appd.synthetic_job` → `oya-observability-synthetic-test`.
  - `appd.anomaly_event` → `oya-intelligence-anomaly`.
  - `appd.secure_app_vulnerability` → `oya-secops-vulnerability-finding`.
  - `appd.secure_app_attack` → `oya-secops-attack-event`.
  - `appd.custom_dashboard` → `oya-observability-dashboard`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (16 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `intelligence` + `secops` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` µservices with AppDynamics-feature-parity matrix.
  2. Export AppDynamics controller via REST API: applications + tiers + nodes + BTs + snapshots + backends + health-rules + policies + actions + EUM-apps + DB-statements + NetViz-flows + synthetic-jobs + anomaly-events + Secure-App vulnerabilities + custom-dashboards + audit-stream.
  3. Per-Application + Tier + Node: re-create in Oyatie observability; preserve hierarchical naming.
  4. Per-Business-Transaction: import rule + entry-point-type + baseline; per-BT shadow-evaluation.
  5. Per-Snapshot: re-bind APM agents to Oyatie OTLP; preserve call-graph + SQL + backend detail.
  6. Per-Backend: import discovery + properties.
  7. Per-Health-Rule + Policy + Action: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine; per-rule shadow-evaluation.
  8. Per-EUM-Browser-App + Mobile-App: re-bind beacon-endpoint to Oyatie RUM; preserve privacy-settings.
  9. Per-Database-Statement: re-bind DB Visibility agent to Oyatie observability DB-statement-store.
  10. Per-NetViz-Flow: re-bind NetViz agent to Oyatie observability network-flow store.
  11. Per-Synthetic-Job: import script + locations + frequency.
  12. Per-Anomaly-Event: import last 90 days + Cognition-score + suggested-root-cause.
  13. Per-Secure-App vulnerability + attack: import to Oyatie secops; preserve RASP-mode + status.
  14. Per-Custom-Dashboard: import widget-spec; rendering-fidelity test.
  15. Re-bind Cognition Engine + Business iQ + Cisco Cloud Observability UQL queries to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act conformance ledger.
  16. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-app cutover via agent-router; AppDynamics subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (14 specific failures):
  - APM agent byte-code-injection collision with Oyatie agent: per-tier runtime test + agent-compat matrix + opt-out.
  - BT-rule discovery drift (different BTs detected post-migration): per-BT rule-pin + golden-test.
  - Snapshot call-graph drift (method-level resolution loss): per-language code-location adapter test.
  - Health-rule baseline-drift (dynamic-baseline re-learned): per-rule baseline-preservation + transition window.
  - Policy action external-credential leak: per-action vault-binding + Cedar guard.
  - EUM mobile crash symbolication map missing: per-app dSYM/Proguard dual-upload.
  - DB Visibility plan-capture drift (DB-version skew): per-DB agent-version pin.
  - NetViz subnet-tag mis-classification (sensitive subnet leaked to non-network-admin): per-flow scope Cedar guard.
  - Synthetic job multi-location latency-baseline drift: per-job location-baseline + drift-alarm.
  - Cognition Engine anomaly score drift (different statistical kernel): per-event baseline + reviewer.
  - Secure-App RASP blocking-mode kills production: per-policy staged rollout.
  - UQL → Oyatie observability DSL semantic gap: per-query semantic-fidelity + flagged-feature register.
  - Custom-dashboard widget metric-path drift (hierarchical path changes): per-widget path-rewrite on import.
  - Multi-controller / on-prem-vs-SaaS migration: per-controller lane + cross-controller entity-deduplication.

- **Migration playbook outline** (8 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Controller REST API + Cisco Cloud Observability API: full export.
  2. Re-deploy APM/EUM/DB/Machine/NetViz agents on Oyatie observability (AppDynamics protocol-compat); dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate applications + tiers + nodes + BTs + snapshots + backends.
  4. Migrate health-rules + policies + actions with credential rotation.
  5. Migrate EUM browser + mobile apps + database + NetViz + synthetic.
  6. Migrate Cognition Engine + Business iQ + Secure-App; BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4.
  7. Migrate Cisco Cloud Observability UQL queries + custom dashboards.
  8. Parallel-run 30 days; per-app cutover; AppDynamics sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `intelligence` + `secops` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `data-pipeline` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `appdynamics` + `cisco-cloud-observability` are benchmark alias-only; UQL preserved only as a transpilation-source DSL.

### Section D-094 - IBM Instana (IBM Observability)
- Vendor name and category: IBM Instana — Instana APM + Real User Monitoring + Synthetic Monitoring + Mobile APM + Infrastructure Monitoring + Container & Kubernetes Monitoring + Database Monitoring + Logs (Log Volume + Pipeline + Search) + IBM Observability with Instana on watsonx AIOps (formerly Cloud Pak for Watson AIOps) + Unbounded Analytics + Application Perspectives + Smart Alerts + Service Maps + Endpoint Detection + Smart-Discovery + IBM Cloud Pak for Observability + IBM Concert + ML-driven anomaly detection (Watsonx integration) + High-fidelity 1-second-granularity capture (Instana's distinctive selling point) + Stan AI (chatbot assistant).
- Coverage tier: B (capability fit on `observability` (APM + RUM + Synthetic + Mobile + Infra + Containers + K8s + DB + Logs + 1-second granularity anchor) + `intelligence` (watsonx AIOps + Stan AI + Smart Alerts + Smart Discovery — BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4) + `workflow-engine` (Smart Alerts + Event Filters + Action Triggers) + `developer-sdk` (Instana REST API + GraphQL + SDKs + Agent extensibility) + `data-pipeline` (Instana Agent + Host Agent + Database/Container Sensors) + `apigw` (per-tenant agent-key + API token) + `compliance` (audit + per-region tenant residency)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Instana APM Essentials → **Bronze**; APM + RUM + Synthetic → **Silver**; Full stack + watsonx AIOps + Smart Alerts → **Gold**; Enterprise (Cloud Pak for Observability + multi-tenant Concert + CMEK + EU-residency + FedRAMP-Mod + Stan AI BYOK + cross-cluster MSSP) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `observability` (APM + RUM + Synthetic + Mobile + Infra + Container + K8s + DB + Logs anchor with 1-second granularity ceiling); `intelligence` (watsonx AIOps + Stan AI + Smart Alerts + Smart Discovery); `workflow-engine` (Smart Alerts + event-filters + action-triggers); `developer-sdk` (Instana API + GraphQL superset); `data-pipeline` (Instana-Agent-protocol-compatible host + sensor agents); `apigw` (agent-key + API token); `compliance` (audit + EU/US/Govt residency).

  ```
  permit(

    (resource.kind != "rum_session_unmasked" || principal.role == "rum_pii_authorized") &&

    (resource.kind != "agent_key_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&

    (resource.kind != "smart_alert_destructive_action" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "agent_deploy_privileged_host" || principal.role == "platform_engineer")
  };
  ```

- **Failure modes** (13 specific failures):

  - Agent-key over-permissive scope: per-key narrow-scope + rotation.

### Section D-095 - Sentry
- Vendor name and category: Sentry (Functional Software, Inc.) — Sentry Error Monitoring + Application Performance Monitoring (APM with distributed tracing) + Session Replay + Profiling (Sentry Profiling for backend + mobile + browser) + Crons (cron-job monitoring) + Code Coverage (test coverage tracking via Codecov integration) + User Feedback + Cron-monitoring + Release Health + Issues + Workflows + Alerts + Dashboards + Discover (queries over events + transactions) + Metrics (custom metrics) + Sentry AI (Autofix + Suggested-Solutions LLM assistant) + Sentry MCP (Model Context Protocol server) + Sentry SDK (50+ language/framework SDKs) + Issue Linking + integrations (Jira / GitHub / GitLab / Slack / PagerDuty / Opsgenie / MS Teams / Azure DevOps / Asana / Linear / etc.) + Sentry On-Premise (self-hosted).
- Coverage tier: B (capability fit on `observability` (error + APM + session-replay + profiling + crons + release-health anchor) + `intelligence` (Sentry AI Autofix + Suggested-Solutions — BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4) + `workflow-engine` (Alert Rules + Notification Routing + Auto-Resolve) + `developer-sdk` (Sentry SDK ecosystem + REST API + MCP server) + `itsm` (Issue linking + cross-tool sync to Jira/Linear/GitHub) + `apigw` (per-project DSN + auth tokens) + `compliance` (audit + per-region data-residency US/EU)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Developer (basic errors) → **Bronze**; Team (full errors + performance + crons + dashboards) → **Silver**; Business (full + session-replay + profiling + custom-metrics + Sentry AI) → **Gold**; Enterprise (full + audit + SSO/SAML + dedicated-region + EU-residency + Customer-Managed-Keys + on-premise option) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `observability` (error-monitoring + APM + session-replay + profiling + crons + release-health); `intelligence` (Sentry AI Autofix + Suggested-Solutions); `workflow-engine` (Alert Rules + Notification + Auto-Resolve); `developer-sdk` (Sentry-SDK-protocol-compatible ingest + MCP server); `itsm` (cross-tool issue linking); `apigw` (DSN + auth-token); `compliance` (audit + EU/US/Govt residency).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Sentry platform model):
  - `Organization` (Org_ID, Slug, Region {US / EU}, Plan, Open-Membership, SSO-Provider, Allowed-Domains[], Default-Role).
  - `Team` (Team_ID, Slug, Org-Reference, Members[], Projects[]).
  - `Project` (Project_ID, Slug, Name, Platform {python / javascript / ruby / java / .NET / swift / kotlin / go / rust / etc.}, DSN, Public-Key, Secret-Key (legacy), Allowed-Domains[], Inbound-Filters{}, Subject-Template, Default-Environment, Resolve-Age, Auto-Resolve, Grouping-Config).
  - `DSN` (DSN_ID, Project-Reference, Public-Key, Format `https://<pubkey>@<org>.ingest.sentry.io/<project-id>`, Rate-Limit, Status).
  - `Event` (Event_ID, Project-Reference, Type {error / transaction / replay / profile / cron-check-in / user-feedback / attachment / etc.}, Timestamp, Platform, Tags{}, Extra{}, Breadcrumbs[], Request{}, User{}, Contexts{}, Exception{}, Stacktrace[], Release-Reference, Environment, Server-Name).
  - `Issue` (Issue_ID, Project-Reference, Fingerprint, Title, Culprit, Level {fatal / error / warning / info / debug}, Status {unresolved / resolved / ignored / archived}, Substatus {ongoing / regressed / new / escalating / archived-until-condition}, First-Seen, Last-Seen, Times-Seen, Users-Affected, Assignee, Stats[24h / 30d], Annotations[], Tags{}, Linked-External-Issue[]).
  - `Transaction` (Transaction_ID, Trace_ID, Spans[Span_ID → {op, description, start_timestamp, duration, status, tags{}}], Service-Reference, Duration, Status, User, Tags{}).
  - `Replay` (Replay_ID, Project-Reference, Session_ID, User, Browser, OS, Duration, Activity-Score, Errors[], Linked-Issues[], Privacy-Mask-Rules).
  - `Profile` (Profile_ID, Type {backend / mobile / browser}, Service-Reference, Sample-Pattern, FlameGraph).
  - `Cron_Monitor` (Monitor_ID, Slug, Schedule (cron / interval), Margin, Max-Runtime, Timezone, Next-Check-In-Expected, Failure-Issue-Threshold, Recovery-Threshold).
  - `Release` (Release_ID, Version, Project-Refs[], Date-Created, Commits[], Authors[], Deployments[Deployment_ID → Environment + Date-Started + Date-Finished]).
  - `Alert_Rule` (Rule_ID, Project-Refs[], Name, Conditions[], Filters[], Actions[], Frequency, Resolve-Threshold, Created-By, Owner).
  - `Notification_Action` (Action_ID, Type {email / slack / pagerduty / opsgenie / msteams / discord / webhook / azure-devops / jira / linear / etc.}, Configuration, Secure-Config).
  - `Dashboard` (Dashboard_ID, Title, Widgets[Widget_ID → {Type {bar / line / area / table / world-map / big-number}, Query, Display-Options}], Filters[], Project-Refs[]).
  - `Discover_Query` (Query_ID, Name, Fields[], Conditions[], Aggregations[], Time-Range, Project-Refs[]).
  - `Custom_Metric` (Metric_Name, Type {counter / distribution / gauge / set}, Unit, Tags{}, Storage-Tier).
  - `User_Feedback` (Feedback_ID, Event-Reference, User-Reference, Comment, Submitted-At).
  - `Sentry_AI_Autofix_Run` (Run_ID, Issue-Reference, LLM-Endpoint, Suggested-Fix-Description, PR-URL-Created, Status {pending / approved / rejected / applied}).
  - `Integration` (Integration_ID, Provider {jira / github / gitlab / slack / pagerduty / etc.}, Configuration, OAuth-Token-Reference).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Sentry Web API v0 (`https://sentry.io/api/0/...`): per-resource CRUD over organizations, teams, projects, issues, events, releases, deployments, alerts, dashboards, integrations, key-transactions, members, projects-stats.
  - Sentry SDK ingest protocol (`https://<org>.ingest.sentry.io/api/<project-id>/envelope/`): Envelope format with multipart events (errors, transactions, attachments, profiles, replays, user-feedback, cron-check-ins).
  - Relay (open-source Sentry edge ingestion proxy): per-edge PII-scrubbing + rate-limit + buffering.
  - Sentry MCP Server (Model Context Protocol): AI agent tool integration for Sentry resources.
  - SDKs: 50+ languages/frameworks (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Next.js, Nuxt, Remix, Django, Flask, FastAPI, Ruby, Rails, Java, Spring, Android, Kotlin, Swift, iOS, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Go, Rust, PHP, Laravel, Symfony, Node.js, Express, NestJS, Deno, Bun, Cloudflare-Workers, AWS-Lambda, etc.).
  - CLI: `sentry-cli` for release management + source-map upload + dSYM upload + Proguard upload.
  - Webhooks: per-org subscriptions with HMAC-signed payload.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Issues" — fingerprinted error groups with stats + assignee + status + linked-external-issue.
  - "Issue Details" — stack trace + breadcrumbs + tags + request + user-context + linked-transactions + linked-replays.
  - "Performance" — transaction list + P50/P75/P95 + Apdex + key-transaction view.
  - "Session Replay" — DOM-replay with click + scroll + console + network + privacy-mask.
  - "Profiling" — flame-graph per service/transaction with per-frame attribution.
  - "Crons" — per-monitor check-in timeline + missed/failed/timeout status.
  - "Releases" — per-release commit + author + deploy + crash-free-session-rate + adoption.
  - "Alerts" — issue-alert + metric-alert rule editor with action-chain.
  - "Dashboards" — widget-grid with Discover-query and chart visualizations.
  - "Discover" — ad-hoc query over events + transactions with field + aggregation builder.
  - "Sentry AI Autofix" — per-issue LLM-suggested fix with PR-creation flow.

  ```

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (14 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `itsm` + `apigw` + `compliance` µservices with Sentry-feature-parity matrix.
  2. Export Sentry org via API v0: organizations + teams + projects + DSNs + issues + events + releases + deployments + alert-rules + integrations + dashboards + custom-metrics + audit + autofix-runs.
  3. Per-Project: re-create with Oyatie observability project; rotate DSN to Oyatie ingest-token.
  4. Re-bind SDKs to Oyatie ingest endpoint (Envelope-format compatible); dual-route 30 days.
  5. Per-Issue: import fingerprint + status + assignee + substatus + linked-external-issue.
  6. Per-Transaction + Span: re-bind APM ingest to Oyatie OTLP/Envelope-compat.
  7. Per-Replay: re-bind replay ingest; preserve privacy-mask-rules.
  8. Per-Profile: re-bind profiler ingest.
  9. Per-Cron-Monitor: re-bind check-in ingest endpoint; preserve schedule + margin + max-runtime.
  10. Per-Release: import version + commits + deployments.
  11. Per-Alert-Rule + Notification-Action: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine + comms-destination with credential rotation.
  12. Per-Dashboard + Discover-Query: import widget-spec + query; rendering-fidelity test.
  13. Re-bind Sentry AI Autofix + MCP to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger.
  14. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-project cutover via DSN-router; Sentry sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (13 specific failures):
  - SDK Envelope-format protocol drift on Oyatie ingest: per-SDK version-pin + per-language compat-test matrix.
  - Fingerprint drift on stack-trace normalization (issue regroups post-migration): per-issue fingerprint-pin + auto-merge on collision.
  - Source-map upload broken (errors unsymbolicated): per-release source-map dual-upload during cutover.
  - dSYM/Proguard map missing for mobile crashes: per-app symbol-upload dual-upload.
  - Privacy-mask leak on session-replay: per-project PII-scrubbing-rule + Relay-edge enforcement.
  - Cron check-in window mismatch (Oyatie clock skew): per-monitor TZ-explicit + dual-check-in window.
  - Release deploy-marker out-of-order (deploys missed): per-deploy chronological-pin + back-fill.
  - Alert-rule action external-credential leak: per-action vault-binding + Cedar guard.
  - Integration OAuth-token refresh failure (Jira/GitHub sync breaks): per-integration token-refresh playbook + dual-credential window.
  - Discover-query semantic gap on aggregation (e.g., `apdex`, `p75`, `failure_rate`): per-query semantic-fidelity test.
  - Custom-metric cardinality blowup: per-metric tag-allowlist + cost-alarm.
  - Sentry-AI Autofix hallucinated PR (broken code suggestion): per-PR human-in-loop + CI-required + dry-run.
  - DSN over-permissive scope (single DSN for prod+stage): per-DSN narrow-scope + rotation.

- **Migration playbook outline** (8 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via API v0 + sentry-cli: full org export.
  2. Re-create projects + rotate DSNs.
  3. Re-bind SDKs to Oyatie ingest; dual-route 30 days.
  4. Migrate issues + transactions + replays + profiles + crons + releases.
  5. Migrate alert-rules + notification-actions + integrations with credential rotation.
  6. Migrate dashboards + discover-queries + custom-metrics.
  7. Re-bind Sentry AI Autofix + MCP to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger.
  8. Parallel-run 30 days; per-project cutover; Sentry sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `itsm` + `apigw` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `sentry` + `relay` are benchmark alias-only.

### Section D-096 - LogRocket
- Vendor name and category: LogRocket (LogRocket, Inc.) — Session Replay + Frontend Performance Monitoring + Frontend Error Tracking + Conversion Funnel Analytics + Heatmaps + User Journey Analysis + Galileo AI (AI-powered insights + auto-detect issues) + Web Vitals + JavaScript Error Monitoring + Mobile Session Replay (iOS + Android + React Native) + Privacy-First Recording + LogRocket for Customer Support (Co-Browse / Live Session) + Conditional Recording (sample-rule-based) + Funnels + Issues + Insights + Triggers + Dashboards + Integrations (Sentry / Datadog / Slack / Jira / Linear / Intercom / Zendesk / etc.) + Project + Team + SDK (web + mobile + React-Native).
- Coverage tier: B (capability fit on `observability` (frontend session-replay + RUM + frontend-error-tracking + web-vitals + frontend-performance anchor) + `intelligence` (Galileo AI auto-detect — BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4) + `community` (Co-Browse customer-support live-session) + `workflow-engine` (Triggers + Issue-Auto-Action) + `developer-sdk` (LogRocket SDK + REST API) + `apigw` (per-project app-ID) + `compliance` (audit + per-region data-residency US/EU + HIPAA-eligible)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free (1k sessions/mo) → **Bronze**; Team (full session-replay + heatmaps + funnels) → **Silver**; Professional (full + Galileo AI + conditional recording + insights) → **Gold**; Enterprise (full + audit + SSO + EU-residency + HIPAA + dedicated-region + Customer-Managed-Keys + on-prem option) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `observability` (frontend session-replay + RUM + error-tracking + web-vitals + frontend-performance anchor); `intelligence` (Galileo AI); `community` (Co-Browse customer-support); `workflow-engine` (Triggers + Issue-Auto-Action); `developer-sdk` (LogRocket-SDK-compat); `apigw` (app-ID); `compliance` (audit + EU/US + HIPAA-eligible).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (LogRocket model):
  - `Organization` (Org_ID, Name, Plan, Region {US / EU}, SSO-Provider, HIPAA-Eligible).
  - `Project` (Project_ID, Slug, Name, App-ID, Allowed-Domains[], SDK-Version, Privacy-Policy {default-mask / custom-rule}, Sample-Rate, Conditional-Recording-Rules{}, Mobile-Bundle-IDs[], Retention-Days).
  - `Session` (Session_ID, Project-Reference, User-Reference, Start, Duration, Browser, OS, Device, Geo, Pages-Visited[], Errors-Count, Actions-Count, Replay-URL, Privacy-Mask-Snapshot, Activity-Score, Tags{}, Custom-Properties{}).
  - `Event` (Event_ID, Session-Reference, Type {click / page / form-submit / network / log / error / web-vital / custom}, Timestamp, Payload{}).
  - `Network_Request` (Request_ID, Session-Reference, URL, Method, Status, Duration, Headers{redacted}, Body{redacted}, Response{redacted}).
  - `Console_Log` (Log_ID, Session-Reference, Level {debug / info / log / warn / error}, Args[], Timestamp).
  - `JS_Error` (Error_ID, Session-Reference, Message, Stack, Linked-Source-Map, Fingerprint, Times-Seen).
  - `Issue` (Issue_ID, Project-Reference, Fingerprint, Title, Type {JS-error / network / web-vital / custom-event}, Status {active / resolved / ignored}, First-Seen, Last-Seen, Sessions-Affected, Users-Affected, Assignee).
  - `Insight` (Insight_ID, Type {Galileo-detected / manual}, Title, Description, Sessions-Linked[], Severity, Status {new / in-review / dismissed}).
  - `Funnel` (Funnel_ID, Name, Steps[Step_ID → {Event-Match + Condition}], Time-Window, Conversion-Rate, Linked-Sessions[]).
  - `Heatmap` (Heatmap_ID, URL-Pattern, Type {click / scroll / move}, Sessions-Aggregated, Last-Updated).
  - `Trigger` (Trigger_ID, Conditions[], Actions[{type: notify / webhook / record-conditional-session}], Frequency).
  - `Custom_Property` (Property_Name, Type, Identify-Source {SDK-identify / SDK-track}, Cardinality, Owner).
  - `User` (User_ID, External-ID, Traits{}, First-Seen, Last-Seen, Sessions-Count, Companies[]).
  - `Company` (Company_ID, External-ID, Traits{}, Users-Count).
  - `Co_Browse_Session` (CB_Session_ID, Agent-User-Reference, End-User-Session-Reference, Start, End, Annotations[]).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - LogRocket Ingest endpoint (`https://r.lr-ingest.com/i/<app-id>/...` or per-region equivalent): SDK-protocol multipart session payload (events + network + console + DOM snapshots).
  - LogRocket REST API (`https://api.logrocket.com/v1/...`): per-resource read over sessions, issues, insights, funnels, heatmaps, users.
  - GraphQL API (newer): unified query.
  - SDKs: Web JS (`logrocket`), React (`logrocket-react`), React Native (`@logrocket/react-native`), iOS (`LogRocket-iOS`), Android (`logrocket-android`); identify + track + addTag + getSessionURL APIs.
  - Webhook subscription: per-issue + per-insight POST with HMAC-signed payload.
  - Integrations: Sentry / Datadog / Slack / Jira / Linear / Intercom / Zendesk / Segment with per-integration OAuth.

  - "Session Replay Player" — DOM-replay with click + scroll + network + console + error timeline + jump-to-error.
  - "Issues" — fingerprinted error groups with linked sessions.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (12 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `intelligence` + `community` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `compliance` µservices with LogRocket-feature-parity matrix.

- **Failure modes** (12 specific failures):
  - SDK protocol drift on Oyatie RUM ingest: per-SDK-version compat-test matrix.
  - Privacy-rule regression (PII leak in session-replay): per-project mask-policy + Sensitive-Data-Scanner cross-check.
  - DOM-snapshot fidelity loss on re-ingest (CSS / iframe / shadow-DOM gap): per-session rendering-fidelity test on sample.
  - Source-map missing for JS errors (unsymbolicated): per-release dual-upload during cutover.
  - Fingerprint drift on JS-error normalization: per-issue fingerprint-pin.
  - Conditional-recording rule mis-fire (recordings missed or over-recorded): per-rule golden-test + first-72h shadow.
  - User-identify drift (External-ID re-mapping): per-user cross-system identity-pin.
  - Funnel step-match drift (event-name rename): per-funnel step-rewrite + dry-run.
  - Heatmap URL-pattern cardinality blowup: per-pattern cardinality-cap.
  - Co-Browse session consent not preserved: per-session consent-audit + ToS-snapshot.
  - Galileo AI hallucinated insight: per-suggestion source-evidence + dry-run.
  - Integration OAuth token-refresh failure: per-integration token-refresh playbook.

- **Migration playbook outline** (7 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via REST + GraphQL: full org export.
  2. Re-bind SDKs to Oyatie RUM ingest; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate projects + sessions + issues + insights + funnels + heatmaps + triggers + users + companies.
  4. Migrate Co-Browse history.
  5. Migrate integrations with credential rotation.
  6. Re-bind Galileo AI to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger.
  7. Parallel-run 30 days; per-project cutover; LogRocket sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `intelligence` + `community` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `logrocket` + `galileo-ai` are benchmark alias-only.

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - FullStory Ingest endpoint (`https://rs.fullstory.com/rec/<org-id>/...` or `https://edge.fullstory.com/...` per region): SDK-protocol session payload.
  - FullStory REST API v2 (`https://api.fullstory.com/v2/...`): per-resource read over `sessions`, `users`, `segments`, `funnels`, `events`, `pages`, `notes`, `watchpoints`.

  - Webhook subscription: per-Watchpoint POST.
  - Anywhere Embed: iframe-embedded analytics + replay in customer apps.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Session Replay Player" — DOM-replay with timeline + frustration-overlay + event-list.
  - "Search" — query bar with FullStory query DSL.
  - "Segments" — saved query with user-count + session-count.
  - "Funnels" — multi-step conversion with drop-off + linked-sessions.
  - "Heatmaps" — click / move / scroll / attention per URL-pattern.
  - "Page Insights" — auto-detected page friction + load-time + scroll.
  - "Frustration Score" — per-user + per-session aggregated frustration signal.
  - "AI Insights" — auto-detected anomaly / opportunity / friction with linked-sessions.
  - "Watchpoints" — conditional alert with notification.
  - "Notes" — collaboration annotations on session or page.
  - "Anywhere Embed" — embedded analytics in customer apps.

- **Cedar permit shape** (observability + intelligence + workflow + data-pipeline cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<fullstory-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"FullStorySessionView", Oyatie::Action::"FullStorySessionExport",
      Oyatie::Action::"FullStorySegmentCreate", Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryFunnelCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryHeatmapView", Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryPageInsightView",
      Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryWatchpointConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryNoteCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryCustomEventTrack", Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryUserExportPII",
      Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryPrivacyRuleEdit", Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryAIInsightTriage",
      Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryDataDirectSyncConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryAnywhereEmbedConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryAppIDRotate", Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryIntegrationConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"FullStoryAuditExport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::FullStoryApp::"<app-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FullStorySession::"<session-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FullStorySegment::"<segment-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FullStoryWatchpoint::"<wp-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FullStoryDataDirectSync::"<sync-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FullStoryAppID::"<app-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "session_view_unmasked" || principal.role == "session_replay_pii_authorized") &&
    (resource.kind != "session_export_pii" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "user_export_pii" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "privacy_rule_edit_relax" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "data_direct_sync_configure_external" || context.warehouse_in_egress_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "anywhere_embed_configure_external" || context.embed_origin_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "ai_insight_triage" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "watchpoint_destructive_action" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "appid_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_export" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "integration_configure_external" || context.integration_target_in_allowlist == true)
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-FullStory (BAA-eligible Enterprise + per-app PHI-mask via Element-Block/Mask + 7-yr retention); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region org residency US/EU/APAC + DSAR via user-export + right-to-erasure via user-delete + consent-aware recording via `FullStory.consent(false)`); SOC-2 (audit + access-review); PCI-DSS (PAN-masking via Element-Mask + restricted session-view); EU-AI-Act (AI Insights + Anomaly Detection conformance ledger).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `fullstory.organization` → `oya-tenant-account`.
