- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (12 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` + `compliance` µservices with FullStory-feature-parity matrix.
  2. Export FullStory org via REST + GraphQL: apps + sessions (last 30d) + page-views + element-events + frustration-signals + users + segments + funnels + heatmaps + page-insights + watchpoints + notes + custom-events + AI-insights + data-direct-syncs + audit + integrations.
  3. Re-bind FullStory SDKs to Oyatie RUM ingest (FullStory-protocol-compatible); dual-route 30 days.
  4. Per-App: re-create with Oyatie RUM application; preserve privacy-policy + element-rules.
  5. Per-Session (last 30d): re-ingest with DOM-snapshot + frustration-signal preserved.
  6. Per-Segment + Funnel + Heatmap + Page-Insight: import filter + URL-pattern + step-spec; transpile FullStory query DSL.
  7. Per-Watchpoint: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine event-rule.
  8. Per-AI-Insight: import as Oyatie intelligence detected-issue with confidence + linked-sessions.
  9. Per-User + Custom-Event + Note: import identifier + properties + annotation.
  10. Per-Data-Direct-Sync: re-deploy as Oyatie data-pipeline warehouse-sync with destination credential rotation.
  11. Re-bind AI Insights + Anomaly Detection to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger.
  12. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-app cutover via app-ID-router; FullStory subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (12 specific failures):
  - SDK protocol drift on Oyatie RUM ingest: per-SDK-version compat-test matrix.
  - Element-Block/Mask rule regression (PII leak): per-app privacy-rule + Sensitive-Data-Scanner cross-check.
  - DOM-snapshot fidelity loss on re-ingest: per-session rendering-fidelity test on sample.
  - Frustration-Signal detection algorithm drift (different rage-click threshold): per-signal-type baseline + reviewer.
  - FullStory query DSL semantic gap (e.g., `freq`, `count` with nested match): per-segment transpile fidelity test.
  - Funnel step-match drift on event-name rename: per-funnel step-rewrite.
  - Heatmap URL-pattern cardinality blowup: per-pattern cap.
  - Data-Direct sync schema drift (destination schema-mismatch on cutover): per-sync schema-version pin + dual-write 30 days.
  - User-identify drift (External-ID re-mapping): per-user identity-pin.
  - Consent state not preserved (`FullStory.consent(false)` ignored): per-user consent-audit + recording-suppression validation.
  - AI Insight hallucination: per-suggestion source-evidence + dry-run.
  - Anywhere Embed cross-origin / CSP collision: per-embed origin-allowlist + CSP-policy validation.

- **Migration playbook outline** (7 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via REST + GraphQL: full org export.
  2. Re-bind SDKs to Oyatie RUM ingest; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate apps + sessions + page-views + element-events + frustration-signals.
  4. Migrate users + segments + funnels + heatmaps + page-insights + watchpoints + notes + custom-events.
  5. Migrate AI Insights + Data Direct syncs with credential rotation.
  6. Re-bind AI Insights + Anomaly Detection to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger.
  7. Parallel-run 30 days; per-app cutover; FullStory sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- Vendor name and category: Mixpanel, Inc. — Product Analytics platform: Event tracking + User-centric data model + Funnels + Retention + Flows + Cohorts + Insights + Boards + Signal (predictive analytics + correlation analysis) + Notifications + Experiments (A/B testing) + Group Analytics (B2B account-level) + Lexicon (data governance / dictionary) + Mixpanel Warehouse Connectors (Snowflake / BigQuery / Databricks / Redshift) + Mirror (warehouse-native analytics) + Reverse-ETL (Send-Data to Salesforce / HubSpot / Iterable / Customer.io / Braze / etc.) + Identity Management (Simplified Identity Merge) + Session Replay (newer feature) + Engage (user list + push / email) + Live View + Customer Journey Analytics + Mixpanel AI (NL query assistant).

Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free → **Bronze**; Growth → **Silver**; Enterprise (full + Signal + Group Analytics + Experiments + Session Replay + Mixpanel AI) → **Gold**; Enterprise + Customer-Managed-Keys + EU-residency + HIPAA-eligible + dedicated-region + Warehouse-Connectors-bidirectional + SSO/SAML + Audit-Stream → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `observability` (product-analytics event-store + funnels + retention + flows + cohorts + experiments + group-analytics + session-replay anchor); `intelligence` (Signal + correlation + Mixpanel AI); `workflow-engine` (Notifications + Experiments + Reverse-ETL); `developer-sdk` (Mixpanel-protocol-compatible SDK ingest); `data-pipeline` (Warehouse Connectors + Mirror + Reverse-ETL); `apigw` (project-token + service-account + API-secret); `compliance` (audit + EU/US residency).

  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-Mixpanel (BAA-eligible Enterprise + per-project PHI-mask via property-filter + 7-yr retention); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region project residency US/EU + DSAR via `/api/2.0/delete` + right-to-erasure); SOC-2 (audit + access-review + SA rotation); PCI-DSS (PAN-masking at SDK ingest + restricted insight); EU-AI-Act (Signal + Mixpanel AI conformance ledger).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `mixpanel.organization` → `oya-tenant-account`.
  - `mixpanel.project` → `oya-observability-product-analytics-project`.
  - `mixpanel.event` → `oya-observability-product-event`.
  - `mixpanel.user_profile` → `oya-observability-end-user-profile`.
  - `mixpanel.group_profile` → `oya-observability-end-user-company` (B2B group analytics).
  - `mixpanel.cohort` → `oya-observability-user-segment`.
  - `mixpanel.funnel` → `oya-observability-funnel`.
  - `mixpanel.retention` → `oya-observability-retention-cohort`.
  - `mixpanel.flow` → `oya-observability-event-flow`.
  - `mixpanel.insight` → `oya-observability-product-analytics-insight`.
  - `mixpanel.board` → `oya-observability-dashboard`.
  - `mixpanel.signal` → `oya-intelligence-predictive-analytics-run`.
  - `mixpanel.experiment` → `oya-experimentation-ab-test`.
  - `mixpanel.notification` → `oya-workflow-engine-notification-rule`.
  - `mixpanel.lexicon` → `oya-observability-event-dictionary`.
  - `mixpanel.warehouse_connector` → `oya-data-pipeline-warehouse-sync`.
  - `mixpanel.reverse_etl_destination` → `oya-data-pipeline-reverse-etl-destination`.
  - `mixpanel.session_replay` → `oya-observability-rum-session-replay`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (14 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` + `compliance` µservices with Mixpanel-feature-parity matrix (events + user-profiles + group-profiles + cohorts + funnels + retention + flows + insights + boards + signal + experiments + notifications + lexicon + warehouse-connectors + reverse-ETL + session-replay + AI).
  2. Export Mixpanel project via Export API + REST: events (last 90d) + user-profiles + group-profiles + cohorts + funnels + retention + flows + insights + boards + signals + experiments + notifications + lexicon + warehouse-connectors + reverse-ETL + session-replays + audit + service-accounts.
  3. Re-bind Mixpanel SDKs to Oyatie product-analytics ingest (Mixpanel-protocol-compatible); dual-route 30 days; preserve `$distinct_id` + `$insert_id` semantics.
  4. Per-Project: re-create with Oyatie product-analytics project; rotate token + service-account.
  5. Per-Event-Stream: re-ingest via Mixpanel-Import-compatible historical-load (last 90d).
  6. Per-User-Profile + Group-Profile: import with properties preserved.
  7. Per-Cohort: import definition; per-cohort shadow-evaluation on 30-day sample.
  8. Per-Funnel + Retention + Flow + Insight + Board: import spec; per-artifact rendering-fidelity test.
  9. Per-Signal-Run: archive correlation + predictive-cohort history.
  10. Per-Experiment: import variants + metrics + cohort-filter + status; preserve statistical-significance audit.
  11. Per-Notification: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine notification-rule.
  12. Per-Lexicon: import event + property catalog with owner + tag.
  13. Per-Warehouse-Connector + Reverse-ETL: re-deploy with destination credential rotation to OpenBao.
  14. Re-bind Signal + Mixpanel AI to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger; parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-project cutover via token-router; Mixpanel subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (13 specific failures):
  - SDK protocol drift on Oyatie product-analytics ingest: per-SDK-version compat-test matrix.
  - `$distinct_id` Simplified-vs-Original identity-merge drift (user-profile mis-merge post-cutover): per-project identity-mode-pin + dual-mode shadow.
  - `$insert_id` dedup-key collision (events double-counted): per-event dedup-window validation.
  - Cohort definition semantic gap (`freq`, `time-window`, group-event filters): per-cohort transpile fidelity test.
  - Funnel `Within-N-Days/Hours + Order-Sensitive` semantic gap: per-funnel re-run on 30-day sample with output diff.
  - Retention `Born-Event vs Return-Event` mis-pair: per-retention configuration audit.
  - Experiment sample-allocation drift on re-launch (variant population skew): per-experiment allocation-pin + chi-square test.
  - Lexicon Hidden-flag drift (PII-marked properties exposed post-cutover): per-property flag-pin + audit on un-hide.
  - Warehouse-Connector schema-drift on destination rename: per-connector schema-version pin + dual-write window.
  - Reverse-ETL destination OAuth refresh failure: per-destination token-refresh playbook.
  - Session-Replay PII unmask on re-bind: per-project mask-policy + Sensitive-Data-Scanner cross-check.
  - Signal correlation output drift (different stat kernel): per-run baseline + reviewer.
  - Mixpanel AI hallucinated query: per-suggestion source-evidence + dry-run.

- **Migration playbook outline** (8 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Export + REST API: events + profiles + cohorts + funnels + retention + flows + insights + boards + signals + experiments + notifications + lexicon + connectors + reverse-ETL + audit.
  2. Re-bind SDKs to Oyatie ingest; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate events via Import-API-compat historical-load.
  4. Migrate user-profiles + group-profiles + cohorts + funnels + retention + flows + insights + boards + experiments + notifications + lexicon.
  5. Migrate Warehouse-Connectors + Reverse-ETL with credential rotation.
  6. Migrate Session-Replays.
  7. Re-bind Signal + Mixpanel AI to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4).
  8. Parallel-run 30 days; per-project cutover; Mixpanel sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `mixpanel` + `signal` + `mixpanel-ai` are benchmark alias-only.

- Vendor name and category: Amplitude, Inc. — Amplitude Analytics + Amplitude Experiment (A/B testing + feature flags) + Amplitude CDP (Customer Data Platform: Identity Resolution + Audiences + Destinations) + Amplitude Data (data governance / tracking plans) + Amplitude Recommend (personalization + ML-driven recommendations) + Amplitude AI (AI-driven Insights + Ask Amplitude NL assistant) + Amplitude Session Replay + Path-finder + Funnel Analysis + Retention Analysis + Cohort Analysis + Notebooks + Dashboards + Pathfinder + Compass (predictive analytics) + Microscope (deep-dive) + Engagement Matrix + Stickiness + Behavioral Cohorts + Govern (taxonomy enforcement) + Amplitude Mobile/Web/Server SDKs + Amplitude Iteratively (taxonomy-as-code) + Amplitude Recommend.

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:

  - Amplitude Snowflake-Native App: bidirectional warehouse query without data egress.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Event Segmentation" — event + breakdown + filter line/bar chart.
  - "Funnel Analysis" — multi-step with ordered/any-order + breakdown.
  - "Retention Analysis" — N-day / bracket retention with breakdown.
  - "Pathfinder" — sequential event-path forward/backward with drop-off.
  - "Lifecycle" — new / current / dormant / resurrected user split.
  - "Stickiness" — DAU/WAU/MAU + sticky-user ratio.
  - "Compass" — predictive cohort + conversion-likelihood scoring.
  - "Microscope" — deep-dive on chart data point.
  - "Impact" — change-over-time attribution.
  - "Behavioral Cohorts" — saved query + auto-refresh + sync-destinations.
  - "Notebooks" — narrative investigation with embedded charts + cohorts.
  - "Experiment" — A/B test with variant + metric + statistical-significance.
  - "Govern" — taxonomy enforcement with required-properties + lint-rules.
  - "Ask Amplitude" — NL query assistant + insight generation.

### Section D-100 - Heap (Heap Analytics)
- Vendor name and category: Heap Inc. (Contentsquare-acquired) — Heap Analytics + Autocapture (Heap's defining feature: codeless retroactive event capture of all user interactions: clicks, form-submits, page-views, taps, swipes) + Virtual Events + Heap Snapshots (saved analyses) + Heap Charts + Funnels + Journeys + Retention + Segmentation + Cohorts + Behavioral Segmentation + Heap CDP-style Sync to BigQuery / Snowflake / Redshift / S3 + Heap IQ (AI insights — recently rebranded under Contentsquare AI) + Session Replay (Contentsquare integration) + Hot Path Analysis + Engagement Score + Conversion Pulse + Anomalies + Heap (warehouse-native) + Heap iOS / Android / Web SDK + Heap Insights + Definitions / Property Renaming / Event Renaming.
- Coverage tier: B (capability fit on `observability` (product-analytics anchor + autocapture-uniquely + funnels + journeys + retention + cohorts + engagement-score + anomalies anchor — Heap is the autocapture-pioneer category leader) + `intelligence` (Heap IQ + Contentsquare AI + anomaly detection — BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4) + `workflow-engine` (Alerts + Anomaly notifications) + `developer-sdk` (Heap SDK + REST API + Heap Connect) + `data-pipeline` (Heap warehouse-native sync) + `apigw` (per-project env-ID + API token) + `compliance` (audit + per-region residency US/EU)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free → **Bronze**; Growth → **Silver**; Pro (full Autocapture + Journeys + Anomalies + Heap Connect) → **Gold**; Premier (full + Heap IQ + Contentsquare Session Replay + dedicated-region + EU-residency + HIPAA-eligible + Customer-Managed-Keys + cross-org governance) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `observability` (product-analytics + autocapture + funnels + journeys + retention + cohorts + engagement-score + anomalies anchor); `intelligence` (Heap IQ + Contentsquare AI); `workflow-engine` (Alerts + Anomaly notifications); `developer-sdk` (Heap-SDK-protocol-compat ingest); `data-pipeline` (Heap-warehouse-native sync); `apigw` (env-ID + token); `compliance` (audit + EU/US residency).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Heap Ingest endpoint (`https://heapanalytics.com/h?` for browser autocapture; `https://heapanalytics.com/api/track` for server-side API tracking): per-event ingest with env-ID + identity token.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Autocapture" — codeless DOM-selector event capture; events created retroactively without code changes.
  - "Definitions" — virtual-event editor over autocapture DOM-selectors with preview.
  - "Charts" — trend + funnel + journey + retention + cohort chart builder.
  - "Funnels" — multi-step with breakdown + conversion-window.
  - "Journeys" — top-N-path sankey with drop-off + branch.
  - "Retention" — N-day / bracket with breakdown.
  - "Cohorts" — saved query + behavioral segmentation.
  - "Engagement Score" — per-user weighted score.
  - "Anomalies" — auto-detected event-metric spikes/drops with notification.
  - "Heap IQ" — AI-driven ranked-feature + friction + opportunity insights.
  - "Heap Connect" — warehouse-native + warehouse-export sync.

- **Cedar permit shape** (observability + intelligence + workflow + data-pipeline cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<heap-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"HeapEventIngest", Oyatie::Action::"HeapAutocaptureToggle",
      Oyatie::Action::"HeapVirtualEventCreate", Oyatie::Action::"HeapVirtualEventEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"HeapCohortCreate", Oyatie::Action::"HeapCohortDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"HeapFunnelCreate", Oyatie::Action::"HeapJourneyQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"HeapRetentionQuery", Oyatie::Action::"HeapChartQuery",
      Oyatie::Action::"HeapReportEdit", Oyatie::Action::"HeapEngagementScoreView",
      Oyatie::Action::"HeapAnomalyRuleConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"HeapConnectSyncConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"HeapConnectSyncTrigger", Oyatie::Action::"HeapIQInvoke",
      Oyatie::Action::"HeapUserIdentityReset", Oyatie::Action::"HeapDefinitionRollback",
      Oyatie::Action::"HeapEnvTokenRotate", Oyatie::Action::"HeapAuditExport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::HeapEnvironment::"<env-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HeapVirtualEvent::"<virtual-event-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HeapCohort::"<cohort-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HeapFunnel::"<funnel-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HeapAnomalyRule::"<rule-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HeapConnectSync::"<sync-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::HeapEnvToken::"<token-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "event_ingest_high_volume" || context.daily_quota_remaining > 0) &&
    (resource.kind != "autocapture_toggle" || principal.role in ["product_analytics_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "cohort_delete" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "virtual_event_edit_breaking" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "heap_connect_sync_configure_external" || context.warehouse_in_egress_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "heap_iq_invoke" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "anomaly_rule_destructive_action" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "user_identity_reset" || principal.role == "privacy_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "definition_rollback" || principal.role in ["product_analytics_admin", "data_governance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "env_token_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_export" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "report_share_external" || context.report_share_target_in_allowlist == true)
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: HIPAA-Heap (BAA-eligible Premier + per-env PHI-mask via autocapture-exclusion-rule + 7-yr retention); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-region env residency US/EU + DSAR via user-delete + right-to-erasure); SOC-2 (audit + access-review + token rotation); PCI-DSS (PAN-masking via autocapture-exclusion + DOM-redaction); EU-AI-Act (Heap IQ + Contentsquare AI conformance ledger).

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (13 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `observability` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` + `compliance` µservices with Heap-feature-parity matrix (autocapture + virtual-events + funnels + journeys + retention + cohorts + engagement-score + anomalies + Heap-+ Heap-IQ + session-replay).
  2. Export Heap org via REST + Heap Connect: environments + auto-events (last 90d) + virtual-events + event-definitions + users + accounts + sessions + cohorts + funnels + journeys + retention + charts + reports + engagement-scores + anomaly-rules + heap-connect-syncs + heap-iq-insights + definition-edit-history + audit + tokens.
  3. Re-bind Heap SDKs to Oyatie product-analytics ingest (Heap-protocol-compatible with autocapture DOM-selector capture); dual-route 30 days; preserve `heap_anonymous_id` + `identified_user_id`.
  4. Per-Environment: re-create with rotated env-token; preserve autocapture-enabled + privacy-settings.
  5. Per-Auto-Event (last 90d): re-ingest with DOM-selector + element-properties preserved.
  6. Per-Virtual-Event + Event-Definition: import multi-step DOM-selector + property-filter; per-virtual-event golden-test on autocapture sample.
  7. Per-User + Account + Session: import identity + properties + memberships; preserve anonymous-to-identified merge.
  8. Per-Cohort + Funnel + Journey + Retention + Chart + Report: import spec; per-artifact rendering-fidelity test.
  9. Per-Engagement-Score: recalculate on Oyatie observability; per-user score-diff test.
  10. Per-Anomaly-Rule: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine event-rule + intelligence anomaly-detector; per-rule shadow-evaluation.
  11. Per-Heap-Connect-Sync: re-deploy as Oyatie data-pipeline warehouse-sync; warehouse-native vs export-based mode preserved; rotate destination credentials.
  12. Re-bind Heap IQ + Contentsquare AI to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger.
  13. Parallel-run 30 days dual-ingest + dual-query; per-env cutover via env-token-router; Heap subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (13 specific failures):
  - Autocapture DOM-selector format drift (Oyatie selector engine doesn't match Heap's): per-environment selector-syntax compat test on golden DOM samples.
  - Retroactive event capture gap (Oyatie can't reproduce events from past DOM that wasn't captured at the time): per-env historical-data-only-from-cutover policy + audit on virtual-event creation against pre-cutover dates.
  - Virtual-event DOM-selector multi-step join semantic gap: per-virtual-event transpile fidelity test.
  - Identity-merge drift on anonymous-to-identified user transition: per-user identity-merge dual-mode shadow.
  - Cohort `did / did not / time-since / count-of` semantic gap: per-cohort transpile fidelity test.
  - Engagement-Score calculation-input drift (different weight per event): per-user score-diff test + reviewer comparison.
  - Anomaly-rule sensitivity calibration drift (false-positive storm post-migration): per-rule first-72h shadow + sensitivity-tune.
  - Heap-warehouse-native query compatibility (Snowflake-Native-App-vs-Oyatie-Native-App): per-sync mode-pin + cross-validation.
  - Definitions edit-history audit gap: per-edit dual-write audit during cutover.
  - User-delete (DSAR) async-completion: per-delete completion verification.
  - Autocapture privacy-leak (PII captured in DOM): per-env autocapture-exclusion-rule + Sensitive-Data-Scanner cross-check.
  - Heap IQ hallucinated insight: per-suggestion source-evidence + dry-run.
  - Multi-environment migration: per-env separate lane + cross-env user-identity merge.

- **Migration playbook outline** (8 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Heap REST + Heap Connect: full org export.
  2. Re-bind SDKs to Oyatie ingest with autocapture support; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate auto-events + virtual-events + event-definitions via historical-load.
  4. Migrate users + accounts + sessions + cohorts + funnels + journeys + retention + charts + reports.
  5. Migrate engagement-scores + anomaly-rules with shadow-eval.
  6. Migrate Heap-syncs with credential rotation.
  7. Re-bind Heap IQ + Contentsquare AI to Oyatie `intelligence` (BYOK per ADR-0255 §D-4); EU-AI-Act ledger.
  8. Parallel-run 30 days; per-env cutover; Heap sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `observability` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `heap` + `heap-iq` + `heap-connect` + `contentsquare-ai` are benchmark alias-only. Autocapture is a feature-pattern preserved as `oya-observability-autocapture-discriminator` projection on the canonical product-event entity.

### Section D-101 - Stripe
- Vendor name and category: Stripe Inc. — Stripe Payments + Stripe Billing (recurring + usage-based) + Stripe (multi-party / marketplace payouts) + Stripe Invoicing + Stripe Checkout (hosted) + Stripe Elements (embedded UI) + Stripe Payment Links + Stripe Terminal (in-person + Tap-to-Pay) + Stripe Radar (fraud) + Stripe Sigma (SQL over Stripe data) + Stripe Atlas (incorporation) + Stripe Issuing (card-issuing) + Stripe Treasury (BaaS) + Stripe Capital (lending) + Stripe Tax (automated sales-tax / VAT / GST) + Stripe Identity (KYC verification) + Stripe Climate + Stripe Financial Connections + Stripe Revenue Recognition + Stripe Data Pipeline (warehouse sync) + Stripe CLI + Stripe Dashboard + Stripe Workbench (developer tooling).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `cloud-billing` (payment intent + invoice + subscription + customer balance + dunning + revenue-recognition anchor — Stripe is the developer-payments category leader) + `marketplace` (Stripe multi-party + Issuing + Treasury) + `compliance` (PCI-DSS Level 1 + Strong-Customer-Authentication + 3-D-Secure-2 + PSD2 + SCA + Stripe Tax + Stripe Identity KYC) + `intelligence` (Stripe Radar ML fraud-scoring + Sigma SQL) + `workflow-engine` (webhooks + Workflows + Schedules) + `developer-sdk` (Stripe API + CLI + SDKs across 9+ languages + Elements) + `data-pipeline` (Stripe Data Pipeline → Snowflake / Redshift / BigQuery) + `apigw` (per-account restricted + publishable + secret keys + webhook signing)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Standard pay-as-you-go → **Silver**; Plus (volume-pricing + IC+) → **Gold**; Enterprise / Premium (dedicated AM + Premier-Support + 99.999%-SLA + dedicated-account-region + Stripe-Data-Pipeline + Sigma + advanced-Radar + Custom-+ Treasury + Issuing + Atlas + EU/UK/JP/SG/AU residency + PCI-Level-1 attestation share) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `cloud-billing` (payments + invoice + subscription + dunning + revenue-recognition anchor); `marketplace` (multi-party + Issuing); `compliance` (PCI + PSD2 + SCA + 3DS2 + Stripe-Tax + Identity-KYC); `intelligence` (Radar fraud + Sigma analytics); `workflow-engine` (webhooks + Schedules); `developer-sdk` (Stripe-API-protocol-compat); `data-pipeline` (Data-Pipeline warehouse sync); `apigw` (key + webhook-signing).

  ```
    (resource.kind != "subscription_cancel_at_period_end_false" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "dispute_respond" || principal.role in ["billing_admin", "disputes_specialist"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "payout_manual" || principal.role == "treasury_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "connect_account_create_custom" || context.kyc_complete == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "issuing_card_create" || context.cardholder_kyc_complete == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "treasury_outbound_payment" || (principal.role == "treasury_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "radar_rule_block_destructive" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "api_key_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "data_pipeline_external_warehouse" || context.warehouse_in_egress_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "sigma_query_pii" || principal.role == "data_governance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "tax_registration_external_jurisdiction" || context.tax_advisor_approval == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "webhook_endpoint_external" || context.webhook_target_in_allowlist == true)
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: PCI-DSS-Stripe (Level-1 attestation share + SAQ-A or SAQ-A-EP via Elements + per-tenant tokenization-only); PSD2-SCA (EU 3-D-Secure-2 + exemption-flow); GDPR + KR-PIPA (EU-residency + DSAR via customer-delete + right-to-erasure ledger); SOC-2 (audit + access-review + key-rotation); HIPAA-Stripe (limited — Stripe is not BAA-eligible for cardholder data; PHI must not be in `metadata`); Stripe-Tax (per-jurisdiction registration + automated filing); EU-AI-Act (Radar ML scoring conformance ledger).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `stripe.account` → `oya-tenant-payment-account` (Connect-account distinction preserved).
  - `stripe.customer` → `oya-cloud-billing-customer` (Stripe `metadata` preserved as `oya-cloud-billing-customer-metadata`).
  - `stripe.payment_method` → `oya-cloud-billing-payment-instrument` with type-discriminator.
  - `stripe.payment_intent` → `oya-cloud-billing-payment-intent` (lifecycle states preserved).
  - `stripe.setup_intent` → `oya-cloud-billing-payment-setup-intent`.
  - `stripe.charge` → `oya-cloud-billing-charge` (Stripe outcome preserved as `oya-cloud-billing-fraud-outcome`).
  - `stripe.refund` → `oya-cloud-billing-refund`.
  - `stripe.dispute` → `oya-cloud-billing-dispute` with evidence-bundle.
  - `stripe.invoice` → `oya-cloud-billing-invoice` (Stripe hosted-invoice-URL preserved).
  - `stripe.subscription` → `oya-cloud-billing-subscription` (Stripe billing-cycle-anchor preserved).
  - `stripe.product` + `stripe.price` → `oya-cloud-billing-product` + `oya-cloud-billing-price`.
  - `stripe.coupon` + `stripe.promotion_code` → `oya-cloud-billing-discount` + `oya-cloud-billing-promotion-code`.
  - `stripe.payout` → `oya-cloud-billing-payout`.
  - `stripe.transfer` → `oya-marketplace-multi-party-transfer`.
  - `stripe.connect_account` → `oya-marketplace-merchant-account` (sub-account model preserved).
  - `stripe.issuing_card` → `oya-marketplace-issued-card`.
  - `stripe.treasury_financial_account` → `oya-marketplace-financial-account` (BaaS).
  - `stripe.radar_rule` → `oya-intelligence-fraud-rule` + `oya-workflow-engine-event-rule`.
  - `stripe.webhook_endpoint` → `oya-workflow-engine-webhook-subscriber`.
  - `stripe.tax_registration` → `oya-compliance-tax-registration`.
  - `stripe.api_key` → `oya-apigw-api-key` (publishable + secret + restricted preserved).

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (15 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `cloud-billing` + `marketplace` + `compliance` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` µservices with Stripe-feature-parity matrix (payment-intent + setup-intent + invoice + subscription + dispute + payout + transfer + connect-account + issuing + treasury + tax + radar + sigma + data-pipeline + webhooks + elements + checkout).
  2. Export Stripe account via REST: customers + payment-methods + payment-intents (last 13mo for dispute-window) + charges + refunds + disputes + invoices + subscriptions + products + prices + coupons + payouts + transfers + connect-accounts + issuing-cards + treasury-accounts + radar-rules + webhook-endpoints + api-keys + tax-registrations + sigma-saved-queries.
  3. Re-bind merchant integrations: Stripe-API-protocol-compatible Oyatie endpoint accepting same Idempotency-Key + Stripe-Version header semantics; dual-route 30 days; preserve `metadata` round-trip.
  4. Per-Customer: re-create with rotated payment-method-tokens (network-token re-vault via PCI-DSS-Level-1 compliant token-vault).
  5. Per-Payment-Method: re-tokenize via network-token + per-issuer 3-D-Secure-2 re-authentication where required.
  6. Per-Subscription: import billing-cycle-anchor + trial-end + items + collection-method; per-sub next-renewal smoke test.
  7. Per-Invoice (open + draft): import lines + tax + due-date; preserve hosted-invoice-URL via redirect.
  8. Per-Dispute (last 13mo): import evidence bundle; ensure response-window not breached.
  9. Per-Payout schedule: re-establish bank-account-verification + payout-cadence.
  10. Per-Connect-Account: re-onboard via Oyatie KYC flow (Standard/Express/Custom variants preserved); per-account capability-matrix shadow.
  11. Per-Issuing-Card: re-issue with cardholder-KYC preserved; PAN-rotation per PCI.
  12. Per-Treasury-Financial-Account: re-provision with BaaS-provider re-binding.
  13. Per-Radar-Rule: transpile predicate to Oyatie `intelligence` fraud-rule; per-rule shadow-eval on last-30d charges.
  14. Per-Webhook-Endpoint: re-register with new signing-secret; dual-route 30 days; per-endpoint replay-test.
  15. Per-Tax-Registration: re-bind to Oyatie tax-engine; per-jurisdiction filing-cadence preserved; parallel-run 30 days; per-account cutover via API-key-router; Stripe contract sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (17 specific failures):
  - Idempotency-Key replay collision during dual-route (Stripe-side already-succeeded, Oyatie-side processing): per-request idempotency-router with shared store.
  - Network-token migration loss (re-vaulting fails on certain issuers): per-card BIN-coverage pre-check.
  - 3-D-Secure-2 challenge-frictionless flow drift (Oyatie issuer-config differs from Stripe's): per-issuer challenge-fidelity test.
  - PCI scope expansion if cardholder data leaks to logs during migration: per-log automated PAN-scanner + SAQ-A boundary preservation.
  - Subscription billing-cycle-anchor off-by-one (Stripe uses UTC, Oyatie may use tenant-tz): per-sub anchor-normalization audit.
  - Invoice numbering sequence break (Stripe uses sequential per-account; Oyatie must continue or branch): per-account number-policy decision + audit.
  - Dispute evidence upload size/format drift: per-dispute evidence-bundle compat test.
  - Connect-account capability mismatch (Stripe Custom-accounts have granular capabilities; Oyatie marketplace must mirror): per-capability shadow.
  - Issuing card-PAN re-issuance breaks downstream cardholder integrations: per-card cardholder-comms playbook.
  - Treasury BaaS-provider change requires re-KYC for all financial accounts: per-account re-onboard window + dual-provider window.
  - Radar rule false-positive storm post-migration (different scoring distribution): per-rule first-72h shadow + sensitivity-tune.
  - Webhook delivery-ordering not preserved across providers: per-endpoint Stripe-Signature-equivalent HMAC + replay-window.
  - Stripe-Sigma SQL dialect drift (Stripe uses Presto-subset): per-query SQL-port test.
  - Stripe Tax jurisdiction-rate drift mid-migration: per-jurisdiction snapshot-pinning during cutover window.
  - Stripe-on-behalf-of vs direct-charge semantic gap: per-charge model-pin during migration.
  - Stripe-API-version pinning drift (consumer hardcoded a version Oyatie didn't replicate): per-merchant version-pin audit + shim.
  - Stripe-Data-Pipeline schema-evolution gap: per-table schema-version-pin.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Stripe REST API: full account export with all child resources.
  2. Re-bind merchant integrations to Oyatie Stripe-API-compatible endpoint; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate customers + payment-methods + network-tokens with PCI-Level-1 vault.
  4. Migrate subscriptions + invoices + products + prices; preserve billing-cycle-anchor.
  5. Migrate open disputes + ensure response-window honored.
  6. Migrate accounts + re-onboard via Oyatie KYC.
  7. Migrate Issuing + Treasury accounts + re-bind BaaS provider.
  8. Migrate Radar rules + Tax registrations + Webhook endpoints with shadow-eval.
  9. Re-bind Sigma + Data-Pipeline to Oyatie observability + warehouse.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days; per-account cutover; Stripe sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `cloud-billing` + `marketplace` + `compliance` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `stripe` + `connector` + `radar` + `sigma` + `issuing` + `treasury` + `atlas` + `climate` are benchmark alias-only. Stripe-API-protocol compatibility is preserved at the `apigw` ingress as a compat-shim, not a new canonical surface.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-102 - Adyen
- Vendor name and category: Adyen N.V. — Adyen Platform + Adyen for Platforms (multi-party marketplace) + Adyen Online Payments + Adyen Point-of-Sale (in-person Terminals + Tap-to-Pay) + Adyen Unified Commerce + Adyen Risk (RevenueProtect ML fraud) + Adyen Issuing + Adyen Capital (lending) + Adyen Authentication (3-D-Secure-2 / Network-Token-Service) + Adyen Data + Adyen Customer Area (back-office UI) + Adyen MarketPay (legacy → Adyen for Platforms) + Adyen Dispute Manager + Adyen RevenueAccelerate (retry / network-token / account-updater) + Adyen Pay-By-Link + Adyen Drop-in + Adyen Components + Adyen Webhooks + Adyen API.
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `cloud-billing` (payment + capture + refund + recurring + tokenization — Adyen is the global enterprise-payments category leader alongside Stripe; differentiated by single-platform acquiring across 100+ currencies and direct local-acquiring relationships in EU/APAC/LATAM) + `marketplace` (Adyen-for-Platforms multi-party + split-payments + Issuing + Capital) + `compliance` (PCI-DSS Level 1 + PSD2 + SCA + 3DS2 + EU-Acquirer-License + Singapore-MAS + JP-METI + global-AML) + `intelligence` (RevenueProtect + RetryAccelerate + Network-Token + Account-Updater) + `workflow-engine` (webhooks + Notifications) + `developer-sdk` (Adyen API + Drop-in + Components + SDKs) + `data-pipeline` (Adyen Data Export to S3 / Azure Blob / GCS) + `apigw` (per-merchant-account + sub-merchant + API-key + HMAC)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Standard → **Gold**; Enterprise (dedicated-AM + Premier-Support + 99.999%-SLA + dedicated-acquiring + EU-EEA-acquirer-license + Singapore + JP + global-AML attestations + Adyen-Data warehouse + RevenueProtect-tuning + Capital + Issuing) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `cloud-billing` (payment + capture + refund + recurring + tokenization anchor); `marketplace` (multi-party + split); `compliance` (PCI + PSD2 + SCA + acquirer-license + AML); `intelligence` (RevenueProtect ML fraud + retry + network-token + account-updater); `workflow-engine` (webhooks + Notifications); `developer-sdk` (Adyen-API-protocol-compat); `data-pipeline` (Adyen Data Export); `apigw` (per-merchant + sub-merchant key + HMAC).

  1. Inventory via Adyen Management + Classic + Checkout APIs: full export.
  2. Re-bind merchant integrations to Oyatie Adyen-API-compatible endpoint; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate merchant + sub-merchant accounts with KYC re-onboarding.
  4. Migrate payment-methods + network-tokens + recurring-details.
  5. Migrate last-13mo payments + captures + refunds for dispute-window.
  6. Migrate open + recent disputes with defense-bundles.
  7. Migrate risk-rules + account-updater + webhook-configurations with shadow-eval.
  8. Migrate payouts + account-holders + accounts + transfers.
  9. Migrate issuing-cards + capital-accounts.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days; per-merchant cutover; Adyen sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `cloud-billing` + `marketplace` + `compliance` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `adyen` + `revenueprotect` + `revenueaccelerate` + `account-updater` + `network-token` + `pay-by-link` + `customer-area` are benchmark alias-only. Multi-acquirer routing preserved as `oya-cloud-billing-acquirer-routing-policy` projection.

### Section D-103 - Square / Block
- Vendor name and category: Block Inc. (parent of Square + Cash App + Afterpay + TIDAL) — Square Point-of-Sale + Square for Retail + Square for Restaurants + Square Appointments + Square Online + Square Invoices + Square Payroll + Square Banking (Checking + Savings + Debit Card) + Square Loans (formerly Square Capital) + Square Marketing + Square Loyalty + Square Gift Cards + Square Customer Directory + Square Dashboard + Square Hardware (Square Register + Square Terminal + Square Stand + Square Reader) + Square API + Square Webhooks + Cash App Pay + Afterpay BNPL + Square Developer Tools.
- Coverage tier: B (capability fit on `cloud-billing` (payment + invoice + subscription + tip-handling — Square is the SMB-and-retail category leader, integrated POS + payments + commerce + banking; differentiated by full-stack SMB + hardware-software unification) + `marketplace` (Square-Online catalog + multi-location + commerce-platform) + `compliance` (PCI-DSS Level 1 + SCA + Square-Banking-FDIC-via-partner) + `intelligence` (Square Loyalty + Customer Directory analytics + Square Marketing AI) + `workflow-engine` (webhooks + automations) + `developer-sdk` (Square API + In-App Payments SDK + Web Payments SDK) + `data-pipeline` (Square Data Export + BigQuery / Snowflake connectors) + `apigw` (per-application + per-location + OAuth)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free (Square POS standard) → **Bronze**; Plus (Square for Retail Plus / Restaurants Plus) → **Silver**; Premium (custom-pricing volume) → **Gold**; Enterprise (Square Enterprise — dedicated AM + custom-rate + multi-location-orchestration + Square-Banking + Loans + Afterpay-merchant + Cash-App-Pay + data-pipeline) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `cloud-billing` (POS + invoice + subscription + tip + loyalty anchor); `marketplace` (catalog + multi-location + commerce); `compliance` (PCI + SCA + Banking-partner); `intelligence` (loyalty + customer-directory analytics); `workflow-engine` (webhooks); `developer-sdk` (Square-API-protocol-compat); `data-pipeline` (Square-Data + BQ/Snowflake); `apigw` (OAuth + per-location).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Square canonical model):
  - `Merchant` (Merchant_ID, Business-Name, Country, Currency, Status).
  - `Location` (Location_ID, Merchant-Ref, Name, Address, Type {physical / online / mobile}, Status, Capabilities[CREDIT_CARD_PROCESSING / AUTOMATIC_TRANSFERS / etc.]).
  - `Customer` (Customer_ID, Given-Name + Family-Name, Email, Phone, Address, Reference-ID, Note, Birthday, Group-IDs[], Segment-IDs[]).
  - `Catalog_Object` (CatalogObject_ID, Type {ITEM / ITEM_VARIATION / CATEGORY / MODIFIER / MODIFIER_LIST / TAX / DISCOUNT / IMAGE / etc.}, Item-Data{}, Version, Updated-At).
  - `Inventory_Count` (Catalog-Object-Ref, Location-Ref, State {IN_STOCK / SOLD / etc.}, Quantity, Calculated-At).
  - `Order` (Order_ID, Location-Ref, Customer-Ref, Line-Items[], Taxes[], Discounts[], Service-Charges[], Tenders[], Total, Net-Amount-Due, State {OPEN / COMPLETED / CANCELED / DRAFT}, Closed-At, Source).
  - `Payment` (Payment_ID, Order-Ref, Amount, Tip-Money, Approved-Money, Source-Type {CARD / CASH / EXTERNAL / WALLET / etc.}, Card-Details, Status {APPROVED / COMPLETED / CANCELED / FAILED}, Receipt-URL, Application-Details, Device-Details).
  - `Refund` (Refund_ID, Payment-Ref, Amount, Reason, Status).
  - `Dispute` (Dispute_ID, Payment-Ref, Reason-Code, State {INQUIRY_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED / EVIDENCE_REQUIRED / etc.}, Evidence-IDs[], Due-At).
  - `Invoice` (Invoice_ID, Order-Ref, Primary-Recipient, Payment-Requests[], Delivery-Method, Status {DRAFT / SCHEDULED / UNPAID / PAID / etc.}, Public-URL).
  - `Subscription` (Subscription_ID, Plan-ID, Customer-Ref, Location-Ref, Status, Start-Date, Canceled-Date).
  - `Subscription_Plan` (Plan_ID, Phases[Cadence + Periods + Recurring-Price-Money]).
  - `Gift_Card` (GiftCard_ID, GAN, Type, State {NOT_ACTIVE / ACTIVE / DEACTIVATED / BLOCKED / PENDING}, Balance).
  - `Loyalty_Program` + `Loyalty_Account` + `Loyalty_Event` (LoyaltyAccount_ID, Program-Ref, Customer-Ref, Balance, Lifetime-Points).
  - `Team_Member` + `Team_Member_Wage` + `Timecard` (for Square Payroll + employee management).
  - `Booking` (Booking_ID, Customer-Ref, Location-Ref, Appointment-Segments[Team-Member + Service-Variation + Duration], Status, Start-At).
  - `Webhook_Subscription` (Subscription_ID, Application-ID, Event-Types[], Notification-URL, Signature-Key).
  - `OAuth_Application` (Application_ID, Permissions[], Redirect-URLs[], Access-Token, Refresh-Token).
  - `Bank_Account` (BankAccount_ID, Account-Number-Suffix, Routing-Number, Verification-Method, Status).
  - `Cash_Drawer_Shift` (Shift_ID, Location-Ref, Employee-Ref, Opened-At, Closed-At, Starting-Cash, Ending-Cash, Cash-Payment-Money, Cash-Refund-Money).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: `https://connect.squareupsandbox.com/v2/` + `https://connect.squareup.com/v2/`; resource shape `payments` + `orders` + `customers` + `catalog/object` + `inventory/counts` + `invoices` + `subscriptions` + `loyalty/programs` + `gift-cards` + `bookings` + `team-members` + `timecards` + `locations` + `merchants` + `webhooks/subscriptions`.
  - GraphQL: limited subset for catalog + orders read.
  - OAuth 2.0 for multi-merchant integrations.
  - Webhooks: HMAC-SHA256 signed via `X-Square-HmacSha256-Signature` header.
  - SDKs: Node + Python + Ruby + PHP + Java + .NET + Go; Web Payments SDK (`SqPaymentForm` → `Square.payments`); In-App Payments SDK (iOS + Android + React Native + Flutter).
  - CLI: Square CLI (`square` command) for webhook-test + token-management.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Dashboard" — merchant home (sales + customers + items + reports + banking + payroll).
  - "Square POS" — iOS / Android / Square-Register touchscreen POS.
  - "Square for Retail" — retail-specific POS with inventory management.
  - "Square for Restaurants" — restaurant POS with table management + KDS (Kitchen Display System).
  - "Square Appointments" — booking / calendar UI for service businesses.
  - "Square Online" — Weebly-derived storefront editor.
  - "Item Library" — catalog editor with variations + modifiers + categories.
  - "Customer Directory" — CRM-lite with segments + groups + Loyalty integration.
  - "Square Banking" — checking + savings + debit card.
  - "Square Marketing" — email + auto-campaign builder.
  - "Square Loyalty" — points + tier + reward UI.
  - "Square Gift Cards" — physical + digital gift card management.
  - "Payroll" — payroll + tax + 1099 + W-2.
  - "Reports" — sales + items + categories + employees + locations cross-filter.

- **Cedar permit shape** (cloud-billing + marketplace + intelligence + compliance cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<square-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"SquarePaymentCreate", Oyatie::Action::"SquarePaymentRefund",
      Oyatie::Action::"SquareOrderCreate", Oyatie::Action::"SquareOrderCancel",
      Oyatie::Action::"SquareInvoiceSend", Oyatie::Action::"SquareInvoiceCancel",
      Oyatie::Action::"SquareSubscriptionCreate", Oyatie::Action::"SquareSubscriptionCancel",
      Oyatie::Action::"SquareCustomerCreate", Oyatie::Action::"SquareCustomerDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"SquareCatalogUpsert", Oyatie::Action::"SquareInventoryAdjust",
      Oyatie::Action::"SquareGiftCardActivate", Oyatie::Action::"SquareLoyaltyAccrue",
      Oyatie::Action::"SquareBookingCreate", Oyatie::Action::"SquareDisputeRespond",
      Oyatie::Action::"SquareWebhookSubscribe", Oyatie::Action::"SquareOAuthGrant",
      Oyatie::Action::"SquareLocationCreate", Oyatie::Action::"SquareBankingTransfer",
      Oyatie::Action::"SquareDataExportConfigure"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareMerchant::"<merchant-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareLocation::"<location-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquarePayment::"<payment-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareOrder::"<order-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareInvoice::"<invoice-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareCatalogObject::"<catalog-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareGiftCard::"<gc-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareLoyaltyAccount::"<la-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareBooking::"<booking-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareDispute::"<dispute-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareWebhookSubscription::"<ws-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SquareBankAccount::"<ba-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "payment_refund_above_threshold" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "order_cancel_completed" || principal.role in ["finance_admin", "ops_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "invoice_cancel_sent" || principal.role in ["finance_admin", "billing_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "subscription_cancel" || context.cancellation_reason_recorded == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "customer_delete" || principal.role == "privacy_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "catalog_destructive_bulk" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "inventory_adjust_large" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "gift_card_activate_bulk" || principal.role == "finance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "loyalty_accrue_manual" || principal.role in ["loyalty_admin", "finance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "dispute_respond" || principal.role in ["billing_admin", "disputes_specialist"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "oauth_grant_external" || context.oauth_app_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "banking_transfer_above_threshold" || (principal.role == "treasury_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "data_export_external" || context.export_target_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "location_create" || principal.role == "merchant_admin")
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: PCI-DSS-Square (Level-1 attestation share + SAQ-A via Web-Payments-SDK + Square-Reader-firmware-attested); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-merchant residency + DSAR via customer-delete); SOC-2 (audit + OAuth-token rotation); Square-Banking-FDIC (via partner Sutton Bank — passthrough); Cash-App-Pay (network-token + tokenization); Afterpay-Merchant-Pack (BNPL conformance); EU-AI-Act (Square Marketing AI + Customer Directory ML conformance ledger).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `square.merchant` → `oya-tenant-merchant-account`.
  - `square.location` → `oya-marketplace-location` (capabilities preserved).
  - `square.customer` → `oya-cloud-billing-customer` + `oya-marketplace-customer-directory-entry`.
  - `square.catalog_object` → `oya-marketplace-catalog-object` with type-discriminator.
  - `square.inventory_count` → `oya-marketplace-inventory-count` per-location.
  - `square.order` → `oya-marketplace-order` (Square Order is rich — includes line-items + taxes + discounts + service-charges + tenders).
  - `square.payment` → `oya-cloud-billing-charge` with Source-Type discriminator.
  - `square.refund` → `oya-cloud-billing-refund`.
  - `square.dispute` → `oya-cloud-billing-dispute`.
  - `square.invoice` → `oya-cloud-billing-invoice` (Square hosted public-URL preserved).
  - `square.subscription` + `square.subscription_plan` → `oya-cloud-billing-subscription` + `oya-cloud-billing-subscription-plan`.
  - `square.gift_card` → `oya-marketplace-gift-card`.
  - `square.loyalty_*` → `oya-marketplace-loyalty-program` + `oya-marketplace-loyalty-account` + `oya-marketplace-loyalty-event`.
  - `square.team_member` + `square.timecard` → `oya-workforce-employee` + `oya-workforce-timecard` (cross-product framing).
  - `square.booking` → `oya-marketplace-appointment`.
  - `square.webhook_subscription` → `oya-workflow-engine-webhook-subscriber`.
  - `square.oauth_application` → `oya-apigw-oauth-application`.
  - `square.bank_account` → `oya-marketplace-bank-account`.
  - `square.cash_drawer_shift` → `oya-marketplace-cash-drawer-shift`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (15 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `cloud-billing` + `marketplace` + `compliance` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` µservices with Square-feature-parity matrix (POS + retail + restaurants + appointments + online + invoice + subscription + gift-card + loyalty + customer-directory + bookings + payroll-light + banking-light + webhooks + OAuth).
  2. Export Square via API: merchants + locations + customers + catalog (items + variations + categories + modifiers + taxes + discounts) + inventory + orders (last 13mo) + payments + refunds + disputes + invoices + subscriptions + gift-cards + loyalty + team-members + timecards + bookings + webhook-subscriptions + oauth-apps + bank-accounts + cash-drawer-shifts.
  3. Re-bind merchant integrations: Square-API-protocol-compatible Oyatie endpoint with same Idempotency-Key + HMAC-signed-webhook semantics; dual-route 30 days.
  4. Per-Location: re-create with capability-matrix preserved (CREDIT_CARD_PROCESSING + AUTOMATIC_TRANSFERS + etc.).
  5. Per-Catalog-Object: import items + variations + categories + modifiers + taxes + discounts; per-item rendering fidelity test.
  6. Per-Inventory-Count: snapshot + reconcile + dual-write during cutover window.
  7. Per-Customer: import with reference-ID + groups + segments + birthday + note preserved.
  8. Per-Order + Payment + Refund (last 13mo): import for dispute-window + reporting continuity.
  9. Per-Invoice + Subscription: import schedules; preserve public-URL via redirect.
  10. Per-Gift-Card: import with GAN + balance preserved; PCI-scope-safe.
  11. Per-Loyalty-Program + Account: re-bind to Oyatie marketplace loyalty; per-account balance + lifetime-points preserved.
  12. Per-Booking: import appointment-segments + team-member + service-variation.
  13. Per-Team-Member + Timecard + Cash-Drawer-Shift: re-bind to Oyatie workforce module.
  14. Per-OAuth-Application + Webhook-Subscription: re-register with new signing-keys; dual-route.
  15. Per-Bank-Account + Banking: re-bind to Oyatie banking-partner; parallel-run 30 days; per-merchant cutover via OAuth-router; Square subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (15 specific failures):
  - Square-Hardware firmware-attestation gap (Square-Reader / Terminal / Register hardware can't talk to Oyatie POS): per-device firmware-route via Oyatie POS-compat mode + hardware-sunset playbook.
  - Catalog item-variation modifier-list join semantic drift: per-catalog-object transpile fidelity test.
  - Inventory cross-location adjustment timing race: per-adjustment dual-write reconciliation.
  - Order tender-handling (CARD / CASH / EXTERNAL / WALLET) gap: per-order tender-mapping audit.
  - Gift-card GAN format change breaking pre-printed cards: per-GAN format-preserve audit.
  - Loyalty earn/redeem-rule transpile drift: per-rule shadow-eval.
  - Booking appointment-segment team-member-availability drift: per-team-member schedule shadow.
  - Square Payroll tax-jurisdiction gap (per-state US tax tables): per-jurisdiction tax-engine pin.
  - Square-Banking deposit-cadence + auto-transfer drift: per-account banking-partner re-binding window.
  - Cash-drawer-shift reconciliation gap during cutover: per-shift dual-close audit.
  - Cash App Pay tokenization drift: per-transaction Cash-App-Pay-Network-Token re-bind.
  - Afterpay BNPL merchant-rate drift: per-merchant Afterpay-pack rate re-binding.
  - OAuth application-permission-scope expansion: per-app scope-diff review at re-register.
  - Webhook event-type renaming: per-event-type alias-map.
  - Multi-merchant OAuth onboarding drift: per-developer app-credential dual-window.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Square API + Dashboard export: full merchant export.
  2. Re-bind integrations to Oyatie Square-API-compatible endpoint; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate locations + catalog + inventory.
  4. Migrate customers + groups + segments.
  5. Migrate orders + payments + refunds + invoices + subscriptions (last 13mo).
  6. Migrate gift-cards + loyalty.
  7. Migrate bookings + team-members + timecards.
  8. Migrate OAuth-apps + webhook-subscriptions.
  9. Migrate bank-accounts + Square-Banking via partner re-binding.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days; per-merchant cutover; Square sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `cloud-billing` + `marketplace` + `compliance` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `square` + `cash-app-pay` + `afterpay` + `block` + `tidal` + `square-register` + `square-reader` are benchmark alias-only. POS-hardware integration is preserved as `oya-marketplace-pos-hardware-driver` projection.

### Section D-104 - Shopify Plus
- Vendor name and category: Shopify Inc. — Shopify Plus + Shopify Markets (global) + Shopify Functions + Shopify Hydrogen / Oxygen (headless storefront + edge runtime) + Shopify POS + Shopify Payments + Shop Pay + Shopify Shipping + Shopify Fulfillment Network + Shopify Capital + Shopify Audiences + Shopify Flow (automation) + Shopify Launchpad (event scheduler) + Shopify Scripts (legacy → Functions) + Shopify Apps + Shopify CLI + Shopify Admin API (REST + GraphQL) + Shopify Storefront API + Shopify Customer Account API + Shopify ShopifyQL Notebooks + Shopify Theme Editor + Shopify Checkout Extensibility + Shopify Subscription APIs + Shopify B2B + Shopify Collabs (creator/affiliate).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `marketplace` (storefront + catalog + cart + checkout + B2B — Shopify is the SMB-to-mid-market e-commerce category leader; Shopify Plus is the enterprise tier; differentiated by full headless + edge + Functions + Markets + B2B + multi-store-org-model) + `cloud-billing` (Shopify Payments + Shop Pay + Functions billing + subscriptions) + `compliance` (PCI + GDPR + EU-AI-Act for Audiences/Magic + accessibility) + `intelligence` (Shopify Magic AI + Audiences + Sidekick + ShopifyQL) + `workflow-engine` (Shopify Flow + Launchpad + Webhooks) + `developer-sdk` (Admin API + Storefront API + Customer Account API + Functions + Hydrogen + CLI) + `data-pipeline` (Shopify Plus data export + BigQuery / Snowflake / Hightouch connectors) + `apigw` (per-shop + per-app + OAuth)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Shopify Basic / Standard / Advanced → **Silver / Gold**; Shopify Plus (enterprise-tier — dedicated Merchant Success Manager + 99.99%-uptime SLA + Shopify Functions + Hydrogen + Oxygen + Markets + B2B + custom-checkout-extensibility + Shopify Audiences + dedicated-region + EU-residency + Customer-Managed-Keys + multi-store-org) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `marketplace` (storefront + catalog + cart + checkout + B2B anchor); `cloud-billing` (Shopify Payments + Shop Pay + Functions billing + subscription); `compliance` (PCI + GDPR + accessibility); `intelligence` (Magic + Audiences + Sidekick); `workflow-engine` (Flow + Launchpad + Webhooks); `developer-sdk` (Admin-API-protocol-compat + Hydrogen + Functions); `data-pipeline` (Plus export); `apigw` (OAuth + per-app).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Admin API REST: `https://{shop}.myshopify.com/admin/api/{version}/` with `X-Shopify-Access-Token` header.
  - Admin API GraphQL: `https://{shop}.myshopify.com/admin/api/{version}/graphql.json` — preferred for new development.
  - Storefront API GraphQL: `https://{shop}.myshopify.com/api/{version}/graphql.json` — for headless storefronts.
  - Customer Account API: customer-authenticated subset for storefront.
  - Functions API: deployed via Shopify CLI as WebAssembly modules.
  - Webhooks: HMAC-SHA256 signed via `X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256` header; topics like `orders/create` + `orders/paid` + `products/update` + `customers/data_request` + 100+ topics.
  - SDKs: JS Admin + Storefront + Customer-Account + Hydrogen-React + Hydrogen-CSS + Hydrogen-Remix + Polaris (admin-UI) + Shopify-CLI.
  - ShopifyQL: SQL-like query language for analytics over Shopify data.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Shopify Admin" — merchant home (orders + products + customers + analytics + marketing + apps + settings).
  - "Theme Editor" — drag-and-drop section + block editor over Liquid templates.
  - "Checkout Extensibility" — Checkout UI Extensions + Branding + Functions.
  - "Shopify POS" — iOS / Android mobile + tablet POS.
  - "Shopify Markets" — international expansion configurator (currency + language + domain + pricing + tax + shipping per region).
  - "Shopify B2B" — company + location + catalog + payment-terms + quote editor.
  - "Shopify Flow" — trigger-condition-action automation builder.
  - "Shopify Launchpad" — scheduled flash-sale / drop event manager.
  - "Shopify Audiences" — Plus-only ML-derived audience for retargeting.
  - "Shopify Magic" — generative AI (product description + email + image edit + section generation).
  - "Sidekick" — conversational AI shopkeeper assistant.
  - "ShopifyQL Notebooks" — SQL-like analytics notebooks.
  - "Functions CLI" — develop + deploy Wasm Functions.
  - "Hydrogen" + "Oxygen" — headless storefront framework + edge runtime.
  - "Polaris" — Shopify admin design system.
  - "Plus Organization Admin" — multi-store organization console.

- **Cedar permit shape** (marketplace + cloud-billing + intelligence + workflow + compliance cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<shopify-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyProductCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyProductPublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyCollectionCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyInventoryAdjust",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyOrderCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyOrderCancel",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyOrderRefund", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyFulfillmentCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyCustomerCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyCustomerDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifySubscriptionContractCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyDiscountCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyB2BCompanyCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyMarketCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyFlowCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyFlowEnable",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyFunctionDeploy", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyThemePublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyAppInstall", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyWebhookSubscribe",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyAudienceExport", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyHydrogenDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyOAuthTokenRotate", Oyatie::Action::"ShopifyOrgAdminGrant"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyShop::"<shop-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyOrganization::"<org-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyProduct::"<product-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyOrder::"<order-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyCustomer::"<customer-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyMarket::"<market-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyB2BCompany::"<b2b-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyFlow::"<flow-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyFunction::"<fn-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyTheme::"<theme-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyApp::"<app-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ShopifyWebhookSubscription::"<wh-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "product_publish_bulk" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "inventory_adjust_large" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "order_cancel_paid" || principal.role in ["finance_admin", "ops_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "order_refund_above_threshold" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "customer_delete_with_orders" || principal.role == "privacy_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "b2b_company_create" || principal.role in ["b2b_admin", "merchant_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "market_create" || principal.role == "merchant_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "flow_enable_destructive" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "function_deploy_payment_method" || (principal.role == "payments_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "theme_publish" || principal.role in ["theme_admin", "merchant_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "app_install_external" || context.app_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "webhook_subscribe_external" || context.webhook_target_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audience_export_external" || (context.audience_export_target_in_allowlist == true && context.tenant_data_export_optin == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "hydrogen_deploy_oxygen" || principal.role in ["dev_admin", "merchant_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "oauth_token_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "org_admin_grant" || principal.role == "org_owner")
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: PCI-DSS-Shopify-Payments (Level-1 via Stripe-backed acquirer + SAQ-A via Checkout Extensibility); GDPR + KR-PIPA (per-shop EU-residency + DSAR via `customers/data_request` webhook + redaction); SOC-2 (audit + OAuth-token rotation + scope-review); EU-AI-Act (Magic + Audiences + Sidekick conformance ledger); Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA for theme + checkout); Shopify-B2B (net-terms + tax-exempt + quote-workflow); Shopify-Markets-International (per-region currency + language + tax-engine).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `shopify.shop` → `oya-tenant-shop`.
  - `shopify.organization` → `oya-tenant-organization` (multi-shop parent preserved).
  - `shopify.customer` → `oya-marketplace-customer` (Multipass-Identifier preserved as `oya-marketplace-sso-identifier`).
  - `shopify.product` + `shopify.variant` → `oya-marketplace-product` + `oya-marketplace-product-variant`.
  - `shopify.collection` → `oya-marketplace-collection` with smart/custom rule preserved.
  - `shopify.inventory_*` + `shopify.location` → `oya-marketplace-inventory-item` + `oya-marketplace-inventory-level` + `oya-marketplace-location`.
  - `shopify.cart` → `oya-marketplace-cart` (Storefront-API model preserved).
  - `shopify.checkout` → `oya-marketplace-checkout`.
  - `shopify.order` → `oya-marketplace-order` with Financial-Status + Fulfillment-Status preserved as two-axis state machine.
  - `shopify.fulfillment_*` → `oya-marketplace-fulfillment` + `oya-marketplace-fulfillment-order` + `oya-marketplace-fulfillment-service`.
  - `shopify.transaction` → `oya-cloud-billing-transaction` with Kind discriminator.
  - `shopify.refund` → `oya-cloud-billing-refund`.
  - `shopify.discount_code` + `shopify.price_rule` → `oya-marketplace-discount-code` + `oya-marketplace-price-rule`.
  - `shopify.subscription_contract` → `oya-cloud-billing-subscription-contract`.
  - `shopify.b2b_*` → `oya-marketplace-b2b-company` + `oya-marketplace-b2b-location` + `oya-marketplace-b2b-catalog`.
  - `shopify.market` → `oya-marketplace-region-market`.
  - `shopify.webhook_subscription` → `oya-workflow-engine-webhook-subscriber`.
  - `shopify.app` → `oya-marketplace-app-installation`.
  - `shopify.shopify_function` → `oya-marketplace-extension-function` (Wasm-deployed).
  - `shopify.flow_workflow` → `oya-workflow-engine-workflow`.
  - `shopify.metafield` + `shopify.metaobject` → `oya-marketplace-metafield` + `oya-marketplace-metaobject`.
  - `shopify.theme` → `oya-marketplace-storefront-theme`.
  - `shopify.hydrogen_storefront` → `oya-marketplace-headless-storefront`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (16 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `marketplace` + `cloud-billing` + `compliance` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` µservices with Shopify-Plus-feature-parity matrix (storefront + catalog + cart + checkout-extensibility + B2B + Markets + Functions + Flow + Launchpad + Magic + Audiences + Hydrogen + Subscriptions + POS + Payments).
  2. Export Shopify-Plus org via Admin GraphQL + Bulk Operations API: shop + organization + customers + products + variants + collections + inventory + locations + orders + fulfillments + transactions + refunds + discount-codes + subscription-contracts + B2B-companies + markets + webhook-subscriptions + apps + functions + flow-workflows + metafields + metaobjects + themes + hydrogen-storefronts.
  3. Re-bind merchant integrations: Shopify-Admin-API-protocol-compatible Oyatie endpoint accepting same OAuth + HMAC-webhook + GraphQL schema; dual-route 30 days; preserve `gid://shopify/...` IDs via canonical-id-mapper.
  4. Per-Shop / Organization: re-provision with Plus-org-model preserved.
  5. Per-Product + Variant + Collection: import with handle + metafield + tag + smart-rule preserved; per-product rendering-fidelity test on storefront.
  6. Per-Inventory-Level + Location: snapshot + dual-write reconciliation.
  7. Per-Customer: import with Multipass-Identifier + addresses + tax-exemption preserved.
  8. Per-Order + Fulfillment + Transaction + Refund (last 13mo): import for analytics + dispute continuity.
  9. Per-Discount-Code + Price-Rule + Automatic-Discount: import with usage-limit + customer-selection preserved.
  10. Per-Subscription-Contract: re-bind to Oyatie subscription-engine; per-contract next-billing smoke test.
  11. Per-B2B-Company + Location + Catalog: re-bind to Oyatie B2B; per-company quote-workflow shadow.
  12. Per-Market: re-provision with currency + tax-engine + shipping-rule preserved.
  13. Per-Flow-Workflow: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine; per-workflow shadow-eval on last-30d triggers.
  14. Per-Shopify-Function: re-deploy as Oyatie marketplace-extension-function (Wasm); per-function discount/payment-method/shipping/cart-validation rendering test.
  15. Per-Theme: import Liquid + sections + blocks + assets; per-theme rendering-fidelity test; cross-browser + accessibility audit.
  16. Per-Hydrogen-Storefront: re-deploy on Oyatie edge runtime equivalent (oya-edge-runtime); Oxygen-domain re-bind; parallel-run 30 days; per-shop cutover via DNS + OAuth-token-router; Shopify-Plus subscription sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (17 specific failures):
  - Shopify `gid://shopify/...` ID format dependence in third-party apps: per-app canonical-id-mapper + dual-ID exposure during cutover.
  - Liquid template rendering drift (Oyatie's Liquid-equivalent has different filter behavior): per-theme golden-render test on 50+ pages.
  - Checkout Extensibility — UI Extensions runtime gap (Shopify uses sandboxed JS with specific API surface): per-extension API-shim or rewrite.
  - Shopify Functions Wasm-ABI gap: per-function ABI-compat layer + golden-test on input/output payloads.
  - Flow workflow trigger-condition-action transpile drift: per-workflow shadow-eval.
  - Markets per-region currency + tax + shipping interaction drift: per-region cross-rule shadow.
  - B2B quote → order conversion semantic gap: per-company quote-workflow shadow.
  - Subscription billing-policy + delivery-policy interaction drift: per-contract next-billing dual-cycle compare.
  - Inventory cross-location adjustment race during cutover: per-location dual-write reconciliation.
  - Multipass SSO identifier preservation (customer-side links break): per-customer Multipass-token re-binding.
  - Discount-code stacking + automatic-discount interaction drift: per-cart discount-resolution shadow.
  - Magic / Audiences / Sidekick ML output drift: per-output reviewer comparison + EU-AI-Act ledger.
  - Shopify-Payments-via-Stripe acquirer-route drift: per-merchant Stripe-acquirer mapping pre-check.
  - Theme app-embed + app-block dependency on Shopify-only APIs: per-embed compat-shim or rewrite.
  - Webhook topic renaming + payload schema drift: per-topic alias + payload-shim.
  - OAuth scope expansion required during re-install: per-app scope-diff merchant-approval flow.
  - Hydrogen + Oxygen edge-runtime gap (Oxygen uses V8 isolates + specific Shopify primitives): per-storefront edge-runtime compat-shim.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Admin GraphQL Bulk Operations: full org export.
  2. Re-bind merchant integrations to Oyatie Shopify-Admin-API-compatible endpoint; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate shop + org + customers + products + collections + inventory + locations.
  4. Migrate last-13mo orders + fulfillments + transactions + refunds.
  5. Migrate discount-codes + subscription-contracts + B2B + Markets.
  6. Migrate Flow + Functions + Webhooks + Apps with shadow-eval.
  7. Migrate themes + metafields + metaobjects with rendering audit.
  8. Migrate Hydrogen + Oxygen storefronts to Oyatie edge runtime.
  9. Migrate Magic + Audiences + Sidekick to Oyatie intelligence with EU-AI-Act ledger.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days; per-shop cutover via DNS + OAuth; Shopify-Plus sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `marketplace` + `cloud-billing` + `compliance` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `data-pipeline` + `apigw` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `shopify` + `shopify-plus` + `hydrogen` + `oxygen` + `magic` + `audiences` + `sidekick` + `flow` + `launchpad` + `shopify-functions` + `shopify-markets` + `shop-pay` are benchmark alias-only. Edge-runtime is preserved as `oya-marketplace-edge-runtime` projection of `apigw` + `marketplace` join.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-105 - Twilio
- Vendor name and category: Twilio Inc. — Twilio Programmable Messaging (SMS + MMS + WhatsApp + RCS) + Twilio Programmable Voice + Twilio Programmable Video + Twilio Programmable Chat (legacy → Conversations) + Twilio Conversations API + Twilio Flex (CCaaS contact center) + Twilio Verify (OTP + Silent-Network-Auth + email-verify) + Twilio Lookup (phone-number intelligence) + Twilio Authy (legacy MFA) + Twilio Frontline (rep-mobile) + Twilio Engage (CDP — formerly Segment Personas) + Twilio Segment (CDP) + Twilio SendGrid Email API + Twilio Marketing Campaigns + Twilio Studio (visual flow builder) + Twilio TaskRouter + Twilio Phone Numbers + Twilio Trust Hub (sender-reputation + 10DLC + WhatsApp-BSP) + Twilio Voice Insights + Twilio Event Streams + Twilio Functions + Twilio Sync + Twilio Super-SIM (IoT) + Twilio Microvisor (IoT-embedded).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `intelligence` (Twilio Engage CDP + Segment + Voice-Insights + Flex-Insights — Twilio is the developer-CPaaS category leader; differentiated by full-stack messaging + voice + video + email + CDP + CCaaS spanning SMS/WhatsApp/RCS/voice/video/email under one developer API) + `workflow-engine` (Studio visual builder + TaskRouter + Functions) + `developer-sdk` (Twilio API + SDKs + CLI + Helper Libraries) + `apigw` (per-Account-SID + per-Subaccount + Auth-Token + API-Key + API-Secret) + `compliance` (10DLC + WhatsApp-Business-Solution-Provider + HIPAA-eligible + GDPR + STIR/SHAKEN + opt-out-management + EU-AI-Act for Engage) + `cloud-billing` (per-minute / per-message / per-API call usage-billing + Subscription Add-Ons) + `data-pipeline` (Event Streams to Kinesis / Segment / S3) + `marketplace` (Twilio Marketplace add-ons)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Pay-as-you-go → **Silver**; Volume-Pricing → **Gold**; Enterprise Plan (dedicated AM + Premier Support + 99.95%-SLA + Trust Hub VIP + 10DLC pre-vetted + WhatsApp BSP + HIPAA BAA + EU-residency + dedicated short-codes + Flex Enterprise + Engage Premier) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `intelligence` (Engage CDP + Segment + Voice-Insights anchor); `workflow-engine` (Studio + TaskRouter + Functions); `developer-sdk` (Twilio-API-protocol-compat); `apigw` (Account-SID + Subaccount + API-Key); `compliance` (10DLC + WhatsApp-BSP + HIPAA + STIR/SHAKEN + opt-out); `cloud-billing` (usage); `data-pipeline` (Event Streams); `marketplace` (add-ons).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Twilio canonical model):

  - `Subaccount` (Subaccount_SID, Parent-Account-SID, Friendly-Name, Status).

  - `Message` (Message_SID, From, To, Body, Status {queued / sending / sent / delivered / undelivered / failed}, Direction, Price, Num-Segments, Media-URLs[], Channel {sms / mms / whatsapp / rcs}).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: `https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/` for legacy APIs; `https://verify.twilio.com/v2/` + `https://conversations.twilio.com/v1/` + `https://taskrouter.twilio.com/v1/` + `https://studio.twilio.com/v2/` + `https://events.twilio.com/v1/` + `https://numbers.twilio.com/v1/` + `https://trusthub.twilio.com/v1/` + `https://messaging.twilio.com/v1/` for newer products.
  - Auth: Account-SID + Auth-Token (Basic Auth) OR API-Key-SID + Secret (preferred).
  - Webhooks: signed via `X-Twilio-Signature` HMAC-SHA1 with full URL + form-params.
  - TwiML: XML markup for voice + messaging call flow.
  - Studio: visual editor that compiles to JSON DAG; deployable revisions.
  - SDKs: `twilio` (Node + Python + Ruby + PHP + Java + .NET + Go); Voice + Video + Chat client SDKs (iOS + Android + JS).
