- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (16 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `compliance` + `cloud-billing` + `data-pipeline` + `marketplace` + `comms` µservices with Twilio-feature-parity matrix (messaging + voice + video + verify + lookup + conversations + flex + studio + taskrouter + functions + event-streams + trust-hub + a2p + whatsapp-bsp + sendgrid + segment + engage).
  2. Export Twilio account via REST: account + subaccounts + api-keys + phone-numbers + short-codes + messages (last 90d) + calls (last 90d) + conferences + recordings + conversations + verify-services + studio-flows + taskrouter-workspaces + flex-workspaces + functions + sync-services + notify-services + trust-hub-bundles + a2p-brands + a2p-campaigns + whatsapp-senders + whatsapp-templates + event-stream-sinks; SendGrid: API-keys + templates + sender-auth + suppressions; Segment: workspaces + sources + destinations + tracking-plans; Engage: audiences + journeys.
  3. Re-bind merchant integrations: Twilio-API-protocol-compatible Oyatie endpoint accepting same Account-SID-or-API-Key auth + X-Twilio-Signature HMAC-SHA1 + TwiML semantics; dual-route 30 days.
  4. Per-Subaccount: re-create with rotated Auth-Token + API-Keys.
  5. Per-Phone-Number + Short-Code: port to Oyatie carrier-relationships (or re-bind via Oyatie-as-Twilio-reseller during transition); per-number trust-bundle + A2P-campaign re-submit.
  6. Per-Verify-Service: re-bind to Oyatie verify; per-channel template re-config; rate-limit preserved.
  7. Per-Conversation + Message + Call (last 90d): import for analytics + audit.
  8. Per-Studio-Flow: transpile JSON DAG to Oyatie workflow-engine visual-flow; per-flow shadow-eval on last-30d executions.
  9. Per-TaskRouter-Workspace + Workflow + Queue + Worker: re-bind to Oyatie task-router.
  10. Per-Flex-Workspace + UI: re-deploy Flex-equivalent contact-center; per-workspace agent-desktop training.
  11. Per-Function + Asset + Sync-Service: re-deploy as Oyatie developer-sdk serverless + state.
  12. Per-Trust-Hub-Bundle + A2P-Campaign + WhatsApp-Template: re-submit through Oyatie carrier-relationships; per-bundle approval-window shadow.
  13. Per-Event-Stream-Sink: re-bind to Oyatie data-pipeline event-sink.
  14. Per-SendGrid-API-Key + Template + Sender-Auth + Suppression: re-bind to Oyatie email-engine; preserve DKIM + SPF + DMARC + suppression list.
  15. Per-Segment-Source + Destination + Tracking-Plan: re-bind to Oyatie intelligence CDP; per-source dual-route 30 days.
  16. Per-Engage-Audience + Journey: re-bind to Oyatie intelligence + workflow-engine journey; parallel-run 30 days; per-subaccount cutover via Auth-Token-router; Twilio contract sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (18 specific failures):
  - X-Twilio-Signature HMAC verification gap (Oyatie's HMAC formula differs subtly from Twilio's full-URL + sorted-form-params canonicalization): per-request signature-shim + golden-test on 100+ samples.
  - TwiML grammar drift (Oyatie's voice-XML interpreter has different `<Gather>` / `<Dial>` / `<Record>` defaults): per-TwiML golden-execution test.
  - Phone-number-port carrier-LOA delay (legitimate porting takes 7-30 days per carrier): per-number port-cutover playbook + bridged-routing during port-window.
  - 10DLC A2P-campaign re-registration delay (US carriers re-vet brand + campaign on provider change): per-campaign 30-90d advance registration.
  - WhatsApp-BSP migration (Meta requires WABA re-provisioning): per-WABA business-verification re-submit + template re-approval.
  - STIR/SHAKEN attestation level drop (A→B→C downgrade kills caller-ID display): per-call attestation pre-check.
  - Verify-Service template per-locale + per-channel drift: per-template locale + channel re-bind.
  - Studio-Flow JSON DAG node-type drift (Oyatie may not have 1:1 equivalents for every state type): per-flow node-coverage audit + custom-node fallback.
  - TaskRouter expression-language drift: per-workflow expression transpile test.
  - Flex plugin (React-based) API-surface drift: per-plugin compat-shim or rewrite.
  - Functions Node-runtime version + module-allowlist drift: per-function dependency audit.
  - Sync-Service real-time consistency model drift (Twilio Sync uses eventually-consistent CRDT-ish; Oyatie equivalent must match): per-document consistency-shadow.
  - SendGrid DKIM-key rotation breaks downstream email deliverability: per-domain DNS-window + dual-DKIM during transition.
  - SendGrid suppression-list import gap (bounce + spam + unsubscribe must be preserved or you re-mail unsubscribed users): per-list dual-write + lawyer-review of CAN-SPAM compliance.
  - Segment Source + Destination connector versioning drift (Oyatie may have older/newer destination connectors): per-destination version-pin + alias.
  - Tracking-Plan enforcement strictness drift (Segment can block events that violate plan; Oyatie must mirror): per-plan strictness-mode preserve.
  - Engage Audience refresh-cadence + journey-step transition-latency drift: per-audience + journey shadow-eval.
  - Multi-region account-region pinning (Twilio EU-region accounts have different endpoint hosts): per-region endpoint re-map.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Twilio + SendGrid + Segment + Engage APIs: full account export.
  2. Re-bind integrations to Oyatie Twilio-API-compatible endpoint; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Port phone-numbers + short-codes + WABA + DKIM-domain (longest pole: schedule 30-90d ahead).
  4. Re-submit Trust-Hub + A2P + WhatsApp regulatory bundles + templates.
  5. Migrate Verify + Conversations + Recordings.
  6. Migrate Studio-Flows + TaskRouter + Flex + Functions with shadow-eval.
  7. Migrate Event-Streams + SendGrid + Segment + Engage.
  8. Migrate Notify + Sync.
  9. Re-train Flex agents on Oyatie-equivalent agent desktop.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days; per-subaccount cutover via Auth-Token-router; Twilio sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

Communications surface is preserved as the dedicated `comms` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout); regulatory bundles are preserved as `oya-compliance-regulatory-bundle` projection.

### Section D-106 - Zoom
- Vendor name and category: Zoom Video Communications Inc. — Zoom Meetings + Zoom Webinars + Zoom Events + Zoom Rooms (in-room hardware controller) + Zoom Phone (cloud PBX) + Zoom Contact Center (CCaaS) + Zoom Team Chat + Zoom Mail + Zoom Calendar + Zoom Whiteboard + Zoom Spaces + Zoom Workplace (rebranded suite) + Zoom Apps (in-meeting apps) + Zoom IQ / Zoom AI Companion (meeting summary + smart compose + smart recordings) + Zoom Video SDK + Zoom Marketplace + Zoom Compliance Manager + Zoom Revenue Accelerator (conversation intelligence acquired from Solvvy/UserTesting/Loop tracks).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `comms` (video + audio + chat + phone + contact-center — Zoom is the unified-communications-and-collaboration category leader; differentiated by Zoom-Phone PSTN reach + Rooms hardware + Workplace bundle covering meetings/webinars/events/team-chat/mail/calendar/phone/contact-center under one identity) + `intelligence` (AI Companion + Revenue Accelerator + Smart Recordings + IQ for Sales) + `workflow-engine` (Zoom Apps + Zoom Events workflows + Phone routing) + `developer-sdk` (Zoom Video SDK + Meeting SDK + Marketplace App SDK + Webhooks v2) + `apigw` (per-account + OAuth + Server-to-Server-OAuth + JWT-legacy) + `compliance` (HIPAA-Zoom + GDPR + FedRAMP-Moderate + StateRAMP + DOD-IL4 + SOC-2 + ISO + FERPA + GDPR-EU-residency + KR-PIPA + EU-AI-Act for AI-Companion) + `cloud-billing` (per-host + per-add-on usage)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Zoom Free → **Bronze**; Pro → **Silver**; Business / Business Plus → **Gold**; Enterprise / Enterprise+ (Zoom Workplace Enterprise + Phone Enterprise + Contact Center + Events Enterprise + Rooms + dedicated CSM + 99.999%-SLA + FedRAMP / DOD / EU-residency / HIPAA-BAA / Customer-Managed-Keys / Compliance Manager) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `comms` (video + audio + chat + phone + contact-center anchor); `intelligence` (AI Companion + Revenue Accelerator + Smart Recordings); `workflow-engine` (Apps + Events workflows + Phone routing); `developer-sdk` (Zoom-API-protocol-compat); `apigw` (OAuth + S2S-OAuth); `compliance` (HIPAA + FedRAMP + DOD + GDPR + KR-PIPA + EU-AI-Act); `cloud-billing` (per-host + add-on).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Zoom canonical model):
  - `Account` (Account_ID, Owner-Email, Plan-Type, Currency, Vanity-URL, Default-Locale, Service-URL).
  - `Sub_Account` (SubAccount_ID, Parent-Account-ID, Tier-Limits, Department).
  - `User` (User_ID, Email, First-Name + Last-Name, Type {1=Basic / 2=Licensed / 3=On-prem}, Department, Job-Title, Groups[], PMI (Personal Meeting ID), Manager, Location, Status).
  - `Group` (Group_ID, Name, Members[], Locked-Settings).
  - `Meeting` (Meeting_ID, UUID, Host-User-Ref, Topic, Type {1=instant / 2=scheduled / 3=recurring-no-fixed-time / 8=recurring-fixed-time / 4=PMI}, Start-Time, Duration, Timezone, Password, Settings{Waiting-Room + Mute-On-Entry + Join-Before-Host + Audio-Type + Auto-Recording + Encryption-Type{enhanced/end-to-end}}, Status).
  - `Meeting_Recording` (Recording_ID, Meeting-UUID, Files[Type{MP4/M4A/TIMELINE/TRANSCRIPT/CHAT}+Size+URL], Cloud-Storage, Auto-Delete-Date).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: `https://api.zoom.us/v2/`; resource shape `users` + `meetings` + `webinars` + `recordings` + `phone` + `chat` + `contact_center` + `rooms` + `accounts` + `groups` + `events` + `whiteboard`.
  - Auth: Server-to-Server-OAuth (preferred) + OAuth Authorization-Code + legacy JWT (deprecated).
  - Webhooks: signed via `x-zm-signature` (HMAC) + `x-zm-request-timestamp`; events like `meeting.started` + `meeting.ended` + `recording.completed` + `phone.callee_call_history_completed` + `app_deauthorized` + 200+ events.
  - Video SDK + Meeting SDK: native iOS + Android + Windows + macOS + Linux + Web + React Native; embed Zoom UI or build custom UI on Zoom infrastructure.
  - Zoom Apps SDK: in-meeting iframe-style app surface.
  - CLI: limited (community).

- **Cedar permit shape** (comms + intelligence + workflow + apigw + compliance cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<zoom-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomMeetingCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ZoomMeetingDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomMeetingRecord", Oyatie::Action::"ZoomRecordingDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomRecordingDownload", Oyatie::Action::"ZoomWebinarCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomEventCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ZoomPhoneNumberAssign",
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomPhoneCallInitiate", Oyatie::Action::"ZoomPhoneRecordingAccess",
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomContactCenterAgentLogin", Oyatie::Action::"ZoomContactCenterFlowEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomTeamChatChannelCreate", Oyatie::Action::"ZoomRoomConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomAppInstall", Oyatie::Action::"ZoomWebhookSubscribe",
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomAICompanionInvoke", Oyatie::Action::"ZoomTranscriptExport",
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomCompliancePolicyEdit", Oyatie::Action::"ZoomOAuthTokenRotate",
      Oyatie::Action::"ZoomSubAccountCreate"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomAccount::"<acct-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomUser::"<user-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomMeeting::"<mtg-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomRecording::"<rec-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomWebinar::"<web-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomEvent::"<evt-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomPhoneNumber::"<pn-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomContactCenterFlow::"<cc-flow-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomTeamChatChannel::"<ch-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomRoom::"<room-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomApp::"<app-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomWebhook::"<wh-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::ZoomCompliancePolicy::"<pol-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "meeting_record_e2ee" || (principal.role == "host" && context.e2ee_consent == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "recording_download_external" || (context.recording_download_target_in_allowlist == true && context.recording_classification != "phi")) &&
    (resource.kind != "recording_delete" || principal.role in ["host", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "phone_recording_access" || (principal.role in ["phone_admin", "compliance_admin"] && context.legal_basis_recorded == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "contact_center_flow_edit_breaking" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "phone_number_assign" || principal.role in ["phone_admin", "comms_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "phone_call_initiate_international" || principal.role in ["phone_admin", "comms_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "team_chat_channel_external" || context.federation_target_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "app_install_external" || context.app_in_marketplace_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "webhook_subscribe_external" || context.webhook_target_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "ai_companion_invoke" || (context.tenant_ai_optin == true && context.meeting_ai_consent_collected == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "transcript_export_phi" || (principal.role == "compliance_admin" && context.baa_active == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "compliance_policy_edit" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "oauth_token_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "subaccount_create" || principal.role == "account_owner")
  };
  ```

- **Failure modes** (15 specific failures):
  - Zoom E2EE key custody loss during migration (Zoom uses per-meeting symmetric keys with no key escrow for true E2EE): per-meeting E2EE-recording sunset-path + non-E2EE re-record decision.
  - PMI re-binding breaks calendar invites with embedded Zoom-URL: per-user calendar-rewrite + redirect-shim on legacy zoom.us/j/{PMI} URLs.
  - Phone-number-port carrier-LOA delays: per-number 30-90d port-cutover playbook.
  - 911 Emergency-Address re-binding required for every Zoom-Phone user: per-user Emergency-Address re-verify (regulatory requirement).
  - STIR/SHAKEN attestation downgrade: per-call attestation pre-check.
  - Recording-file MP4 / M4A / Transcript / Chat / Timeline format dependency: per-recording per-asset format preservation + re-encode if needed.
  - Webinar registrant data + Q&A history loss: per-webinar dual-write during cutover window.
  - Contact-Center flow visual-editor JSON drift: per-flow node-coverage audit.
  - Room hardware (Neat / Logitech / Poly) firmware-attestation re-pairing: per-room factory-reset + re-provisioning.
  - Team-Chat message-history retention-policy drift: per-tenant retention re-application.
  - Apps Marketplace deauthorization webhook misses during cutover: per-app dual-webhook + reconciliation.
  - AI-Companion language-coverage drift (per-language summary quality varies): per-language quality shadow.
  - Compliance-Manager DLP-rule expression-language drift: per-rule transpile fidelity test.
  - Federation (Zoom-to-Zoom cross-tenant chat / SIP-federation) link breakage: per-federation cross-cutover playbook.
  - FedRAMP / DOD-IL4 tier requires dedicated cluster + cleared-personnel — full re-vetting on Oyatie side: per-tenant FedRAMP-equivalent ATO re-attestation.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Zoom REST + Reports + Compliance-Manager export: full account export.
  2. Re-bind integrations to Oyatie Zoom-API-compatible endpoint; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate users + groups + PMIs with calendar rewrite.
  4. Migrate scheduled meetings + webinars + events with URL re-issue + redirect.
  5. Migrate recordings + transcripts (per retention + E2EE policy).
  6. Port phone numbers + sites + Emergency-Addresses.
  7. Migrate phone call-logs + recordings + SMS.
  8. Migrate contact-center + team-chat + whiteboards + rooms.
  9. Migrate apps + webhooks + AI-Companion + Compliance-Manager.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days; per-account cutover via OAuth + DNS; Zoom sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `comms` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `compliance` + `cloud-billing` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `zoom` + `zoom-workplace` + `zoom-phone` + `zoom-contact-center` + `ai-companion` + `revenue-accelerator` + `compliance-manager` + `zoom-rooms` + `zoom-whiteboard` are benchmark alias-only. Meeting-encryption-modes preserved as `oya-comms-meeting-encryption-mode` enum {enhanced / e2ee} per ADR-0251 §D-10.

### Section D-107 - DocuSign
- Vendor name and category: DocuSign Inc. — DocuSign eSignature + DocuSign CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management — formerly SpringCM) + DocuSign Insight (AI contract analytics) + DocuSign Identify (ID verification) + DocuSign Notary + DocuSign Negotiate (formerly DocuSign for Microsoft Word) + DocuSign Gen (document generation) + DocuSign Click (click-to-agree clickwrap) + DocuSign Monitor (security + telemetry) + DocuSign Admin + DocuSign Web Forms + DocuSign Rooms (real-estate + financial-services collaborative deal rooms) + DocuSign (webhooks) + DocuSign Maestro (workflow orchestration — newer) + DocuSign IAM (Intelligent Agreement Management — newer rebrand).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `compliance` (eSignature legal-validity + ESIGN + UETA + eIDAS + 21-CFR-Part-11 + HIPAA + FedRAMP + DOD-IL4 — DocuSign is the eSignature + CLM category leader; differentiated by global jurisdiction coverage + CLM + AI contract analytics under one platform) + `workflow-engine` (Maestro + envelope workflows + CLM workflows + webhooks) + `intelligence` (Insight AI + Negotiate AI) + `developer-sdk` (eSignature REST API + CLM REST API + Click API + webhooks + Embedded Signing + SDKs) + `apigw` (per-account + OAuth-JWT + OAuth-Authorization-Code + integration-key) + `cloud-billing` (per-envelope + per-seat + per-add-on billing)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Personal → **Bronze**; Standard / Business Pro → **Silver / Gold**; Enhanced Plans / Enterprise (CLM + Insight + Identify + Notary + Rooms + Monitor + Maestro + dedicated CSM + 99.99%-SLA + EU-residency + HIPAA-BAA + FedRAMP + DOD-IL4 + 21-CFR-Part-11 + Customer-Managed-Keys + Customer-IP-Allowlist) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `compliance` (eSignature + UETA + ESIGN + eIDAS + 21-CFR-Part-11 + HIPAA + FedRAMP anchor); `workflow-engine` (Maestro + envelope + CLM workflows + Connect); `intelligence` (Insight + Negotiate AI); `developer-sdk` (DocuSign-API-protocol-compat); `apigw` (OAuth-JWT + integration-key); `cloud-billing` (per-envelope + per-seat).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (DocuSign canonical model):
  - `Account` (Account_ID, GUID, Plan-Classification, Currency, Default-Locale, External-Account-ID, Distributor-Code, Status).
  - `User` (User_ID, Email, First-Name + Last-Name, Title, Job-Title, Permission-Profile-ID, Send-Activation, User-Type, Forgotten-Password-Questions[], Last-Login).
  - `Permission_Profile` (Profile_ID, Name, Settings{Allow-Bulk-Send / Allow-PowerForm / Allow-Send-API / Use-Authentication-via-API / etc.}).
  - `Envelope` (Envelope_ID, Status {created / sent / delivered / signed / completed / declined / voided}, Email-Subject, Email-Blurb, Sender-User-Ref, Created-Date, Sent-Date, Completed-Date, Voided-Date, Documents[], Recipients{Signers[]+CarbonCopies[]+CertifiedDeliveries[]+Witnesses[]+Notaries[]+InPersonSigners[]}, Routing-Order, Custom-Fields{TextCustomFields[]+ListCustomFields[]}, Notification{ExpireAfter+Reminder}, Brand-ID, External-Envelope-ID).
  - `Document` (Document_ID, Envelope-Ref, Name, FileExtension, Order, Pages, Base64-or-URI).
  - `Recipient` (Recipient_ID, Envelope-Ref, Type {signer / cc / certified_delivery / agent / editor / intermediary / witness / notary / in_person_signer}, Email, Name, Routing-Order, Status, Authentication-Method, Access-Code, Identity-Verification, Sign-Date-Time).
  - `Tab` (Tab_ID, Recipient-Ref, Document-Ref, Type {sign / date_signed / text / checkbox / radio / list / dropdown / formula / draw / initial_here / etc.}, Page, X+Y, Required, Anchor-String, Conditional-Parent-Tab-ID).
  - `Brand` (Brand_ID, Name, Colors, Logos[], Custom-CSS, Email-Templates[]).
  - `Template` (Template_ID, Name, Description, Documents[], Recipients[], Tabs[], Custom-Fields[], Shared-With[]).
  - `PowerForm` (PowerForm_ID, Template-Ref, Name, Public-URL, Recipients-Open-as-Anonymous).
  - `Web_Form` (WebForm_ID, Field-Definitions[], Submission-Handler, Identity-Verification-Required).
  - `Bulk_Send_List` (List_ID, Name, Recipient-Rows[per-row{Name+Email+Custom-Fields+Tab-Pre-Fills}], Status).
  - `Connect_Configuration` (Config_ID, URL, Events[], Salesforce-Integration, Format {XML / JSON}, EnableLog, IncludeCertificateOfCompletion, RequireMutualTLS, SOAPNamespace, EnableSign + Salt).
  - `Connect_Event` (Event_ID, Config-Ref, Envelope-Ref, Status, Failure-Description, Retry-Count, Last-Retry).
  - `Notary_Journal_Entry` (Entry_ID, Envelope-Ref, Notary-User-Ref, Signer-Identity-Bundle, Audio-Video-Recording-URI, Notarial-Act).
  - `Identity_Verification_Result` (IDV_ID, Recipient-Ref, Type {phone_auth / SMS / KBA / ID-card / Selfie-match}, Result, Provider).
  - `CLM_Document` (CLM_Doc_ID, Folder, Workflow-State, Metadata{Counterparty + Effective-Date + Renewal + Value + Region}, Clauses[], Risk-Score).
  - `CLM_Workflow` (Workflow_ID, Document-Ref, Steps[Approval / Negotiation / Generate / Send-for-Signature / Store], Current-Step, History[]).
  - `CLM_Clause_Library` (Clause_ID, Title, Text, Risk-Profile, Approved-Variants[], Last-Reviewed).
  - `Insight_Extracted_Clause` (Extraction_ID, Document-Ref, Clause-Type, Confidence, Position, Risk-Flag).
  - `Maestro_Workflow` (Workflow_ID, Name, Steps[], Trigger, Status).
  - `Audit_Trail_Event` (Event_ID, Envelope-Ref, Event-Type, User, Timestamp, IP, Geo, Authentication-Method).
  - `Certificate_of_Completion` (CoC_ID, Envelope-Ref, Hash, PDF-URI, Audit-Trail-Embed).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: `https://www.docusign.net/restapi/v2.1/accounts/{accountId}/` (US prod); `https://eu.docusign.net/...` (EU); resource shape `envelopes` + `templates` + `users` + `groups` + `brands` + `permission_profiles` + `bulk_send_lists` + `connect/configurations` + `power_forms` + `web_forms`.
  - Auth: OAuth-JWT (machine-to-machine — preferred) + OAuth-Authorization-Code (user) + legacy Header-Based-Authentication.
  - Webhooks (Connect): per-config XML or JSON POST with optional HMAC + mTLS + Cert-of-Completion embed; events `envelope-sent` + `envelope-delivered` + `envelope-completed` + `envelope-declined` + `envelope-voided` + `recipient-sent` + `recipient-completed` + 100+ events.
  - Embedded Signing: signing-URL generation for in-app signing (no email).
  - Embedded Sending: in-app envelope authoring.
  - SDKs: Node + Python + Ruby + PHP + Java + .NET + Go + Salesforce-Apex.
  - CLM REST: `https://apieu.springcm.com/v2/`.
  - Click API: clickwrap creation + tracking.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "DocuSign Admin" — account + user + group + permission + brand + plan + report home.
  - "DocuSign Envelope Sender" — drag-and-drop document + recipient + tab editor + send.
  - "DocuSign Template Editor" — reusable templates with anchor-strings + conditional tabs.
  - "DocuSign Signing UI" — recipient signing experience (embedded + email).
  - "DocuSign Recipient Authentication" — phone + SMS + KBA + ID-card + Selfie + DocuSign-ID-Verification.
  - "DocuSign Console" — webhook-config + retry + replay UI.
  - "PowerForm Builder" — public template-backed URL form.
  - "Web Form Builder" — field-driven form with identity-verification.
  - "Bulk Send" — CSV-driven mass-send with per-row tab pre-fills.
  - "DocuSign Insight" — AI contract analytics dashboard (clauses + risk + obligations).
  - "DocuSign CLM" — contract lifecycle management with folders + workflow + clause-library.
  - "Notary Journal" — notary act log with audio-video recording.
  - "DocuSign Rooms" — collaborative deal rooms (real-estate + financial-services).
  - "Maestro Workflow Designer" — newer visual workflow builder.

- **Cedar permit shape** (compliance + workflow + intelligence + developer-sdk + apigw cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<docusign-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignEnvelopeCreate", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignEnvelopeSend",
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignEnvelopeVoid", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignEnvelopeCorrect",
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignRecipientUpdate", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignDocumentSign",
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignTemplateCreate", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignTemplateShare",
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignBulkSendDispatch", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignPowerFormCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignWebFormCreate", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignConnectConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignNotaryJournalAccess", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignIdentityVerifyInvoke",
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignCLMDocumentMove", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignCLMWorkflowStart",
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignCLMClauseEdit", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignInsightInvoke",
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignMaestroWorkflowDeploy", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignAuditExport",
      Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignIntegrationKeyRotate", Oyatie::Action::"DocuSignBrandEdit"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignAccount::"<acct-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignEnvelope::"<env-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignTemplate::"<tpl-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignPowerForm::"<pf-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignWebForm::"<wf-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignConnectConfig::"<cc-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignCLMDocument::"<clm-doc-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignCLMWorkflow::"<clm-wf-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignClause::"<clause-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignMaestroWorkflow::"<m-wf-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignBrand::"<brand-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::DocuSignIntegrationKey::"<key-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "envelope_void" || (principal.role in ["sender", "envelope_admin"] && context.envelope_status != "completed")) &&
    (resource.kind != "envelope_correct" || (principal.role in ["sender", "envelope_admin"] && context.envelope_status in ["sent", "delivered"])) &&
    (resource.kind != "envelope_send_to_phi_recipient" || (principal.role == "compliance_admin" && context.baa_active == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "envelope_send_with_21cfr_part11" || (context.part11_enabled == true && context.signer_meaning_collected == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "bulk_send_above_threshold" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "powerform_anonymous" || (principal.role in ["form_admin", "marketing_admin"] && context.fraud_screening_enabled == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "connect_config_external" || (context.connect_target_in_allowlist == true && context.mtls_enabled == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "notary_journal_access" || principal.role in ["notary_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "identity_verify_invoke" || context.tenant_idv_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "clm_document_move_external_folder" || principal.role in ["clm_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "clm_workflow_start_high_value" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "clause_edit" || principal.role in ["legal_admin", "clm_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "insight_invoke" || context.tenant_ai_optin == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "maestro_workflow_deploy_breaking" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_export" || principal.role == "compliance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "integration_key_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "brand_edit" || principal.role in ["brand_admin", "marketing_admin"])
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: ESIGN-Act + UETA (US legal-validity); eIDAS (EU — Simple / Advanced / Qualified Electronic Signature tiers + Qualified Trust Service Provider linkage); 21-CFR-Part-11 (FDA — life-sciences signing-meaning-collection + audit-trail + system-validation); HIPAA-DocuSign (BAA-eligible Enhanced + 21-CFR-supplement); GDPR + KR-PIPA (EU-residency tenant + DSAR + redaction); SOC-2 (audit + integration-key rotation); FedRAMP-Moderate / DOD-IL4 (DocuSign-for-Government); EU-AI-Act (Insight + Negotiate AI conformance ledger); Notary (commission-state + journal + audio-video recording).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `docusign.account` → `oya-tenant-esignature-account`.

  - `docusign.template` → `oya-compliance-esignature-template`.

  - `docusign.connect_event` → `oya-workflow-engine-webhook-delivery-event`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (15 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `compliance` + `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `cloud-billing` µservices with DocuSign-feature-parity matrix (eSignature + envelopes + tabs + anchor-strings + templates + PowerForm + Web-Form + Bulk-Send + + Maestro + Notary + Identity-Verify + CLM + Insight + Click + Rooms + Brand).
  2. Export DocuSign account via REST + CLM REST: account + users + permission-profiles + brands + envelopes (last 7yr per retention) + documents + recipients + tabs + templates + PowerForms + Web-Forms + Bulk-Send-Lists + Connect-Configurations + Connect-Events + Notary-Journal-Entries + Identity-Verification-Results + CLM-Documents + CLM-Workflows + Clause-Library + Insight-Extracted-Clauses + Maestro-Workflows + Audit-Trail + Certificates-of-Completion.
  3. Re-bind merchant integrations: DocuSign-API-protocol-compatible Oyatie endpoint accepting same OAuth-JWT + integration-key + XML/JSON semantics; dual-route 30 days.
  4. Per-User + Permission-Profile: re-provision; per-profile setting-coverage matrix.
  5. Per-Brand: re-provision with logo + email-template + color preserved.
  6. Per-Completed-Envelope (last 7yr): import with Certificate-of-Completion + audit-trail; verify hash + cryptographic integrity at re-store.
  7. Per-In-Flight-Envelope: re-issue via Oyatie sender; per-envelope dual-route + recipient-comms.
  8. Per-Template + PowerForm + Web-Form: import with anchor-strings + conditional-tabs + identity-verification preserved.
  9. Per-Bulk-Send-List: re-bind to Oyatie bulk-send; preserve per-row tab pre-fills.
  10. Per-Connect-Configuration: re-register with new HMAC + mTLS; replay-test on last-30d envelopes.
  11. Per-Notary-Journal-Entry: re-store with audio-video recording preserved + notary commission re-bind per state.
  12. Per-Identity-Verification-Result: re-bind to Oyatie IDV provider (or re-verify on next envelope).
  13. Per-CLM-Document + Workflow + Clause-Library: re-bind to Oyatie CLM; per-workflow shadow-eval.
  14. Per-Insight-Extracted-Clause + Maestro-Workflow: re-bind to Oyatie intelligence + workflow-engine; EU-AI-Act ledger.
  15. Per-Account: re-establish 21-CFR-Part-11 system-validation + HIPAA-BAA + FedRAMP-equivalent ATO; parallel-run 30 days; per-account cutover via OAuth + DNS; DocuSign contract sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (16 specific failures):
  - Certificate-of-Completion cryptographic-hash drift (Oyatie's CoC generator must produce a legally-equivalent artifact): per-envelope golden-CoC validation against DocuSign-issued CoCs.
  - 21-CFR-Part-11 signer-meaning-collection prompt drift (FDA inspector test): per-envelope Part-11 prompt + system-validation re-attestation.
  - eIDAS QES (Qualified Electronic Signature) requires Qualified Trust Service Provider linkage which is jurisdictional + non-trivial to re-bind: per-EU-jurisdiction QTSP re-provisioning playbook.
  - Anchor-string positioning drift on re-render (Oyatie's PDF anchor-engine may not match DocuSign's pixel-perfect positioning): per-template golden-render test.
  - webhook event-ordering not preserved (DocuSign retries can deliver out-of-order): per-config order-tolerant consumer pattern.
  - Notary audio-video recording format (DocuSign Notary uses specific encoded MP4 + journal-link): per-entry format + journal-link preservation.
  - Identity-verification provider re-binding (DocuSign uses Mitek + Onfido + IDology + Equifax behind the scenes): per-provider re-contract or Oyatie-IDV-shim.
  - CLM clause-library risk-profile drift on re-import: per-clause risk-score reconciliation.
  - CLM workflow state-machine transition drift: per-workflow shadow-eval.
  - Insight AI confidence-score drift on re-extraction: per-document re-extract + reviewer compare.
  - Embedded Signing iframe + URL signing pattern (DocuSign signing-URL is single-use short-TTL): per-envelope signing-URL re-issue.
  - Bulk Send CSV column-mapping drift: per-bulk-send mapping audit.
  - 7-year retention policy storage migration (cold-storage to Oyatie-cold-storage): per-tenant cold-tier re-binding.
  - 911 / Emergency-disclosure compliance (DocuSign retains records for subpoena): per-jurisdiction subpoena-response playbook.
  - Audit-trail event-type renaming: per-event-type alias-map.
  - FedRAMP / DOD-IL4 dedicated-cluster + cleared-personnel re-vetting: per-tenant FedRAMP-equivalent ATO re-attestation.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via DocuSign + CLM REST + Insight export: full account export.
  2. Re-bind integrations to Oyatie DocuSign-API-compatible endpoint; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate users + permission-profiles + brands.
  4. Migrate completed-envelopes (last 7yr) with Certificate-of-Completion validation.
  5. Re-issue in-flight envelopes via Oyatie sender.
  6. Migrate templates + PowerForms + Web-Forms + Bulk-Send + Connect.
  7. Migrate Notary-Journal + Identity-Verification.
  8. Migrate CLM + Insight + Maestro.
  9. Re-establish 21-CFR-Part-11 + HIPAA-BAA + FedRAMP attestations.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days; per-account cutover via OAuth; DocuSign sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `compliance` + `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `cloud-billing` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `docusign` + `esignature` + `clm` + `insight` + `identify` + `notary` + `negotiate` + `gen` + `click` + `monitor` + `web-forms` + `rooms` + `connector` + `maestro` + `iam` are benchmark alias-only. Anchor-string-driven tab positioning preserved as `oya-compliance-esignature-anchor-string-projection`.

### Section D-108 - Coupa
- Vendor name and category: Coupa Software Inc. — Coupa Business Spend Management (BSM) Platform + Coupa Procurement + Coupa Sourcing (RFx + auctions + supplier-selection) + Coupa Contract Lifecycle Management + Coupa Invoicing (eInvoicing + AP automation) + Coupa Expenses + Coupa Pay (B2B payments) + Coupa Treasury + Coupa Supplier Information Management (SIM) + Coupa Supplier Diversity + Coupa Supplier Risk Assessment + Coupa Travel + Coupa Inventory + Coupa Spend Analysis (analytics) + Coupa Community AI (community-derived AI insights — anonymized community spend benchmarks) + Coupa Open API + Coupa CSO (Compliance + Sustainability + Operations) + Coupa Sourcing Optimization.
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `cloud-billing` (invoice + payment + tax + AP automation + Pay anchor) + `marketplace` (supplier catalog + RFx + contracts + SIM + travel + inventory — Coupa is the cloud-BSM category leader; differentiated by community-AI-derived spend benchmarks + sourcing-optimization solver + end-to-end procure-to-pay+contract+expense+treasury under one platform) + `compliance` (Sarbanes-Oxley + ASC-606 + IFRS + e-Invoicing per-country mandates {Italy SdI, France FE, Mexico CFDI, Spain SII, India IRP, Brazil NFe, Saudi-Zatca, etc.} + supplier-diversity + ESG reporting + SOC-1 + SOC-2 + GDPR + ISO + HIPAA-limited) + `intelligence` (Community AI + spend-analysis + supplier-risk-scoring + invoice-OCR) + `workflow-engine` (approval workflows + sourcing event flows + contract workflows + risk-monitoring workflows) + `developer-sdk` (Coupa Open API + cXML + EDI + flat-file integrations) + `apigw` (per-account + OAuth + API-key)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Coupa Express / SMB → **Gold**; Coupa Enterprise (full BSM Suite + Pay + Treasury + Sourcing-Optimization + Community-AI + dedicated CSM + 99.9%-SLA + EU-residency + e-Invoicing-per-country + supplier-diversity + ESG + Customer-Managed-Keys) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `cloud-billing` (invoice + payment + tax + AP automation + Pay anchor); `marketplace` (supplier-catalog + RFx + contracts + SIM + travel + inventory anchor); `compliance` (SOX + ASC-606 + e-Invoicing + supplier-diversity + ESG); `intelligence` (Community-AI + spend-analysis + supplier-risk); `workflow-engine` (approval + sourcing + contract); `developer-sdk` (Coupa-API + cXML + EDI); `apigw` (OAuth + API-key).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Coupa canonical model):
  - `Account` (Account_ID, Instance-URL, Tier-Plan, Locale, Currency, Time-Zone, Multi-Org-Tree).
  - `Content_Group` (ContentGroup_ID, Name, Country-Group, Currency-Group, Visible-to-Users[]).
  - `User` (User_ID, Email, Login-Name, First+Last, Department, Manager, Default-Currency, Default-Locale, Roles[], Approval-Limits{}).
  - `Approval_Chain` (Chain_ID, Approvers-Ordered[], Threshold-Conditions[]).
  - `Supplier` (Supplier_ID, Display-Name, Legal-Name, Number, Tax-IDs[], DUNS, Addresses[], Bank-Accounts[], Diversity-Categories[], Risk-Score, ESG-Score, Status, Onboarding-Stage, Punchout-Catalog-Ref, cXML-Setup).
  - `Supplier_Information_Management_Form` (SIM_Form_ID, Supplier-Ref, Section-Definitions[], Submission, Reviewer, Status).
  - `Supplier_Risk_Assessment` (SRA_ID, Supplier-Ref, Risk-Domains[financial / cyber / sanctions / ESG / geographic], Source-Providers[Dun&Bradstreet + RapidRatings + EcoVadis + others], Last-Refresh).
  - `Requisition` (Requisition_ID, Requestor-Ref, Lines[], Justification, Status {draft / pending_approval / approved / ordered / withdrawn / rejected}, Approval-Chain-Ref, Currency, Total).
  - `Purchase_Order` (PO_ID, Number, Supplier-Ref, Lines[], Status {issued / received / closed / canceled}, Issued-Date, Buyer, Currency, Total, Document-Sent-Method {cXML / Email / Portal / EDI}).
  - `Invoice` (Invoice_ID, Number, Supplier-Ref, PO-Ref-or-Non-PO, Lines[], Tax-Lines[], Currency, Total, Status {draft / pending_approval / approved / on_hold / paid / canceled / disputed / abandoned}, Submission-Method {cXML / Email-PDF / Portal-Upload / SAP-Ariba-Network-via-coverage / etc.}, Compliance-Country-Code, e-Invoicing-Status {accepted-by-tax-authority / rejected / pending}, IRN/UUID-from-Tax-Authority).

  - `Sourcing_Event` (Event_ID, Type {RFI / RFQ / RFP / Reverse-Auction / Forward-Auction / Quick-Sourcing}, Items[], Suppliers-Invited[], Stages[Bid-Round + Negotiation-Round], Award-Criteria[Price + Quality + Delivery + ESG + Diversity], Status, Award).
  - `Contract` (Contract_ID, Type, Supplier-Ref, Effective-Date, Renewal-Date, Value, Currency, Clauses[], Owner, Status, e-Signature-Provider-Ref).
  - `Sourcing_Optimization_Scenario` (Scenario_ID, Solver-Constraints[], Bid-Data, Solution, KPI-Improvements).
  - `Payment_Run` (PaymentRun_ID, Source-Account, Invoices[], Payment-Method {ACH / Wire / Coupa-Pay-Card / Check / Cross-Border-FX}, Date, Status).

  - `Travel_Itinerary` (Itinerary_ID, Traveler-Ref, Segments[Flight + Hotel + Car], Cost, Approval-Chain, Status).
  - `Inventory_Item` (Item_ID, SKU, Description, On-Hand, Reorder-Point, Locations[Warehouse + Bin]).
  - `Punchout_Catalog_Session` (Session_ID, Supplier-Ref, User-Ref, Punchout-Setup-Request, Returned-Cart).
  - `Approval_Document` (Document_ID, Approvable-Type, Approvable-ID, Approver-Ref, Decision, Comments, Timestamp).
  - `Community_AI_Insight` (Insight_ID, Type {price-benchmark / supplier-suggestion / risk-alert / contract-clause-recommendation}, Source-Cohort (anonymized), Confidence, Linked-Object).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST (Coupa Open API): `https://{instance}.coupahost.com/api/`; resource shape `requisitions` + `purchase_orders` + `invoices` + `suppliers` + `users` + `expense_reports` + `sourcing_events` + `contracts` + `payments` + `approval_chains` + `cxml_documents` + `lookups`.
  - cXML: industry-standard XML for PunchOut + Order-Request + Order-Response + ConfirmationRequest + ShipNoticeRequest + InvoiceDetailRequest.
  - EDI: X12 850 / 855 / 856 / 810 / 820 for B2B integrations.
  - Auth: OAuth 2.0 (preferred) + API-key.
  - SDKs: limited official; community-maintained Ruby + Python + Node.
  - Webhooks: configurable per-event (PO-Issued + Invoice-Approved + Supplier-Onboarded + etc.).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Coupa Home" — buyer + approver + supplier dashboards.
  - "Requisition Editor" — Amazon-like search + add-to-cart + checkout for procurement.
  - "PO + Invoice Inbox" — buyer view of supplier docs.
  - "Supplier Portal" — separate supplier-facing UI for invoice submission + PO acknowledgment + catalog upload.
  - "Sourcing Event Designer" — multi-round RFx + auction config + award.
  - "Sourcing Optimization Solver" — constraint-based award-allocation tool.
  - "Contract Workspace" — clause + redline + e-signature flow.
  - "Expense Mobile App" — receipt capture + OCR + per-diem + mileage.
  - "Travel Booking" — corporate-policy-aware travel search + book.
  - "Coupa Pay" — payment-method config + payment-run + reconciliation.
  - "Spend Analysis" — slice-and-dice spend cubes + category trees.
  - "Community AI" — opt-in benchmarks + supplier suggestions + price guidance.
  - "Approval Workflow Designer" — multi-step + threshold-based.
  - "SIM Form Builder" — supplier-information-management form editor.

- **Cedar permit shape** (cloud-billing + marketplace + compliance + intelligence + workflow cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<coupa-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaRequisitionSubmit", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaRequisitionApprove",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaPOIssue", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaPOCancel",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaInvoiceSubmit", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaInvoiceApprove",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaInvoiceDispute", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaPaymentRunCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaPaymentRunRelease", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaSupplierOnboard",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaSupplierBankUpdate", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaSourcingEventCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaSourcingEventAward", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaContractExecute",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaExpenseSubmit", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaExpenseApprove",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaTravelBook", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaInventoryAdjust",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaSIMFormPublish", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaSRARefresh",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaCommunityAIQuery", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaApprovalChainEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"CoupaAPIKeyRotate", Oyatie::Action::"CoupaPunchoutSessionInitiate"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaAccount::"<acct-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaSupplier::"<supplier-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaRequisition::"<req-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaPO::"<po-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaInvoice::"<inv-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaPaymentRun::"<pr-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaSourcingEvent::"<event-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaContract::"<contract-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaExpenseReport::"<exp-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaTravelItinerary::"<it-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaInventoryItem::"<item-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaSIMForm::"<sim-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaApprovalChain::"<ac-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::CoupaAPIKey::"<key-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "requisition_above_approval_limit" || context.approval_chain_satisfied == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "po_issue_above_threshold" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "po_cancel_received_partial" || (principal.role == "buyer_admin" && context.supplier_notified == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "invoice_approve" || (context.three_way_match_satisfied == true || principal.role == "ap_admin")) &&
    (resource.kind != "invoice_dispute" || principal.role in ["ap_admin", "buyer_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "payment_run_release" || (principal.role == "treasury_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "supplier_bank_update" || (context.confirmation_callback_verified == true && principal.role == "supplier_admin")) &&
    (resource.kind != "sourcing_event_award" || (context.evaluation_complete == true && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "contract_execute" || (context.legal_review_complete == true && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "expense_approve_above_threshold" || context.policy_match == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "travel_book_above_policy" || (context.policy_exception_approved == true && principal.role in ["travel_admin", "manager"])) &&
    (resource.kind != "inventory_adjust_large" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "sim_form_publish" || principal.role in ["procurement_admin", "supplier_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "sra_refresh_high_risk" || principal.role == "risk_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "community_ai_query" || (context.tenant_community_ai_optin == true && context.tenant_data_share_optin == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "approval_chain_edit" || principal.role == "procurement_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "api_key_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true)
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: SOX (US public-company audit + segregation-of-duties + 3-way-match); ASC-606 + IFRS-15 (revenue + procurement-side revenue-receipt matching); e-Invoicing-per-country (Italy SdI + France FE + Mexico CFDI + Spain SII + India IRP + Brazil NFe + Saudi-Zatca + EU-DRR-2030 + KR-NTS): per-country tax-authority connector + IRN/UUID round-trip; SOC-1 + SOC-2 (audit + access-review); GDPR + KR-PIPA (EU-residency + DSAR); Supplier-Diversity (US 8(a) + WBE + MBE + LGBTBE + Veteran + EU diverse-supplier); ESG (EcoVadis + CDP + science-based-targets); EU-AI-Act (Community-AI + spend-analysis + supplier-risk-scoring conformance ledger).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):

  - `coupa.sim_form` → `oya-marketplace-supplier-info-form`.
  - `coupa.supplier_risk_assessment` → `oya-intelligence-supplier-risk-assessment`.
  - `coupa.requisition` → `oya-marketplace-requisition`.
  - `coupa.purchase_order` → `oya-marketplace-purchase-order`.
  - `coupa.invoice` → `oya-cloud-billing-invoice` with per-country e-invoicing-compliance preserved.
  - `coupa.expense_report` → `oya-cloud-billing-expense-report`.
  - `coupa.card_transaction` → `oya-cloud-billing-card-transaction`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (16 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `cloud-billing` + `marketplace` + `compliance` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` µservices with Coupa-BSM-feature-parity matrix (procure-to-pay + sourcing + contracts + invoicing + expenses + payments + treasury + supplier-information + supplier-risk + travel + inventory + spend-analysis + Community-AI + sourcing-optimization + per-country e-invoicing).
  2. Export Coupa via Open API: account + content-groups + users + approval-chains + suppliers + SIM-forms + SRA + requisitions + POs + invoices + expense-reports + card-transactions + sourcing-events + contracts + sourcing-optimization-scenarios + payment-runs + treasury-cash-positions + travel-itineraries + inventory-items + punchout-sessions + approval-documents + community-AI-insights.
  3. Re-bind merchant integrations: Coupa-API-protocol-compatible Oyatie endpoint + cXML + EDI shims for supplier-facing flows; dual-route 30 days.
  4. Per-Supplier: re-onboard with SIM form + bank-account-confirmation-callback (anti-fraud); Punchout-setup re-bind.
  5. Per-cXML/EDI Supplier-Network connection: re-establish on Oyatie marketplace; per-supplier test transaction.
  6. Per-Approval-Chain: transpile to Oyatie workflow-engine; per-chain shadow-eval on last-30d requisitions.
  7. Per-Requisition + PO (last 12mo): import for in-flight + 3-way-match continuity.
  8. Per-Invoice (last 7yr per tax-retention): import with per-country e-invoicing status + IRN/UUID preserved; per-country tax-authority connector re-test.
  9. Per-Expense-Report + Card-Transaction: import with match-state preserved.
  10. Per-Sourcing-Event (open + closed last 24mo): import bid-data + award; per-event continuity preserved.
  11. Per-Contract (active + recently-expired): import clauses + e-signature provider linkage + renewal-date alerts.
  12. Per-Sourcing-Optimization-Scenario: re-import solver-input + re-validate solution.
  13. Per-Payment-Run + Treasury-Cash-Position: re-bind to Oyatie cloud-billing payment-runs + treasury.
  14. Per-Travel-Itinerary + Inventory: re-bind to Oyatie travel + inventory.
  15. Per-SIM-Form + SRA: re-bind to Oyatie marketplace + intelligence; per-supplier risk-score recalculation.
  16. Per-Community-AI-Insight: re-bind to Oyatie intelligence (opt-in cohort preserved per ADR-0251 §D-10); parallel-run 30 days; per-content-group cutover via API + Supplier-Portal-DNS; Coupa contract sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (17 specific failures):
  - Per-country e-invoicing tax-authority connector gap (Italy SdI + France FE + Mexico CFDI + India IRP all have unique submit + IRN/UUID round-trip semantics): per-country connector golden-test on 100+ live invoices before cutover.
  - Supplier-Network connection re-handshake (cXML PunchOutSetupRequest signature drift): per-supplier cXML cert + auth re-bind.
  - EDI 850/810/820/856 schema-version drift: per-supplier EDI-version pin.
  - 3-way-match (PO + Receipt + Invoice) tolerance drift: per-tenant tolerance-policy preserve.
  - Approval-chain threshold-expression drift: per-chain transpile shadow.
  - Punchout-Setup catalog-content rendering drift: per-supplier punchout-session render test.
  - Sourcing-Optimization solver-constraint expression-language drift (Coupa uses proprietary LP/MIP): per-scenario solver-output diff.
  - Community-AI opt-in preservation (anonymized cohort-share is opt-in per supplier + per tenant): per-tenant opt-in re-collect.
  - Per-country e-invoicing IRN/UUID retention (tax-authority round-trip ID must persist for 7-10 years): per-invoice IRN preserve.
  - Bank-account-change-fraud (supplier bank-update is high-fraud target): per-supplier bank-change confirmation-callback + dual-control re-enforced post-migration.
  - Contract renewal-date alert + escalation drift: per-contract date-alert schedule preserve.
  - Expense-receipt OCR provider re-binding: per-receipt OCR re-run + match-state preserve.
  - Travel policy-engine + GDS (Sabre / Amadeus / Travelport) re-binding: per-GDS re-contract or shim.
  - Inventory location + reorder-point + cycle-count drift: per-location dual-write reconciliation.
  - Card-transaction MCC + spend-category mapping drift: per-card-program category-tree preserve.
  - Supplier-diversity certification re-binding (per-jurisdiction MWBE certificates have unique validation): per-supplier cert re-verify.
  - ESG (EcoVadis + CDP) score provider re-binding: per-supplier provider-link preserve.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Coupa Open API + cXML/EDI catalog export: full account export.
  2. Re-bind integrations to Oyatie Coupa-API-compatible endpoint; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate suppliers + SIM + SRA + cXML/EDI handshakes.
  4. Migrate approval-chains + content-groups + users.
  5. Migrate requisitions + POs + invoices (last 7yr) with e-invoicing IRN/UUID.
  6. Migrate expenses + card-transactions + travel + inventory.
  7. Migrate sourcing-events + contracts + sourcing-optimization.
  8. Migrate payment-runs + treasury.
  9. Migrate Community-AI insights with opt-in cohort preservation.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days; per-content-group cutover; Coupa sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `cloud-billing` + `marketplace` + `compliance` + `intelligence` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `coupa` + `bsm` + `procurement` + `sourcing` + `contracts` + `pay` + `treasury` + `sim` + `sra` + `travel` + `inventory` + `spend-analysis` + `community-ai` + `cso` + `cxml` + `punchout` are benchmark alias-only. Community-derived benchmarks preserved as `oya-intelligence-community-benchmark-insight` with mandatory tenant-and-supplier-opt-in per ADR-0251 §D-10.

### Section D-109 - Okta
- Vendor name and category: Okta Inc. — Okta Identity Cloud + Okta Workforce Identity Cloud (employee IAM: SSO + MFA + Lifecycle Management + Universal Directory + Adaptive MFA + Advanced Server Access + Access Gateway + API Access Management + Privileged Access (recently launched) + Identity Governance (formerly Okta Identity Governance — IGA)) + Okta Customer Identity Cloud (Auth0-based CIAM — covered in D-113) + Okta FastPass (passwordless) + Okta Verify (MFA app) + Okta ThreatInsight + Okta Workflows (Workato-derived automation) + Okta Personal (consumer password manager — formerly uno) + Okta Provisioning Connectors (SCIM + on-prem) + Okta Privileged Access (formerly ScaleFT) + Okta Devices.
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `iam` (canonical identity domain — Okta is the workforce-IAM category leader; differentiated by largest pre-integrated app catalog (7,000+ via Okta-Integration-Network OIN) + Universal-Directory schema-flexibility + workflow automation + governance + privileged-access under one identity-fabric) + `compliance` (SOC-2 Type II + ISO 27001 + 27017 + 27018 + 27701 + FedRAMP-High + DOD-IL4 + GDPR + HIPAA-BAA + EU-AI-Act for ThreatInsight) + `workflow-engine` (Okta Workflows — Workato-based no-code automation) + `intelligence` (ThreatInsight + Risk-Based Adaptive MFA + ML-driven anomaly detection) + `developer-sdk` (Okta API + SCIM + OIDC + SAML + WebAuthn + SDKs) + `apigw` (per-org + OAuth + API-token + API-Access-Management) + `observability` (System Log + SIEM streaming + audit)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Workforce Identity Essentials → **Silver**; Professional → **Gold**; Enterprise + Identity Governance + Privileged Access + FedRAMP (full Workforce Identity Cloud — dedicated cell + 99.99%-SLA + EU-residency + FedRAMP-High + DOD-IL4 + HIPAA-BAA + Identity-Governance + Privileged-Access + Workflows + Customer-Managed-Keys + on-prem-agents + Customer-IP-Allowlist) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `iam` (workforce identity + SSO + MFA + lifecycle + directory + governance + privileged-access anchor); `compliance` (SOC-2 + ISO + FedRAMP + DOD + GDPR + HIPAA); `workflow-engine` (Okta Workflows); `intelligence` (ThreatInsight + risk-based adaptive); `developer-sdk` (Okta-API-protocol-compat + OIDC + SAML + SCIM); `apigw` (OAuth + API-token + API-Access-Management); `observability` (System Log + SIEM stream).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Okta canonical model):
  - `Organization` (Org_ID, Subdomain, Type {production / preview / dev}, Domain-Customization, Custom-URL-Domain, SLA-Tier).
  - `User` (User_ID, Login (email), Profile{First+Last+Email+Login+Mobile+Title+Department+Manager+Custom-Attributes-via-Universal-Directory-Schema}, Status {STAGED / PROVISIONED / ACTIVE / RECOVERY / LOCKED_OUT / PASSWORD_EXPIRED / SUSPENDED / DEPROVISIONED}, Credentials{Provider + Password-Hash-Last-Update + Recovery-Question}, Type-Ref, Created, Activated, Last-Login).
  - `Group` (Group_ID, Type {OKTA_GROUP / APP_GROUP / BUILT_IN}, Name, Description, Members[], Rules[]).
  - `Group_Rule` (Rule_ID, Conditions{Expression}, Actions{Assign-Users-To-Groups}, Status).
  - `Application` (App_ID, Name, Label, Sign-On-Mode {SAML_2_0 / OPENID_CONNECT / SECURE_PASSWORD_STORE / AUTO_LOGIN / WS_FEDERATION / Custom}, Status, Settings{Provisioning + SAML-Settings + OIDC-Settings + SCIM-Settings + Bookmark-URL}, Visibility, Features[Provisioning + Import + Profile-Sync + Group-Sync + Profile-Mastering]).
  - `Application_User` (App-User-ID, App-Ref, User-Ref, Scope {USER / GROUP}, Status, Sync-State, External-ID).
  - `Application_Group` (App-Group-ID, App-Ref, Group-Ref, Priority, Profile-Push-Profile).
  - `Factor` (Factor_ID, User-Ref, Type {sms / call / email / push / token-software-totp / token-hardware / token-hotp / question / webauthn / fastpass / biometric}, Provider {OKTA / GOOGLE / RSA / SYMANTEC / DUO / YUBICO}, Status {ENROLLED / PENDING_ACTIVATION / ACTIVE / EXPIRED}).
  - `Authenticator` (Authenticator_ID, Type {password / phone / email / security-question / security-key / okta-verify / fastpass / on-prem}, Status, Policy-Override).
  - `Policy` + `Policy_Rule` (Policy_ID, Type {OKTA_SIGN_ON / PASSWORD / MFA_ENROLL / AUTHENTICATION / IDP_DISCOVERY / OAUTH_AUTHORIZATION / etc.}, Rules[Priority + Conditions{Network + User + UserType + AppContext + Risk} + Actions{Allow + Deny + MFA-Prompt + Session-Lifetime + Re-Authentication-Frequency}]).
  - `Network_Zone` (Zone_ID, Type {IP / DYNAMIC}, Gateway-Subnets[], Proxy-Subnets[], ASNs[], Locations[]).
  - `Identity_Provider` (IdP_ID, Type {SAML2 / OIDC / GOOGLE / FACEBOOK / X509 / MICROSOFT / etc.}, Issuer, Authorization-Endpoint, Token-Endpoint, JWKS).
  - `Trusted_Origin` (Origin_ID, Origin-URL, Scopes[]).
  - `Session` (Session_ID, User-Ref, Status, Expires-At, Last-Password-Verification, Last-Factor-Verification, Amr[], Idp).
  - `Event` (Event_ID — System Log, Event-Type, Actor, Client, Target[], Outcome, Severity, Display-Message, Debug-Context, Authentication-Context, Request{}, Geo).
  - `Token` (Token_ID — API-Access-Management, Subject, Audience, Scopes[], Expires-At).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: `https://{orgsubdomain}.okta.com/api/v1/`; resource shape `users` + `groups` + `apps` + `policies` + `factors` + `authenticators` + `network/zones` + `idps` + `sessions` + `logs` (System Log) + `tokens` + `authorizationServers` + `privilegedaccess` + `governance` + `iam`.
  - Auth: API-token (legacy) + OAuth-Auth-Code (preferred for delegated) + Private-Key-JWT (for service-to-service).
  - System Log streaming: `/api/v1/events` with poll + Event Hooks (webhooks) + SIEM connectors (Splunk + Sumo Logic + Datadog).
  - OIDC + SAML standards-compliant endpoints per app.
  - SCIM 2.0 for inbound provisioning from HR systems + outbound provisioning to apps.
  - SDKs: Okta-Node + Okta-Java + Okta-Python + Okta-Go + Okta-.NET + Okta-PHP + Okta-Spring-Boot + Okta-React + Okta-Vue + Okta-Angular + Okta-Auth-JS + Okta-iOS-Swift + Okta-Android.
  - CLI: `okta` CLI for dev-tooling.
  - Workflows: visual no-code editor exposed via Workflows-Console.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Okta Admin Console" — directory + applications + security + workflows + reports + settings home.
  - "Okta End-User Dashboard" — app-launchpad (chiclets) + self-service password reset + factor enrollment.
  - "Okta Verify Mobile App" — push + TOTP + FastPass biometric.
  - "Universal Directory" — schema editor for custom user attributes.
  - "Lifecycle Management" — joiner / mover / leaver automation via Group-Rules + Provisioning.
  - "Policies + Rules" — Sign-On + Password + MFA + Authentication + IDP-Discovery + Profile-Master policies.
  - "Application Integration Wizard" — SAML / OIDC config + SCIM provisioning setup.
  - "Okta Workflows" — visual no-code automation builder (cards + connections).
  - "ThreatInsight Dashboard" — suspicious-IP feed + brute-force + credential-stuffing detection.
  - "System Log" — searchable event log with replay + SIEM streaming.
  - "Identity Governance" — certification + access-review campaign console.
  - "Privileged Access" — just-in-time elevated-access request + approval + session-recording.
  - "Devices Console" — device-posture + device-trust enrollment.
  - "Okta Personal" (consumer) — personal password vault.

- **Cedar permit shape** (iam + compliance + workflow + intelligence + developer-sdk + apigw + observability cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<okta-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaUserCreate", Oyatie::Action::"OktaUserDeactivate",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaUserSuspend", Oyatie::Action::"OktaUserUnlock",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaUserResetPassword", Oyatie::Action::"OktaUserResetFactors",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaGroupCreate", Oyatie::Action::"OktaGroupRuleEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaAppAssign", Oyatie::Action::"OktaAppProvision",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaAppRevoke", Oyatie::Action::"OktaPolicyEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaPolicyRuleEdit", Oyatie::Action::"OktaNetworkZoneEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaIdPConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"OktaTrustedOriginCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaAuthServerConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"OktaAuthenticatorEnroll",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaWorkflowDeploy", Oyatie::Action::"OktaWorkflowExecute",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaPrivilegedAccessRequest", Oyatie::Action::"OktaPrivilegedAccessGrant",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaGovernanceCampaignLaunch", Oyatie::Action::"OktaGovernanceRequestApprove",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaSchemaEdit", Oyatie::Action::"OktaProvisioningConnectorConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaSystemLogExport", Oyatie::Action::"OktaAPITokenRotate",
      Oyatie::Action::"OktaThreatInsightOverride", Oyatie::Action::"OktaSuperAdminGrant"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaOrg::"<org-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaUser::"<user-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaGroup::"<group-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaApp::"<app-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaPolicy::"<policy-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaNetworkZone::"<zone-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaIdP::"<idp-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaAuthServer::"<as-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaAuthenticator::"<auth-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaWorkflow::"<wf-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaPrivilegedAccessResource::"<par-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaGovernanceCampaign::"<gc-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaSchema::"<schema-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaProvisioningConnector::"<conn-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OktaAPIToken::"<tok-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "user_create_admin_role" || (principal.role == "super_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "user_deactivate" || principal.role in ["user_admin", "hr_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "user_unlock_after_threatinsight_block" || principal.role in ["security_admin", "user_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "user_reset_factors" || principal.role in ["help_desk_admin", "user_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "group_rule_edit_breaking" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "app_assign_privileged" || (principal.role == "app_admin" && context.governance_approval_recorded == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "policy_edit_signon" || (principal.role == "security_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "network_zone_edit_trusted" || (principal.role == "security_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "idp_configure_federation" || principal.role == "federation_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "auth_server_configure" || principal.role in ["api_admin", "security_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "workflow_deploy_external_connection" || context.connection_target_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "privileged_access_grant" || (principal.role in ["privileged_access_admin", "approver"] && context.justification_recorded == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "governance_campaign_launch" || principal.role == "governance_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "governance_request_approve_above_threshold" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "schema_edit_breaking" || (principal.role == "directory_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "provisioning_connector_external" || context.connector_target_in_allowlist == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "system_log_export_external" || (principal.role in ["security_admin", "compliance_admin"] && context.siem_target_in_allowlist == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "api_token_rotate" || context.key_rotation_window_open == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "threatinsight_override" || (principal.role == "security_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "super_admin_grant" || (principal.role == "org_owner" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true))
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: SOC-2 Type II (audit + access-review + key-rotation); ISO 27001 + 27017 + 27018 + 27701 (cloud + cloud-PII); FedRAMP-High (Okta-for-Government cluster); DOD-IL4 (DOD-specific cluster + IL5 in roadmap); GDPR + KR-PIPA (EU-residency cell + DSAR); HIPAA-BAA (BAA-eligible Enterprise tier); EU-AI-Act (ThreatInsight + Adaptive-MFA ML conformance ledger); FIDO2-WebAuthn + FIDO2-CTAP2 (FastPass + security-keys); NIST-800-63B-AAL3 (highest assurance level for federal); OIDC + SAML 2.0 standards.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (17 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `iam` + `compliance` + `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `observability` µservices with Okta-Workforce-feature-parity matrix (SSO + MFA + Lifecycle + Universal-Directory + Adaptive-MFA + API-Access-Management + Workflows + Identity-Governance + Privileged-Access + ThreatInsight + Devices + FastPass).
  2. Export Okta org via REST: org + users + groups + group-rules + apps + app-user + app-group + factors + authenticators + policies + policy-rules + network-zones + IdPs + trusted-origins + sessions + events (System Log retention) + tokens + auth-servers + privileged-access + governance-campaigns + governance-requests + workflows + threat-insight-feed + UD-custom-schema + provisioning-connectors.
  3. Re-bind upstream HR sources (Workday + Ultimate + UKG + ADP + Bamboo + SAP-SuccessFactors): SCIM re-provisioning into Oyatie Universal-Directory.
  4. Re-bind downstream apps (7,000+ in Okta-Integration-Network): per-app SAML/OIDC/SCIM re-config; Oyatie ships its own pre-integrated catalog as `oya-iam-app-integration-catalog`.
  5. Per-User: re-create with profile + Universal-Directory custom-attributes + status-state-machine preserved; per-user password-credential decision (re-provision vs. force-reset).
  6. Per-Group + Group-Rule: re-create with rule-expression transpiled; per-rule shadow-eval on last-30d membership-changes.
  7. Per-Application: re-config SAML/OIDC/SCIM; per-app golden-test on signing + provisioning.
  8. Per-Factor + Authenticator: re-enroll users (FastPass + Okta-Verify + WebAuthn must be re-enrolled — no key-export possible for biometric / hardware factors); per-user re-enrollment campaign.
  9. Per-Policy + Policy-Rule: transpile to Oyatie policy-engine; per-policy shadow-eval.
  10. Per-Network-Zone + Trusted-Origin: re-config; per-zone IP-range coverage audit.
  11. Per-IdP (SAML / OIDC / Social / X.509): re-bind; per-IdP federation handshake test.
  12. Per-Auth-Server + Token: re-configure API-Access-Management with new issuer; tokens force-rotate.
  13. Per-Privileged-Access-Resource + Request: re-bind to Oyatie privileged-access; session-recording archive preserved.
  14. Per-Governance-Campaign + Request: re-bind to Oyatie governance; in-flight campaigns continue or pause.
  15. Per-Workflow: transpile Okta-Workflows to Oyatie workflow-engine; per-workflow shadow-eval; preserve connection-credentials securely.
  16. Per-ThreatInsight feed + per-UD-schema + per-Provisioning-Connector: re-bind to Oyatie intelligence + directory + provisioning.
  17. Stream System Log to Oyatie observability + downstream SIEM; per-event-type alias-map; parallel-run 30 days dual-IdP (Okta as primary, Oyatie as shadow IdP via cross-IdP-bridge); per-app cutover via SAML/OIDC re-issuance; Okta contract sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (19 specific failures):
  - WebAuthn + FIDO2 hardware-key re-enrollment (security-keys cryptographically bound to per-IdP origin — can't be transferred): per-user re-enroll campaign + bridged-MFA window.
  - Okta-Verify + FastPass biometric re-enrollment (no export possible): per-user re-enroll campaign.
  - Universal-Directory custom-schema attribute-type drift: per-attribute schema migration audit.
  - Group-Rule expression-language drift: per-rule transpile shadow.
  - Policy rule-evaluation ordering drift (Okta evaluates priority-ordered, first-match): per-policy shadow-eval.
  - SAML signing-certificate rotation breaks downstream app trust: per-app cert-rotation playbook with overlap.
  - OIDC client-id + client-secret rotation: per-app re-issue + downstream re-config.
  - SCIM provisioning connector schema-mapping drift: per-connector mapping audit.
  - Workflows visual-card behavior drift (Workato-derived — specific Action + If + For-Loop semantics): per-workflow transpile + shadow.
  - ThreatInsight feed re-binding to Oyatie threat-intel sources: per-feed coverage gap audit.
  - Identity-Governance campaign in-flight state preserved (some reviewers may have already certified): per-campaign mid-flight snapshot.
  - Privileged-Access session-recording format + retention drift: per-recording format-preserve audit.
  - System-Log event-type renaming + payload schema drift: per-event-type alias-map + SIEM downstream re-config.
  - FedRAMP-High dedicated cluster re-attestation (ATO is org-specific + non-transferable): per-tenant ATO re-issue.
  - DOD-IL4 cleared-personnel re-vetting: per-tenant cleared-personnel re-assignment.
  - HIPAA-BAA re-execution: per-tenant BAA-signing.
  - End-user dashboard chiclets URL change breaks bookmarks: per-tenant dashboard-redirect-shim.
  - End-user mobile-app (Okta-Verify) factory-reset campaign: per-user re-enrollment communications.
  - Cross-IdP-bridge during dual-IdP window (Okta-as-primary, Oyatie-as-shadow): per-app SAML/OIDC dual-config with primary-secondary fallback.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Okta API + System-Log export + Workflows-export: full org export.
  2. Re-bind HR sources + downstream apps; dual-route 30 days.
  3. Migrate users + groups + group-rules + UD-schema.
  4. Migrate apps + app-user + app-group + provisioning-connectors.
  5. Re-enroll factors + authenticators (campaign).
  6. Migrate policies + network-zones + IdPs + auth-servers.
  7. Migrate workflows + privileged-access + governance.
  8. Stream System-Log to Oyatie observability + downstream SIEM.
  9. Re-establish FedRAMP-High / DOD-IL4 / HIPAA-BAA / SOC-2 attestations.
  10. Parallel-run 30 days; per-app cutover via SAML/OIDC re-issuance; Okta sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `iam` + `compliance` + `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `observability` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `okta` + `workforce-identity-cloud` + `customer-identity-cloud` + `fastpass` + `okta-verify` + `threatinsight` + `okta-workflows` + `universal-directory` + `okta-integration-network` + `oin` + `privileged-access` + `identity-governance` are benchmark alias-only. Identity-cloud surface preserved as the dedicated `iam` µservice per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout.

### Section D-110 - CrowdStrike
- Vendor name and category: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. — CrowdStrike Falcon Platform: Falcon Prevent (NGAV) + Falcon Insight XDR / EDR + Falcon Discover (asset + identity) + Falcon Spotlight (vulnerability management) + Falcon Identity Protection (ITDR) + Falcon Cloud Security (CNAPP — CSPM + CWP + CDR + ASPM) + Falcon LogScale (log analytics — formerly Humio) + Falcon Surface (external attack-surface management — formerly Reposify) + Falcon Adversary Intelligence (threat intel + CrowdStrike Intelligence) + Falcon Counter Adversary Operations (managed threat hunting Falcon OverWatch + Managed Detection Falcon Complete) + Falcon Foundry (no-code app dev) + Charlotte AI (generative-AI assistant) + Falcon Data Protection (DLP — recently launched) + Falcon for Mobile + Falcon for IoT + Falcon Sandbox (malware analysis) + Falcon Forensics + Falcon Discover for Cloud + Falcon Real-Time Response (RTR) + Falcon ZTA (Zero-Trust-Assessment-Score).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `cyber` (canonical security domain — CrowdStrike is the cloud-native endpoint-security category leader; differentiated by single-agent unified platform spanning endpoint + identity + cloud + log + attack-surface + threat-intel + managed-hunting + DLP under one Falcon Cloud) + `intelligence` (Charlotte AI + Adversary Intelligence + Indicator-of-Attack ML) + `observability` (LogScale log analytics + Falcon telemetry stream) + `compliance` (SOC-2 + FedRAMP-Moderate + DOD-IL4 + GDPR + HIPAA + PCI-DSS + ISO + EU-AI-Act for Charlotte) + `workflow-engine` (Falcon Foundry app builder + Fusion workflows) + `developer-sdk` (Falcon API + Falcon Foundry SDK + LogScale-Search SDK + CrowdStrike-CLI) + `apigw` (per-customer + OAuth-Client-Credentials + API-Client-ID + Secret) + `iam` (Falcon Identity Protection + Falcon ZTA)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Falcon Go (SMB) → **Silver**; Falcon Pro → **Gold**; Falcon Enterprise / Premium / Complete + FedRAMP (Falcon Enterprise + Falcon Complete managed-MDR + Falcon-OverWatch managed-threat-hunt + dedicated cluster + 99.95%-SLA + EU-residency + FedRAMP-Moderate + DOD-IL4 + Customer-Managed-Keys + Customer-Quarantine-Region) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `cyber` (endpoint + identity + cloud + log + attack-surface + threat-intel + managed-hunting + DLP anchor); `intelligence` (Charlotte + Adversary-Intel + IoA-ML); `observability` (LogScale + Falcon-telemetry); `compliance` (SOC-2 + FedRAMP + DOD + GDPR + HIPAA + PCI + EU-AI-Act); `workflow-engine` (Foundry + Fusion); `developer-sdk` (Falcon-API-protocol-compat); `apigw` (OAuth-Client-Credentials); `iam` (Identity-Protection + ZTA).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Falcon Console" — modules-launchpad (Endpoint-Security + Identity-Protection + Cloud-Security + LogScale + Surface + Adversary-Intel + Discover + Spotlight + DLP + Foundry).
  - "Endpoint Detection + Response (EDR)" — process-tree + behavior-timeline + RTR-shell.

  - "Identity Protection" — AD + Entra-ID + Okta identity-risk timeline.
  - "Cloud Security Posture (CSPM)" — multi-cloud account inventory + findings + compliance frameworks.
  - "LogScale Search" — Humio-derived log analytics with live + saved queries.
  - "Charlotte AI" — conversational assistant with citations to detections + intel + telemetry.
  - "Falcon Surface" — external attack-surface inventory.

  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<crowdstrike-user-uuid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"FalconDetectionAcknowledge", Oyatie::Action::"FalconDetectionClassify",
      Oyatie::Action::"FalconIncidentEscalate", Oyatie::Action::"FalconIoCCreate",

    ],

      Oyatie::Resource::FalconDetection::"<det-id>",

      Oyatie::Resource::FalconRTRScript::"<script-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FalconSensorUpdate::"<sensor-update-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FalconExclusion::"<excl-id>",

  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "detection_classify_false_positive" || principal.role in ["analyst", "soc_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "incident_escalate" || principal.role in ["analyst", "soc_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "ioc_create_allow" || (principal.role == "soc_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "custom_ioa_rule_prevent" || (principal.role == "soc_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "prevention_policy_edit_slider_down" || (principal.role == "soc_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "rtr_session_start" || principal.role in ["responder", "soc_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "rtr_command_execute_destructive" || (principal.role == "responder" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "rtr_script_upload" || (principal.role == "responder" && context.script_signed == true)) &&

    (resource.kind != "sensor_uninstall" || (principal.role == "soc_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "exclusion_create" || (principal.role == "soc_admin" && context.exclusion_justification_recorded == true)) &&

    (resource.kind != "logscale_query_pii_repo" || (principal.role == "data_governance_admin" && context.pii_repo_access_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "foundry_app_deploy_breaking" || context.dual_control_approver_present == true) &&
