- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (16 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `cyber` + `intelligence` + `observability` + `compliance` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `iam` µservices with Falcon-feature-parity matrix (NGAV + EDR + RTR + Identity-Protection + Spotlight + CSPM + CWP + LogScale + Surface + Adversary-Intel + OverWatch-managed-hunt + Charlotte-AI + DLP + Sensor-Update + Custom-IoA + Foundry).
  2. Export CrowdStrike CID via REST: customer-account + hosts + host-groups + detections (last 6mo) + incidents + IoCs + custom-IoA + prevention-policies + sensor-update-policies + response-policies + RTR-sessions (last 90d) + RTR-scripts + vulnerabilities + identity-accounts + identity-detections + cloud-account-assets + cloud-posture-findings + container-image-vulnerabilities + adversary-profiles + intel-IoCs + LogScale-repos + searches + dashboards + alerts + Foundry-apps + Charlotte-AI-conversations + DLP-policies + Surface-assets + Sensor-exclusions.
  3. Plan single-agent replacement: Falcon sensor (single agent — Windows + macOS + Linux + iOS + Android + ChromeOS) → Oyatie cyber-endpoint-sensor; per-platform sensor-pair window with both agents running for 30 days (high-CPU but necessary to ensure detection-continuity).
  4. Per-Host: re-enroll on Oyatie endpoint-sensor with preserved hostname + tags + host-group assignment.
  5. Per-Host-Group + Prevention-Policy + Sensor-Update-Policy + Response-Policy: re-create on Oyatie with transpiled settings; per-policy shadow-eval on last-30d behavior-pattern matches.
  6. Per-Custom-IoA-Rule: transpile to Oyatie custom-IoA rule-engine; per-rule shadow-eval.
  7. Per-IoC + Threat-Intel-IoC: re-bind to Oyatie threat-intel feed; per-IoC source + confidence preserved.
  8. Per-RTR-Script: re-upload + re-sign on Oyatie; per-script approval re-flow.
  9. Per-Identity-Protection + Spotlight + Cloud-Security: re-bind to Oyatie identity + vuln + cloud-security modules; per-finding state preserved.
  10. Per-LogScale-Repo + Search + Dashboard + Alert: migrate to Oyatie observability LogScale-compat repo; per-query Humio-syntax shadow-eval.
  11. Per-Foundry-App: re-deploy on Oyatie workflow-engine; per-app function shadow-eval.
  12. Per-DLP-Policy: re-bind to Oyatie DLP; per-policy shadow-eval on last-30d sample.
  13. Per-Surface-Asset: re-bind to Oyatie attack-surface inventory; per-asset risk-score preserved.
  14. Per-Charlotte-AI-Conversation: archive (conversations don't migrate); per-tenant AI-opt-in re-collect with EU-AI-Act ledger.
  15. Per-Sensor-Exclusion: re-create with approver + justification preserved.
  16. Decommission Falcon sensor on per-host basis after 30-day pair-window confirms Oyatie detection-coverage parity; per-CID cutover via API-token-router; CrowdStrike contract sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (19 specific failures):
  - Sensor pair-window CPU + memory overhead (running two EDR agents on same host can trigger AV conflict + perf degradation): per-platform agent-conflict-mode + memory-budget tuning.
  - Detection-continuity gap during cutover (window between Falcon-disable and Oyatie-detect-go-live): per-host overlap-window > 24h + shadow-eval reconciliation.
  - Custom-IoA rule pattern-disposition semantic drift (Falcon-IoA-language is proprietary): per-rule transpile + golden-test on known-bad samples.
  - Process-tree + behavior-timeline format drift (Falcon's pattern-ID + MITRE-ATT&CK mapping is proprietary): per-detection MITRE-tag preserve + Falcon-pattern-ID alias.
  - RTR script-platform drift (Falcon-RTR-scripts use Falcon-specific cmdlets like `runscript`, `runlib`): per-script transpile to Oyatie RTR-script-language.
  - Sensor-Update-Policy ring (N / N-1 / N-2 / latest) cadence drift: per-policy ring cadence preserve.
  - Prevention-Policy ML-slider numeric mapping drift (Falcon-ML-slider is 1-7 with proprietary tuning): per-policy slider-to-Oyatie-tuning calibration shadow.
  - Sensor-Anti-Tampering drift (Falcon sensors are hard to uninstall — by design; on Oyatie side must respect): per-host sensor-uninstall workflow with admin + reboot.
  - LogScale Humio-query-language dialect drift: per-search query-port test.
  - Foundry app manifest-schema drift: per-app manifest transpile + shadow.
  - Identity-Protection AD + Entra-ID + Okta connection re-bind: per-IdP re-connect + entity-state shadow.
  - Spotlight ExPRT-Rating proprietary ML drift: per-vuln rating recalc + reviewer compare.
  - Cloud-Security multi-cloud connector re-bind (AWS + Azure + GCP + OCI roles): per-cloud-account role re-issue + permission shadow.
  - Container Image Scanning registry-connector re-bind: per-registry re-connect.
  - Adversary-Profile + Intel-Report access-tier (Premium intel vs. Standard): per-tier license re-bind on Oyatie.
  - Charlotte-AI grounding + citation-source drift (Charlotte cites internal-detections + intel-reports): per-citation-source re-bind.
  - DLP-Policy sensitive-data-type pattern drift (per-region credit-card + national-ID patterns differ): per-policy data-type pattern preserve.
  - Surface external-attack-surface scan-cadence drift: per-org scan cadence preserve.
  - FedRAMP / DOD-IL4 cleared-personnel re-vetting: per-tenant ATO re-attestation.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Falcon REST + Streaming + LogScale-export: full CID export.
  2. Plan 30-day sensor-pair window with both Falcon and Oyatie endpoint-sensor running.
  3. Migrate hosts + host-groups + policies + exclusions.
  4. Migrate detections + incidents + IoCs + custom-IoA with shadow-eval.
  5. Migrate RTR + scripts + sensor-update.
  6. Migrate Identity-Protection + Spotlight + Cloud-Security + Container.
  7. Migrate LogScale repos + searches + dashboards + alerts.
  8. Migrate Foundry apps + DLP + Surface.
  9. Re-establish FedRAMP-Moderate / DOD-IL4 / HIPAA-BAA / SOC-2 attestations.
  10. Decommission Falcon sensors per-host after 30-day pair-window; per-CID cutover; CrowdStrike sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `cyber` + `intelligence` + `observability` + `compliance` + `workflow-engine` + `developer-sdk` + `apigw` + `iam` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `crowdstrike` + `falcon` + `falcon-prevent` + `falcon-insight` + `falcon-discover` + `falcon-spotlight` + `falcon-identity-protection` + `falcon-cloud-security` + `falcon-logscale` + `falcon-surface` + `falcon-overwatch` + `falcon-complete` + `falcon-foundry` + `charlotte-ai` + `falcon-dlp` + `falcon-zta` + `falcon-sandbox` + `falcon-rtr` are benchmark alias-only. The `cyber` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Falcon-equivalent platform surface.

- Vendor name and category: Asana Inc. — Asana Work Management Platform: Asana Tasks + Projects + Portfolios + Goals (OKR) + Workload (resource mgmt) + Timeline (Gantt) + Boards (Kanban) + Calendar + List + Inbox + My Tasks + Forms + Rules (automation) + Approvals + Proofing + Asana AI (Smart fields + Smart status + Smart summaries + Smart goals) + Asana Flow (workflow builder + Bundles) + Universal Reporting + Custom Fields + Status Updates + Milestones + Dependencies + Subtasks + Sections + Tags + Custom Templates + App Integrations (270+ — Slack + Teams + Zoom + Salesforce + Gmail + Outlook + Drive + OneDrive + Dropbox + Box + Adobe-CC + Figma + GitHub + Jira + Power-BI + Tableau + Looker) + Asana Embedded + Asana for Marketing + Asana for IT + Asana for Operations + Asana for HR + Asana Enterprise + EKM (Enterprise Key Management) + Service Accounts + Audit-Log API.

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: `https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/` resource shapes `workspaces` + `teams` + `projects` + `tasks` + `sections` + `stories` + `attachments` + `portfolios` + `goals` + `time_periods` + `status_updates` + `custom_fields` + `custom_field_settings` + `rules` + `bundles` + `forms` + `workspace_memberships` + `team_memberships` + `project_memberships` + `users` + `audit_log_events` + `service_accounts`; pagination via `offset` + `limit`.
  - Auth: Personal-Access-Token + OAuth-2.0 (Client-ID + Secret + Redirect-URI + scopes `default` / `email` / `openid` / `profile`); Service-Account-Token for Enterprise.
  - Webhooks: `GET / POST /webhooks` with `resource` + `target` URI; signature verification via X-Hook-Signature HMAC-SHA256; events `added` / `changed` / `removed` / `deleted` / `undeleted`.
  - GraphQL: limited preview surface for query-heavy clients; Asana Embedded uses GraphQL.
  - SDKs: official Python (`asana`) + Node (`asana-node`) + Java + Ruby + PHP + .NET.
  - CLI: community `asana-cli`.
  - Rate Limits: standard 1500 req/min; Enterprise 3500 req/min.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "My Tasks" — personal triage inbox (today / upcoming / later sections).
  - "Inbox" — notification-center with read / archived / mentions.
  - "Project List View" — spreadsheet-like task grid with custom-fields columns.
  - "Project Board View" — Kanban with sections-as-columns.
  - "Project Timeline (Gantt)" — task bars with dependencies + critical path.
  - "Project Calendar" — due-date grid view.
  - "Portfolios" — multi-project rollup with status-color heat-map.
  - "Goals" — hierarchical OKR tree with progress + status.
  - "Workload" — assignee-by-week resource view with capacity bars.
  - "Universal Reporting" — chart-builder (bar + line + pie + funnel + burnup) over task-graph.
  - "Rules Builder" — if-this-then-that for projects.
  - "Bundles" — composable rule + custom-field + section template applied to projects.
  - "Forms" — public/internal intake forms feeding tasks.
  - "Approvals" — task-subtype with approver chain.
  - "Proofing" — image/PDF/video markup + version compare.
  - "Asana AI Sidebar" — smart-summary + smart-goals + smart-status + smart-fields.

- **Cedar permit shape** (workflow-engine + intelligence + collaboration + automation + apigw + compliance cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<asana-user-gid>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaTaskCreate", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaTaskUpdate",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaTaskDelete", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaTaskAssign",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaTaskComplete", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaApprovalDecide",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaStoryPost", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaAttachmentUpload",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaProjectCreate", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaProjectDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaProjectMemberInvite", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaPortfolioEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaGoalEdit", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaStatusUpdatePost",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaRuleEdit", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaBundleApply",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaFormPublish", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaCustomFieldEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaWorkloadEdit", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaWebhookManage",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaServiceAccountIssue", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaAuditLogExport",
      Oyatie::Action::"AsanaAIInvoke", Oyatie::Action::"AsanaEKMKeyRotate"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::AsanaWorkspace::"<ws-gid>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AsanaTeam::"<team-gid>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AsanaProject::"<proj-gid>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AsanaTask::"<task-gid>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AsanaPortfolio::"<port-gid>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AsanaGoal::"<goal-gid>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AsanaStatusUpdate::"<su-gid>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AsanaRule::"<rule-gid>",
      Oyatie::Resource::AsanaBundle::"<bundle-gid>",

    (resource.kind != "project_delete" || (principal.role == "workspace_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&

    (resource.kind != "approval_decide" || principal.user_gid in resource.approvers) &&
    (resource.kind != "rule_edit_destructive" || (principal.role in ["project_admin", "workspace_admin"] && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "bundle_apply_global" || principal.role == "workspace_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "form_publish_public" || principal.role in ["project_admin", "workspace_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "custom_field_edit_global" || principal.role == "workspace_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_log_export" || principal.role in ["compliance_admin", "workspace_admin"]) &&

    (resource.kind != "asana_ai_invoke" || (context.tenant_ai_optin == true && context.workspace_ai_optin == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "asana_ai_invoke_pii_project" || context.pii_project_ai_approved == true)
  };

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (17 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` + `collaboration` + `automation` + `apigw` + `compliance` + `iam` µservices with Asana-feature-parity matrix (Tasks + Projects + Portfolios + Goals + Workload + Rules + Bundles + Forms + Approvals + Proofing + Universal-Reporting + Asana-AI + Audit-Log + Service-Accounts + EKM).
  2. Export Asana workspace via REST: workspaces + teams + projects + sections + tasks + subtasks + dependencies + stories + attachments + custom-fields + portfolios + goals + time-periods + status-updates + workload-allocations + rules + bundles + forms + workspace/team/project memberships + audit-log + service-accounts + asana-AI conversation history.
  3. Plan per-team migration cohorts (Marketing / Engineering / Ops / HR per Asana templates).
  4. Per-Team: re-create on Oyatie with preserved privacy + visibility-default + membership.
  5. Per-Project: re-create with preserved layout + privacy + owner + members + followers + color + icon + default-access-level + permalink (issue redirect alias).
  6. Per-Section: preserved order within project.
  7. Per-Task + Subtask: re-create with preserved GID-alias + name + notes + HTML-notes + assignee + assignee-status + completed-state + due-on / due-at + start-on + dependencies + tags + custom-fields + memberships + resource-subtype (approval / milestone / default) + approval-status; subtask parent chain preserved.
  8. Per-Story: replay as Oyatie activity-entries; HTML preserved; system-stories regenerated where deterministic (e.g., "X assigned task to Y").
  9. Per-Attachment: re-host on Oyatie object-store; external (drive/dropbox/box/onedrive) host-tokens re-grant; permalink preserve.
  10. Per-Custom-Field: re-create with type + enum-options + formula transpile (Asana formula DSL → Oyatie formula).
  11. Per-Portfolio + Goal + Time-Period: re-create with progress-source + parent-goal chain.
  12. Per-Status-Update: re-post on Oyatie with author + status-type preserved.
  13. Per-Workload-Allocation: re-create with effort-type + effort-value preserved.
  14. Per-Rule + Bundle: transpile to Oyatie automation-DSL; per-rule shadow-eval on last-30d trigger-history.
  15. Per-Form: re-publish with field-set + submit URL alias.
  16. Per-Webhook + Service-Account + API-Token: re-issue on Oyatie with rotated secrets + audit-log entry; per-integration re-grant.
  17. Decommission Asana on per-workspace basis after 30-day shadow window confirms parity; per-workspace cutover via DNS + API-token-router; Asana contract sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (17 specific failures):
  - Custom-field formula-DSL drift (Asana formulas reference field-GIDs + workspace functions): per-field transpile + golden-test on last-quarter computed values.
  - Rule-engine trigger semantic drift (Asana rules trigger on field-change events with sub-second debounce): per-rule shadow-eval on 30-day event replay.
  - Task-dependency cycle handling drift (Asana allows lazy cycles, Oyatie may reject): pre-migration cycle-detection sweep.
  - Approval-task multi-stage routing drift (Asana approvals have single approver-set; multi-stage simulated): per-approval transpile to Oyatie approval-chain.
  - Proofing annotation positioning drift (Asana stores coords relative to render size): per-proof coord-transform on re-render.
  - Asana-AI Smart-Summary citation back-link drift (citations reference Story-GIDs): per-summary citation rewrite to Oyatie activity-entry IDs.
  - Workload-allocation effort-percent vs effort-hours mode drift: per-allocation mode preserve + tenant default-mode.
  - Form submission anonymous-allowed flag drift: per-form anonymous-flag preserve + per-tenant CAPTCHA hook.
  - Portfolio-of-portfolio nesting depth (Asana supports nested portfolios): per-nested-portfolio recursive create.
  - Goal progress-source `project / sub_goal / task_completion / manual` enum drift: per-goal source mapping + recompute.
  - Service-account API-token scope drift: per-SA scope-mapping + rotated-secret re-issue.
  - EKM key-rotation cadence drift: per-tenant EKM-key import + rotation-schedule preserve.
  - Audit-log-event type taxonomy drift: per-event-type mapping table maintained.
  - Asana-Connect-Embedded integration re-bind (270+ integrations): per-app OAuth re-grant + scope-shadow.
  - Permalink-URL alias preservation (Asana permalinks are GID-encoded; SEO + share-link backlog): per-resource 301-redirect map.
  - Asana-AI tenant-opt-in re-collect (EU-AI-Act + tenant AI-policy): per-workspace AI-policy re-acknowledge ledger.
  - Rate-limit ceiling drift (Enterprise 3500 rpm vs Oyatie default): per-tenant rate-policy alignment + grace-period.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Asana REST + audit-log + asana-AI conversation history.
  2. Plan 30-day shadow window with parallel writes (Asana + Oyatie).
  3. Migrate workspaces + teams + projects + sections + tasks + subtasks + stories + attachments.
  4. Migrate custom-fields + portfolios + goals + time-periods + status-updates.
  5. Migrate workload-allocations + rules + bundles + forms + approvals + proofing.
  6. Migrate memberships (workspace + team + project) + service-accounts + EKM-keys.
  7. Migrate Asana-AI conversation history + smart-summary citation re-binding.
  8. Re-establish 270+ app-integrations via OAuth re-grant.
  9. Re-establish SOC-2 / ISO / GDPR / HIPAA / EU-AI-Act attestations.
  10. Decommission Asana per-workspace after 30-day shadow; cutover via DNS + API-token-router; Asana sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` + `collaboration` + `automation` + `apigw` + `compliance` + `iam` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `asana` + `asana-ai` + `asana-flow` + `asana-bundles` + `asana-rules` + `asana-portfolios` + `asana-goals` + `asana-workload` + `asana-universal-reporting` + `asana-connect-embedded` + `asana-ekm` are benchmark alias-only. The `workflow-engine` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Asana-equivalent work-management surface.

- Vendor name and category: monday.com Ltd. — monday Work OS: monday Work Management + monday Sales CRM + monday Dev (developer projects) + monday Service (helpdesk) + monday Marketer + monday Projects + monday WorkForms + monday DocsAI + monday Workdocs + monday Workspace + Boards + Items + Subitems + Groups + Columns (40+ column types — status / dropdown / numbers / formula / date / timeline / person / team / location / files / mirror / connect-boards / dependency / tags / hour / world-clock / vote / rating / progress / tracking / email / phone / link / country / time-tracking / item-id / creation-log / last-updated / button / auto-number / lookup) + Views (Table / Kanban / Timeline / Gantt / Calendar / Chart / Map / Workload / Form / Files / Cards) + Automations (250+ recipes + custom builder) + Integrations (200+ apps) + monday AI (Quick-Compose + Sentiment-Analysis + AI-Assistant + AI-Workflows + Smart-Categories + AI-Block) + Apps Framework (build apps + sell on marketplace) + Workforms (form builder) + WorkdocsAI (collaborative docs + AI rewrite + summary) + Mirror Columns + Connect-Boards Columns + Dependencies + Time-Tracking + Workload + Enterprise Scale (audit log + SCIM + SAML SSO + HIPAA + IP-restrictions + private-board + panic-mode).

    (resource.kind != "integration_install_paid" || principal.role in ["workspace_admin", "account_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "app_install_high_scope" || (principal.role == "account_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "webhook_manage" || principal.role in ["board_owner", "workspace_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_log_export" || principal.role in ["compliance_admin", "account_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "monday_ai_invoke" || (context.tenant_ai_optin == true && context.account_ai_optin == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "doc_ai_edit_compliance_doc" || context.compliance_doc_ai_approved == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "panic_mode_activate" || (principal.role == "account_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true))
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: SOC-2 Type II (audit-log + access-review); ISO-27001 / 27017 / 27018 / 27701; GDPR + KR-PIPA + EU-DPF (EU-Frankfurt residency + DSAR); HIPAA-BAA (Enterprise BAA-eligible); EU-AI-Act (monday-AI Quick-Compose + Sentiment + Assistant + Workflows conformance ledger); CCPA + CPRA (US-CA opt-out).

- **Ontology projection** (vendor → Oyatie entity, field-level deltas):
  - `monday.account` + `monday.workspace` → `oya-workflow-engine-account` + `-workspace`.
  - `monday.board` → `oya-workflow-engine-board` (kind {public/private/share} preserved as visibility-level).
  - `monday.item` + `monday.subitem` → `oya-workflow-engine-work-item` (parent-item ref for subitem preserved).
  - `monday.group` → `oya-workflow-engine-group`.
  - `monday.column` + `monday.column_value` → `oya-workflow-engine-column` + `-column-value` (40+ type taxonomy preserved as enum; formula DSL transpiled).
  - `monday.update` → `oya-collaboration-update`.
  - `monday.asset` → `oya-collaboration-asset`.
  - `monday.doc` + `monday.doc_block` → `oya-collaboration-doc` + `-doc-block`.
  - `monday.view` → `oya-workflow-engine-view` (type enum preserved).
  - `monday.workform` → `oya-workflow-engine-intake-form`.
  - `monday.automation_recipe` → `oya-automation-recipe`.
  - `monday.integration` → `oya-automation-integration-binding`.
  - `monday.app_subscription` + `monday.app_manifest` → `oya-marketplace-app-subscription` + `oya-marketplace-app-manifest`.
  - `monday.webhook` → `oya-apigw-webhook`.
  - `monday.audit_log` → `oya-compliance-audit-log-event`.
  - `monday.monday_ai_action_log` + `monday.workdoc_ai_edit` → `oya-intelligence-workflow-ai-action` + `-doc-ai-edit` (EU-AI-Act conformance ledger preserved).
  - `monday.mirror_column_binding` + `monday.connect_boards_binding` → `oya-workflow-engine-mirror-binding` + `-connect-boards-binding`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (16 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` + `automation` + `apigw` + `developer-sdk` + `marketplace` + `compliance` + `collaboration` µservices with monday-feature-parity (boards + 40-column-types + views + automations + apps + WorkdocsAI + monday-AI + Workforms + Mirror + Connect-Boards + Subitems + Dependencies + Time-Tracking + Workload + Panic-Mode).
  2. Export monday account via GraphQL: account + workspaces + boards + items + subitems + groups + columns + column-values + updates + assets + docs + views + workforms + automation-recipes + integrations + apps + webhooks + audit-log + AI-action-log.
  3. Plan per-workspace migration cohorts (Marketing / Sales-CRM / Dev / Service / Ops).
  4. Per-Workspace: re-create with preserved kind + owners + members.
  5. Per-Board: re-create with preserved name + description + kind + folder + owners + subscribers + tags + permissions.
  6. Per-Column: re-create with type taxonomy mapping + settings-JSON transpile (formula DSL → Oyatie formula; mirror/connect-boards references preserved as bindings).
  7. Per-Group: preserved title + color + position + archive state.
  8. Per-Item + Subitem: re-create with column-values + state + subscribers + parent-item chain; subitem-board structure preserved.
  9. Per-Update: replay as Oyatie updates with creator + body + HTML + replies + likers + assets.
  10. Per-Doc + Doc-Block: re-create with block taxonomy + embedded-board references; WorkdocsAI edits preserved as ledger.
  11. Per-View: re-create with type + settings + public flag.
  12. Per-Workform: re-publish with questions + style + submit URL alias.
  13. Per-Automation-Recipe + Integration: transpile to Oyatie automation-DSL; per-recipe shadow-eval on last-30d trigger replay; per-integration OAuth re-grant.
  14. Per-App-Subscription: re-install on Oyatie marketplace; per-app OAuth re-grant; iframe-context shim for legacy apps.
  15. Per-Webhook: re-register with secret rotation + signature alignment.
  16. Decommission monday on per-account basis after 30-day shadow; per-account cutover via DNS + API-router; monday contract sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (17 specific failures):
  - 40-column-type taxonomy mapping drift (custom column-types like `formula` / `mirror` / `connect_boards` / `lookup` / `auto_number` have proprietary semantics): per-type transpile + golden-test.
  - Formula-column DSL drift (monday formula language uses `{column}` syntax + 100+ functions): per-formula transpile + recompute compare.
  - Mirror-column read-only enforcement (mirror-columns reflect source but cannot be written): per-mirror direction preserve.
  - Connect-Boards bidirectional sync drift (changes propagate both ways): per-binding direction + propagation-policy preserve.
  - Subitem-board structure (each board with subitems has hidden subitem-board): per-board subitem-board create + relation preserve.
  - Automation-recipe complexity-budget drift (monday complexity = 10M / min Enterprise): per-tenant complexity-budget alignment.
  - GraphQL complexity-cost drift (queries cost complexity-points): per-client query-cost calibration.
  - Apps-Framework iframe-context-passing (monday-SDK provides session-token + storage): per-app iframe-context shim.
  - AI-Block per-doc prompt-template drift: per-AI-block template transpile.
  - WorkdocsAI rewrite/summary citation drift (cites doc-blocks): per-edit citation rewrite.
  - Workform style + branding preservation: per-form theme + custom-CSS preserve.
  - Webhook signature secret rotation: per-webhook secret re-issue + signing-key rotate.
  - Audit-log event-type taxonomy drift: per-event-type map maintained.
  - Panic-mode emergency-lockdown semantics (revoke all sessions + freeze writes): per-account panic-protocol re-implement.
  - HIPAA-eligible board-flag drift (Enterprise sets per-board PHI flag): per-board PHI-flag preserve + Cedar gate.
  - IP-restriction policy drift: per-account IP-allowlist preserve.
  - monday-AI tenant + account opt-in re-collect: per-account AI-policy re-acknowledge ledger.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via monday GraphQL + audit-log + AI-action-log.
  2. Plan 30-day shadow window with parallel writes (monday + Oyatie).
  3. Migrate accounts + workspaces + boards + columns + groups + items + subitems + updates + assets.
  4. Migrate docs + views + workforms + automation-recipes + integrations + apps + webhooks.
  5. Migrate mirror + connect-boards bindings; formula transpile + recompute.
  6. Migrate monday-AI + WorkdocsAI action-logs as conformance ledger.
  7. Re-establish 200+ app integrations via OAuth re-grant.
  8. Re-establish SOC-2 / ISO / GDPR / HIPAA / EU-AI-Act attestations.
  9. Re-establish panic-mode + IP-restriction + private-cloud (if Enterprise+).
  10. Decommission monday per-account after 30-day shadow; cutover via DNS + API-router; monday sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `workflow-engine` + `intelligence` + `automation` + `apigw` + `developer-sdk` + `marketplace` + `compliance` + `collaboration` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `monday-com` + `monday-work-os` + `monday-ai` + `monday-workdocs-ai` + `monday-workforms` + `monday-apps-framework` + `monday-mirror-columns` + `monday-connect-boards` + `monday-automation-recipes` + `monday-sales-crm` + `monday-dev` + `monday-service` + `monday-panic-mode` are benchmark alias-only. The `workflow-engine` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical monday-equivalent multi-product Work-OS surface.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-126 - Auth0
- Vendor name and category: Auth0 (acquired by Okta 2021, operates as the Okta Customer Identity Cloud / CIC) — Identity-as-a-Service for B2C + B2B Customer-Identity: Universal Login + Login-Flows + Actions (post-login / pre-user-registration / post-change-password / send-phone-message / machine-to-machine) + Rules-Legacy + Hooks-Legacy + Tenants + Connections (Database / Social / Enterprise / Passwordless) + Users + Roles + Permissions + Organizations (B2B SaaS multi-tenant) + Applications (Native / SPA / Regular-Web / M2M) + APIs (Resource-Servers) + Custom-Domains + Branding + MFA (Push / SMS / Email / WebAuthn / TOTP / Recovery-Code / Duo) + Attack-Protection (Brute-Force / Suspicious-IP-Throttling / Breached-Password-Detection / Bot-Detection) + Hooks + Email-Templates + Log-Streams (Datadog / Splunk / Sumo / EventBridge / Mixpanel / Segment / HTTP / Azure / Sumo) + Adaptive-MFA + Step-Up-Authentication + Refresh-Token-Rotation + DPoP + JWT-Profile + FAPI-2.0-Adv + Passkeys + Fine-Grained-Authorization (FGA — Zanzibar-shape ReBAC) + Auth0 Marketplace (Integrations / SDKs / Quickstarts) + Auth0 Lab (Experimental Identity products).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `iam` (canonical CIAM surface — Auth0 differs from Okta D-109 by CIAM-first vs workforce-first; Auth0 is Customer Identity, Okta is Workforce Identity) + `intelligence` (Adaptive-MFA risk-engine + Bot-Detection + Breached-Password) + `automation` (Actions JS/Node sandbox + Login-Flows) + `apigw` (Management-API + Authentication-API + OIDC + OAuth-2.0 + FAPI-2.0-Adv + SAML) + `data-store` (User-Store + Connection-Store) + `compliance` (SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + ISO-27018 + GDPR + HIPAA-BAA + PCI-DSS + EU-DPF + FedRAMP-Moderate + CSA-STAR + EU-AI-Act for risk-scoring) + `marketplace` (Auth0 Marketplace integrations) + `observability` (Log-Streams + Tenant-Logs + Real-Time-Webtask-Logs) + `policy` (ReBAC via Auth0 FGA Zanzibar)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free (7K MAU + 25K MAU social) → **Silver**; Essentials (B2C $35/mo + B2B $150/mo) → **Gold**; Professional + Enterprise (HIPAA-eligible + private-cloud + 99.99%-SLA + FAPI-2.0-Adv + step-up + custom-domain + SSO-from-multiple-orgs + Adaptive-MFA + Bot-Detection-pro + Org-MAU 100M+) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `iam` (Universal Login + Connections + Users + Roles + Organizations anchor); `intelligence` (Adaptive-MFA + Bot-Detection + Breached-Password-Detection); `automation` (Actions); `apigw` (Authentication + Management + OIDC + OAuth + SAML + FAPI-2.0); `data-store` (User Profile + Connection); `compliance` (HIPAA + FedRAMP + EU-AI-Act for risk-engine); `marketplace` (Auth0 Marketplace + Quickstarts); `observability` (Log-Streams + Tenant-Logs); `policy` (Auth0 FGA Zanzibar ReBAC).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Authentication-API: `https://<tenant>.<region>.auth0.com/oauth/token` (token), `/authorize` (auth-code), `/userinfo` (OIDC userinfo), `/dbconnections/signup`, `/dbconnections/change_password`, `/mfa/associate`, `/mfa/challenge`, `/passwordless/start`, `/co/authenticate`, `/oauth/device/code` (device-flow), `/oauth/par` (PAR), `/.well-known/openid-configuration`, `/.well-known/jwks.json`.

  - Auth0 CLI: `auth0 login`, `auth0 apps create`, `auth0 actions create`, `auth0 logs list`, `auth0 users create`, `auth0 orgs create`, `auth0 quickstarts download`.

- **Cedar permit shape** (iam + intelligence + automation + apigw + policy + compliance cross-product framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<auth0-admin-id>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0TenantSettingsWrite", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0ApplicationCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0ApplicationDelete", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0ClientSecretRotate",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0ConnectionCreate", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0ConnectionDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0UserCreate", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0UserDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0UserBlock", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0UserMfaReset",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0RoleCreate", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0RoleAssign",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0OrganizationCreate", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0OrgMemberInvite",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0ActionDeploy", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0ActionSecretWrite",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0TriggerBindingUpdate", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0EmailTemplateEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0CustomDomainAdd", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0LogStreamCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0AttackProtectionToggle", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0FGAModelWrite",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0FGATupleWrite", Oyatie::Action::"Auth0BrandingUpdate",
      Oyatie::Action::"Auth0ResourceServerEdit"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::Auth0Tenant::"<tenant-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Auth0Application::"<client-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Auth0Connection::"<conn-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Auth0User::"<user-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Auth0Role::"<role-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Auth0Organization::"<org-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Auth0Action::"<action-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::Auth0FGAStore::"<store-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    context.tenant_id == principal.tenant_id &&
    context.region == resource.region &&  // EU-residency enforcement
    context.mfa_satisfied == true &&
    context.step_up_recent_seconds < 300 &&  // recent step-up for admin
    context.client_app_first_party == true &&  // mgmt-api callers are first-party
    context.action_secret_kms_wrapped == true &&  // secrets per ADR-0251 §D-10
    context.log_stream_pii_redacted == true &&
    context.adaptive_mfa_risk_score < 60 &&
    context.fga_model_schema_version >= "1.1" &&
    context.byok_provider_credential_mode in ["platform_default", "byok"] &&
    context.compliance_pack_active in ["soc2", "iso27001", "hipaa", "gdpr", "fedramp_moderate", "eu_ai_act"]
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Tenant` → `Oyatie::Iam::tenant_namespace` (Auth0 tenant ≡ Oyatie tenant per [[oyatie-is-a-tenant-doctrine]]).
  - `Application` → `Oyatie::Iam::oauth_client` (with token-endpoint-auth-method + grant-types + JWT-config).
  - `Connection` → `Oyatie::Iam::identity_provider_binding` (database / social / enterprise / passwordless).
  - `User` → `Oyatie::Iam::customer_principal` (with identities-multi-provider linking).
  - `Role` + `Permission` → `Oyatie::Iam::rbac_role` + `permission` (RBAC, with resource-server scoping).
  - `Organization` → `Oyatie::Iam::b2b_tenant` (multi-tenancy within Auth0 tenant — sub-tenant per [[tenant-as-universal-scoping-primitive]]).
  - `Resource_Server` → `Oyatie::Iam::api_audience` (Authorization-Details-Types per RAR / FAPI-2.0).
  - `Action` + `Trigger_Binding` → `Oyatie::Automation::login_flow_hook` (Node.js sandboxed).
  - `Auth0_FGA_Store` → `Oyatie::Policy::rebac_store` (Zanzibar ReBAC native — distinct from Cedar but complementary).
  - `Adaptive_MFA` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::risk_engine` (per ADR-0255 §D-4 — risk-scoring EU-AI-Act-classified).
  - `Custom_Domain` → `Oyatie::Apigw::cname_alias`.
  - `Log_Stream` → `Oyatie::Observability::audit_log_sink`.
  - `Email_Template` → `Oyatie::Collaboration::transactional_message_template`.

- **12-23 specific workflow steps for migrating-off / dual-running Auth0 → Oyatie**:
  1. Inventory tenants via Management-API + Tenant-Logs export + Quotas-Usage report.
  2. Plan 60-day shadow window with mirror-tenant for dual-issue + dual-validate JWT.
  3. Export Applications + Connections + Resource-Servers + Rules-Legacy + Hooks-Legacy + Actions + Trigger-Bindings + Email-Templates + Custom-Domains + Log-Streams + Branding + Prompts via Deploy-CLI YAML.
  4. Export Users via `GET /api/v2/users` paginated + bulk-export job; preserve `user_id` as alias.
  5. Export Roles + Permissions + Organizations + Memberships + Invitations.
  6. Export Auth0 FGA store schema + tuples via `/expand` + `/read`.
  7. Export MFA enrollments (Guardian/WebAuthn/TOTP) — credentials NOT exportable (re-enroll required) but enrollment-metadata preserved.
  8. Migrate database-connection users with `import_mode` + password-hash-preservation (bcrypt + Auth0-PBKDF2 + custom-hash schemes).
  9. Migrate social/enterprise/passwordless connections via OAuth-app re-registration + IdP-config copy.
  10. Migrate Actions Node.js code → Oyatie automation µservice with dependency-manifest + secret-rewrap to KMS per ADR-0251 §D-10.
  11. Migrate Rules-Legacy + Hooks-Legacy → Actions equivalents in Oyatie (Auth0 deprecated these — Oyatie rejects legacy on intake).
  12. Migrate Trigger-Bindings → Oyatie login-flow-graph with order-preservation.
  13. Re-enroll MFA via step-up flow during shadow login; user-side re-enrollment forced over 30-day window.
  14. Migrate Auth0 FGA model + tuples → Cedar policy + ReBAC store (model translation guide).
  15. Re-establish Log-Streams sinks (Datadog/Splunk/EventBridge) on Oyatie observability.
  16. Re-establish Custom-Domain CNAME with cert-rotation.
  17. Re-establish Email-Templates with Liquid → Oyatie templating engine.
  18. Re-establish Attack-Protection (Brute-Force + Suspicious-IP + Breached-Password + Bot-Detection + Adaptive-MFA) per ADR-0255 risk-engine.
  19. Parallel run: 60-day shadow with dual-issue JWT + JWKS-rotation alias + per-request token-validation-parity ≥ 99.99%.
  20. Cut-over via DNS swap on tenant-domain + Custom-Domain + JWKS-alias retention 90-day.
  21. Decommission Auth0 tenant after 90-day shadow; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **12-20 specific failure modes**:
  - **Password-hash incompatibility on import** (Auth0 uses bcrypt + PBKDF2-Auth0 + scrypt + custom; some custom-hash-scripts not portable): per-connection hash-scheme detection + lazy-rehash on first login + forced-reset fallback after 90 days.
  - **MFA-secret non-portability** (Guardian + Duo + Authenticator OTP-seeds cannot be exported — security boundary): forced re-enrollment with step-up + grace-period for users.
  - **Auth0 Rules-Legacy deprecation in 2024** (Rules removed from new tenants; migration to Actions required): pre-migration Rule→Action translator + warning on intake.
  - **Auth0 Hooks deprecation** (Hooks removed in 2023; replaced by Actions): same translator pattern.
  - **Actions Node.js version pin** (Auth0 pins Node 18; Oyatie automation may use Node 20+): per-action runtime-version preserve + compat-shim + dependency-audit.
  - **Custom-domain TLS-cert-rotation race** (Auth0 manages LE cert; Oyatie needs cert-handover): pre-provision cert on Oyatie + DNS-CNAME flip + dual-validity overlap.
  - **JWKS-key rotation during shadow** (JWT issued by Auth0 must validate on Oyatie consumers): JWKS-aggregator endpoint serving both providers' keys for 90-day overlap.
  - **Organizations multi-tenancy model mismatch** (Auth0 Organizations are connection-binding-scoped; Oyatie tenants are hard-isolated): per-org sub-tenant projection + connection-allowlist preservation.
  - **Identity-linking break** (User has multiple identities {google + db + apple}; primary-identity not always preserved): per-user identity-graph export + primary-pin + secondary-link re-establish.
  - **FGA Zanzibar → Cedar model translation lossy** (FGA supports rewrite-trees + computed-userset that Cedar handles differently): per-type-definition translator + lossy-rule disclosure + dual-eval window.
  - **Tenant-log retention drop** (Auth0 free/essentials 1-day, pro 30-day, enterprise 30-day); migration windows may exceed retention): pre-migration tenant-log archive to S3 + Oyatie ingest.
  - **Log-Stream sink permission drift** (Datadog/Splunk API-key rotation during migration): per-sink credential re-wrap to Oyatie KMS + rotation-aware refresh.
  - **Email-Template Liquid syntax break** (Auth0 Liquid dialect has `{{user.email}}` + tenant-scoped helpers; Oyatie may render differently): per-template golden-render + diff + manual-rewrite tracker.
  - **Branding asset CDN URL break** (Auth0-hosted logo URLs change on migration): per-asset re-host + Universal-Login template re-link.
  - **Anomaly-detection profile drift** (Adaptive-MFA risk model trained on Auth0 user-base; Oyatie risk-engine starts cold): 30-day shadow risk-score logging + threshold-recalibration before enforcement.
  - **Refresh-token-rotation invalidation** (clients holding refresh-tokens issued by Auth0 break on cutover): graceful-degrade with refresh-token-exchange endpoint accepting Auth0 RT for 30 days.
  - **M2M client-secret rotation race** (machine-to-machine clients break if secret rotated mid-migration): coordinated client-secret rotation with deploy-pipeline notification + 7-day overlap.
  - **Quota / MAU pricing tier mismatch** (Auth0 prices on MAU; Oyatie prices differently): tenant-cost-projection report + invoice-reconcile during overlap.
  - **EU residency violation on user-data export** (EU tenant data must stay in eu.auth0.com region): per-region exporter + per-region importer + audit trail per [[tenant-as-universal-scoping-primitive]].
  - **EU-AI-Act bias-audit gap on Adaptive-MFA risk-engine** (Auth0 risk model is opaque per Auth0; Oyatie must publish model-card + bias-audit): pre-migration risk-engine-replacement with auditable model per ADR-0255.

- **Migration playbook outline (Auth0 → Oyatie iam µservice)**:
  1. Inventory tenants + applications + connections + users + organizations + actions + rules + hooks + log-streams + custom-domains via Management-API + Deploy-CLI export + Tenant-Logs archive.
  2. Plan 60-day shadow window with mirror-tenant + JWKS-aggregator + refresh-token-exchange endpoint.
  3. Migrate applications + connections + resource-servers (Deploy-CLI YAML translation).
  4. Migrate users with password-hash-preservation + lazy-rehash + identity-link preservation.
  5. Migrate roles + permissions + organizations + memberships + invitations.
  6. Migrate Actions code with Node.js runtime-pin + dependency-audit + secret-rewrap to KMS.
  7. Translate Rules-Legacy / Hooks-Legacy → Actions on Oyatie automation µservice.
  8. Translate Auth0 FGA model → Cedar + ReBAC store with lossy-rule disclosure.
  9. Re-enroll MFA via step-up flow during shadow login (forced over 30-day window).
  10. Decommission Auth0 tenant per-tenant after 90-day shadow; cutover via DNS + Custom-Domain + JWKS-alias retention; Auth0 sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `iam` + `intelligence` + `automation` + `apigw` + `data-store` + `compliance` + `marketplace` + `observability` + `policy` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `auth0` + `auth0-cic` + `auth0-actions` + `auth0-rules` + `auth0-fga` + `auth0-adaptive-mfa` + `auth0-organizations` + `auth0-universal-login` + `auth0-deploy-cli` + `auth0-marketplace` + `auth0-log-streams` are benchmark alias-only. The `iam` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Auth0-equivalent CIAM surface, distinct from `iam-workforce` (Okta D-109 equivalent).

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-127 - ForgeRock
- Vendor name and category: ForgeRock (acquired by Thoma Bravo 2023, merged with Ping Identity 2024 — operates as ForgeRock-by-Ping Identity Platform) — Comprehensive Identity Platform spanning Workforce + CIAM + IoT-Identity + Things: ForgeRock Identity Cloud (SaaS) + ForgeRock Identity Platform (self-managed) + Access Management (AM — formerly OpenAM) + Identity Management (IDM — formerly OpenIDM) + Directory Services (DS — formerly OpenDJ) + Identity Gateway (IG — formerly OpenIG) + Autonomous Identity (ML-driven access certification) + Authenticator (mobile MFA) + Trees (Intelligent Authentication — node-graph auth flows) + Journeys + Policy Engine (XACML-shape + Authorization-Service) + Federation (SAML / OIDC / WS-Federation) + Mobile-SDK + Web-SDK + IoT-SDK + Workforce Identity (employee SSO + Lifecycle + PAM) + CIAM (consumer + B2B login + progressive profile + delegated admin) + IGA (Identity Governance + Access-Review + SoD) + UMA-2.0 (User-Managed Access) + Verifiable-Credentials + Decentralized-Identity (DID) + ForgeRock Trust Network (digital trust ecosystem).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `iam` (canonical multi-domain IAM — ForgeRock differs from Auth0 D-126 (CIAM) + Okta D-109 (Workforce) by being unified across Workforce + CIAM + IoT + B2B, plus self-managed deploy option) + `identity-governance` (Autonomous Identity ML access-review + IGA + Access-Certification) + `intelligence` (Autonomous Identity ML + risk-engine) + `automation` (Trees / Journeys auth-flow graph) + `apigw` (AM as authZ proxy + IG as identity-gateway) + `data-store` (DS as LDAP + custom-attribute schema) + `policy` (XACML + Authorization-Service + Policy-Sets + Policy-Conditions) + `compliance` (FedRAMP-Moderate + StateRAMP + HITRUST + SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + HIPAA + CSA-STAR + EU-DPF + Common Criteria EAL-4+ + EU-AI-Act for Autonomous-Identity) + `iot` (IoT-Identity + Thing-SDK) + `verifiable-credentials` (DID + VC issuance)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Identity Cloud Essentials → **Silver**; Identity Cloud Standard → **Gold**; Identity Cloud Enterprise + Government Cloud + self-managed Platform with FedRAMP + Common-Criteria EAL-4+ + Autonomous-Identity ML + IoT + DID/VC + IGA + 99.99%-SLA → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `iam` (AM + IDM + DS + IG + Trees anchor); `identity-governance` (Autonomous Identity + IGA); `intelligence` (Autonomous Identity ML); `automation` (Trees / Journeys); `apigw` (AM authZ-proxy + IG gateway); `data-store` (DS LDAP); `policy` (XACML + Authorization-Service); `compliance` (FedRAMP + StateRAMP + EU-AI-Act for ML); `iot` (Thing-SDK); `verifiable-credentials` (DID/VC).

- **Cedar permit shape** (iam + identity-governance + intelligence + automation + apigw + policy + iot + verifiable-credentials + compliance framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<fr-admin-id>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"FRRealmCreate", Oyatie::Action::"FRRealmDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRIdentityCreate", Oyatie::Action::"FRIdentityModify",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRIdentityDelete", Oyatie::Action::"FRIdentityLock",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRManagedObjectWrite", Oyatie::Action::"FRMappingWrite",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRConnectorWrite", Oyatie::Action::"FRConnectorReconcile",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRTreePublish", Oyatie::Action::"FRJourneyPublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRPolicySetWrite", Oyatie::Action::"FRPolicyWrite",
      Oyatie::Action::"FROAuth2ClientCreate", Oyatie::Action::"FRFederationEntityImport",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRRoleAssign", Oyatie::Action::"FRAssignmentApply",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRWorkflowDeploy", Oyatie::Action::"FRAutonomousIdentityApprove",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRUMAResourceShare", Oyatie::Action::"FRThingRegister",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRDIDIssue", Oyatie::Action::"FRVCIssue", Oyatie::Action::"FRVCRevoke",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRAuditEventExport", Oyatie::Action::"FRDSSchemaWrite",
      Oyatie::Action::"FRIGRouteDeploy"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::FRRealm::"<realm-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FRIdentity::"<identity-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FRManagedObject::"<obj-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FRTree::"<tree-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FRPolicy::"<policy-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FROAuth2Client::"<client-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FRThing::"<thing-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FRVC::"<vc-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    context.tenant_id == principal.tenant_id &&
    context.realm == resource.realm &&
    context.mfa_satisfied == true &&
    context.authentication_level >= 3 &&  // FR auth-level cascade
    context.fedramp_boundary_check == true &&  // FedRAMP-Moderate enforcement
    context.common_criteria_eal4_required ==> resource.deployed_in_eal4_evaluated_config &&
    context.autonomous_identity_recommendation_confidence > 0.85 &&
    context.byok_provider_credential_mode in ["platform_default", "byok"] &&
    context.compliance_pack_active in ["fedramp_moderate", "stateramp", "hitrust", "soc2", "iso27001", "gdpr", "hipaa", "eu_ai_act", "common_criteria_eal4"]
  };
  ```

  - `Managed_Object` → `Oyatie::Iam::custom_managed_resource` (schema-driven).
  - `AuthN_Tree` / `Journey` → `Oyatie::Automation::auth_flow_graph` (node-graph with scripted-decision nodes sandboxed per ADR-0251 §D-10).
  - `Policy_Set` + `Policy` → `Oyatie::Policy::xacml_policy_set` (translatable to Cedar per [[cedar-as-universal-gate]] §D-3).
  - `OAuth2_Client` → `Oyatie::Iam::oauth_client` (RFC-7591 dyn-registration).
  - `Federation_Entity_SAML2` → `Oyatie::Iam::saml_federation_entity`.
  - `Mapping` + `Connector` → `Oyatie::Automation::identity_sync_pipeline`.
  - `Role` + `Assignment` → `Oyatie::Iam::rbac_role` + `provisioning_assignment`.
  - `Risk_Profile` + `Autonomous_Identity_Insight` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::access_risk_model` (EU-AI-Act-classified per ADR-0255 §D-4).

  - `Thing_Identity` → `Oyatie::Iot::thing_principal`.
  - `Verifiable_Credential` + `DID` → `Oyatie::VC::credential` + `did_document`.

- **12-23 specific workflow steps for migrating-off / dual-running ForgeRock → Oyatie**:
  1. Inventory realms via AM Admin Console + Amster export + frodo export.
  2. Plan 90-day shadow window (ForgeRock self-managed deployments are heavy — extended runway justified).
  3. Export Managed-Object schema + data via IDM REST + DS LDAP dump (LDIF).
  4. Export Trees/Journeys with node-graph JSON (frodo journey export).
  5. Export Policies + Policy-Sets + Resource-Types + Applications.
  6. Export OAuth2-Client + Federation-Entity metadata.
  7. Export Mappings + Connectors + Connector-Config (sanitize secrets).
  8. Export Workflows (BPMN XML) + Task-Forms.
  9. Export Autonomous-Identity ML model + training data + insights history.
  10. Export Audit-Events per-topic (access / activity / authentication / config / system) for 7-year window per FedRAMP.
  11. Translate Trees/Journeys node-graph → Oyatie auth-flow-graph in automation µservice; preserve scripted-decision via sandboxed JS.
  12. Translate Policies XACML → Cedar via XACML-to-Cedar translator + dual-eval window for verification.
  13. Re-bind Mappings/Connectors via Oyatie automation µservice with credential-rewrap to KMS.
  14. Re-bind Federation-Entities (SAML/OIDC) with entity-ID preservation + cert-rotation.
  15. Re-train Autonomous-Identity ML on Oyatie intelligence µservice with published model-card + bias-audit per ADR-0255 §D-4.
  16. Re-bind Things/IoT identities with attestation-cert re-issuance via Oyatie IoT µservice.
  17. Re-issue DID/VC with did:fr → did:oyatie translation + holder-side wallet update.
  18. Re-establish FedRAMP / StateRAMP / Common-Criteria evidence packs.
  19. Re-establish UMA resource-sharing with resource-owner re-consent.
  20. Parallel run: 90-day shadow with per-realm authN parity ≥ 99.99% + policy-eval parity ≥ 99.99% + Autonomous-Identity insight parity ≥ 95%.
  21. Cut-over per realm via DNS + federation-metadata flip + Audit-event aggregation overlap.
  22. Decommission ForgeRock platform per-realm after 90-day shadow; AM/IDM/DS/IG sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **12-20 specific failure modes**:
  - **XACML → Cedar translation lossy** (XACML has policy-combining algorithms + obligation/advice + variable-references that Cedar lacks): per-policy translator + lossy-rule disclosure + dual-eval window.
  - **Scripted-Decision Groovy-to-JS translation** (ForgeRock uses Groovy + Java in scripted nodes; Oyatie sandbox is JS/Node): per-script translator + manual-rewrite tracker for non-trivial scripts.
  - **DS schema custom-attribute drift** (LDAP custom-attributes with vendor-specific OIDs may collide with Oyatie schema): per-attribute OID-translate + namespace-prefix preservation.
  - **Authentication-level cascade mismatch** (FR uses numeric auth-level for step-up; Oyatie may use semantic levels): per-realm auth-level mapping table + step-up policy preservation.
  - **Federation entity-ID change breaks SP/IDP partners** (changing entity-ID requires partner-coordination): entity-ID-alias preservation + DNS-flip with 90-day overlap.
  - **Connector OpenICF bundle JAR portability** (custom-scripted connectors written in Groovy/Java not portable to Oyatie automation): per-connector re-implement in Oyatie automation + dual-run with reconciliation.
  - **BPMN workflow engine mismatch** (FR uses Activiti BPMN; Oyatie may use Camunda or custom): per-workflow re-deploy + task-form re-bind.
  - **Autonomous-Identity ML model retrain cold-start** (FR model trained on tenant access history; Oyatie starts cold): 30-day shadow log-only window + threshold-recalibration before enforcement; model-card published per ADR-0255.
  - **UMA-2.0 grant-flow client-incompatibility** (UMA-clients hardcoded to FR endpoints): per-client UMA-endpoint-rewrite + 90-day overlap.
  - **DID method translation** (did:fr → did:oyatie requires holder-wallet update; some legacy verifiers may not support new method): per-DID method-alias resolution + holder-notification.
  - **VC revocation-list propagation lag** (revocation status-list endpoint URL change): per-VC revocation-list URL-alias + dual-publish during overlap.
  - **Audit-event 5-topic taxonomy mismatch** (FR's access/activity/authentication/config/system topics map differently in Oyatie): per-event topic-translate + dual-emit during shadow.
  - **Common-Criteria EAL-4+ evaluated config drift** (FR Platform EAL-4+ evaluation tied to specific deployment topology; Oyatie may not be EAL-4 evaluated): pre-migration regulatory-impact analysis + customer waiver + future EAL-4 roadmap commitment.
  - **FedRAMP boundary expansion** (Oyatie boundary must include FR-replacement µservices; FedRAMP-PMO re-attestation required): pre-migration FedRAMP boundary-amendment package + 3PAO assessment.
  - **Things/IoT attestation-cert re-issuance flow** (devices have FR-issued attestation-certs; Oyatie must re-attest + re-key without device reflash): per-device OTA re-attestation flow + rollback plan.
  - **LDIF schema-extension conflict** (DS uses RFC-4523 schema + custom-OIDs; Oyatie data-store may need schema-translation): per-OID mapping + attribute-renaming with alias preservation.
  - **DS replication topology break** (multi-master DS replication during migration may diverge): freeze-replication + LDIF-snapshot + replay-during-shadow.
  - **Identity Cloud → self-managed shape mismatch** (Identity Cloud has multi-tenant constraints; self-managed has full schema flex): per-feature parity matrix + customer-side migration choice (Cloud or Platform).
  - **Frodo CLI non-API parity** (some FR features only exposed via Admin Console — not Amster or REST): manual extraction + UI-screencap + replay via Oyatie admin surface.
  - **EU-AI-Act bias-audit gap on Autonomous-Identity** (FR Autonomous-Identity model opaque): pre-migration model-card + bias-audit before enforcement re-enable.

- **Migration playbook outline (ForgeRock → Oyatie iam + identity-governance + intelligence µservices)**:
  1. Inventory realms + managed-objects + trees + policies + OAuth2-clients + federation-entities + mappings + connectors + workflows + autonomous-identity-models + audit-events via Amster + frodo + IDM-REST + AM-REST + DS LDIF export.
  2. Plan 90-day shadow window with mirror-realm + federation-entity-alias + JWKS-aggregator + UMA-endpoint-rewrite.
  3. Translate Trees/Journeys → Oyatie auth-flow-graph; XACML → Cedar; Groovy/Java scripted-nodes → JS sandboxed.
  4. Migrate identities + managed-objects + roles + assignments + groups via LDIF + IDM-REST batch.
  5. Re-train Autonomous-Identity ML on Oyatie intelligence µservice with published model-card.
  6. Re-bind Things/IoT identities + attestation-certs via Oyatie IoT µservice.
  7. Re-issue DID/VC with did:fr → did:oyatie translation + holder-wallet notification.
  8. Re-establish FedRAMP + StateRAMP + Common-Criteria + HITRUST + EU-AI-Act evidence packs.
  9. Parallel run with per-realm authN + policy-eval + Autonomous-Identity insight parity verification.
  10. Decommission ForgeRock per-realm after 90-day shadow; AM/IDM/DS/IG sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `iam` + `identity-governance` + `intelligence` + `automation` + `apigw` + `data-store` + `policy` + `compliance` + `iot` + `verifiable-credentials` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `forgerock` + `forgerock-am` + `forgerock-idm` + `forgerock-ds` + `forgerock-ig` + `forgerock-trees` + `forgerock-journeys` + `forgerock-autonomous-identity` + `forgerock-things` + `forgerock-uma` + `forgerock-did-vc` + `forgerock-amster` + `frodo` are benchmark alias-only. The `iam` + `identity-governance` µservice pair (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical ForgeRock-equivalent multi-domain IAM surface, with `iot` + `verifiable-credentials` µservices anchoring the IoT-Identity + DID/VC capabilities ForgeRock uniquely covers.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-128 - Ping Identity
- Vendor name and category: Ping Identity (now merged with ForgeRock under Thoma Bravo 2024 — Ping Identity Platform brand) — Identity-Security suite spanning Workforce + CIAM + B2B + Authorization + API-Security: PingOne (cloud-native multi-product platform) + PingFederate (federation hub — SAML / OIDC / WS-Federation / OAuth-2.0 / SCIM provisioning) + PingAccess (web-access management proxy) + PingDirectory (LDAP directory) + PingDataSync (directory sync) + PingDataGovernance (data-access governance + privacy) + PingAuthorize (fine-grained authorization XACML+ABAC) + PingOne Risk (risk-scoring + adaptive auth) + PingOne Protect (fraud / bot / API protection) + PingOne MFA (push / SMS / email / TOTP / WebAuthn / FIDO2) + PingOne DaVinci (drag-and-drop orchestration of identity flows) + PingID (legacy MFA) + PingOne Authorize + PingOne Verify (identity verification + document-check + selfie-match + liveness) + PingOne Neo (decentralized identity wallet + Verifiable Credentials) + PingOne Fraud + PingCentral (federation lifecycle mgmt) + PingIntelligence-for-APIs (ML-driven API security).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `iam` (canonical multi-product IAM — Ping differs from Auth0/Okta/ForgeRock by federation-hub-first heritage + on-prem PingFederate legacy + cloud-native PingOne + DaVinci orchestrator) + `intelligence` (PingOne Risk + PingOne Protect ML fraud + PingIntelligence-for-APIs ML) + `automation` (DaVinci flow orchestration) + `apigw` (PingAccess + PingIntelligence-for-APIs) + `data-store` (PingDirectory + PingDataSync) + `policy` (PingAuthorize XACML+ABAC + PingDataGovernance) + `compliance` (FedRAMP-Moderate + StateRAMP + SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + ISO-27017 + ISO-27018 + GDPR + HIPAA + PCI-DSS + CSA-STAR + EU-DPF + EU-AI-Act for Risk/Protect/Intelligence) + `verifiable-credentials` (PingOne Neo wallet + VC) + `identity-verification` (PingOne Verify document + biometric)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: PingOne Essentials → **Silver**; PingOne Plus → **Gold**; PingOne Premium + on-prem PingFederate + PingAccess + PingDirectory + PingAuthorize + DaVinci + Neo + Verify + Risk + Protect + FedRAMP-Moderate + 99.99%-SLA → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `iam` (PingFederate + PingOne + PingAccess + PingDirectory anchor); `intelligence` (Risk + Protect + Intelligence-for-APIs); `automation` (DaVinci); `apigw` (PingAccess + Intelligence-for-APIs); `data-store` (PingDirectory + DataSync); `policy` (PingAuthorize + PingDataGovernance); `compliance` (FedRAMP + EU-AI-Act); `verifiable-credentials` (Neo); `identity-verification` (Verify).

- **Cedar permit shape** (iam + intelligence + automation + apigw + data-store + policy + verifiable-credentials + identity-verification + compliance framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<ping-admin-id>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"PingEnvironmentCreate", Oyatie::Action::"PingPopulationWrite",
      Oyatie::Action::"PingUserCreate", Oyatie::Action::"PingUserDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"PingApplicationCreate", Oyatie::Action::"PingIdentityProviderConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"PingMfaDeviceManage", Oyatie::Action::"PingRiskPolicyEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"PingDaVinciFlowPublish", Oyatie::Action::"PingVerifyPolicyEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"PingNeoCredentialIssue", Oyatie::Action::"PingProtectPolicyEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"PingFederateConnectionImport", Oyatie::Action::"PingFederateAdapterDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"PingFederateBulkExport", Oyatie::Action::"PingAccessResourcePublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"PingAccessRuleWrite", Oyatie::Action::"PingDirectoryEntryWrite",
      Oyatie::Action::"PingAuthorizePolicyDeploy", Oyatie::Action::"PingDataGovernanceTokenPolicyWrite",
      Oyatie::Action::"PingIntelligenceAPIRegister", Oyatie::Action::"PingAuditEventExport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::PingEnvironment::"<env-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PingPopulation::"<pop-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PingApplication::"<app-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PingDaVinciFlow::"<flow-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PingFederateConnection::"<conn-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PingAccessResource::"<pa-res-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PingDirectoryEntry::"<dn>",
      Oyatie::Resource::PingNeoWallet::"<wallet-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    context.tenant_id == principal.tenant_id &&
    context.environment_region == resource.region &&  // PingOne region affinity
    context.mfa_satisfied == true &&
    context.risk_level != "HIGH" &&  // Ping Risk integration
    context.fedramp_boundary_check == true &&
    context.davinci_flow_signed == true &&  // DaVinci flow signature
    context.neo_credential_kms_wrapped == true &&  // VC private-key wrap
    context.byok_provider_credential_mode in ["platform_default", "byok"] &&
    context.compliance_pack_active in ["fedramp_moderate", "stateramp", "soc2", "iso27001", "gdpr", "hipaa", "pci_dss", "eu_ai_act"]
  };
  ```

- **12-23 specific workflow steps for migrating-off / dual-running Ping → Oyatie**:
  1. Inventory environments + populations + applications + IdPs + MFA-devices + Risk-Policies + DaVinci-Flows + Verify-Transactions + Neo-Wallets via PingOne API.
  2. Inventory PingFederate IdP/SP-Connections + Adapters + Policy-Trees + OAuth-Clients via Admin API + Bulk-Export.
  3. Inventory PingAccess Resources + Rules + Policies + Sites + Web-Sessions via Admin API.
  4. Inventory PingDirectory entries via LDIF dump + Replication-Topology snapshot.
  5. Inventory PingAuthorize policies + PingDataGovernance token-policies + PingIntelligence-for-APIs API-definitions.
  6. Plan 90-day shadow window with mirror-environment + federation-entity-aliases + dual-issue JWT.
  7. Migrate PingOne users + populations + applications + IdPs via PingOne API replay onto Oyatie iam µservice.
  8. Migrate DaVinci flows → Oyatie automation µservice with node-by-node translation + sandboxed function nodes.
  9. Migrate PingFederate IdP/SP-Connections + Adapters via SAML-metadata import + adapter-equivalent in Oyatie iam.
  10. Migrate PingAccess Resources + Rules → Oyatie apigw access policies (translate rule classes to apigw rule-engine).
  11. Migrate PingDirectory entries via LDIF replay onto Oyatie data-store with schema-translation.
  12. Migrate PingAuthorize XACML policies → Cedar via translator + dual-eval window for verification.
  13. Migrate PingDataGovernance token-resource-policies → Oyatie policy µservice token-binding.
  14. Migrate PingIntelligence API-definitions + ML-models → Oyatie intelligence with bias-audit per ADR-0255.
  15. Re-train Risk-Policies + Protect-Policies on Oyatie intelligence with model-card publication.
  16. Re-issue Neo Verifiable-Credentials with did:ping → did:oyatie translation + holder-wallet update.
  17. Re-establish PingOne Verify identity-verification document-check + selfie + liveness providers.
  18. Re-establish FedRAMP-Moderate + StateRAMP + HIPAA + PCI-DSS + EU-AI-Act evidence packs.
  19. Parallel run: 90-day shadow with per-env authN + federation + API-access + risk-score + verify-decision parity ≥ 99.99%.
  20. Cut-over per environment via DNS + federation-metadata flip + JWKS-alias retention + LDAP-VIP swap.
  21. Decommission PingOne environments + PingFederate clusters + PingAccess clusters + PingDirectory + PingAuthorize after 90-day shadow; Ping platform sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **12-20 specific failure modes**:
  - **PingFederate adapter custom-Java not portable** (custom HTML-Form / OAuth-Token / Risk-Plugin adapters written in Java with PingFederate-SDK): per-adapter re-implement on Oyatie iam adapter framework + dual-run with diff verification.
  - **PingFederate Policy-Tree multi-branch authentication-source mismatch** (Policy-Trees support nested selectors with chained adapters; Oyatie auth-flow-graph may not be 1:1): per-tree translator + manual rewrite for edge nodes.
  - **DaVinci connector ecosystem gap** (DaVinci has 100+ pre-built connectors {ServiceNow / Workday / Salesforce / Okta / etc.}; Oyatie automation may lack some): per-connector inventory + Oyatie connector-build prioritization + manual-rewrite tracker.
  - **PingAccess rule-class portability** (rules are Java classes with vendor-specific config; some have no Oyatie equivalent): per-rule-class compatibility matrix + custom-rule implementation in Oyatie apigw.
  - **PingDirectory replication topology disruption** (multi-master replication with subtree-replication; freeze-replication during LDIF dump): coordinated freeze + LDIF + replay + post-replay-replication-resume.
  - **PingAuthorize XACML → Cedar lossy translation** (XACML obligation/advice + policy-combining algorithms): per-policy translator + lossy-rule disclosure + dual-eval window.
  - **PingOne Verify document-check vendor binding** (Verify integrates Au10tix / Mitek / Jumio / etc.; per-tenant vendor binding): per-tenant vendor-rebind on Oyatie identity-verification.
  - **PingOne Neo DID-method translation** (did:ping → did:oyatie requires holder-wallet update; legacy verifiers may not support): per-DID method-alias resolution + holder OTA notification.
  - **PingOne Risk predictor model retrain cold-start** (Risk-Policy thresholds tuned to PingOne predictor outputs; Oyatie predictors may produce different distributions): 30-day shadow log-only window + threshold-recalibration + model-card published per ADR-0255.
  - **PingIntelligence-for-APIs ML model proprietary** (ML model not exportable): pre-migration Oyatie API-anomaly-model training on shadow traffic + 30-day warmup before enforcement.
  - **Federation entity-ID change breaks partners** (changing entity-ID requires partner-coordination across thousands of SP/IDP relationships): entity-ID-alias preservation + 90-day overlap + partner-coordination playbook.
  - **PingDirectory schema custom-attribute drift** (custom-OID + LDAP-syntax + multi-value attributes): per-attribute OID-translate + namespace-prefix.
  - **PingFederate bulk-export config-store JSON not Oyatie-portable** (Ping config-store has Ping-specific node-paths): per-section translator + manual-review queue.
  - **PingAccess web-session cookie change breaks active sessions** (cookie domain + name + SameSite + secure flags change): coordinated cookie-rebind + active-session-drain + session-migration overlap.
  - **PingOne MFA device re-enrollment forced** (MFA secrets non-portable): user-side re-enrollment with step-up + grace-period.
  - **Audit-event format mismatch** (PingOne audit-event JSON has Ping-specific event-IDs + categories): per-event translator + dual-emit during shadow.
  - **FedRAMP boundary re-attestation required** (Oyatie boundary must include Ping-replacement µservices): pre-migration FedRAMP boundary-amendment + 3PAO assessment.
  - **PingCentral federation-lifecycle workflows lost** (PingCentral provides federation-connection lifecycle UI; Oyatie equivalent must be built): pre-migration PingCentral parity build + workflow-equivalent in iam µservice admin surface.
  - **DaVinci flow signature break** (DaVinci flows may be signed by tenant cert; signature break on translation): per-flow re-sign with Oyatie tenant cert + signature-verification toggle during overlap.
  - **EU-AI-Act bias-audit gap on Risk/Protect/Intelligence** (Ping ML models opaque): pre-migration Oyatie risk-engine training with published model-card + bias-audit before enforcement re-enable.

- **Migration playbook outline (Ping Identity → Oyatie iam + automation + apigw + intelligence + verifiable-credentials + identity-verification µservices)**:
  1. Inventory PingOne environments + PingFederate clusters + PingAccess clusters + PingDirectory + PingAuthorize + DaVinci + Neo + Verify + Protect + Intelligence-for-APIs via PingOne API + Admin APIs + LDIF + Bulk-Export.
  2. Plan 90-day shadow window with mirror-environment + federation-entity-aliases + JWKS-aggregator + cookie-dual-publish.
  3. Migrate PingOne users + populations + apps + IdPs + MFA devices + Risk + Protect + DaVinci + Neo + Verify onto Oyatie iam + intelligence + automation + VC + identity-verification µservices.
  4. Migrate PingFederate connections + adapters + policy-trees onto Oyatie iam federation surface; custom Java-adapters re-implemented.
  5. Migrate PingAccess resources + rules onto Oyatie apigw access-policy engine.
  6. Migrate PingDirectory entries via LDIF replay onto Oyatie data-store; replication topology rebuilt.
  7. Migrate PingAuthorize XACML → Cedar via translator + lossy-rule disclosure + dual-eval window.
  8. Migrate PingDataGovernance token-policies + PingIntelligence-for-APIs models onto Oyatie policy + intelligence µservices with bias-audit.
  9. Re-issue Neo VC + DID method translation + holder-wallet update; re-establish Verify document-vendor bindings.
  10. Decommission Ping platform per-environment after 90-day shadow; PingOne + PingFederate + PingAccess + PingDirectory + PingAuthorize sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `iam` + `intelligence` + `automation` + `apigw` + `data-store` + `policy` + `compliance` + `verifiable-credentials` + `identity-verification` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `ping-identity` + `pingone` + `pingfederate` + `pingaccess` + `pingdirectory` + `pingauthorize` + `pingdatasync` + `pingdatagovernance` + `pingone-risk` + `pingone-protect` + `pingone-mfa` + `pingone-davinci` + `pingone-verify` + `pingone-neo` + `pingid` + `pingcentral` + `pingintelligence-for-apis` are benchmark alias-only. The `iam` + `apigw` + `intelligence` µservice triad (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Ping-equivalent multi-product identity-security surface, distinct from `iam` (Auth0 D-126 CIAM) + `iam-workforce` (Okta D-109) + `iam` + `identity-governance` (ForgeRock D-127) by federation-hub-first heritage.
