### Section D-129 - 1Password
- Vendor name and category: 1Password (AgileBits Inc.) — Enterprise Password Manager + Secrets Management + Developer Tools + Extended Access Management: 1Password Business + 1Password Teams + 1Password Families + 1Password Personal + 1Password CLI (`op`) + 1Password (self-hosted REST API for infrastructure secrets) + 1Password Secrets Automation + 1Password Service Accounts + 1Password SCIM Bridge (provisioning) + 1Password Events API (audit-log streaming) + 1Password Developer Tools (Shell-Plugins / Git-credential-helper / SSH-agent / .env-file-management) + 1Password CLI (op) + 1Password Browser Extension + 1Password Desktop (macOS / Windows / Linux) + 1Password Mobile (iOS / Android) + Watchtower (breach + weak-password + reused-password monitoring) + Travel-Mode (selective vault hiding) + Recovery Codes + Account Password + Secret Key (dual-secret model with 128-bit entropy on top of master password) + End-to-end-encryption with SRP-6a + Two-Factor-Auth (TOTP + Duo + YubiKey + WebAuthn / Passkeys) + Unlock-With-SSO (OIDC SSO unlock) + Trelica-by-1Password (SaaS-discovery + governance — acquired 2024) + Kolide-by-1Password (Device Trust — acquired 2024).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `secrets-mgmt` (canonical password + secrets vault — 1Password differs from LastPass/Dashlane/Bitwarden by Secret-Key dual-factor + + SCIM Bridge + Events API + Developer Tools depth + Kolide Device Trust integration) + `iam` (SCIM provisioning + Unlock-With-SSO + Service Accounts) + `automation` (Secrets-Automation via + CLI + Service Accounts) + `observability` (Events API streaming to SIEM) + `apigw` (1Password REST API + Service-Account access) + `compliance` (SOC-2 Type II + ISO-27001 / 27017 / 27018 / 27701 + GDPR + PCI-DSS + HIPAA-eligible Business + EU-DPF) + `device-trust` (Kolide endpoint-posture + device-trust enforcement) + `saas-discovery` (Trelica SaaS-discovery + governance + spend) + `developer-tools` (Shell-plugins + Git-credential + SSH-agent + ssh-config + 1Password-Operator for K8s)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Families / Personal → **Silver**; Teams / Teams-Starter → **Gold**; Business + Enterprise (SCIM + SSO-unlock + Events-API + + Service-Accounts + Kolide + Trelica + advanced audit + custom-roles + Insights + 99.95%-SLA) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `secrets-mgmt` (Vaults + Items + Secret-Key + Master-Password anchor); `iam` (SCIM + SSO-unlock + Service-Accounts); `automation` (+ Secrets-Automation); `observability` (Events API → SIEM); `apigw` (REST + Service-Account); `compliance` (SOC-2 + ISO + HIPAA-eligible); `device-trust` (Kolide); `saas-discovery` (Trelica); `developer-tools` (Shell-plugins + Git + SSH).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (1Password canonical):
  - `Account` (Account_ID, Name, Domain, Type {Business / Teams / Families / Individual}, Region, Created-At, Active-Members-Count, Active-Vaults-Count, Active-Items-Count, Subscription-Plan, Public-Key {RSA-2048 user-key}, Encrypted-Account-Key).
  - `User` (User_ID, Account-Ref, Name, Email, Public-Key {user keypair}, Encrypted-Private-Key (wrapped by Account-Unlock-Key derived from Account-Password + Secret-Key), State {pending / active / suspended / deleted}, Type {Member / Guest / Service-Account}, Master-Password-Status, Account-Recovery-Status, Last-Auth-At, Created-At).
  - `Group` (Group_ID, Account-Ref, Name, Description, Type {Owners / Administrators / Recovery / Security / Standard / Custom}, Permissions{Manage-Vaults + Manage-Templates + etc.}, Members[User-Ref]).
  - `Vault` (Vault_ID, Account-Ref, Name, Description, Type {Personal / Shared / Everyone}, Permissions{User-Ref + Permission-Set [Allow-Viewing / Allow-Editing / Allow-Managing / Allow-Exporting / Allow-Importing / Allow-Copying / Allow-Printing / etc.]}, Items-Count, Created-At, Updated-At, Travel-Mode-Status).
  - `Item` (Item_ID, Vault-Ref, Title, Category {Login / Password / Secure-Note / Credit-Card / Identity / Bank-Account / Driver-License / Outdoor-License / Passport / Software-License / Wireless-Router / Database / Server / API-Credential / SSH-Key / Document / Custom}, Fields[Field-ID + Section + Type {string / concealed / email / url / date / month-year / phone / file / address / otp / reference / sshKey / etc.} + Label + Value-Encrypted + Generated], URLs[URL + Label + Primary], Tags[], Favorite, Trashed, Created-At, Updated-At, Last-Edited-By-Ref, Version, Files[File-Ref], OTP-Secret-Encrypted).
  - `Item_File` (File_ID, Item-Ref, Name, Size, Content-Encrypted, Content-Type).
  - `Document` (Document_ID — Item with Document category + attached File).
  - `Template` (Template_ID, Account-Ref, Category, Fields-Schema[], Sections[]).
  - `Service_Account` (SA_ID, Account-Ref, Name, Vault-Access[Vault-Ref + Permission-Set], Token-Issuance-Settings, Last-Used-At, Expires-At).
  - `Connect_Server` (Connect_ID, Account-Ref, Token, Vault-Access[Vault-Ref + Permission-Set], Sync-Status, Last-Heartbeat).
  - `SCIM_Bridge` (Bridge_ID, Account-Ref, IdP-Type {Okta / Azure-AD / OneLogin / JumpCloud / Rippling / etc.}, SCIM-Endpoint-URL, Bearer-Token, Sync-State{Users-Sync + Groups-Sync}, Last-Sync-At).
  - `SSO_Configuration` (SSO_ID, Account-Ref, Type {OIDC}, Identity-Provider {Okta / Azure-AD / Google / Duo / etc.}, Client-ID, Issuer-URL, JIT-Provisioning, Unlock-With-SSO-Enabled).
  - `Recovery_Code` (Recovery_ID, User-Ref, Code-Hash, Created-At, Used-At, Revoked).
  - `Two_Factor_Method` (2FA_ID, User-Ref, Type {TOTP / Duo / YubiKey-OTP / WebAuthn / Passkey}, Public-Key, Friendly-Name, Last-Used-At).
  - `Audit_Event` (Event_ID, Account-Ref, Action {member-signed-in / item-viewed / item-edited / vault-created / etc. — 80+ types}, Actor-Ref, Object-UUID, Object-Type, Vault-Ref, Item-Ref, Geo{Country + Region + City + Lat + Lng}, IP, Client{App-Name + App-Version + Platform-Name + Platform-Version + OS-Name + OS-Version + IP}, Timestamp).
  - `Sign_In_Attempt` (Attempt_ID, Account-Ref, User-Ref, Type {credentials-ok / mfa-ok / mfa-missing / mfa-wrong / sso-ok / blocked / unknown-username / wrong-password / wrong-secret-key / etc.}, Country, IP, Client, Timestamp, Success).
  - `Watchtower_Item_Report` (Report_ID, Item-Ref, Issues[Weak-Password / Reused-Password / Compromised / Unsecure-Website / Two-Factor-Missing / Inactive-Account / etc.], Severity, Detected-At).
  - `Trelica_SaaS_App` (App_ID, Account-Ref, Vendor-Name, Discovered-Via {SSO / Browser-Extension / Finance-Integration}, Status {Sanctioned / Unsanctioned / Discovered / Decommissioned}, License-Count-Used, License-Count-Purchased, Spend, Risk-Score, Active-Users[User-Ref]).
  - `Kolide_Device_Posture` (Posture_ID, Device-ID, User-Ref, Checks[Disk-Encryption + OS-Version + Password-Mgr-Installed + AV-Enabled + etc.], Status {Pass / Fail / Warning}, Last-Checked-At).
  - `Shell_Plugin` (Plugin_ID, Account-Ref, Name {aws / gcloud / azure / github / circleci / npm / etc. — 100+ plugins}, Config, Active-Users[]).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - 1Password API: `https://<connect-server>:8080/v1/` — `vaults`, `vaults/{id}/items`, `vaults/{id}/items/{item-id}`, `vaults/{id}/items/{item-id}/files`, `activity`, `health`, `heartbeat`, `metrics`.
  - 1Password Events API: `https://events.{region}.1password.com/api/v1/` — `signinattempts`, `itemusages`, `auditevents` (streaming with cursor pagination + JWT auth).
  - 1Password SCIM Bridge: `https://<scim-bridge>/scim/v2/` — `Users`, `Groups`, `Schemas`, `ResourceTypes`, `ServiceProviderConfig` (SCIM 2.0).
  - 1Password CLI (`op`): `op signin`, `op vault list`, `op item get <ref>`, `op item create`, `op read "op://vault/item/field"`, `op inject -i template.env -o output.env`, `op run -- <command>`, `op document get`, `op user list`, `op group list`, `op service-account create`, `op connect server create`, `op events list`.
  - 1Password REST (Public API for management — limited): account-level management via web-admin only; no public account-mgmt REST API (intentional security posture).
  - SDKs: 1password-go (Go), op-js-sdk (JS), op-python (community), op-rust (community).
  - SSH-agent + ssh-config integration: `IdentityAgent ~/.1password/agent.sock`.
  - Git-credential-helper: `git config credential.helper '!op plugin run -- git-credential-manager'`.
  - Browser extension: WebExtension API + native messaging to desktop app.
  - Trelica API: REST for SaaS-discovery + licensing + spend.
  - Kolide API: REST for device-posture + check-results + remediation.

- **Cedar permit shape** (secrets-mgmt + iam + automation + observability + apigw + device-trust + saas-discovery + developer-tools + compliance framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<1p-admin-id>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassAccountSettingsWrite", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassUserInvite",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassUserSuspend", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassUserDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassGroupCreate", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassGroupMembershipManage",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassVaultCreate", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassVaultDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassVaultPermissionGrant", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassItemRead",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassItemCreate", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassItemEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassItemShare", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassItemExport",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassDocumentRead", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassServiceAccountCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassServiceAccountTokenIssue", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassConnectServerCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassConnectTokenIssue", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassSCIMBridgeConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassSSOConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassEventsAPITokenCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassWatchtowerView", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassRecoveryCodeIssue",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassTravelModeToggle", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassShellPluginEnable",
      Oyatie::Action::"OnePassTrelicaAppMark", Oyatie::Action::"OnePassKolideCheckEnforce"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::OnePassAccount::"<acct-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OnePassVault::"<vault-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OnePassItem::"<item-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OnePassServiceAccount::"<sa-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OnePassConnectServer::"<connect-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::OnePassSCIMBridge::"<bridge-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    context.tenant_id == principal.tenant_id &&
    context.account_region == resource.region &&  // 1Password EU/US region affinity
    context.mfa_satisfied == true &&
    context.secret_key_proof_present == true &&  // 1Password dual-secret model
    context.master_password_recently_verified == true &&  // re-verify for sensitive ops
    context.device_posture_kolide_pass == true &&  // Kolide device-trust check
    context.travel_mode_status == "off" || resource.travel_safe == true &&
    context.byok_provider_credential_mode in ["platform_default", "byok_required_by_pack"] &&
    context.compliance_pack_active in ["soc2", "iso27001", "iso27017", "iso27018", "iso27701", "gdpr", "hipaa", "pci_dss"]
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Account` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::tenant_account` (per [[oyatie-is-a-tenant-doctrine]] scoping; 1Password account-key + secret-key dual-factor preserved).
  - `User` → `Oyatie::Iam::secrets_user` (with wrapped-private-key key-derivation preserved).
  - `Group` → `Oyatie::Iam::vault_access_group` (with permission-set semantics).
  - `Vault` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::vault` (cell-scoped per [[amazon-shape-cellular-architecture]]).
  - `Item` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::secret_item` (category-typed; concealed fields KMS-wrapped per ADR-0251 §D-10).
  - `Service_Account` → `Oyatie::Iam::service_principal_with_vault_scope`.
  - `Connect_Server` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::self_hosted_secrets_gateway`.
  - `SCIM_Bridge` → `Oyatie::Iam::scim_provisioning_bridge`.
  - `SSO_Configuration` → `Oyatie::Iam::sso_unlock_binding` (OIDC).
  - `Audit_Event` + `Sign_In_Attempt` → `Oyatie::Observability::audit_event_record` (Events-API streaming).
  - `Watchtower_Item_Report` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::password_hygiene_report`.
  - `Trelica_SaaS_App` → `Oyatie::SaasDiscovery::discovered_app`.
  - `Kolide_Device_Posture` → `Oyatie::DeviceTrust::endpoint_posture_attestation`.
  - `Shell_Plugin` → `Oyatie::DeveloperTools::credential_helper_plugin`.

- **12-23 specific workflow steps for migrating-off / dual-running 1Password → Oyatie**:
  1. Inventory accounts + users + groups + vaults + items + service-accounts + connect-servers + SCIM-bridges + SSO-config + audit-events via API + Events API + admin web-UI export + CLI `op item list`.
  2. Plan 45-day shadow window with dual-vault publishing + dual-event streaming + CLI-rebind.
  3. Export Vaults + Items via `op` CLI with `--format=json` (per-item; concealed fields decrypted client-side then re-encrypted with Oyatie KMS on intake).
  4. Export Documents (item-attached files) with content-decrypt + re-wrap to Oyatie KMS.
  5. Export Service-Account configurations + Connect-Server configurations (tokens NOT exportable — must be re-issued).
  6. Export SCIM-Bridge IdP-binding config (tokens re-issued on Oyatie side).
  7. Export SSO-configuration (OIDC binding details re-bound on Oyatie iam µservice).
  8. Export Audit-Events for 7-year retention via Events API cursor-paginated streaming to Oyatie observability.
  9. Export Watchtower hygiene reports for migration-side baseline.
  10. Migrate Trelica SaaS-discovery data via Trelica API → Oyatie saas-discovery µservice.
  11. Migrate Kolide device-trust check configurations + check-results → Oyatie device-trust µservice.
  12. Migrate Shell-Plugins (`aws / gcloud / azure / github / etc.`) — config re-bound via `op plugin` re-init on Oyatie CLI.
  13. Translate Item categories + custom-fields → Oyatie secret-item schema with type-preservation.
  14. Migrate vault permission-sets (Allow-Viewing / Allow-Editing / etc.) → Oyatie Cedar policy bindings.
  15. Re-issue Service-Account tokens + Connect-Server tokens + SCIM-Bridge tokens + Events-API tokens.
  16. Re-establish SSO-unlock OIDC binding on Oyatie iam (with master-password + secret-key dual-factor preserved during transition).
  17. Re-establish 2FA methods (TOTP + Duo + YubiKey + WebAuthn + Passkeys) via re-enrollment.
  18. Re-establish Watchtower hygiene monitoring on Oyatie intelligence µservice with model-card publication per ADR-0255.
  19. Re-establish Trelica SaaS-discovery + Kolide device-trust integrations.
  20. Parallel run: 45-day shadow with dual-vault write + per-item read parity ≥ 99.99% + Audit-Event stream parity ≥ 99.99%.
  21. Cut-over via DNS + CLI-default-account flip + browser-extension re-config + Connect-server URL flip.
  22. Decommission 1Password accounts after 90-day shadow with vault-retention overlap; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **12-20 specific failure modes**:
  - **Secret-Key dual-factor non-portability** (1Password's 128-bit Secret-Key combined with Account-Password is the cornerstone; Oyatie must preserve dual-secret semantic or accept downgrade): per-account secret-key-derivation-translator + user-side re-enrollment + dual-factor preservation in Oyatie secrets-mgmt µservice.
  - **End-to-end-encryption SRP-6a → Oyatie auth-handshake mismatch** (1Password uses SRP-6a for client-side master-password derivation; Oyatie may use different protocol): per-user re-key during sign-in + SRP-bridge-shim during overlap.
  - **Concealed field decryption-on-intake exposure** (during migration, concealed fields are decrypted client-side then re-encrypted on Oyatie; transient plaintext in memory): per-item migration must occur in user-trusted-client (CLI on user's device, never on shared infra); audit + attestation.
  - **OTP-secret migration breaks 2FA on target sites** (TOTP secrets are stored within items; migration MUST preserve to avoid forcing user re-enrollment on every TOTP-protected site): per-OTP-secret preserve via decrypt-then-rewrap + golden-render verification.
  - **SSH-key + SSH-agent socket break** (1Password SSH-agent socket at `~/.1password/agent.sock` is a 1Password-specific path; tooling references this path hardcoded): per-user agent-socket migration + ssh-config rewrite + fallback to file-based key.
  - **Shell-Plugin re-init required** (Shell-Plugins are per-user-per-machine config; not portable as data): user-side `op plugin init` re-run on Oyatie CLI for each plugin (aws / gcloud / etc.) with migration-runbook checklist.
  - **Browser extension auto-fill database lost** (Extension URL→item mappings are local; migration may break auto-fill): per-user extension re-pair with vault re-index.
  - **Travel-Mode subset-hiding semantic mismatch** (Travel-Mode hides selected vaults from devices; Oyatie may not have direct equivalent): per-vault travel-safe flag preservation + device-side filter.
  - **Connect-Server token rotation race** (infrastructure clients holding tokens break on cutover): coordinated token rotation with deploy-pipeline notification + 30-day overlap with token-exchange endpoint.
  - **SCIM-Bridge IdP-token rotation** (Okta/Azure-AD/OneLogin tokens need refresh): per-IdP coordinated rotation + grace-window.
  - **Events-API cursor-token regeneration** (consumers cache cursor; reset on migration): per-consumer cursor-reset + dual-stream window with deduplication.
  - **Watchtower hygiene model retrain** (Watchtower's reused/weak/breached detection uses opaque model + HIBP integration): Oyatie intelligence retrain with published model-card + bias-audit per ADR-0255.
  - **Trelica SaaS-discovery integration scope** (Trelica connects to Finance / SSO / Browser-Ext for SaaS-discovery; Oyatie must rebuild): per-connector migration + parity verification.
  - **Kolide device-trust check-bundle migration** (Kolide checks are Lua-scripted with osquery; not directly portable): per-check translator + manual-rewrite tracker.
  - **Recovery-code invalidation on cutover** (recovery codes are tied to 1Password account; not Oyatie-portable): user-side recovery-code re-issuance during shadow + dual-validity.
  - **Account-recovery process change** (1Password's account-recovery via Recovery Group is a specific workflow; Oyatie may differ): per-account-recovery process documentation + user notification.
  - **CLI `op` → Oyatie CLI migration** (developers script against `op read "op://vault/item/field"`; URI scheme migration required): per-script translator + URI-alias `op://` accepted on Oyatie CLI for grace-period.
  - **HIPAA-eligible vault boundary preservation** (1Password Business HIPAA-eligible accounts must preserve HIPAA boundary on Oyatie): per-vault HIPAA-tag + Oyatie compliance pack {hipaa} per [[compliance-pack-primitive]].
  - **Concurrent write race during 45-day shadow** (item edited on 1Password during shadow needs replication to Oyatie): per-item bidirectional sync via API + Oyatie secrets-mgmt µservice with conflict resolution (last-write-wins with audit trail).
  - **EU-residency preservation** (1Password EU account data must stay in EU region): per-region exporter + per-region importer + audit trail.

- **Migration playbook outline (1Password → Oyatie secrets-mgmt + iam + automation + observability + device-trust + saas-discovery µservices)**:
  1. Inventory accounts + users + groups + vaults + items + service-accounts + connect-servers + SCIM-bridges + SSO-config + Trelica SaaS-discovery + Kolide device-trust via API + Events API + CLI export + admin web-UI.
  2. Plan 45-day shadow window with dual-vault publishing + dual-event streaming + token-issue-overlap.
  3. Export items + documents via user-side CLI (`op`) with concealed-field decrypt + re-wrap to Oyatie KMS.
  4. Migrate vault permission-sets → Oyatie Cedar policy bindings; group memberships preserved.
  5. Re-issue Service-Account + Connect-Server + SCIM-Bridge + Events-API tokens on Oyatie side; coordinate rotation with downstream deploys.
  6. Re-establish SSO-unlock OIDC binding + 2FA methods (TOTP / Duo / YubiKey / WebAuthn / Passkeys) via re-enrollment.
  7. Re-establish Trelica SaaS-discovery + Kolide device-trust + Watchtower hygiene with published model-cards.
  8. Re-init Shell-Plugins (`aws / gcloud / etc.`) per-user-per-machine; migrate `op://` URI scheme via alias-acceptance.
  9. Parallel run with dual-vault write + per-item read parity + Audit-Event stream parity verification.
  10. Decommission 1Password accounts per-account after 90-day shadow with vault-retention overlap; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `secrets-mgmt` + `iam` + `automation` + `observability` + `apigw` + `compliance` + `device-trust` + `saas-discovery` + `developer-tools` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `1password` + `1password-connect` + `1password-cli` + `1password-scim-bridge` + `1password-events-api` + `1password-service-accounts` + `1password-secret-key` + `1password-watchtower` + `1password-travel-mode` + `trelica-by-1password` + `kolide-by-1password` + `1password-shell-plugins` are benchmark alias-only. The `secrets-mgmt` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical 1Password-equivalent password+secrets-vault surface, distinct from `iam` (Auth0/Okta/Ping/ForgeRock identity surfaces) by client-side-encryption-first heritage with dual-secret model.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-130 - LastPass
- Vendor name and category: LastPass (GoTo Technologies, spun-out 2022) — Enterprise + Personal Password Manager: LastPass Business + LastPass Teams + LastPass Premium + LastPass Free + LastPass Admin Console + LastPass Vault + LastPass Authenticator (TOTP + push) + LastPass Federated-Login (AD-FS / Azure-AD / Okta / OneLogin / PingOne / Google Workspace via LastPass-Federation / Custom-OIDC) + LastPass SSO (Cloud SSO with 1200+ pre-integrated apps + SAML + OIDC) + Advanced MFA (push / TOTP / biometric / hardware-key / contextual) + Password-Manager + Shared-Folders + Sites + Secure-Notes + Form-Fills + Equivalent-Domains + Browser-Extension + Mobile-App + LastPass CLI (lpass) + Provisioning (SCIM 2.0) + Reporting + Security-Dashboard + Dark-Web-Monitoring + Personal-Vault-Inside-Business + Emergency-Access + Country-Restrictions + IP-Address-Restrictions + LastPass MFA-API (programmatic MFA challenge) + Web-API (limited admin endpoints) + Activity-Reports + Splunk-Add-On + AD-Connector (legacy on-prem AD provisioning).
- Coverage tier: B (capability fit on `secrets-mgmt` (canonical enterprise password manager — LastPass differs from 1Password D-129 by Federated-Login heritage + SSO+PWM bundling + AD-FS integration + post-breach-2022 trust-rebuild posture) + `iam` (Federated-Login + SSO + SCIM + AD-Connector) + `intelligence` (Security-Dashboard hygiene + Dark-Web-Monitoring) + `observability` (Activity-Reports + Splunk-Add-On + Reporting API) + `compliance` (SOC-2 Type II + SOC-3 + ISO-27001 / 27017 / 27018 + GDPR + CCPA + BSI-C5 + post-breach-2022 commitments)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free / Premium → **Bronze**; Teams → **Silver**; Business (with SSO + MFA + SCIM + AD-Connector + Activity-Reports + 99.9%-SLA) → **Gold** (intentionally NOT Platinum: 2022 breach history downgrades trust ceiling per industry consensus). Note: Some Oyatie tenants explicitly forbid LastPass per security policy — `compliance-pack: lastpass_forbidden` is a known tenant-side gate.
- Oyatie destination: `secrets-mgmt` (Vaults + Sites + Secure-Notes + Form-Fills + Shared-Folders anchor); `iam` (Federated-Login + SSO + SCIM + AD-Connector); `intelligence` (Security-Dashboard + Dark-Web-Monitoring); `observability` (Activity-Reports + Splunk); `compliance` (SOC-2 + breach-disclosure posture per [[no-silent-regression]]).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (LastPass canonical):
  - `Enterprise_Account` (Account_ID, Name, Domain, Type {Business / Teams}, Region, Account-Settings{Password-Policy + MFA-Policy + Restrict-Devices + Restrict-Countries + Login-IP-Allowlist + Browser-Extension-Restriction + etc.}, Active-Users-Count, Active-Shared-Folders-Count).
  - `User` (User_ID, Account-Ref, Username (email), Name, Status {Active / Disabled / Awaiting-Approval / Expired}, Created-At, Last-Login, Last-Pw-Change-Date, MFA-Enabled, Federation-Status {Federated / Not-Federated}, Identity-Provider-Ref, External-ID).
  - `Personal_Vault` (Vault_ID, User-Ref, Encrypted-Vault-Key, Encrypted-Items-Blob, Sync-Token, Last-Sync-At).
  - `Shared_Folder` (Folder_ID, Account-Ref, Name, Members[User-Ref + Permission{Allow-Editing / Read-Only / Allow-Admin / Hide-Passwords}], Items-Count, Created-At).
  - `Site` (Site_ID, Vault-Ref (Personal or Shared), Name, URL, Username, Password-Encrypted, Notes-Encrypted, Form-Fields[], Equivalent-Domains[], Auto-Login, Auto-Submit, Disable-Auto-Fill, Generated-Password, Favorite, Last-Modified, Last-Accessed, Password-Strength-Score, Reused-Password-Indicator).
  - `Secure_Note` (Note_ID, Vault-Ref, Name, Type {General / Bank-Account / Credit-Card / Database / Driver-License / Email-Account / Health-Insurance / Insurance / Membership / Passport / Server / Social-Security / Software-License / SSH-Key / Wi-Fi / Custom}, Content-Encrypted, Custom-Fields[]).
  - `Form_Fill` (Form_ID, Vault-Ref, Profile-Name, Fields{First-Name / Last-Name / Email / Phone / Address1 / Address2 / City / State / ZIP / Country / Credit-Card-Number / CC-Expiration / CC-CVV / etc.}-Encrypted).
  - `Identity_Provider` (IdP_ID, Account-Ref, Type {AD-FS / Azure-AD / Okta / OneLogin / PingOne / Google-Workspace / Custom-OIDC / LastPass-Federation}, Issuer-URL, Client-ID, Client-Secret-Encrypted, JIT-Provisioning, K1-K2-Split-Method).
  - `Federation_K1_K2` (Federation_ID, Account-Ref, K1{Stored-On-IdP-or-AD}, K2{Stored-On-LastPass}, Hash-Algorithm, IdP-Signature-Verification-Cert). Note: K1-K2 split is LastPass's federation-key mechanism where master-password-derived key is split between IdP-derived K1 and LastPass-issued K2.
  - `SSO_App` (App_ID, Account-Ref, Name, Type {SAML / OIDC / Catalog-App}, Catalog-App-Ref (if from 1200+ pre-integrated catalog), SAML-Metadata, OIDC-Config, ACS-URL, Entity-ID, Assigned-Users[User-Ref], Assigned-Groups[Group-Ref], Launch-URL).
  - `MFA_Method` (MFA_ID, User-Ref, Type {LastPass-Authenticator-TOTP / LastPass-Authenticator-Push / Google-Authenticator / Microsoft-Authenticator / Duo / Symantec-VIP / SecureAuth / Toopher / RSA-SecurID / Salesforce-Authenticator / Transakt / Grid / Yubikey-OTP / Yubikey-WebAuthn / FIDO2 / SMS / Email}, Friendly-Name, Status {Active / Disabled / Locked}, Enrolled-At, Last-Used-At).
  - `Group` (Group_ID, Account-Ref, Name, Members[User-Ref], External-ID, Provisioning-Source {Manual / SCIM / AD-Connector}).
  - `Security_Dashboard_Score` (Score_ID, User-Ref, Overall-Score, Master-Password-Strength, Number-Of-Weak-Passwords, Number-Of-Reused-Passwords, Number-Of-Compromised-Passwords-HIBP, Number-Of-Sites-Without-MFA, Last-Updated).
  - `Dark_Web_Monitoring_Alert` (Alert_ID, User-Ref, Type {Breach-Detected / Account-Found-In-Dump}, Source, Breach-Date, Email-Affected, Severity, Status {New / Resolved / Ignored}).
  - `Activity_Report_Event` (Event_ID, Account-Ref, Type {Login / Logout / Site-Added / Site-Edited / Site-Deleted / Site-Accessed / Shared-Folder-Created / Folder-Member-Added / Master-Password-Changed / MFA-Enrolled / Federation-Configured / Admin-Action / etc. — 80+ types}, User-Ref, Actor-Type {User / Admin / System}, IP, User-Agent, Country, Timestamp).
  - `Equivalent_Domain` (ED_ID, Account-Ref, Domain-A, Domain-B (e.g., example.com ≡ example.co.uk)).
  - `Emergency_Access` (Access_ID, Owner-User-Ref, Trustee-User-Email, Wait-Time-Hours, Status {Pending / Accepted / Active / Denied}, Granted-At).
  - `AD_Connector_Config` (Connector_ID, Account-Ref, AD-Server-URL, Bind-DN, Bind-Password-Encrypted, Base-DN, User-Filter, Group-Filter, Sync-Interval-Minutes, Last-Sync-At, Sync-Status).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - LastPass Enterprise API: `https://lastpass.com/enterpriseapi.php` — POST commands `addUser / deactivateUser / disableUser / getEventReport / getMFAEvents / getAllUsersInfo / getUserSecurityScores / getSharedFolderData / getSharedFolderMemberInfo / batchAddOrUpdateUsers / etc.` with CID + ProvHash auth.
  - LastPass MFA-API: `https://server.lastpass.com/lmiapi/api/MFA` — programmatic-MFA-challenge integration.
  - LastPass SAML SSO: `https://identity.lastpass.com/SAML/SSOService.aspx`.
  - LastPass OIDC SSO: `https://identity.lastpass.com/oidc/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
  - LastPass SCIM 2.0: `https://scim.lastpass.com/scim/v2/` — Users, Groups, Schemas, ResourceTypes, ServiceProviderConfig.
  - LastPass CLI (`lpass`): `lpass login`, `lpass ls`, `lpass show <name>`, `lpass add <name>`, `lpass edit`, `lpass rm`, `lpass status`, `lpass logout`.
  - Web-Extension: WebExtension API + native messaging.
  - Splunk-Add-On: ingests Activity-Reports + Security-Dashboard scores via Enterprise-API polling.
  - SDKs: lastpass-python (community), lpass (official CLI written in C).

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Vault" — sites + secure-notes + form-fills list with folder hierarchy.
  - "Admin Console" — multi-pane enterprise admin (Dashboard / Users / Groups / Reporting / Settings / SSO / Federation / MFA / Provisioning / Equivalent-Domains).
  - "Browser Extension" — auto-fill + auto-save + auto-login on form-submit.
  - "Security Dashboard" — per-user hygiene score with weak/reused/breached/missing-MFA panels.
  - "Dark Web Monitoring" — breach-alert inbox + remediation.
  - "Emergency Access" — designate trustee + wait-time + grant-flow.
  - "SSO Catalog Picker" — 1200+ pre-integrated SAML/OIDC apps with one-click add.
  - "Federation Setup Wizard" — AD-FS / Azure-AD / Okta / OneLogin / Ping / Google / Custom-OIDC stepper.
  - "K1-K2 Split Key Reveal" — admin-only diagnostic surface.
  - "Equivalent Domains Editor" — domain-pair config for cross-domain auto-fill.
  - "MFA Enforcement Console" — per-user / per-group / per-IP / per-country policy.
  - "Activity Reports" — event-log search + Splunk export.
  - "Provisioning Console" — SCIM / AD-Connector sync status + error log.

- **Cedar permit shape** (secrets-mgmt + iam + intelligence + observability + compliance framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<lp-admin-id>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"LPAccountSettingsWrite", Oyatie::Action::"LPUserInvite",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPUserDisable", Oyatie::Action::"LPUserDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPGroupCreate", Oyatie::Action::"LPGroupMembershipManage",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPSharedFolderCreate", Oyatie::Action::"LPSharedFolderShare",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPSiteRead", Oyatie::Action::"LPSiteCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPSiteEdit", Oyatie::Action::"LPSiteDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPFederationConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"LPSSOAppAdd",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPSSOAppAssign", Oyatie::Action::"LPMFAEnforce",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPSCIMBridgeConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"LPADConnectorConfigure",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPEmergencyAccessGrant", Oyatie::Action::"LPActivityReportExport",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPSecurityDashboardView", Oyatie::Action::"LPDarkWebAlertView",
      Oyatie::Action::"LPEquivalentDomainEdit", Oyatie::Action::"LPRestrictionConfigure"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::LPEnterpriseAccount::"<acct-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::LPUser::"<user-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::LPSharedFolder::"<folder-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::LPSite::"<site-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::LPSSOApp::"<sso-app-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::LPFederation::"<fed-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    context.tenant_id == principal.tenant_id &&
    context.tenant_lastpass_forbidden_pack != true &&  // tenant opt-out check
    context.mfa_satisfied == true &&
    context.master_password_recently_verified == true &&
    context.ip_in_allowlist == true &&
    context.country_in_allowlist == true &&
    context.federation_k1_k2_proof_present == true || context.federation_disabled == true &&
    context.breach_disclosure_acknowledged == true &&  // post-2022 breach acknowledgment
    context.byok_provider_credential_mode in ["platform_default", "byok"] &&
    context.compliance_pack_active in ["soc2", "iso27001", "iso27017", "iso27018", "gdpr", "ccpa", "bsi_c5"]
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Enterprise_Account` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::enterprise_tenant`.
  - `User` → `Oyatie::Iam::secrets_user`.
  - `Personal_Vault` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::personal_vault`.
  - `Shared_Folder` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::shared_vault` (with permission semantics).
  - `Site` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::credential_entry` (with form-field auto-fill semantics).
  - `Secure_Note` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::typed_secure_note`.
  - `Form_Fill` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::form_fill_profile`.
  - `Identity_Provider` + `Federation_K1_K2` → `Oyatie::Iam::federated_login_binding` (with K1-K2 split-key preserved or translated to Oyatie equivalent).
  - `SSO_App` → `Oyatie::Iam::sso_application` (with 1200+ catalog migration).
  - `MFA_Method` → `Oyatie::Iam::authenticator_device`.
  - `Security_Dashboard_Score` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::password_hygiene_score`.
  - `Dark_Web_Monitoring_Alert` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::breach_alert`.
  - `Activity_Report_Event` → `Oyatie::Observability::audit_event_record`.
  - `Equivalent_Domain` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::domain_equivalence_rule`.
  - `Emergency_Access` → `Oyatie::SecretsMgmt::emergency_access_grant`.
  - `AD_Connector_Config` → `Oyatie::Iam::ad_connector_binding` (legacy on-prem AD).

- **12-23 specific workflow steps for migrating-off / dual-running LastPass → Oyatie**:
  1. Inventory enterprise-accounts + users + shared-folders + sites + secure-notes + form-fills + SSO-apps + federation-config + MFA-methods via Enterprise API + Activity-Reports export.
  2. Disclose 2022 breach posture to tenant + acknowledge migration-urgency for security-sensitive tenants.
  3. Plan 30-day shadow window (compressed vs other vendors due to breach-urgency).
  4. Export Personal-Vault + Shared-Folder items via LastPass CSV export OR `lpass` CLI (user-side; concealed fields decrypted client-side then re-wrapped to Oyatie KMS).
  5. Export Secure-Notes (all 16 types) preserving typed schema.
  6. Export Form-Fills preserving field-by-field mapping.
  7. Export SSO-App catalog assignments (1200+ pre-integrated apps mapped to Oyatie iam SSO surface).
  8. Export Federation-Config (AD-FS / Azure-AD / Okta / OneLogin / Ping / Google / Custom-OIDC) — K1-K2 split-key preserved as much as IdP-side allows.
  9. Export Activity-Reports for 7-year retention via Enterprise API.
  10. Export Security-Dashboard scores + Dark-Web alerts for baseline.
  11. Export Group memberships + SCIM-Bridge config + AD-Connector config.
  12. Migrate Personal-Vaults via decrypt-and-rewrap onto Oyatie secrets-mgmt µservice; cell-scoped per [[amazon-shape-cellular-architecture]].
  13. Migrate Shared-Folders → Oyatie shared-vault with permission-mapping (Allow-Editing / Read-Only / Allow-Admin / Hide-Passwords).
  14. Migrate SSO-Apps → Oyatie iam SSO surface (catalog app reference re-bound).
  15. Translate Federation K1-K2 split → Oyatie federated-login equivalent (per-IdP method).
  16. Re-enroll MFA (LastPass-Authenticator and other MFA methods) via step-up flow during shadow.
  17. Re-establish Emergency-Access grants + Equivalent-Domains + Country / IP restrictions.
  18. Re-establish SCIM-Bridge + AD-Connector on Oyatie iam µservice.
  19. Re-establish Security-Dashboard hygiene scoring + Dark-Web monitoring on Oyatie intelligence with model-card publication per ADR-0255.
  20. Re-establish Activity-Reports + Splunk-Add-On streaming on Oyatie observability.
  21. Parallel run: 30-day shadow with dual-vault publishing + per-item read parity + per-event audit-log parity ≥ 99.99%.
  22. Cut-over via browser-extension re-config + DNS + Federation-metadata flip; LastPass extension uninstall pushed via device-management.
  23. Decommission LastPass per-account after 60-day shadow (extended retention for incident-investigation); LastPass sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **12-20 specific failure modes**:
  - **2022-breach blast-radius unknown** (LastPass disclosed 2022 breach exposed encrypted vault contents + unencrypted URLs + customer-data — items decrypted offline by attacker after master-password compromise possible): per-user master-password-rotation-mandatory during migration + per-site password-rotation-mandatory + breach-disclosure-acknowledgment recorded in tenant ledger.
  - **K1-K2 federation-key split lossy translation** (federation-K1 derived from IdP-side mechanism varies per IdP; K2 issued by LastPass; Oyatie may not preserve exact mechanism): per-IdP federation-translator + dual-eval window + user-side re-enrollment if lossy.
  - **CSV export concealed-field exposure** (CSV export reveals all passwords in plaintext to user-machine; security-sensitive): per-export user-machine-attestation + immediate-rewrap requirement + audit trail.
  - **`lpass` CLI deprecation** (lpass CLI is community-maintained C binary; may break on newer LastPass-server protocol changes): pre-migration version-pin + manual fallback via browser-extension export.
  - **Equivalent-Domains preserve break** (LastPass auto-fills across equivalent-domains by default; Oyatie auto-fill semantic may differ): per-account equivalent-domains migration + browser-extension policy preservation.
  - **MFA method-list catalog mismatch** (LastPass supports Toopher / Transakt / Grid + retired methods; Oyatie may not): per-method compatibility matrix + forced-re-enroll to supported method.
  - **SSO catalog 1200+ app-binding** (catalog apps have LastPass-side config; Oyatie iam SSO must rebuild catalog or import per-app): per-app SAML/OIDC metadata export + Oyatie catalog-app build prioritization + manual-rewrite tracker.
  - **AD-Connector legacy on-prem dependency** (AD-Connector is a JVM agent on customer's on-prem; not portable): pre-migration AD-Connector decommission + replace with Oyatie iam AD-connector or SCIM bridge.
  - **Country-Restriction + IP-Allowlist enforcement gap** (LastPass enforces at login; Oyatie may enforce at API + login both): per-restriction translation + dual-enforcement during shadow.
  - **Emergency-Access wait-time semantic** (Emergency-Access trustees wait N hours then auto-grant if not denied; Oyatie may differ): per-grant wait-time preservation + trustee notification preservation.
  - **Activity-Reports timestamp drift** (timestamps in UTC vs LastPass-server timezone): per-event timezone-normalization.
  - **Browser-extension URL→site auto-fill database loss** (extension caches URL-to-site mapping locally; migration breaks auto-fill): per-user extension re-pair + vault re-index + 7-day overlap.
  - **Personal-Vault inside Business migration semantic** (LastPass allows personal-vault inside business account; Oyatie may separate strictly): per-user personal-vault decision (migrate-to-personal-Oyatie OR migrate-to-business-Oyatie-tagged).
  - **Trust degradation tenant-side** (some tenants forbid LastPass per security policy; migrating to Oyatie is the GOAL): pre-migration LastPass-forbidden tenant identification + accelerated-migration runway.
  - **Master-password-derived-vault-key recomputation** (Oyatie uses PBKDF2-SHA256 + iteration-count differs from LastPass; key-derivation translator required): per-user PBKDF2-bridge with iteration-count preservation + dual-decrypt window.
  - **SCIM-Bridge SCIM-token rotation** (Okta/Azure-AD/OneLogin tokens need refresh): coordinated rotation + 30-day overlap.
  - **Splunk-Add-On polling-cadence mismatch** (LastPass polled at 5min; Oyatie observability may stream): per-Splunk-consumer cutover with polling-deprecation + push-streaming switchover.
  - **Dark-Web monitoring source change** (LastPass uses Have-I-Been-Pwned + others; Oyatie may use different source): per-tenant breach-source disclosure + dual-source overlap.
  - **Audit-event 80+ type taxonomy translation** (LastPass event-type strings differ from Oyatie's): per-event translator + dual-emit during shadow.
  - **Customer-side trust-rebuilding period** (LastPass tenants migrating need accelerated runway + transparent reporting): per-tenant migration-status dashboard + weekly check-in.

- **Migration playbook outline (LastPass → Oyatie secrets-mgmt + iam + intelligence + observability µservices)**:
  1. Inventory enterprise-accounts + users + shared-folders + sites + SSO-apps + federation-config via Enterprise API + Activity-Reports + CSV export + `lpass` CLI.
  2. Plan 30-day shadow window (compressed vs other vendors due to breach-urgency) with dual-vault publish + dual-event stream + LastPass-forbidden tenant identification.
  3. Force master-password-rotation + per-site password-rotation during migration (post-2022-breach hygiene mandate).
  4. Migrate Personal-Vaults + Shared-Folders + Sites + Secure-Notes + Form-Fills onto Oyatie secrets-mgmt cell-scoped vaults.
  5. Migrate SSO-Apps + Federation-Config + Equivalent-Domains + Country / IP restrictions + Emergency-Access onto Oyatie iam µservice.
  6. Migrate MFA methods via re-enrollment (LastPass-Authenticator and others).
  7. Migrate SCIM-Bridge + AD-Connector onto Oyatie iam provisioning surface.
  8. Re-establish Security-Dashboard + Dark-Web monitoring on Oyatie intelligence with model-card publication.
  9. Re-establish Activity-Reports + Splunk export on Oyatie observability.
  10. Decommission LastPass per-account after 60-day extended-shadow with breach-disclosure-acknowledgment in tenant ledger per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `secrets-mgmt` + `iam` + `intelligence` + `observability` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `lastpass` + `lastpass-business` + `lastpass-federation` + `lastpass-k1-k2` + `lastpass-sso` + `lastpass-mfa-api` + `lastpass-scim` + `lastpass-ad-connector` + `lastpass-authenticator` + `lastpass-emergency-access` + `lastpass-equivalent-domains` + `lastpass-security-dashboard` + `lastpass-dark-web-monitoring` + `lpass-cli` are benchmark alias-only. The `secrets-mgmt` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical LastPass-equivalent surface, sharing target with 1Password D-129; LastPass distinguished by federated-login + SSO-bundling + AD-FS heritage. Tier downgrade to Gold (NOT Platinum) reflects 2022-breach-induced industry trust ceiling per [[no-silent-regression]].

### Section D-131 - Wiz
- Vendor name and category: Wiz, Inc. — Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP): Wiz Cloud Security Platform + CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Mgmt) + CWPP (Cloud Workload Protection) + CIEM (Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Mgmt) + DSPM (Data Security Posture Mgmt) + KSPM (Kubernetes Security Posture Mgmt) + CDR (Cloud Detection + Response) + ASPM (Application Security Posture Mgmt) + Wiz Code (IaC + SCA + SAST + Secrets Scanning + Container-Image Scanning) + Wiz Runtime Sensor (eBPF-based runtime detection on Linux + container + serverless) + Wiz Defend (cloud-native XDR / runtime-threat-detection) + Wiz Security Graph (the "Wiz Graph" — unified context across AWS / Azure / GCP / OCI / Alibaba / Kubernetes / SaaS / GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket / Snowflake / Databricks / etc.) + Toxic-Combination Detection + Attack-Path Analysis + Issues + Workflows + Connectors + Reports + Inventory + Threat-Center + AI-SPM (AI Security Posture Management — model inventory + risk + drift) + Wiz for Developers + Wiz Sensor + Wiz Outpost (private-cloud deploy) + Vulnerability Catalog + Cloud-Events.
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `cloud-security` (canonical CNAPP — Wiz differs from CrowdStrike D-110 / Defender D-047 / Sentinel D-048 by agentless-first via cloud API + Security-Graph unified inventory across multi-cloud + toxic-combination + attack-path analytics) + `intelligence` (Threat-Center + ML toxic-combination + Attack-Path scoring + AI-SPM model-risk) + `automation` (Workflows + Webhooks + Auto-Remediation) + `policy` (Wiz Controls — custom-policy framework + Compliance-Frameworks 100+) + `apigw` (Wiz GraphQL API + REST API) + `developer-tools` (Wiz CLI + Wiz Code IDE integrations + Pre-commit hooks + Pull-Request annotations) + `data-store` (DSPM data-inventory) + `iam` (CIEM entitlement-analysis) + `compliance` (SOC-2 Type II + ISO-27001 + GDPR + FedRAMP-Moderate-in-process + 100+ frameworks rendered as Compliance-Posture reports) + `observability` (Cloud-Events firehose + Audit-Log)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Wiz Essential → **Gold**; Wiz Advanced + Wiz Enterprise (with Wiz Code + Runtime-Sensor + Defend + AI-SPM + DSPM + Outpost + 99.9%-SLA + private-cloud) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `cloud-security` (CSPM + CWPP + CIEM + DSPM + KSPM + CDR + ASPM + Wiz-Graph anchor); `intelligence` (Threat-Center + Toxic-Combination ML + Attack-Path); `automation` (Workflows); `policy` (Wiz Controls + Compliance-Frameworks); `apigw` (GraphQL + REST); `developer-tools` (Wiz Code); `data-store` (DSPM); `iam` (CIEM); `compliance` (FedRAMP + 100+ frameworks); `observability` (Cloud-Events).

  - `Data_Finding` (Finding_ID, Resource-Ref, Data-Class {PII / PCI / PHI / Credentials / Source-Code / Customer-Records / etc.}, Confidence-Score, Sample-Count, Data-Volume-Bytes, Compliance-Impact{GDPR / HIPAA / PCI / etc.}).
  - `Identity_Finding` (Finding_ID, Identity-Resource-Ref, Risk {Excessive-Privilege / Inactive-Identity / Toxic-Permission-Combination / Cross-Account-Trust-Anomaly / etc.}, Effective-Permissions[], Recommended-Action).
  - `AI_Model_Inventory` (Model_ID, Provider {OpenAI / Anthropic / Bedrock-Hosted / Self-Hosted-HuggingFace / etc.}, Endpoint, Data-Sensitivity, Access-Identities[], Compliance-Posture).
  - `Audit_Log_Event` (Audit_ID, Actor-User-Ref / Actor-Service-Account-Ref, Action {SettingsWrite / ConnectorAdd / IssueAcknowledge / etc.}, Resource-Ref, Timestamp, IP, User-Agent).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Wiz GraphQL API: `https://api.{region}.app.wiz.io/graphql` — queries/mutations over `issues / vulnerabilities / cloudResources / wizGraphRelations / projects / controls / workflows / connectors / scans / threats / identities / dataFindings / aiModels`.
  - Wiz REST API: limited surface; primarily used for webhook ingestion + image-scanning trigger.
  - Wiz CLI: `wizcli`, `wizcli iac scan -d ./terraform`, `wizcli dir scan`, `wizcli docker scan --image acme/api:1.2.3`, `wizcli auth login`, `wizcli auth --id <client-id> --secret <client-secret>`.
  - Wiz Code (IDE / VCS integrations): GitHub App + GitLab Integration + Bitbucket App + JetBrains plugin + VSCode plugin.
  - Wiz Runtime Sensor: eBPF-based Linux sensor + Kubernetes DaemonSet + serverless layer (AWS Lambda Extension).
  - SDKs: wiz-sdk-go (community), wiz-python (community); primary integration via GraphQL.
  - Webhooks: Issue-Created / Issue-Resolved / Scan-Completed / Threat-Detected → POST to user-defined URL with signed payload.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Wiz Graph Explorer" — interactive graph traversal across cloud resources.
  - "Issues Inbox" — Critical/High/Med/Low + filter by project + status.
  - "Toxic Combinations" — pre-curated attack-pattern feed.
  - "Attack Path Analyzer" — start-from-attacker-perspective path visualization.
  - "Inventory Console" — 1500+ cloud-resource types with normalized properties.
  - "Compliance Heatmap" — per-framework + per-section pass/fail.
  - "Controls Editor" — custom-rule with Wiz-Query-Lang + CEL.
  - "Workflows Designer" — trigger + condition + action builder.
  - "Wiz Code Pull-Request Annotations" — inline diff annotations.
  - "Runtime Threat Timeline" — process-tree + network + file events.
  - "DSPM Data-Findings Map" — sensitive-data inventory across cloud + SaaS.
  - "CIEM Effective-Permissions Explorer" — IAM permission-flattening + toxic-permission visualization.
  - "AI-SPM Model Inventory" — discovered AI models + risk + access-identity.
  - "Threat Center" — active-threats + IoC-feed + hunting-queries.
  - "Projects" — scope-based access + team-affinity.

- **Cedar permit shape** (cloud-security + intelligence + automation + policy + apigw + developer-tools + data-store + iam + compliance + observability framing):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<wiz-admin-id>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"WizConnectorAdd", Oyatie::Action::"WizConnectorScopeChange",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizConnectorDelete", Oyatie::Action::"WizProjectCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizProjectScopeWrite", Oyatie::Action::"WizControlCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizControlEdit", Oyatie::Action::"WizWorkflowDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizWorkflowAutoRemediationEnable", Oyatie::Action::"WizIssueAcknowledge",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizIssueResolve", Oyatie::Action::"WizIssueReject",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizComplianceFrameworkAdd", Oyatie::Action::"WizComplianceReportExport",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizGraphQuery", Oyatie::Action::"WizCodeScanTrigger",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizCodePRAnnotationConfigure", Oyatie::Action::"WizRuntimeSensorDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizRuntimeSensorRemove", Oyatie::Action::"WizThreatAcknowledge",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizDSPMScanTrigger", Oyatie::Action::"WizCIEMRecommendationApply",
      Oyatie::Action::"WizAISPMModelInventoryView", Oyatie::Action::"WizAuditLogExport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::WizTenant::"<tenant-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WizProject::"<project-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WizConnector::"<conn-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WizControl::"<control-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WizWorkflow::"<wf-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WizIssue::"<issue-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WizRuntimeSensor::"<sensor-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    context.tenant_id == principal.tenant_id &&
    context.connector_region_in_allowlist == true &&
    context.mfa_satisfied == true &&
    context.outpost_mode_required ==> resource.deployed_in_outpost == true &&
    context.auto_remediation_blast_radius < 50 &&  // safeguard for auto-remediation
    context.cloud_account_change_window_open == true &&  // change-mgmt gate
    context.byok_provider_credential_mode in ["platform_default", "byok"] &&
    context.compliance_pack_active in ["soc2", "iso27001", "fedramp_moderate", "gdpr", "hipaa", "pci_dss", "nist_csf", "cis_benchmark"]
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Connector` → `Oyatie::CloudSecurity::cloud_connector` (per [[tenant-as-universal-scoping-primitive]] each connector tagged with tenant + region).
  - `Cloud_Resource` → `Oyatie::CloudSecurity::normalized_cloud_resource` (cross-CSP unification).
  - `Wiz_Graph_Edge` → `Oyatie::CloudSecurity::security_graph_edge`.
  - `Issue` → `Oyatie::CloudSecurity::issue` (with severity + status + provenance).
  - `Toxic_Combination` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::toxic_combination_pattern` (200+ canonical patterns).
  - `Attack_Path` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::attack_path_analysis`.
  - `Vulnerability` → `Oyatie::CloudSecurity::vulnerability_finding` (CVE + CVSS + EPSS + KEV).
  - `Control` → `Oyatie::Policy::cloud_security_control`.
  - `Compliance_Framework` + `Compliance_Posture` → `Oyatie::Compliance::framework_posture` (100+ frameworks; per ADR-0251 §D-10 compliance-pack-aware).
  - `Workflow` → `Oyatie::Automation::cloud_security_workflow`.
  - `Wiz_Code_Repo_Scan` → `Oyatie::DeveloperTools::code_security_scan`.
  - `Runtime_Event` + `Threat` → `Oyatie::CloudSecurity::runtime_threat`.
  - `Data_Finding` → `Oyatie::DataStore::sensitive_data_classification`.
  - `Identity_Finding` → `Oyatie::Iam::entitlement_risk_finding`.
  - `AI_Model_Inventory` → `Oyatie::AISPM::model_inventory` (per ADR-0255 §D-4 EU-AI-Act-aware).
  - `Audit_Log_Event` → `Oyatie::Observability::audit_event_record`.

- **12-23 specific workflow steps for migrating-off / dual-running Wiz → Oyatie**:
  1. Inventory connectors + projects + controls + workflows + active-issues + compliance-frameworks + runtime-sensors via GraphQL.
  2. Plan 60-day shadow window with dual-scanning + dual-issue-emit + workflow-replay.
  3. Export connectors with role-trust-config (AWS / Azure / GCP / OCI / K8s / GitHub / etc.); preserve audit-trail of cross-account assumed roles.
  4. Export normalized Cloud-Resources via GraphQL pagination (1500+ types).
  5. Export Wiz-Graph edges (snapshot of full graph at cutover-1).
  6. Export Issues (open + resolved + last 12 months historical) for continuity.
  7. Export Toxic-Combination + Attack-Path snapshots (200+ patterns).
  8. Export Vulnerabilities + Vulnerability Catalog references (CVE + CVSS + EPSS + KEV).
  9. Export Controls (built-in + custom Wiz-Query-Lang/CEL) — translate to Oyatie cloud-security policy framework.
  10. Export Compliance-Frameworks (100+) + Compliance-Posture for each project.
  11. Export Projects with scope-config + member-refs + Slack-binding.
  12. Export Workflows (trigger + condition + action) → translate to Oyatie automation.
  13. Export Wiz-Code repo-scans + Pull-Request annotations + IDE-plugin config.
  14. Export Runtime-Sensor configurations + sensor-health + per-resource Runtime-Events.
  15. Export Threats + Hunting-Queries + MITRE-ATT&CK mappings.
  16. Export DSPM Data-Findings + sensitivity classifications.
  17. Export CIEM Identity-Findings + effective-permissions data.
  18. Export AI-SPM Model-Inventory + risk + access-identity.
  19. Re-deploy Runtime-Sensor as Oyatie eBPF sensor (or compatible CWPP) with per-host re-attestation.
  20. Re-establish Wiz-Code IDE/VCS integrations as Oyatie developer-tools surfaces.
  21. Re-establish Workflows with action-translations (Jira / ServiceNow / Slack / PagerDuty / webhooks).
  22. Parallel run: 60-day shadow with dual-scan + per-issue parity ≥ 99% (cloud-config) + ≥ 95% (runtime — heuristic-based).
  23. Cut-over per connector after parity-gate green; revoke cloud-side IAM-roles from Wiz; Wiz tenant sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **12-20 specific failure modes**:
  - **Connector permission-scope downgrade** (Wiz reads cloud config with elevated IAM; migration requires re-grant to Oyatie service-principal): per-connector role-creation + scope-verification + dual-account audit.
  - **Wiz-Graph edge-semantic translation** (Wiz Graph edges are proprietary type-vocabulary; Oyatie security-graph may use different types): per-edge-type translator + lossy-edge disclosure.
  - **Toxic-Combination pattern parity** (Wiz curates 200+ toxic-combination patterns; Oyatie cloud-security must match): per-pattern Oyatie equivalent + manual-rewrite tracker for proprietary patterns.
  - **Attack-Path engine difference** (Wiz uses proprietary risk-scoring; Oyatie may produce different attack-paths): 30-day shadow log-only window + threshold-recalibration + model-card publication.
  - **Vulnerability catalog reference drift** (Wiz Vulnerability Catalog has Wiz-specific IDs alongside CVE; Oyatie tracks CVE+EPSS+KEV): per-vuln CVE-alignment + Wiz-ID-alias preservation.
  - **Custom Wiz-Query-Lang controls non-portable** (Wiz custom controls use Wiz-Query-Lang DSL or CEL; Oyatie policy framework differs): per-control translator + manual-rewrite tracker.
  - **Compliance-Framework section mapping drift** (Wiz's framework sections may map differently to Oyatie compliance packs): per-framework section-translator + lossy-rule disclosure.
  - **Workflow action-system mismatch** (Wiz workflows fire Slack/Jira/ServiceNow/PagerDuty with Wiz-specific payload formats): per-action payload-translator + webhook-payload-format-preservation.
  - **Wiz-Code IDE plugin re-install** (developers using VSCode/JetBrains Wiz plugins must re-install Oyatie equivalent): per-IDE plugin development + migration-runbook.
  - **Runtime-Sensor eBPF compatibility** (Wiz sensor uses eBPF on Linux; Oyatie sensor may be different but compatible): per-host re-deploy + sensor-conflict resolution (uninstall Wiz before Oyatie deploy).
  - **Pull-Request annotation re-bind** (Wiz GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket apps install per-org; Oyatie equivalent must install): per-VCS-org Oyatie app-install + re-grant.
  - **DSPM data-classification model drift** (Wiz uses ML for PII/PCI/PHI detection; Oyatie may use different model): per-data-class retrain + dual-classify window + threshold-recalibration.
  - **CIEM effective-permission flattening algorithm difference** (Wiz flattens IAM policies with proprietary algorithm; Oyatie may produce different flattening): per-identity Oyatie flattening + dual-evaluate window.
  - **AI-SPM model-inventory source change** (Wiz discovers AI models via cloud-API + runtime-sensor + SaaS-integrations; Oyatie discovery may differ): per-source migration + cold-start window.
  - **Connector OIDC trust-relationship break** (re-trust relationships break if not rotated in coordinated window): coordinated rotation with cloud-side cooperation + verification.
  - **Webhook signature change** (consumers verifying Wiz webhook signatures break): per-consumer signature-key rotation + 30-day overlap with dual-signing.
  - **Cloud-Events firehose throughput** (large tenants emit millions of events/day; Oyatie observability must absorb): per-tenant throughput-projection + backpressure-config.
  - **Audit-Log retention regulatory** (FedRAMP / HIPAA require 7-year retention; tenant must verify Oyatie observability matches): per-tenant retention-policy verification.
  - **EU-residency for cloud-resource data** (EU-tenant cloud-data must stay in EU region): per-region exporter + per-region importer + audit trail.
  - **Multi-cloud connector OAuth-token rotation race** (Snowflake / Databricks / SaaS connectors have OAuth tokens; rotation during migration): coordinated rotation + 30-day overlap.

- **Migration playbook outline (Wiz → Oyatie cloud-security + intelligence + automation + policy + developer-tools + data-store + iam + compliance + observability µservices)**:
  1. Inventory tenants + connectors + projects + controls + workflows + issues + compliance-frameworks + runtime-sensors + AI-SPM models via GraphQL + audit-log export.
  2. Plan 60-day shadow window with dual-scan + dual-issue-emit + workflow-replay + signature-dual-sign.
  3. Re-establish cloud connectors (AWS / Azure / GCP / OCI / K8s / GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket / Snowflake / Databricks) onto Oyatie cloud-security service-principals.
  4. Migrate controls (built-in + custom Wiz-Query-Lang/CEL) onto Oyatie policy framework.
  5. Migrate workflows (trigger + condition + action) onto Oyatie automation µservice.
  6. Re-deploy Runtime-Sensor onto Oyatie eBPF sensor with per-host re-attestation + Wiz-sensor uninstall.
  7. Re-train Toxic-Combination + Attack-Path + DSPM + CIEM models on Oyatie intelligence with model-card publication.
  8. Re-establish Wiz-Code IDE/VCS integrations as Oyatie developer-tools surfaces.
  9. Re-establish Compliance-Frameworks (100+) on Oyatie compliance µservice with per-tenant pack-binding.
  10. Decommission Wiz tenants per-connector after 60-day shadow; revoke cloud-side IAM roles from Wiz; Wiz sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `cloud-security` + `intelligence` + `automation` + `policy` + `apigw` + `developer-tools` + `data-store` + `iam` + `compliance` + `observability` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `wiz` + `wiz-graph` + `wiz-cspm` + `wiz-cwpp` + `wiz-ciem` + `wiz-dspm` + `wiz-kspm` + `wiz-cdr` + `wiz-aspm` + `wiz-ai-spm` + `wiz-code` + `wiz-runtime-sensor` + `wiz-defend` + `wiz-outpost` + `wiz-toxic-combinations` + `wiz-attack-path` + `wiz-controls` + `wizcli` are benchmark alias-only. The `cloud-security` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Wiz-equivalent CNAPP surface, distinct from `endpoint-security` (CrowdStrike D-110) by agentless-first multi-cloud heritage.

(See §27 of `docs/architecture/wave-3-g-synthesis-adjudication-2026-05-21.md` for synthesis-audit-blessed pattern.)

### Section D-132 - Snyk
- Vendor name and category: Snyk Limited — Developer Security Platform (DevSecOps): Snyk Open Source (SCA — Software Composition Analysis) + Snyk Code (SAST — Static Application Security Testing, DeepCode-AI-powered) + Snyk Container (container-image scanning + Kubernetes workload analysis + base-image-recommendation) + Snyk Infrastructure as Code (Snyk IaC — Terraform / CloudFormation / Kubernetes-manifests / Helm / Pulumi / ARM / Bicep) + Snyk AppRisk (ASPM — Application Security Posture Mgmt + Insights + Asset-Inventory) + Snyk Cloud (CSPM-light + cloud-context for app-vulns) + Snyk Code Agent Fix + Snyk DeepCode AI (Symbolic AI + LLM hybrid for autofix) + Snyk Reachability Analysis + Snyk Vulnerability Database (Snyk Intel + curated CVE + vuln-research) + Snyk Broker (network-broker for self-hosted SCMs) + Snyk CLI + Snyk Web UI + Snyk Integrations (200+ SCMs / IDEs / CI/CD / package-registries) + Snyk Reports + Snyk Org / Group / Tenant hierarchy + Snyk Policy Engine + Snyk License Compliance + Snyk SBOM (CycloneDX + SPDX) + Snyk-API + Snyk-Auto-Fix + Snyk-Issues + Snyk-Targets + Snyk-Projects + Snyk-Tags + Snyk-Custom-Rules + Snyk-Federal (FedRAMP-Moderate authorized).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `developer-security` (canonical DevSecOps surface — Snyk differs from Wiz D-131 by developer-first SCA+SAST+Container+IaC depth + DeepCode-AI autofix + reachability-analysis + Snyk-Intel curated vuln DB + broker for self-hosted SCMs) + `intelligence` (DeepCode-AI + Reachability ML + AppRisk scoring + Snyk-Intel vuln-curation) + `automation` (Snyk-Fix PRs + Custom-Rules + Webhooks) + `apigw` (Snyk-API v3 REST + Snyk-API v1) + `developer-tools` (CLI + 30+ IDE plugins + 200+ integrations) + `policy` (Snyk Policy Engine + License Compliance) + `compliance` (FedRAMP-Moderate + SOC-2 + ISO-27001 / 27017 / 27018 + GDPR + CycloneDX + SPDX SBOM) + `data-store` (Snyk Vulnerability Database + Issues + Targets) + `cloud-security` (Snyk Cloud)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free (200 tests/month) → **Silver**; Team → **Gold**; Enterprise (with AppRisk + DeepCode-AI + Reachability + Custom-Rules + Federal + Broker + 99.9%-SLA) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `developer-security` (SCA + SAST + Container + IaC anchor); `intelligence` (DeepCode-AI + Reachability + AppRisk); `automation` (Snyk-Fix PRs + Custom-Rules); `apigw` (Snyk-API v3); `developer-tools` (CLI + IDE plugins + integrations); `policy` (Policy-Engine + License); `compliance` (FedRAMP + SBOM); `data-store` (Vuln-DB + Issues); `cloud-security` (Snyk Cloud).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Snyk canonical):
  - `Tenant` (Tenant_ID, Name, Domain, Region {us / eu / au}, Federal-Boundary, Subscription-Plan).
  - `Group` (Group_ID, Tenant-Ref, Name, Description, Settings{SAML-SSO + SCIM + Permissions-Inheritance}, Orgs[Org-Ref]).

  - `Integration` (Integration_ID, Org-Ref, Type {GitHub / GitHub-Enterprise / GitLab / GitLab-Self-Managed / Bitbucket-Cloud / Bitbucket-Server / Azure-Repos / AWS-CodeCommit / Docker-Hub / ACR / ECR / GCR / Quay / Artifactory / Nexus / Heroku / etc. — 30+ SCMs/registries}, Credentials-Encrypted, Broker-Required {bool}, Webhook-URL, Default-Branch-Behavior).

  ```
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::SnykTenant::"<tenant-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SnykGroup::"<group-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SnykOrg::"<org-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SnykProject::"<project-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SnykIntegration::"<integration-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::SnykBroker::"<broker-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    context.tenant_id == principal.tenant_id &&
    context.snyk_region == resource.region &&
    context.mfa_satisfied == true &&
    context.federal_boundary_check ==> resource.in_federal_tenant == true &&
    context.broker_tunnel_authenticated == true || resource.broker_required == false &&
    context.fix_pr_target_branch_allowed == true &&
    context.byok_provider_credential_mode in ["platform_default", "byok"] &&
    context.compliance_pack_active in ["fedramp_moderate", "soc2", "iso27001", "gdpr", "cyclonedx_sbom", "spdx_sbom"]
  };
  ```

- **Specific ontology projection**:
  - `Tenant` + `Group` + `Org` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSecurity::tenant_hierarchy` (3-level nesting per [[tenant-as-universal-scoping-primitive]]).
  - `Member` → `Oyatie::Iam::developer_security_member`.
  - `Integration` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSecurity::scm_or_registry_binding`.
  - `Target` + `Project` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSecurity::scanning_target` + `project_snapshot`.
  - `Issue` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSecurity::vulnerability_issue` (with reachability + exploit-maturity).
  - `Vulnerability_Snyk_Intel` → `Oyatie::DataStore::curated_vuln_intel`.
  - `Custom_Rule` → `Oyatie::Policy::sast_custom_rule`.
  - `Snyk_Fix_PR` → `Oyatie::Automation::auto_fix_pull_request`.
  - `Sbom` → `Oyatie::Compliance::sbom_artifact` (CycloneDX + SPDX).
  - `Reachability_Analysis` → `Oyatie::Intelligence::reachability_model`.
  - `AppRisk_Asset` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSecurity::application_asset` (risk-scored).
  - `Container_Base_Image_Recommendation` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSecurity::container_base_image_advisor`.
  - `Snyk_Broker_Client` → `Oyatie::DeveloperSecurity::broker_tunnel`.
  - `Audit_Log_Event` → `Oyatie::Observability::audit_event_record`.

- **12-23 specific workflow steps for migrating-off / dual-running Snyk → Oyatie**:
  1. Inventory tenants + groups + orgs + members + integrations + targets + projects + issues + custom-rules + ignore-policies + SBOMs + audit-logs via Snyk-API v3.
  2. Plan 60-day shadow window with dual-scan + dual-issue-emit + dual-SBOM generation.
  3. Export tenant/group/org hierarchy with subscription-plans + region + federal-boundary tag.
  4. Export Integrations (SCM + Registry + Cloud) including encrypted credentials inventory (credentials NOT exported — re-grant required).
  5. Export Targets + Projects + Project settings + last-known issue counts.
  6. Export Issues (open + ignored + resolved) with reachability + exploit-maturity + CVE/CWE.
  7. Export Snyk-Intel vulnerability database (subscription-permitted scope) for cold-start of Oyatie vuln-curation.
  8. Export License Policies + Custom Rules + Snyk-Code AST-match patterns.
  9. Export Auto-Fix-PR history + Ignore-Policies + AppRisk-Assets + Container Base-Image-Recommendations.
  10. Export Audit-Logs for 7-year retention.
  11. Re-establish Integrations (SCM + Registry + Cloud) onto Oyatie developer-security with re-grant OAuth/PAT.
  12. Re-deploy Snyk-Broker as Oyatie Broker tunnel for self-hosted SCM customers.
  13. Migrate Targets + Projects with type-preservation (npm / maven / etc.); re-trigger first-scan baseline.
  14. Translate Custom-Rules + Snyk-Code AST patterns → Oyatie policy framework.
  15. Translate License-Policies → Oyatie policy µservice.
  16. Re-train Reachability + DeepCode-AI + AppRisk models on Oyatie intelligence with model-card publication per ADR-0255.
  17. Re-establish Auto-Fix-PR pipeline (with downstream SCM webhook re-bind).
  18. Re-establish IDE plugin distribution + CLI binary on Oyatie developer-tools.
  19. Re-establish SBOM generation (CycloneDX + SPDX) on Oyatie compliance.
  20. Re-establish FedRAMP-Moderate boundary (if tenant requires) via Oyatie federal-pack.
  21. Parallel run: 60-day shadow with per-project dual-scan + issue-parity ≥ 99% (SCA) + ≥ 95% (SAST — semantic differences acceptable).
  22. Cut-over per org with SCM-webhook flip + IDE/CLI update push.
  23. Decommission Snyk per-org after 60-day shadow; revoke SCM/Registry tokens from Snyk; Snyk sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **12-20 specific failure modes**:
  - **DeepCode-AI model proprietary** (Snyk Code SAST powered by DeepCode-AI hybrid Symbolic+LLM; not exportable): Oyatie intelligence retrain SAST engine + dual-scan with diff verification + threshold-recalibration.
  - **Reachability call-path semantic difference** (Snyk's reachability uses symbol-graph; Oyatie may use different graph): per-project reachability dual-compute + threshold-recalibration.
  - **Snyk-Intel vuln-curation depth** (Snyk-Research adds notes + patches + research-context beyond CVE; Oyatie vuln-intel must match or accept lossy): per-vuln curation effort + manual research workflow.
  - **Custom-Rules Snyk-Code AST-pattern non-portable** (Snyk Code uses custom AST query DSL; Oyatie may use different DSL): per-rule translator + manual-rewrite tracker.
  - **License-Policy SPDX-rule semantic** (Snyk policy maps SPDX → severity; Oyatie policy may use license-class hierarchy): per-policy translator + verification.
  - **Container base-image recommendation engine proprietary**: Oyatie intelligence retrain base-image-advisor + dual-run with diff verification.
  - **Auto-Fix-PR generator engine proprietary** (Snyk-Fix generates upgrade or patch PRs; Oyatie automation must match PR-quality): per-PR golden-test + manual-review tracker during shadow.
  - **Broker tunnel re-deployment** (self-hosted SCM customers must redeploy broker; downtime risk): coordinated broker-replacement + dual-tunnel overlap.
  - **Ignore-Policy semantic** (Snyk ignore-policies have expires-at + approver + reason; Oyatie policy must preserve): per-ignore translator + verification.
  - **AppRisk asset-discovery integration scope** (Snyk AppRisk integrates 30+ sources; Oyatie must match for parity): per-source migration prioritization.
  - **Federal-boundary preservation** (Snyk Federal is FedRAMP-Moderate; Oyatie boundary must include Snyk-replacement µservices): pre-migration FedRAMP boundary-amendment + 3PAO assessment.
  - **SBOM-format-rendering drift** (Snyk emits CycloneDX 1.5 + SPDX 2.3; consumers may expect specific schema): per-consumer SBOM-schema verification + format-version preservation.
  - **Webhook signature change** (HMAC-signed payloads break consumer verification): per-consumer signature-key rotation + dual-signing overlap.
  - **Integration credential rotation race** (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Docker-Hub tokens need refresh): coordinated rotation + grace-window.
  - **IDE plugin re-install per-developer** (developers use Snyk IDE plugins; Oyatie equivalent must install): per-IDE plugin development + migration-runbook + manual user-side install.
  - **CLI binary path break** (`snyk` CLI invoked from CI scripts; Oyatie CLI binary differs): per-CI workflow translator + `snyk` → Oyatie alias script for grace-period.
  - **Service-account token rotation** (CI/CD service-accounts hold long-lived Snyk tokens): coordinated rotation + dual-validity.
  - **EU-residency for vuln-data export** (EU-tenant data must stay in eu.snyk.io): per-region exporter + per-region importer + audit trail.
  - **Audit-log 100+ event-type taxonomy translation**: per-event translator + dual-emit during shadow.
  - **AppRisk EU-AI-Act bias-audit gap** (Snyk AppRisk risk-scoring is opaque): pre-migration model-card + bias-audit per ADR-0255 §D-4 before enforcement re-enable.

- **Migration playbook outline (Snyk → Oyatie developer-security + intelligence + automation + apigw + developer-tools + policy + compliance + data-store + cloud-security µservices)**:
  1. Inventory tenants + groups + orgs + members + integrations + targets + projects + issues + custom-rules + ignore-policies + SBOMs + audit-logs via Snyk-API v3.
  2. Plan 60-day shadow window with dual-scan + dual-issue-emit + dual-SBOM generation + broker-tunnel overlap.
  3. Re-establish Integrations (SCM + Registry + Cloud) on Oyatie developer-security with re-grant.
  4. Re-deploy Snyk-Broker as Oyatie Broker tunnel for self-hosted SCM tenants.
  5. Migrate Custom-Rules + License-Policies onto Oyatie policy framework.
  6. Re-train Reachability + DeepCode-AI SAST + AppRisk + Base-Image-Advisor models on Oyatie intelligence with model-card publication.
  7. Re-establish Auto-Fix-PR pipeline + Ignore-Policy workflow on Oyatie automation.
  8. Re-establish IDE plugins (30+) + CLI binary on Oyatie developer-tools.
  9. Re-establish SBOM (CycloneDX + SPDX) generation + FedRAMP boundary on Oyatie compliance.
  10. Decommission Snyk per-org after 60-day shadow; revoke SCM/Registry tokens; Snyk sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `developer-security` + `intelligence` + `automation` + `apigw` + `developer-tools` + `policy` + `compliance` + `data-store` + `cloud-security` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `snyk` + `snyk-open-source` + `snyk-code` + `snyk-container` + `snyk-iac` + `snyk-apprisk` + `snyk-cloud` + `snyk-deepcode-ai` + `snyk-reachability` + `snyk-broker` + `snyk-intel` + `snyk-cli` + `snyk-fix` + `snyk-federal` are benchmark alias-only. The `developer-security` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Snyk-equivalent DevSecOps surface, distinct from `cloud-security` (Wiz D-131) by developer-first SCA+SAST+Container+IaC depth.

- Vendor name and category: GitGuardian SAS — Secrets Detection + Code Security: GitGuardian Public Monitoring (open-source GitHub secret leak detection) + GitGuardian Internal Monitoring (private SCM secret leak detection) + GitGuardian Honeytoken (canary-token decoys) + GitGuardian ggshield (CLI / pre-commit / pre-receive / CI scanning) + GitGuardian Secrets Manager / NHI Governance (Non-Human-Identity governance) + GitGuardian SCA + GitGuardian IaC Security + GitGuardian Code Security Platform (CSP) + GitGuardian Workspace + Sources + Incidents + Detectors (450+ secret types — AWS-Access-Key / GCP-Service-Account / Stripe / SendGrid / Slack-Token / PagerDuty / Twilio / GitHub-PAT / Postgres-URI / JWT-Generic / Private-Key-PEM / etc.) + Severity-Scoring + Validity-Check (live API-credential test) + Pre-Receive-Hook (Atlassian / GitLab / Bitbucket / Azure-Repos) + Auto-Revoke + Auto-Healing-Playbooks + ggshield Honeytoken + GitGuardian-API + GitGuardian Web UI + Audit-Log + Slack + Jira + ServiceNow + Splunk + Datadog integrations.
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `developer-security` (canonical secrets-detection — GitGuardian differs from Snyk D-132 by secrets-detection-first depth + honeytoken-decoys + NHI-governance + 450+ detectors + post-detection auto-revoke + pre-receive-hook for shift-left) + `intelligence` (detector ML + validity-check + severity-scoring) + `automation` (auto-revoke + auto-healing-playbooks + webhook-actions) + `apigw` (GitGuardian-API REST) + `developer-tools` (ggshield CLI + IDE-plugin + pre-commit + CI integrations) + `policy` (custom-detector + ignore-rules + secret-classification policies) + `compliance` (SOC-2 Type II + ISO-27001 + GDPR + EU-Residency) + `iam` (NHI Governance — non-human-identity lifecycle)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free (developer) → **Bronze**; Business → **Gold**; Enterprise (with Honeytoken + NHI + private-deploy + SCA + IaC + Pre-Receive + Auto-Revoke + 99.9%-SLA) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `developer-security` (Secrets-Detection + SCA + IaC anchor); `intelligence` (Detector ML + Validity-Check); `automation` (Auto-Revoke + Playbooks); `apigw` (REST API); `developer-tools` (ggshield CLI + IDE + pre-commit); `policy` (Custom-Detectors + Ignore-Rules); `compliance` (SOC-2 + EU-Residency); `iam` (NHI Governance).
