  - `Box_Notes_Doc` (Notes_ID, Parent-Folder-Ref, Content {Markdown + Blocks[]}, Mentions[], Annotations[], Sharing).
  - `Box_Skill_Card` (SkillCard_ID, File-Ref, Skill-Ref, Type {keyword / status / transcript / timeline / topic}, Entries[]).
  - `Box_AI_Action_Log` (AI_Action_ID, Enterprise-Ref, Type {qa / hubs / notes / sign / studio}, Prompt, Response, Citations[File-Refs + Folder-Refs], Approved-By-Ref).
  - `Classification` (Classification_ID, Enterprise-Ref, Name {Public / Internal / Confidential / Highly-Confidential / etc.}, Color, Definitions, Action-Policy-Refs[]).
  - `Shield_Access_Policy` (Policy_ID, Enterprise-Ref, Type {classification_based / file_based / app_based / geo_based}, Rule, Action {restrict_share_link / restrict_download / restrict_collaborator_invitation / etc.}).
  - `Shield_Smart_Access_Policy` (SmartPolicy_ID, ML-Rule, Threshold, Action).
  - `Governance_Retention_Policy` (Retention_ID, Enterprise-Ref, Policy-Type {finite / indefinite}, Retention-Length, Disposition-Action {permanently_delete / remove_retention}, Folders-Applied[], Metadata-Applied[]).
  - `Legal_Hold_Policy` (LegalHold_ID, Enterprise-Ref, Description, Status, Custodians[], Files[], Folders[]).
  - `Webhook_v2` (Webhook_ID, Target {Item-Ref}, Address-URL, Triggers[FILE.UPLOADED / FILE.DOWNLOADED / FILE.SHARED / FILE.UNSHARED / FILE.LOCKED / etc.]).
  - `Audit_Event` (Event_ID, Type, Source, Created-By-Ref, Created-At, Event-Type, Session-ID, Action-By-Ref).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: `https://api.box.com/2.0/` resource shapes `users` + `folders` + `files` + `file_versions` + `collaborations` + `comments` + `tasks` + `web_links` + `shared_items` + `metadata_templates` + `metadata_cascade_policies` + `sign_requests` + `workflows` (Relay) + `hubs` + `canvas_boards` + `notes` + `skills` + `classifications` + `shield_information_barrier_segments` + `retention_policies` + `legal_hold_policies` + `webhooks` + `events`; Upload via `https://upload.box.com/api/2.0/files/content` (chunked-upload for ≥50MB).
  - Auth: OAuth-2.0 + JWT-Auth (Server-Auth with public-key + private-key + JWT-assertion) + Client-Credentials (CCG); App-Users for headless service-accounts.
  - Webhooks v2: HMAC-SHA256 signature; pre-defined + custom triggers.
  - SDKs: official Node (`box-node-sdk`) + Python (`boxsdk`) + Java (`box-java-sdk`) + .NET + iOS + Android; UI Elements (drop-in widgets); Skills Framework for AI-skills.
  - CLI: `box-cli`.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Box Drive" — desktop mounted file-system (Mac + Windows).
  - "Box for Web" — folder/file browser with preview + collab.
  - "Box Notes" — Notion-like collaborative doc.
  - "Box Canvas" — Miro-like whiteboard with file-embed.
  - "Box Sign" — e-signature with multi-signer + ordering + verification.
  - "Box Relay" — workflow builder over folder events.
  - "Box Hubs" — curated content portal with sections.
  - "Box AI Sidebar" — Q&A over files + folders with citations.
  - "Shield Admin Console" — classification + access-policy + smart-policy + threat-detection.
  - "Governance Admin Console" — retention + legal-hold + smart classification.
  - "KeySafe" — BYOK key-management.
  - "Box Capture" — mobile scan-to-Box.
  - "UI Elements Embed" — drop-in preview / explorer / picker / uploader / sidebar widgets.
  - "Skills Framework Console" — register + invoke custom AI skills.
  - "Zones Map" — per-tenant data-residency dashboard.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<box-user-id>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxFileUpload", Oyatie::Action::"BoxFileDownload",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxFileDelete", Oyatie::Action::"BoxFileLock",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxFileMove", Oyatie::Action::"BoxFileVersionRestore",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxFolderCreate", Oyatie::Action::"BoxFolderDelete",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxCollaborationInvite", Oyatie::Action::"BoxSharedLinkCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxSharedLinkPasswordSet", Oyatie::Action::"BoxCommentPost",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxTaskAssign", Oyatie::Action::"BoxMetadataInstanceWrite",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxMetadataTemplateEdit", Oyatie::Action::"BoxMetadataCascadeApply",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxSignRequestSend", Oyatie::Action::"BoxRelayWorkflowEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxHubPublish", Oyatie::Action::"BoxCanvasEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxNotesEdit", Oyatie::Action::"BoxAIInvoke",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxClassificationApply", Oyatie::Action::"BoxShieldPolicyEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxGovernanceRetentionApply", Oyatie::Action::"BoxLegalHoldPlace",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxKeySafeKeyRotate", Oyatie::Action::"BoxZoneMigrate",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxSkillRegister", Oyatie::Action::"BoxWebhookManage",
      Oyatie::Action::"BoxAuditEventExport", Oyatie::Action::"BoxFedRAMPTokenIssue"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxEnterprise::"<ent-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxFolder::"<fld-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxFile::"<file-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxCollaboration::"<col-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxSharedLink::"<sl-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxMetadataTemplate::"<mt-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxSignRequest::"<sign-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxRelayWorkflow::"<rl-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxHub::"<hub-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxCanvas::"<cv-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxNotes::"<nt-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxClassification::"<cls-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxShieldPolicy::"<sh-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxRetentionPolicy::"<ret-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxLegalHold::"<lh-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxKeySafeKey::"<ks-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxZone::"<zn-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxSkill::"<sk-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxWebhook::"<hook-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::BoxAuditEventStream::"<stream-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "file_download_classification_confidential" || (principal.role in ["data_governance_admin", "file_owner"] && context.classification_download_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "file_delete_under_legal_hold" || principal.role == "legal_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "collaboration_invite_external" || (principal.role in ["file_owner", "folder_owner"] && context.external_collab_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "shared_link_create_open" || (principal.role in ["file_owner", "folder_owner"] && context.public_link_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "metadata_template_edit_enterprise" || principal.role == "metadata_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "metadata_cascade_apply" || principal.role in ["metadata_admin", "folder_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "sign_request_send_pii_doc" || (principal.role == "sign_admin" && context.pii_send_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "relay_workflow_edit_destructive" || (principal.role == "relay_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "classification_apply" || principal.role in ["data_governance_admin", "file_owner"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "shield_policy_edit" || principal.role == "shield_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "governance_retention_apply" || principal.role in ["governance_admin", "compliance_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "legal_hold_place" || principal.role in ["legal_admin", "ediscovery_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "keysafe_key_rotate" || (principal.role == "security_admin" && context.key_rotation_window_open == true && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "zone_migrate" || (principal.role == "data_residency_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "box_ai_invoke" || (context.tenant_ai_optin == true && context.enterprise_ai_optin == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "box_ai_invoke_classified_file" || context.classified_ai_approved == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_event_export" || principal.role in ["compliance_admin", "enterprise_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "fedramp_token_issue" || (principal.role == "fedramp_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true))
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: SOC-1 / 2 / 3; ISO-27001 / 27017 / 27018 / 27701; GDPR + KR-PIPA + EU-DPF (Zones EU / Germany residency); HIPAA-BAA + GxP (Box for Healthcare + Life Sciences); PCI-DSS; FedRAMP-Moderate + High + DOD-IL5 (Box for Government via dedicated GovCloud); ITAR + CJIS (Box for Defense + Law-Enforcement); EU-AI-Act (Box AI conformance ledger).

- **Ontology projection**:
  - `box.enterprise` → `oya-data-store-tenant-enterprise`.
  - `box.user` → `oya-iam-user` (type {managed / external / app} preserved).
  - `box.folder` + `box.file` + `box.file_version` → `oya-data-store-folder` + `-file` + `-file-version`.
  - `box.collaboration` → `oya-data-store-collaboration` (role taxonomy preserved).
  - `box.comment` + `box.task` + `box.web_link` + `box.bookmark` → `oya-collaboration-comment` + `oya-workflow-engine-task` + `oya-data-store-web-link` + `-bookmark`.
  - `box.shared_link` → `oya-data-store-shared-link`.
  - `box.metadata_template` + `box.metadata_instance` + `box.metadata_cascade_policy` → `oya-data-store-metadata-template` + `-instance` + `-cascade`.
  - `box.box_sign_request` → `oya-e-signature-request`.
  - `box.relay_workflow` → `oya-automation-workflow`.
  - `box.hub` → `oya-data-store-hub`.
  - `box.box_canvas_board` + `box.box_notes_doc` → `oya-collaboration-whiteboard` + `-doc`.
  - `box.box_skill_card` → `oya-intelligence-data-store-skill-card`.
  - `box.box_ai_action_log` → `oya-intelligence-data-store-ai-action`.
  - `box.classification` + `box.shield_*` → `oya-policy-classification` + `oya-policy-shield-*`.
  - `box.governance_retention_policy` + `box.legal_hold_policy` → `oya-compliance-retention-policy` + `-legal-hold`.
  - `box.webhook_v2` → `oya-apigw-webhook`.
  - `box.audit_event` → `oya-compliance-audit-log-event`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (15 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `data-store` + `intelligence` + `automation` + `apigw` + `compliance` + `policy` + `developer-sdk` µservices with Box-feature-parity (Folders + Files + Sign + Relay + Hubs + Canvas + Notes + AI + Shield + Governance + KeySafe + Zones + Skills + UI-Elements).
  2. Export Box Enterprise via REST + events stream: users + folders + files + file-versions + collaborations + comments + tasks + web-links + shared-links + metadata-templates + metadata-instances + cascade-policies + sign-requests + relay-workflows + hubs + canvas + notes + skill-cards + AI-action-log + classifications + shield + retention + legal-hold + webhooks + audit-events.
  3. Plan per-folder migration cohorts (org-roots + departmental + per-classification).
  4. Per-User: re-create with type + role + status + space-amount preserved.
  5. Per-Folder + File + File-Version: re-create with SHA-1 hash verify + path-collection preserve + classification + metadata + tags; chunked-upload for ≥50MB.
  6. Per-Collaboration: re-create with role + accessible-by + status + expiry preserved.
  7. Per-Shared-Link: re-issue URL + password + expiry; 301 redirect alias.
  8. Per-Metadata-Template + Instance + Cascade-Policy: re-create with field-types + cascade rules.
  9. Per-Box-Sign-Request: archive signed; in-flight re-send via Oyatie e-signature.
  10. Per-Box-Relay-Workflow: transpile to Oyatie automation-DSL; shadow-eval on last-30d folder events.
  11. Per-Hub + Canvas + Notes + Skill-Card: re-create with object-graph + permissions.
  12. Per-Classification + Shield-Policy + Smart-Access-Policy: transpile to Oyatie policy µservice.
  13. Per-Retention + Legal-Hold: re-apply with disposition-action + custodian preserved; legal-hold must remain unbroken during cutover.
  14. Per-KeySafe-Key: import BYOK to Oyatie KMS; rotation schedule preserved.
  15. Decommission Box per-enterprise after 90-day shadow; Box-for-Government requires separate FedRAMP-High + DOD-IL5 ATO; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (16 specific failures):
  - SHA-1 vs SHA-256 hash drift (Box uses SHA-1 for file-integrity): per-file dual-hash verify during cutover.
  - Chunked-upload ≥50MB pre-signed-URL workflow drift: per-large-file chunked-upload re-implement.
  - Shared-Link URL format drift (Box `app.box.com/s/<hash>`): per-link 301-redirect alias + backlog SEO preserve.
  - Collaboration-role taxonomy (8 levels: editor / viewer / previewer / uploader / previewer_uploader / viewer_uploader / co-owner / owner): per-collab role-mapping preserve.
  - Metadata-template field-type drift (string / float / date / enum / multiSelect): per-template type-mapping preserve.
  - Metadata-cascade policy semantics (apply-down vs apply-only-new): per-cascade direction preserve.
  - Box-Notes block-content schema (Markdown + custom blocks): per-doc transpile.
  - Box-Canvas object-graph (sticky / shape / text / connector / image / embed-item): per-canvas object-graph transpile.
  - Box-Sign multi-signer ordering + verification-method drift: per-request signer-chain preserve.
  - Box-Relay step-type taxonomy (assign_task / move_file / lock_file / start_sign / metadata_set / etc.): per-step transpile + shadow-eval.
  - Skills Framework custom-skill-card schema (keyword / status / transcript / timeline / topic): per-skill card-type preserve.
  - Shield classification-action policy chain (per-classification download/share/share-link restrictions): per-classification rule-chain transpile.
  - Governance retention disposition-action (permanently_delete vs remove_retention): per-policy action preserve.
  - Legal-hold custodian continuity during cutover (hold must remain unbroken): per-LH dual-track preserve + ledger.
  - KeySafe BYOK rotation cadence + AWS-KMS keystore re-bind: per-tenant KMS provider rotation preserve.
  - Zones residency (US / EU / Canada / Germany / Japan / Australia / Singapore): per-tenant zone preserve + data-locality enforcement.
  - Webhook v2 trigger taxonomy (FILE.UPLOADED / FILE.DOWNLOADED / FILE.SHARED / etc.): per-webhook trigger map maintained.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Box REST + events stream + audit-events.
  2. Plan 90-day shadow window (legal-hold continuity is critical).
  3. Migrate users + folders + files + file-versions (chunked-upload ≥50MB) with SHA-1 verify.
  4. Migrate collaborations + shared-links + metadata + cascade-policies + tasks + comments.
  5. Migrate Sign + Relay + Hubs + Canvas + Notes + Skills + AI-action-log.
  6. Migrate Shield (classifications + access-policies + smart-policies) + Governance (retention + legal-hold).
  7. Migrate KeySafe BYOK keys; AWS-KMS keystore re-bind.
  8. Migrate Zones residency (per-tenant Zone preserve).
  9. Re-establish SOC-1/2/3 / ISO / GDPR / HIPAA / PCI / FedRAMP-High / DOD-IL5 / ITAR / CJIS / GxP / EU-AI-Act attestations.
  10. Decommission Box per-enterprise after 90-day shadow; Box-for-Government separate ATO; Box sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `data-store` + `intelligence` + `automation` + `apigw` + `compliance` + `policy` + `developer-sdk` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `box` + `box-content-cloud` + `box-drive` + `box-notes` + `box-canvas` + `box-sign` + `box-relay` + `box-hubs` + `box-ai` + `box-shield` + `box-governance` + `box-keysafe` + `box-zones` + `box-skills` + `box-ui-elements` + `box-for-government` + `box-for-healthcare` are benchmark alias-only. The `data-store` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Box-equivalent enterprise-content-management surface.

### Section D-118 - Egnyte
- Vendor name and category: Egnyte Inc. — Egnyte Platform (Smart Content Platform): Egnyte Cloud (cloud file-share + collaboration) + Egnyte (hybrid storage — cloud + on-prem) + Egnyte Protect (DLP + ransomware detection + data classification + sensitive content discovery + supervised access) + Egnyte Migrate (large-scale migration tool) + Egnyte Storage Sync (CIFS/NFS on-prem appliance) + Egnyte Mobile + Egnyte Desktop App + Smart Cache (selective sync) + Egnyte for Construction (AEC industry vertical with Procore + Autodesk + AutoCAD + Revit integrations) + Egnyte for Life Sciences (GxP + 21 CFR Part 11) + Egnyte for Financial Services + Egnyte AI (Copilot + Knowledge AI + Document AI + Smart Search) + Document Room (data-room — VDR) + e-Sign + Workflows + Tasks + Comments + Webform + Public Link + Power Link (long-lived link) + Smart Folders (auto-classification) + ACLs (group + user + folder + file) + Audit Reports + Compliance Reports + Egnyte Government (FedRAMP-Moderate).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `data-store` (hybrid file-share leader — Egnyte differentiated by hybrid cloud + on-prem CIFS/NFS appliance + industry-vertical packs + Protect DLP + Smart Cache) + `intelligence` (Egnyte AI Copilot + Knowledge + Document + Smart Search) + `policy` (Protect — DLP + Smart Classification + Ransomware Detection + Supervised Access) + `automation` (Workflows + Tasks + Webform) + `apigw` (Egnyte Public API v1/v2 + Webhooks + WebDAV + FTP) + `compliance` (SOC-2 Type II + ISO-27001 + GDPR + HIPAA-BAA + 21 CFR Part 11 + GxP + FINRA + SEC-17a-4 + FedRAMP-Moderate + EU-AI-Act for Egnyte-AI) + `developer-sdk` (REST API + WebDAV + FTP + Drive-SDK) + `marketplace` (Egnyte App Gallery)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Business / Enterprise → **Silver**; Enterprise Lite / Standard → **Gold**; Enterprise Premium + Egnyte-Government + industry verticals (HIPAA-BAA / GxP / 21 CFR Part 11 / FINRA + FedRAMP + dedicated tenant + Storage Sync appliances + 99.9%-SLA) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `data-store` (cloud + hybrid file-share anchor); `intelligence` (Egnyte AI); `policy` (Protect — DLP + Smart Classification + Ransomware + Supervised Access); `automation` (Workflows + Tasks + Webform); `apigw` (REST + WebDAV + FTP + Webhooks); `compliance` (SOC-2 + ISO + GDPR + HIPAA + 21 CFR + GxP + FINRA + FedRAMP + EU-AI-Act); `developer-sdk` (REST + Drive-SDK); `marketplace` (App Gallery).

  - `User` (User_ID, Domain-Ref, Username, Email, Name, Status {active / disabled}, Type {standard / power / admin}, Roles[], Auth-Type {egnyte / sso / ad}, Idp-User-ID, Groups[], User-Type-Pack).
  - `Group` (Group_ID, Domain-Ref, Name, Members[]).
  - `Folder` (Folder_ID, Path, Parent-Folder-Ref, Created, Last-Modified, Folder-Description, Allowed-File-Link-Types[], Allowed-Folder-Link-Types[], Allow-Links {true / false}, Inherits-Permissions, Allow-Folder-Subscription, Allow-Folder-Add, Allow-Public-Folder-View, Allow-WebDAV-Access, Sub-Folders[], Files[], Permissions[Permission + Subject {user / group} + Subject-Ref], Restrict-Move-Delete).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST v1/v2: `https://<domain>.egnyte.com/pubapi/v1/` resource shapes `fs/<path>` (folder + file operations) + `users` + `groups` + `links` + `workflows` + `tasks` + `permissions/<path>` + `audit/<type>` + `event-cursor` + `webhooks` + `protect` + `document-rooms` + `webforms` + `smart-folders` + `classifications` + `ai`.
  - Auth: OAuth-2.0 (Client-Credentials + Code + Implicit) + API-Token-per-User; Egnyte-SSO + SAML; AD-Sync for hybrid.
  - WebDAV: standard WebDAV protocol exposed at `https://<domain>.egnyte.com/webdav/`.

  - CLI: `egnyte-cli`.

  ```

      Oyatie::Action::"EgnytePowerLinkCreate", Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteWebformPublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteWorkflowEdit", Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteTaskAssign",
      Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteDocumentRoomPublish", Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteeSignRequest",
      Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteSmartFolderEdit", Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteClassificationApply",
      Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteProtectPolicyEdit", Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteProtectIncidentResolve",
      Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteStorageSyncBind", Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteAIInvoke",
      Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteWebhookManage", Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteAuditReportGenerate",
      Oyatie::Action::"EgnyteFedRAMPTokenIssue"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteDomain::"<dom-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteFolder::"<path>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteFile::"<file-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteLink::"<lnk-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteWorkflow::"<wf-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteDocumentRoom::"<dr-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteWebform::"<form-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteSmartFolder::"<sf-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteClassification::"<cls-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteProtectPolicy::"<pp-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteStorageSyncAppliance::"<app-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteWebhook::"<hook-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteAuditReportStream::"<stream-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::EgnyteFedRAMPToken::"<gov-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "file_download_phi_folder" || (principal.role in ["data_governance_admin", "file_owner"] && context.phi_download_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "permission_set_root_folder" || principal.role == "domain_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "link_create_public" || (principal.role in ["folder_owner", "file_owner"] && context.public_link_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "power_link_create" || (principal.role in ["folder_owner", "domain_admin"] && context.long_lived_link_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "document_room_publish_external" || (principal.role == "vdr_admin" && context.nda_collected == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "esign_request_compliance_doc" || (principal.role == "sign_admin" && context.compliance_doc_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "smart_folder_edit_global" || principal.role == "domain_admin") &&
    (resource.kind != "protect_policy_edit_destructive" || (principal.role == "protect_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "protect_incident_resolve_ransomware" || (principal.role == "soc_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "storage_sync_bind_appliance" || (principal.role == "infrastructure_admin" && context.appliance_attestation_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "egnyte_ai_invoke" || (context.tenant_ai_optin == true && context.domain_ai_optin == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "egnyte_ai_invoke_gxp_folder" || context.gxp_ai_approved == true) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_report_generate_pii" || (principal.role == "compliance_admin" && context.pii_audit_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "fedramp_token_issue" || (principal.role == "fedramp_admin" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true))
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: SOC-2 Type II; ISO-27001 / 27017 / 27018; GDPR + KR-PIPA + EU-DPF (EU-residency); HIPAA-BAA; 21 CFR Part 11 + GxP (Life-Sciences vertical); FINRA + SEC-17a-4 (Financial Services vertical — WORM compliance); FedRAMP-Moderate (Egnyte-Government); EU-AI-Act (Egnyte AI Copilot + Knowledge + Document + Smart-Search conformance ledger).

- **Ontology projection**:
  - `egnyte.domain` → `oya-data-store-domain`.

  - `egnyte.link` + `egnyte.power_link` → `oya-data-store-shared-link` + `-power-link`.
  - `egnyte.workflow` + `egnyte.task` → `oya-automation-workflow` + `oya-workflow-engine-task`.
  - `egnyte.webform` → `oya-workflow-engine-intake-form`.
  - `egnyte.document_room` → `oya-data-store-document-room`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (15 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `data-store` + `intelligence` + `policy` + `automation` + `apigw` + `compliance` + `developer-sdk` + `marketplace` µservices with Egnyte-feature-parity (cloud + hybrid + Storage-Sync + Protect + Workflows + Document-Room + Webform + Smart-Folders + Egnyte-AI + industry verticals + FedRAMP).
  2. Export Egnyte Domain via REST + event-cursor: users + groups + folders + files + file-versions + permissions + links + power-links + workflows + tasks + webforms + document-rooms + smart-folders + classifications + protect-policies + storage-sync-appliances + AI-action-log + webhooks + audit-reports.
  3. Plan per-folder migration cohorts (root-folders + industry-vertical packs).
  4. Per-User + Group: re-create with auth-type + idp-user-id + role + group-membership preserved.
  5. Per-Folder + File + File-Version: re-create with checksum verify + path + size + lock-state preserved; chunked-upload for large files.
  6. Per-Permission: re-bind (folder + file ACLs) with inherits-permissions flag preserved.
  7. Per-Link + Power-Link: re-issue with accessibility + password + recipients + expiry; 301-redirect alias.
  8. Per-Workflow + Task: transpile to Oyatie automation-DSL; shadow-eval on last-30d.
  9. Per-Webform + Document-Room + eSign-Request: re-create with NDA + watermark + audit preserved.
  10. Per-Smart-Folder + Classification: re-create with detection-rules transpiled.
  11. Per-Protect-Policy + Incident: transpile to Oyatie policy µservice; per-incident state preserved.
  12. Per-Storage-Sync-Appliance: re-bind via Oyatie hybrid-appliance protocol; per-appliance local-path + capacity preserved.
  13. Per-Industry-Vertical-Pack (Construction / Life-Sciences / Financial-Services): re-apply pack-specific schemas + integrations (Procore + Autodesk + Revit + AutoCAD for Construction; 21 CFR Part 11 evidence chain for Life-Sciences; FINRA WORM for Financial).
  14. Per-Webhook + Audit-Report + AI-Action-Log: re-register + import as conformance ledger.
  15. Decommission Egnyte per-domain after 90-day shadow; Egnyte-Government separate FedRAMP-Moderate ATO; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (15 specific failures):
  - Path-based addressing drift (Egnyte uses `/Shared/...` and `/Private/...` path semantics): per-path canonical-mapping + alias.
  - File checksum format drift (MD5 vs SHA-256): per-file dual-hash verify during cutover.
  - Permission inheritance chain (inherits-permissions flag + override): per-folder permission-tree preserve + recompute.
  - Link accessibility-level (anyone / password / domain / recipients) + send-email + notify: per-link config preserve.
  - Power-Link long-lived semantics (multi-year link with audit): per-power-link audit-chain preserve.
  - Workflow step-type taxonomy (approval / review / task / signature): per-step transpile.
  - Document-Room VDR features (watermark + NDA + audit + expiry): per-VDR feature-set preserve.
  - Smart-Folder auto-classification rule DSL (regex + ML-model): per-smart-folder rule transpile.
  - Protect-policy action taxonomy (alert / block / quarantine / require_approval): per-policy action preserve.
  - Ransomware-detection ML-baseline drift (Egnyte's anomaly model): per-domain baseline recompute + shadow.
  - Storage-Sync appliance hybrid protocol drift (Egnyte appliance ↔ cloud sync protocol is proprietary): per-appliance Oyatie hybrid-shim.
  - 21 CFR Part 11 audit-chain continuity (Life-Sciences): per-folder audit-chain preserve + e-signature-proof.
  - FINRA + SEC-17a-4 WORM compliance (Financial Services): per-WORM-folder write-once enforce.
  - Egnyte-AI Copilot + Knowledge + Document opt-in re-collect: per-domain AI-policy ledger.
  - Webhook trigger taxonomy (FILE_ADDED / FILE_DELETED / FILE_RENAMED / PERMISSION_CHANGED / LINK_CREATED): per-trigger map maintained.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Egnyte REST + event-cursor + audit-reports.
  2. Plan 90-day shadow window with industry-vertical (Life-Sciences / Financial) compliance continuity.
  3. Migrate users + groups + folders + files + file-versions with checksum verify.
  4. Migrate permissions + links + power-links + webforms + workflows + tasks.
  5. Migrate document-rooms + eSign + smart-folders + classifications.
  6. Migrate Protect (policies + incidents) + Storage-Sync appliances.
  7. Migrate industry-vertical packs (Construction / Life-Sciences / Financial-Services).
  8. Migrate Egnyte-AI action-log as conformance ledger.
  9. Re-establish SOC-2 / ISO / GDPR / HIPAA / 21 CFR / GxP / FINRA / FedRAMP / EU-AI-Act attestations.
  10. Decommission Egnyte per-domain after 90-day shadow; Egnyte sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `data-store` + `intelligence` + `policy` + `automation` + `apigw` + `compliance` + `developer-sdk` + `marketplace` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `egnyte` + `egnyte-cloud` + `egnyte-connect` + `egnyte-protect` + `egnyte-migrate` + `egnyte-storage-sync` + `egnyte-ai` + `egnyte-document-room` + `egnyte-smart-folders` + `egnyte-for-construction` + `egnyte-for-life-sciences` + `egnyte-for-financial-services` + `egnyte-government` + `egnyte-app-gallery` are benchmark alias-only. The `data-store` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Egnyte-equivalent hybrid-content-management surface.

### Section D-119 - Squarespace
- Vendor name and category: Squarespace Inc. — Squarespace 7.1 all-in-one website + commerce + scheduling + email-marketing + domains: Websites (drag-drop Fluid Engine editor + templates + CSS-injection + Developer Platform) + Commerce (products + variants + subscriptions + Member Areas + digital downloads + abandoned-cart + gift-cards + reviews + advanced shipping + Squarespace POS + tax-via-TaxJar + Stripe/Square/PayPal) + Acuity Scheduling (appointments + classes + packages + group classes + intake forms + payments + Zoom/Google-Meet integration) + Squarespace Email Campaigns (newsletters + automated + audiences + segmentation + A/B test) + Domains (registration + DNS + Google-Workspace + email forwarding) + SEO (sitemaps + meta + Open Graph + Schema.org + redirects + URL slugs) + Analytics (traffic + ecommerce + traffic-sources + popular-content) + Member Areas (gated content + member roles + tiered access) + Squarespace AI (AI Site Builder + AI Email Drafting + AI Blueprint Generator) + Mobile Editor + Unfold (story templates — separate acquisition) + Bio Sites (link-in-bio) + Code Block + Forms + Donations + Logo Maker + Fonts (Adobe Fonts + Google Fonts) + Image Library (Getty Images / Unsplash) + Custom Code + Squarespace Marketplace + Developer Platform (Custom Templates via Git + Squarespace CLI).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `web` (canonical website + commerce builder — Squarespace is the design-led leader; differentiated by Fluid Engine + design templates + unified commerce/scheduling/email/domains) + `commerce` (products + subscriptions + Member Areas + POS + tax) + `marketing` (Email Campaigns + audiences + segmentation + AB test) + `scheduling` (Acuity — appointments + classes + packages) + `intelligence` (Squarespace AI Site Builder + Email Drafting + Blueprint) + `apigw` (Squarespace Commerce API + Webhooks + JSON API) + `developer-sdk` (Developer Platform + Custom Templates via Git + Squarespace CLI + Code Blocks) + `compliance` (SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + CCPA + PCI-DSS + EU-AI-Act for AI features)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Personal → **Silver**; Business → **Gold**; Commerce Basic / Commerce Advanced + Acuity Powerhouse + Member Areas Pro (advanced shipping + abandoned-cart + gift-cards + tiered Member Areas + 99.99%-SLA + Premium AI) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `web` (websites + pages + blocks anchor); `commerce` (products + Member Areas + POS); `marketing` (Email Campaigns); `scheduling` (Acuity); `intelligence` (Squarespace AI); `apigw` (Commerce API + Webhooks); `developer-sdk` (Developer Platform); `compliance` (SOC-2 + GDPR + PCI + EU-AI-Act).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Squarespace canonical model):
  - `Site` (Site_ID, Name, Template-Ref, Domain-Primary, Domain-Aliases[], Plan, Status {active / draft / archived}, Site-Language, Time-Zone, SEO-Settings).
  - `Page` (Page_ID, Site-Ref, Title, URL-Slug, Type {standard / blog / events / portfolio / shop / album / index / link / external / member_areas / cover_page}, Layout {classic / fluid_engine}, Visibility {public / hidden / password / members_only / scheduled_publish}, Sections[Section-ID + Block-Refs[] + Style + Background], Navigation-Position, Created, Modified, Author-Ref).
  - `Block` (Block_ID, Page-Ref / Section-Ref, Type {text / image / gallery / video / embed / code / form / button / spacer / line / quote / accordion / chart / instagram / twitter / spotify / amazon / soundcloud / map / opentable / calendar / donation / product / summary / archive / search}, Content, Style, Layout).
  - `Template` (Template_ID, Name, Version, Family, Designer-Type {7.1 / 7.0}, Style-Variants[]).
  - `Product` (Product_ID, Site-Ref, Type {physical / digital / service / gift_card / subscription}, Name, Description, SKU, Price, Sale-Price, On-Sale, Tax-Category, Stock, Visible, URL-Slug, Categories[], Tags[], Variants[Variant-ID + Attributes{Color + Size + etc.} + Price + SKU + Stock], Subscription-Plan-Ref, Images[]).
  - `Order` (Order_ID, Site-Ref, Customer-Ref, Items[], Subtotal, Shipping, Tax, Total, Currency, Status {pending / fulfilled / cancelled / refunded}, Payment-Status, Fulfillment-Status, Shipping-Address, Billing-Address).
  - `Customer` (Customer_ID, Site-Ref, Email, Name, Address[], Member-Of-Areas[], Subscription-Refs[], Created, Lifetime-Value).
  - `Subscription` (Sub_ID, Customer-Ref, Product-Ref, Frequency, Next-Bill, Status {active / cancelled / paused}, Amount).

  - `Acuity_Appointment` (Appt_ID, AcuityType-Ref, Calendar-Ref, Client-Email, Client-Name, Client-Phone, Datetime-Start-End, Status, Forms-Filled[], Payments[]).

  - `Email_Audience` (Audience_ID, Site-Ref, Name, Segments[Segment-Rule], Members-Count).

  - `Form` (Form_ID, Site-Ref, Fields[], Storage {google_drive / mailchimp / email / soundcloud-style-storage}, Submit-Action).
  - `Squarespace_AI_Action_Log` (AI_Action_ID, Site-Ref, Type {site_builder / email_drafting / blueprint / copy_assist}, Prompt, Response, Approved-By-Ref).
  - `Developer_Template` (DevTemplate_ID, Site-Ref, Git-Repo, Branch, Active-Variant).
  - `Webhook` (Webhook_ID, Site-Ref, Endpoint, Topics[order.created / order.fulfilled / product.created / inventory.updated]).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: Commerce API at `https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce/` resource shapes `orders` + `inventory` + `products` + `transactions` + `profiles` + `webhook_subscriptions`; Site API: `https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/`.
  - Auth: OAuth-2.0 (Client-ID + Secret + Redirect + scopes — `website.orders` / `website.products` / `website.inventory` / `website.profiles`) + API-Key for first-party.
  - Webhooks: webhook-subscription with topic + endpoint URL; HMAC-SHA256 signature.
  - JSON API: `?format=json` query for any page returns JSON representation (read-only).
  - Acuity API: separate at `https://acuityscheduling.com/api/v1/`.
  - Developer Platform: Git-based template repo + Squarespace CLI.
  - SDKs: community wrappers in Node + Python.

  2. Export Squarespace site via REST + Acuity API: site + pages + blocks + templates + products + orders + customers + subscriptions + member-areas + discounts + Acuity (types + appointments + calendars + packages) + email-campaigns + audiences + domains + forms + AI-action-log + developer-templates + webhooks.
  3. Plan per-site migration cohorts.
  4. Per-Site: re-create with template + domain + plan + SEO-settings + site-language preserved.
  5. Per-Page + Block: re-create with Fluid Engine layout grid preserved (section + block + style + background); 25+ block-types transpiled.
  6. Per-Template: import via Developer Platform + Git-repo bind.
  7. Per-Product: re-create with variants + subscription-plan + tax-category + URL-slug; 301-redirect alias.
  8. Per-Order + Customer + Subscription: import with fulfillment + payment state preserved.
  9. Per-Member-Area + Pricing-Plan: re-create with members + access-rules + trial-days.
  10. Per-Acuity-Type + Calendar + Package + Appointment: import with intake-forms + payments + Zoom/Meet integration re-bind.
  11. Per-Email-Campaign + Audience + Segment: migrate with send-stats archived; in-flight automated re-schedule.
  12. Per-Domain: transfer-out from Squarespace-registry to Oyatie-registry or DNS-only handoff (Squarespace's registration auto-renew → Oyatie domain µservice).
  13. Per-Squarespace-AI-Action-Log + Developer-Template + Webhook: import as ledger + re-bind Git-repo + re-register webhook.
  14. Decommission Squarespace per-site after 30-day shadow; DNS cutover (Squarespace → Oyatie); Squarespace contract sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (14 specific failures):
  - Fluid Engine grid drift (Squarespace 7.1 uses proprietary grid + section + block model): per-page Fluid Engine → Oyatie web-grid transpile + golden screenshot diff.
  - Template family compatibility (7.0 vs 7.1 templates have different block semantics): per-site template-family preserve + transpile.
  - 25+ block-type taxonomy mapping: per-block type-mapping table + transpile.
  - Product 5 product-type taxonomy (physical / digital / service / gift_card / subscription) + variants schema: per-product type preserve + variant matrix recompute.
  - Subscription billing-interval semantics drift: per-subscription interval + next-bill preserve.
  - Member-Areas pricing-plan recurring-interval + trial-days drift: per-plan config preserve + Stripe/Square billing-pipe re-bind.
  - Acuity intake-form schema drift: per-form field-schema transpile.
  - Acuity Zoom/Meet integration re-bind: per-Acuity-type meeting-integration re-grant.
  - Email-campaign segmentation rule DSL drift: per-segment rule transpile.
  - Email-campaign send-stats archive (opens + clicks + unsubscribes + bounces): per-campaign stats preserve.
  - Domain transfer-lock + auth-code + ICANN-window: per-domain transfer-window + auth-code coordination.
  - Domain-private WHOIS privacy preserve: per-domain privacy-flag preserve.
  - Squarespace-AI Site Builder + Email Drafting + Blueprint opt-in re-collect: per-site AI-policy ledger.
  - Developer Platform Git-repo branch + build-pipeline drift: per-site Git-repo + CI-pipeline re-bind.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Squarespace Commerce API + Acuity API + AI-action-log.
  2. Plan 30-day shadow window with DNS cutover scheduled.
  3. Migrate sites + pages + blocks + templates with Fluid Engine transpile.
  4. Migrate products + orders + customers + subscriptions + Member Areas + discounts.
  5. Migrate Acuity appointments + calendars + packages + types.
  6. Migrate email-campaigns + audiences + segments.
  7. Migrate domains (transfer or DNS-only).
  8. Migrate forms + Squarespace-AI action-log + Developer-Platform templates + webhooks.
  9. Re-establish SOC-2 / GDPR / CCPA / PCI / EU-AI-Act attestations.
  10. Decommission Squarespace per-site after 30-day shadow; DNS cutover; Squarespace sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `web` + `commerce` + `marketing` + `scheduling` + `intelligence` + `apigw` + `developer-sdk` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `squarespace` + `squarespace-7-1` + `fluid-engine` + `squarespace-commerce` + `squarespace-member-areas` + `acuity-scheduling` + `squarespace-email-campaigns` + `squarespace-domains` + `squarespace-ai` + `squarespace-bio-sites` + `squarespace-developer-platform` + `squarespace-marketplace` + `squarespace-unfold` are benchmark alias-only. The `web` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Squarespace-equivalent design-led website + commerce + scheduling surface.

### Section D-120 - Wix Business
- Vendor name and category: Wix.com Ltd. — Wix all-in-one website + business platform: Wix Studio (advanced designer platform) + Wix Editor (drag-drop) + Wix ADI (AI-generated site builder) + Wix Velo (low-code dev platform — Wix's serverless backend + DB collections + Wix-JS API) + Wix Stores (e-commerce — products + Wix Payments + Wix Multilingual + tax + shipping + dropshipping + subscriptions + abandoned-cart + reviews + loyalty + Wix Retail POS) + Wix Bookings (appointments + classes + courses + packages + memberships) + Wix Restaurants (online orders + reservations + menus + table-management + delivery + POS) + Wix Hotels (room bookings + channel manager + housekeeping + payments) + Wix Events (tickets + RSVPs + check-in + livestreams) + Wix Forum (community discussions) + Wix Blog + Wix Groups + Wix Members Area + Wix Forms (form builder) + Wix Email Marketing (newsletters + automated + segmentation) + Wix SMS (transactional + marketing) + Wix Marketing Suite (Wix AI Content + SEO + Google Ads + Facebook + Social Media + Multilingual + Inbox CRM) + Wix Logo Maker + Wix Video + Wix Music + Wix Photography + Wix Domains + Wix Mobile App (Spaces by Wix — branded mobile app) + Wix AI Site Generator (text-to-site) + Wix Chat + Wix Marketplace (designers) + Wix App Market (third-party apps) + Wix Enterprise.
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `web` (broadest no-code website platform — Wix differentiated by Wix Studio for agencies + Wix Velo for devs + 8+ business verticals + AI Site Generator + Wix Mobile App) + `commerce` (Wix Stores + Bookings + Restaurants + Hotels + Events) + `marketing` (Wix Email + SMS + Inbox CRM + Marketing Suite) + `scheduling` (Wix Bookings) + `intelligence` (Wix ADI + AI Site Generator + AI Content) + `apigw` (Wix REST API + GraphQL + Webhooks + Wix Velo serverless) + `developer-sdk` (Wix Velo + Wix-JS + Wix CLI + Custom Elements) + `marketplace` (Wix App Market + Wix Marketplace designers) + `compliance` (SOC-2 + ISO-27001 + GDPR + CCPA + PCI-DSS + EU-AI-Act for AI features)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Light / Core → **Silver**; Business / Business Elite → **Gold**; Wix Enterprise + Wix Studio agency tier (custom-domain + priority-support + dedicated account-manager + 99.9%-SLA + Wix Multilingual + Wix Velo + AI Generator + Wix Mobile App) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `web` (sites + pages + designer + ADI anchor); `commerce` (Stores + Bookings + Restaurants + Hotels + Events); `marketing` (Email + SMS + Inbox); `scheduling` (Bookings); `intelligence` (Wix AI Generator + Content); `apigw` (REST + GraphQL + Webhooks + Velo); `developer-sdk` (Velo + Wix-JS); `marketplace` (App Market); `compliance` (SOC-2 + GDPR + PCI + EU-AI-Act).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Wix canonical model):
  - `Account` (Account_ID, Owner-Email, Plan, Tier, Region, Wix-Studio-Enabled, Wix-Enterprise).
  - `Site` (Site_ID, Account-Ref, Name, Editor-Type {wix_editor / wix_adi / wix_studio}, Templates[], Plan {free / connect / combo / unlimited / business / business_elite / business_vip}, Primary-Domain, Custom-Domain-Connected, Site-Language-Primary, Site-Languages-Secondary[], Status {draft / published / not_published}, SEO-Settings).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST: `https://www.wixapis.com/` resource shapes `sites` + `pages` + `stores/v1/products` + `stores/v2/orders` + `bookings/v2/services` + `bookings/v2/sessions` + `bookings/v2/bookings` + `restaurants` + `hotels/v3/rooms` + `events/v1/events` + `members/v1/members` + `forum/v1/posts` + `blog/v3/posts` + `forms/v4/forms` + `email-marketing/v1/campaigns` + `sms/v2/campaigns` + `inbox/v1/conversations` + `domains/v1/domains` + `app-market` + `webhooks` + `velo/v1`.

- **Cedar permit shape**:
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<wix-user-id>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"WixSiteCreate", Oyatie::Action::"WixSitePublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixSiteDelete", Oyatie::Action::"WixPageEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixComponentEdit", Oyatie::Action::"WixVeloCodeDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixDatabaseCollectionEdit", Oyatie::Action::"WixProductCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixProductPriceEdit", Oyatie::Action::"WixOrderFulfill",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixBookingServiceEdit", Oyatie::Action::"WixBookingSessionPublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixRestaurantMenuEdit", Oyatie::Action::"WixHotelRoomEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixEventPublish", Oyatie::Action::"WixMemberInvite",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixBlogPostPublish", Oyatie::Action::"WixForumModerate",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixFormPublish", Oyatie::Action::"WixEmailCampaignSend",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixSMSCampaignSend", Oyatie::Action::"WixInboxRespond",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixDomainTransfer", Oyatie::Action::"WixAppInstall",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixAIInvoke", Oyatie::Action::"WixSpacesMobileAppPublish",
      Oyatie::Action::"WixWebhookManage", Oyatie::Action::"WixAPIKeyRotate"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::WixAccount::"<acct-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixSite::"<site-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixPage::"<page-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixVeloCode::"<code-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixDatabaseCollection::"<col-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixProduct::"<prod-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixBookingService::"<svc-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixRestaurantMenu::"<menu-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixHotelRoom::"<room-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixEvent::"<ev-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixMember::"<mem-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixBlogPost::"<bp-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixForumPost::"<fp-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixForm::"<form-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixEmailCampaign::"<cmp-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixSMSCampaign::"<sms-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixInboxConversation::"<conv-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixDomain::"<dom-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixAppInstall::"<app-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixSpacesApp::"<sp-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixWebhook::"<hook-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WixAPIKey::"<key-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "site_delete" || (principal.role == "site_owner" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "site_publish_first_time" || principal.role in ["site_owner", "editor"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "velo_code_deploy_prod" || (principal.role in ["developer", "site_owner"] && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "database_collection_edit_schema" || principal.role in ["developer", "data_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "product_price_edit_bulk" || (principal.role in ["store_admin"] && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "order_fulfill_high_value" || (principal.role in ["store_admin"] && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "hotel_room_rate_edit_seasonal" || principal.role in ["hotel_admin", "revenue_manager"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "member_invite_external" || principal.role in ["member_admin", "site_owner"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "email_campaign_send_>50000" || (principal.role == "marketing_admin" && context.send_volume_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "sms_campaign_send_marketing" || (principal.role == "marketing_admin" && context.tcpa_consent_validated == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "domain_transfer_out" || (principal.role == "site_owner" && context.transfer_lock_disabled == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "app_install_high_scope" || (principal.role == "site_owner" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "wix_ai_invoke" || (context.tenant_ai_optin == true && context.site_ai_optin == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "spaces_mobile_app_publish" || (principal.role in ["site_owner"] && context.app_store_credentials_present == true))
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: SOC-2; ISO-27001; GDPR + KR-PIPA + EU-DPF; CCPA + CPRA; PCI-DSS (Wix Payments + Stripe + PayPal + Wix Retail POS); TCPA (SMS Marketing consent); EU-AI-Act (Wix ADI + AI Site Generator + AI Content + Email Draft conformance ledger).

  - Velo Wix-JS API surface drift (proprietary Wix-JS modules `wix-data` / `wix-stores` / `wix-bookings`): per-code-file Wix-JS → Oyatie-JS shim + golden-test.

  - Forum post + comment + reaction + tag schema: per-forum schema transpile.
  - Spaces by Wix branded mobile-app re-publish (App-Store + Play-Store credentials re-bind): per-tenant app-store re-publish workflow.
  - AI Site Generator + ADI + AI Content opt-in re-collect: per-site AI-policy ledger.

### Section D-149 - Fly.io
- Vendor name and category: Fly.io (Fly.io Inc.) — Public cloud for full-stack apps: Fly Machines (per-VM micro-VMs on Firecracker) + Fly Apps + Fly Volumes (NVMe persistent storage) + Fly Postgres (managed Stolon cluster) + Fly Redis (Upstash partner) + Fly LiteFS (distributed SQLite) + Fly Edge (anycast Wireguard + load balancing) + Fly Networking (private 6PN IPv6 mesh) + Fly Proxy (HTTP/TCP/UDP/TLS) + Fly Secrets (KMS-encrypted env) + flyctl CLI + fly.toml + GraphQL + Machines REST API + Multi-Region Deploy (35+ regions) + GPU Machines (A100/L40S/A10) + Tigris Object Storage (partner) + Sentry/Logtail integration + Org + Member RBAC + SSO (SAML for Enterprise).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `compute` (Machines + Firecracker micro-VMs + GPU) + `data` (Volumes + Postgres + Redis + LiteFS) + `apigw` (Fly Proxy + anycast edge) + `network` (6PN private mesh + Wireguard) + `developer-experience` (flyctl + fly.toml) + `compliance` (SOC-2 + HIPAA-eligible) + `identity` (Org + RBAC + SAML)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Hobby / Launch → **Silver**; Scale → **Gold**; Enterprise (SAML + dedicated-hardware + HIPAA-BAA + 99.99%-SLA + dedicated-support) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `compute` (Machines + Firecracker anchor + GPU); `data` (Volumes + Postgres + LiteFS); `apigw` (Proxy + anycast); `network` (6PN + Wireguard); `developer-experience` (flyctl + fly.toml); `identity` (Org + RBAC + SAML); `compliance` (SOC-2 + HIPAA).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Fly.io canonical machine-graph):
  - `Organization` (Org_ID, Name, Billing-Ref, Members[], SSO-Config).
  - `App` (App_ID, Org-Ref, Name, Network-ID {6PN}, Hostname `<app>.fly.dev`).
  - `Machine` (Machine_ID, App-Ref, Region, Image, Config{Guest{cpus + memory_mb + gpu_kind} + Init + Services[Internal-Port + Protocol + Ports[] + Concurrency + Checks[]] + Mounts[] + Env + Restart + Schedule}, State {created / starting / started / stopping / stopped / replacing / destroying / destroyed}).
  - `Volume` (Volume_ID, App-Ref, Region, Size-GB, Block-Size, FS-Type {ext4 / xfs}, Encrypted, Snapshot-Retention).
  - `Postgres_Cluster` (PG_Cluster_ID, App-Ref, Regions[], Plan, HA-Config{Primary-Region + Replica-Regions[]}).
  - `LiteFS_Cluster` (LiteFS_ID, App-Ref, Regions[], Lease-Type).
  - `Secret` (Secret_ID, App-Ref, Name, Encrypted-Value, Updated-At).
  - `IP_Address` (IP_ID, App-Ref, Type {v4 / v4_shared / v6 / private_v6}).
  - `Certificate` (Cert_ID, App-Ref, Hostname, Source {acme / custom}, State).
  - `Service_Spec` (Internal-Port, Protocol {tcp / udp / http / https / tls}, Ports[Port + Handlers[] + TLS-Options], Auto-Stop-Machines, Auto-Start-Machines, Min-Machines-Running, Concurrency{Type + Soft-Limit + Hard-Limit}, Checks[]).
  - `Release` (Release_ID, App-Ref, Version, Image-Ref, Strategy {immediate / rolling / canary / bluegreen}, Status).
  - `Org_Member` (Member_ID, Org-Ref, User-Ref, Role {admin / member / billing_admin}).
  - `Wireguard_Peer` (Peer_ID, Org-Ref, Name, Public-Key, Endpoint, Region).
  - `Webhook` (Webhook_ID, Org-Ref, URL, Events[]).
  - `Audit_Event` (Event_ID, Actor-Ref, Resource-Ref, Action).
  - `GPU_Machine` (GPU_Machine_ID, App-Ref, Region, GPU-Kind {a100-pcie-40gb / a100-pcie-80gb / l40s / a10}).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Machines REST API: `https://api.machines.dev/v1/apps/{app}/machines` shapes machines + volumes + secrets + checks + cordon/uncordon + start/stop/restart + lease + signal.
  - GraphQL: `https://api.fly.io/graphql` shapes apps + orgs + members + IPs + certs + releases + organizations + billing.
  - Auth: Fly Personal Access Token (`flyctl auth token`) + Org-scoped tokens.
  - CLI: `flyctl` (apps / machines / volumes / secrets / postgres / scale / deploy / regions / ssh / wireguard / certs / proxy / logs).
  - Config: `fly.toml` (app + primary-region + http_service / services + checks + vm + mounts + env).
  - Webhooks: org-level event stream.

- **Vendor distinctive UX surfaces**:
  - "Fly Machines (micro-VMs)" — per-VM unit (Firecracker), boot in milliseconds.
  - "fly.toml" — config-as-code with primary-region + services + checks.
  - "Anycast edge" — single hostname routes to nearest healthy machine.
  - "6PN Private Network" — IPv6 mesh per app.
  - "Wireguard peering" — VPN access to private network.
  - "LiteFS" — distributed SQLite with primary/replica lease.
  - "Postgres clusters" — Stolon-based HA with primary/replica regions.
  - "Auto-Stop / Auto-Start Machines" — idle hibernation.
  - "Multi-Region Deploy" — `fly regions set`.
  - "GPU Machines" — A100 / L40S / A10 for inference.
  - "Volumes (NVMe)" — region-pinned persistent storage.
  - "Secrets" — `fly secrets set` (KMS-encrypted env).
  - "fly proxy" — local TCP/HTTP tunnel to remote machine.
  - "Releases (rolling / canary / bluegreen)" — deploy strategy.

- **Cedar permit shape** (compute + data + apigw + network + developer-experience + identity + compliance):
  ```
  permit(
    principal == Oyatie::User::"<fly-user-id>",
    action in [
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyAppCreate", Oyatie::Action::"FlyAppDestroy",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyMachineCreate", Oyatie::Action::"FlyMachineDestroy",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyMachineStart", Oyatie::Action::"FlyMachineStop",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyMachineRestart", Oyatie::Action::"FlyMachineCordon",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyVolumeCreate", Oyatie::Action::"FlyVolumeDestroy",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyVolumeSnapshot", Oyatie::Action::"FlyPostgresCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyPostgresAttach", Oyatie::Action::"FlyLiteFSConfig",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlySecretSet", Oyatie::Action::"FlyIPAllocate",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyCertIssue", Oyatie::Action::"FlyReleaseDeploy",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyOrgMemberInvite", Oyatie::Action::"FlyWireguardPeerCreate",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyGPUMachineCreate", Oyatie::Action::"FlySAMLConfig",
      Oyatie::Action::"FlyAuditLogExport"
    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyOrg::"<org-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyApp::"<app-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyMachine::"<machine-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyVolume::"<vol-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyPostgresCluster::"<pg-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyLiteFSCluster::"<litefs-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlySecret::"<secret-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyIP::"<ip-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyCert::"<cert-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyRelease::"<release-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyWireguardPeer::"<wg-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyGPUMachine::"<gpu-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::FlyAuditLogStream::"<stream-id>"
    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "app_destroy" || (principal.role in ["org_admin"] && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "machine_destroy" || principal.role in ["org_admin", "app_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "volume_destroy" || (principal.role in ["org_admin", "data_admin"] && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "postgres_create" || principal.role in ["org_admin", "data_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "secret_set" || principal.role in ["org_admin", "secrets_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "ip_allocate_v4_dedicated" || principal.role in ["org_admin", "network_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "release_deploy_production" || principal.role in ["org_admin", "release_manager"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "gpu_machine_create" || (principal.role in ["org_admin", "ml_admin"] && context.gpu_budget_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "saml_config" || (principal.role == "org_admin" && context.enterprise_plan == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "wireguard_peer_create" || principal.role in ["org_admin", "network_admin"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_log_export" || principal.role in ["compliance_admin", "org_admin"])
  };
  ```
  Per-jurisdiction packs: SOC-2 Type II; ISO-27001; GDPR + EU-DPF; HIPAA-BAA (Enterprise BAA-eligible).

- **Ontology projection**:
  - `fly.organization` → `oya-identity-org`.
  - `fly.app` → `oya-compute-app` (6PN-network preserved).
  - `fly.machine` → `oya-compute-micro-vm` (Firecracker semantics + state-machine preserved).
  - `fly.volume` → `oya-data-persistent-volume` (NVMe + region-pinned preserved).
  - `fly.postgres_cluster` → `oya-data-postgres-cluster` (multi-region HA preserved).
  - `fly.litefs_cluster` → `oya-data-distributed-sqlite-cluster`.
  - `fly.secret` → `oya-secrets-encrypted-env`.
  - `fly.ip_address` → `oya-network-ip-address`.
  - `fly.certificate` → `oya-apigw-tls-cert`.
  - `fly.service_spec` → `oya-apigw-service-spec` (concurrency + checks preserved).
  - `fly.release` → `oya-developer-experience-release` (4-strategy taxonomy preserved).
  - `fly.org_member` → `oya-identity-org-member`.
  - `fly.wireguard_peer` → `oya-network-wireguard-peer`.
  - `fly.webhook` → `oya-apigw-webhook`.
  - `fly.audit_event` → `oya-compliance-audit-log-event`.
  - `fly.gpu_machine` → `oya-compute-gpu-vm` (4-kind taxonomy preserved).

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (14 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `compute` + `data` + `apigw` + `network` + `developer-experience` + `identity` + `compliance` µservices with Fly-feature-parity.
  2. Export Fly org + apps + machines + volumes + postgres + litefs + secrets + IPs + certs + releases + wireguard via Machines REST + GraphQL + flyctl.
  3. Plan per-app migration cohorts (by region + workload class).
  4. Per-App: re-create with primary-region + 6PN-network alias.
  5. Per-Machine: re-create with guest{cpus + memory + gpu_kind} + image + services{port + protocol + handlers + concurrency + checks} + mounts + env + restart + schedule; preserve state-machine.
  6. Per-Volume: snapshot + restore to Oyatie persistent-volume; preserve region-pin + size + FS-type + encryption.
  7. Per-Postgres-Cluster: replicate with primary-region + replica-regions + HA-config.
  8. Per-LiteFS-Cluster: re-establish lease-type + replicas.
  9. Per-Secret: re-encrypt + re-publish (KMS rotation).
  10. Per-IP + Cert: re-allocate; ACME re-issue or custom-cert re-import.
  11. Per-Service-Spec: transpile to Oyatie service-spec with concurrency + checks preserved.
  12. Per-Release: replay deploy strategy (immediate / rolling / canary / bluegreen).
  13. Per-Wireguard-Peer + Webhook: re-establish.
  14. Decommission Fly per-app after 30-day shadow; Fly sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (15 specific failures):
  - Firecracker micro-VM boot semantics vs Oyatie micro-VM substrate (Cloud Hypervisor per ADR-0248/0254): per-machine boot-shim + golden-test.
  - Machine state-machine (8 states): per-machine state-replay.
  - 6PN IPv6 mesh semantics + per-app network-isolation: per-app 6PN re-alloc + DNS preserve.
  - Anycast edge routing (shortest-path to healthy machine): per-app anycast re-config.
  - LiteFS lease semantics (primary + replica lease): per-cluster lease-replay.
  - Postgres Stolon HA + primary-region failover: per-cluster HA-state preserve.
  - Volume region-pin semantics + NVMe local-disk vs network-disk: per-volume tier preserve.
  - Concurrency limit semantics (soft-limit / hard-limit / connections / requests): per-service spec preserve.
  - Auto-Stop / Auto-Start hibernation policy: per-machine policy preserve.
  - Wireguard private-network peer set: per-org peer set re-issue.
  - Multi-region deploy fly.toml (primary_region + regions): per-app region-set preserve.
  - GPU machine kind taxonomy (a100-40 / a100-80 / l40s / a10): per-GPU kind-mapping.
  - Release strategy (immediate / rolling / canary / bluegreen) parity: per-release strategy-replay.
  - Fly Proxy port/handler taxonomy (tcp / udp / http / https / tls + handlers): per-port preserve.
  - Audit Log retention (Enterprise 365-day): per-stream retention preserve.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via Machines REST + GraphQL + flyctl + audit.
  2. Plan 30-day shadow window with parallel anycast advertising.
  3. Migrate apps + machines + volumes + postgres + litefs + secrets.
  4. Migrate IPs + certs + service-specs + releases + wireguard-peers.
  5. Re-create fly.toml-equivalent Oyatie config + region-set.
  6. Re-establish 6PN-equivalent private network + Wireguard.
  7. Re-establish webhooks + audit-log-streams + SAML.
  8. Re-establish SOC-2 + ISO + GDPR + HIPAA + EU-DPF attestations.
  9. Cut anycast advertisement to Oyatie edge; preserve hostname + cert.
  10. Decommission Fly per-app after 30-day shadow; Fly sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `compute` + `data` + `apigw` + `network` + `developer-experience` + `identity` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `fly` + `fly-machines` + `fly-volumes` + `fly-postgres` + `fly-litefs` + `fly-6pn` + `fly-wireguard` + `fly-anycast` + `fly-gpu` are benchmark alias-only. The `compute` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Fly.io-equivalent micro-VM application-cloud surface.

### Section D-150 - Cloudflare Workers
- Vendor name and category: Cloudflare Workers (Cloudflare, Inc.) — Edge compute platform on 300+ POPs: Workers (V8 isolates) + Workers KV (eventually-consistent key-value) + Durable Objects (strongly-consistent stateful objects + WebSocket) + Workers D1 (SQLite at edge) + Workers Hyperdrive (DB connection pooler) + Workers Queues + Workers Cron Triggers + Workers AI (LLM inference at edge) + Vectorize (vector DB) + Workers Analytics Engine (time-series) + Pages (static + Functions) + Email Workers + Bindings (KV / R2 / D1 / DO / Queue / Service / Vectorize / AI / Browser) + Wrangler CLI + wrangler.toml + Smart Placement + Logpush + Workers Tail + Account + Member RBAC + SSO (SAML for Enterprise) + Workers for Platforms (multi-tenant).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `compute` (Workers V8 isolates + Durable Objects + AI) + `data` (KV + D1 + Vectorize + Analytics Engine) + `apigw` (Edge routing + Smart Placement) + `developer-experience` (Wrangler + wrangler.toml + bindings) + `intelligence` (Workers AI + Vectorize) + `messaging` (Queues + Email Workers) + `compliance` (SOC-2 + ISO + GDPR + HIPAA-eligible)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Free / Paid → **Silver**; Workers Unbound → **Gold**; Enterprise (SAML + Workers-for-Platforms + 99.99%-SLA + dedicated-IP + HIPAA-BAA) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `compute` (Workers + Durable Objects anchor); `data` (KV + D1 + Vectorize + Analytics Engine); `apigw` (edge routing + smart placement); `developer-experience` (Wrangler + bindings); `intelligence` (Workers AI); `messaging` (Queues); `compliance` (SOC-2 + ISO + GDPR + HIPAA).

- **Vendor data model and top objects** (Cloudflare Workers canonical edge-graph):
  - `Account` (Account_ID, Name, Plan, SSO-Config, Members[]).
  - `Worker_Script` (Script_ID, Account-Ref, Name, Source-Code, Compatibility-Date, Compatibility-Flags[], Bindings[], Migrations[]).
  - `Worker_Route` (Route_ID, Script-Ref, Pattern, Zone-Ref).
  - `Workers_KV_Namespace` (KV_NS_ID, Account-Ref, Title, Keys[]).
  - `Durable_Object_Namespace` (DO_NS_ID, Script-Ref, Class-Name, ID-Allocator {by_id / by_name / unique}).
  - `Durable_Object_Instance` (DO_ID, Namespace-Ref, Storage-Items[]).
  - `D1_Database` (D1_ID, Account-Ref, Name, Region-Preference, Tables[]).
  - `R2_Bucket_Binding` (Binding_ID, Script-Ref, Bucket-Name).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - REST API v4: `https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/` shapes `accounts/{id}/workers/scripts/{name}` + `workers/routes` + `workers/kv/namespaces` + `workers/queues` + `d1/database` + `vectorize/indexes` + `ai/run/@cf/{model}` + `pages/projects` + `workers/dispatch/namespaces`.

- **Workflow steps for displacement journey** (14 numbered steps):
  1. Provision Oyatie tenant + `compute` + `data` + `apigw` + `developer-experience` + `intelligence` + `messaging` + `compliance` µservices with Workers-feature-parity.
  2. Export Cloudflare account + scripts + routes + KV + DO + D1 + Queues + Vectorize + AI bindings + Analytics-Engine + Crons + Email-Workers + Hyperdrive + Pages + WFP via REST + Wrangler.
  3. Plan per-script migration cohorts (group by route-pattern).
  4. Per-Worker-Script: re-deploy to Oyatie edge-handler with compat-date + flags + bindings preserved.
  5. Per-Worker-Route: re-register with pattern + zone preserved.
  6. Per-KV-Namespace: replicate keys with eventual-consistency tier preserved.
  7. Per-Durable-Object-Namespace + Instance: re-create class + ID-allocator; replicate storage items; preserve actor-instance ID alias.
  8. Per-D1-Database: dump + restore with region-preference preserved.
  9. Per-Queue: re-create with consumer-settings + DLQ preserved.
  10. Per-Vectorize-Index: re-create + re-index with dimensions + metric preserved.
  11. Per-Workers-AI: transpile model-invocation to Oyatie intelligence-edge-model.
  12. Per-Analytics-Engine-Dataset: replay schema + retention.
  13. Per-Cron-Trigger + Email-Worker + Hyperdrive + Pages + WFP-Dispatcher: re-establish; OAuth + DNS re-grant.
  14. Decommission CF Workers per-script after 30-day shadow; CF Workers sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Failure modes** (15 specific failures):
  - V8-isolate runtime semantics + per-request CPU-ms limit: per-script CPU-budget shim.
  - Compatibility-date + compatibility-flags drift: per-script compat-pin preserve.
  - Durable Object strongly-consistent storage + WebSocket-hibernation: per-instance state-migration + lease replay.
  - KV eventual-consistency tier vs Oyatie KV strong-tier: per-namespace consistency-mode preserve.
  - D1 SQLite edge replication semantics: per-DB region-replication preserve.
  - Vectorize index metric + dimension semantics: per-index metric-mapping preserve.
  - Queue at-least-once delivery + DLQ + batch-size semantics: per-queue consumer-policy preserve.
  - Workers AI model catalog (`@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct` etc.): per-model mapping + golden eval.
  - Smart-Placement call-graph semantics: per-script placement-policy preserve.
  - Email-Workers catch-all + routing-rules: per-worker email-policy preserve.
  - Hyperdrive DB-pooler upstream auth: per-config secret rotation.
  - Pages Functions inline-Worker semantics: per-project function-mapping.
  - Workers for Platforms multi-tenant dispatch semantics: per-namespace tenant-isolation preserve.
  - Bindings DSL drift (kv_namespaces + r2_buckets + d1_databases + durable_objects + queues + vectorize + ai + service + analytics_engine_datasets): per-binding transpile.
  - Audit Log retention (Enterprise 365-day): per-stream retention preserve.

- **Migration playbook outline** (10 numbered steps):
  1. Inventory via CF REST + Wrangler + audit-log.
  2. Plan 30-day shadow window with parallel edge deploys.
  3. Migrate scripts + routes + KV + DO + D1 + Queues + Vectorize.
  4. Migrate Workers-AI + Analytics-Engine + Crons + Email-Workers.
  5. Migrate Hyperdrive + Pages + WFP-Dispatcher + bindings.
  6. Re-create wrangler.toml-equivalent Oyatie config per script.
  7. Re-establish webhooks + audit-log-streams + SAML.
  8. Re-establish SOC-2 + ISO + GDPR + HIPAA + EU-DPF attestations.
  9. Cut traffic via DNS to Oyatie edge; preserve route-pattern.
  10. Decommission CF Workers per-script after 30-day shadow; CF Workers sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

- **Naming justification**: `compute` + `data` + `apigw` + `developer-experience` + `intelligence` + `messaging` + `compliance` are canonical 12-layer enum entries per ADR-0105 (13-value canonical); `cloudflare-workers` + `workers-kv` + `durable-objects` + `workers-d1` + `workers-queues` + `vectorize` + `workers-ai` + `analytics-engine` + `cron-triggers` + `email-workers` + `hyperdrive` + `workers-for-platforms` are benchmark alias-only. The `compute` µservice (per ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout) is the canonical Cloudflare-Workers-equivalent edge-compute surface.

      Oyatie::Action::"WebflowFormPublish", Oyatie::Action::"WebflowLogicFlowEdit",
      Oyatie::Action::"WebflowLocaleEnable", Oyatie::Action::"WebflowCustomCodeInject",

    ],
    resource in [
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowWorkspace::"<ws-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowSite::"<site-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowPage::"<page-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowElement::"<el-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowClass::"<cls-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowSymbol::"<sy-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowCMSCollection::"<col-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowCMSItem::"<item-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowProduct::"<prod-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowOrder::"<order-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowMember::"<mem-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowAccessGroup::"<ag-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowPlan::"<pl-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowForm::"<form-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowLogicFlow::"<lf-id>",
      Oyatie::Resource::WebflowLocale::"<loc-id>",

    ]
  ) when {
    resource.tenant == principal.tenant &&
    principal.role in resource.allowed_roles &&
    (resource.kind != "site_delete" || (principal.role == "workspace_owner" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "site_publish_prod" || principal.role in ["editor", "designer", "workspace_owner"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "cms_collection_edit_schema" || (principal.role in ["designer", "workspace_owner"] && context.schema_change_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "product_create_high_value" || principal.role in ["store_admin", "workspace_owner"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "order_refund" || principal.role in ["store_admin", "workspace_owner"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "member_invite_external" || principal.role in ["member_admin", "workspace_owner"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "logic_flow_edit_destructive" || (principal.role in ["logic_admin"] && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "custom_code_inject_global" || (principal.role in ["designer", "workspace_owner"] && context.code_review_approved == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "webflow_ai_invoke" || (context.tenant_ai_optin == true && context.site_ai_optin == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "app_install_high_scope" || (principal.role == "workspace_owner" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "audit_log_export" || principal.role in ["compliance_admin", "workspace_owner"]) &&
    (resource.kind != "sso_configure" || (principal.role == "workspace_owner" && context.dual_control_approver_present == true)) &&
    (resource.kind != "private_instance_provision" || (principal.role == "enterprise_admin" && context.enterprise_contract_present == true))
  };

- **Failure modes** (14 specific failures):
  - Class-cascade + combo-class semantics (Webflow has class + combo-class system with state + media-query inheritance): per-class cascade-tree transpile + golden screenshot diff.
  - Symbol overrides (symbol instances with field-level overrides): per-symbol-instance override-map preserve.

  - Ecommerce variant matrix (attribute-combination explosion): per-product variant matrix recompute.

  - Localization per-locale CMS item override: per-item locale-override preserve.
  - Custom Code position (head / before_body / after_body / footer): per-injection position preserve.
  - DevLink React component sync (Designer-side ↔ React-side schema): per-component DevLink schema preserve + CI integration.
  - Webflow Apps OAuth scopes + iframe-context-passing: per-app re-grant + iframe-shim.
  - Webflow AI Site Builder + Copywriter + Page-Builder opt-in re-collect: per-site AI-policy ledger.

  3. Migrate workspaces + sites + pages + elements + classes + symbols.

  5. Migrate products + orders + customers + members + access-groups + plans.
  6. Migrate forms + form-submissions + Logic flows + locales.
  7. Migrate custom-code + interactions + apps + webhooks + DevLink components.
  8. Migrate Webflow-AI action-log as conformance ledger.
  9. Re-establish SOC-2 / GDPR / CCPA / PCI / EU-AI-Act attestations.
  10. Decommission Webflow per-site after 30-day shadow; DNS cutover; Webflow sunset; tenant ledger evidence per ADR-0247 + ADR-0250 + ADR-0251 §D-10.

### Section D-122 - Ghost Pro
- Vendor name and category: Ghost Foundation — Ghost Pro hosted membership + publishing platform (also OSS Ghost self-host): Ghost CMS (post + page + tag + author + Markdown-based rich-text via Lexical editor + Mobiledoc legacy + dynamic templates + Handlebars themes) + Ghost Members (subscriber list + Stripe-integrated paid memberships + tiered access + free + paid tiers + complimentary memberships + portal modal + member analytics + member events) + Ghost Newsletters (email delivery via Mailgun + open/click tracking + segmentation + replies + per-tier delivery) + Ghost Themes (Handlebars-based themes + Marketplace + custom-theme via API + theme-overrides) + Ghost Portal (signup + checkout + account flows as embedded modal) + Ghost Apps + Ghost Integrations (Slack + Zapier + Webhooks + custom-integrations) + Ghost Admin API + Ghost Content API + Ghost Webhooks + Lexical Editor (collaborative rich-text editor with cards + embeds + product cards + bookmarks + galleries + signup-card + email-only blocks) + Ghost Email Card + Ghost SEO (sitemap + robots + meta + structured-data) + Ghost Search (Sodo Search + native search) + Ghost Tips (subscriber tipping) + Ghost Recommendations (cross-site newsletter recommendations like Substack Network) + Ghost Comments (member-gated comments) + Bookmarks + Tags + Internal-Tags + Public-Tags + Routes.yaml (custom URL routing).
- Coverage tier: A (capability fit on `web` (publication + membership platform — Ghost is the OSS publishing leader; differentiated by membership + newsletter + Lexical editor + Handlebars themes + hosted-managed Ghost Pro + self-host OSS) + `commerce` (subscription tiers via Stripe + tipping + complimentary memberships) + `marketing` (Newsletters + segmentation + Recommendations cross-newsletter network) + `intelligence` (Ghost AI is light-touch — search + recommendation) + `apigw` (Admin API + Content API + Webhooks + JSON-API) + `developer-sdk` (Handlebars themes + Routes.yaml + Custom Integrations + Ghost-CLI + Ghost-OSS) + `compliance` (SOC-2 + GDPR + CCPA + PCI-DSS via Stripe) + `marketplace` (Ghost Themes Marketplace + Recommendations Network)). Capability-tier mapping per ADR-0316: Ghost-OSS self-host → **Silver** (free, you-host); Ghost Pro Starter / Creator → **Gold**; Ghost Pro Team / Business (custom-theme + priority-support + multi-author + larger member-count + Sodo-Search + custom-integrations + 99.99%-SLA + private-instance + audit-log + dedicated-CSM) → **Platinum**.
- Oyatie destination: `web` (publication + post + page + tag anchor); `commerce` (memberships + tiers + tipping); `marketing` (Newsletters + Recommendations); `apigw` (Admin + Content API + Webhooks); `developer-sdk` (Handlebars + Routes.yaml + Custom Integrations); `compliance` (SOC-2 + GDPR + PCI); `marketplace` (Themes + Recommendations Network).

- **Vendor primary APIs and endpoint shapes**:
  - Admin API: `https://<site>/ghost/api/admin/` resource shapes `posts` + `pages` + `tags` + `users` + `members` + `tiers` + `newsletters` + `subscriptions` + `comments` + `recommendations` + `webhooks` + `integrations` + `themes` + `images` + `media` + `files`.
  - Content API: `https://<site>/ghost/api/content/` read-only for `posts` + `pages` + `tags` + `authors` + `tiers` + `settings`.
  - Auth: Admin API uses JWT signed with Admin-API-Key + Secret; Content API uses Content-API-Key in query.

  - CLI: `ghost` for self-hosted Ghost-OSS.
